examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用泥在自己的脸上涂抹。
examples.english_sentence: He smeared mud on his face.

english_meaning: to alter, to tamper with, to doctor, to change (writing or documents)
explanation_mandarin: 用笔或其它方式修改、更改文字或数字。
explanation_english: To alter or modify writing or numbers by erasing, overwriting, or making changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以喺正式文件上面隨便塗改㗎。

explanation_english: A stationery item used to cover up writing mistakes with a strip of white tape.

examples.english_sentence: This correction tape is very good, it's thin and adheres well.

english_meaning: correction fluid, white-out, liquid paper

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用咗好多塗改液，份功課都花晒。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 请借我一支涂改液。
examples.english_sentence: Please lend me a bottle of correction fluid.

english_meaning: to sully, to defile, to smear, to tarnish
explanation_mandarin: 弄脏，玷污，比喻损害名誉。
explanation_english: To make something dirty or impure; to defile; to tarnish someone's reputation or honour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好塗汙人哋嘅名聲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tou4 wu1 jan4 dei6 ge3 ming4 seng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要玷污别人的名声了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tarnish other people's reputation.

examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 cheung4 bei2 di1 jau4 chat1 tou4 wu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙被油漆弄脏了。
examples.english_sentence: The wall was smeared with paint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為塗汙咗我哋成個團隊嘅聲譽。

examples.english_sentence: His behaviour tarnished the reputation of our entire team.

english_meaning: to smear, to deface, to stain, to dirty
explanation_mandarin: 用脏东西涂抹，使之变得不干净。
explanation_english: To smear or deface something, making it dirty or unclean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺牆上面塗污呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 cheung4 soeng6 min6 tou4 wu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在墙上涂抹呀！
examples.english_sentence: Don't smear on the wall!

examples.english_sentence: These graffiti have defaced the whole street.

english_meaning: to apply rouge and powder (makeup); to prettify; to whitewash; to gloss over
explanation_mandarin: 本义是涂上胭脂和粉末，指化妆。比喻为了掩盖真相而进行粉饰。
explanation_english: Literally, to apply rouge and powder (makeup). Figuratively, to whitewash or gloss over something, often to conceal the truth or make something appear better than it is.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日都係塗脂抹粉，呃啲唔識嘢嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 tou4 zi1 mut3 fan2, aak1 di1 m4 sik1 je5 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是涂脂抹粉，欺骗那些不懂的人。
examples.english_sentence: They are always whitewashing things to deceive people who don't know any better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再幫佢哋塗脂抹粉啦，事實就係咁差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 bong1 keoi5 dei6 tou4 zi1 mut3 fan2 laa1, si6 sat6 zau6 hai6 gam3 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再帮他们涂脂抹粉了，事实就是这么糟糕。
examples.english_sentence: Stop whitewashing for them, the truth is that it's so bad.

english_meaning: paint job, coating, finishing
explanation_mandarin: 指在物体表面涂上油漆或其他材料，使其具有装饰、保护或其他功能的过程或结果。
explanation_english: The process of applying paint, coating, or finishing to the surface of an object for decoration, protection, or other purposes; also refers to the finished appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車做咗個新嘅塗裝，望落去精神好多。

examples.english_sentence: The car got a new paint job and looks much better now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機嘅塗裝好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 ge3 tou4 zong1 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这架飞机的涂装很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The airplane has a very distinctive paint scheme.

english_meaning: graffiti, to doodle, scribble
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共场合或私人场所随意书写或绘画的行为，通常未经许可。
explanation_english: To write or draw randomly, often without permission, in public or private places.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲細路成日喺牆上面塗鴉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 sai3 lou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 cheung4 seung6 min6 tou4 ngaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们总是喜欢在墙上涂鸦。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are always scribbling on the walls.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里乱涂乱画！
examples.english_sentence: Don't scribble randomly here!

english_meaning: pond, pool; (slang) a 'spare tire' or backup option in dating/relationships
explanation_mandarin: 指小型的水池。在感情方面，指备胎。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a small body of standing water, a pond or pool. In slang, it refers to someone kept as a 'spare tire' or backup option, particularly in dating or relationships.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個公園有個大塘，好多人喺度餵魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gung1 jyun2 jau5 go3 daai6 tong4, hou2 do1 jan4 hai2 dou6 wai2 yu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公园里有一个大池塘，很多人在那里喂鱼。
examples.english_sentence: There's a big pond in the park, and a lot of people are feeding the fish there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做人哋嘅塘呀，要識得保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 tong4 aa3, jiu3 sik1 dak1 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做别人的备胎啊，要懂得保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone's 'spare tire', you need to know how to protect yourself.

english_meaning: To show the bottom of the pond; to give oneself away; to reveal one's flaws or secrets; to let the cat out of the bag
explanation_mandarin: 比喻隐藏的事情或真相暴露出来，就像池塘底部显露出来一样。
explanation_english: This idiom figuratively means that a hidden secret or deception has been revealed, similar to the bottom of a pond being exposed. It can also refer to revealing one's true intentions or flaws.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己做得好隱蔽，點知咁快就塘底凸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 zou6 dak1 hou2 yan2 bai3, dim2 zi1 gam3 faai3 zau6 tong4 dai2 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己做得很好，很隐蔽，没想到这么快就露馅了。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he was being discreet, but he gave himself away so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份假report嘅數字穿崩，即刻塘底凸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gaa2 report1 ge3 sou3 zi6 chuan1 bang1, zik1 hak1 tong4 dai2 dat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那份假报告的数字露出了漏洞，立刻就露馅了。
examples.english_sentence: The numbers in his fake report had loopholes, so he was immediately exposed.

english_meaning: bottom of the pond; the worst; the bottom rung; at the bottom
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是池塘底部的泥土。引申为形容某事物或某人在群体中处于最底层，最差的水平，没有价值。
explanation_english: Literally, it means the mud at the bottom of a pond. Metaphorically, it describes something or someone being at the very bottom of a group, being the worst, or having no value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日話我係塘底泥，做乜都唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 waa6 ngo5 hai6 tong4 dai2 nai4, zou6 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说我是垫底的，做什么都不行。
examples.english_sentence: They always say I'm at the bottom, and can't do anything right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考到塘底泥，真係好灰心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 ngo5 haau2 dou3 tong4 dai2 nai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 fui1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考到了最差的成绩，真的很灰心。
examples.english_sentence: I got the worst score in this exam, I'm really disheartened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少佢，可能佢遲啲會鹹魚翻生，唔再係塘底泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, ho2 nang4 keoi5 ci4 di1 wui5 haam4 yu2 faan1 saang1, m4 zoi3 hai6 tong4 dai2 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，也许他以后会咸鱼翻身，不再是垫底的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, maybe he will turn things around later and no longer be at the bottom.

jyutping: tong4 dai2 nai4 – seoi2 gon1 zi3 gin3
english_meaning: The truth comes out when the water dries up; the truth will be revealed eventually.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻真相最终会显露出来，坏人坏事终究会被发现。
explanation_english: A metaphor for the truth eventually coming out; bad deeds will inevitably be discovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使咁驚嘅，塘底泥——水乾至見，佢哋嘅陰謀總有一日會俾人揭穿嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 geng1 ge3, tong4 dai2 nai4 – seoi2 gon1 zi3 gin3, keoi5 dei6 ge3 jam1 mau4 zung2 jau5 jat1 jat6 wui5 bei2 jan4 kit3 cyun1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用那么害怕，水落石出，他们的阴谋总有一天会被人揭穿的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't have to be so scared; the truth will come out. Their conspiracy will be exposed one day.

mandarin_meaning: 垫底的石头；比喻垫底的人或物
english_meaning: Bottom stone; bottom of the heap; someone/something at the very bottom, often supporting others
explanation_mandarin: 原本指池塘底部的石头，引申为位于最底层，支撑着上面的人或事物的人或物。比喻处境最差，承受压力最大，但往往默默付出，不为人知的人或事物。
explanation_english: Originally referring to the stones at the bottom of a pond. Figuratively, it refers to someone or something at the very bottom, supporting those above. It describes someone or something in the worst situation, bearing the most pressure, but often making contributions quietly and without recognition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫公司捱更抵夜，但係永遠都係塘底石，冇人欣賞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 gung1 si1 ngaai4 gang1 dai2 je2, daan6 hai6 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 tong4 dai2 sek6, mou5 jan4 jan1 soeng2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是帮公司加班熬夜，但是永远都是垫底的人，没有人欣赏他。
examples.english_sentence: He always works overtime for the company, but he's always at the bottom of the heap, and no one appreciates him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少啲塘底石，冇佢哋默默耕耘，上邊啲嘢都搞唔掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 di1 tong4 dai2 sek6, mou5 keoi5 dei6 mak6 mak6 geng1 wan4, soeng6 bin1 di1 je5 dou1 gaau2 m4 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看那些垫底的人，没有他们默默耕耘，上面的事情都搞不定。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate those at the bottom, without their quiet hard work, the things above wouldn't be successful.

english_meaning: Unfashionable, unsophisticated, boorish; a rural area or small town
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：形容人或事物不时尚、不时髦，带有土气，或者形容地方比较落后、乡下。名词：指乡下地方。
explanation_english: Adjective: Describing a person or thing as unfashionable, unsophisticated, or boorish. Noun: Referring to a rural area or small town.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著衫好塘廈㗎，成日都著啲過時嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 saam1 hou2 tong4 haa6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 zoek3 di1 gwo3 si4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿衣服很土气，总是穿一些过时的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He dresses very unfashionably, always wearing outdated clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇少佢，佢雖然喺塘廈出身，但係好有能力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 keoi5, keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hai2 tong4 haa6 cheot1 san1, daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看他，他虽然在乡下地方长大，但是很有能力。
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate him, although he grew up in a rural area, he is very capable.

mandarin_meaning: 内部循环；自己人提拔自己人
english_meaning: A closed loop; insider promoting insiders; keeping it within the same small circle
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在狭小的范围内循环，也指自己人提拔自己人，没有引进新的力量或人才。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where things are kept within a closed loop or small circle. It often refers to a situation where insiders promote each other, without bringing in fresh talent or new perspectives from outside the existing group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司升職都係塘水滾塘魚，永遠都係嗰班人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sing1 zik1 dou1 hai6 tong4 seoi2 gwan2 tong4 jyu4, wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 go2 baan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司升职都是内部循环，永远都是那帮人。
examples.english_sentence: Promotions in this company are always an inside job, it's always the same group of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目都係塘水滾塘魚，搵返啲舊客戶做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 dou1 hai6 tong4 seoi2 gwan2 tong4 jyu4, wan2 faan1 di1 gau6 haak3 wu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目还是内部循环，找回一些老客户来做。
examples.english_sentence: This project is just sticking to the same old circle, going back to the old clients.

english_meaning: Catfish; A freeloader; A person who sticks around
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指塘鲺，一种鱼。2. (俗语) 比喻喜欢粘着别人、占别人便宜的人，类似于“寄生虫”。
explanation_english: 1. Literally means catfish. 2. (Slang) Refers to a freeloader; someone who sticks around or leeches off others. The term is often used to describe someone who benefits from others' efforts without contributing much themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺我屋企食飯，真係一條塘虱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 ngo5 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6, zan1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 tong4 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是在我家吃饭，真是一条塘鲺（占便宜的人）。
examples.english_sentence: He always eats at my house, he's such a freeloader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做塘虱，自己都要出啲力啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 tong4 sat1, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 chut1 di1 lik6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做寄生虫，自己也要出点力啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a freeloader, you need to contribute something yourself.

english_meaning: Toad
explanation_mandarin: 一种两栖动物，身体表面有疣状突起。
explanation_english: An amphibian with a warty skin and relatively short legs, typically hopping rather than running.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻塘蝞跳得好快啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 tong4 lai4 tiu3 dak1 hou2 faai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只癞蛤蟆跳得好快啊！
examples.english_sentence: That toad is hopping very fast!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 鄉下地方好多塘蝞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heung1 ha5 dei6 fong1 hou2 do1 tong4 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 乡下地方有很多癞蛤蟆。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of toads in the countryside.

mandarin_meaning: 水虱; 形容人迟钝、反应慢
english_meaning: Water louse; (figurative) slow-witted, dull, slow to react
explanation_mandarin: 塘蝨原本是指一种水生昆虫。 在粤语中， 塘蝨也用来形容一个人反应迟钝、愚笨、反应慢。
explanation_english: Originally, '塘蝨' refers to a type of aquatic insect (water louse). In Cantonese, it is also used figuratively to describe someone who is slow-witted, dull, or slow to react.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁塘蝨嘅，教咗你咁多次都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 tong4 sat1 ge3, gaau3 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨，教了你这么多次都不会。
examples.english_sentence: You're so slow, I've taught you so many times and you still don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁塘蝨啦，快啲諗吓計仔啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tong4 sat1 laa1, faai3 di1 lam2 haa5 gai3 zai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么迟钝了，快点想想办法！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow-witted, quickly think of a solution!

english_meaning: onlooker, bystander, someone who observes without participating
explanation_mandarin: 指在一旁观看，不参与其中的人。通常带有袖手旁观，没有提供帮助的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who observes from the sidelines without participating. It often carries the implication of standing by and not offering help.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘈交，我淨係做個塘邊鶴，唔敢插手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cou4 gaau1, ngo5 zing6 hai6 zou6 go3 tong4 bin1 hok6, m4 gam2 chaap3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵架，我只是做一个旁观者，不敢插手。
examples.english_sentence: They were arguing, I just acted as an onlooker and didn't dare to intervene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做塘邊鶴啦，幫下手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 tong4 bin1 hok6 laa1, bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做旁观者了，帮帮忙吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a bystander, give us a hand!

english_meaning: Backup option, a person kept as an alternative romantic partner
explanation_mandarin: 指被当做恋爱备胎的人，不一定是正式的恋爱对象，但对方有需要的时候会联络你。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is kept as a backup romantic option. They are not necessarily in a formal relationship, but the other person will contact them when they need something or as a fallback plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做人哋嘅塘魚啦，佢根本唔認真對待你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 jan4 dei6 ge3 tong4 jyu2 laa1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 jing6 zan1 deoi3 doi6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做别人的备胎了，他根本不认真对待你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be someone's backup option, he doesn't treat you seriously at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢次次失戀都搵我，擺明當我係塘魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci3 ci3 sat1 lyun2 dou1 wan2 ngo5, baai2 ming4 dong3 ngo5 hai6 tong4 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每次失恋都来找我，摆明把我当备胎。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes to me after a breakup, clearly treating me as a backup option.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做塘魚啦，揾返個真心對你好嘅人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 tong4 jyu2 laa1, wan2 faan1 go3 zan1 sam1 deoi3 nei5 hou2 ge3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做备胎了，找回一个真心对你好的人吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a backup option anymore, find someone who truly treats you well.

mandarin_meaning: 塘鹅 (一种鸟); 指反应慢，笨拙的人
english_meaning: Pelican (bird); (slang) slow-witted, clumsy person
explanation_mandarin: 塘鹅是一种鸟类。 在粤语俚语中，用来形容反应迟钝、笨手笨脚的人。
explanation_english: A pelican is a type of bird. In Cantonese slang, it's used to describe someone who is slow-witted or clumsy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日跌嘢，真係好似隻塘鵝咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dit3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 zoek3 tong4 ngo4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是掉东西，真像只笨鹅。
examples.english_sentence: He's always dropping things, he's really like a clumsy pelican.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁塘鵝啦，快啲諗吓計啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tong4 ngo4 laa1, faai3 di1 lam2 haa5 gai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么迟钝了，快点想想办法吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slow-witted, think of a solution quickly!

english_meaning: to be in a daze; to be stunned; to be dumbfounded; to stare blankly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因惊讶、迷惑等原因而神情呆滞，不知所措的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a person appearing stunned or dumbfounded due to surprise, confusion, or other reasons, resulting in a blank stare and being at a loss for words or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到中咗頭獎，即刻成隻塘鶴噉企喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 zung3 zo2 tau4 zoeng2, zik1 hak1 seng4 zek3 tong4 hok6 gam2 kei5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他听到中了头奖，立刻像傻了一样站在那里。
examples.english_sentence: When he heard he won the first prize, he immediately stood there dumbfounded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日塘鶴噉，做嘢醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tong4 hok6 gam2, zou6 je5 sing2 sing2 deng6 deng6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是发呆，工作时要机灵点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be in a daze, be more alert when working!

english_meaning: clumsy; awkward; unskilled; unfamiliar (with something)
explanation_mandarin: 形容动作或技巧不熟练、生疏。 也可形容对某事物不熟悉。
explanation_english: Describes movements or skills that are clumsy, awkward, or unskilled. Can also describe being unfamiliar with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗幾日琴啫，梗係塘𧋦啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 gei2 jat6 kam4 ze1, gang2 hai6 tong4 lei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学了几天钢琴而已，当然不熟练啦。
examples.english_sentence: He's only been learning piano for a few days, of course he's clumsy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好耐冇揸車，有啲塘𧋦啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 noi6 mou5 zaa1 ce1, jau5 di1 tong4 lei4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很久没开车了，有点生疏啊。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't driven in a long time, I'm a bit rusty.

synonyms: 笨手笨腳 (bun6 sau2 bun6 goek3)

english_meaning: grave, tomb
explanation_mandarin: 指埋葬死者的地方，坟墓。
explanation_english: A burial site for the deceased; a grave or tomb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去拜山，清理吓阿爺嘅塚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 baai3 saan1, cing1 lei5 haa5 aa3 je4 ge3 cung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去扫墓，清理一下爷爷的坟墓。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to visit the grave and clean up my grandfather's tomb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好多舊塚，睇落好陰森。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 do1 gau6 cung2, tai2 lok6 hou2 jam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多旧坟墓，看起来很阴森。
examples.english_sentence: There are many old tombs here, it looks quite gloomy.

english_meaning: to block; to stuff; to cram; congested
explanation_mandarin: 指用东西堵住，填满；也指交通拥堵。
explanation_english: To block up, fill, or cram something; can also refer to traffic congestion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞住個窿佢啦，唔係漏水呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 zyu6 go3 lung1 keoi5 laa1, m4 hai6 lau6 seoi2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把那个洞塞住吧，不然会漏水。
examples.english_sentence: Block that hole, or it'll leak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條隧道塞車塞到死，唔知幾時先到屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 seoi6 dou6 sak1 che1 sak1 dou3 sei2, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 dou3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 隧道堵车堵死了，不知道什么时候才能到家。
examples.english_sentence: The tunnel is so congested, I don't know when I'll get home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好塞咁多嘢入去個袋度啦，會爛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sak1 gam3 do1 je5 jap6 heoi3 go3 doi2 dou6 laa1, wui5 laan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要塞这么多东西进包里了，会烂的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stuff so many things into the bag, it will break.

english_meaning: Senegal
explanation_mandarin: 非洲国家名，塞内加尔。
explanation_english: Senegal, a country in West Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對塞內加爾嘅足球隊好有印象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 sak1 noi6 gaa1 ji5 ge3 zuk1 kau4 deoi2 hou2 jau5 jam3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对塞内加尔的足球队印象深刻。
examples.english_sentence: I'm very impressed with the Senegal football team.

english_meaning: Outside the Great Wall, frontier region
explanation_mandarin: 指长城以外的地区，通常指北方边境地区。
explanation_english: Refers to the area outside the Great Wall, usually referring to the northern frontier regions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一路向北行，去到塞外嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 lou6 hoeng3 bak1 haang4, heoi3 dou3 sak1 ngoi6 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一路向北走，去到了塞外的地方。
examples.english_sentence: They traveled north all the way to the frontier region outside the Great Wall.

english_meaning: Sierra Leone
explanation_mandarin: 西非国家名，塞拉利昂。
explanation_english: A country in West Africa, Sierra Leone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗塞拉利昂做義工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 sak1 laai1 lei6 ong4 zou6 ji6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了塞拉利昂做义工。
examples.english_sentence: He went to Sierra Leone to volunteer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對塞拉利昂嘅歷史唔係好了解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 sak1 laai1 lei6 ong4 ge3 lik6 si2 m4 hai6 hou2 liu5 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对塞拉利昂的历史不是很了解。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know much about the history of Sierra Leone.

english_meaning: Cyprus
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲的一个岛国，位于地中海东部。
explanation_english: An island country in Europe, located in the eastern Mediterranean Sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年暑假去塞浦路斯度假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 syu2 ga3 heoi3 sak1 pou4 lo4 si1 dou6 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年暑假去塞浦路斯度假。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to Cyprus for vacation this summer.

english_meaning: Serbia
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲东南部的一个国家。
explanation_english: A country in Southeastern Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會飛去塞爾維亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 fei1 heoi3 sak1 ji5 wai4 aa3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会飞去塞尔维亚旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I will fly to Serbia for travel tomorrow.

jyutping: sak1 ji5 wai4 aa3 gap6 hak1 saan1
english_meaning: Serbia and Montenegro
explanation_mandarin: 塞尔维亚和黑山，是一个曾经存在的国家，于2003年由塞尔维亚和黑山共和国组成，于2006年解体。
explanation_english: Serbia and Montenegro was a country that existed from 2003 to 2006. It was formed from the republics of Serbia and Montenegro and dissolved when Montenegro declared its independence in 2006.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞爾維亞及黑山喺2006年解體，變成咗兩個獨立嘅國家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ji5 wai4 aa3 gap6 hak1 saan1 hai2 ji6 ling4 ling4 luk6 nin4 gaai2 tai2, bin3 sing4 zo2 loeng5 go3 duk6 laap6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 塞尔维亚和黑山在2006年解体，变成了两个独立的国家。
examples.english_sentence: Serbia and Montenegro dissolved in 2006, becoming two independent countries.

english_meaning: To plug a hole; to patch up; to find excuses (to cover up a mistake or fault); to gloss over
explanation_mandarin: 本义是堵塞洞穴，引申为用借口或不充分的方法掩盖问题、错误或漏洞。也可以指做一些零碎的修补工作，以掩盖更大的问题。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to plug a hole or cave. Figuratively, it refers to using excuses or inadequate methods to cover up problems, mistakes, or loopholes. It can also mean doing small, patchwork fixes to conceal a larger underlying issue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係度塞竇窿，永遠都唔解決根本問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 sak1 dau3 lung1, wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 gaai2 kyut3 gan1 bun2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是敷衍了事，永远不解决根本问题。
examples.english_sentence: He's always just patching things up and never solves the root cause of the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再塞竇窿啦，嗱嗱聲搵個人嚟整好佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 sak1 dau3 lung1 laa1, naa4 naa4 seng1 wan2 go3 jan4 lai4 zing2 hou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再找借口搪塞了，赶快找个人来修好它。
examples.english_sentence: Stop making excuses and get someone to fix it properly quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司嘅財政有問題，佢地只係識得塞竇窿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 jau5 man6 tai4, keoi5 dei6 zi2 hai6 sik1 dak1 sak1 dau3 lung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的财政有问题，他们只会掩盖漏洞。
examples.english_sentence: The company's finances are in trouble, and they only know how to gloss over the problems.

mandarin_meaning: 塞翁失马，焉知非福 (sài wēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú)
english_meaning: A blessing in disguise; a loss may turn out to be a gain; misfortune may be a blessing.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻一时虽然受到损失，也许反而因此能得到好处。语出《淮南子‧人间训》。
explanation_english: An idiom originating from a story about an old man (塞翁) who lost his horse (失馬). What initially appeared to be bad luck ultimately led to good fortune. It implies that misfortune can sometimes lead to a blessing or unexpected good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔合格都唔使咁灰心，塞翁失馬吖嘛，或者俾你發現自己真正嘅興趣呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3 dou1 m4 sai2 gam3 fui1 sam1, sak1 jung1 sat1 maa5 a1 maa3, waak6 ze2 bei2 nei5 faat3 hin3 zi6 gei2 zan1 zeng3 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 ne1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格也不用这么灰心，塞翁失马嘛，也许让你发现自己真正的兴趣呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged about failing this exam. It's a blessing in disguise, maybe it will help you discover your true interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失咗份工，但係塞翁失馬，之後搵到份人工更高嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 zo2 fan6 gung1, daan6 hai6 sak1 jung1 sat1 maa5, zi1 hau6 wan2 dou2 fan6 jan4 gung1 gang3 gou1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失去了工作，但是塞翁失马，之后找到一份工资更高的。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his job, but it was a blessing in disguise, and he later found a job with a higher salary.

jyutping: sak1 yung1 sat1 maa5, jin1 zi1 fei1 fuk1
mandarin_meaning: 塞翁失马，焉知非福 (sài wēng shī mǎ, ān zhī fēi fú)
english_meaning: A loss may turn out to be a blessing in disguise; a misfortune may be a blessing in disguise; every cloud has a silver lining.
explanation_mandarin: 出自《淮南子·人间训》。比喻一时虽然受到损失，也许反而因此能得到好处。也指坏事在一定条件下可变为好事。
explanation_english: This idiom originates from the book *Huainanzi*. It means that a loss may turn out to be a blessing in disguise. It also suggests that bad things, under certain conditions, can be transformed into good things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然今次考試唔合格，但係塞翁失馬，焉知非福，可能令你有機會重新檢視自己嘅學習方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, daan6 hai6 sak1 yung1 sat1 maa5, jin1 zi1 fei1 fuk1, ho2 nang4 ling6 nei5 jau5 gei1 wui5 cung4 san1 gim2 si5 zi6 gei2 ge3 hok6 zaap6 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这次考试不及格，但是塞翁失马，焉知非福，可能让你有机会重新审视自己的学习方法。
examples.english_sentence: Although you failed this exam, a loss may turn out to be a blessing in disguise. Maybe it will give you a chance to re-evaluate your study methods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥失業之後好唔開心，但係塞翁失馬，焉知非福，佢之後搵到份人工更高嘅工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 sat1 yip6 zi1 hau6 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1, daan6 hai6 sak1 yung1 sat1 maa5, jin1 zi1 fei1 fuk1, keui5 zi1 hau6 wan2 dou3 fan6 yan4 gung1 gang3 gou1 ge3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥失业之后很不开心，但是塞翁失马，焉知非福，他之后找到一份工资更高的工作。
examples.english_sentence: My brother was very unhappy after losing his job, but a misfortune may be a blessing in disguise. He later found a job with a higher salary.

english_meaning: Seychelles
explanation_mandarin: 非洲东部岛国塞舌尔
explanation_english: Seychelles, an island country in East Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋計劃緊去塞舌爾度蜜月呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 gan2 heoi3 sak1 sit6 ji5 dou6 mat6 jyut6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们正在计划去塞舌尔度蜜月啊。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to go to Seychelles for our honeymoon.

mandarin_meaning: 堵塞漏洞的人，没用的人，废物
english_meaning: Someone who plugs holes, but figuratively means someone useless, a waste of space
explanation_mandarin: 本意指堵塞洞口的人，引申为没有用的人，废物。形容某人能力低下，不能胜任工作或解决问题，甚至反而会添乱。
explanation_english: Literally means someone who plugs holes (like filling a crack in a wall), but figuratively refers to someone who is useless or a waste of space. It describes someone incompetent, unable to handle tasks or solve problems, and may even cause more trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁蠢，真係成日都喺度塞豆窿！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ceon2, zan1 hai6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 sak1 dau2 lung4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨，简直每天都在那里帮倒忙！
examples.english_sentence: You're so stupid, you're just always making things worse!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日塞豆窿，真係唔知點解老細仲要留佢喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 sak1 dau2 lung4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 lou5 sai3 zung6 jiu3 lau4 keoi5 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是帮倒忙，真不知道老板为什么还要留他在这里。
examples.english_sentence: He always messes things up at work, I really don't know why the boss still keeps him around.

english_meaning: traffic jam, to be stuck in traffic
explanation_mandarin: 指道路上的车辆过多，导致交通阻塞，车辆行驶缓慢或停滞。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where there are too many vehicles on the road, causing traffic congestion and vehicles to move slowly or stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝返工塞車塞到死，遲咗成個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 faan1 gung1 sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 sei2, ci4 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上上班堵车堵死了，迟到了一个小时。
examples.english_sentence: This morning I was stuck in terrible traffic on my way to work, I was an hour late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你睇睇地圖，邊條路唔會塞車？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 tai2 tai2 dei6 tou4, bin1 tiu4 lou6 m4 wui5 sak1 ce1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你看看地图，哪条路不会堵车？
examples.english_sentence: Please check the map, which road is not congested?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 假日嘅時候，去郊區條路成日都塞車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 jat6 ge3 si4 hau6, heoi3 gaau1 keoi1 tiu4 lou6 seng4 jat6 dou1 sak1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假日的时候，去郊区的路经常都堵车。
examples.english_sentence: During holidays, the road to the suburbs is often congested.

english_meaning: To benefit you, to give you an advantage (often used sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是把钱塞进你的口袋。比喻让你获得利益，占到便宜，有时含有讽刺意味，指对方可能通过不正当手段获取利益。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to stuff money into your pocket.' It figuratively means to benefit you or give you an advantage. It often carries a sarcastic connotation, implying that someone might be profiting through illegitimate means.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁樣做咪即係塞錢入佢哋袋囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 jik1 hai6 sak1 cin2 jap6 keoi5 dei6 doi2 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做不就是把钱塞进他们的口袋里吗？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't doing it this way just stuffing money into their pockets?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪塞錢入個發展商袋囉，對我哋有咩好處？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 sak1 cin2 jap6 go3 faat3 zin2 soeng1 doi2 lo1, deoi3 ngo5 dei6 jau5 me1 hou2 chu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是把钱塞进开发商的口袋里吗，对我们有什么好处？
examples.english_sentence: Isn't doing it this way just lining the developer's pockets? What benefits do we get?

english_meaning: to fill in; to stuff; to pack
explanation_mandarin: 把空缺的地方塞满。
explanation_english: To fill a space or gap; to stuff or pack something into a container.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫我塡咗佢吖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 ngo5 tin4 zo2 keoi5 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮我把它填上吧。
examples.english_sentence: Could you please fill it in for me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要塡飽個肚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tin4 baau2 go3 tou5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们得先填饱肚子。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fill our stomachs first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力咁塡補自己嘅不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 tin4 bou2 zi6 gei2 ge3 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力地填补自己的不足。
examples.english_sentence: He works very hard to make up for his shortcomings.

english_meaning: to fill; to stuff; to pack
explanation_mandarin: 把空缺的地方塞满。
explanation_english: To fill a void or empty space; to stuff or pack something into a space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將啲表格塡晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 di1 biu2 gaak3 tin1 saai3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把这些表格全部填完。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fill out all of these forms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞啲衫嚟塡滿個喼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 di1 saam1 lai4 tin1 mun5 go3 gip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿一些衣服来填满那个箱子。
examples.english_sentence: He used some clothes to fill the suitcase.

english_meaning: to fill; to stuff; to pad
explanation_mandarin: 把东西填满空隙。
explanation_english: To fill something empty, to stuff, to pad something to make it full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要用啲棉花嚟塡充個公仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 yung6 di1 min4 faa1 lai4 tin4 cung1 go3 gung1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要用一些棉花来填充这个公仔。
examples.english_sentence: We need to use some cotton to stuff this doll.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞啲文件嚟塡充返個文件夾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 di1 man4 gin2 lai4 tin4 cung1 faan1 go3 man4 gin2 gaap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿些文件来填充回文件夹。
examples.english_sentence: He took some documents to fill up the file folder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個枕頭唔夠塡充，瞓得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zam2 tau4 m4 gau3 tin4 cung1, fan3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个枕头不够填充，睡得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This pillow isn't padded enough, it's uncomfortable to sleep on.

english_meaning: to fill a gap; to patch up a hole; to cover a deficit; to plug a leak
explanation_mandarin: 本义是填补坑洞，引申为填补不足或空缺，尤指填补财务上的亏空。
explanation_english: Literally means to fill a hole or pit. Figuratively, it means to fill a deficiency or gap, especially a financial deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次投資失利，要拎啲錢出嚟塡凼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, jiu3 ling1 di1 cin2 chut1 lai4 tin4 tam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资失利，要拿出一些钱来填补亏空。
examples.english_sentence: This investment failed, so we need to take out some money to cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日使突錢，要屋企人幫佢塡凼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sai2 dat6 cin2, jiu3 uk1 kei2 jan4 bong1 keoi5 tin4 tam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是花超预算，需要家人帮他填补亏空。
examples.english_sentence: He always overspends and needs his family to help him cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司業績唔好，要諗辦法塡凼先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jip6 jik1 m4 hou2, jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 tin4 tam3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司业绩不好，要想想办法填补亏空才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company's performance is not good, we need to think of ways to cover the deficit first.

english_meaning: to fill in (a form), to declare, to report (information)
explanation_mandarin: 填写并上报表格或者信息。
explanation_english: To fill in a form or report information to authorities or relevant parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住要準時塡報稅表啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 jiu3 zeon2 si4 tin4 bou3 seoi3 biu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记住要准时填写报税表啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to fill in your tax form on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司要我哋塡報每日嘅工作進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 tin4 bou3 mui5 jat6 ge3 gung1 zok3 zeon3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司要求我们填写每日的工作进度。
examples.english_sentence: The company requires us to report our daily work progress.

english_meaning: Crossword puzzle
explanation_mandarin: 一种文字游戏，在一个方格图中根据提示填写字词。
explanation_english: A word puzzle that takes the form of a rectangular grid of white and shaded squares. The goal is to fill the white squares with letters, forming words or phrases, by solving clues which lead to the answers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意玩塡字遊戲，可以考驗我嘅詞彙量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waan2 tin4 zi6 jau4 hei3, ho2 ji5 haau2 jim6 ngo5 ge3 ci4 wui6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢玩填字游戏，可以考验我的词汇量。
examples.english_sentence: I really like playing crossword puzzles, it can test my vocabulary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚得閒，不如一齊玩個塡字遊戲點樣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 dak1 haan4, bat1 jyu4 jat1 cai4 waan2 go3 tin4 zi6 jau4 hei3 dim2 joeng2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有空，不如一起玩个填字游戏怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: I'm free tonight, how about we play a crossword puzzle together?

english_meaning: to fill in; to write (in a form)
explanation_mandarin: 将信息或答案写在表格、问卷等上面。
explanation_english: To write information or answers on a form, questionnaire, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住要喺張表格度塡寫你嘅個人資料呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 jiu3 hai2 zoeng1 biu2 gaak3 dou6 tin4 se2 nei5 ge3 go3 jan4 zi1 liu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记住要在表格上填写你的个人资料啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to fill in your personal details on the form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔肯定應該點樣塡寫呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 ying1 goi1 dim2 yeung2 tin4 se2 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不确定应该怎样填写这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not sure how to fill in this question.

english_meaning: to fill in, to level, to fill up (a hole or depression)
explanation_mandarin: 把凹陷的地方或洞穴填满，使其平坦。
explanation_english: To fill in a depression or hole, making it level or flat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要將個地盤啲坑洞塡平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 go3 dei6 pun4 di1 haang1 dung6 tin4 ping4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要把工地上的坑洞填平。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fill in the holes on the construction site.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞啲泥去塡平花園入面嘅啲凹位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 di1 nai4 heoi3 tin4 ping4 faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 ge3 di1 aap3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一些泥去填平花园里的凹陷处。
examples.english_sentence: He took some soil to fill in the depressions in the garden.

english_meaning: concubine who replaces the deceased wife; second wife (taken after the death of the first wife)
explanation_mandarin: 指正妻死后，丈夫再娶的妻子。地位低于正妻，但高于妾。
explanation_english: Refers to a wife taken by a husband after the death of his first wife. Her status is lower than that of the first wife but higher than that of a concubine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆死咗無幾耐，就娶咗個塡房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po2 si2 zo2 mou5 gei2 noi6, zau6 cheui2 zo2 go3 tin4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老婆死了没多久，就娶了个填房。
examples.english_sentence: His wife died not long ago, and he married a second wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時，好多男人都會娶個塡房嚟延續香火。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4, hou2 do1 naam4 jan2 dou1 wui5 cheui2 go3 tin4 fong2 lai4 jin4 zuk6 heung1 fo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在过去，很多男人都会娶个填房来延续香火。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many men would marry a second wife to continue the family line.

english_meaning: to cover a deficit; to make up for losses; to balance the books (usually after a loss or deficit)
explanation_mandarin: 指用某种方式来弥补财务上的亏损或填补其他方面的不足。
explanation_english: To make up for a financial loss or deficiency. It can also refer to covering a shortfall in other areas, like sales targets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年生意差咗好多，要諗辦法塡數先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 sang1 ji3 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 tin4 sou3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的生意差了很多，要想想办法弥补亏损才行。
examples.english_sentence: Business is much worse this year, we need to think of ways to cover the losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗啲獎金嚟塡數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 di1 zoeng2 gam1 lai4 tin4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿了一些奖金来弥补亏损。
examples.english_sentence: He used some bonus money to cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月啲數未塡得返，好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 di1 sou3 mei6 tin4 dak1 faan1, hou2 tau4 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月的账还没有填补回来，很头疼。
examples.english_sentence: The accounts for this month haven't been balanced yet; it's a headache.

english_meaning: filler; to fill in; to pad (something); to make up the numbers; to make something look fuller
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到数量要求或使某事物看起来更充实而添加的无实际价值的东西；泛指凑数，充数。
explanation_english: Refers to something of little or no real value that is added to meet a quota or make something appear fuller; generally refers to filling in, padding, or making up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告太多塡料，冇咩實質內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 taai3 do1 tin4 liu2, mou5 me1 sat6 zat1 noi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告里太多充数的内容，没什么实质内容。
examples.english_sentence: His report has too much filler and not much substance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆要我哋加啲嘢落份計劃書度，唔好咁寡，但係我覺得只係想塡料咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 gaa1 di1 je5 lok6 fan6 gai3 waak6 syu1 dou6, m4 hou2 gam3 gwaa2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 zi2 hai6 soeng2 tin4 liu2 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板要我们加一些东西到计划书里，不要这么单薄，但是我觉得只是想充数而已。
examples.english_sentence: The boss wants us to add something to the proposal, so it doesn't look so thin, but I think he just wants to add filler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲獎品都係攞嚟塡料㗎，唔值錢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zoeng2 ban2 dou1 hai6 lo2 lai4 tin4 liu2 gaa3, m4 zik6 cin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些奖品都是用来充数的，不值钱的。
examples.english_sentence: These prizes are just for show, they're not worth much.

synonyms: 濫竽充數 (laam6 jyu4 cung1 sou3)

english_meaning: To fill a hole; to cover a deficit; to bail out (financially)
explanation_mandarin: 指填补亏损或漏洞，使之恢复完整或正常状态。
explanation_english: Refers to filling a gap, hole, or deficit, often financially, to restore something to a complete or normal state. Can also refer to bailing someone out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司蝕咗好多錢，要諗辦法塡氹先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 tin4 dam3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司亏损了很多钱，要想办法填补亏空才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost a lot of money, we need to find a way to cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸咗好多，要屋企人幫佢塡氹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 uk1 kei2 jan4 bong1 keoi5 tin4 dam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输了很多，要家人帮他填补亏空。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money gambling, and his family has to bail him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月唔夠錢交租，唯有攞啲儲蓄嚟塡氹住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 m4 gau3 cin2 gaau1 zu1, wai4 jau5 lo2 di1 cyu5 cuk1 lai4 tin4 dam3 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月不够钱交房租，只好拿些储蓄来填补一下。
examples.english_sentence: I don't have enough money to pay rent this month, so I'll have to use some savings to cover it for now.

english_meaning: land reclamation
explanation_mandarin: 把海面填平，造出陸地。
explanation_english: To reclaim land from the sea; land reclamation (the process of creating new land from ocean, riverbeds, or lakebeds).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多土地都係塡海得嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 tou2 dei6 dou1 hai6 tin4 hoi2 dak1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多土地都是填海而来的。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of land in Hong Kong comes from land reclamation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塡海對環境有一定嘅影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 hoi2 deoi3 waan4 ging2 jau5 jat1 ding6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 填海对环境有一定的影响。
examples.english_sentence: Land reclamation has a certain impact on the environment.

english_meaning: to fill up, to be filled with
explanation_mandarin: 使空间或容器充满东西。
explanation_english: To make a space or container full of something; to fill something completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將個杯塡滿水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 go3 bui1 tin4 mun5 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把杯子填满了水。
examples.english_sentence: He filled the cup with water.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅時間表已經塡滿晒，冇時間見你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 si4 gaan3 biu2 ji5 ging1 tin4 mun5 saai3, mou5 si4 gaan3 gin3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的时间表已经填满了，没时间见你。
examples.english_sentence: My schedule is already full, I don't have time to see you.

english_meaning: to fill a gap; to make up for a deficiency; to compensate
explanation_mandarin: 补足空缺或不足的部分。
explanation_english: To fill a vacancy or deficiency; to make something whole or complete by adding what is lacking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力工作，去塡補公司嘅損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 gung1 zok3, heoi3 tin4 bou2 gung1 si1 ge3 syun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力工作，去填补公司的损失。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard to compensate for the company's losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想搵多啲錢去塡補屋企嘅開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wan2 do1 di1 cin2 heoi3 tin4 bou2 uk1 kei5 ge3 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想挣更多的钱去填补家里的开支。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to earn more money to make up for the family expenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工可以塡補返我失去嘅時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 ho2 ji5 tin4 bou2 faan1 ngo5 sat1 heoi3 ge3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作可以弥补我失去的时间。
examples.english_sentence: This job can make up for the time I lost.

english_meaning: to write lyrics
explanation_mandarin: 为歌曲谱写歌词。
explanation_english: To write the lyrics for a song; songwriting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專門幫人哋塡詞嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 dei6 tin4 ci4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门帮别人填词的。
examples.english_sentence: He specializes in writing lyrics for other people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想學吓點樣塡詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 hok6 haa5 dim2 joeng2 tin4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想学一下怎么填词。
examples.english_sentence: I want to learn how to write lyrics.

english_meaning: Lyricist, songwriter
explanation_mandarin: 专门负责创作歌词的人。
explanation_english: A person who specializes in writing lyrics for songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅塡詞人，好多歌都係佢寫嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 cheut1 ming4 ge3 tin4 ci4 jan4, hou2 do1 go1 dou1 hai6 keoi5 se2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个很出名的作词人，很多歌都是他写的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous lyricist, he wrote many songs.

english_meaning: to fill up (on food); to satiate
explanation_mandarin: 使吃东西的人感到饱足。
explanation_english: To eat until one is full and no longer hungry; to satiate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食多啲嘢嚟塡飽個肚先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 do1 di1 je5 lai4 tin4 baau2 go3 tou5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们多吃点东西，先把肚子填饱。
examples.english_sentence: Let's eat more so we can fill our stomachs first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你淨係食啲菜點樣塡飽呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zing6 hai6 sik6 di1 coi3 dim2 joeng2 tin4 baau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你只吃点菜怎么能填饱肚子呢？
examples.english_sentence: How can you fill up just by eating vegetables?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食碗麵都夠塡飽肚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 wun2 min6 dou1 gau3 tin4 baau2 tou5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃一碗面也够填饱肚子了。
examples.english_sentence: Eating a bowl of noodles is enough to fill you up.

english_meaning: cramming (students with information)
explanation_mandarin: 原指用人工填喂方式养鸭，使其快速肥大。比喻强迫式地向学生灌输知识，不注重理解和思考。
explanation_english: Originally refers to force-feeding ducks to fatten them quickly. It is a metaphor for cramming students with knowledge without emphasizing understanding or critical thinking; rote learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅教育制度有時都好似塡鴨式咁，學生好多嘢都要死記硬背。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 jau5 si4 dou1 hou2 ci5 tin4 aap3 sik1 gam2, hok6 sang1 hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 sei2 gei3 ngaang6 bui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的教育制度有时候就像填鸭式一样，学生很多东西都要死记硬背。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's education system is sometimes like cramming, where students have to memorize a lot of things by rote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意呢種塡鴨式嘅學習方法，我覺得應該鼓勵學生思考。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 ni1 zung2 tin4 aap3 sik1 ge3 hok6 zaap6 fong1 faat3, ngo5 gok3 dak1 jing1 goi1 gu2 lai6 hok6 sang1 si1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢这种填鸭式的学习方法，我觉得应该鼓励学生思考。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like this cramming method of learning, I think we should encourage students to think.

english_meaning: spoon-feeding education, rote learning
explanation_mandarin: 一种强调死记硬背，缺乏启发性和创造性的教育方式。比喻像填鸭一样，强迫学生接受知识。
explanation_english: A method of education that emphasizes rote memorization and regurgitation of information, lacking in creativity and critical thinking. It is likened to force-feeding a duck to fatten it for consumption, where students are passively fed information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅教育制度，好多人都話係塡鴨式教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 waa6 hai6 tin4 aap3 sik1 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的教育制度，很多人都说是填鸭式教育。
examples.english_sentence: Many people say that Hong Kong's education system is a spoon-feeding education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得小朋友最緊要培養創造力，唔好用塡鴨式教育限制佢哋嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 siu2 pang4 jau5 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 pui4 joeng5 cong3 zou6 lik6, m4 hou2 yung6 tin4 aap3 sik1 gaau3 juk6 haan6 zai3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得小朋友最重要的是培养创造力，不要用填鸭式教育限制他们的发展。
examples.english_sentence: I think it is most important to cultivate creativity in children. Don't use spoon-feeding education to limit their development.

english_meaning: dockyard, shelter, small depression in the hills
explanation_mandarin: 指停船修理的场所；或指地势低凹的地方。
explanation_english: Refers to a shipyard for repairing ships; or a low-lying area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間船廠有個大船塢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 syun4 cong2 jau5 go3 daai6 syun4 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的船厂有一个大船坞。
examples.english_sentence: His shipyard has a large dockyard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個山塢入面有好多草。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 saan1 wu1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 cou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个山坳里有很多草。
examples.english_sentence: There is a lot of grass in that small depression in the hills.

english_meaning: to fill; to stuff; to fill in (a form)
explanation_mandarin: 将东西塞满; 在空白处写字
explanation_english: To fill something up; to write in blanks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 填飽個肚先啦，陣間再做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin4 baau2 go3 tou5 sin1 laa1, zan6 gaan1 zoi3 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先填饱肚子吧，一会儿再工作。
examples.english_sentence: Let's fill our stomachs first, and then we'll work later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份申請表要填曬所有資料㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 san1 ching2 biu2 jiu3 tin4 saai3 so2 jau5 zi1 liu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份申请表要填写所有资料的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to fill in all the information on this application form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想填補我哋之間嘅裂痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tin4 bou2 ngo5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 lit6 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想填补我们之间的裂痕。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to bridge the gap between us.

english_meaning: to fill, to stuff, to pad
explanation_mandarin: 把空缺的地方填满。
explanation_english: To fill a space or gap completely; to stuff or pad something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份申請表要你填充啲個人資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 san1 ching2 biu2 jiu3 nei5 tin1 chung1 di1 go3 yan4 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请表需要你填写一些个人资料。
examples.english_sentence: The application form requires you to fill in some personal information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以用棉花填充個枕頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 yung6 min4 faa1 tin1 chung1 go3 zam2 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以用棉花填充枕头。
examples.english_sentence: We can stuff the pillow with cotton.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牙醫幫我填充咗蛀牙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngaa4 yi1 bong1 ngo5 tin1 chung1 zo2 zyu3 ngaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 牙医帮我填补了蛀牙。
examples.english_sentence: The dentist filled my cavity.

mandarin_meaning: 补洞; 填补空缺; 补漏
english_meaning: To fill a hole; to patch up; to cover a deficit; to fill a gap
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指填补坑洞，引申义为弥补亏空或填补空缺。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to fill a hole or pit. Figuratively, it means to cover a deficit or fill a gap, especially in a financial sense or to make up for something lacking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司蝕咗好多錢，要諗辦法填凼先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sit6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 tin4 dum2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司亏损了很多钱，得想办法补漏洞才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost a lot of money, we need to find a way to cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日洗腳唔抹腳，搞到成日都要幫佢填凼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 sai2 goek3 m4 maat3 goek3, gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 tin4 dum2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是挥霍无度，导致总是要帮他补窟窿。
examples.english_sentence: He's always wasteful, which leads to having to constantly bail him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有啲漏洞，我哋要盡快填凼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 di1 lau6 dung6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon6 faai3 tin4 dum2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划有一些漏洞，我们要尽快填补。
examples.english_sentence: There are some loopholes in this plan, we need to fill them as soon as possible.

english_meaning: to pay with one's life; to atone with one's life
explanation_mandarin: 用生命来偿还。通常指犯了严重的罪行，需要以死谢罪。
explanation_english: To pay for something with one's life, usually referring to atoning for a serious crime or wrong by dying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢殺人放火，真係要填命㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2, zan1 hai6 jiu3 tin4 ming6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他杀人放火，真的是要偿命的！
examples.english_sentence: He committed murder and arson, he really has to pay with his life!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢錯手傷咗人，雖然唔係故意，但係都可能要填命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 co3 sau2 soeng1 zo2 jan4, seoi1 jin4 m4 hai6 gu3 ji3, daan6 hai6 dou1 ho2 nang4 jiu3 tin4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心伤了人，虽然不是故意的，但有可能要偿命。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally injured someone. Although it wasn't intentional, he might have to pay with his life.

synonyms: 以命償還 (ji5 ming6 soeng4 waan4)

english_meaning: to fill in (a form); to declare; to report
explanation_mandarin: 填写并上报（表格、资料等）。
explanation_english: To fill in and submit (forms, information, etc.).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你填報咗稅表未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tin4 bou3 zo2 seoi3 biu2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你填报了税表了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you filled in your tax return yet?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要喺限期之前填報所有資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 haan6 kei5 zi1 cin4 tin4 bou3 so2 jau5 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要在截止日期之前填报所有资料。
examples.english_sentence: We need to submit all the information before the deadline.

english_meaning: Crossword puzzle
explanation_mandarin: 一种益智游戏，在一个有编号的空格组成的表格里，根据提示填入单词。
explanation_english: A word puzzle in which words are filled into a grid according to numbered clues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意玩填字遊戲嘅，可以考下自己嘅詞彙量。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 waan2 tin4 zi6 jau4 hei3 ge3, ho2 ji5 haau2 haa5 zi6 ge3 ci4 wui6 loeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我非常喜欢玩填字游戏，可以考考自己的词汇量。
examples.english_sentence: I really enjoy doing crossword puzzles; it tests my vocabulary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報紙每日都有填字遊戲，等我可以打發時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 zi2 mui5 jat6 dou1 jau5 tin4 zi6 jau4 hei3, dang2 ngo5 ho2 ji5 daa2 faat3 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报纸每天都有填字游戏，让我可以打发时间。
examples.english_sentence: The newspaper has a crossword puzzle every day, which helps me pass the time.

english_meaning: to fill in; to write in (a form)
explanation_mandarin: 指在表格、问卷等空白处写上必要的信息。
explanation_english: To write information in the blank spaces on a form, questionnaire, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要喺呢份表格上面填寫你嘅個人資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 hai2 ni1 fan6 biu2 gaak3 soeng6 min6 tin4 se2 nei5 ge3 go3 yan4 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你需要在这份表格上填写你的个人资料。
examples.english_sentence: You need to fill in your personal information on this form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得填寫埋個聯絡電話啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 tin4 se2 maai4 go3 lyun4 lok3 din6 waa2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得把联系电话也填上啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to fill in the contact number as well.

english_meaning: to level; to flatten; to fill in (a hole); to even out
explanation_mandarin: 把凹凸不平的地方填满，使表面变得平坦。
explanation_english: To make something level or flat by filling in uneven or depressed areas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 工人要填平笪地先可以起樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 jan4 jiu3 tin4 ping4 daat3 dei6 sin1 ho2 ji5 hei2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工人们要先把这块地填平才可以盖楼房。
examples.english_sentence: The workers need to level this piece of land before they can build a building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條路爛咗，要填平佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 lou6 laan6 zo2, jiu3 tin4 ping4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 路坏了，需要把它填平。
examples.english_sentence: The road is damaged and needs to be leveled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定填平嗰個山谷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 tin4 ping4 go2 go3 saan1 guk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定填平那个山谷。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to level that valley.

english_meaning: Second wife, to remarry (as a wife after the death of the first wife)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫在前妻去世后娶的妻子，即继室。
explanation_english: Refers to a wife a man takes after his first wife has died. The term implies she is 'filling the room' or position of the deceased wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老婆死咗之後，佢阿媽就想佢快啲娶個填房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 po2 si2 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 aa3 maa1 zau6 soeng2 keoi5 faai3 di1 cheoi2 go3 tin4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他老婆去世后，他妈妈就想让他快点娶个续弦。
examples.english_sentence: After his wife died, his mother wanted him to quickly remarry and take a second wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人思想比較傳統，覺得男人死老婆一定要娶填房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 si1 soeng2 bei2 gaau3 tyun4 tung2, gok3 dak1 naam4 jan2 si2 lou5 po2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cheoi2 tin4 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人思想比较传统，觉得男人死了妻子一定要娶续弦。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people's thinking was more traditional, and they felt that a man whose wife died had to take a second wife.

mandarin_meaning: 补数; 完成指标; 达到目标
english_meaning: To make up the numbers; to meet a quota; to fulfill a target; to balance accounts (especially gambling losses)
explanation_mandarin: 指为了达到某个目标或者指标，而采取行动补足差额。也指在赌博中，为了弥补亏损而继续下注。
explanation_english: Refers to taking action to fill a gap or deficiency in order to reach a target or meet a quota. Also refers to betting more in gambling to cover losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月生意唔好，要諗辦法填數先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 seng1 ji3 m4 hou2, jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 tin4 sou3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月生意不好，要想办法补数才行。
examples.english_sentence: Business is bad this month, we need to find a way to meet our target.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸咗好多，想填數但係越賭越大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1, soeng2 tin4 sou3 daan6 hai6 yut6 dou2 yut6 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输了很多，想补数但是越赌越大。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money gambling and wanted to recoup his losses, but the more he bet, the more he lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆話今年一定要填夠一百萬嘅數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 waa6 gam1 nin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tin4 gau3 jat1 baak3 maan6 ge3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板说今年一定要完成一百万的指标。
examples.english_sentence: The boss said we must meet the target of one million this year.

synonyms: 追數 (zeoi1 sou3) - in some contexts of chasing the amount

mandarin_meaning: 填充物; 垫料; 填充信息; 凑数
english_meaning: filling material; filler; padding; to pad (information); to fill in (a blank)
explanation_mandarin: 指填充某种东西的材料，可以是物理上的填充物，也可以是比喻意义上的填充信息或凑数。
explanation_english: Refers to the material used to fill something. It can be a physical filling material or a metaphorical filling of information or just to make up the numbers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個箱入面有好多填料，保護住啲易碎嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 soeng1 jap6 min6 jau5 ho2 do1 tin4 liu2, bou2 wu6 zyu6 di1 ji6 seoi3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个箱子里面有很多填充物，保护着那些易碎的东西。
examples.english_sentence: There is a lot of filler in this box to protect the fragile items.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告好多嘢都係填料，冇乜實質內容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ho2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 tin4 liu2, mou5 mat1 sat6 zat1 noi6 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告里很多东西都是填充信息，没什么实质内容。
examples.english_sentence: A lot of stuff in his report is just filler, there's not much real content.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叫多幾個人嚟填料，費事得幾丁友咁少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: giu3 do1 gei2 go3 jan4 lai4 tin4 liu2, fai3 si2 dak1 gei2 ding1 jau5 gam3 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多叫几个人来凑数，免得只有几个人这么少。
examples.english_sentence: Call a few more people to fill in, so we don't just have a few people.

english_meaning: to fill a hole; to cover a deficit; to bail out (financially)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指填补坑洞，引申为弥补亏空、解决财政危机。多用于财务方面。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to fill a hole'. Figuratively, it means to cover a deficit, especially a financial one; to bail someone out financially. It implies addressing a shortfall or covering a financial loss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕咗好多錢，要搵人嚟填氹先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 tin4 dam3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司亏损了很多钱，得找人来弥补亏空才行。
examples.english_sentence: The company lost a lot of money, we need to find someone to bail us out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢輸咗好多，要借錢嚟填氹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 syu1 zo2 hou2 do1, jiu3 ze3 cin2 lai4 tin4 dam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱输了很多，要借钱来填补亏空。
examples.english_sentence: He lost a lot of money gambling, he needs to borrow money to cover the deficit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個月生意唔好，唔夠錢交租，要自己攞錢填氹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 saang1 ji3 m4 hou2, m4 gau3 cin2 gaau1 zou1, jiu3 zi6 gei2 lo2 cin2 tin4 dam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个月生意不好，不够钱交租，要自己拿钱来弥补亏空。
examples.english_sentence: Business is bad this month, not enough money to pay the rent, I have to use my own money to cover the deficit.

synonyms: 埋單 (maai4 daan1) - in some contexts

english_meaning: land reclamation; to reclaim land from the sea; to fill the sea
explanation_mandarin: 指把海滩、海湾或浅海区域用泥土、沙石等填平，变成陆地的行为。 在粤语中，也可以引申为比喻徒劳无功，白费力气。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of filling beaches, bays, or shallow sea areas with soil, sand, stones, etc., to transform them into land. In Cantonese, it can also be extended to metaphorically mean a futile effort, a waste of energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府計劃喺嗰度填海起新機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gai3 waak6 hai2 go2 dou6 tin4 hoi2 hei2 san1 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府计划在那里填海建造新机场。
examples.english_sentence: The government plans to reclaim land there to build a new airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同佢講咁多都係填海啫，佢根本唔會聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 keoi5 gong2 gam3 do1 dou1 hai6 tin4 hoi2 ze1, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui5 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跟他说这么多都是白费力气，他根本不会听。
examples.english_sentence: Talking so much to him is just a waste of effort, he won't listen at all.

english_meaning: to fill up, to stuff, to pack full
explanation_mandarin: 使某物充满；把空的地方塞满。
explanation_english: To fill something completely; to fill up an empty space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞啲書填滿晒個書架。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 di1 syu1 tin4 mun5 saai3 go3 syu1 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把书都填满了书架。
examples.english_sentence: He filled the bookshelf with books.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食咗好多嘢，填滿晒個肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 zo2 hou2 do1 je5, tin4 mun5 saai3 go3 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃了很多东西，填饱了肚子。
examples.english_sentence: I ate a lot and filled my stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份申請表要你填滿所有資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 san1 cing2 biu2 jiu3 nei5 tin4 mun5 so2 jau5 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份申请表需要你填写所有资料。
examples.english_sentence: This application form requires you to fill in all the information.

english_meaning: to fill a gap; to make up for; to compensate; to replenish
explanation_mandarin: 填充空缺，补充不足。
explanation_english: To fill a gap or vacancy; to make up for a deficiency; to replenish something that is lacking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要努力填補經濟上嘅損失。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nou5 lik6 tin4 bou2 ging1 zai3 soeng6 ge3 sun2 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要努力填补经济上的损失。
examples.english_sentence: We need to work hard to make up for the economic losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工作可以填補我嘅經驗不足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 ho2 ji5 tin4 bou2 ngo5 ge3 ging1 jim6 bat1 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作可以弥补我经验的不足。
examples.english_sentence: This job can compensate for my lack of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望用愛去填補心靈上嘅空虛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 yung6 oi3 heoi3 tin4 bou2 sam1 ling4 soeng6 ge3 hung1 heoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望用爱去填补心灵上的空虚。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to fill the emptiness in his heart with love.

english_meaning: to write lyrics; lyric writing
explanation_mandarin: 为歌曲创作歌词。指按照旋律填写歌词。
explanation_english: To write lyrics for a song, specifically fitting words to a pre-existing melody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好有才華，又識作曲又識填詞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jau5 coi4 waa4, jau6 sik1 jok3 kuk1 jau6 sik1 tin4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有才华，既会作曲又会作词。
examples.english_sentence: He is very talented, he can both compose music and write lyrics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多歌嘅歌詞都唔掂，真係要請啲專業嘅人嚟填詞先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 go1 ge3 go1 ci4 dou1 m4 dim6, zan1 hai6 jiu3 ceng2 di1 zyun1 jip6 ge3 jan4 lai4 tin4 ci4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多歌的歌词都不太好，真的要请一些专业人士来作词才行。
examples.english_sentence: The lyrics of many songs nowadays are not good, we really need to hire some professionals to write the lyrics.

english_meaning: lyricist, songwriter
explanation_mandarin: 指专门创作歌曲歌词的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who specializes in writing lyrics for songs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 林夕係一位好出名嘅填詞人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lam4 sik1 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 tin4 ci4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 林夕是一位非常有名的作词人。
examples.english_sentence: Lin Xi is a very famous lyricist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係成為一個填詞人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 tin4 ci4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一名作词人。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become a lyricist.

english_meaning: to fill (one's stomach); to satisfy hunger; to eat one's fill
explanation_mandarin: 指把肚子吃饱，满足食欲。
explanation_english: To eat enough to satisfy hunger; to fill one's stomach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你食咗飯未呀？填飽咗未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sik6 zo2 faan6 mei6 aa3? tin4 baau2 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你吃饭了吗？吃饱了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you eaten yet? Are you full?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食啲嘢填飽個肚先啦，陣間再食好嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 di1 je5 tin4 baau2 go3 dou2 sin1 laa1, zan6 gaan1 zoi3 sik6 hou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先吃点东西填饱肚子吧，一会儿再吃好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's eat something to fill our stomachs first, then we'll eat something good later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 淨係食啲餅乾唔會填飽肚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing6 hai6 sik6 di1 beng2 gon1 m4 wui5 tin4 baau2 dou5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 光吃饼干是不会吃饱的。
examples.english_sentence: Just eating biscuits won't fill you up.

english_meaning: cramming (education)
explanation_mandarin: 指强迫学生死记硬背，不注重理解和思考的教育方式。
explanation_english: Refers to an educational approach that forces students to memorize information without focusing on understanding or critical thinking; cramming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅教育制度好似填鴨噉，淨係叫你死背爛背。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 hou2 ci5 tin4 aap3 gam2, zing6 hai6 giu3 nei5 si2 bui6 laan6 bui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的教育制度就像填鸭式教育一样，只是让你死记硬背。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's education system is like cramming; it just tells you to memorize everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用填鴨嘅方法教細路，咁樣佢哋唔會學到嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 tin4 aap3 ge3 fong1 faat3 gaau3 sai3 lou2, gam2 joeng2 keoi5 dei6 m4 wui5 hok6 dou2 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用填鸭式的方法教育小孩，这样他们学不到东西的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use the cramming method to teach children; they won't learn anything that way.

english_meaning: spoon-feeding education, rote learning
explanation_mandarin: 一种以强制灌输知识为主的教育方式，强调死记硬背，忽略学生的自主学习和思考能力。
explanation_english: An educational method characterized by intensive instruction and memorization, often neglecting independent thinking and creativity. It emphasizes rote learning and the passive absorption of information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅教育制度好多時俾人批評係填鴨式教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 hou2 do1 si4 bei2 jan4 pai1 ping3 hai6 tin4 aap3 sik1 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的教育制度常常被人批评是填鸭式教育。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's education system is often criticized as spoon-feeding education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意填鴨式教育，覺得咁樣學唔到真正嘅知識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tin4 aap3 sik1 gaau3 juk6, gok3 dak1 gam2 joeng2 hok6 m4 dou2 zan1 zeng3 ge3 zi1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢填鸭式教育，觉得这样学不到真正的知识。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like spoon-feeding education; I feel that you can't learn real knowledge that way.

english_meaning: low-lying, muddy land; a swampy area
explanation_mandarin: 指低洼、潮湿、泥泞的土地，通常是乡村地区。
explanation_english: Refers to low-lying, wet, and muddy land, often in rural areas. It often implies a swampy or marshy environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度以前係一片塱地，後來先填平咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat1 pin3 long5 dei6, hau6 loi4 sin1 tim4 ping4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里以前是一片泥泞的洼地，后来才被填平。
examples.english_sentence: This place used to be a muddy swamp, but it was later reclaimed.

english_meaning: dust
explanation_mandarin: 细小的土粒、灰土。
explanation_english: Fine, dry powder consisting of tiny particles of earth or waste matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張檯面好多塵，抹乾淨佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 toi2 min6 hou2 do1 can4, mat3 gon1 zing6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 桌子表面有很多灰尘，擦干净它吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of dust on the table surface, wipe it clean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋好耐冇人住，積咗好多塵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 noi6 mou5 jan4 zyu6, zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间房子很久没人住了，积了很多灰尘。
examples.english_sentence: This house hasn't been lived in for a long time, it's accumulated a lot of dust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係都塵埃落定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 dou1 can4 oi1 lok6 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系都已经尘埃落定了。
examples.english_sentence: Their relationship has settled (resolved) finally.

english_meaning: mortal world; mundane world; earthly existence
explanation_mandarin: 指充满烦恼和诱惑的世俗世界。多用于佛教或道教语境，带有摆脱尘世、追求精神解脱的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the secular world filled with troubles and temptations. Often used in Buddhist or Taoist contexts, carrying the meaning of escaping the mundane world and pursuing spiritual liberation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇破紅塵，決定出家修行，離開塵世嘅煩惱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 po3 hung4 can4, kyut3 ding6 ceot1 gaa1 sau1 hang6, lei4 hoi1 can4 sai3 ge3 faan4 nou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看破红尘，决定出家修行，离开尘世的烦恼。
examples.english_sentence: He saw through the vanity of the world and decided to become a monk, leaving behind the troubles of the mortal world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人為咗名利喺塵世掙扎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 wai6 zo2 ming4 lei6 hai2 can4 sai3 zaang1 zaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人为了名利在尘世挣扎。
examples.english_sentence: Many people struggle in the mundane world for fame and fortune.

english_meaning: worldly, mundane, secular
explanation_mandarin: 指人或事物沾染了世俗的习气，追求物质享受，缺乏精神追求。
explanation_english: Referring to people or things that are tainted with worldly habits, pursuing material pleasures, and lacking spiritual pursuits. Describing something as mundane, ordinary or secular, relating to the everyday world rather than spiritual or religious matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得藝術唔應該受塵俗嘅事物影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 ngai6 seot1 m4 jing1 goi1 sau6 can4 zuk6 ge3 si6 mat6 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得艺术不应该受到世俗事物的影响。
examples.english_sentence: He feels that art should not be influenced by worldly matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢厭倦咗塵俗嘅生活，想去山上修行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jim3 gyun6 zo2 can4 zuk6 ge3 sang1 wut6, soeng2 heoi3 saan1 soeng6 sau1 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他厌倦了世俗的生活，想去山上修行。
examples.english_sentence: He is tired of the mundane life and wants to go to the mountains to practice spiritual cultivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以太過沉迷於塵俗嘅享樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 taai3 gwo3 cam4 mai4 jyu1 can4 zuk6 ge3 hoeng2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以太过于沉迷于世俗的享乐。
examples.english_sentence: We should not be too immersed in worldly pleasures.

english_meaning: dust, dirt
explanation_mandarin: 细小的沙粒和尘埃。
explanation_english: Fine particles of earth, dust, or other matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 抹走啲塵土佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maat3 zau2 di1 can4 tou2 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把那些尘土擦掉吧。
examples.english_sentence: Wipe off the dust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋好耐冇人住，積咗好多塵土。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 hou2 noi6 mou5 jan4 zyu6, zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 can4 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子很久没人住，积了很多灰尘。
examples.english_sentence: The house has been empty for a long time and is covered in dust.

english_meaning: dusty; dust flying; dust swirling
explanation_mandarin: 形容尘土很多，到处飞扬的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there is a lot of dust in the air, swirling around and flying everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車喺爛地上面開過，搞到成條路都塵土飛揚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 hai2 laan6 dei6 soeng6 min6 hoi1 gwo3, gaau2 dou3 seng4 tiu4 lou6 dou1 can4 tou2 fei1 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车在颠簸的路面上开过，搞得整条路都尘土飞扬。
examples.english_sentence: The car drove over the rough road, causing dust to swirl everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拆樓嘅時候，塵土飛揚，好大塵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caak3 lau2 ge3 si4 hau6, can4 tou2 fei1 joeng4, hou2 daai6 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拆楼的时候，尘土飞扬，灰尘很大。
examples.english_sentence: During the building demolition, dust was flying everywhere, it was very dusty.

english_meaning: dust
explanation_mandarin: 指漂浮在空气中或落在物体表面的细小尘土颗粒。
explanation_english: Fine particles of earth or other matter that float in the air or settle on surfaces.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲陽光照入嚟，先見到好多塵埃喺空氣度飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 joeng4 gwong1 ziu3 jap6 lai4, sin1 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 can4 oi1 hai2 hung1 hei3 dou6 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阳光照进来，才看到很多尘埃在空气中飞。
examples.english_sentence: When the sunlight shines in, you can see a lot of dust flying in the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 成間屋冇人住，積咗好多塵埃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seng4 gaan1 uk1 mou5 jan4 zyu6, zik1 zo2 hou2 do1 can4 oi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整间屋没人住，积了很多尘埃。
examples.english_sentence: The whole house is uninhabited and has accumulated a lot of dust.

english_meaning: The dust has settled; the matter is settled; the outcome is final.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻事情经过一段时间后，有了结果或结论，趋于稳定。
explanation_english: Metaphorically, it means that after a period of time, a matter has come to a conclusion, the outcome is final, and things have become stable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞咗咁耐，而家終於塵埃落定喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 can4 oi1 lok6 ding6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事弄了这么久，现在终于尘埃落定了。
examples.english_sentence: This matter has been going on for so long, now it's finally settled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 選舉結果塵埃落定，佢贏咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun2 geoi2 git3 gwo2 can4 oi1 lok6 ding6, keoi5 wing4 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 选举结果尘埃落定，他赢了。
examples.english_sentence: The election result is final, he won.

english_meaning: to be covered in dust, to be shelved (unused), to lie forgotten
explanation_mandarin: 指物品长期不用，积满灰尘；也比喻长期搁置，不被重视。
explanation_english: Describes something that has been unused for a long time and is covered in dust; also used metaphorically to describe something that has been shelved or forgotten and is not given importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本嘢塵封咗好耐，都唔記得點用啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 je5 can4 fung1 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 dim2 yung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这东西已经封尘很久了，都不记得怎么用了。
examples.english_sentence: This thing has been gathering dust for a long time; I don't even remember how to use it anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃已經塵封咗好幾年，睇嚟都唔會再攞返出嚟搞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ji5 ging1 can4 fung1 zo2 hou2 gei2 nin4, tai2 lai4 dou1 m4 wui5 zoi3 lo2 faan1 ceot1 lai4 gaau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划已经搁置好几年了，看来也不会再拿出来做了。
examples.english_sentence: This project has been shelved for several years; it seems unlikely that it will be brought back to life.

english_meaning: duster
explanation_mandarin: 一种清洁工具，用于拂去灰尘。
explanation_english: A cleaning tool used for dusting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用塵拂拂走啲灰塵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 can4 fat1 fat1 zau2 di1 fui1 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用掸子掸走一些灰尘。
examples.english_sentence: I use a duster to dust off some dust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日攞住塵拂清潔屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 lo2 zyu6 can4 fat1 cing1 git3 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈经常拿着掸子清洁家里。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always cleans the house with a duster.

jyutping: can4 gwai1 can4, tou2 gwai1 tou2
english_meaning: Dust to dust, ashes to ashes.
explanation_mandarin: 出自基督教葬礼仪式中的祷告词，表示人死后最终会回归自然。
explanation_english: Derived from the Christian burial service, it signifies that after death, a person returns to their natural elements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生都好努力，但係最後都係塵歸塵，土歸土。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sang1 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 can4 gwai1 can4, tou2 gwai1 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都很努力，但是最后还是尘归尘，土归土。
examples.english_sentence: He worked hard his whole life, but in the end, it's still dust to dust, ashes to ashes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人生就係咁，塵歸塵，土歸土，咩都帶唔走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 sang1 zau6 hai6 gam2, can4 gwai1 can4, tou2 gwai1 tou2, me1 dou1 daai3 m4 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人生就是这样，尘归尘，土归土，什么都带不走。
examples.english_sentence: Life is like this, dust to dust, ashes to ashes, you can't take anything with you.

english_meaning: unsophisticated, lacking in refinement, tacky, provincial, old-fashioned
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物缺乏品味，不够时尚，显得庸俗、老土。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that lacks sophistication, refinement, and is considered tacky, provincial or old-fashioned. It implies a lack of style and worldliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙好塵氣，邊度買㗎？
