examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 can4 hei3, bin1 dou6 maai5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这条裙子很俗气，在哪里买的？
examples.english_sentence: Her dress is so tacky, where did you buy it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好著咁塵氣嘅衫去party啦，襯返靚啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 gam3 can4 hei3 ge3 saam1 heoi3 party laa1, can3 faan1 leng3 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要穿这么土气的衣服去派对了，搭配得好看一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't wear such old-fashioned clothes to the party, dress up a bit nicer!

english_meaning: Dust explosion
explanation_mandarin: 指大量可燃性粉塵顆粒在有限空間內懸浮，與空氣混合達到一定濃度後，遇到火源或高溫而發生的爆炸。
explanation_english: An explosion resulting from the rapid combustion of fine particulate matter (dust) suspended in the air, typically in an enclosed location. It occurs when a combustible dust is dispersed at a sufficient concentration, ignited, and confined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間工廠因為處理麵粉嘅時候冇做好安全措施，結果搞到塵爆，死咗好多人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 cong2 jan1 wai6 cyu5 lei5 min6 fan2 ge3 si4 hau6 mou5 zou6 hou2 on1 cyun4 cou3 si1, git3 gwo2 gaau2 dou3 can4 baau3, si2 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家工厂因为处理面粉的时候没有做好安全措施，结果导致粉尘爆炸，死了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: That factory didn't implement proper safety measures when handling flour, which resulted in a dust explosion and many deaths.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要避免塵爆，最緊要係保持工作場所嘅通風，同埋處理粉塵嘅時候要小心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 bei6 min5 can4 baau3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 bou2 chi4 gung1 zok3 coeng4 so2 ge3 tung1 fung1, tung4 mai4 cyu5 lei5 fan2 can4 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要避免粉尘爆炸，最重要的是保持工作场所的通风，并且处理粉尘的时候要小心。
examples.english_sentence: To avoid dust explosions, it's crucial to maintain ventilation in the workplace and handle dust carefully.

english_meaning: dust mite
explanation_mandarin: 一种微小的蛛形纲动物，生活在灰尘中，是常见的过敏原。
explanation_english: A tiny arachnid that lives in dust and is a common allergen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你對塵蟎敏感，就要勤啲換床單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 deoi3 can4 maan6 man5 gam2, zau6 jiu3 kan4 di1 wun6 cong4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你对尘螨过敏，就要勤换床单。
examples.english_sentence: If you are allergic to dust mites, you need to change your bedsheets more often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企有好多塵蟎，搞到我成日打乞嗤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jau5 hou2 do1 can4 maan6, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 sing4 jat6 daa2 hat1 ci1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里有很多尘螨，导致我经常打喷嚏。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of dust mites in the house, causing me to sneeze all the time.

english_meaning: moat; trench; ditch (military)
explanation_mandarin: 古代用于防御的挖掘的沟，通常较深较宽。
explanation_english: A ditch, often deep and wide, dug for defense purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺城堡嘅周圍挖咗條深塹嚟保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 sing4 bou2 ge3 zau1 wai4 waat3 zo2 tiu4 sam1 caam3 lai4 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在城堡周围挖了一条深壕沟来保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: They dug a deep moat around the castle to protect themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 士兵匿埋喺戰塹入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si1 bing1 nik1 maai4 hai2 zin3 caam3 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 士兵们躲藏在战壕里。
examples.english_sentence: The soldiers hid in the trenches.

english_meaning: to pad; padding; cushion
explanation_mandarin: 用东西填满或垫起，使平整、稳固或舒适；起填充作用的东西。
explanation_english: To pad, stuff, or cushion something to make it level, stable, or comfortable; the padding itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 張凳太硬，加啲嘢塾下會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 dang3 taai3 ngaang6, gaa1 di1 je5 suk1 haa5 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这椅子太硬了，加点东西垫一下会舒服点。
examples.english_sentence: This chair is too hard. It would be more comfortable if you put something to pad it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用報紙塾住個爛凳腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 bou3 zi2 suk1 jyu6 go3 laan6 dang3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用报纸垫着破凳子的脚。
examples.english_sentence: He used newspapers to pad the leg of the broken stool.

english_meaning: situation, state, circumstances, boundary
explanation_mandarin: 指所处的状况，境界，地方界限等。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation, state, realm, or boundary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家個經濟境況咁差，好多人都失業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 go3 ging1 zai3 ging2 fong3 gam3 caa1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济状况这么差，很多人都失业了。
examples.english_sentence: The economic situation is so bad right now, many people are unemployed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 置身喺咁靚嘅環境，心情都好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi3 san1 hai2 gam3 leng3 ge3 waan4 ging2, sam1 ching4 dou1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 置身于这么美的环境，心情都好些。
examples.english_sentence: Being in such a beautiful environment, my mood is better.

english_meaning: within the border; domestic
explanation_mandarin: 指国家或地区的边界以内。
explanation_english: Refers to the area within the borders of a country or region; domestic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司境內嘅業務發展得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ging2 noi6 ge3 yip6 mou6 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司境内的业务发展得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This company's domestic business is developing very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 境內旅遊而家都幾受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 noi6 leoi5 jau4 ji4 gaa1 dou1 gei2 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 境内旅游现在也很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: Domestic tourism is quite popular now.

mandarin_meaning: 境地; 处境; 状况
english_meaning: situation; circumstances; state; plight
explanation_mandarin: 指所处的境况、状况或地步。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation, circumstances, or state someone is in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家嘅境地好慘，冇晒錢又冇屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 ge3 ging2 dei6 hou2 caam2, mou5 saai3 cin2 jau6 mou5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在的境地很惨，没钱又没有家。
examples.english_sentence: His current situation is very miserable, he has no money and no home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想自己落到呢個境地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 zi6 gei2 lok6 dou3 ni1 go3 ging2 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想自己落到这个境地。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to end up in this situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過努力，佢嘅境地終於好轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 nou5 lik6, keoi5 ge3 ging2 dei6 zung1 jyu1 hou2 zyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过努力，他的境地终于好转。
examples.english_sentence: After hard work, his situation finally improved.

english_meaning: outside the territory, abroad, overseas
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或地区的管辖范围以外的地区。
explanation_english: Refers to a region outside the jurisdiction of a country or territory; abroad, overseas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋諗住將啲錢轉移到境外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 di1 cin2 zyun2 ji4 dou3 ging2 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们打算把一些钱转移到境外。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to transfer some money abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司喺境外設立咗好多分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 ging2 ngoi6 sat3 lap6 zo2 hou2 do1 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在境外设立了很多分公司。
examples.english_sentence: This company has established many branches overseas.

english_meaning: situation; circumstances; condition
explanation_mandarin: 指所处的环境和情况。
explanation_english: Refers to the environment and situation someone or something is in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家嘅境況唔係幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ge3 ging2 fong3 m4 hai6 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在的状况不太好。
examples.english_sentence: His current situation is not very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 疫情之下，好多公司嘅境況都變得好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jik6 ching4 zi1 haa6, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 ge3 ging2 fong3 dou1 bin3 dak1 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在疫情之下，很多公司的状况都变得很差。
examples.english_sentence: Under the epidemic, many companies' situations have become very bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅境況好轉咗未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 ging2 fong3 hou2 zyun2 zo2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的状况好转了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Has your situation improved?

english_meaning: environment, surroundings
explanation_mandarin: 周围的情况；所处的环境。
explanation_english: The surrounding conditions; the environment one is in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度境環幾好啊，好靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ging2 waan4 gei2 hou2 aa3, hou2 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的环境挺好的，很安静。
examples.english_sentence: The environment here is quite nice, it's very quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司嘅工作境環好影響員工嘅心情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ge3 gung1 zok3 ging2 waan4 hou2 ying2 hoeng2 yun4 gung1 ge3 sam1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的工作环境很影响员工的心情。
examples.english_sentence: The working environment of a company greatly affects the mood of its employees.

english_meaning: realm; sphere; level; state of mind; spiritual state
explanation_mandarin: 指达到的程度或精神状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the level achieved or a state of mind; a realm or sphere of experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅繪畫技巧已經達到一個新嘅境界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 kui2 waa2 gei6 haau2 ji5 ging1 daat6 dou3 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 ging2 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的绘画技巧已经达到了一个新的境界。
examples.english_sentence: His painting skills have reached a new level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要達到心靈平靜嘅境界，需要長時間嘅修行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 daat6 dou3 sam1 ling4 ping4 zing6 ge3 ging2 gaai3, seoi1 jiu3 coeng4 si4 gaan3 ge3 sau1 hang6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要达到心灵平静的境界，需要长时间的修行。
examples.english_sentence: To reach a state of inner peace, one needs long-term practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅特技效果簡直係去到另一個境界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 dak6 gei6 haau6 gwo2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 heoi3 dou3 ling6 jat1 go3 ging2 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的特效简直是达到了另一个境界。
examples.english_sentence: The special effects in this movie have simply reached another level.

english_meaning: villa, mansion
explanation_mandarin: 指郊外或风景区的独立式住宅，通常有花园或庭院。
explanation_english: A detached or semi-detached house in the suburbs or scenic areas, usually with a garden or courtyard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺半山嘅一間大墅，好鬼富貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 bun3 saan1 ge3 jat1 gaan1 daai6 syu5, hou2 gwai2 fu3 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在半山的一栋大别墅，非常富裕。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a large villa on the Mid-Levels, they are very rich.

mandarin_meaning: 陡岸; 堤岸; 河岸
english_meaning: bank (of a river, canal, etc.); steep bank; embankment
explanation_mandarin: 指河、湖、水库等水体的边缘，通常是比较陡峭的土坡或石壁。
explanation_english: Refers to the edge of a body of water such as a river, lake, or reservoir, usually a steep slope or stone wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條河嘅墈好斜，行落去要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 ho4 ge3 ham3 hou2 ce4, haang4 lok6 heoi3 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 河岸很陡，下去要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The river bank is very steep, be careful when going down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺墈邊搭咗個棚，方便釣魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 ham3 bin1 daap3 zo2 go3 paang4, fong1 bin6 diu3 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在河岸边搭了个棚，方便钓鱼。
examples.english_sentence: They built a shed on the river bank to make fishing easier.

english_meaning: to pad; to line; to cushion; to support; to advance (money); to pay in advance; to subside; to settle
explanation_mandarin: 在下面加上东西使平稳、加厚或升高。
explanation_english: To put something underneath to make it level, thicker, or higher; to advance money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺張凳上面墊返個咕𠱸，坐得舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zoeng1 dang3 soeng6 min6 din3 faan1 go3 gu1 zeoi2, zo6 dak1 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在凳子上垫个靠垫，坐得舒服点。
examples.english_sentence: Pad the chair with a cushion so it will be more comfortable to sit on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我先墊住啲錢俾你，出糧再還返俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sin1 din3 zyu6 di1 cin2 bei2 nei5, ceot1 loeng4 zoi3 waan4 faan1 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我先垫付点钱给你，发工资再还给我。
examples.english_sentence: I'll advance you some money first, and you can pay me back when you get your salary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，可唔可以幫我墊住張枱啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ho2 m4 ho2 ji3 bong1 ngo5 din3 zyu6 zoeng1 toi2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，可不可以帮我垫一下桌子啊？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, could you help me to support the table?

mandarin_meaning: 死无葬身之地，被他人利用还背黑锅的人
english_meaning: to be used and betrayed, to be a scapegoat after death, to be used as a stepping stone for someone else's success (often at one's expense)
explanation_mandarin: 原意指尸体被放在最底层，以供上方其他尸体垫着，引申为被人利用后还背负恶名，最终成为他人成功的垫脚石，下场凄惨。
explanation_english: Originally, it refers to a corpse placed at the very bottom to cushion the bodies above. Figuratively, it means being used and betrayed, bearing the blame and a bad reputation, ultimately becoming a stepping stone for someone else's success, with a tragic ending. Often used to describe someone who is exploited after death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁信任佢老細，點知最後俾佢老細利用完仲要墊屍底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seon3 jan6 keoi5 lou5 sai3, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 keoi5 lou5 sai3 lei6 yung6 jyun4 zung6 jiu3 dim3 si1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么信任他的老板，没想到最后被他老板利用完还要当替罪羊。
examples.english_sentence: He trusted his boss so much, but in the end, he was exploited by his boss and became a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁蠢啦，唔好俾人利用完仲要幫佢哋墊屍底呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 lei6 yung6 jyun4 zung6 jiu3 bong1 keoi5 dei6 dim3 si1 dai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么蠢了，不要被人利用完还要帮他们背黑锅啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't let people exploit you and then make you their scapegoat!

english_meaning: To be at the bottom; to come in last; to be the worst; to line the stomach (with food); to underlay; to use as a base
explanation_mandarin: （1）比喻处于最底层，排名最后。 (2) 食物垫底，指吃少量食物充饥，以免空腹喝酒或吃刺激性食物。
explanation_english: (1) To be at the bottom; to come in last place; to be the worst. (2) To line the stomach (with food); to eat something before drinking alcohol or eating something irritating to the stomach, to lessen the impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我考到墊底，真係好瘀呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 haau2 dou3 din3 dai2, zan1 hai6 hou2 wu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我考了最后一名，真是太丢脸了！
examples.english_sentence: I came in last in the exam this time, it's so embarrassing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲酒之前最好食啲嘢墊底，唔係好易醉㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 zau2 zi1 cin4 zui3 hou2 sik6 di1 ye5 din3 dai2, m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 zeoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝酒之前最好吃点东西垫底，不然很容易醉的。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to eat something to line your stomach before drinking alcohol, otherwise you'll get drunk easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方案只係墊底方案，如果其他唔得先用佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zi2 hai6 din3 dai2 fong1 on3, jyu4 gwo2 kei4 taa1 m4 dak1 sin1 yung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方案只是备选方案，如果其他方案不行才用它。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is just a backup plan; we'll only use it if the others don't work.

english_meaning: to advance money, to pay in advance, to cover (expenses) temporarily
explanation_mandarin: 先行支付（费用）, 临时垫付。
explanation_english: To pay out money in advance, usually with the expectation of being reimbursed later; to cover an expense temporarily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你幫我墊支住先，我聽日還返俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 dim3 zi1 zyu6 sin1, ngo5 ting1 jat6 waan4 faan1 bei2 nei5.
