examples.english_sentence: He always speaks nonsensically; no one can understand what he's trying to say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好士多啤梨蘋果橙，睇到我一頭霧水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 hou2 si6 do1 be1 lei4 ping4 gwo2 caang2, tai2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很无厘头，看得我一头雾水。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very nonsensical; it left me completely confused.

english_meaning: Strawberry nose
explanation_mandarin: 形容鼻子上有很多黑头粉刺，看起来像草莓的表面。
explanation_english: Describes a nose with many blackheads, resembling the surface of a strawberry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個鼻好多黑頭，真係好似士多啤梨鼻咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 bei6 hou2 do1 hak1 tau4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 si6 do1 be1 lei4 bei6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的鼻子有很多黑头，真的很像草莓鼻。
examples.english_sentence: His nose has so many blackheads, it really looks like a strawberry nose.

english_meaning: storeroom, pantry, storage room
explanation_mandarin: 用来储存物品的房间，通常较小。
explanation_english: A room used for storing items, usually relatively small.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢擺喺士多房度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 baai2 hai2 si6 do1 fong2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 东西放在储藏室里。
examples.english_sentence: The things are stored in the storeroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間士多房好細，擺唔到咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 si6 do1 fong2 hou2 sai3, baai2 m4 dou2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间储藏室很小，放不下那么多东西。
examples.english_sentence: This storeroom is very small and can't hold so much stuff.

english_meaning: store; storage; storeroom; pantry
explanation_mandarin: 指用来储存物品的地方，如杂物间、仓库等。
explanation_english: Refers to a place for storing items, such as a storeroom or warehouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將啲聖誕裝飾放喺士多貢度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 di1 sing3 daan3 zong1 sik1 fong3 hai2 si6 do1 gung1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们把一些圣诞装饰放在储藏室里。
examples.english_sentence: We put some Christmas decorations in the storage room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間士多貢好細，擺唔到咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 si6 do1 gung1 hou2 sai3, bai2 m4 dou2 gam3 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间储藏室很小，放不下这么多东西。
examples.english_sentence: This storeroom is very small, it can't fit so many things.

english_meaning: wrench, spanner
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于拧紧或松开螺母或螺栓的工具。
explanation_english: A tool used for tightening or loosening nuts or bolts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎個士巴拿嚟，我扭實啲螺絲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 go3 si6 baa1 naa4 lai4, ngo5 nau2 sat6 di1 lo4 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿个扳手来，我把螺丝拧紧一点。
examples.english_sentence: Bring a wrench, I'll tighten the screws.

english_meaning: start
explanation_mandarin: 源自英语"start"的音译。表示开始，启动。多用于口语，指开始做某事或启动机器等。
explanation_english: A transliteration of the English word "start." It means to begin or initiate something. Often used in spoken Cantonese to refer to starting an activity or a machine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家就士撻做功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 zau6 si6 taat3 zou6 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们现在就开始做功课吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's start doing our homework now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車士撻唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 si6 taat3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车启动不了。
examples.english_sentence: The car won't start.

english_meaning: Scared to start; hesitant to begin; lacking initiative; being easily intimidated; weak-willed
explanation_mandarin: 本意指汽车启动器有问题，引申形容人胆小怕事，不敢尝试新事物，缺乏行动力。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a faulty car starter, it's used metaphorically to describe someone who is timid, afraid to try new things, and lacks initiative. They are easily intimidated and struggle to start anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好士撻膽，咩都唔敢試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 si6 taat3 daam2, me1 dou1 m4 gam2 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很胆小，什么都不敢尝试。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very timid person, afraid to try anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁士撻膽啦，試吓又唔會死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 si6 taat3 daam2 laa1, si3 haa5 jau6 m4 wui5 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么胆怯啦，试一下又不会死。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so timid, trying it won't kill you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司啲新人個個都士撻膽，唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 di1 san1 jan4 go3 go3 dou1 si6 taat3 daam2, m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的新人个个都胆小，不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: All the new employees in their company are timid and afraid to speak up.

english_meaning: standard; level; burden; responsibility
explanation_mandarin: “士擔”原本是英文单词“standard”的音译，在粤语中引申为标准、水平的意思。也可以指承担的责任或负担。
explanation_english: "士擔 (si6 daam1)" is a transliteration of the English word "standard." In Cantonese, it has evolved to mean standard, level. It can also refer to a burden or responsibility undertaken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅英文水平達到咗專業嘅士擔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ying1 man2 seoi2 ping4 daat6 dou3 zo2 zyun1 jip6 ge3 si6 daam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的英语水平达到了专业的标准。
examples.english_sentence: His English level has reached a professional standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要達到呢個士擔唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 daat6 dou3 ni1 go3 si6 daam1 m4 yung4 yi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要达到这个标准不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to reach this standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人孭起晒所有嘅士擔，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 be1 hei2 saai3 so2 jau5 ge3 si6 daam1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人承担了所有的责任，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He bears all the responsibility alone, it's really hard.

english_meaning: Cement
explanation_mandarin: 建筑材料，一种粉状水硬性无机胶凝材料。加水搅拌后成浆体，能在空气中或水中硬化，能把砂、石等胶结成坚固的建筑材料。
explanation_english: A powdery substance made with calcined lime and clay. It is mixed with water to form mortar or concrete, which hardens to a very strong, stonelike mass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲士敏土已經硬嗮，好難整走佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 si6 man4 tou2 ji5 ging1 ngaang6 saai3, hou2 naan4 zing2 zau2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的水泥已经硬了，很难弄走它。
examples.english_sentence: The cement here is already hardened, it's hard to get rid of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 起樓一定要用好嘅士敏土，如果唔係好易塌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei2 lau2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 yung6 hou2 ge3 si6 man4 tou2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 hou2 ji6 taap3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 盖楼一定要用好的水泥，不然很容易塌。
examples.english_sentence: You must use good cement to build a building, otherwise it will easily collapse.

mandarin_meaning: 世家大族; 门阀士族
english_meaning: Gentry; aristocratic family; powerful clan
explanation_mandarin: 指古代拥有政治、经济和文化特权的世家大族。
explanation_english: Refers to the powerful and influential aristocratic families of ancient times who held political, economic, and cultural privileges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰陣時啲士族好有權勢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zan6 si4 dik1 si6 zuk6 hou2 jau5 kuen4 sai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那时候的士族很有权势。
examples.english_sentence: The gentry were very powerful back then.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出身士族，所以自細就受到良好嘅教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheot1 san1 si6 zuk6, so2 ji5 zi6 sai3 zau6 sau6 dou3 loeng4 hou2 ge3 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出身于士族，所以从小就受到了良好的教育。
examples.english_sentence: He comes from an aristocratic family, so he received a good education since he was young.

english_meaning: morale; esprit de corps
explanation_mandarin: 指团队或个人的精神状态，战斗意志，积极性等。
explanation_english: Refers to the spirit, will to fight, and enthusiasm of a team or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要提高團隊嘅士氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai4 gou1 teoi1 deoi2 ge3 si6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要提高团队的士气。
examples.english_sentence: We need to boost the team's morale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 輸咗波之後，大家都好冇士氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syu1 zo2 bo1 zi1 hau6, daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 mou5 si6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 输了球赛之后，大家都非常没有士气。
examples.english_sentence: After losing the game, everyone was very demoralized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅演講好激勵士氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin2 gong2 hou2 gik1 lai6 si6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的演讲很鼓舞士气。
examples.english_sentence: His speech was very morale-boosting.

english_meaning: high morale, spirits are soaring; morale is like a rainbow
explanation_mandarin: 形容士气非常高昂，像彩虹一样充满力量和希望。
explanation_english: Describes morale being very high, full of power and hope like a rainbow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 球隊琴日贏咗場波，而家士氣如虹，一定可以攞冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kau4 deoi2 kam4 jat6 wing4 zo2 coeng4 bo1, ji4 gaa1 si6 hei3 jyu4 hung4, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 lo2 gun1 gwan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 球队昨天赢了一场比赛，现在士气如虹，一定可以拿冠军。
examples.english_sentence: The team won a match yesterday, and now their morale is soaring, they will definitely win the championship.

english_meaning: cement and sand mixture; mortar
explanation_mandarin: 指用于建筑工程的由水泥、沙子混合而成的物质。 主要用于砌砖、抹灰等。
explanation_english: A mixture of cement and sand, primarily used in construction for bricklaying, plastering, and similar applications. Mortar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要買多啲士沙嚟起牆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 maai5 do1 di1 si6 saa1 lai4 hei2 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要买多一点水泥沙石来砌墙。
examples.english_sentence: We need to buy more mortar to build the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲士沙太乾啦，要加返啲水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 si6 saa1 taai3 gon1 laa1, jiu3 gaa1 faan1 di1 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些水泥沙石太干了，要加点水。
examples.english_sentence: This mortar is too dry, we need to add some water.

mandarin_meaning: 助理; 文员; 职员
english_meaning: clerk; assistant; office worker
explanation_mandarin: 香港粤语，指从事办公室文书工作的职员，类似于助理或文员。通常指职位较低的办公室人员。
explanation_english: Hong Kong Cantonese term referring to an office clerk, assistant, or office worker. Usually refers to lower-level office personnel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺間公司做士的，負責處理文件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 si6 dik1, fu3 zaak3 cyu5 lei5 man4 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那家公司做文员，负责处理文件。
examples.english_sentence: He works as a clerk in that company, responsible for handling documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想升職，唔想一世都做士的。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing1 zik1, m4 soeng2 jat1 sai3 dou1 zou6 si6 dik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想升职，不想一辈子都做文员。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get promoted; he doesn't want to be a clerk his whole life.

synonyms: 辦公室助理 (baan6 gung1 sat1 zo6 lei5)

english_meaning: Candy, sweets
explanation_mandarin: 指各种类型的糖果，包括硬糖、软糖等。
explanation_english: Refers to various types of candies and sweets, including hard candies, gummy candies, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣，我成日都扭計要買士的糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 nau1 gai2 jiu3 maai5 si6 dik1 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我总是吵着要买糖果。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I always whined about buying candy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭賣好多唔同種類嘅士的糖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 zung2 leoi6 ge3 si6 dik1 tong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖很多不同种类的糖果。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells many different kinds of candy.

english_meaning: Taxi; Cab
explanation_mandarin: 粤语中对出租车的称呼。
explanation_english: Cantonese term for a taxi or cab.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想搭士的車去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 daap3 si6 dik1 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想打出租车去机场。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a taxi to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好難截士的車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 naan4 zit6 si6 dik1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里很难拦出租车。
examples.english_sentence: It's very difficult to hail a taxi here.

english_meaning: Snooker (billiards game)
explanation_mandarin: 一种台球游戏，使用带有彩球和白球的球台，游戏目的是通过击打白球将彩球击入球袋得分。
explanation_english: A billiards game played on a table with colored balls and a cue ball. The objective is to score points by striking the cue ball and potting the colored balls into pockets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去打士碌架啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 daa2 si6 luk1 gaa2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去打斯诺克吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's go play snooker tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢士碌架打得好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 si6 luk1 gaa2 daa2 dak1 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他斯诺克打得非常好。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at playing snooker.

english_meaning: Stuck; jammed; awkward; not smooth
explanation_mandarin: 形容状态不流畅、不顺利，或者事情卡住无法进行。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being stuck, jammed, awkward, or not smooth; used when something is not progressing or functioning well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦成日士篤吉，搞到我好炆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 sing4 jat6 si6 duk1 gat1, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑总是卡住，让我很烦躁。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is always getting stuck, which makes me very frustrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條拉鏈士篤吉咗，拉唔落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 laai1 lin2 si6 duk1 gat1 zo2, laai1 m4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拉链卡住了，拉不下来。
examples.english_sentence: The zipper is stuck; I can't pull it down.

english_meaning: gentry; local gentry; landed gentry
explanation_mandarin: 指地方上有声望和地位的人，通常是地主或有功名的人。
explanation_english: Refers to people with reputation and status in the local community, usually landlords or those with academic titles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲鄉村，啲士紳話晒事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 hoeng1 cyun1, di1 si6 san1 waa6 saai3 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的乡村，都是那些乡绅说了算的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old villages, the gentry had the final say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係當地嘅士紳，好多人都聽佢嘅話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dong1 dei6 ge3 si6 san1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 teng1 keoi5 ge3 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是当地的乡绅，很多人都听他的话。
examples.english_sentence: He is a local gentry, and many people listen to him.

mandarin_meaning: 绅士化, 中产阶级化, 高档化
english_meaning: Gentrification
explanation_mandarin: 指一个旧区经过重建后，吸引中产阶级或更高收入的人士迁入，从而改变该区的社会结构和文化面貌的过程。通常伴随着房价上涨，原居民被迫迁出。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of renovating and redeveloping a deteriorated urban area to conform to middle-class tastes and standards. This often leads to an influx of wealthier residents, driving up property values and displacing the original inhabitants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個舊區越嚟越士紳化，啲舖頭都賣貴嘢多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gau6 khu1 yuet6 lai4 yuet6 si6 san1 faa3, di1 pou3 tau2 dou1 maai6 gwai3 ye5 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个旧区越来越绅士化，商店都卖贵的东西多了。
examples.english_sentence: This old district is becoming increasingly gentrified, and the shops are selling more expensive things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 士紳化令到好多窮人冇得住喺市中心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 san1 faa3 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 kung4 yan4 mou5 dak1 jyu6 hai2 si5 jung1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 绅士化使得很多穷人没法住在市中心。
examples.english_sentence: Gentrification makes it impossible for many poor people to live in the city center.

english_meaning: penis (vulgar slang)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“壬”是男性生殖器的粗俗俚语。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "壬" (jam4) is a vulgar slang term for the penis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條壬咁短都攞出嚟獻世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jam4 gam3 dyun2 dou1 lo2 ceot1 lai4 hin3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么短的阴茎也拿出来丢人现眼。
examples.english_sentence: Bringing out such a short penis to embarrass yourself.

english_meaning: strong, robust, healthy
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体强健，有力气。
explanation_english: Describes a person's body being strong, healthy, and having physical strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身體好壯喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 tai2 hou2 zong3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身体很强壮啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's very strong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢操咗咁耐，變到好壯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cou1 zo2 gam3 noi6, bin3 dou3 hou2 zong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他锻炼了这么久，变得很强壮。
examples.english_sentence: He's been working out for so long, he's become very strong.

english_meaning: able-bodied man; conscript
explanation_mandarin: 指身强力壮的男子，旧时指被强征入伍的男子。
explanation_english: Refers to a strong and healthy man; in the old days, it referred to men who were forcibly conscripted into the army.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲戰爭成日捉啲壯丁去打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 zin3 zang1 sing4 jat6 zuk1 di1 zong3 ding1 heoi3 daa2 zang3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的战争经常抓壮丁去打仗。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, wars often involved conscripting able-bodied men to fight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁嘅身形，一看就知係個壯丁啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ge3 san1 ying4, jat1 hon3 zau6 zi1 hai6 go3 zong3 ding1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样的身材，一看就知道是个壮丁。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at his build, you can tell he's an able-bodied man.

english_meaning: robust, healthy, strong and fit
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体强壮健康。
explanation_english: Describing someone as being strong, healthy and robust.

explanation_mandarin: 一种日本料理，将醋饭与各种食材（通常是海鲜、蔬菜等）结合制成。
explanation_english: A Japanese dish consisting of vinegared rice combined with various ingredients, typically seafood and vegetables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我想食壽司，得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 soeng2 sik6 sau6 si1, dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我想吃寿司，可以吗？
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat sushi tonight, is that okay?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅壽司好新鮮呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sau6 si1 hou2 san1 sin1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的寿司很新鲜啊。
examples.english_sentence: The sushi at this restaurant is very fresh.

english_meaning: lifespan; life expectancy
explanation_mandarin: 指生物生存的时间长短。
explanation_english: The length of time a living thing exists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲醫療咁發達，人嘅壽命都長咗好多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 ji1 liu4 gam3 faat3 daat6, jan4 ge3 sau6 ming6 dou1 coeng4 zo2 hou2 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在医疗这么发达，人的寿命都长了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: With the medical advancement now, people's lifespans have become much longer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好注重健康，希望可以延長壽命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyu3 zung6 gin6 hong1, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 jin4 coeng4 sau6 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很注重健康，希望可以延长寿命。
examples.english_sentence: He pays great attention to his health, hoping to prolong his lifespan.

english_meaning: Birthday star; person celebrating a birthday
explanation_mandarin: 指过生日的人，尤指年长者。
explanation_english: Refers to the person who is celebrating their birthday, especially an elderly person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你生日快樂，今日嘅壽星！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6, gam1 jat6 ge3 sau6 sing1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你生日快乐，今天的寿星！
examples.english_sentence: Happy birthday, you birthday star of today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆今日係壽星，我哋去同佢慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 gam1 jat6 hai6 sau6 sing1, ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tung4 keoi5 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶今天过生日，我们去和她庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is the birthday celebrant today, let's go celebrate with her.

synonyms: 生日嘅人 (saang1 jat6 ge3 jan4)

english_meaning: Little star of longevity; used to refer to a person celebrating their birthday, especially a child
explanation_mandarin: 指过生日的人，尤指儿童。 也可指长寿的人，含有祝福的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is celebrating their birthday, especially a child. It can also refer to a long-lived person, implying blessings of longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係我個仔嘅生日，佢係今日嘅壽星仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 ngo5 go3 zai2 ge3 saang1 jat6, keoi5 hai6 gam1 jat6 ge3 sau6 sing1 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是我儿子的生日，他是今天的寿星！
examples.english_sentence: Today is my son's birthday, he is the birthday boy today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你生日快樂，身體健康，做個快樂嘅壽星仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 saang1 jat6 faai3 lok6, san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, zou6 go3 faai3 lok6 ge3 sau6 sing1 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你生日快乐，身体健康，做一个快乐的小寿星！
examples.english_sentence: Happy birthday, good health, and be a happy birthday boy!

english_meaning: God of Longevity
explanation_mandarin: 指寿星，即中国神话中的长寿之神。也常用来比喻上了年纪的人，或嘲讽那些明知故问的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the God of Longevity in Chinese mythology. It is also often used to describe elderly people or to sarcastically refer to those who ask obvious questions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大個人，仲問埋啲咁簡單嘅嘢，真係當自己係壽星公呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4, zung6 man6 maai4 di1 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 dong3 zi6 gei2 hai6 sau6 sing1 gung1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都这么大了，还问这么简单的问题，真是把自己当寿星老了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're so old, and you're still asking such simple questions, are you really acting like the God of Longevity?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺今日生日，大家祝佢壽星公咁長命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 gam1 jat6 saang1 jat6, daai6 gaa1 zuk1 keoi5 sau6 sing1 gung1 gam3 coeng4 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷今天生日，大家祝他像寿星一样长寿。
examples.english_sentence: It's Grandpa's birthday today, everyone wish him a long life like the God of Longevity.

mandarin_meaning: 老寿星上吊；活得不耐烦
english_meaning: The God of Longevity hanging himself; tired of living; acting contrary to one's own interests.
explanation_mandarin: 寿星公，即寿星，是道教神仙，象征长寿。寿星公上吊，形容人做的事情与自己的利益完全相反，活得不耐烦，自讨苦吃。
explanation_english: "Sau Sing Gung" (壽星公) is the God of Longevity, symbolizing a long and prosperous life.  For him to hang himself is a paradox, indicating someone is doing something completely against their own interests, as if they are tired of living or are asking for trouble. It's often used sarcastically.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明冇錢，仲要買咁貴嘅嘢，真係壽星公吊頸！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 mou5 cin2, zung6 jiu3 maai5 gam3 gwai3 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 sau6 sing1 gung1 diu3 geng2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明没钱，还要买这么贵的东西，真是老寿星上吊！
examples.english_sentence: You clearly have no money, yet you still want to buy such an expensive thing, you're really asking for trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明唔識游水，仲要跳落海救人，簡直係壽星公吊頸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 m4 sik1 jau4 seoi2, zung6 jiu3 tiu3 lok6 hoi2 gau3 jan4, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sau6 sing1 gung1 diu3 geng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明不会游泳，还要跳下海救人，简直是老寿星上吊。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly can't swim, yet he still jumped into the sea to save someone, it's practically suicide.

synonyms: 攞苦嚟辛 (lo2 fu2 lai4 san1)

cantonese: 壽星公吊頸 - 嫌命長
jyutping: sau6 sing1 gung1 diu3 geng2 -- him4 ming6 coeng4
english_meaning: The God of Longevity hanging himself - finding life too long; seeking one's own demise; courting disaster.
explanation_mandarin: 寿星公是掌管人间寿命的神仙，上吊自杀是缩短寿命的行为。整个俗语比喻一个人做的事情很愚蠢，自找麻烦，或者做一些有损自身利益的事情。
explanation_english: Shouxing Gong (the God of Longevity) is the deity in charge of human lifespan. Hanging oneself is an act that shortens one's life. The idiom describes someone doing something foolish, asking for trouble, or harming their own interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔識游水都走去跳落海，真係壽星公吊頸——嫌命長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sik1 jau4 seoi2 dou1 zau2 heoi3 tiu3 lok6 hoi2, zan1 hai6 sau6 sing1 gung1 diu3 geng2 -- him4 ming6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不会游泳还跑去跳海，真是老寿星上吊——嫌命长。
examples.english_sentence: You can't swim and you still jumped into the sea, you're really the God of Longevity hanging himself - finding life too long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明知道呢份投資風險咁高，你仲要擺晒啲錢落去，簡直係壽星公吊頸——嫌命長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 zi1 dou3 ni1 fan6 tau4 zi1 fung1 him2 gam3 gou1, nei5 zung6 jiu3 baai2 saai3 di1 cin2 lok6 heoi3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 sau6 sing1 gung1 diu3 geng2 -- him4 ming6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明知道这个投资风险这么高，你还要把所有的钱都投进去，简直是老寿星上吊——嫌命长。
examples.english_sentence: Knowing that this investment is so risky, you still put all your money into it, it's practically the God of Longevity hanging himself - finding life too long.

english_meaning: Birthday girl; female birthday celebrant
explanation_mandarin: 指生日当天庆祝生日的女性。是“寿星”的女性版本。
explanation_english: Refers to a female who is celebrating her birthday on that particular day. It's the female version of "壽星" (sau6 sing1, birthday celebrant).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係我個女嘅生日，佢係今日嘅壽星女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 ngo5 go3 neoi2 ge3 sang1 jat6, keoi5 hai6 gam1 jat6 ge3 sau6 sing1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是我女儿的生日，她是今天的寿星婆。
examples.english_sentence: Today is my daughter's birthday, she's the birthday girl today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你生日快樂，壽星女！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 sang1 jat6 faai3 lok6, sau6 sing1 neoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你生日快乐，寿星女！
examples.english_sentence: Happy birthday, birthday girl!

english_meaning: coffin; funeral wood
explanation_mandarin: 指为老年人预备的棺材。传统上认为准备壽木有长寿的寓意。
explanation_english: Refers to a coffin prepared for the elderly. Traditionally, preparing a 'sau6 muk6' is believed to bring longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋開始幫阿爺準備壽木啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hoi1 chi2 bong1 aa3 je4 zhun2 bei6 sau6 muk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们开始帮爷爷准备棺材了。
examples.english_sentence: They are starting to prepare the coffin for grandpa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅人會好早準備壽木，希望可以長命百歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 jan4 wui5 hou2 zou2 zhun2 bei6 sau6 muk6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 cheung4 ming6 baak3 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人会很早准备棺材，希望可以长命百岁。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, people would prepare coffins very early, hoping to live a long life.

english_meaning: coffin board; coffin
explanation_mandarin: 指棺材的木板，泛指棺材。因为棺材是为逝者准备的，所以说“壽”字。
explanation_english: Refers to the wooden board of a coffin; generally refers to a coffin. The word '壽' (longevity) is used because coffins are prepared for the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企好窮，死咗都冇錢買壽板。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 kung4, sei2 zo2 dou1 mou5 cin2 maai5 sau6 baan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家很穷，死了都没钱买棺材。
examples.english_sentence: His family is very poor, they don't even have money to buy a coffin when he dies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁後生講埋啲咁嘅嘢，好似講緊壽板咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hau6 saang1 gong2 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5, hou2 ci5 gong2 gan2 sau6 baan2 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么年轻说这些不吉利的话，好像在说棺材一样。
examples.english_sentence: You're so young, don't say such unlucky things, it's like you're talking about coffins.

english_meaning: longevity peach bun
explanation_mandarin: 一种外形做成桃子的包子，常用于祝寿。
explanation_english: A steamed bun shaped like a peach, commonly used for birthday celebrations and wishing someone a long life.  The peach symbolizes longevity in Chinese culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日阿婆生日，我哋買咗好多壽桃包慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 aa3 po4 saang1 jat6, ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 sau6 tou4 baau1 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天奶奶生日，我们买了很多寿桃包庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday was Grandma's birthday, we bought a lot of longevity peach buns to celebrate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壽宴上面通常都會有壽桃包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau6 yin3 soeng6 min6 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 jau5 sau6 tou4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寿宴上通常都会有寿桃包。
examples.english_sentence: Longevity peach buns are usually served at birthday banquets.

english_meaning: May your life be as long as the Southern Mountain.
explanation_mandarin: 祝福他人长寿的吉祥话，比喻寿命像南山一样长久。
explanation_english: A blessing wishing someone a long life, comparing their lifespan to the Southern Mountain, implying extreme longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你身體健康，壽比南山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 tai2 gin6 hong1, sau6 bei2 naam4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你身体健康，寿比南山。
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you good health and a life as long as the Southern Mountain.

english_meaning: Lucky mole; a mole that is considered auspicious or a sign of longevity
explanation_mandarin: 指长在脸上，被认为是吉祥，预示长寿的痣。在面相学中，某些位置的痣被认为是好的，代表吉利或长寿。
explanation_english: A mole on the face that is considered lucky and a sign of longevity. In face reading, certain moles in specific locations are considered auspicious, representing good fortune or longevity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個眼角有粒壽癦，聽講代表好命。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 ngaan5 gok3 jau5 lap1 sau6 me1, teng1 gong2 doi6 biu2 hou2 ming6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的眼角有一颗好痣，据说代表好命。
examples.english_sentence: He has a lucky mole on the corner of his eye, it's said to represent good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆塊面好多癦，但係佢話只有一粒係壽癦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 faai3 min6 hou2 do1 me1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 waa6 zi2 jau5 jat1 lap1 hai6 sau6 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶的脸上有很多痣，但是她说只有一颗是好痣。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma has a lot of moles on her face, but she says only one of them is a lucky mole.

english_meaning: long eyebrows (symbol of longevity); a type of white tea
explanation_mandarin: 1. 长长的眉毛，象征长寿。 2. 白茶的一种，等级比白毫银针低。
explanation_english: 1. Long eyebrows, symbolizing longevity. 2. A type of white tea, with a lower grade than Silver Needle White Tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺啲壽眉好長，睇落好有福氣咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 di1 sau6 mei4 hou2 coeng4, tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 fuk1 hei3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷的眉毛很长，看起来很有福气。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa's eyebrows are very long, he looks very blessed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想試下你沖嘅壽眉，聽講好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 si3 haa5 nei5 cung1 ge3 sau6 mei4, ting3 gong2 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想尝尝你泡的寿眉，听说很香。
examples.english_sentence: I want to try the Shoumei tea you brew, I heard it's very fragrant.

english_meaning: to die peacefully in one's bed (of old age); to pass away peacefully
explanation_mandarin: 指在自己家里安详地去世，一般指老年人安详去世。
explanation_english: Refers to dying peacefully at home, usually referring to the peaceful death of an elderly person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢享咗九十幾歲嘅高齡，最後喺屋企壽終內寢，都算係好有福氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoeng2 zo2 gau2 sap6 gei2 seoi3 ge3 gou1 ling4, zeoi3 hau6 hai2 uk1 kei2 sau6 zung1 noi6 cam2, dou1 syun3 hai6 hou2 jau5 fuk1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他享年九十多岁的高龄，最后在家里寿终正寝，也算是很有福气。
examples.english_sentence: He lived to the ripe old age of ninety-something and passed away peacefully at home, which is considered very fortunate.

english_meaning: to die peacefully in one's bed; to die of old age in one's bed; to pass away peacefully
explanation_mandarin: 指人高寿而终，在家中自然死亡。形容去世比较安详。
explanation_english: Refers to someone dying of old age peacefully in their own home and bed. It describes a peaceful passing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺九十幾歲先壽終正寢，都算好長命啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 gau2 sap6 gei2 seoi3 sin1 sau6 zung1 zing3 cam2, dou1 syun3 hou2 coeng4 ming6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爷爷九十多岁才寿终正寝，也算是很长寿了。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather only passed away peacefully in his nineties, which is considered a very long life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望我將來都可以壽終正寢，唔駛受咁多痛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ngo5 zoeng1 loi4 dou1 ho2 ji5 sau6 zung1 zing3 cam2, m4 sai2 sau6 gam3 do1 tung3 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望我将来也可以寿终正寝，不用受那么多痛苦。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can also pass away peacefully in the future, without suffering so much pain.

english_meaning: burial clothes; shroud
explanation_mandarin: 指人去世后穿的衣服，通常为传统服饰。
explanation_english: Burial clothes, typically traditional garments, worn by the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋幫阿婆準備咗一套壽衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bong1 aa3 po4 zeon2 bei6 zo2 jat1 tou3 sau6 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们帮奶奶准备了一套寿衣。
examples.english_sentence: They prepared a set of burial clothes for grandma.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人覺得買壽衣係一件唔吉利嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 maai5 sau6 ji1 hai6 jat1 gin6 m4 gat1 lei6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们觉得买寿衣是不吉利的事情。
examples.english_sentence: People think buying burial clothes is an inauspicious thing.

english_meaning: birthday (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 比较正式的说法，指生日。多用于长辈或尊敬的人。
explanation_english: Formal term for birthday. Often used when referring to the birthday of elders or people you respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個禮拜就係爺爺嘅八十大壽辰啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 zau6 hai6 je4 je2 ge3 baat3 sap6 daai6 sau6 san4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个星期就是爷爷的八十大寿了。
examples.english_sentence: Next week is Grandpa's 80th birthday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要隆重噉慶祝嫲嫲嘅壽辰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lung4 zung6 gam2 hing3 zuk1 maa4 maa2 ge3 sau6 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要隆重地庆祝奶奶的寿辰。
examples.english_sentence: We need to celebrate Grandma's birthday in a grand manner.

english_meaning: life insurance
explanation_mandarin: 以人的寿命为保险标的的保险，当被保险人在保险期限内死亡或生存至一定年龄时，保险公司会给付保险金。
explanation_english: An insurance policy that pays out a sum of money either on the death of the insured person or after a set period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗份壽險，保障屋企人嘅將來。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 fan6 sau6 him2, bou2 zoeng3 uk1 kei5 jan4 ge3 zoeng1 loi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了份人寿保险，保障家人的将来。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a life insurance policy to protect his family's future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住買邊間公司嘅壽險啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 zyu6 maai5 bin1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sau6 him2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算买哪家公司的人寿保险啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which company's life insurance are you planning to buy?

english_meaning: idiot, fool, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 骂人的话，指愚笨、迟钝的人。
explanation_english: A derogatory term referring to a stupid, foolish, or slow-witted person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁蠢呀？真係個壽頭嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 ceon2 aa3? zan1 hai6 go3 sau6 tau4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做什么这么蠢啊？真是个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you doing things so stupidly? You're really an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞氣啦，佢都係個壽頭仔，唔明你講乜㗎。

examples.english_sentence: This person is very unreliable, you can't even trust what they say.

english_meaning: Summer Solstice
explanation_mandarin: 二十四节气之一，通常在公历6月21日或22日，表示夏季正式开始，白昼最长。
explanation_english: One of the Twenty-Four Solar Terms, usually on June 21st or 22nd in the Gregorian calendar, marking the official start of summer and the longest day of the year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夏至嗰日日頭最長，夜晚最短㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 zi3 go2 jat6 jat6 tau4 zeoi3 coeng4, je6 maan5 zeoi3 dyun2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夏至那天白天最长，夜晚最短。
examples.english_sentence: The day of the Summer Solstice has the longest day and the shortest night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係夏至喇，要開始注意防暑降溫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 haa6 zi3 laa3, jiu3 hoi1 chi2 zyu3 yi3 fong4 syu2 gong3 wan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是夏至了，要开始注意防暑降温了。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is the Summer Solstice, we need to start paying attention to preventing heatstroke and cooling down.

jyutping: haa6 zi3 zou2, lai6 zi1 jat1 ding6 hou2
mandarin_meaning: 夏至来得早，荔枝一定好
english_meaning: If the summer solstice comes early, the lychees will be good.
explanation_mandarin: 这句俗语是关于农业的经验总结。夏至是一个重要的节气，如果夏至来得比正常年份早，通常预示着接下来会有更充足的阳光和适宜的温度，有利于荔枝的生长，因此荔枝的质量和产量会更好。
explanation_english: This is a proverb based on agricultural experience. The summer solstice is an important solar term. If it arrives earlier than usual, it often indicates more sunshine and suitable temperatures in the following period, which is beneficial to the growth of lychees, resulting in better quality and higher yields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年夏至早，希望今年嘅荔枝都好食啦。 夏至早，荔枝一定好 嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 haa6 zi3 zou2, hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ge3 lai6 zi1 dou1 hou2 sik6 laa1. haa6 zi3 zou2, lai6 zi1 jat1 ding6 hou2 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的夏至来得早，希望今年的荔枝都好吃。夏至来得早，荔枝一定好 嘛。
examples.english_sentence: The summer solstice is early this year, I hope the lychees will be delicious. If the summer solstice comes early, the lychees will be good.

mandarin_meaning: 传说中的一种似龙的怪兽
english_meaning: Kui, a mythical one-legged beast in Chinese mythology
explanation_mandarin: 古代传说中的一种怪兽，形状像龙，只有一只脚。常用作形容威武的样子。
explanation_english: In ancient legends, Kui is a mythical beast resembling a dragon with only one leg. It is often used to describe a majestic and awe-inspiring appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話上古時代嘅帝王曾經用夔牛嘅皮嚟做鼓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 soeng6 gu2 si4 doi6 ge3 dai3 wong4 cang4 ging1 yung6 kui4 ngau4 ge3 pei4 lai4 zou6 gu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说上古时代的帝王曾经用夔牛的皮来做鼓。
examples.english_sentence: They say that the emperors of ancient times used the skin of the Kui bull to make drums.

english_meaning: Kui dragon pattern, kui dragon design
explanation_mandarin: 夔龙纹是一种中国传统的纹样，以传说中的神兽夔龙为主题，常用于青铜器、玉器等器物上。
explanation_english: The Kui dragon pattern is a traditional Chinese decorative motif featuring the mythical Kui dragon. It is commonly found on bronze ware, jade objects, and other artifacts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個青銅器上面有好多夔龍紋，睇落好古老。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cing1 tung4 hei3 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 kwai4 lung4 man4, tai2 lok6 hou2 gu2 lou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个青铜器上面有很多夔龙纹，看起来很古老。
examples.english_sentence: This bronze ware has many Kui dragon patterns on it; it looks very ancient.

english_meaning: evening, sunset
explanation_mandarin: 指傍晚，日落的时候。在粤语中，也常出现在一些与时间相关的词语中，表示过去，从前。
explanation_english: Refers to the evening, the time of sunset. In Cantonese, it often appears in time-related words, meaning past or previous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 除夕我哋一家人一齐食饭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceoi4 sik1 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 除夕我们一家人一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: On New Year's Eve, my family eats dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日话以前嘅日子好，夕时好过依家好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 ji5 cin4 ge3 jat6 zi2 hou2, zik6 si4 hou2 gwo3 ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说以前的日子好，以前比现在好很多。
examples.english_sentence: He always says that the old days were better, that the past was much better than now.

english_meaning: sunset; the setting sun
explanation_mandarin: 傍晚时分的太阳；日落时的景色。
explanation_english: The sun during the evening; the scenery at sunset.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日啲夕陽好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 di1 zik6 joeng4 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天的夕阳真美啊！
examples.english_sentence: The sunset yesterday was so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺夕陽下漫步，好浪漫啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 zik6 joeng4 haa6 maan6 bou6, hou2 long6 maan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在夕阳下漫步，好浪漫啊。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them were strolling in the sunset, so romantic.

english_meaning: Sunset industry, declining industry
explanation_mandarin: 指逐渐衰落，前景黯淡的产业。
explanation_english: Refers to an industry that is gradually declining and has a bleak future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 報紙呢啲傳統媒體，而家已經變咗夕陽行業喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou3 zi2 ne1 di1 cyun4 tung2 mui4 tai2, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 bin3 zo2 zik6 joeng4 hang4 jip6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 报纸这些传统媒体，现在已经变成了夕阳产业了。
examples.english_sentence: Traditional media like newspapers have now become a sunset industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都覺得影碟鋪頭係夕陽行業，好難生存落去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 jing2 dip2 pou3 tau4 hai6 zik6 joeng4 hang4 jip6, hou2 naan4 sang1 cyun4 lok6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都觉得影碟店是夕阳产业，很难生存下去。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that video stores are a sunset industry, it's hard to survive.

english_meaning: outside, outer, foreign, external
explanation_mandarin: 指外部，外面，外国的，非本地的。
explanation_english: Refers to the outside, outer part, foreign country, or something that is not local or internal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 出邊好熱，唔好喺外便逗留太耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ceot1 bin1 hou2 jit6, m4 hou2 hai2 ngoi6 bin6 dau6 lau4 taai3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外面很热，不要在外面停留太久。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot outside, don't stay outside for too long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺外國讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在国外读书。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔太識佢哋嘅外語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 taai3 sik1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ngoi6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不太懂他们的外语。
examples.english_sentence: I don't understand their foreign language very well.

english_meaning: diplomacy; foreign affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家在国际关系中处理与其他国家关系的活动，包括政治、经济、文化等方面的交往。
explanation_english: The art and practice of conducting negotiations between nations; the management of international relations by negotiation; international relations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅外交事務係由北京負責嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ngoi6 gaau1 si6 mou6 hai6 jau4 bak1 ging1 fu6 zaak3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的外交事务是由北京负责的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's foreign affairs are handled by Beijing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個國家嘅外交政策需要調整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 ngoi6 gaau1 zing3 caak3 seoi1 jiu3 tiu4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个国家的外交政策需要调整。
examples.english_sentence: This country's foreign policy needs to be adjusted.

english_meaning: diplomat
explanation_mandarin: 代表国家在国外从事外交事务的官员。
explanation_english: An official representing a country abroad, engaged in diplomatic affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好出色嘅外交官，周圍去唔同嘅國家做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 ngo6 gaau1 gun1, zau1 wai4 heoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 gwok3 gaa1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很出色的外交官，到处去不同的国家工作。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very outstanding diplomat who travels to different countries for work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外交官嘅工作好重要，因為佢哋要代表國家同其他國家溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo6 gaau1 gun1 ge3 gung1 zok3 hou2 zung6 jiu3, jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 jiu3 doi6 biu2 gwok3 gaa1 tung4 kei4 taa1 gwok3 gaa1 gau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外交官的工作很重要，因为他们要代表国家和其他国家沟通。
examples.english_sentence: The work of a diplomat is very important because they represent their country and communicate with other countries.

english_meaning: Outsider; stranger; foreigner
explanation_mandarin: 指关系疏远或不属于自己圈子的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is not part of a group or close relationship; an outsider or stranger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我哋屋企嘅事，唔關外人事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 si6, m4 gwaan1 ngoi6 jan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我们家的事情，不关外人的事。
examples.english_sentence: These are our family matters; it's none of an outsider's business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁輕易信外人講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 seon3 ngoi6 jan4 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么轻易相信外人说的话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't so easily believe what outsiders say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢當我哋係外人噉睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dong3 ngo5 dei6 hai6 ngoi6 jan4 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把我们当外人看待。
examples.english_sentence: He treats us like outsiders.

mandarin_meaning: 外来的; 外来的事物
english_meaning: foreign; external; imported; originating from outside
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：指从外面来的，不是本地的。名词：指从外面来的事物。
explanation_english: Adjective: Describes something that comes from outside, not local. Noun: Refers to things that originate from outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲外來文化對本地嘅影響好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 ngoi6 loi4 man1 faa3 deoi3 bun2 dei6 ge3 jing2 hoeng2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些外来文化对本地的影响很大。
examples.english_sentence: These foreign cultures have a great influence on the local area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋引入咗好多外來品種嘅植物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan5 jap6 zo2 hou2 do1 ngoi6 loi4 ban2 zung2 ge3 zik6 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们引进了许多外来品种的植物。
examples.english_sentence: They introduced many foreign species of plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多外來人口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 ngoi6 loi4 jan4 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多外来人口。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has a large foreign population.

english_meaning: loanword, borrowed word
explanation_mandarin: 指从其他语言借用过来的词汇。
explanation_english: A word adopted from a foreign language and incorporated into the vocabulary of the receiving language.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港嘅口語都係外來語嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hau2 jyu5 dou1 hai6 ngoi6 loi4 jyu5 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港的口语都是外来语。
examples.english_sentence: Many colloquial Cantonese words are loanwords.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「巴士」係一個好常見嘅外來語。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 siu2 gin3 ge3 ngoi6 loi4 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “巴士”是一个很常见的外来语。
examples.english_sentence: "Bus" is a very common loanword.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家越來越多外來語滲入廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 jyut6 lai4 jyut6 do1 ngoi6 loi4 jyu5 sam3 jap6 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在越来越多的外来语渗入到粤语中。
examples.english_sentence: Now more and more loanwords are infiltrating Cantonese.

english_meaning: foreign aggression; foreign invasion
explanation_mandarin: 指来自外部的侵略或侮辱。
explanation_english: Refers to aggression or humiliation from external sources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對外侮，我哋一定要團結一致抵抗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 ngoi6 mou5, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 tyun4 git3 jat1 zai3 dai2 kong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对外来的侵略，我们一定要团结一致抵抗。
examples.english_sentence: Faced with foreign aggression, we must unite and resist.

english_meaning: outside; outdoors
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物或场所的外部空间。
explanation_english: Refers to the exterior space of a building or place; outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日外便好熱呀，記得搽防曬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngoi6 bin6 hou2 jit6 aa3, gei3 dak1 caa4 fong4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天外面很热啊，记得涂防晒霜。
examples.english_sentence: It's very hot outside today, remember to put on sunscreen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺外便等你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ngoi6 bin6 dang2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在外面等你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll wait for you outside.

english_meaning: to lend out, to loan out
explanation_mandarin: 将自己的东西借给别人使用。
explanation_english: To lend something of yours to someone else to use.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想外借呢本書俾我朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 ngoi6 ze3 ni1 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把这本书借给我的朋友。
examples.english_sentence: I want to lend this book to my friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館提供外借服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 tai4 cung4 ngoi6 ze3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆提供外借服务。
examples.english_sentence: The library provides lending services.

english_meaning: outer side, outside
explanation_mandarin: 指物体的外部或侧面。
explanation_english: Refers to the outer part or side of an object.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 巴士嘅外側有好多廣告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baa1 si6 ge3 ngoi6 caak1 jau5 hou2 do1 gwong2 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 巴士的外侧有很多广告。
examples.english_sentence: There are many advertisements on the outside of the bus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行喺人行道嘅外側，小心啲車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 hai2 jan4 haang4 dou6 ge3 ngoi6 caak1, siu2 sam1 di1 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走在人行道的外侧，小心车辆。
examples.english_sentence: Walk on the outside of the sidewalk and watch out for cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟大廈外側嘅牆壁好舊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 daai6 haa6 ngoi6 caak1 ge3 cheung4 bik1 hou2 gau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座大厦外侧的墙壁很旧。
examples.english_sentence: The walls on the outside of this building are very old.

english_meaning: Foreign domestic helper
explanation_mandarin: 指来自外国的家庭佣工，通常指来自菲律宾、印尼等地的家庭佣工。
explanation_english: Refers to domestic helpers from foreign countries, typically from the Philippines, Indonesia, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企請咗個外傭照顧小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ceng2 zo2 go3 ngoi6 yung4 ziu3 gu3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家请了一个外籍佣工照顾小朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Our family hired a foreign domestic helper to take care of the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家香港好多家庭都請外傭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 dou1 ceng2 ngoi6 yung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在香港很多家庭都请外籍佣工。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many families in Hong Kong hire foreign domestic helpers.

english_meaning: Rumor; Legend; Unofficial Account; It is said that...
explanation_mandarin: 指未经官方证实或公开的消息，通常指流传于民间的传闻、传说，或者非官方的传记故事。
explanation_english: Refers to news or stories that are not officially confirmed or published. It usually refers to rumors, legends circulating among the people, or unofficial biographical stories.  Can also mean 'it is said that...'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外傳佢發咗達，搬咗去美國住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 cyun4 keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6, bun1 zo2 heoi3 mei5 gwok3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说他发财了，搬到美国住了。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that he became rich and moved to the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故事只係外傳，真實性有待考證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 si6 zi2 hai6 ngoi6 cyun4, zan1 sat6 sing3 jau5 doi6 haau2 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事只是一个传说，真实性还有待考证。
examples.english_sentence: This story is just a legend; its authenticity remains to be verified.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外傳佢哋兩個鬧翻咗，唔再係朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 cyun4 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 naau6 faan1 zo2, m4 zoi3 hai6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传闻他们两个闹翻了，不再是朋友了。
examples.english_sentence: It is rumored that the two of them had a falling out and are no longer friends.

english_meaning: foreign debt; external debt
explanation_mandarin: 指向国外借的债款。
explanation_english: Debt owed to a foreign entity, such as a foreign government, bank, or international organization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司爭落好多外債，恐怕好難還得清。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zaang1 lok6 hou2 do1 ngoi6 zaai3, kung2 paa3 hou2 naan4 waan4 dak1 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司欠了很多外债，恐怕很难还得清。
examples.english_sentence: The company has accumulated a lot of foreign debt, I'm afraid it will be difficult to pay off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果國家外債太多，經濟就會受到影響。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gwok3 gaa1 ngoi6 zaai3 taai3 do1, ging1 zai3 zau6 wui5 sau6 dou3 jing2 hoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果国家外债太多，经济就会受到影响。
examples.english_sentence: If a country has too much foreign debt, the economy will be affected.

english_meaning: external injury; wound
explanation_mandarin: 指身体表面受到的损伤，如割伤、擦伤、撞伤等。
explanation_english: An injury to the external surface of the body, such as a cut, abrasion, or contusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跌親搞到周身外傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dit3 can1 gaau2 dou3 zau1 san1 ngoi6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摔倒了，弄得全身都是外伤。
examples.english_sentence: He fell and ended up with injuries all over his body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生幫佢處理外傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 bong1 keoi5 cyu2 lei5 ngoi6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生帮他处理外伤。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor treated his external injuries.

english_meaning: toe-out (walking style)
explanation_mandarin: 指走路或站立时，脚尖向外撇，形成“八”字形的姿势。
explanation_english: Refers to a walking or standing style where the toes point outwards, forming the shape of the Chinese character '八' (eight).  It is also known as 'toe-out'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路外八得好犀利㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 ngoi6 baat3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路外八字很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: He walks with a very pronounced toe-out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢外八可能係細個嘅時候姿勢唔正確導致嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 ngoi6 baat3 ho2 nang4 hai6 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zi1 sai3 m4 zing3 kok3 dou6 zi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他外八字可能是小时候姿势不正确导致的。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his toe-out might be caused by incorrect posture when he was little.

english_meaning: maternal grandfather
explanation_mandarin: 指母亲的父亲。
explanation_english: Refers to the father of one's mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好掛住我外公呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 ngo5 ngoi6 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很想我的外公。
examples.english_sentence: I miss my maternal grandfather very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時，成日都去外公屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, seng4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 ngoi6 gung1 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去外公家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often went to my maternal grandfather's house to play.

english_meaning: cold on the outside, warm on the inside
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人表面上看起来冷漠，但实际上内心热情。
explanation_english: Describes a person who appears cold or aloof on the outside but is actually warm and caring on the inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人外冷內熱㗎，雖然平時唔多出聲，但係好幫得手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 ngoi6 laang5 noi6 jit6 gaa3, seoi1 jin4 ping4 si4 m4 do1 cheut1 seng1, daan6 hai6 hou2 bong1 dak1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人外冷内热，虽然平时不怎么说话，但是很能帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: He's cold on the outside, warm on the inside. Although he doesn't talk much usually, he's very helpful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢個樣呃到，佢其實係外冷內熱啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 go3 joeng2 aak1 dou3, keoi5 kei4 sat6 hai6 ngoi6 laang5 noi6 jit6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他的外表骗了，他其实是外冷内热而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be fooled by his appearance, he's actually cold on the outside, warm on the inside.

english_meaning: to go out, to leave (home, office, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 离开家、办公室等地方到外面去。
explanation_english: To leave a place such as home, office, or building to go outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日要外出辦啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jiu3 ngoi6 ceot1 baan6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天要外出办点事。
examples.english_sentence: I need to go out and run some errands today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都外出應酬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 ngoi6 ceot1 ying1 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常外出应酬。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes out for social engagements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁外出，外面好多壞人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 ngoi6 ceot1, ngoi6 min6 hou2 do1 waai6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱跑出去，外面有很多坏人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't go wandering off randomly; there are a lot of bad people outside.

english_meaning: outsource, subcontract
explanation_mandarin: 指公司将部分工作或业务委托给外部公司或个人完成。
explanation_english: To contract out work or tasks to an external company or individual; to subcontract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司將啲IT嘢外判咗畀另一間公司做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 zoeng1 di1 IT je5 ngoi6 paan3 zo2 bei2 ling6 jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司把一些IT业务外包给另一家公司做了。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has outsourced some IT work to another company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗慳錢，佢哋決定將生產線外判去大陸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 haan1 cin2, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 sang1 caan2 sin3 ngoi6 paan3 heoi3 daai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了省钱，他们决定把生产线外包去大陆。
examples.english_sentence: In order to save money, they decided to outsource the production line to mainland China.

english_meaning: external force, outside influence
explanation_mandarin: 外部的力量或影响。
explanation_english: A force or influence that comes from outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事係喺外力干擾之下先至搞成咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hai6 hai2 ngoi6 lik6 gon1 jiu2 zi1 haa6 sin1 zi3 gaau2 sing4 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是在外力干扰下才变成这样的。
examples.english_sentence: This matter only turned out like this because of external interference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺外力幫助下成功升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngoi6 lik6 bong1 zo6 haa6 sing4 gung1 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在外力帮助下成功升职。
examples.english_sentence: He was successfully promoted with external help.

english_meaning: external affairs; outside duties; field work
explanation_mandarin: 指对外事务、外勤工作或非本职范围内的工作。
explanation_english: Refers to external affairs, field work, or work outside of one's main job responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都要出去做外務，好少喺公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 cheot1 heoi3 zou6 ngoi6 mou6, hou2 siu2 hai2 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常要出去做外勤工作，很少在公司。
examples.english_sentence: He often has to go out to do external duties, and is rarely in the office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅外務部負責處理所有對外嘅合作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 ngoi6 mou6 bou6 fu6 zaak3 chu5 lei5 so2 jau5 deoi3 ngoi6 ge3 hap6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的外事部负责处理所有对外的合作。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's external affairs department is responsible for handling all external collaborations.

english_meaning: Foreign worker, migrant worker
explanation_mandarin: 指来自国外的劳工，通常从事本地人不愿做或稀缺的工作。
explanation_english: Refers to a foreign worker, usually employed in jobs that locals are unwilling to do or where there is a shortage of local workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多地盤都係靠外勞做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 dei6 paan2 dou1 hai6 kaau3 ngoi6 lou4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多工地都是靠外籍劳工工作。
examples.english_sentence: Many construction sites in Hong Kong rely on foreign workers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請外勞手續好麻煩㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 ngoi6 lou4 sau2 zuk1 hou2 maa4 faan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 聘请外籍劳工的手续很麻烦的。
examples.english_sentence: The procedures for hiring foreign workers are very troublesome.

english_meaning: field work; outside duty; external affairs
explanation_mandarin: 指不在办公室而在外面进行的事务性工作，例如拜访客户、实地考察等。
explanation_english: Refers to work that is carried out outside the office, such as visiting clients, conducting field studies, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅sales成日都要做外勤㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 sales seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zou6 ngoi6 kan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的销售人员经常要做外勤的。
examples.english_sentence: Our company's sales staff often have to do field work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日要出外勤，唔返嚟食晏啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 ngoi6 kan4, m4 faan1 lai4 sik6 aan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天要去外勤，不回来吃午饭了。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go out for field work today, so I won't be back for lunch.

english_meaning: foreign exchange; forex
explanation_mandarin: 指以外国货币表示的，为进行国际结算的支付手段和资产。
explanation_english: Foreign exchange refers to assets and means of payment denominated in foreign currencies, used for international settlement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家外匯市場波動好大，投資要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ngoi6 wui6 si5 coeng4 bo1 dung6 hou2 daai6, tau4 zi1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在外汇市场波动很大，投资要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The foreign exchange market is very volatile now, so be careful when investing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個自由外匯市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 zi6 jau4 ngoi6 wui6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个自由外汇市场。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a free foreign exchange market.

english_meaning: superficial; judging people based on appearance; appearance-oriented
explanation_mandarin: 指非常注重外貌，以貌取人的人或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who places a high value on appearance and judges people based on their looks. It can describe the person or the behavior itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁外協，淨係睇樣揀男朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ngoi6 hip3, zing6 hai6 tai2 joeng2 gaan2 naam4 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太外貌协会了，只看脸挑男朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's so superficial, he only chooses boyfriends based on their looks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁外協啦，內在美先至重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ngoi6 hip3 laa1, noi6 zoi6 mei5 sin1 zi3 zung6 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么外貌协会了，内在美才重要。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so appearance-oriented, inner beauty is what matters.

english_meaning: extroverted, outgoing
explanation_mandarin: 性格开朗，喜欢与人交往。
explanation_english: Describing someone who is outgoing, sociable, and enjoys interacting with others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好外向，成日同人傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ngoi6 hoeng3, seng4 jat6 tung4 jan4 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很外向，总是和人聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very extroverted person and always chats with people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係好外向嘅人，比較鍾意靜靜哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 ngoi6 hoeng3 ge3 jan4, bei2 gaau3 zung1 ji3 zing6 zing6 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是一个很外向的人，比较喜欢安静。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not a very extroverted person, I prefer to be quiet.

english_meaning: foreign businessman; foreign merchant; foreign company
explanation_mandarin: 指来自外国的商人或公司。
explanation_english: Refers to businessmen or companies from foreign countries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店好多外商住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 hou2 do1 ngoi6 soeng1 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店住着很多外商。
examples.english_sentence: Many foreign businessmen stay in this hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港吸引咗好多外商嚟投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 kap1 jan5 zo2 hou2 do1 ngoi6 soeng1 lai4 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港吸引了很多外商来投资。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has attracted many foreign businessmen to invest.

english_meaning: foreign country; abroad
explanation_mandarin: 指自己国家以外的国家。
explanation_english: A country other than one's own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日都想去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常都想去外国。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I always wanted to go abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺外國讀緊書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 duk6 gan2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在外国读书。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 外國嘅月亮又圓啲？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngoi6 gwok3 ge3 jyut6 loeng6 jau6 jyun4 di1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外国的月亮比较圆？
examples.english_sentence: Is the moon rounder in foreign countries?

english_meaning: Foreigner, non-national
explanation_mandarin: 指不是本国国籍的人。
explanation_english: A person who is not a national of the country being referred to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多外國人住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多外国人住。
examples.english_sentence: There are many foreigners living in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢識講流利嘅廣東話，但係佢係個外國人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik1 gong2 lau4 lei6 ge3 gwong2 dung1 waa2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hai6 go3 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他会说流利的广东话，但他是个外国人。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks fluent Cantonese, but he's a foreigner.

jyutping: ngoi6 gwok3 jyut6 loeng6 dak6 bit6 jyun4
english_meaning: The grass is always greener on the other side (literally: The moon is rounder in foreign countries)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻认为外国的一切都比自己的国家好，带有崇洋媚外的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the belief that everything in foreign countries is better than one's own country, implying a tendency to admire foreign things and belittle one's own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日覺得外國月亮特別圓啦，香港都有好多好嘅嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gok3 dak1 ngoi6 gwok3 jyut6 loeng6 dak6 bit6 jyun4 laa1, hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 ge3 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是觉得外国的月亮特别圆了，香港也有很多好的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think the grass is greener on the other side; Hong Kong has many good things too.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話外國月亮特別圓，移民咗之後先知原來都係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 ngoi6 gwok3 jyut6 loeng6 dak6 bit6 jyun4, ji4 man4 zo2 zi1 hau6 sin1 zi1 jyun4 loi4 dou1 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说外国的月亮特别圆，移民之后才知道原来也都一样。
examples.english_sentence: He always said the grass was greener on the other side, but only realized it was the same after immigrating.

synonyms: 崇洋媚外 (cung4 joeng4 mei6 ngoi5)
羨慕外國 (sin6 mou6 ngoi6 gwok3)

english_meaning: Periphery; surroundings; outskirts; (in gambling/prostitution) operating outside of licensed venues
explanation_mandarin: 指外部的范围，周围的环境；也指非法赌博或卖淫活动的场外经营。
explanation_english: Refers to the outer perimeter, the surrounding environment; also refers to illegal gambling or prostitution activities operating outside of licensed or legal venues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲外圍波好難捉摸㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 ngoi6 wai4 bo1 hou2 naan4 zuk1 mo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 外围的赌球很难捉摸。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to predict the results of illegal soccer gambling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺香港嘅外圍地方，出入都唔方便。

examples.english_sentence: He lives in the outskirts of Hong Kong, so it's not convenient to get around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方掃蕩外圍賭檔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 sou3 dong6 ngoi6 wai4 dou2 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方扫荡场外赌博场所。
examples.english_sentence: The police raided the illegal gambling dens.

english_meaning: Qualifying round; Preliminary round
explanation_mandarin: 指体育赛事中，为了选拔正式参赛队伍或选手而进行的比赛。通常在正式比赛之前举行，让水平较低或排名靠后的队伍/选手有机会争取进入正式比赛的资格。
explanation_english: Refers to a round of competition in sports tournaments held to determine which teams or individuals will qualify for the main competition. These are usually held before the main tournament, giving lower-ranked or less experienced teams/athletes a chance to qualify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港隊喺世界盃外圍賽輸咗波，冇得入決賽週。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 deoi2 hai2 sai3 gaai3 bui1 ngoi6 wai4 coi3 syu1 zo2 bo1, mou5 dak1 jap6 kyut3 coi3 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港队在世界杯资格赛输了比赛，没有进入决赛圈。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong team lost in the World Cup qualifying round and didn't qualify for the finals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗奧運外圍賽，希望可以攞到資格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 ou3 wan6 ngoi6 wai4 coi3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 lo2 dou2 zi1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了奥运会资格赛，希望可以获得参赛资格。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in the Olympic qualifying round, hoping to get qualified.

english_meaning: Illegal betting on horse races; off-track betting (illegal)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过非官方渠道进行的赛马赌博活动。通常赔率和玩法与官方渠道不同，且不受法律保护。
explanation_english: Refers to illegal horse racing betting activities conducted through unofficial channels. The odds and betting methods are usually different from official channels and are not protected by law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都賭外圍馬，輸咗好多錢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是赌外围马，输了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always bets on illegal horse racing and has lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 賭外圍馬係犯法㗎，千祈唔好試呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou2 ngoi6 wai4 maa5 hai6 faan6 faat3 gaa3, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 si3 aa3!
