examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 naau6 gaau1, ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 do1 jat1 si6 bat1 jyu4 siu2 jat1 si6, m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻吵架，我们还是多一事不如少一事，不要理他们了。
examples.english_sentence: They are having a fight, it's better for us to stay out of it, let's not interfere.

synonyms: 明哲保身 (ming4 zit3 bou2 san1)

english_meaning: countless; innumerable; too numerous to count
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，无法数清。
explanation_english: Describes a very large quantity, so numerous that it cannot be counted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅遊客多不勝數，特別係假期嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jau4 haak3 do1 bat1 sing1 sou3, dak6 bit1 hai6 gaa3 kei4 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的游客数不胜数，尤其是在假期的时候。
examples.english_sentence: There are countless tourists in Hong Kong, especially during the holidays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會入面嘅歌迷多不勝數，氣氛好熱烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 jap6 min6 ge3 go1 mai1 do1 bat1 sing1 sou3, hei3 fan1 hou2 jit6 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会里面的歌迷数不胜数，气氛非常热烈。
examples.english_sentence: There were countless fans at the concert, the atmosphere was very lively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天上面嘅星星多不勝數，真係好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 soeng6 min6 ge3 sing1 sing1 do1 bat1 sing1 sou3, zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天空中的星星数不胜数，真是太漂亮了！
examples.english_sentence: There are countless stars in the sky, it's so beautiful!

english_meaning: how long; how much time
explanation_mandarin: 询问时间的长短。
explanation_english: Used to ask about the duration of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要等多久先有車呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 dang2 do1 gau2 sin1 jau5 ce1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要等多久才有车啊？
examples.english_sentence: How long do you have to wait before there's a car?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋結婚咗多久呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 git3 fan1 zo2 do1 gau2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们结婚多久了？
examples.english_sentence: How long have you been married?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲有幾耐呀？大約個半鐘，你估吓我要睇多久先睇得完？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 jau5 gei2 noi6 aa3? daai6 joek3 go3 bun3 zung1, nei5 gu2 haa5 ngo5 jiu3 tai2 do1 gau2 sin1 tai2 dak1 jyun4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影有多长啊？大约一个半小时，你猜我要看多久才能看完？
examples.english_sentence: How long is this movie? About an hour and a half, guess how long it'll take me to finish watching it?

english_meaning: meddlesome; interfering; to be a busybody; to make trouble; to create problems
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢管闲事，制造麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who likes to meddle in other people's affairs or create trouble. Can also describe something that creates unnecessary complications or difficulty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多事啦，人哋嘅嘢由人哋自己搞掂啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 si6 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 je5 jau4 jan4 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么多事了，别人的事情让他们自己解决吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so meddlesome, let them handle their own affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多嘢，咪即係多事囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 je5, mai1 zik1 hai6 do1 si6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞这么多事情，不就是多事吗？
examples.english_sentence: Creating so many things, isn't that just being a busybody/making trouble?

english_meaning: a time of troubles; a period of crisis; a turbulent time
explanation_mandarin: 指事故或事变很多的时期。
explanation_english: Refers to a period characterized by many troubles, incidents, or crises. It implies a period of instability and upheaval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，社會又咁亂，真係多事之秋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, se5 wui2 jau6 gam3 lyun6, zan1 hai6 do1 si6 zi1 cau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，社会又这么乱，真是多事之秋。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad now, and society is so chaotic. It's really a time of troubles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年發生咗好多天災人禍，可以話係多事之秋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 faat3 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 tin1 zoi1 yan4 wo6, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 do1 si6 zi1 cau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年发生了好多天灾人祸，可以说是多事之秋。
examples.english_sentence: This year, many natural disasters and man-made calamities have occurred. It can be said to be a time of troubles.

english_meaning: troublesome; a lot of things to do; busy with many tasks; a lot of hassle
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情多，麻烦多，或者事情繁琐。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where there are many things to do, a lot of trouble, or things are complicated and troublesome. It can also refer to a person who makes things complicated for others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排真係多事幹，日日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 zan1 hai6 do1 si6 gon3, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近真是很多事，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: It's really troublesome lately; I have to work overtime every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多事幹啦，淨係做好你嘅嘢就得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 si6 gon3 laa1, zing6 hai6 zou6 hou2 nei5 ge3 je5 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么多事了，做好你的事就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so troublesome, just do your job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多嘢咪即係多事幹囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 mai1 zik1 hai6 do1 si6 gon3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞这么多事情不就是多事吗。
examples.english_sentence: Doing so many things is just being troublesome.

english_meaning: Slow-witted; dull; stupid; a bit daft
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应慢，有点笨，不太聪明。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow to react, a little stupid or not very intelligent. It's a mild insult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢咁慢吞吞，真係多二錢重㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 gam3 maan6 tan1 tan1, zan1 hai6 do1 ji6 cin4 cung5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事这么慢吞吞的，真是有点笨！
examples.english_sentence: You're so slow at doing things, you're really a bit slow-witted!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁多二錢重啦，講咗咁多次都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 do1 ji6 cin4 cung5 laa1, gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨了，说了这么多次都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so daft, I've explained it so many times and you still don't understand.

jyutping: do1 go3 jan4 do1 soeng1 faai3
english_meaning: The more the merrier; With more people, it just takes a few more chopsticks (meaning it's easy to accommodate an extra person).
explanation_mandarin: 形容增加的人员不会带来太大的负担，容易接纳。
explanation_english: Describes that adding more people won't be a big burden, implying it's easy to accommodate them, usually referring to situations like meals or simple tasks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁擔心嘅，多個人多雙筷啫，一齊食飯囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daam1 sam1 ge3, do1 go3 jan4 do1 soeng1 faai3 ze1, jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么担心，多一个人多一双筷子而已，一起吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry so much. The more the merrier. Let's have dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 是但啦，多個人多雙筷，加多張櫈就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 daan6 laa1, do1 go3 jan4 do1 soeng1 faai3, gaa1 do1 zoeng1 dang3 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 随便吧，多一个人多一双筷子，加多一把椅子就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Whatever, the more the merrier, we just need to add another chair.

jyutping: do1 go3 hoeng1 lou4 do1 zek3 gwai2
english_meaning: Too many cooks spoil the broth; the more the people, the more the problems.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻参与的人或部门多了，反而容易产生矛盾，难以处理。通常指增加人员反而带来更多问题，降低效率。
explanation_english: This idiom figuratively means that when there are too many people involved in a task, it becomes more difficult to manage and resolve issues. It suggests that adding more people can paradoxically lead to more problems and decreased efficiency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事已經夠晒複雜，唔好再加人啦，多個香爐多隻鬼呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 ji5 ging1 gau3 saai3 fuk1 zaap6, m4 hou2 zoi3 gaa1 jan4 laa1, do1 go3 hoeng1 lou4 do1 zek3 gwai2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事已经够复杂了，不要再加人了，人多了事情就不好办啊。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is already complex enough, don't add any more people, the more the people, the more the problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司啲部門太多，多個香爐多隻鬼，搞到效率好低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 bou6 mun4 taai3 do1, do1 go3 hoeng1 lou4 do1 zek3 gwai2, gaau2 dou3 haau2 leot2 hou2 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的部门太多了，人多了事情就不好办，导致效率很低。
examples.english_sentence: There are too many departments in this company, leading to inefficiency because the more people, the more problems.

english_meaning: Toronto
explanation_mandarin: 加拿大安大略省的省会，也是加拿大最大的城市之一。
explanation_english: The capital city of Ontario, Canada, and one of the largest cities in Canada.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去多倫多探親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 do1 leon4 do1 taam3 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去多伦多探亲戚。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Toronto next month to visit relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多倫多啲樓價好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 leon4 do1 di1 lau2 gaa3 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多伦多的房价很贵。
examples.english_sentence: The housing prices in Toronto are very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺多倫多讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 do1 leon4 do1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在多伦多读书。
examples.english_sentence: He studies in Toronto.

english_meaning: diverse, multiple, pluralistic
explanation_mandarin: 指具有多种不同的性质、形式或要素。
explanation_english: Refers to having a variety of different qualities, forms, or elements; diverse or multifaceted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係一個多元文化嘅城市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 do1 jyun4 man4 faa3 ge3 sing4 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是一个多元文化的城市。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is a multicultural city.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品線好多元化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 sin3 hou2 do1 jyun4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的产品线很多元化。
examples.english_sentence: This company's product line is very diverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重社會嘅多元聲音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 se5 wui2 ge3 do1 jyun4 seng1 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重社会的多元声音。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect the diverse voices of society.

english_meaning: Diversification, diversity, pluralization
explanation_mandarin: 指事物具有多种不同的形式、特征或方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the existence of a variety of different forms, characteristics, or aspects in something. Describes the process of becoming more diverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品線好多元化，乜嘢都有得賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 sin3 hou2 dyun1 jyun4 faa3, mat1 je5 dou1 jau5 dak1 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的产品线非常多元化，什么都有得卖。
examples.english_sentence: This company has a very diversified product line; they sell everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅文化好多元化，可以體驗到唔同國家嘅風俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 man4 faa3 hou2 dyun1 jyun4 faa3, ho2 ji5 tai1 jim6 dou3 m4 tung4 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 fung1 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的文化非常多元化，可以体验到不同国家的风俗。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's culture is very diverse, you can experience customs from different countries.

english_meaning: To value more, to attach more importance to, to think more highly of
explanation_mandarin: 比喻更加看重某人或某事物，更加重视。
explanation_english: A metaphor that means to value someone or something more, to attach greater importance to it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完書之後，屋企人多咗兩錢重佢嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 syu1 zi1 hau6, uk1 kei5 jan4 do1 zo2 loeng5 cin4 zung6 keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读完书之后，家里人更重视他的意见了。
examples.english_sentence: After he finished his studies, his family valued his opinions more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗職之後，公司多咗兩錢重佢嘅能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, gung1 si1 do1 zo2 loeng5 cin4 zung6 keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职后，公司更重视他的能力了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he got promoted, the company thinks more highly of his abilities.

english_meaning: Dirty, filthy
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常肮脏，不干净。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely dirty and filthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間廁所多利亞到呢，真係唔想入去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 ci3 so2 do1 lei6 aa3 dou3 ni1, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 jap6 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厕所太脏了，真不想进去。
examples.english_sentence: This toilet is so filthy, I really don't want to go in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢件衫污糟到多利亞咁，應該洗下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin6 saam1 wu1 zou1 dou3 do1 lei6 aa3 gam3, ying1 goi1 sai2 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的衣服脏得不成样子，应该洗洗了。
examples.english_sentence: His clothes are so dirty, he should wash them.

english_meaning: The more you work, the more you gain; the more effort, the more reward
explanation_mandarin: 付出越多，得到越多。强调努力工作与回报成正比。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes that the amount of reward is directly proportional to the amount of effort put in. It means that the more one works, the more one will gain or achieve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司興「多勞多得」制，做得越多，獎金越多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 hing1 "do1 lou4 do1 dak1" zai3, zou6 dak1 yut6 do1, zoeng2 gam1 yut6 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司实行“多劳多得”制，做得越多，奖金越多。
examples.english_sentence: The company implements a "the more you work, the more you gain" system. The more you work, the more bonus you get.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢信奉「多勞多得」，日日都好勤力咁做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seon3 fung6 "do1 lou4 do1 dak1", jat1 jat1 dou1 hou2 kan4 lik6 gam2 zou6 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他信奉“多劳多得”，每天都很勤奋地工作。
examples.english_sentence: He believes in "the more you work, the more you gain" and works very hard every day.

english_meaning: mostly, in most cases, probably
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概率，大部分情况下。
explanation_english: Indicates a high probability or that something is the case in most instances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日多半會落雨㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 do1 bun3 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天多半会下雨的。
examples.english_sentence: It will probably rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生多半都鍾意放暑假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 do1 bun3 dou1 zung1 ji3 fong3 syu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们多半都喜欢放暑假。
examples.english_sentence: Most students like summer vacation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢多半唔會嚟㗎啦，佢好忙㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 do1 bun3 m4 wui5 lai4 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 hou2 mong4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他多半不会来的，他很忙的。
examples.english_sentence: He probably won't come, he's very busy.

english_meaning: garrulous; talkative; meddlesome; to butt in; to be nosy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人话多，爱插嘴，或喜欢搬弄是非。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is talkative, prone to butting in, or likes to gossip and cause trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多口啦，人哋嘅事由得佢哋自己搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 hau2 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 si6 jau4 dak1 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多嘴了，别人的事让他们自己解决。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy. Let them handle their own affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係問下啫，你唔使咁多口解釋咁多嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 man6 haa5 ze1, nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 do1 hau2 gaai2 sik1 gam3 do1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是问一下而已，你不用那么多嘴解释那么多。
examples.english_sentence: I was just asking; you don't need to be so talkative and explain so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人就係咁多口，成日周圍講人哋壞話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zau6 hai6 gam3 do1 hau2, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 gong2 jan4 dei6 waai6 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人就是很多嘴，整天到处说别人坏话。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a talkative person like that, always going around badmouthing others.

english_meaning: garrulous, talkative, gossipy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话很多，爱搬弄是非，多管闲事。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks too much, likes to gossip, and is meddlesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多口水啦，人哋嘅事關你咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 hau2 seoi2 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 si6 gwaan1 nei5 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么多嘴了，别人的事关你什么事啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so gossipy. What business is it of yours?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都多口水，所以我唔鍾意同佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 do1 hau2 seoi2, so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是很多嘴，所以我不喜欢和他说话。
examples.english_sentence: He's always so talkative and gossipy, so I don't like talking to him.

english_meaning: to butt in; to say more than one should; to be nosy
explanation_mandarin: 指不该说的话说了出来，多管闲事的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to saying something that shouldn't be said, often implying interfering or being nosy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係想多句嘴，但係你咁樣做真係唔得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 soeng2 do1 geoi3 zeoi2, daan6 hai6 nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是想多嘴，但是你这样做真的不行啊。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to butt in, but you really can't do it this way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多句嘴啦，呢件事唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 geoi3 zeoi2 laa1, ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多嘴啦，这件事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, this is none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我純粹多句嘴啫，你唔使咁緊張。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seon4 seoi6 do1 geoi3 zeoi2 ze1, nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是多嘴而已，你不用那么紧张。
examples.english_sentence: I was just butting in, you don't have to be so nervous.

english_meaning: garrulous, talkative; meddlesome; to butt in, to be nosy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人话多，爱插嘴，喜欢评论或干涉别人的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is talkative, tends to butt in, and likes to comment on or interfere in other people's affairs. Implies being meddlesome and indiscreet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多咀啦，人哋嘅事唔關你事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 zeoi2 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多嘴啦，别人的事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, it's none of your business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日多咀，搞到好多人都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 do1 zeoi2, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天多嘴，搞得很多人都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always butting in, so many people don't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽話我多咀，叫我唔好理咁多閒事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 do1 zeoi2, giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 lei5 gam3 do1 haan4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈说我多嘴，叫我不要管那么多闲事。
examples.english_sentence: My mom said I was being nosy and told me not to meddle in so many things.

english_meaning: fool, idiot, dummy
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语，指愚笨、傻气的人。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang term for a foolish or idiotic person. It is often used playfully or teasingly, but can also be derogatory depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係多哥，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 do1 go1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个傻瓜，这么简单的东西都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: You're such a fool, you can't even do something so simple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多哥啦，快啲諗辦法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 go1 laa1, faai3 di1 nim2 baan6 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨了，快点想办法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, hurry and think of a solution.

english_meaning: more; a little more; some more
explanation_mandarin: 表示增加数量或程度。用于请求或建议时，表示希望对方多做一些。
explanation_english: Indicates increasing quantity or degree. Used in requests or suggestions, it expresses the desire for the other party to do more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你飲多啲水啦，唔好咁容易病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jam2 do1 di1 seoi2 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你多喝点水吧，别那么容易生病。
examples.english_sentence: Drink more water, don't get sick so easily.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你比多啲心機讀書啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bei2 do1 di1 sam1 gei1 duk6 syu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你多用点心读书吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put more effort into studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講多啲 details 啦，我想知清楚啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 do1 di1 details laa1, ngo5 soeng2 zi1 cing1 co2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多说点细节吧，我想知道清楚点。
examples.english_sentence: Tell me more details, I want to know more clearly.

jyutping: do1 di1 lai4 mat6 di1 sau2
english_meaning: Come more often, do more (work/effort)
explanation_mandarin: 鼓励别人经常来，并且多帮忙，多出力。
explanation_english: Encourages someone to come more often and to contribute more effort or help when they do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，阿明，得閒多啲嚟密啲手啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, aa3 ming4, dak1 haan4 do1 di1 lai4 mat6 di1 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，阿明，有空多来几次，多帮帮忙啊！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Ming, come more often and help out more when you're free!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫手搞掂呢個project，真係唔該曬你，得閒多啲嚟密啲手啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 sau2 gaau2 dim6 ni1 go3 project, zan1 hai6 m4 goi1 saai3 nei5, dak1 haan4 do1 di1 lai4 mat6 di1 sau2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮忙搞定这个项目，真是非常感谢你，以后有空多来几次，多帮帮忙吧！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much for helping to complete this project. Please come more often and lend a hand!

english_meaning: talkative; meddlesome; to say too much; to put one's oar in
explanation_mandarin: 指不该说的话说了出来，或者喜欢插嘴，多管闲事。
explanation_english: To say something one shouldn't have; to be meddlesome; to offer unwanted advice or opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多嘴啦，冇人想聽你講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 zeoi2 laa1, mou5 jan4 soeng2 teng1 nei5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多嘴了，没人想听你说话。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so talkative, nobody wants to listen to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日多嘴，所以啲同事都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 do1 zeoi2, so2 ji5 di1 tung4 si6 dou1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是多嘴，所以同事们都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always meddlesome, so his colleagues don't like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪多嘴啦！呢件事唔關你事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 do1 zeoi2 laa1! ni1 gin6 si6 m4 gwaan1 nei5 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别多嘴了！这件事不关你的事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put your oar in! This is none of your business.

english_meaning: unnecessary, superfluous, redundant, extra
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事物是多余的、不需要的。
explanation_english: Describes something as unnecessary, superfluous, or redundant. It implies that something is an extra burden or complication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都做晒啦，仲叫我做？多嚿魚呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 zou6 saai3 laa1, zung6 giu3 ngo5 zou6? do1 gau6 jyu2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都做完了，还叫我做？多余吗？
examples.english_sentence: You've already done everything, why are you asking me to do it too? Is it really necessary?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個功能其實冇乜用，簡直係多嚿魚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 nang4 kei4 sat6 mou5 mat1 jung6, gaan2 zik6 hai6 do1 gau6 jyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个功能其实没什么用，简直是多余的。
examples.english_sentence: This function is actually not very useful, it's completely unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經夠忙喇，你唔好再加多嚿魚畀我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 gau3 mong4 laa3, nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gaa1 do1 gau6 jyu2 bei2 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经够忙了，你不要再给我增加负担了！
examples.english_sentence: I'm already busy enough, don't give me any extra burden!

english_meaning: toast
explanation_mandarin: 指烤过的面包片，通常搭配黄油或果酱食用。
explanation_english: Refers to sliced bread that has been browned by radiant heat, usually served with butter or jam.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食多士，加啲花生醬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 do1 si2, gaa1 di1 faa1 sang1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃吐司，加点花生酱。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat toast with some peanut butter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅多士好好食，好脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 do1 si2 hou2 hou2 sik6, hou2 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的吐司很好吃，很脆。
examples.english_sentence: The toast in this restaurant is very delicious, it's very crispy.

english_meaning: toaster
explanation_mandarin: 一种用于烘烤面包片的电器。
explanation_english: An electrical appliance for toasting bread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用多士爐整咗兩塊多士做早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 do1 si6 lou4 zeng2 zo2 loeng5 faai3 do1 si6 zou2 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用烤面包机做了两片吐司当早餐。
examples.english_sentence: I used the toaster to make two slices of toast for breakfast.

mandarin_meaning: 多多的; 多谢; 尽量
english_meaning: Much; a lot; many; thank you very much; as much as possible; do your best
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 副词; 形容词; 动词
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量多；表示感谢，相当于“多谢”；表示尽力，尽量。
explanation_english: Indicates a large quantity; expresses gratitude, equivalent to "thank you very much"; indicates doing one's best or as much as possible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該曬，多多指教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 saai3, do1 do1 zi2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢，请多多指教。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you very much, please give me a lot of guidance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你幫咗我咁多，真係要多多多謝你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 bong1 zo2 ngo5 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 do1 do1 do1 ze6 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你帮了我这么多，真的要非常感谢你。
examples.english_sentence: You've helped me so much, I really need to thank you a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要多多保重身體啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 do1 do1 bou2 zung6 san1 tai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要多加保重身体啊！
examples.english_sentence: You also need to take good care of your health!

mandarin_meaning: 很多事实; 证据确凿
english_meaning: Numerous facts; undeniable evidence; a lot of facts; solid evidence.
explanation_mandarin: 指有很多确实存在的事实或证据，强调证据充分，不容辩驳。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where there are many existing facts or evidence, emphasizing that the evidence is sufficient and irrefutable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多多事實擺喺眼前，佢仲想抵賴？
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 do1 si6 sat6 baai2 hai2 ngaan5 cin4, keoi5 zung6 soeng2 dai2 laai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那么多事实摆在眼前，他还想抵赖？
examples.english_sentence: With so many facts right in front of him, he still wants to deny it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 法庭已經提出咗多多事實嚟證明佢嘅罪行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faat3 ting4 ji5 ging1 tai4 ceot1 zo2 do1 do1 si6 sat6 lai4 zing3 ming4 keoi5 ge3 zeoi6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 法庭已经提出了很多事实来证明他的罪行。
examples.english_sentence: The court has already presented numerous facts to prove his crime.

synonyms: 鐵證如山 (tit3 zing3 jyu4 saan1)

english_meaning: a lot of things to do; very busy; many responsibilities
explanation_mandarin: 形容有很多事情要处理，非常忙碌。
explanation_english: Describes having a lot of things to handle; very busy; overwhelmed with responsibilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近多多事幹，忙到冇時間瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 do1 do1 si6 gon3, mong4 dou3 mou5 si4 gaan3 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近有很多事情要做，忙到没有时间睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I've been very busy lately, so busy that I don't even have time to sleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司多多事幹，日日都要OT。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 do1 do1 si6 gon3, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 OT.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司有很多事情要做，每天都要加班。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has a lot going on, they have to work overtime every day.

english_meaning: Please forgive me; please excuse me; please bear with me.
explanation_mandarin: 客套话，请求对方多多谅解、原谅自己的不足之处。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to request understanding and forgiveness from someone when you might have made a mistake or when you are about to do something that might be imperfect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我廣東話唔係咁好，多多包涵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gwong2 dung1 waa2 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2, do1 do1 baau1 haam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的广东话说得不太好，请多多包涵。
examples.english_sentence: My Cantonese isn't very good, please forgive me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次係我第一次搞呢啲嘢，有咩做得唔好嘅地方，多多包涵啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 gaau2 ni1 di1 je5, jau5 me1 zou6 dak1 m4 hou2 ge3 dei6 fong1, do1 do1 baau1 haam4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次是我第一次做这些事情，有什么做得不好的地方，请多多包涵。
examples.english_sentence: This is my first time doing these things, if there's anything I don't do well, please bear with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先架車壞壞地，遲咗到，多多包涵啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 gaa3 ce1 waai6 waai6 dei6, ci4 zo2 dou3, do1 do1 baau1 haam4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才车坏了，迟到了，请多多包涵啊。
examples.english_sentence: The car broke down just now, so I was late, please forgive me.

synonyms: 唔好意思 (m4 hou2 ji3 si1)

english_meaning: more or less; somewhat; to some extent
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，指或多或少，带有不确定的意思。
explanation_english: Indicates degree, meaning more or less, to some extent. Implies uncertainty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，我多多少少都有啲擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, ngo5 do1 do1 siu2 siu2 dou1 jau5 di1 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，我或多或少都有点担心。
examples.english_sentence: I'm somewhat worried about the exam this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢多多少少都有啲醉意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 do1 do1 siu2 siu2 dou1 jau5 di1 zeoi3 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他或多或少都有点醉意。
examples.english_sentence: He is somewhat drunk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多多少少都幫到手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 do1 siu2 siu2 dou1 bong1 dou2 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多多少少都可以帮上忙的。
examples.english_sentence: It can help to some extent.

english_meaning: Please give me your advice (often used when meeting someone for the first time or starting a new job)
explanation_mandarin: 客套话，表示希望对方以后多多给予指导和帮助。
explanation_english: A polite expression used to request guidance or advice from someone, typically when meeting them for the first time or starting a new job. It conveys humility and a willingness to learn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱嚟呢間公司做嘢，多多指敎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lai4 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 je5, do1 do1 zi2 gaau3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚来这家公司上班，多多指教！
examples.english_sentence: I just started working at this company, please give me your advice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家好，我係新嚟嘅，以後多多指敎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 hou2, ngo5 hai6 san1 lai4 ge3, ji5 hau6 do1 do1 zi2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家好，我是新来的，以后多多指教。
examples.english_sentence: Hello everyone, I'm new here, please give me your advice in the future.

english_meaning: Please give me your guidance (used when meeting someone new or starting a new job)
explanation_mandarin: 表示希望对方多多指导，给予帮助。一般在初次见面或者开始新工作时使用，以示谦虚和尊重。
explanation_english: An expression used to politely request guidance and assistance from someone, usually used when meeting someone for the first time or starting a new job, showing humility and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋新嚟嘅，多多指教啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 san1 lei4 ge3, do1 do1 zi2 gaau3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们新来的，请多多指教！
examples.english_sentence: We're new here, please give us your guidance!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我第一日返工，多多指教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dai6 jat1 jat6 faan1 gung1, do1 do1 zi2 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我第一天上班，请多多指教。
examples.english_sentence: It's my first day at work, please give me your guidance.

synonyms: 請多多關照 (cing2 do1 do1 gwaan1 ziu3)

english_meaning: the more the better; the more the merrier
explanation_mandarin: 表示越多越好，不嫌多。
explanation_english: Means 'the more, the better'; not disliking having more. It expresses the sentiment that more is preferable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 錢呢樣嘢，梗係多多益善啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin2 ne1 joeng2 je5, gang2 hai6 do1 do1 jik1 sin6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 钱这种东西，当然是越多越好啦！
examples.english_sentence: As for money, of course, the more the better!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲優惠券多多益善，畀多啲我啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 jau1 wai6 hyun3 do1 do1 jik1 sin6, bei2 do1 di1 ngo5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些优惠券越多越好，多给我一些吧！
examples.english_sentence: The more the better with these coupons; give me more!

english_meaning: repeatedly; many times (usually expressing thanks or apologies)
explanation_mandarin: 表示动作或状态重复多次，通常用于表达多次感谢或多次道歉。
explanation_english: Indicates that an action or state is repeated many times, usually used to express repeated thanks or apologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，多多聲打擾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, do1 do1 seng1 daa2 jiu2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，多次打扰你。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for disturbing you so many times.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 真係好多謝你，要多多聲同你講聲唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zan1 hai6 hou2 do1 ze6 nei5, jiu3 do1 do1 seng1 tung4 nei5 gong2 seng1 m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真的很感谢你，要多次对你说声谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really grateful to you, I have to thank you many times.

english_meaning: as numerous as hairs on an ox; countless; numerous
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极多，像牛身上的毛一样数不清。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely numerous, like the uncountable hairs on an ox.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲垃圾資訊多如牛毛，真係唔知邊啲先係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 laap6 saap3 zi1 seon3 do1 jyu4 ngau4 mou4, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 bin1 di1 sin1 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些垃圾信息多如牛毛，真的不知道哪些是真的。
examples.english_sentence: These pieces of junk information are as numerous as hairs on an ox, I really don't know which ones are true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅餐廳多如牛毛，你想食咩都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 caan1 teng1 do1 jyu4 ngau4 mou4, nei5 soeng2 sik6 me1 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的餐厅多如牛毛，你想吃什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has restaurants as numerous as hairs on an ox, you can find whatever you want to eat.

english_meaning: colorful, diverse, varied
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或生活非常丰富，充满不同的色彩和变化。
explanation_english: Describes something (an event, life, etc.) as being rich, diverse, and full of different colors and variations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜生活真係多姿多彩，咩都有得玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 sang1 wut6 zan1 hai6 do1 zi1 do1 coi2, me1 dou1 jau5 dak1 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜生活真是丰富多彩，什么都有的玩。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's nightlife is truly colorful and diverse, there's everything to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生多姿多彩，做過好多唔同嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 do1 zi1 do1 coi2, zou6 gwo3 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生丰富多彩，做过很多不同的事情。
examples.english_sentence: His life is colorful and diverse, he has done many different things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個展覽多姿多彩，展出咗好多唔同類型嘅藝術品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zin2 laam5 do1 zi1 do1 coi2, zin2 ceot1 zo2 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 leoi6 jing4 ge3 ngai6 seot1 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个展览丰富多彩，展出了很多不同类型的艺术品。
examples.english_sentence: This exhibition is colorful and diverse, displaying many different types of artworks.

english_meaning: colorful; diverse; multifaceted; rich and varied
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物丰富多彩，形式多样。
explanation_english: Describes something that is rich, diverse, and varied in form and content. Used to describe a colorful and vibrant state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夜生活真係多姿多采。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 je6 sang1 wut6 zan1 hai6 do1 zi1 do1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夜生活真是多姿多彩。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's nightlife is truly colorful and diverse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生經驗好多姿多采，好值得人學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 ging1 jim6 hao2 do1 zi1 do1 coi2, hao2 zik6 dak1 jan4 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生经验很多姿多彩，很值得人学习。
examples.english_sentence: His life experiences are so rich and varied, it's worth learning from him.

english_meaning: multimedia
explanation_mandarin: 指多种媒体形式的结合，包括文字、图像、音频、视频等。
explanation_english: Refers to the combination of multiple media forms, including text, images, audio, and video.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅廣告好多都用多媒體嘅方式嚟吸引觀眾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 gwong2 gou3 hou2 do1 dou1 yung6 do1 mui4 tai2 ge3 fong1 sik1 lai4 kap1 yan5 gun1 zung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的广告很多都用多媒体的方式来吸引观众。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many advertisements use multimedia to attract audiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個多媒體項目包含咗影片、動畫同互動遊戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 do1 mui4 tai2 hong6 muk6 baau1 haam4 zo2 ying2 pin2, dung6 waak2 tung4 wu6 dung6 yau4 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个多媒体项目包含了影片、动画和互动游戏。
examples.english_sentence: This multimedia project includes videos, animations, and interactive games.

english_meaning: amount; quantity; how much; more or less
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量的多少，通常指不精确的数量。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount or quantity, usually indicating an imprecise quantity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔知實際數字，淨係知道大概嘅多寡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 zi1 sat6 zai3 sou3 zi6, zing6 hai6 zi1 dou3 daai6 koi3 ge3 do1 gwaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不知道实际数字，只知道大概的多少。
examples.english_sentence: We don't know the exact number, we only know the approximate amount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論多寡，我都好多謝你嘅幫忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 do1 gwaa2, ngo5 dou1 hou2 do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 bong1 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论多少，我都非常感谢你的帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how much, I am very grateful for your help.

english_meaning: Turbot
explanation_mandarin: 一种比目鱼，也称为大菱鲆。 肉质鲜美，适合清蒸。
explanation_english: A type of flatfish, also known as turbot. It has delicious, delicate flesh and is often steamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食多寶魚好唔好？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 do1 bou2 jyu2 hou2 m4 hou2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃多宝鱼好不好？
examples.english_sentence: Shall we go eat turbot tonight?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅清蒸多寶魚做得好正宗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 cing1 zaang1 do1 bou2 jyu2 zou6 dak1 hou2 zing3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的清蒸多宝鱼做得非常正宗。
examples.english_sentence: The steamed turbot in this restaurant is very authentic.

english_meaning: how much; how many; some; more or less
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量，询问数量有多少。
explanation_english: Indicates quantity, asking how many or how much. Can also mean 'some' or 'more or less'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個袋多少錢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 doi2 do1 siu2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个包多少钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: How much does this bag cost?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想要多少？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 jiu3 do1 siu2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想要多少？
examples.english_sentence: How much do you want?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋仲有多少時間？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 do1 siu2 si4 gaan3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们还有多少时间？
examples.english_sentence: How much time do we have left?

english_meaning: So what? What's the big deal? What does it matter?
explanation_mandarin: 表示不以为然，认为没什么大不了的。通常用于反驳或轻视对方的说法。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference or dismissal, suggesting something is not a big deal. Usually used in response to something to dismiss or downplay its importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你考試肥咗啫，多幾錢重啊？下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 haau2 si5 fei4 zo2 ze1, do1 gei2 cin4 cung5 aa3? haa6 ci3 nou5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不就是考试没通过吗，有什么大不了的？下次努力一点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: You just failed the exam, so what? Just try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遲到幾分鐘啫，多幾錢重啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ci4 dou3 gei2 fan1 zung1 ze1, do1 gei2 cin4 cung5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不就是迟到几分钟吗，有什么大不了的？
examples.english_sentence: It's just a few minutes late, so what?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跌咗少少錢啫，多幾錢重呀？我搵得返嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dit3 zo2 siu2 siu2 cin2 ze1, do1 gei2 cin4 cung5 aa3? ngo5 wan2 dak1 faan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不就是掉了点钱吗，有什么大不了的？我可以挣回来的。
examples.english_sentence: It's just a little bit of money that's lost, so what? I can earn it back.

english_meaning: Thanks to, owing to, because of, due to
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为某人或某事而得到好的结果或避免了坏的结果。有感谢或讽刺的意味，视语境而定。
explanation_english: Expresses gratitude or sarcasm (depending on context) for a positive outcome or avoided negative outcome resulting from someone or something. Can mean 'thanks to' or 'because of' with varying degrees of sincerity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試合格，多得你幫我補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hap6 gaak3, do1 dak1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bou2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试合格，多亏你帮我补习。
examples.english_sentence: I passed the exam this time, thanks to you for tutoring me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多得你嘅提醒，我先記得帶遮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 dak1 nei5 ge3 tai4 sing2, ngo5 sin1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多亏你的提醒，我才记得带伞。
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to your reminder, I remembered to bring an umbrella.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多得佢成日遲到，搞到我哋成日都要等佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 dak1 keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 dang2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多亏他总是迟到，害得我们总是要等他。(讽刺)
examples.english_sentence: Thanks to him always being late, we always have to wait for him. (sarcastic)

english_meaning: Thanks to... a great deal; Owes a lot to...
explanation_mandarin: 表示因为某人或某事而得到很大的帮助或好处。语气略带讽刺，也可能纯粹表示感谢。
explanation_english: Used to express that someone or something has been a great help or benefit. The tone can be slightly sarcastic, or it can be purely an expression of gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試考得咁好，多得你幫我補習唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 gam3 hou2, do1 dak1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bou2 sik1 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试考得这么好，多亏你帮我补习了不少。
examples.english_sentence: I did so well on this exam, thanks to you tutoring me a great deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司執笠，多得佢啲亂咁投資唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1, do1 dak1 keoi5 di1 lyun6 gam3 tau4 zi1 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司倒闭了，多亏他乱投资了不少。（讽刺）
examples.english_sentence: The company went bankrupt, thanks to his reckless investments. (sarcastic)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我升職多得同事們幫忙唔少。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing1 zik1 do1 dak1 tung4 si6 mun4 bong1 mong4 m4 siu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我升职多亏同事们帮忙不少。
examples.english_sentence: I got promoted, thanks to my colleagues helping me a great deal.

english_meaning: Thanks to you (sarcastic)
explanation_mandarin: 反语，字面上是“多亏你不少”，实际意思是指因为对方，导致出现负面结果或不好的情况，带有责备或讽刺的意味。
explanation_english: A sarcastic phrase meaning 'thanks to you (a lot)' or 'all thanks to you'. It's used when someone's actions have led to a negative outcome. It expresses blame or irony.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬，多得你唔少，成日叫我去玩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, do1 dak1 nei5 m4 siu2, seng4 jat6 giu3 ngo5 heoi3 waan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，多亏你，整天叫我去玩！
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time, all thanks to you for always asking me to go out and play!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到咁，多得你唔少，揀條咁嘅路嚟行！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 gam2, do1 dak1 nei5 m4 siu2, gaan2 tiu4 gam2 ge3 lou6 lai4 haang4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵成这样，多亏你，选了这么一条路来走！
examples.english_sentence: The traffic is so bad, all thanks to you for choosing this road!

english_meaning: to be suspicious, to overthink, to be too sensitive, to read too much into something
explanation_mandarin: 想得太多，考虑过多，通常指对别人的言行过于敏感或猜疑。
explanation_english: To overthink things; to be suspicious or overly sensitive; to read too much into a situation or someone's words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多心啦，佢冇惡意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sam1 laa1, keoi5 mou5 ok3 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要想太多了，他没有恶意的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so suspicious, he doesn't have any bad intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係隨便講吓啫，你唔好咁多心啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 ceoi4 bin2 gong2 haa5 ze1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是随便说说，你不要想太多。
examples.english_sentence: I was just saying it casually, don't overthink it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪多心呀？人哋根本冇咁嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 do1 sam1 aa3? jan4 dei6 gan1 bun2 mou5 gam3 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是多虑了？人家根本没有那个意思。
examples.english_sentence: Are you being too sensitive? They didn't mean it that way at all.

synonyms: 疑神疑鬼 (ji4 san4 ji4 gwai2)

english_meaning: sentimental; affectionate; amorous; susceptible to love; tender-hearted; romantic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人感情丰富，容易动情，对异性有好感。
explanation_english: Describing someone who is emotionally rich, easily moved to feeling, and has a fondness for the opposite sex (or whomever they are attracted to). It implies being susceptible to romantic love and affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好鬼多情，成日都話鍾意人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gwai2 do1 cing4, seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zung1 ji3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很感情丰富，总是说喜欢别人。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very sentimental person and is always saying he likes someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多情啦，人哋都唔領情嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 cing4 laa1, jan4 dei6 dou1 m4 ling5 cing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别太感情用事了，人家都不领情的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sentimental, people don't appreciate it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好鬼多情，睇到我眼濕濕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 gwai2 do1 cing4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 sip1 sip1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很感人，看得我都眼眶湿润了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is so sentimental, it made my eyes water.

mandarin_meaning: 多愁善感 (duō chóu shàn gǎn)
english_meaning: melancholy; sentimental; given to sorrow and pity; prone to emotional ups and downs
explanation_mandarin: 形容人感情丰富，容易因外界事物而产生忧愁或感伤的情绪。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very emotional and easily affected by external things, often experiencing sadness or sentimental feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鬼多愁善感，成日都愁眉苦臉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 yan4 hou2 gwai2 do1 sau4 sin6 gam2, seng4 yat6 dou1 sau4 mei4 fu2 lim5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人特别多愁善感，整天都愁眉苦脸的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very sentimental person, always looking sad and gloomy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多愁善感啦，試下睇下啲開心嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sau4 sin6 gam2 laa1, si3 haa5 tai2 haa5 di1 hoi1 sam1 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么多愁善感了，试着看看一些开心的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sentimental, try watching something cheerful.

synonyms: 傷春悲秋 (soeng1 ceon1 bei1 cau1)

english_meaning: nosy; interfering; meddling; to be handsy
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢管不该管的事，或者不该碰的东西也去碰。
explanation_english: Describes someone who likes to interfere in other people's affairs or touch things they shouldn't. It can also refer to being overly helpful to the point of being annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多手啦，人哋自己會搞掂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sau2 laa1, yan4 dei6 zi6 gei2 wui5 gaau2 dim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多管闲事了，人家自己会处理好的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, they can handle it themselves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鬼多手，乜嘢都要插手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwai2 do1 sau2, mat1 je5 dou1 yiu3 chaap3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常喜欢多管闲事，什么都要插手。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interfering, wanting to get involved in everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多手掂人哋啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sau2 dim1 yan4 dei6 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么手贱地碰别人的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so handsy touching other people's things.

synonyms: 雞手鴨腳 (gai1 sau2 aap3 goek3)

mandarin_meaning: 多管閒事, 愛動手動腳
english_meaning: nosy, meddlesome, interfering; fidgety, restless with hands and feet
explanation_mandarin: 形容人喜欢多管闲事，喜欢乱动别人的东西，或者形容人手脚不老实，总是动来动去。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is nosy, meddlesome, and likes to touch other people's things without permission. It can also describe someone who is fidgety and can't keep their hands and feet still.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多手多腳啦，人哋做嘢唔使你幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sau2 do1 goek3 laa1, jan4 dei6 zou6 je5 m4 sai2 nei5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么多管闲事了，人家做事不需要你帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, they don't need your help with their work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔好鬼多手多腳，成日搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hou2 gwai2 do1 sau2 do1 goek3, seng4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩很爱动手动脚，整天捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: That kid is very fidgety and always causing trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多手多腳掂我啲嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 sau2 do1 goek3 dim1 ngo5 di1 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱动我的东西！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy and touch my things!

english_meaning: versatile, multi-talented, having many talents
explanation_mandarin: 形容人具有多种才能和技艺。
explanation_english: Describes a person who has many talents and skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係多才多藝，又識唱歌又識跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 do1 coi4 do1 ngai6, jau6 sik1 coeng3 go1 jau6 sik1 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是多才多艺，又会唱歌又会跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: He is really versatile, he can sing and dance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校嘅才藝表演入面，展現咗佢多才多藝嘅一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 ge3 coi4 ngai6 biu2 jin2 jap6 min6, zin2 hin6 zo2 keoi5 do1 coi4 do1 ngai6 ge3 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在学校的才艺表演中，展现了他多才多艺的一面。
examples.english_sentence: He showed his versatile side in the school's talent show.

english_meaning: majority, most
explanation_mandarin: 表示大部分，占多数的情况。也可用作形容词，表示多数的，大部分的。
explanation_english: Indicates the majority or most of something. Can also be used as an adjective to describe something as being the majority or most.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多數人都鍾意飲奶茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 sou3 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 jam2 naai5 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大多数人都喜欢喝奶茶。
examples.english_sentence: Most people like to drink milk tea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多數嘅學生都會覺得考試好大壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 sou3 ge3 hok6 sang1 dou1 wui5 gok3 dak1 haau2 si5 hou2 daai6 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大多数学生都会觉得考试压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: Most students feel that exams are very stressful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次投票，多數人揀咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 tau4 piu3, do1 sou3 jan4 gaan2 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投票，大多数人选了他。
examples.english_sentence: In this election, the majority voted for him.

english_meaning: more than
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量或程度超过某个数值或标准。
explanation_english: Used to indicate that a quantity or degree exceeds a certain value or standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有超過一百蚊，即係多於我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 baak3 man1, zik1 hai6 do1 jyu1 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一百多块钱，也就是比我多。
examples.english_sentence: He has more than one hundred dollars, which is more than I have.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試嘅合格分數係五十分，多於呢個分數就合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si5 ge3 hap6 gaak3 fan1 sou3 hai6 ng5 sap6 fan1, do1 jyu1 ni1 go3 fan1 sou3 zau6 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的及格分数是五十分，多于这个分数就及格。
examples.english_sentence: The passing score for this exam is fifty, more than this score means you pass.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要多於三個人嚟幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 do1 jyu1 saam1 go3 jan4 lai4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要多于三个人来帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: We need more than three people to help.

english_meaning: Dominica (island nation)
explanation_mandarin: 位于加勒比海的一个岛国，全称多米尼克国。
explanation_english: An island nation in the Caribbean Sea, officially the Commonwealth of Dominica.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下年去多明尼加旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 haa6 nin4 heoi3 do1 ming4 nei4 ga1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算明年去多米尼加旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm planning to travel to Dominica next year.

english_meaning: Shishamo smelt
explanation_mandarin: 一种体型细小的海鱼，因为腹部含有丰富的鱼卵，吃起来满口都是鱼卵的香味，所以在香港很受欢迎。
explanation_english: A type of small sea fish, popular in Hong Kong because its abdomen is full of roe, giving it a rich and flavorful taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去食多春魚啦，好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 do1 ceon1 jyu2 laa1, hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去吃多春鱼吧，很好吃的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat shishamo tonight, it's very delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多春魚最好就係成條攞去煎，煎到香噴噴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ceon1 jyu2 zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 seng4 tiu4 lo2 heoi3 zin1, zin1 dou3 hoeng1 pan1 pan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 多春鱼最好就是整条拿去煎，煎得香喷喷的。
examples.english_sentence: The best way to cook shishamo is to pan-fry the whole fish until it's fragrant.

english_meaning: a long time, for quite a while, long ago
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间较长，已经过了一段比较长的时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a relatively long period of time has passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我等多時都唔見佢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deng2 do1 si4 dou1 m4 gin3 keoi5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我等了很久都没看见他来。
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for a long time and haven't seen him come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋分手多時啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan1 sau2 do1 si4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们分手很久了。
examples.english_sentence: They broke up a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事發生多時，我都唔記得晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 faat3 sang1 do1 si4, ngo5 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事发生很久了，我都忘光了。
examples.english_sentence: This happened a long time ago, I've forgotten all about it.

english_meaning: diverse; varied; multiple
explanation_mandarin: 形容种类繁多，形式多样。
explanation_english: Describing something as having many different kinds or forms; diverse; varied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜式好多様，總有一款啱你口味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 coi3 sik1 hou2 do1 joeng6, zung2 jau5 jat1 kwan2 ngaam1 nei5 hau2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜式很多样，总有一款适合你的口味。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has a diverse menu, there's bound to be something to suit your taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅文化好多様化，融合咗中西嘅元素。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 man4 faa3 hou2 do1 joeng6 faa3, jung4 hap6 zo2 zung1 sai1 ge3 jyun4 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的文化很多样化，融合了中西的元素。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's culture is very diverse, blending Chinese and Western elements.

english_meaning: to do something superfluous; to go to unnecessary lengths; to make an unnecessary move
explanation_mandarin: 指做多余的、没有必要的事情。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something superfluous or unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都已經買咗飛啦，重嚟多次劃位，咪多此一舉囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 ji5 ging1 maai5 zo2 fei1 laa1, cung4 lai4 do1 ci3 waak6 wai2, mai1 do1 ci2 jat1 geoi2 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都已经买票了，又来划位，不是多此一举吗！
examples.english_sentence: You've already bought the tickets, coming to reserve seats again is just superfluous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將啲嘢包到咁實，拆開又要搵剪刀，真係多此一舉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 di1 je5 baau1 dou3 gam3 sat6, caak3 hoi1 jau6 jiu3 wan2 zin2 dou1, zan1 hai6 do1 ci2 jat1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把东西包得这么紧，拆开又要找剪刀，真是多此一举。
examples.english_sentence: He wrapped the things so tightly that you need scissors to open them, it's really superfluous.

synonyms: 畫蛇添足 (waak6 se4 tim1 zuk1)

english_meaning: fraught with many disasters and difficulties
explanation_mandarin: 形容经历很多灾难和困难。
explanation_english: Describes a situation or period characterized by numerous disasters and difficulties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊年佢屋企真係多災多難，先係阿爺過身，跟住阿媽又入咗醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 nin4 keoi5 uk1 kei5 zan1 hai6 do1 zoi1 do1 naan6, sin1 hai6 aa3 je4 gwo3 san1, gan1 zyu6 aa3 maa1 jau6 jap6 zo2 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去年他家真是多灾多难，先是爷爷去世了，然后妈妈又进了医院。
examples.english_sentence: Last year was really a disaster-filled year for his family, first his grandfather passed away, and then his mother was hospitalized.

synonyms: 禍不單行 (wo6 bat1 daan1 hang4)

english_meaning: Danube River
explanation_mandarin: 位于欧洲的一条河流，是欧洲第二长河。
explanation_english: A river in Europe, the second-longest river in Europe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年夏天去多瑙河度旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 ha6 tin1 heoi3 do1 nou5 ho4 dou6 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年夏天去多瑙河旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to travel to the Danube River this summer.

english_meaning: prolific; productive; fertile
explanation_mandarin: 指产量多，生育能力强。
explanation_english: Referring to high productivity or strong fertility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年好犀利，多產咗好多畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 hou2 sai1 lei6, do1 caan2 zo2 hou2 do1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年很厉害，创作了很多画。
examples.english_sentence: He's been amazing this year, producing a lot of paintings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個作家真係多產，每年都出幾本書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zaak3 gaa1 zan1 hai6 do1 caan2, mui5 nin4 dou1 ceot1 gei2 bun2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位作家真的很会创作，每年都出几本书。
examples.english_sentence: This author is really prolific, publishing several books every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲雞好似幾多產，成日生蛋嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gai1 hou2 ci5 gei2 do1 caan2, seng4 jat6 saang1 daan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些鸡好像很能下蛋，总是下蛋。
examples.english_sentence: These chickens seem to be quite productive; they lay eggs all the time.

english_meaning: suspicious, distrustful, paranoid
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人经常怀疑别人，缺乏信任感。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is often suspicious of others, lacking trust and tending to doubt motives or intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好鬼多疑，成日覺得有人想害佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gwai2 do1 ji4, seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 jau5 jan4 soeng2 hoi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人非常多疑，总是觉得有人想害他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very suspicious person and always thinks someone wants to harm him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁多疑啦，我真係冇呃你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 do1 ji4 laa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 mou5 aak1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么多疑了，我真的没有骗你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so suspicious, I really didn't lie to you.

english_meaning: plenty; lots; there's plenty more
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很多，还有很多。
explanation_english: Indicates that there is a large quantity or number of something, and that there is more available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，呢度多的是靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, ni1 dou6 do1 dik1 si6 leng3 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，这里多的是美女。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, there are plenty of beautiful girls here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 機會多的是，唔使咁灰心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei1 wui6 do1 dik1 si6, m4 sai2 gam3 fui1 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 机会多的是，不用这么灰心。
examples.english_sentence: There are plenty of opportunities, don't be so discouraged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔怕冇錢，佢多的是錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 paa3 mou5 cin2, keoi5 do1 dik1 si6 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不怕没钱，他多的是钱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about not having money, he has plenty of money.

english_meaning: Polytheism
explanation_mandarin: 信仰多种神祇的宗教。
explanation_english: The belief in or worship of more than one god.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時好多地方都信多神教㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 seon3 do1 san4 gaau3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代很多地方都信奉多神教的。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, many places believed in polytheism.

english_meaning: to be nosy; to interfere; to meddle
explanation_mandarin: 指过问自己不该管的事情，爱管别人的事。
explanation_english: To interfere in other people's business; to be overly concerned with matters that do not concern oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁多管閒事啦，人哋嘅家事關你咩事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 do1 gun2 haan4 si6 laa1, jan4 dei6 ge3 gaa1 si6 gwaan1 nei5 me1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么多管闲事了，人家家事关你什么事啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nosy, what business is it of yours about their family matters?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人就係鍾意多管閒事，成日問長問短。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zau6 hai6 zung1 ji3 do1 gun2 haan4 si6, seng4 jat6 man6 coeng4 man6 dyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人就是喜欢多管闲事，总是问长问短。
examples.english_sentence: He's the type who likes to meddle, always asking a lot of questions.

english_meaning: a whole lot, a great many, very much
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，程度很深。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity or a significant degree of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企嘅書多籮籮，睇唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 ge3 syu1 do1 lo4 lo4, tai2 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家里的书非常多，看不完。
examples.english_sentence: He has a whole lot of books at home, impossible to read them all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日買咗多籮籮嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 do1 lo4 lo4 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天买了很多很多的东西。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a great many things today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對你嘅愛多籮籮㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 nei5 ge3 oi3 do1 lo4 lo4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对你的爱非常多啊。
examples.english_sentence: His love for you is very much.

english_meaning: Dominica (country)
explanation_mandarin: 加勒比海的一个岛国，名为多米尼克。
explanation_english: An island country in the Caribbean Sea named Dominica.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去多米尼克旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 do1 mai5 nei4 hak1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去多米尼克旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Dominica for travel tomorrow.

english_meaning: A lot, many, numerous
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多。口语用法。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity or number of something. Colloquial usage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日街上多羅羅都係人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaai1 soeng6 do1 lo4 lo4 dou1 hai6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天街上到处都是人。
examples.english_sentence: There are people everywhere on the street today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗多羅羅嘅嘢返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 do1 lo4 lo4 ge3 je5 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了很多东西回家。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a lot of things back home.

english_meaning: unnecessary; superfluous; redundant; a waste of time
explanation_mandarin: 形容某件事物是多余的，没有必要，或者做了也是浪费时间。
explanation_english: Describes something as unnecessary, superfluous, or a waste of time. It implies that the effort or item is not needed and adds no value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買多份麵包咪多舊魚囉，我哋食唔晒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 do1 fan6 min6 baau1 mai1 do1 gau6 jyu2 lo1, ngo5 dei6 sik6 m4 saai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买多一份面包不是多余吗，我们吃不完的。
examples.english_sentence: Buying another portion of bread is unnecessary, we won't be able to finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 再解釋多次都係多舊魚，佢根本唔會聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoi3 gaai2 sik1 do1 ci3 dou1 hai6 do1 gau6 jyu2, keoi5 gan1 bun2 m4 wui ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 再解释多次也是多余的，他根本不会听。
examples.english_sentence: Explaining it again is just a waste of time, he won't listen anyway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家先嚟準備，咪多舊魚囉，都嚟唔切㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sin1 lai4 zeon2 bei6, mai1 do1 gau6 jyu2 lo1, dou1 lai4 m4 cit3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在才来准备，不是多余的吗，都来不及了。
examples.english_sentence: Preparing now is pointless, there's no time left.

english_meaning: crafty, resourceful, full of ideas (often with a negative connotation of being sly or scheming)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人有很多主意，但有时也带有贬义，指这个人很狡猾，有很多鬼点子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has many ideas, but sometimes carries a negative connotation of being cunning, sly, or scheming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好多計㗎，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 do1 gai3 gaa3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很狡猾，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He's a crafty person, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明好鬼多計，成日諗埋啲蠱惑嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hou2 gwai2 do1 gai3, seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 di1 gu2 waak6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明很有鬼点子，总是想一些古怪的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is very crafty and always thinks of strange things.

english_meaning: Thank you
explanation_mandarin: 表示感谢的用语。
explanation_english: An expression of gratitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你幫我手呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 sau2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你帮我忙！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝晒！你真係好好人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 saai3! nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非常感谢！你真是个好人。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much! You are really a good person.

english_meaning: thank you
explanation_mandarin: 表示感谢的意思。 用于对他人所给予的恩惠、帮助等表示谢意。
explanation_english: Expressing gratitude or thankfulness to someone for a favor, help, or kindness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你今日幫我搬屋呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 gam1 jat6 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你今天帮我搬家！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for helping me move today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝晒！你真係好好人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 saai3! nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 非常感谢！你真是个好人！
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much! You're really a good person!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使多謝，舉手之勞啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 do1 ze6, geoi2 sau2 zi1 lou4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用谢，只是举手之劳而已。
examples.english_sentence: You're welcome, it was just a small favor.

english_meaning: Thanks in advance
explanation_mandarin: 在请求对方帮忙或提供信息之前，先表达感谢。表示预计对方会提供帮助，先礼后兵。
explanation_english: An expression of gratitude given in advance, before the help or information is actually provided. It implies the speaker expects the recipient to fulfill the request and is thanking them preemptively.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我買定張飛，多謝先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 maai5 ding6 zoeng1 fei1, do1 ze6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我买好票，先谢谢你。
examples.english_sentence: Please buy the ticket for me, thanks in advance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要交功課，唔該你借我抄下，多謝先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3, m4 goi1 nei5 ze3 ngo5 caau1 haa5, do1 ze6 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要交作业，麻烦你借我抄一下，先谢谢你！
examples.english_sentence: I need to hand in my homework tomorrow, please let me copy it, thanks in advance!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我搬啲嘢上樓啊？多謝先！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 di1 je5 soeng5 lau2 aa3? do1 ze6 sin1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可不可以帮我搬一些东西上楼啊？先谢谢你！
examples.english_sentence: Could you help me carry some stuff upstairs? Thanks in advance!

english_meaning: Thank you, and how much is it altogether?
explanation_mandarin: 购物或消费后，对店员或服务员表示感谢，并询问总共需要支付多少钱。
explanation_english: A phrase used after making a purchase or receiving a service to thank the cashier or service provider and ask for the total amount due.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝夾盛惠，總共一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 gaap3 sing6 wai6, zung2 gung1 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢，总共一百块钱。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you, that will be 100 dollars in total.

english_meaning: as much as, up to, reaching
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量之多，达到某个令人惊讶或显著的程度。
explanation_english: Indicates a surprisingly or significantly large quantity or extent, reaching a certain level.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日Black Friday，間鋪頭嘅折扣多達五成啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 Black Friday, gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 zit3 kuk1 do1 daat6 ng5 seng4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天黑色星期五，那家店的折扣高达五成啊！
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday was Black Friday, the discount in that shop was as much as 50%!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 尋日有遊行，人數多達十萬人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cam4 jat6 jau5 jau4 hang4, jan4 sou3 do1 daat6 sap6 maan6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天有游行，人数多达十万人。
examples.english_sentence: There was a parade yesterday, with the number of people reaching as many as 100,000.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅成本多達一億蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 sing4 bun2 do1 daat6 jat1 jik1 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的成本高达一亿港币。
examples.english_sentence: The cost of this project is up to 100 million Hong Kong dollars.

english_meaning: everywhere; all around; versatile; multi-faceted
explanation_mandarin: 表示范围广泛，涉及多个方面。
explanation_english: Indicates a wide range or multiple aspects; everywhere; versatile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅技能好多邊，識唱歌又識跳舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gei1 nang4 hou2 do1 bin1, sik1 cheung3 go1 jau6 sik1 tiu3 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的技能非常全面，既会唱歌又会跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: His skills are very versatile, he can sing and dance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司嘅業務好多邊，咩都做啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jip6 mou6 hou2 do1 bin1, me1 dou1 zou6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的业务范围很广，什么都做一点。
examples.english_sentence: The company's business is very diverse; they do a little bit of everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題要多邊考慮，先可以做決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 jiu3 do1 bin1 hau2 leui5, sin1 ho2 ji5 zou6 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题需要从各个方面考虑，才能做出决定。
examples.english_sentence: This problem needs to be considered from all angles before a decision can be made.

english_meaning: polygon
explanation_mandarin: 几何学中，由三个或三个以上线段组成的封闭平面图形。
explanation_english: A closed two-dimensional shape with three or more straight sides.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個公園嘅花圃係一個六邊形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 yun2 ge3 faa1 pou2 hai6 jat1 go3 luk6 bin1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个公园的花坛是一个六边形。
examples.english_sentence: The flower bed in this park is a hexagon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幾何學入面，我哋要學好多唔同嘅多邊形。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei2 ho4 hok6 jap6 min6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 do1 bin1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在几何学里，我们要学习很多不同的多边形。
examples.english_sentence: In geometry, we need to learn many different polygons.

english_meaning: Multiple personality disorder, Dissociative identity disorder (DID)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人拥有多种不同的人格，这些人格会在不同时间表现出来。
explanation_english: Refers to a mental disorder where a person exhibits multiple distinct personalities, which manifest at different times. Also known as Dissociative Identity Disorder (DID).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇戲成日見到啲主角有多重人格嘅劇情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hei3 seng4 jat6 gin3 dou2 di1 zyu2 gok3 jau5 do1 cung4 jan4 gaak3 ge3 kek6 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看电影经常看到主角有多重人格的剧情。
examples.english_sentence: I often see storylines about protagonists with multiple personalities in movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢可能有啲精神問題，唔排除佢有多重人格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ho2 nang4 jau5 di1 zing1 san4 man6 tai4, m4 paai3 ceoi3 keoi5 jau5 do1 cung4 jan4 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他可能有一些精神问题，不排除他有多重人格。
examples.english_sentence: He may have some mental issues; it can't be ruled out that he has multiple personalities.

english_meaning: To make up for deficiencies; to compensate for shortcomings; to adjust and balance
explanation_mandarin: 原本意思是指从多的地方拿出来分给少的地方，达到一种平衡的状态。比喻把多余的部分拿出来弥补不足，使整体达到平衡。
explanation_english: Originally, it referred to taking from the abundant and giving to the deficient to achieve balance. Figuratively, it means to take from the surplus to make up for the shortfall, bringing the overall situation into equilibrium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃嘅預算有啲問題，我哋要多除少補，重新分配資源先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 jyu6 syun3 jau5 di1 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 do1 ceoi4 siu2 bou2, cung4 san1 fan1 pui3 zi1 jyun4 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划的预算有些问题，我们要做一些调整，重新分配资源才行。
examples.english_sentence: There are some issues with the budget of this project, we need to make adjustments and redistribute the resources to balance things out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然有啲部門做得好好，但係有啲部門做得唔夠好，所以要多除少補，先可以達到公司嘅目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jau5 di1 bo6 mun4 zou6 dak1 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 jau5 di1 bo6 mun4 zou6 dak1 m4 gau3 hou2, so2 ji5 jiu3 do1 ceoi4 siu2 bou2, sin1 ho2 ji5 daat6 dou3 gung1 si1 ge3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然有些部门做得很好，但是有些部门做得不够好，所以要进行调整，才能达到公司的目标。
examples.english_sentence: Although some departments are doing very well, some are not performing well enough. Therefore, we need to adjust and compensate so that we can achieve the company's goals.

jyutping: do1 zek3 hoeng1 lou4 do1 zek3 gwai2
english_meaning: The more people involved, the more problems arise; Too many cooks spoil the broth.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻参与的人越多，事情就越复杂，出现问题的可能性也越大。香炉是用来烧香的，鬼是迷信观念中不好的存在。香炉越多，鬼也越多，引申为人数增加带来更多麻烦。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe situations where an increase in the number of people involved leads to more complications and problems. It uses the analogy of incense burners (香爐) attracting ghosts (鬼); the more incense burners, the more ghosts, implying that more people equates to more issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project本來好簡單嘅，但係老細硬要加多幾個人落嚟，真係多隻香爐多隻鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project bun2 lai4 hou2 gaan2 daan1 ge3, daan6 hai6 lou5 sai3 ngaang6 jiu3 gaa1 do1 gei2 go3 jan4 lok6 lai4, zan1 hai6 do1 zek3 hoeng1 lou4 do1 zek3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目本来很简单，但是老板非要加几个人进来，真是人多事多。
examples.english_sentence: This project was originally very simple, but the boss insisted on adding more people, it's really a case of too many cooks spoil the broth.

english_meaning: Adversity builds the nation; A nation prospers through trials and tribulations.
explanation_mandarin: 指国家经历多次灾难后，反而能够更加奋发图强，走向繁荣昌盛。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that a nation, after experiencing multiple disasters and hardships, will become more resilient, strive harder, and eventually achieve prosperity and strength. It implies that challenges can lead to growth and improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港經歷過沙士、金融風暴，但每次都挺過，真係應驗咗句多難興邦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ging1 lik6 gwo3 saa1 si6, gam1 jung4 fung1 bou6, daan6 mui5 ci3 dou1 ting5 gwo3, zan1 hai6 jing3 jim6 zo2 geoi3 do1 naan6 hing1 bong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港经历了非典、金融风暴，但每次都挺过来了，真应验了“多难兴邦”这句话。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has experienced SARS and financial crises, but it has overcome them every time, truly fulfilling the saying "Adversity builds the nation."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然疫情對經濟打擊好大，但係如果我哋可以團結一致，咁就真係多難興邦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jik1 cing4 deoi3 ging1 zai3 daa2 gik1 hou2 daai6, daan6 hai6 jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 tyun4 git3 jat1 zi3, gam2 zau6 zan1 hai6 do1 naan6 hing1 bong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然疫情对经济打击很大，但是如果我们能够团结一致，那么就真的能做到多难兴邦。
examples.english_sentence: Although the epidemic has greatly impacted the economy, if we can unite, we can truly achieve prosperity through adversity.

english_meaning: polynomial
explanation_mandarin: 在数学中，由常数、变量和指数，通过加法、减法和乘法运算构成的代数表达式。
explanation_english: In mathematics, a polynomial is an expression consisting of variables (also called indeterminates) and coefficients, that involves only the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and non-negative integer exponentiation of variables.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條數嘅答案係一個多項式。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 sou3 ge3 daap3 aan3 hai6 jat1 go3 do1 hong6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个题的答案是一个多项式。
examples.english_sentence: The answer to this problem is a polynomial.

english_meaning: superfluous; unnecessary; redundant; uncalled-for
explanation_mandarin: 指不必要的，多出来的，没有用处的。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is unnecessary, extra, or useless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講呢啲嘢咪即係多餘囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ni1 di1 je5 mai1 zik1 hai6 do1 jyu4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的这些话不就是多余的吗？
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is just unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經食飽咗，唔使再加飯啦，多餘嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 sik6 baau2 zo2, m4 sai2 zoi3 gaa1 faan6 laa1, do1 jyu4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经吃饱了，不用再加饭了，多余的。
examples.english_sentence: I'm already full, no need to add more rice, it's unnecessary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做咪多餘囉，根本就冇人想睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 mai1 do1 jyu4 lo1, gan1 bun2 zau6 mou5 jan4 soeng2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做是多余的，根本没人想看。
examples.english_sentence: What you're doing is unnecessary, nobody wants to see it anyway.

english_meaning: redundant; superfluous; to do something unnecessary
explanation_mandarin: 形容做的事情多余、没必要，反而造成麻烦。
explanation_english: Describes an action that is unnecessary, redundant, and often causes more trouble than it's worth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都搞掂咗啦，仲要check多次，真係多鳩餘！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gaau2 dim6 zo2 laa3, zung6 jiu3 check jat1 ci3, zan1 hai6 do1 gau1 jyu4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都搞定了，还要再检查一次，真是多此一举！
examples.english_sentence: You've already finished it, checking again is just redundant!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都識做㗎啦，你咪再教佢啦，多鳩餘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 sik1 zou6 gaa3 laa1, nei5 mai5 zoi3 gaau3 keoi5 laa1, do1 gau1 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都会做了，你别再教他了，多此一举。
examples.english_sentence: He already knows how to do it, don't teach him again, it's unnecessary.

english_meaning: how; what; such
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“何等”、“怎样”。用于感叹句中，表示程度很深。
explanation_english: Used to express a high degree of something, similar to 'how' or 'what'. Often used in exclamatory sentences to indicate intensity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋多麼靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 do1 mo1 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子多么漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: How beautiful this house is!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗吓，我哋以前嘅日子多麼快樂啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 haa5, ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 ge3 jat6 zi2 do1 mo1 faai3 lok6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想想，我们以前的日子多么快乐啊！
examples.english_sentence: Think about it, how happy were our days back then!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢多麼努力咁溫書呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 do1 mo1 nou5 lik6 gam2 wan1 syu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他多么努力地在学习啊！
examples.english_sentence: How hard he is studying!

english_meaning: night
explanation_mandarin: 指从日落到日出的时间，一天中的黑暗时间。
explanation_english: The period from sunset to sunrise; the dark part of the day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我夜晚通常十點瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je6 maan5 tung1 soeng4 sap6 dim2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我晚上通常十点睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I usually go to sleep at ten o'clock at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚夜唔去街喇，太攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 je6 m4 heoi3 gaai1 laa3, taai3 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚不出去逛街了，太累了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not going out tonight, I'm too tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貓夜晚先至活躍。
