explanation_english: Describes a situation that is extremely bad and likely to have serious consequences. It suggests an impending crisis or unfavorable outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥琴日炒咗車，宜家仲喺醫院，大事不妙啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 kam4 jat6 caau2 zo2 ce1, ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai2 ji1 jyun2, daai6 si6 bat1 miu6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥昨天出了车祸，现在还在医院，情况不妙啊！
examples.english_sentence: My older brother had a car accident yesterday and is still in the hospital. Things are not looking good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就考試，但我乜都冇溫，大事不妙呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 haau2 si3, daan6 ngo5 mat1 dou1 mou5 wan1, daai6 si6 bat1 miu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就要考试了，但是我什么都没复习，大事不妙啊！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is tomorrow, but I haven't studied anything. This is a disaster!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦壞咗，我啲報告仲未save，大事不妙呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 waai6 zo2, ngo5 di1 bou3 gou3 zung6 mei6 save1, daai6 si6 bat1 miu6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑坏了，我的报告还没保存，情况不妙啊！
examples.english_sentence: The computer crashed, and I haven't saved my report yet. This is terrible!

jyutping: daai6 si6 faa3 siu2, siu2 si6 faa3 mou4
mandarin_meaning: 大事化小，小事化了 / 息事宁人
english_meaning: To reduce a major problem to a minor one, and a minor problem to nothing at all; to sweep things under the rug; to minimize trouble; to make light of a situation.
explanation_mandarin: 将大事淡化成小事，小事则当没有发生过一样处理。通常指为了避免麻烦或冲突，而采取的一种息事宁人的态度。
explanation_english: To downplay or minimize problems to avoid trouble or conflict. A larger issue is reduced to a smaller one, and a small issue is treated as if it never happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司成日都大事化小，小事化無，搞到好多問題都冇解決。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 daai6 si6 faa3 siu2, siu2 si6 faa3 mou4, gaau2 dou3 hou2 do1 man6 tai4 dou1 mou5 gaai2 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司总是大事化小，小事化了，导致很多问题都没有解决。
examples.english_sentence: Their company always minimizes problems, resulting in many unresolved issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好大事化小，小事化無啊！呢件事咁嚴重，一定要認真處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daai6 si6 faa3 siu2, siu2 si6 faa3 mou4 aa3! ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 jim4 zung6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 jing6 zan1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要大事化小，小事化了啊！这件事这么严重，一定要认真处理。
examples.english_sentence: Don't minimize the problem! This matter is so serious; it must be dealt with seriously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細成日都大事化小，小事化無，員工士氣都跌哂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 daai6 si6 faa3 siu2, siu2 si6 faa3 mou4, wun4 gung1 si6 hei3 dou1 dit3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是大事化小，小事化了，员工的士气都下降了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always minimizes problems, and the employees' morale has plummeted.

synonyms: 息事寧人 (sik1 si6 ning4 jan4)

english_meaning: Big5 encoding
explanation_mandarin: 一种繁体中文的字符编码方式，在电脑普及的早期广泛使用。
explanation_english: A character encoding standard for Traditional Chinese characters, widely used in the early days of computer adoption.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲網頁好多都係用大五碼，如果部機唔支援就睇唔到啲字。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 mong5 jip6 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 yung6 daai6 ng5 maa5, jyu4 gwo2 bou6 gei1 m4 zi1 wun4 zau6 tai2 m4 dou2 di1 zi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前很多网页都是用大五码，如果电脑不支持就看不到那些字。
examples.english_sentence: Many webpages used to use Big5 encoding. If your computer didn't support it, you couldn't see the characters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲系統通常都用UTF-8，好少再用大五碼喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hai6 tung2 tung1 soeng4 dou1 yung6 UTF-8, hou2 siu2 zoi3 yung6 daai6 ng5 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的系统通常都用UTF-8，很少再用大五码了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, systems usually use UTF-8 and rarely use Big5 anymore.

english_meaning: Sexual intercourse, to mess around sexually
explanation_mandarin: 粗俗用语，指发生性行为，多含贬义，暗示关系混乱或不正当。
explanation_english: A vulgar term referring to sexual intercourse, often with a negative connotation, implying a chaotic or improper relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺間房度唔知做緊乜嘢，唔會喺度大交合啩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 gaan1 fong2 dou6 m4 zi1 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5, m4 wui5 hai2 dou6 daai6 gaau1 hap6 gwaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在房间里不知道在做什么，不会是在乱搞吧？
examples.english_sentence: I don't know what those two are doing in the room, could they be messing around sexually?

english_meaning: tycoon, magnate, big boss, influential person
explanation_mandarin: 指在商业或某个领域有巨大影响力和财富的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with great influence and wealth in business or a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李嘉誠係香港嘅地產大亨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 gaa1 sing4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 dei6 saan2 daai6 hang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李嘉诚是香港的房地产大亨。
examples.english_sentence: Li Ka-shing is a property tycoon in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嘅時候就已經想成為一個大亨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 ji5 ging1 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 daai6 hang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就已经想成为一个大亨。
examples.english_sentence: He already wanted to become a tycoon when he was young.

english_meaning: adult; grown-up; sir; madam; your Excellency
explanation_mandarin: 1. 成年人。2. 敬称官员或长辈。
explanation_english: 1. Adult; a grown-up person. 2. A respectful term for officials or elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋細路仔唔明大人嘅世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai3 lou2 zai2 m4 ming4 daai6 jan4 ge3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们小孩子不明白大人的世界。
examples.english_sentence: We children don't understand the adult world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大人，有咩可以幫到你？
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 jan4, jau5 me1 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大人，有什么可以帮到您的？
examples.english_sentence: Sir/Madam, how may I help you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經係個大人，唔需要人哋照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 hai6 go3 daai6 jan4, m4 seoi1 jiu3 jan4 dei6 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经是个大人了，不需要别人照顾。
examples.english_sentence: He is already an adult and doesn't need anyone to take care of him.

jyutping: daai6 jan4 bat1 gei3 siu2 jan4 gwo3
english_meaning: A great person doesn't remember the offenses of a petty person; To overlook the faults of others.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻宽宏大量的人不计较心胸狭窄的人的过失。
explanation_english: This idiom means that a magnanimous person doesn't hold grudges or dwell on the petty faults or offenses committed by someone who is narrow-minded or of lower status. It emphasizes forgiveness and understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好啦好啦，大人不記小人過啦，下次唔好再遲到就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 laa1 hou2 laa1, daai6 jan4 bat1 gei3 siu2 jan4 gwo3 laa1, haa6 ci3 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好了好了，大人不计小人过，下次不要再迟到就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, okay, let's not dwell on it. Just don't be late again next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次算數啦，大人不記小人過，希望你以後唔好再犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 syun3 sou3 laa1, daai6 jan4 bat1 gei3 siu2 jan4 gwo3, hei1 mong6 nei5 ji5 hau6 m4 hou2 zoi3 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次就算了，大人不计小人过，希望你以后不要再犯。
examples.english_sentence: I'll let it go this time; a great person doesn't remember the offenses of a petty person. I hope you won't do it again.

english_meaning: Young lady; spoiled young woman; prim and proper young woman
explanation_mandarin: 形容年轻女子，通常带有一些负面含义，例如娇生惯养，摆架子，装模作样等。
explanation_english: Describes a young woman, usually with negative connotations such as being spoiled, putting on airs, being pretentious, or acting prim and proper. It often implies disapproval or mockery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺大人大姐款，好似好矜貴咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baai2 daai6 jan4 daai6 je2 kwan2, hou2 ci5 hou2 ging1 gwai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是摆大小姐的架子，好像自己很矜贵一样。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts like a spoiled young lady, as if she's very precious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大人大姐啦，幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 jan4 daai6 je2 laa1, bong1 saa2 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么大小姐脾气了，帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a prim and proper young lady, give us a hand.

english_meaning: An adult should not concern themselves with the petty faults of a child/inferior.
explanation_mandarin: 表示大人应该宽宏大量，不应该和小孩子或者地位较低的人计较一些小错。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the idea that an adult should be magnanimous and not concern themselves with the minor faults of children or those of lower status. It implies forgiveness and understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都係細路仔啫，你大人大者，咪同佢計較咁多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 hai6 sai3 lou2 zai2 ze1, nei5 daai6 jan4 daai6 ze2, mai5 tung4 keoi5 gai3 giu3 gam3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还是个孩子，你大人不记小人过，别和他计较那么多。
examples.english_sentence: He's just a child, you should be the bigger person and not fuss over it so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次佢真係唔啱，但係都係小朋友，你大人大者，原諒佢今次啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 keoi5 zan1 hai6 m4 ngaam1, daan6 hai6 dou1 hai6 siu2 pang4 jau5, nei5 daai6 jan4 daai6 ze2, jyun4 loeng6 keoi5 gam1 ci3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次他的确不对，但是他还是个孩子，大人不记小人过，原谅他这次吧。
examples.english_sentence: He was really wrong this time, but he's still a kid, be the bigger person and forgive him this time.

english_meaning: magnanimous; generous; big-hearted; to have a large capacity for forgiveness
explanation_mandarin: 形容人宽宏大量，不计较别人的过错或不足。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is magnanimous and forgiving, not dwelling on the mistakes or shortcomings of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬲啦，佢都知錯喇，大人大量原諒佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 nau1 laa1, keoi5 dou1 zi1 co3 laa3, daai6 jan4 daai6 loeng6 jyun4 loeng6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么生气了，他都知道错了，大人有大量原谅他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry. He knows he's wrong. Please be magnanimous and forgive him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事都過咗咁耐，你大人大量，唔好再提啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 dou1 gwo3 zo2 gam3 noi6, nei5 daai6 jan4 daai6 loeng6, m4 hou2 zoi3 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情都过去这么久了，你大人有大量，不要再提了。
examples.english_sentence: It's been so long since that happened. Be big-hearted and don't bring it up again.

synonyms: 寬宏大量 (fun1 wang4 daai6 loeng6)

english_meaning: A great man has a big heart; to be forgiving of others' faults; to be magnanimous
explanation_mandarin: 形容有气度，不计较别人的过失或冒犯。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is generous and doesn't hold grudges or dwell on others' mistakes or offenses. It implies a superior person is willing to overlook the shortcomings of someone inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，大人有大量，原諒佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, daai6 jan4 jau5 daai6 loeng6, jyun4 loeng6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了吧，大人不记小人过，原谅他吧。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, be the bigger person and forgive him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係有心㗎，你大人有大量，唔好同佢計較啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 gaa3, nei5 daai6 jan4 jau5 daai6 loeng6, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gai3 giu3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不是故意的，你大人不记小人过，不要和他计较了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't mean to, be the bigger person and don't hold it against him.

english_meaning: important person, big shot, VIP
explanation_mandarin: 指地位高、权力大或有影响力的人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a person of high status, great power, or significant influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係公司嘅大人物，好多嘢都係佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 jan4 mat6, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 hai6 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是公司的大人物，很多事情都由他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's a big shot in the company now; he's the one who makes a lot of the decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我淨係個小人物，邊度識得啲大人物啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zing6 hai6 go3 siu2 jan4 mat6, bin1 dou6 sik1 dak1 di1 daai6 jan4 mat6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是个小人物，哪里认识什么大人物啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm just a nobody; how would I know any important people?

english_meaning: eldest son; first-born son
explanation_mandarin: 指家中的第一个儿子，长子。
explanation_english: Refers to the first-born son in a family, the eldest son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個大仔今年都三十歲喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 daai6 zai2 gam1 nin4 dou1 saam1 sap6 seoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的大儿子今年都三十岁了。
examples.english_sentence: Their eldest son is already thirty years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸最錫佢個大仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa1 zeoi3 sek3 keoi5 go3 daai6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸最疼他那个大儿子。
examples.english_sentence: Dad loves his eldest son the most.

synonyms: 大佬 (daai6 lou2) - can also mean elder brother or boss, depending on context

mandarin_meaning: 神仙; 占卜者; 厲害的人
english_meaning: Deity; Fortune teller; A very capable person
explanation_mandarin: 1. 神話傳說中的神仙。2. 指占卜算命的人。3. 比喻非常厲害或有能力的人。
explanation_english: 1. Deity in mythology and legends. 2. Refers to fortune tellers or diviners. 3. A metaphor for someone who is very capable or powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 黃大仙廟好出名，好多人去拜大仙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 daai6 sin1 miu2 hou2 cheut1 ming4, hou2 do1 yan4 heui3 baai3 daai6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 黄大仙庙非常有名，很多人去拜黄大仙。
examples.english_sentence: Wong Tai Sin Temple is very famous, many people go to worship Wong Tai Sin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日去搵大仙問卜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 heui3 wan2 daai6 sin1 man6 buk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去找算命先生算卦。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to see fortune tellers for divination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺投資方面真係大仙，次次都賺錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 tau4 zi1 fong1 min6 zan1 hai6 daai6 sin1, chi3 chi3 dou1 jyun6 chin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在投资方面真是个厉害的人物，每次都赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is really a wizard in investment, he makes money every time.

english_meaning: bulky; large-sized; something big
explanation_mandarin: 形容东西体积较大，或者指体积较大的物品。
explanation_english: Describes something that is bulky or large in size; can also refer to a large-sized item.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件貨好大件，好難搬喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 fo3 hou2 daai6 gin6, hou2 naan4 bun1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件货物很大件，很难搬啊。
examples.english_sentence: This item is very bulky, it's hard to move.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗部大件頭嘅電視機返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 bou6 daai6 gin6 tau4 ge3 din6 si6 gei1 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一台大尺寸的电视机回家。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a large-sized television and brought it home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好買咁多大件嘢啦，屋企都冇位擺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 maai5 gam3 do1 daai6 gin6 je5 laa1, uk1 kei2 dou1 mou5 wai6 baai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要买那么多大件的东西了，家里都没有地方放。
examples.english_sentence: Don't buy so many large items, there's no space to put them in the house.

english_meaning: Serious matter, big deal, important event
explanation_mandarin: 指事情重大，重要，或情况紧急。
explanation_english: Refers to a matter that is serious, important, or an urgent situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試肥佬，大件事啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, daai6 gin6 si6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格，出大事了！
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time, it's a big deal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔見咗護照，真係大件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gin3 zo2 wu6 ziu3, zan1 hai6 daai6 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 护照不见了，真是大事。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my passport, it's really a serious matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆發晒脾氣，肯定大件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 faat3 saai3 pei4 hei3, hang2 ding6 daai6 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板发脾气了，肯定出大事了。
examples.english_sentence: The boss lost his temper, something serious must have happened.

english_meaning: large portion and affordable
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物份量大，价格便宜，性价比高。
explanation_english: Describes food that has a large portion size and is also cheap, representing good value for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢真係大件夾抵食，所以成日都好多人排隊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 zan1 hai6 daai6 gin6 gaap3 dai2 sik6, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真是物美价廉，所以经常很多人排队。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really large portion and affordable, so there are always many people queuing up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意去大排檔食嘢，夠晒大件夾抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 heoi3 daai6 paai4 dong3 sik6 je5, gau3 saai3 daai6 gin6 gaap3 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢去大排档吃东西，足够物美价廉。
examples.english_sentence: I like going to dai pai dongs (open-air food stalls) to eat, it's very large portion and affordable.

english_meaning: large portion, generous serving
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物的量很大，足够吃饱甚至有剩余。
explanation_english: Describes a large amount of food, enough to satisfy hunger and potentially have leftovers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅碟頭飯份量都好大份㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dip6 tau4 faan6 fan6 loeng6 dou1 hou2 daai6 fan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的碟头饭份量都很大份的。
examples.english_sentence: The portion sizes of the set meals at this restaurant are very large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食唔晒咁大份嘅意粉啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 m4 saai3 gam3 daai6 fan6 ge3 ji3 fan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃不完这么大份的意大利面啊！
examples.english_sentence: I can't finish such a large portion of pasta!

english_meaning: everyone; everybody; all
explanation_mandarin: 指所有的人，大家。
explanation_english: Refers to all the people; everyone; everybody.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大伙兒不如一齊去食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 ji4 bat1 jyu4 jat1 cai4 heoi3 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家不如一起去吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Why don't we all go to dinner together?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日大伙喺老地方見啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daai6 fo2 hai2 lou5 dei6 fong1 gin3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天大家在老地方见吧！
examples.english_sentence: Let's meet at the usual place tomorrow, everyone!

english_meaning: everyone, everybody
explanation_mandarin: 指一群人中的所有人，相当于“大家”、“全体”。
explanation_english: Refers to all the people in a group; equivalent to "everyone", "everybody".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大伙兒聽日喺呢度集合啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 ji4 ting1 jat6 hai2 ni1 dou6 zaap6 hap6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家明天在这里集合啊！
examples.english_sentence: Everyone, meet here tomorrow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大伙兒一齊努力，一定可以搞掂佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 fo2 ji4 jat1 cai4 nou5 lik6, jat1 ding6 ho2 ji5 gaau2 dim6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家一起努力，一定可以搞定它。
examples.english_sentence: If everyone works together, we can definitely handle it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該大伙兒幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 daai6 fo2 ji4 bong1 saa2 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦大家帮帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Please everyone, give us a hand.

english_meaning: Husband's elder brother; eldest uncle
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的哥哥，或父亲的哥哥中排行最大的。
explanation_english: Refers to the husband's elder brother; or the eldest of the father's brothers (eldest uncle).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大伯對我好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 baak3 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的大伯对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: My husband's elder brother is very nice to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我大伯，我阿爸嘅大哥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 daai6 baak3, ngo5 aa3 baa1 ge3 daai6 go1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的大伯，我爸爸的大哥。
examples.english_sentence: He is my eldest uncle, my father's eldest brother.

english_meaning: Big Buddha; imposing or unmovable person
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指大型的佛像。 也可比喻指那些难以推动或改变的人或事物，有难以撼动，重量级的意思。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a large Buddha statue. Figuratively, it can refer to a person or thing that is difficult to move or change, implying something immovable and heavyweight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好似尊大佛咁，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 zyun1 daai6 fat6 gam2, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的个性像尊大佛一样，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is like a Big Buddha; he doesn't listen no matter what you say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好似尊大佛咁，好難改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 ci5 zyun1 daai6 fat6 gam2, hou2 naan4 gai2 bin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司就像尊大佛一样，很难改变。
examples.english_sentence: This company is like a Big Buddha; it's very difficult to change.

english_meaning: masterpiece (humble)
explanation_mandarin: 谦称别人的作品，如文章、绘画等。
explanation_english: A humble way of referring to someone else's work, such as a piece of writing, painting, etc. It's a polite and respectful term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔敢當，你嘅大作先至真係精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gam2 dong3, nei5 ge3 daai6 zok3 sin1 zi3 zan1 hai6 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不敢当，你的大作才真是精彩。
examples.english_sentence: I'm flattered, but your masterpiece is truly impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我睇咗你本大作，寫得好好呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tai2 zo2 nei5 bun2 daai6 zok3, se2 dak1 hou2 hou2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看了你的大作，写得很好啊！
examples.english_sentence: I've read your masterpiece, it's written very well!

english_meaning: Big Brother; Boss; Leader; Senior Member (of a triad or gang)
explanation_mandarin: 指黑社会或犯罪团伙的头目；也用于称呼年长的兄长或在某领域内有权威的人。
explanation_english: Refers to the leader of a triad or criminal gang; also used to address an older brother or a person with authority in a particular field. Can also be used informally to refer to someone who is older or more experienced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係呢個社團嘅大佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ni1 go3 se5 tyun4 ge3 daai6 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是这个社团的老大。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss of this gang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞事，呢度大佬睇住㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 si6, ni1 dou6 daai6 lou2 tai2 zyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要惹事，这里老大看着呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't cause trouble, the boss is watching here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋叫佢大佬，因為佢喺公司好有地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 giu3 keoi5 daai6 lou2, jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们叫他大佬，因为他在公司很有地位。
examples.english_sentence: We call him 'big brother' because he has a high position in the company.

english_meaning: Senior expert, veteran, old hand (in a specific field)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个行业或领域里经验丰富、资历深厚的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is highly experienced and has a long history in a particular industry or field. It implies expertise and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺飲食界係個大佬倌，好多人都好尊敬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam2 sik6 gaai3 hai6 go3 daai6 lou5 gun1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 zyun1 ging3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在餐饮界是个老前辈，很多人都很尊敬他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a senior expert in the catering industry, and many people respect him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要解決呢個問題，我哋應該請教下啲大佬倌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 ching2 gaau3 haa5 di1 daai6 lou5 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要解决这个问题，我们应该请教一下那些老前辈。
examples.english_sentence: To solve this problem, we should consult with the veterans.

english_meaning: senior figure, elder, veteran, someone of a higher generation or standing
explanation_mandarin: 指资历深厚、辈分较高的人，通常在某个行业或组织中具有一定的影响力。
explanation_english: Refers to a senior figure, someone of a higher generation or with significant seniority and experience, usually within a particular industry or organization, and often wielding considerable influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行都算係大佬輩㗎啦，好多嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hang4 dou1 syun3 hai6 daai6 lou5 bui3 gaa3 laa1, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这一行也算是老前辈了，很多事情都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's considered a senior figure in this industry, he knows a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重啲大佬輩嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 di1 daai6 lou5 bui3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尊重老前辈的意见。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect the opinions of our seniors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱入行，好多嘢都要問大佬輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 hang4, hou2 do1 ye5 dou1 jiu3 man6 daai6 lou5 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚入行，很多事情都要问老前辈。
examples.english_sentence: He's just starting out, he needs to ask the veterans about a lot of things.

english_meaning: Ambassador
explanation_mandarin: 国家派驻在外国的最高外交代表。
explanation_english: An official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat, representing one country to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係香港駐美國嘅大使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 zyu3 mei5 gwok3 ge3 daai6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是香港驻美国的大使。
examples.english_sentence: He is the ambassador of Hong Kong to the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大使館會處理簽證申請。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 si2 gun2 wui5 cyu5 lei5 cim1 zing3 san1 cing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大使馆会处理签证申请。
examples.english_sentence: The embassy will process visa applications.

english_meaning: embassy
explanation_mandarin: 一个国家在另一个国家设立的官方代表机构，代表本国政府处理与该国的外交事务。
explanation_english: The official diplomatic representation of one country in another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想問下攞簽證要去邊度？大使館喺邊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 man6 haa5 lo2 cin1 zing3 jiu3 heoi3 bin1 dou6? daai6 si3 gun2 hai2 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想问一下办理签证要去哪里？大使馆在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: I want to ask where I need to go to apply for a visa? Where is the embassy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺英國大使館做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jing1 gwok3 daai6 si3 gun2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在英国大使馆工作。
examples.english_sentence: He works at the British embassy.

english_meaning: feces, excrement, stool
explanation_mandarin: 指人体排出的固体或半固体废物。
explanation_english: Refers to solid or semi-solid waste expelled from the human body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我急住要去廁所大便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gap1 zyu6 jiu3 heoi3 ci3 so2 daai6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我急着要去厕所大便。
examples.english_sentence: I urgently need to go to the toilet to defecate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日大便好唔暢順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daai6 bin6 hou2 m4 cheung3 seun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天大便很不顺畅。
examples.english_sentence: He is having difficulty defecating today.

english_meaning: hero; knight-errant; chivalrous person
explanation_mandarin: 指武艺高强、行侠仗义的人，通常出现在武侠小说或电影中。也用于赞扬有正义感、勇敢的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with great martial arts skills who performs acts of chivalry, often appearing in wuxia novels or movies. Also used to praise someone who is righteous and brave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候成日幻想自己係個大俠，儆惡懲奸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 waan6 soeng2 zi6 gei2 hai6 go3 daai6 hap6, ging2 ok3 ching4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候经常幻想自己是个大侠，惩恶扬善。
examples.english_sentence: When he was a child, he often fantasized about being a hero, punishing evil and promoting good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁有正義感，真係好似個大俠咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jau5 zing3 ji6 gam2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 go3 daai6 hap6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么有正义感，真像个大侠。
examples.english_sentence: You are so righteous, you're just like a hero.

english_meaning: termination notice, pink slip
explanation_mandarin: 指公司发出的解雇通知书，因为信封通常比较大，所以得名。
explanation_english: Refers to a termination notice issued by a company, so called because the envelope is usually large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日收到個大信封，俾公司炒咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 go3 daai6 seon3 fung1, bei2 gung1 si1 caau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天收到了解雇通知，被公司解雇了。
examples.english_sentence: He received a termination notice today and was fired by the company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都擔心會收到大信封。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 daam1 sam1 wui5 sau1 dou2 daai6 seon3 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都担心会收到解雇通知。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, and many people are worried about receiving a termination notice.

mandarin_meaning: 老大哥，主要人物，大人物
english_meaning: Big Brother, main figure, important person
explanation_mandarin: 比喻在某个团体或圈子中具有重要地位或影响力的人物，相当于“老大哥”、“主要人物”。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a person who holds a significant position or influence in a group or circle, equivalent to "Big Brother" or "main figure."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司入面係大俥，好多嘢都要問過佢先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 hai6 daai6 ce1, ho2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里是老大哥，很多事情都要问过他才行。
examples.english_sentence: He's the big brother in the company; many things need to be asked of him first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅計劃，佢先係大俥嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 gai3 waak6, keoi5 sin1 hai6 daai6 ce1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的计划，他才是主要人物。
examples.english_sentence: He is the main figure in this project.

english_meaning: to grow up; to become an adult
explanation_mandarin: 指从小孩成长为成人。
explanation_english: Refers to the process of growing from a child into an adult.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你大個咗想做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daai6 go3 zo2 soeng2 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你长大后想做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to be when you grow up?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大個要揸飛機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 go3 jiu3 zaa1 fei1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我长大后要开飞机。
examples.english_sentence: I want to fly a plane when I grow up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大個咗個人成熟咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 go3 zo2 go3 jan4 sing4 suk6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长大后，整个人成熟了很多。
examples.english_sentence: He has matured a lot since he grew up.

english_meaning: grown-up boy; act like a grown-up
explanation_mandarin: 指男孩长大成人，表现得像个男子汉。也用来劝说或要求男孩表现得成熟懂事。
explanation_english: Refers to a boy growing up and acting like a grown man. It's also used to persuade or ask a boy to behave maturely and sensibly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都大個仔喇，唔好成日扭計啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 daai6 go3 zai2 laa3, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 nau2 gai2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都长大了，别老是耍赖！
examples.english_sentence: You're a grown-up boy now, don't always whine!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家大個仔，識得自己照顧自己喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 daai6 go3 zai2, sik1 dak1 zi6 gei2 ziu3 gu3 zi6 gei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在长大了，懂得自己照顾自己了。
examples.english_sentence: He's a grown-up boy now, he knows how to take care of himself.

english_meaning: Grown-up girl; to have grown up (referring to a girl); to be old enough (for a girl)
explanation_mandarin: 指女孩已经长大，在年龄或行为上变得成熟。常带有一种感慨或欣慰的语气。
explanation_english: Refers to a girl who has grown up, either in age or maturity. Often used with a tone of感慨 (gan3 kai2 - sentimental feeling) or 欣慰 (jan1 wai3 - gratified feeling). It can also imply that a girl is old enough to do something or understand something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，你都大個女喇，識得幫手做家務喇喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, nei5 dou1 daai6 go3 neoi2 laa3, sik1 dak1 bong1 sau2 zou6 gaa1 mou6 laa1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，你都长大成人了，懂得帮忙做家务了！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, you're all grown up now, you know how to help with housework!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣好曳㗎，而家真係大個女喇，變得好乖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2陣 hou2 jai6 gaa3, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 daai6 go3 neoi2 laa3, bin3 dak1 hou2 gwaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候很调皮，现在真的长大了，变得很乖巧。
examples.english_sentence: She was very naughty when she was little, now she's really grown up and become very well-behaved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日當佢係小朋友啦，佢都大個女，有自己嘅諗法㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dong3 keoi5 hai6 siu2 pang4 jau5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 daai6 go3 neoi2, jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 lam2 faat3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是把她当小孩，她都长大了，有自己的想法的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always treat her like a child, she's grown up now and has her own opinions.

english_meaning: Big shot; prominent figure; star performer (in opera or entertainment)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一领域内很有名望或地位很高的人，尤指戏曲、娱乐界的著名演员。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with great fame or high status in a particular field, especially a famous actor or performer in opera or entertainment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係粵劇界嘅大倌，好多人都識佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 jyut6 kek6 gaai3 ge3 daai6 gun1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是粤剧界的大人物，很多人都认识他。
examples.english_sentence: He is now a prominent figure in the Cantonese opera scene, many people know him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽晚有位大倌嚟我哋戲院做大戲，你要唔要一齊去睇？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 maan5 jau5 wai2 daai6 gun1 lai4 ngo5 dei6 hei3 jyun2 zou6 daai6 hei3, nei5 jiu3 m4 jiu3 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明晚有一位名角来我们戏院表演，你要不要一起去看？
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow night, a star performer is coming to our theater to perform opera, do you want to go see it together?

english_meaning: long vacation; extended holiday
explanation_mandarin: 指比较长的假期，通常比周末假期更长，例如一周或更长时间的假期。
explanation_english: Refers to a long vacation, usually longer than a weekend, such as a week or more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年想放個大假，去歐洲玩翻一個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 soeng2 fong3 go3 daai6 gaa3, heoi3 au1 zau1 waan2 faan1 jat1 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年想放一个长假，去欧洲玩一个月。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take a long vacation this year and travel around Europe for a month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅大假福利好好，每年都有兩個禮拜嘅假期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 gaa3 fuk1 lei6 hou2 hou2, mui5 nin4 dou1 jau5 loeng5 go3 lai5 baai3 ge3 gaa3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的长假福利很好，每年都有两个星期的假期。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has great long vacation benefits; they get two weeks of vacation every year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放完大假返嚟，好似叉足電咁，做嘢都精神啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 jyun4 daai6 gaa3 faan1 lai4, hou2 ci5 caa1 zuk1 din6 gam3, zou6 je5 dou1 zing1 san4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 休完长假回来，好像充满了电一样，工作都更有精神了。
examples.english_sentence: After taking a long vacation, I feel like I'm fully charged and more energetic at work.

mandarin_meaning: 汽车修理工; 机械师
english_meaning: mechanic; car mechanic
explanation_mandarin: 指精通机械维修的人，通常指汽车修理工。
explanation_english: Refers to a person skilled in mechanical repair, typically a car mechanic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我架車壞咗，要搵個大偈嚟整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 waai6 zo2, jiu3 wan2 go3 daai6 gai2 lai4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的车坏了，要找个汽车修理工来修。
examples.english_sentence: My car broke down, I need to find a mechanic to fix it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候已經對啲機械好有興趣，大個咗就做咗大偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 ji5 ging1 deoi3 di1 gei1 haai6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3, daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 zou6 zo2 daai6 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候就对机械很有兴趣，长大后就做了汽车修理工。
examples.english_sentence: He was interested in machinery since he was young, and became a mechanic when he grew up.

english_meaning: idiot, fool, big fool
explanation_mandarin: 指人愚笨，傻气。也可用来称呼某人（带戏谑意味）。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is foolish or stupid. Can also be used to refer to someone (often in a playful or teasing way). It can also refer to a famous Hong Kong actor Lo Hoi Pang (李兆基), known for his roles as a gangster in many Hong Kong films. He was nicknamed 大傻.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大傻，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 so4, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个大傻瓜，这么简单的事情都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an idiot; he can't even do such a simple thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲講嘢啦，人哋會以為你係大傻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 ji5 wai4 nei5 hai6 daai6 so4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声说话啦，别人会以为你是傻瓜的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't speak so loudly; people will think you're a fool.

english_meaning: literally: big light bulb; figuratively: a third wheel; someone who is intruding on a date or private time
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是大灯泡，比喻在情侣约会或单独相处时，突然出现的第三者，破坏气氛。
explanation_english: Literally 'big light bulb'. Figuratively, it refers to a third wheel, someone who intrudes on a couple's date or private moment, spoiling the atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，唔好做我哋嘅大光燈啦，我哋想靜下傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, m4 hou2 zou6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 daai6 gwong1 dang1 laa1, ngo5 dei6 soeng2 zing6 haa5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，不要做我们的电灯泡了，我们想安静地聊聊天。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't be our third wheel, we want to chat quietly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做大光燈，好冇眼睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 daai6 gwong1 dang1, hou2 mou5 ngaan5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是当电灯泡，真没眼看。
examples.english_sentence: He's always a third wheel, it's unbearable to watch.

cantonese: 大光燈 - 照遠唔照近
jyutping: daai6 gwong1 dang1—ziu3 jyun5 m4 ziu3 gan6
mandarin_meaning: 舍近求远；只见远处，不见近处
english_meaning: To focus on distant things and neglect what's nearby; to overlook the immediate.
explanation_mandarin: 大光灯（强光灯）的光束射得很远，但近处反而照不到。比喻人目光短浅，只看到长远的目标，却忽略了眼前的事情或利益。
explanation_english: A strong lamp (大光燈) illuminates far away but not close by. This idiom describes someone who focuses on distant goals or issues while overlooking immediate concerns, tasks, or benefits; short-sighted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗住將來發大達，但係而家份工又hea做，真係大光燈——照遠唔照近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 loi4 faat3 daai6 daat6, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 fan6 gung1 jau6 hea1 zou6, zan1 hai6 daai6 gwong1 dang1—ziu3 jyun5 m4 ziu3 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着将来发大财，但是现在的工作却马马虎虎，真是舍近求远。
examples.english_sentence: He's always dreaming of getting rich in the future, but he slacks off in his current job. It's really focusing on the distant and neglecting the immediate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好大光燈——照遠唔照近啦，眼前嘅功課都未搞掂，諗咁多將來嘅嘢做咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daai6 gwong1 dang1—ziu3 jyun5 m4 ziu3 gan6 laa1, ngaan5 cin4 ge3 gung1 fo3 dou1 mei6 gaau2 dim6, nam2 gam3 do1 zoeng1 loi4 ge3 je5 zou6 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要舍近求远了，眼前的作业还没搞定，想那么多将来的事情做什么？
examples.english_sentence: Don't focus on the distant and neglect the immediate. You haven't even finished your homework, why are you thinking so much about the future?

english_meaning: to fall; to tumble; to trip
explanation_mandarin: 指身体失去平衡而倒下。在粤语中是口语化的表达方式。
explanation_english: Refers to losing balance and falling down. It's a colloquial expression in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路唔小心，成日都大兜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 m4 siu2 sam1, seng4 jat6 dou1 daai6 dau1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路不小心，总是摔倒。
examples.english_sentence: He is careless when walking and always falls down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔跑步嗰陣大兜咗，搞到成身都係泥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 paau2 bou6 go2 zan6 daai6 dau1 zo2, gaau2 dou3 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6 nai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子跑步的时候摔倒了，弄得全身都是泥。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell while running, getting mud all over their body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果落雨路滑，好容易大兜㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 lok6 jyu5 lou6 waat6, hou2 jung4 ji6 daai6 dau1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果下雨路滑，很容易摔倒的。
examples.english_sentence: If it's raining and the road is slippery, it's easy to fall.

synonyms: 仆街 (puk1 gaai1) - slang, more vulgar

english_meaning: Complete collection; comprehensive collection; encyclopedia
explanation_mandarin: 指搜集齐备的，内容完整的书籍或资料。
explanation_english: Refers to a complete and comprehensive collection of books or materials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本係廣東話大全，咩詞彙都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 hai6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 daai6 cyun4, me1 ci4 wui6 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是一本粤语大全，什么词汇都有。
examples.english_sentence: This is a comprehensive Cantonese dictionary, it has all the vocabulary.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要一份緊急應變大全，以應對突發情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 fan6 gan2 gap1 ying3 bin3 daai6 cyun4, ji5 ying3 deui3 dat6 faat3 ching4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要一份紧急应变大全，以应对突发情况。
examples.english_sentence: We need a comprehensive emergency response manual to deal with emergencies.

mandarin_meaning: 大公无私 (dà gōng wú sī)
english_meaning: completely impartial; selfless; unselfish
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常公正，没有一点私心。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is completely impartial, with no personal bias or selfishness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢大公無私，所以大家都好信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 daai6 gung1 mou4 si1, so2 ji5 daai6 ga1 dou1 hou2 seon3 jam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事大公无私，所以大家都非常信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He is completely impartial in his work, so everyone trusts him a lot.

synonyms: 公正廉明 (gung1 zing3 lim4 ming4)

english_meaning: Idiot, fool, blockhead
explanation_mandarin: 粤语俚语，形容一个人愚笨，迟钝。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang referring to a person who is stupid, foolish, or slow-witted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔明，真係大冬瓜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 dou1 m4 ming4, zan1 hai6 daai6 dung1 gwaa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不明白，真是个笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even understand this, you're such an idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁蠢啦，大冬瓜！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, daai6 dung1 gwaa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么笨啦，傻瓜！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you blockhead!

english_meaning: generally; in most cases; as a rule; usually; generally speaking
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概、一般的情況下。用於引出對某種情況的概括性描述。
explanation_english: Indicates a general or usual situation. Used to introduce a general description of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大凡落雨天，交通都會好塞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 faan4 lok6 jyu5 tin1, gaau1 tung1 dou1 wui5 hou2 sak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一般来说下雨天，交通都会很堵。
examples.english_sentence: Generally speaking, traffic is very congested on rainy days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大凡佢講嘅嘢都唔可以盡信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 faan4 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 ho2 ji5 zeon6 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一般来说，他说的东西都不能完全相信。
examples.english_sentence: Generally speaking, you can't completely believe what he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大凡第一次去日本嘅人，都會覺得好乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 faan4 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 jat6 bun2 ge3 jan4, dou1 wui5 gok3 dak1 hou2 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一般来说，第一次去日本的人，都会觉得很干净。
examples.english_sentence: Generally speaking, people who go to Japan for the first time find it very clean.

english_meaning: heavy bleeding; hemorrhage; to lose a lot of money; to bleed financially
explanation_mandarin: 原指大量出血。引申为花费很多钱，损失惨重，像出血一样。
explanation_english: Originally refers to heavy bleeding. Figuratively, it means to spend a lot of money or suffer a significant financial loss, like losing a lot of blood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買咗層樓之後，我真係大出血啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zo2 cang4 lau2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 daai6 hyut3 cheut1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买了这栋楼之后，我真是大出血啊！
examples.english_sentence: After buying this building, I really bled financially!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今年蝕咗好多錢，大出血啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 sit6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, daai6 hyut3 cheut1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司今年亏了很多钱，大出血啊！
examples.english_sentence: This company lost a lot of money this year, a heavy financial loss!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢醫病醫到大出血。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yi1 beng6 yi1 dou3 daai6 hyut3 cheut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看病看得花了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He spent a lot of money on medical treatment.

english_meaning: drastic; bold and resolute; sweeping
explanation_mandarin: 比喻办事果断而有魄力，改革措施强而有力。
explanation_english: Describes a way of doing things that is decisive, bold, and powerful, often used to describe significant and far-reaching reforms or changes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗解決公司嘅財政問題，佢哋決定大刀闊斧咁改革。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 gaai2 kyut3 gung1 si1 ge3 coi4 zing3 man6 tai4, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 daai6 dou1 fut3 fu2 gam2 gaai2 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了解决公司的财政问题，他们决定大刀阔斧地改革。
examples.english_sentence: In order to solve the company's financial problems, they decided to implement sweeping reforms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該大刀闊斧噉處理環境污染問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ying1 goi1 daai6 dou1 fut3 fu2 gam2 cyu2 lei5 waan4 ging2 wu1 jyun5 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该大刀阔斧地处理环境污染问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government should deal with the environmental pollution problem in a drastic manner.

english_meaning: the year before last year
explanation_mandarin: 指前年再上一年，即三年前。
explanation_english: Refers to the year before last year; three years ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大前年已經去過日本喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 cin4 nin4 ji5 ging1 heoi3 gwo3 jat6 bun2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大前年已经去过日本了。
examples.english_sentence: I already went to Japan the year before last year.

english_meaning: major premise; fundamental condition; prerequisite
explanation_mandarin: 进行论证或推理时，首要的、必须具备的条件或前提。
explanation_english: A major premise or fundamental condition; a prerequisite that must be met before something else can happen or be considered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功，大前提係你要夠勤力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1, daai6 cin4 tai4 hai6 nei5 jiu3 gau3 kan4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成功，大前提是你必须足够勤奋。
examples.english_sentence: To be successful, the major premise is that you must be diligent enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋傾合作嘅大前提係要對雙方都有利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 king1 hap6 zok3 ge3 daai6 cin4 tai4 hai6 jiu3 deoi3 soeng1 fong1 dou1 jau5 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们谈合作的大前提是要对双方都有利。
examples.english_sentence: The prerequisite for us to discuss cooperation is that it must be beneficial to both parties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺討論之前，我哋要先確立一個大前提。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 dou2 leon6 zi1 cin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 kok3 lap6 jat1 go3 daai6 cin4 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在讨论之前，我们首先要确立一个大前提。
examples.english_sentence: Before the discussion, we need to establish a major premise first.

english_meaning: three days ago
explanation_mandarin: 指昨天之前的那一天，即三天前。
explanation_english: Refers to the day before yesterday, meaning three days ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大前日已經交咗份功課啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 cin4 jat6 ji5 ging1 gaau2 zo2 fan6 gung1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我前天就已经交了作业了。
examples.english_sentence: I already submitted the homework three days ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大前日嚟過搵你，你唔喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 cin4 jat6 lai4 gwo3 wan2 nei5, nei5 m4 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他前天来找过你，你不在。
examples.english_sentence: He came to look for you three days ago, but you weren't here.

mandarin_meaning: 持刀砍人者; 凶残的罪犯
english_meaning: Person who attacks with a knife or cleaver; someone who wields a cleaver or knife to attack; a violent criminal; a thug armed with a knife
explanation_mandarin: 指手持刀具（通常是菜刀）行凶的人，多指罪犯或黑社会成员。形容其行为凶残暴力。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who attacks with a knife or cleaver, usually a criminal or a triad member. It describes someone with violent and ruthless behavior, often associated with gangs or criminal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班大劈友衝入嚟，嚇到啲人雞飛狗走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 daai6 pek3 jau2 cung1 jap6 lai4, haak3 dou3 di1 jan4 gai1 fei1 gau2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那群持刀歹徒冲进来，吓得人们四处逃窜。
examples.english_sentence: The group of thugs armed with knives rushed in, scaring everyone and causing them to scatter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係黑社會，成日都見到佢哋班大劈友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 hak1 se6 wui2, seng4 jat6 dou1 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6 baan1 daai6 pek3 jau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是黑社会，经常能看到他们那群持刀歹徒。
examples.english_sentence: They are triad members, and you can often see their gang of knife-wielding thugs.

english_meaning: trouble; serious problem; big deal; in deep trouble
explanation_mandarin: 形容情况非常糟糕，麻烦大了。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is very bad or serious, a big trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次大劑啦，考試唔合格！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daai6 zai1 laa1, haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次糟糕了，考试没及格！
examples.english_sentence: This is a big problem, I failed the exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞爛咗人哋架車，真係大劑！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 laan6 zo2 jan4 dei6 gaa2 ce1, zan1 hai6 daai6 zai1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞坏了别人的车，真是要命了！
examples.english_sentence: He crashed into someone else's car, that's a real problem!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔記得帶護照，大劑啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 wu6 ziu3, daai6 zai1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 忘记带护照了，糟糕了！
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my passport, that's a problem!

english_meaning: with great effort; vigorously; strongly; to make an effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容力量大，或表示用很大的力气。
explanation_english: Describes having great strength or using a lot of strength. Can also mean to make a significant effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大力啲扭開個樽蓋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 lik6 di1 nau2 hoi1 go3 zeon1 goi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用力拧开瓶盖吧。
examples.english_sentence: Use more strength to twist open the bottle cap.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好大力咁推開咗道門。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 daai6 lik6 gam2 tui1 hoi1 zo2 dou6 mun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很用力地推开了门。
examples.english_sentence: He pushed the door open with great force.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要大力支持本地創作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daai6 lik6 zi1 chi4 bun2 dei6 chong3 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要大力支持本地创作。
examples.english_sentence: We need to strongly support local creations.

mandarin_meaning: 大力出奇迹 / 只要努力，奇迹就会发生
english_meaning: Miracles happen through great effort; Put in the hard work and you might get a surprising outcome.
explanation_mandarin: 指只要付出巨大的努力，就有可能创造奇迹，即使看起来不太可能的事情也有机会成功。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that with immense effort, miracles can happen. It implies that even seemingly impossible tasks can be achieved through hard work and dedication. It often has a sarcastic undertone, suggesting that the effort may be disproportionate to the outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試咁難，希望大力出奇蹟啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 gam3 naan4, hei1 mong6 daai6 lik6 ceot1 kei4 jik1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试这么难，希望努力会有奇迹发生吧！
examples.english_sentence: This exam is so difficult, let's hope for a miracle through hard work!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要一日起好棟樓，簡直係大力出奇蹟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 jat1 jat6 hei2 hou2 dung6 lau2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 daai6 lik6 ceot1 kei4 jik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说要一天建好这栋楼，简直是痴人说梦！
examples.english_sentence: He says he can build this building in a day, that's just dreaming!

synonyms: 人定勝天 (jan4 ding6 sing3 tin1) - Man will conquer nature

english_meaning: strongman, Hercules, very strong person
explanation_mandarin: 指力气很大的人，尤指那些以举重或表演力量为职业的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with great strength, especially those who are professional strongmen, weightlifters, or performers demonstrating feats of strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大力士，一個人搬得起成個雪櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 lik6 si6, jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 dak1 hei2 seng4 go3 syut3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个大力士，一个人能搬起整个冰箱。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a strongman, he can lift a whole refrigerator by himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢咁嘅身形，都知佢係個大力士啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 gam3 ge3 san1 ying4, dou1 zi1 keoi5 hai6 go3 daai6 lik6 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他这样的身材，就知道他是个大力士了。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at his physique, you know he's a strongman.

english_meaning: vise-grips; locking pliers; adjustable pliers
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以调节钳口大小并锁紧的钳子，通常用于夹持、扭转或固定物体。
explanation_english: A type of pliers with adjustable jaws that can be locked onto an object, typically used for gripping, twisting, or holding things securely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我用大力鉗夾實個螺絲，咁就擰得鬆佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 yung6 daai6 lik6 kim4 gaap3 sat6 go3 lo4 si1, gam2 zau6 ning1 dak1 sung1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我用大力钳夹紧螺丝，这样就能拧松它了。
examples.english_sentence: I used the vise-grips to clamp down on the screw, so I can loosen it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力鉗啦，會夾爛㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 kim4 laa1, wui5 gaap3 laan6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别用这么大力钳，会夹坏的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't use the vise-grips so hard, you'll break it!

english_meaning: Successful completion; to accomplish a task; mission accomplished
explanation_mandarin: 指巨大的工程或任务圆满完成。
explanation_english: Refers to the successful completion of a large project or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅新屋終於大功告成啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 san1 uk1 zung1 jyu1 daai6 gung1 gou3 sing4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的新房子终于大功告成了！
examples.english_sentence: Our new house is finally completed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過一年嘅努力，呢個工程終於大功告成喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 jat1 nin4 ge3 nu5 lik6, ni1 go3 gung1 ching4 zung1 jyu1 daai6 gung1 gou3 sing4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过一年的努力，这个工程终于大功告成了。
examples.english_sentence: After a year of hard work, this project has finally been successfully completed.

mandarin_meaning: 大功告成 (dà gōng gào chéng)
english_meaning: to be successfully accomplished; to be successfully completed; mission accomplished
explanation_mandarin: 指巨大的工程或重要的任务宣告完成。
explanation_english: Refers to a huge project or important task being successfully completed and announced as such.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過幾個月嘅努力，呢個項目終於大功告成喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gei2 go3 jyut6 ge3 nou5 lik6, ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 zung1 jyu1 daai6 gung1 gou3 sing4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过几个月的努力，这个项目终于大功告成了！
examples.english_sentence: After months of effort, this project has finally been successfully completed!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅團隊合作得好好，所以咁快就大功告成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 tyun4 doi2 hap6 zok3 dak1 hou2 hou2, so2 ji5 gam3 faai3 zau6 daai6 gung1 gou3 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的团队合作得很好，所以这么快就大功告成了。
examples.english_sentence: Our team cooperated very well, so we completed the task so quickly.

english_meaning: aorta; main artery
explanation_mandarin: 人体内最大的一条动脉血管，负责将心脏的血液输送到全身。
explanation_english: The largest artery in the human body, responsible for carrying blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢條大動脈塞咗，要做手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 tiu4 daai6 dung6 mak6 sak1 zo2, jiu3 zou6 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他的大动脉堵塞了，要做手术。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said his aorta is blocked and he needs surgery.

english_meaning: general trend; overall situation; the way things are going; momentum
explanation_mandarin: 指整体的趋势或形势。也指事情发展的大方向。
explanation_english: Refers to the general trend or situation. Also refers to the overall direction of how things are developing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇嚟大勢已去，冇得救啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 lai4 daai6 sai3 ji5 heoi3, mou5 dak1 gau3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看来大势已去，没救了。
examples.english_sentence: It seems the general trend is irreversible, there's no saving it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家嘅大勢係網上購物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ge3 daai6 sai3 hai6 mong5 soeng6 kau3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的趋势是网上购物。
examples.english_sentence: The current trend is online shopping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得把握大勢，所以先可以咁成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 baa2 ak1 daai6 sai3, so2 ji5 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得把握趋势，所以才能这么成功。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at grasping the overall trend, that's why he is so successful.

mandarin_meaning: 大势已去 (dà shì yǐ qù)
english_meaning: The situation is beyond recovery; The game is up; It's all over; The tide has turned.
explanation_mandarin: 指局势已经无法挽回，失败已成定局。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where recovery is impossible, and failure is certain. The opportunity has passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司蝕咗咁多錢，大勢已去㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 sit6 zo2 gam3 do1 cin2, daai6 sai3 ji5 heoi3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司亏损了这么多钱，大势已去了。
examples.english_sentence: This company has lost so much money, the situation is beyond recovery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 比賽去到最後十分鐘佢哋都仲落後緊二十分，大勢已去啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 coi3 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 sap6 fan1 zung1 keoi5 dei6 dou1 zung6 lok6 hau6 gan2 ji6 sap6 fan1, daai6 sai3 ji5 heoi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛到了最后十分钟他们还落后二十分，大势已去了。
examples.english_sentence: With only ten minutes left in the game and they are still 20 points behind, it's all over.

synonyms: 無力回天 (mou4 lik6 wui4 tin1)

english_meaning: inevitable trend; the way the wind is blowing; dictated by the general trend; a foregone conclusion
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展的必然趋势，是时代发展的潮流，不可阻挡。
explanation_english: Refers to an inevitable trend in the development of things, a current of the times that cannot be stopped. It indicates something that is bound to happen given the existing circumstances and general direction of events.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 電子商務係大勢所趨，我哋一定要跟上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din6 zi2 soeng1 mou6 hai6 daai6 sai3 so2 ceoi1, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gan1 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电子商务是大势所趋，我们一定要跟上。
examples.english_sentence: E-commerce is an inevitable trend, we must keep up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人口老化係大勢所趨，政府要諗辦法解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 hau2 lou5 faa3 hai6 daai6 sai3 so2 ceoi1, zing3 fu2 jiu3 lam2 baan6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人口老龄化是大势所趋，政府要想办法解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: Population aging is an inevitable trend, the government needs to think of ways to solve the problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用可再生能源係大勢所趨，對保護地球好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ho2 zoi3 sang1 nang4 jyun4 hai6 daai6 sai3 so2 ceoi1, deoi3 bou2 wu6 dei6 kau4 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 使用可再生能源是大势所趋，对保护地球很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Using renewable energy is an inevitable trend, and it's very important for protecting the Earth.

mandarin_meaning: 大肉包; 形容容易的事情
english_meaning: Large steamed bun with meat filling; (slang) easy task; a pushover
explanation_mandarin: （名词）指很大的肉包子。（形容词，俚语）形容某件事很容易完成，或者形容某人容易被利用或欺骗。
explanation_english: (Noun) Refers to a large steamed bun with meat filling. (Adjective, slang) Describes something that is easy to accomplish, or someone who is easily taken advantage of or deceived; a pushover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗個大包，真係好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 go3 daai6 baau1, zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天买了一个大肉包，真的很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a large steamed bun today, it's really delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工對佢嚟講簡直係大包，佢經驗咁豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 daai6 baau1, keoi5 ging1 gim6 gam3 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作对他来说简直是小菜一碟，他经验这么丰富。
examples.english_sentence: This job is a piece of cake for him, he has so much experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為佢係大包，佢好醒㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 hai6 daai6 baau1, keoi5 hou2 sing2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要以为他是软柿子，他很聪明的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think he's a pushover, he's very smart.

english_meaning: to encircle; to surround; to comprehensively cover (all aspects of a situation)
explanation_mandarin: 本意是指从四面八方包围起来，引申为全面覆盖、涵盖所有方面。
explanation_english: Literally means to surround from all sides. Figuratively, it means to comprehensively cover, encompassing all aspects of a situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試想大包圍，所以咩都讀晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 soeng2 daai6 baau1 wai4, so2 ji5 me1 dou1 duk6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试想全面复习，所以什么都读了。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to cover everything for this exam, so he's studying everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個優惠大包圍，包括晒所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jau1 wai2 daai6 baau1 wai4, baau1 kwut3 saai3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个优惠全面覆盖，包括了所有东西。
examples.english_sentence: This promotion is comprehensive, including everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要大包圍咁宣傳呢個新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 daai6 baau1 wai4 gam2 syun1 cyun4 ni1 go3 san1 caan2 pin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要全面地宣传这个新产品。
examples.english_sentence: We need to promote this new product comprehensively.

english_meaning: Sausage bun
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的香港街头小吃，将香肠夹在面包中食用。
explanation_english: A common Hong Kong street snack consisting of a sausage inside a bun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我晏晝想食個大包夾腸，唔該。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aan3 zau3 seung2 sik6 go3 daai6 baau1 gaap3 cheung2, m4 goi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下午想吃一个面包夹香肠，谢谢。
examples.english_sentence: I want to have a sausage bun this afternoon, please.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣成日食大包夾腸當早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 sing4 jat6 sik6 daai6 baau1 gaap3 cheung2 dong3 zou2 chaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常吃面包夹香肠当早餐。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often had sausage buns for breakfast.

english_meaning: a reliable person to depend on; someone who can be relied on; a big patron; a safe bet
explanation_mandarin: 比喻可以依靠、信赖的人或事物，通常指在经济上或事业上能给予帮助和支持的人。类似“靠山”的意思。
explanation_english: A metaphor for someone or something that can be relied on and trusted, usually referring to someone who can provide help and support economically or in one's career. Similar to the concept of a "backbone" or a "patron".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁叻，係公司嘅大包米嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 gam3 lek1, hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 baau1 mai5 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作这么能干，是公司里的靠山。
examples.english_sentence: He is so capable at work, he is the company's reliable person to depend on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，有我喺度，我係你嘅大包米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, jau5 ngo5 hai2 dou6, ngo5 hai6 nei5 ge3 daai6 baau1 mai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，有我在，我是你的靠山。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, I'm here, I'm your reliable person to depend on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸成日話阿爺係屋企嘅大包米，乜嘢都唔使愁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 seng4 jat6 waa6 aa3 je4 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 daai6 baau1 mai5, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sai2 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸经常说爷爷是家里的靠山，什么都不用愁。
examples.english_sentence: Dad always says grandpa is the backbone of the family, so we don't have to worry about anything.

english_meaning: most, the greater part, more than half
explanation_mandarin: 表示大部分或超过一半。
explanation_english: Indicates the majority or more than half of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個 project 大半都係佢做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project daai6 bun3 dou1 hai6 keoi5 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目大部分都是他做的。
examples.english_sentence: He did most of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啲功課大半都做曬喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 di1 gung1 fo3 daai6 bun3 dou1 zou6 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的功课大部分都做完了。
examples.english_sentence: We've finished most of our homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，大半學生都肥佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, daai6 bun3 hok6 sang1 dou1 fei4 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，大部分学生都不及格。
examples.english_sentence: For this exam, most of the students failed.

english_meaning: most of one's life; a good part of one's life
explanation_mandarin: 指人一生中大部分的时间，通常带有一种时间流逝或经历丰富的情感色彩。
explanation_english: Refers to a significant portion of someone's life. Often used to express the feeling of the passage of time or having accumulated many experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大半世都喺香港度過㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 bun3 sai3 dou1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 dou6 gwo3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大半辈子都在香港度过的。
examples.english_sentence: I've spent most of my life in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗仔女，佢哋付出咗大半世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 zai2 neoi5, keoi5 dei6 fu6 ceot1 zo2 daai6 bun3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了子女，他们付出了大半辈子。
examples.english_sentence: They dedicated a good part of their lives to their children.

english_meaning: Big star; A-lister; Star-studded; Big names
explanation_mandarin: 指非常有名的、重要的或有影响力的人，通常用于娱乐圈或商业界。形容阵容强大，有很多明星或重要人物。
explanation_english: Refers to very famous, important, or influential people, usually in the entertainment or business world. Describes a strong lineup, with many stars or important figures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部戲搵咗好多大卡士嚟拍，一定好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 hei3 wan2 zo2 hou2 do1 daai6 kaa1 si2 lai4 paak3, jat1 ding6 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影找了很多大牌明星来拍，肯定很好看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie hired many big stars to film, it must be very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚個慈善晚宴有好多大卡士出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 go3 ci4 sin6 maan5 jin3 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 kaa1 si2 ceot1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的慈善晚宴有很多大牌明星出席。
examples.english_sentence: There are many big stars attending tonight's charity gala.

english_meaning: Uncle; middle-aged man (often used informally)
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪比较大的男性，比“叔叔”略显非正式，可以指有一定年龄差的男性，有时略带调侃意味。
explanation_english: Refers to an older man, somewhat informal. It can refer to a man with a significant age difference, sometimes used with a slightly teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個大叔喺度睇緊波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 daai6 suk1 hai2 dou6 tai2 gan2 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个大叔正在看球赛。
examples.english_sentence: That uncle is watching the ball game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好叫我大叔，我仲好後生㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 giu3 ngo5 daai6 suk1, ngo5 zung6 hou2 hau6 saang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要叫我大叔，我还很年轻呢！
examples.english_sentence: Don't call me uncle, I'm still very young!

english_meaning: To eat voraciously; to wolf down; to gobble up
explanation_mandarin: 形容人吃饭时大口快速地吃，通常是不太雅观的吃相。
explanation_english: Describes someone eating quickly and with large mouthfuls, often in an unrefined or impolite manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大口扒啦，好似餓咗好耐咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 daai6 hau2 paa1 laa1, hou2 ci5 ngo6 zo2 hou2 noi6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么狼吞虎咽的，好像饿了很久一样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't eat so voraciously, it's like you haven't eaten in ages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一放工就返屋企，大口扒咗個飯就瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 fong3 gung1 zau6 faan1 uk1 kei2, daai6 hau2 paa1 zo2 go3 faan6 zau6 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下班就回家，狼吞虎咽地吃完饭就睡觉了。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he gets off work, he goes home, gobbles up his meal, and goes to sleep.

english_meaning: boastful, arrogant, exaggerating one's abilities, talking big
explanation_mandarin: 形容人说话夸大，自以为是，自吹自擂，口气很大。
explanation_english: Describes someone who exaggerates their abilities, is boastful, arrogant, and talks big. It implies that their claims are unlikely to be true or are overblown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話自己好勁，真係大口氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 hou2 ging6, zan1 hai6 daai6 hau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己很厉害，真是口气很大。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's very capable, he's really boasting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好聽佢亂吹，佢個人好大口氣㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 teng1 keoi5 lyun6 cheui1, keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daai6 hau2 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要听他瞎吹，他这个人很会夸大其词的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to his nonsense, he's a very boastful person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢應承咗幫我搞掂件事，但係我覺得佢只係講大口氣啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ying1 sing4 zo2 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 zi2 hai6 gong2 daai6 hau2 hei3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他答应帮我搞定这件事，但是我觉得他只是说说大话而已。
examples.english_sentence: He promised to help me sort out this matter, but I think he's just talking big.

synonyms: 誇誇其談 (kwaa1 kwaa1 kei4 taam4)

english_meaning: Princess Margaret Hospital Children's Orthopaedic Centre (commonly known)
explanation_mandarin: 香港玛嘉烈医院儿童骨科中心，因其位置在大口环而得名，现在泛指香港儿童医院。
explanation_english: Princess Margaret Hospital Children's Orthopaedic Centre in Hong Kong. Named after its location in Tai Hau Wan, it now generally refers to the Hong Kong Children's Hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔細個嘅時候喺大口環做過手術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hai2 daai6 hau2 waan4 zou6 gwo3 sau2 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的儿子小时候在大口环做过手术。
examples.english_sentence: His son had surgery at the Children's Orthopaedic Centre (Princess Margaret Hospital) when he was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要帶阿仔去大口環覆診。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 daai3 a3 zai2 heoi3 daai6 hau2 waan4 fuk1 can2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要带儿子去儿童医院复诊。
examples.english_sentence: I need to take my son to the Hong Kong Children's Hospital for a follow-up appointment tomorrow.

synonyms: 香港兒童醫院 (hoeng1 gong2 ji4 tung4 ji1 jyun2)
兒童醫院 (ji4 tung4 ji1 jyun2)

english_meaning: to shout loudly; to yell
explanation_mandarin: 大声喊叫，发出很大的声音。
explanation_english: To shout loudly; to yell; to emit a loud sound, often expressing strong emotions like surprise, fear, or excitement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嚇到大叫一聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haak3 dou3 daai6 giu3 jat1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他吓得大叫一声。
examples.english_sentence: He was so scared that he yelled loudly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺圖書館度大叫呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 dou6 daai6 giu3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在图书馆里大喊大叫。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shout loudly in the library.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢贏咗比賽，興奮到大叫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3, hing1 fan5 dou3 daai6 giu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赢了比赛，兴奋地大叫。
examples.english_sentence: He won the competition and shouted excitedly.

english_meaning: perfectly okay, perfectly acceptable, can certainly, might as well
explanation_mandarin: 表示完全可以，没有问题，或者可以考虑做某事。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is perfectly okay, acceptable, or something that can be considered doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔想去嘅話，大可以唔去㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 ge3 waa2, daai6 ho2 ji5 m4 heoi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不想去的话，完全可以不去。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to go, you're perfectly okay not to go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 反正都喺度等，我哋大可以行吓街先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan2 zing3 dou1 hai2 dou6 dang2, ngo5 dei6 daai6 ho2 ji5 haang4 haa5 gaai1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 反正都在这里等，我们当然可以先逛逛街。
examples.english_sentence: Since we're waiting here anyway, we might as well go for a walk first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有錢，大可以買架貴啲嘅車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 cin2, daai6 ho2 ji5 maai5 gaa3 gwai3 di1 ge3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有钱，完全可以买辆贵一点的车。
examples.english_sentence: Since he's so rich, he can certainly buy a more expensive car.

english_meaning: (Mainstream) Television station; Mainstream media
explanation_mandarin: 通常指香港最大的免费电视台TVB（电视广播有限公司），有时也泛指主流媒体。
explanation_english: Usually refers to TVB (Television Broadcasts Limited), the largest free-to-air television station in Hong Kong. It can also refer to mainstream media in general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生仔好少睇大台㗎啦，多數睇網上平台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 hou2 siu2 tai2 daai6 toi4 gaa3 laa1, do1 sou3 tai2 mong5 soeng6 ping4 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的年轻人们很少看主流电视台了，大多数看网络平台。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young people rarely watch mainstream television, they mostly watch online platforms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢離開咗大台之後，就去咗拍電影。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lei4 hoi1 zo2 daai6 toi4 zi1 hau6, zau6 heoi3 zo2 paak3 din6 ying2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他离开了电视台之后，就去拍电影了。
examples.english_sentence: After he left the TV station, he went to make movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人成日話大台嘅劇集質素下降咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 daai6 toi4 ge3 kek6 zaap6 zat1 so3 haa6 gong3 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们总是说电视台的电视剧质量下降了很多。
examples.english_sentence: People always say the quality of TV station dramas has dropped a lot.

english_meaning: to eat and drink extravagantly; to feast; to binge
explanation_mandarin: 指大量地吃喝，通常带有挥霍或放纵的意味。
explanation_english: To eat and drink in large quantities, often implying extravagance or indulgence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後，日日都去大吃大喝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat6 dou1 heoi3 daai6 hek3 daai6 hot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财之后，每天都去大吃大喝。
examples.english_sentence: After he got rich, he went to eat and drink extravagantly every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋贏咗比賽，今晚去大吃大喝慶祝下！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3, gam1 maan1 heoi3 daai6 hek3 daai6 hot3 hing3 zuk1 haa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们赢了比赛，今晚去大吃大喝庆祝一下！
examples.english_sentence: We won the game, let's go out for a feast tonight to celebrate!

english_meaning: group photo
explanation_mandarin: 指很多人在一起照的照片，通常用于纪念活动、毕业典礼等。
explanation_english: A photograph of a large group of people, often taken to commemorate an event, graduation ceremony, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畢業嗰陣，我哋影咗張大合照。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bat1 jip6 go2 zan6, ngo5 dei6 ying2 zo2 zoeng1 daai6 hap6 ziu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 毕业的时候，我们照了一张集体照。
examples.english_sentence: We took a group photo at graduation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等陣大家一齊影張大合照留念啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 zan6 daai6 gaa1 yat1 cai4 ying2 zoeng1 daai6 hap6 ziu3 lau4 nim6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 待会儿大家一起照张集体照留个纪念吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's take a group photo together later to remember this.

english_meaning: Good luck and prosperity; auspicious; said to avoid bad luck
explanation_mandarin: 一种趋吉避凶的说法，通常在提到一些不吉利的事情后说，以求化解。表示希望事情往好的方向发展，图个吉利。
explanation_english: An expression used to ward off bad luck or misfortune. It's typically said after mentioning something unlucky or unpleasant, with the intention of turning things around for the better and hoping for good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先我唔小心打爛咗個碗，大吉利事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 daa2 laan6 zo2 go3 wun2, daai6 gat1 lei6 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才我不小心打碎了一个碗，大吉大利！
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally broke a bowl just now, good luck to us! (May good things happen!)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講，大吉利事，可能聽日會好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2, daai6 gat1 lei6 si6, ho2 nang4 ting1 jat6 wui5 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说，好意头，可能明天会更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, good luck! Maybe things will be better tomorrow.

english_meaning: Great luck and prosperity (said to counteract bad luck when speaking of something unlucky)
explanation_mandarin: 在说了一些不吉利的话之后，为了冲淡或消除不吉利的影响而说的吉祥话，表示逢凶化吉，遇难成祥。
explanation_english: An auspicious phrase used to ward off bad luck after saying something unlucky, similar to "knock on wood" or saying "touch wood" in English. It is meant to turn bad luck into good luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，部車撞到咁，大吉利是，應該冇人受傷嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, bou6 ce1 zong6 dou3 gam2, daai6 gat1 lei6 si6, ying1 goi1 mou5 yan4 sau6 seung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，车撞成这样，大吉大利，应该没有人受伤吧。
examples.english_sentence: Wow, the car crashed like that, knock on wood, hopefully no one was hurt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢尋日病到死死下，大吉利是，今日就生龍活虎咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cam4 jat6 beng6 dou3 sei2 sei2 haa5, daai6 gat1 lei6 si6, gam1 jat6 zau6 sang1 lung4 wut6 fu2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天病得要死，大吉大利，今天就生龙活虎的。
examples.english_sentence: He was nearly dead from sickness yesterday, touch wood, today he's full of energy.

english_meaning: Great fortune and great profit; good luck and prosperity.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常吉利顺利，一切都很好。
explanation_english: An idiom used to wish someone great luck, fortune, and prosperity. It implies everything is going well and bringing positive outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年快樂！祝你哋大吉大利！
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 faai3 lok6! zuk1 nei5 dei6 daai6 gat1 daai6 lei6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年快乐！祝你们大吉大利！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year! Wishing you great fortune and prosperity!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買張彩票，希望可以大吉大利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 zoeng1 coi2 piu3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 daai6 gat1 daai6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买张彩票，希望可以大吉大利。
examples.english_sentence: Buying a lottery ticket, hoping to have great luck and prosperity.

english_meaning: Great Harmony; Utopia; Ideal Society
explanation_mandarin: 指一种理想的社会状态，社会和谐，人人平等，没有剥削和压迫。
explanation_english: Refers to an ideal social state where society is harmonious, everyone is equal, and there is no exploitation or oppression. Often used to describe a utopian society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 實現世界大同係好多人嘅理想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat6 hin6 sai3 gaai3 daai6 tung4 hai6 hou2 do1 jan4 ge3 lei5 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 实现世界大同是很多人的理想。
examples.english_sentence: Achieving global harmony is the ideal of many people.

english_meaning: Similar in general outline but different in minor details; substantially the same but with minor differences; much the same
explanation_mandarin: 整体上基本相同，只有在细节上略有差异。
explanation_english: Generally similar, with only minor differences in details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩個設計嘅概念大同小異，不過顏色配搭就唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 go3 sat3 gai3 ge3 gai3 nim6 daai6 tung4 siu2 ji6, bat1 gwo3 ngaan4 sik1 pui3 daap3 zau6 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两个设计的概念大同小异，不过颜色搭配不同。
examples.english_sentence: The concepts of these two designs are much the same, but the color schemes are different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個人嘅意見大同小異，都係想搞好呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3 daai6 tung4 siu2 ji6, dou1 hai6 soeng2 gaau2 hou2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的意见大同小异，都是想把这件事做好。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions are substantially the same; they both want to get this thing done well.

english_meaning: honorable name; famous name
explanation_mandarin: 敬辞，称呼对方的名字。
explanation_english: A respectful term used to inquire about someone's name or to refer to someone's famous name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知你貴姓大名呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 nei5 gwai3 sing3 daai6 ming4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道您贵姓大名呢？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask your honorable name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 久仰大名，今日終於有機會見到你喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau2 joeng2 daai6 ming4, gam1 jat6 zung1 jyu1 jau5 gei1 wui2 gin3 dou2 nei5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 久仰大名，今天终于有机会见到你了。
