examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然後生，但係處理起事上嚟就好有大將之風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 hau6 saang1, daan6 hai6 cyu5 lei5 hei2 si6 soeng6 lei4 zau6 hou2 jau5 daai6 zoeng3 zi1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然年轻，但是处理起事情来就很有大将风度。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is young, he handles things with the air of a great general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個運動員喺比賽入面表現得好冷靜，真係有大將之風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wan6 dung6 jyun4 hai2 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 biu2 hin3 dak1 hou2 laang5 zing6, zan1 hai6 jau5 daai6 zoeng3 zi1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个运动员在比赛中表现得很冷静，真是有大将风度。
examples.english_sentence: This athlete performed very calmly in the competition, truly possessing the air of a great general.

english_meaning: Post-secondary education (e.g., colleges, vocational schools); higher education (excluding universities); diploma course
explanation_mandarin: 指高等教育中，大学以外的学院、专科学校等。通常指提供文凭或副学士学位课程的教育机构。
explanation_english: Refers to post-secondary educational institutions other than universities, such as colleges and vocational schools. It typically refers to institutions offering diploma or associate degree programs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀完中學就去咗讀大專。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 jyun4 zung1 hok6 zau6 heoi3 zo2 duk6 daai6 zyun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中学毕业后就去读大专了。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing secondary school, he went to study at a post-secondary college.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多大專院校提供唔同嘅課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 zyun1 jyun2 haau6 cung4 cung1 ge3 fo3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多大专院校提供不同的课程。
examples.english_sentence: There are many post-secondary institutions in Hong Kong that offer different courses.

english_meaning: post-secondary student, college student
explanation_mandarin: 指在高等专科学校（简称大专）学习的学生。
explanation_english: Refers to students studying in post-secondary colleges or vocational institutes, typically those offering associate degrees or diplomas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱升做大專生，讀緊工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sing1 zou6 daai6 zyun1 sang1, duk6 gan2 gung1 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚升为大专生，正在读工程专业。
examples.english_sentence: He just became a college student and is studying engineering.

english_meaning: size; large and small; adults and children; to judge someone based on appearance (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 表示尺寸，大的和小的；也可指成年人和儿童；作为俚语，指以貌取人。
explanation_english: Refers to size, both large and small. It can also refer to adults and children. As slang, it means to judge someone based on their appearance or status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫有唔同大小嘅碼數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 jau5 m4 tung4 daai6 siu2 ge3 maa5 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服有不同大小的码数。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt comes in different sizes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好大小超人，睇下人哋嘅能力先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai6 siu2 ciu1 jan4, tai2 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 nang4 lik6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以貌取人，先看看别人的能力吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge people based on appearance, look at their abilities first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企大小平安就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei1 daai6 siu2 ping4 on1 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 全家大小平安就好了。
examples.english_sentence: It's good enough if the whole family, young and old, are safe and sound.

english_meaning: urination and defecation; bowel and bladder movements; excretion
explanation_mandarin: 指排泄的大小便，即尿液和粪便。
explanation_english: Refers to urination and defecation, i.e., urine and feces. A formal and polite way of referring to bodily waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆年紀大，行唔到去廁所，所以要喺床上解決大小二便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 nin4 gei2 daai6, hang4 m4 dou2 heoi3 ci3 so2, so2 ji5 jiu3 hai2 chong4 so2 gaai2 kyut3 daai6 siu2 ji6 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶年纪大了，走不到厕所，所以要在床上解决大小便。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is old and can't walk to the toilet, so she has to relieve herself in bed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生問我大小二便嘅情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 man6 ngo5 daai6 siu2 ji6 bin6 ge3 ching4 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生问我大小便的情况。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor asked me about my bowel and bladder movements.

english_meaning: urination and defecation; bodily waste
explanation_mandarin: 指排泄的大小便，即尿液和粪便。
explanation_english: Refers to the excretion of urine and feces; bodily waste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個細路仔學緊自己去廁所，但係仲控制唔到大小便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 hok6 gan2 zi6 gei2 heoi3 ci3 so2, daan6 hai6 zung6 hung3 zai3 m4 dou2 daai6 siu2 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩正在学习自己去厕所，但是还控制不了大小便。
examples.english_sentence: That child is learning to go to the toilet by himself, but he still can't control his bowel and bladder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院會記錄病人每日嘅大小便情況。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 yun2 wui5 gei3 luk6 beng6 yan4 mui5 jat6 ge3 daai6 siu2 bin6 cing4 kwong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院会记录病人每天的大小便情况。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital will record the patient's daily urination and defecation situation.

english_meaning: Same price for adults and children; one price fits all
explanation_mandarin: 指成年人和儿童的价格相同，没有区别对待。通常用于交通、娱乐场所等，表示不因年龄而有不同的收费标准。
explanation_english: Refers to the same price for both adults and children. It indicates that there is no price difference based on age, often used in transportation, entertainment venues, etc., meaning that there are no different charges based on age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班船大小同價，每位都係一百蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 syun4 daai6 siu2 tung4 gaa3, mui5 wai2 dou1 hai6 jat1 baak3 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这班船大小一个价，每位都是一百块。
examples.english_sentence: This ferry charges the same price for adults and children, $100 per person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間戲院今日做特價，大小同價，快啲去買飛啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hei3 yun2 gam1 jat6 zou6 dak6 gaa3, daai6 siu2 tung4 gaa3, faai3 di1 heoi3 maai5 fei1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家电影院今天搞特价，大小一个价，快点去买票吧！
examples.english_sentence: The cinema has a special offer today, same price for adults and children, go buy tickets quickly!

english_meaning: Young lady; Miss (often implying spoiled or pampered); Eldest daughter
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭中地位尊贵的年轻女性，通常是富裕家庭的女儿。有时带有娇生惯养、不谙世事的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman of high status in a family, typically the daughter of a wealthy family. Sometimes carries the connotation of being spoiled, pampered, or naive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係李生嘅大小姐，梗係唔使做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lei5 saang1 ge3 daai6 siu2 je2, gang2 hai6 m4 sai2 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是李先生的大小姐，当然不用工作啦。
examples.english_sentence: She's Mr. Lee's eldest daughter, of course she doesn't need to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大小姐脾氣啦，自己嘢自己做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 siu2 je2 pei4 hei3 laa1, zi6 gei2 je5 zi6 gei2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么大小姐脾气了，自己的事情自己做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a spoiled miss, do your own things yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就俾人當大小姐咁湊大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 bei2 jan4 dong3 daai6 siu2 je2 gam3 cau3 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她从小就被当成大小姐一样养大。
examples.english_sentence: She was raised like a spoiled miss since she was little.

english_meaning: Takes all; to eat everything, both big and small; to be undiscriminating
explanation_mandarin: 指什么都想要，不挑剔，大小利益都占有。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who wants everything, is not picky, and takes all the benefits, both large and small. Can also imply greed or lack of principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個老闆真係大小通吃，咩錢都賺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou5 baan2 zan1 hai6 daai6 siu2 tung1 hek3, me1 chin2 dou1 jaan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个老板真是大小通吃，什么钱都赚。
examples.english_sentence: This boss really takes all, making money from everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都大小通吃，做人冇底線㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 daai6 siu2 tung1 hek3, zou6 yan4 mou5 dai2 sin3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都大小通吃，做人没有底线啊。
examples.english_sentence: He takes everything, both big and small; he has no bottom line in his behavior.

english_meaning: To win over people of all ages and social classes; to appeal to everyone; a clean sweep
explanation_mandarin: 指无论年龄大小、社会阶层高低的人都能被某种事物或人所吸引、征服。形容其受欢迎程度极高，影响力广泛。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone that can attract and win over people of all ages and social classes. It emphasizes a high degree of popularity and widespread influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影真係大小通殺，個個都話好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 zan1 hai6 daai6 siu2 tung1 saat3, go3 go3 dou1 waa6 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真是大小通吃，每个人都说好看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie really appeals to everyone, young and old. Everyone says it's good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲歌大小通殺，好多唔同年紀嘅人都鍾意聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 go1 daai6 siu2 tung1 saat3, hou2 do1 m4 tung4 nin4 gei2 ge3 jan4 dou1 zung1 ji3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的歌大小通吃，很多不同年龄的人都喜欢听。
examples.english_sentence: His songs appeal to everyone, and many people of different ages like to listen to them.

english_meaning: Young master; Eldest son (in a wealthy family); A spoiled brat (often from a rich family)
explanation_mandarin: 指富裕家庭中的长子，通常带有被娇生惯养的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to the eldest son in a wealthy family, often implying that he is spoiled and entitled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企咁有錢，佢咪係個大少囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 gam3 jau5 cin2, keoi5 mai6 hai6 go3 daai6 siu2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家那么有钱，他不就是个大少爷嘛。
examples.english_sentence: His family is so rich, isn't he just a young master?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大少脾氣啦，自己嘢自己做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 siu2 pei4 hei3 laa1, zi6 gei2 je5 zi6 gei2 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么少爷脾气，自己的事情自己做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a spoiled brat, do your own things yourself.

english_meaning: young master; pampered son; spoiled brat (used sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭富有，从小娇生惯养的年轻男子。
explanation_english: Refers to a young man from a wealthy family who is pampered and spoiled. Often used sarcastically to describe someone who is arrogant, lazy, and expects to be served.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都唔識做，真係一個大少爺咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 siu2 je4 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不会做，真是一个大少爷的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know how to do anything, he's really like a young master.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大少爺啦，自己執拾下啲嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 siu2 je4 laa1, zi6 gei2 zap1 sap1 haa5 di1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大少爷了，自己收拾一下东西吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a spoiled brat, clean up your things yourself.

english_meaning: overall situation; the big picture; general situation
explanation_mandarin: 指整体的、全局性的形势或局面。
explanation_english: Refers to the overall and comprehensive situation or state of affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要以大局為重，唔好因為啲小事而爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ji5 daai6 guk6 wai4 cung5, m4 hou2 jan1 wai6 di1 siu2 si6 ji4 zaang1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要以大局为重，不要因为一些小事而争吵。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prioritize the big picture and not argue over trivial matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事關係到公司嘅大局，你一定要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gwaan1 hai6 dou3 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 guk6, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 cyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事关系到公司的整体利益，你一定要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: This matter concerns the company's overall situation, you must handle it carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺大局面前，個人嘅得失唔重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daai6 guk6 min6 cin4, go3 yan4 ge3 dak1 sat1 m4 cung5 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大局面前，个人的得失并不重要。
examples.english_sentence: In the face of the overall situation, personal gains and losses are not important.

synonyms: 整體情況 (zung2 tai2 cing4 kwong3)

english_meaning: The situation is set; the overall situation is decided; it's a done deal.
explanation_mandarin: 指整个形势已经确定，无法改变。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where the overall outcome is already decided and unchangeable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽佢哋贏硬，大局已定喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dei6 wing4 ngaang6, daai6 guk6 ji5 ding6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛他们赢定了，大局已定了。
examples.english_sentence: They are sure to win this competition; the outcome is already decided.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 投票結果都出咗，大局已定，算數啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 piu3 git3 gwo2 dou1 ceot1 zo2, daai6 guk6 ji5 ding6, syun3 sou3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 投票结果都出来了，大势已定，算了吧。
examples.english_sentence: The voting results are out; it's a done deal, let it be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁有錢，贏呢單生意大局已定啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 jau5 cin2, wing4 ni1 daan1 seng1 ji3 daai6 guk6 ji5 ding6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么有钱，赢得这单生意是大势已定了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so rich, it's a done deal that he'll win this business deal.

english_meaning: to fully display one's abilities; to go all out; to give full play to one's talents
explanation_mandarin: 比喻充分施展自己的才能和本领。
explanation_english: To fully demonstrate one's abilities and skills; to have the opportunity to show what one can do; to make full use of one's talents and abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司畀咗個新project佢，等佢可以大展拳腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 bei2 zo2 go3 san1 project keoi5, dang2 keoi5 ho2 ji5 daai6 zin2 kyun4 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司给了他一个新项目，让他可以大显身手。
examples.english_sentence: The company gave him a new project so he could fully display his abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺新公司終於可以大展拳腳，實現佢嘅抱負啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 san1 gung1 si1 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 daai6 zin2 kyun4 goek3, sat6 hin6 keoi5 ge3 pou5 fu3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他终于可以在新公司大显身手，实现他的抱负了。
examples.english_sentence: He can finally give full play to his talents in the new company and realize his ambition.

english_meaning: to fully display one's skill; to show one's prowess; to have a chance to show off one's abilities
explanation_mandarin: 充分展现自己的才能和技能。
explanation_english: To fully demonstrate one's talents and skills; to have the opportunity to showcase one's abilities and expertise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅比賽，佢終於可以大展身手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 bei2 coi3, keoi5 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 daai6 zin2 san1 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的比赛，他终于可以大显身手了。
examples.english_sentence: In this competition, he can finally show off his skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 俾個機會佢大展身手啦，佢好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 go3 gei1 wui6 keoi5 daai6 zin2 san1 sau2 laa1, keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给他一个机会让他大显身手吧，他很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: Give him a chance to show his skills, he is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺廚藝比賽上面大展身手，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cyu4 ngai6 bei2 coi3 soeng6 min6 daai6 zin2 san1 sau2, lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在厨艺比赛上面大显身手，拿了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He showed his skills in the culinary competition and won the championship.

mandarin_meaning: 大展宏图 (dà zhǎn hóng tú)
english_meaning: To realize great ambitions; to have a bright future; to go from strength to strength
explanation_mandarin: 比喻大规模地实施宏伟的计划或抱负，取得巨大的成就。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to fully develop one's grand plans or ambitions, leading to significant achievements and a prosperous future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新一年大展鴻圖，步步高陞！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 jat1 nin4 daai6 zin2 hung4 tou4, bou6 bou6 gou1 sing1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新的一年大展宏图，步步高升！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you great success and continuous promotions in the new year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司今年準備大展鴻圖，擴展業務去海外。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 zeon2 bei6 daai6 zin2 hung4 tou4, kwok3 zin2 jip6 mou6 heoi3 hoi2 ngoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司今年准备大展宏图，拓展业务到海外。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is planning to expand their business overseas this year, aiming for great success.

mandarin_meaning: 乡下女人，土里土气的人
english_meaning: Country bumpkin, unsophisticated woman
explanation_mandarin: 指来自乡下，不时尚，打扮土气，见识少，不太懂城市生活和潮流的女性。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who comes from the countryside, is unfashionable, dresses in a rustic way, has little knowledge, and doesn't understand urban life and trends. It has a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著到咁樣，成個大山婆咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 gam2 joeng2, seng4 go3 daai6 saan1 po4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿成这样，像个乡下女人一样。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed like that, looking like a country bumpkin.

english_meaning: Lantau Island
explanation_mandarin: 香港最大的岛屿，位于香港西部。
explanation_english: The largest island in Hong Kong, located in the western part of Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去大嶼山行山呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 daai6 jyu4 saan1 haang4 saan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去大屿山爬山吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go hiking on Lantau Island tomorrow.

english_meaning: a big difference; a significant disparity; a wide gap
explanation_mandarin: 形容差别非常大，差异显著。
explanation_english: Describes a very large difference or significant disparity between two or more things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅表現大差呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 biu2 hin3 daai6 caa1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的表现差别很大啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's a big difference in the performance of the two of them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試，我同佢嘅分數大差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3, ngo5 tung4 keoi5 ge3 fan1 sou3 daai6 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试，我和他的分数差别很大。
examples.english_sentence: This time in the exam, there's a big difference between my score and his score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩間公司嘅規模大差，冇得比㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kwai1 mou4 daai6 caa1, mou5 dak1 bei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两家公司的规模差别很大，没法比的。
examples.english_sentence: The scales of the two companies are vastly different; there's no comparison.

english_meaning: A lot; very big; a great deal; in large quantities
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多或者东西很大，程度很高，通常是口语用法，略带夸张的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity or something very big. It's a colloquial expression, often used with a slight exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日買咗大巴大巴嘅嘢食返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 daai6 baa1 daai6 baa1 ge3 je5 sik6 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天买了很多很多的食物回家。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a whole lot of food and brought it home today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋大巴大巴，夠晒住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 daai6 baa1 daai6 baa1, gau3 saai3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房子很大很大，足够住了。
examples.english_sentence: The house is really big, enough to live in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢大巴大巴，唔使咁認真嘅。

english_meaning: general market (referring to the stock market as a whole)
explanation_mandarin: 指股票市场的整体情况，例如整体的上涨或下跌趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to the overall condition of the stock market, such as the general upward or downward trend.

examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 daai6 si5 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1 aa3!

examples.english_sentence: The general market went up a lot today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要睇清楚大市先決定買邊隻股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 tai2 cing1 chu2 daai6 si5 sin1 kyut3 ding6 maai5 bin1 zek3 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要看清楚大盘再决定买哪只股票。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clearly observe the general market before deciding which stock to buy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近排大市都幾波動，要小心啲。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近大盘挺波动的，要小心些。
examples.english_sentence: The general market has been quite volatile recently, so be careful.

mandarin_meaning: 皇帝; 形容某人在某领域非常厉害
english_meaning: Emperor; (slang) someone who is exceptionally good or dominant in a particular field
explanation_mandarin: 原指皇帝。在粤语口语中，也用于形容某人在某个领域或方面非常厉害、具有统治地位的人。
explanation_english: Originally referring to an Emperor. In Cantonese colloquial language, it's also used to describe someone who is extremely good or dominant in a particular field or aspect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺籃球界簡直係大帝咁滯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 laam4 kau4 gaai3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 daai6 dai3 gam2 zai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在篮球界简直就像皇帝一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's practically an emperor in the basketball world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋老細成日都擺款，好似自己係大帝咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 baai2 fun2, hou2 ci5 zi6 gei2 hai6 daai6 dai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们老板总是摆架子，好像自己是皇帝一样。
examples.english_sentence: Our boss always acts high and mighty, as if he's an emperor.

english_meaning: master; great master; expert
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域有很高成就和声望的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has achieved high accomplishments and prestige in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係詠春嘅一代大師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wing6 ceon1 ge3 jat1 dai6 daai6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是咏春的一代大师。
examples.english_sentence: He is a grandmaster of Wing Chun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李小龍係功夫電影嘅大師級人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 siu2 lung4 hai6 gung1 fu1 din6 ying2 ge3 daai6 si1 kap1 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李小龙是功夫电影的大师级人物。
examples.english_sentence: Bruce Lee is a master figure in kung fu movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位畫家俾人稱為水墨畫大師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 waa2 gaa1 bei2 jan4 cing1 wai4 seoi2 mak6 waa2 daai6 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位画家被人称为水墨画大师。
examples.english_sentence: This painter is known as a master of ink painting.

english_meaning: Tai Mo Shan (the highest mountain in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港最高的山峰，位于新界中部。
explanation_english: Tai Mo Shan is the highest mountain in Hong Kong, located in the central New Territories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日想去大帽山行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 soeng2 heoi3 daai6 mou2 saan1 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天想去大帽山爬山。
examples.english_sentence: We want to go hiking on Tai Mo Shan tomorrow.

english_meaning: Substantially; significantly; considerably
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，幅度很大。
explanation_english: Indicates a significant or substantial degree or extent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅營業額大幅上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 ying4 jip6 ngok6 daai6 fuk1 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的营业额大幅上升。
examples.english_sentence: This year's turnover has increased substantially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府宣布大幅削減開支。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 daai6 fuk1 sak1 gaan2 hoi1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府宣布大幅削减开支。
examples.english_sentence: The government announced a significant reduction in spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅健康狀況大幅改善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gin6 hong1 zong6 fong3 daai6 fuk1 goi2 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的健康状况大幅改善。
examples.english_sentence: His health condition has improved considerably.

english_meaning: a large group; a large number
explanation_mandarin: 指很大的一群人或事物。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日有大幫遊客嚟咗香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau5 daai6 bong1 jau4 haak3 lai4 zo2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天有一大群游客来到了香港。
examples.english_sentence: A large group of tourists came to Hong Kong today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日佢請咗大幫朋友去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 keoi5 ceng2 zo2 daai6 bong1 pang4 jau5 heoi3 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天他请了一大群朋友去喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: Yesterday, he invited a large group of friends for drinks.

english_meaning: Clearance sale, bargain sale, huge discount
explanation_mandarin: 指大规模的降价促销活动。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale price reduction promotion, a clearance sale where items are sold at very low prices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭而家大平賣，快啲去睇下有冇啱你嘅嘢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou1 tau2 ji4 gaa1 daai6 ping4 maai6, faai3 di1 heoi3 tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 ngaam1 nei5 ge3 je5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家店现在大甩卖，快去看看有没有适合你的东西吧！
examples.english_sentence: That shop is having a clearance sale now, go quickly and see if there's anything you like!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗清貨，佢哋決定將啲衫褲大平賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 cing1 fo3, keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 di1 saam1 fu3 daai6 ping4 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了清仓，他们决定把衣服裤子大甩卖。
examples.english_sentence: In order to clear their stock, they decided to have a clearance sale on the clothes.

english_meaning: The first day of the Lunar New Year
explanation_mandarin: 农历新年的第一天，是华人最重要的传统节日之一。
explanation_english: The first day of the Lunar New Year, one of the most important traditional holidays for Chinese people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大年初一要着新衫拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 nin4 co1 jat1 jiu3 zoek3 san1 saam1 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 正月初一要穿新衣服拜年。
examples.english_sentence: On the first day of Lunar New Year, you should wear new clothes and pay New Year visits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅大年初一啱啱好係星期六。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 daai6 nin4 co1 jat1 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 hai6 sing1 kei4 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的正月初一刚好是星期六。
examples.english_sentence: The first day of Lunar New Year this year happens to be on a Saturday.

mandarin_meaning: 大大地开玩笑; 捉弄; 恶作剧
english_meaning: to play a big joke; to prank; to tease severely
explanation_mandarin: 指开玩笑开得很大，甚至到了捉弄或恶作剧的程度。 通常带有负面含义，表示玩笑开过了头，可能会引起对方的不愉快或不适。
explanation_english: Refers to playing a joke that is significant or excessive, to the point of pranking or teasing severely. Usually carries a negative connotation, suggesting the joke has gone too far and may cause displeasure or discomfort to the other person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好大幽人哋啦，佢嬲㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 daai6 jau1 jan4 dei6 laa1, keoi5 nau1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要捉弄人家了，他生气了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't tease him so severely, he's getting angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大幽啲同事，搞到人人都唔鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 jau1 di1 tung4 si6, gaau2 dou3 jan4 jan4 dou1 m4 zung1 yi3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是捉弄同事，导致每个人都不喜欢他。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays big jokes on his colleagues, causing everyone to dislike him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大幽啦，適可而止好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 jau1 laa1, sik1 ho2 ji4 zi2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要开这么大的玩笑啦，适可而止好些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't joke around so much, it's better to know when to stop.

english_meaning: double bed; large bed
explanation_mandarin: 指较大的床，通常可以睡两个人。
explanation_english: Refers to a large bed, usually big enough to sleep two people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋張大床好舒服㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 daai6 cong4 hou2 syu1 fuk6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的双人床很舒服的。
examples.english_sentence: Our double bed is very comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店房有張大床同埋張梳化床。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 fong2 jau5 zoeng1 daai6 cong4 tung4 mai4 zoeng1 so1 faa2 cong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个酒店房间有一张大床和一张沙发床。
examples.english_sentence: That hotel room has a double bed and a sofa bed.

english_meaning: in public; in broad daylight; in the presence of a crowd
explanation_mandarin: 指人很多的公共场合；当众。
explanation_english: Refers to a public place with many people; in public; openly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大庭廣眾之下畀人求婚，好surprise呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 zi1 haa6 bei2 jan4 kau4 fan1, hou2 seot1 praai1 si1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在众目睽睽之下被人求婚，好惊喜啊！
examples.english_sentence: She was proposed to in public, it was such a surprise!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺大庭廣眾鬧佢啦，畀啲面佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 nau6 keoi5 laa1, bei2 di1 min6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在公共场合骂他了，给他点面子吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't scold him in public, give him some face.

english_meaning: in public; in broad daylight; in front of everyone
explanation_mandarin: 指在公共场合，众目睽睽之下。
explanation_english: Refers to being in a public place, under the watchful eyes of the public; in front of everyone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺大庭廣衆度鬧交啦，好醜怪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 dou6 naau6 gaau1 laa1, hou2 cau2 gwaai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在大庭广众下吵架了，很丢人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't argue in public, it's embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大庭廣衆面前跪低求婚，真係好浪漫呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 ting4 gwong2 zung3 min6 cin4 gwai1 dai1 kau4 fan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 long4 maan6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大庭广众面前跪下求婚，真的很浪漫啊。
examples.english_sentence: He knelt down to propose in public, it's really romantic.

english_meaning: building, mansion, large building
explanation_mandarin: 指高大的建筑物，尤指多层或高层住宅或商业建筑。
explanation_english: Refers to a large building, especially a multi-story or high-rise residential or commercial building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋住喺嗰棟大廈嘅廿樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 go2 dung6 daai6 haa6 ge3 jaa6 sap6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们住在那个大楼的二十楼。
examples.english_sentence: We live on the 20th floor of that building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢座大廈嘅保安好好，出入都要拍卡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zo6 daai6 haa6 ge3 bou2 on1 hou2 hou2, ceot1 jap6 dou1 jiu3 paak3 kaat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座大楼的保安很好，进出都要刷卡。
examples.english_sentence: The security in this building is very good, you need to swipe a card to enter and exit.

english_meaning: Head chef, Master chef
explanation_mandarin: 指厨艺精湛、经验丰富的厨师，通常是厨房的领导者。
explanation_english: Refers to a chef with excellent cooking skills and rich experience, usually the leader of the kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店請咗個好出名嘅大廚嚟主理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 ceng2 zo2 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 daai6 cyu4 lai4 zyu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店请了一位很有名的大厨来主理。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel hired a very famous head chef to take charge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係成為一間五星級酒店嘅大廚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 gaan1 ng5 sing1 kap1 zau2 dim3 ge3 daai6 cyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是成为一家五星级酒店的厨师长。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to become the head chef of a five-star hotel.

mandarin_meaning: 大型庙宇; 重要人物
english_meaning: Large temple; Important figure/person (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指规模较大的寺庙。俚语用法指有权有势、影响巨大的人物。
explanation_english: Literally means 'large temple'. In slang usage, it refers to an important or influential figure, someone with power or authority.

examples.jyutping_sentence: wong4 daai6 sin1 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jat1 gaan1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 daai6 miu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 黄大仙是香港一间很有名的大庙。
examples.english_sentence: Wong Tai Sin is a very famous large temple in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺公司入面，佢係個大廟，咩都係佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 si1 jap6 min6, keoi5 hai6 go3 daai6 miu2, me1 dou1 hai6 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在公司里面，他是个重要人物，什么都是他说了算。
examples.english_sentence: In the company, he's a big shot, he has the final say on everything.

english_meaning: living room, lounge
explanation_mandarin: 指住宅里主要用来接待客人和日常起居的房间，通常摆放沙发、电视等家具。
explanation_english: The main room in a house or apartment where people relax and entertain guests. Typically furnished with sofas, a television, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺大廳睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 daai6 teng1 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在客厅看电视。
examples.english_sentence: We often watch TV in the living room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將啲嘢擺返入大廳啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 di1 je5 baai2 faan1 jap6 daai6 teng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你把那些东西放回客厅吧。
examples.english_sentence: Put those things back in the living room.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間屋個大廳好大㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 uk1 go3 daai6 teng1 hou2 daai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家的客厅很大。
examples.english_sentence: Their living room is very big.

english_meaning: on a grand scale; ostentatiously; with great fanfare; make a big show of
explanation_mandarin: 形容声势浩大，行动规模大，场面隆重。
explanation_english: Describes doing something in a very showy, ostentatious, or large-scale manner; to make a big display of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗慶祝公司成立十週年，大張旗鼓咁搞咗個晚會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 hing3 zuk1 gung1 si1 sing4 lap6 sap6 zau1 nin4, daai6 zoeng1 kei4 gu2 gam2 gaau2 zo2 go3 maan5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了庆祝公司成立十周年，他们大张旗鼓地举办了一个晚会。
examples.english_sentence: To celebrate the company's tenth anniversary, they organized a gala on a grand scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使大張旗鼓啦，簡單做咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daai6 zoeng1 kei4 gu2 laa1, gaan2 daan1 zou6 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用大张旗鼓了，简单做就行了。
examples.english_sentence: No need to make such a big fuss, just do it simply.

english_meaning: Barrister
explanation_mandarin: 在香港、英国等地，指有资格在高等法院出庭的律师。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong, the UK, and other common law jurisdictions, a barrister is a lawyer who is qualified to plead cases in the higher courts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想第日做大律師，幫人打官司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 dai6 jat6 zou6 daai6 leot6 si1, bong1 jan4 daa2 gun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想将来做大律师，帮人打官司。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to become a barrister in the future and help people litigate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大律師嘅袍好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 leot6 si1 ge3 pou4 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大律师的袍子很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The barrister's robe is very beautiful.

english_meaning: the day after tomorrow
explanation_mandarin: 指后天的后一天，也就是从今天算起的第三天。
explanation_english: Refers to the day after the day after tomorrow, which is the third day from today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大後日要去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 hau6 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大后天要去香港。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to Hong Kong the day after tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大後日就係星期五喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hau6 jat6 zau6 hai6 sing1 kei4 ng5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大后天就是星期五了。
examples.english_sentence: The day after tomorrow is Friday.

english_meaning: to have a complete awakening, to be completely enlightened, to see the light
explanation_mandarin: 指彻底明白事理，完全领悟。通常用于形容突然明白真相或错误。
explanation_english: Refers to a complete understanding of principles and a full realization of something. It is usually used to describe suddenly understanding the truth or an error.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經歷咗咁多挫折之後，先至大徹大悟，知道自己以前嘅諗法錯晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 lik6 zo2 gam3 do1 co3 zit3 zi1 hau6, sin1 zi3 daai6 cit3 daai6 ng6, zi1 dou3 zi6 gei2 ji5 cin4 ge3 lam2 faat3 co3晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经历了这么多挫折之后，才彻底醒悟，知道自己以前的想法都错了。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so many setbacks, he finally had a complete awakening and realized that his previous ideas were all wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇完呢本書，我好似大徹大悟咁，對人生有咗新嘅睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyun4 ni1 bun2 syu1, ngo5 hou2 ci5 daai6 cit3 daai6 ng6 gam3, deoi3 jan4 sang1 jau5 zo2 san1 ge3 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看完这本书，我好像彻底醒悟了一样，对人生有了新的看法。
examples.english_sentence: After reading this book, I felt like I had a complete awakening and gained a new perspective on life.

mandarin_meaning: 雄心壮志, 志向远大
english_meaning: Great ambition; lofty aspiration; high ideal
explanation_mandarin: 指远大的志向和抱负。
explanation_english: Refers to grand ambitions and aspirations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣就已經有大志，想改變世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 zau6 ji5 ging1 jau5 daai6 zi3, soeng2 goi2 bin3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候就已经有雄心壮志，想要改变世界。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he already had great ambitions and wanted to change the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年青人應該要立大志，為社會做貢獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 cing1 jan4 jing1 goi1 jiu3 lap6 daai6 zi3, wai6 se5 wui2 zou6 gung3 hiun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人应该树立远大的志向，为社会做贡献。
examples.english_sentence: Young people should set great ambitions and contribute to society.

english_meaning: busy person
explanation_mandarin: 非常忙碌的人。
explanation_english: A very busy person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近做緊project，真係一個大忙人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 zou6 gan2 project, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 mong4 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近在做一个项目，真是一个大忙人。
examples.english_sentence: He's working on a project lately, truly a busy person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思啊，我近排都係大忙人，遲啲再約你食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1 aa3, ngo5 gan6 paai4 dou1 hai6 daai6 mong4 jan4, chi4 di1 zoi3 joek3 nei5 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我最近都是个大忙人，晚点再约你吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I've been a busy person lately, let's schedule a dinner later.

english_meaning: to the great satisfaction of the people; highly satisfying; giving great pleasure
explanation_mandarin: 指坏人坏事受到惩罚或打击，使大家感到非常痛快。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where evildoers are punished or defeated, bringing great satisfaction and joy to the people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個貪官終於俾人拉咗，真係大快人心啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 taam1 gun1 zung1 jyu1 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, zan1 hai6 daai6 faai3 jan4 sam1 aa!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个贪官终于被抓了，真是大快人心啊！
examples.english_sentence: That corrupt official was finally arrested, it's really to the great satisfaction of the people!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇到佢哋公司破產，我真係覺得大快人心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 dou2 keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 po3 caan2, ngo5 zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 daai6 faai3 jan4 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他们公司破产，我真的觉得大快人心。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing their company go bankrupt, I really feel a sense of great satisfaction.

english_meaning: to eat heartily; to enjoy a delicious meal; to feast
explanation_mandarin: 形容痛快地吃东西，享用美食。朵颐：鼓动腮颊，即吃东西的样子。
explanation_english: Describes the act of eating with great relish and enjoyment, savoring delicious food. 朵颐 (doe2 ji4) refers to the movement of the cheeks while eating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食咁好味，梗係要大快朵頤啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gam3 hou2 mei6, gang2 hai6 jiu3 daai6 faai3 doe2 ji4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物这么好吃，当然要大饱口福了！
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is so delicious, of course we have to feast!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋難得嚟到呢度，一定要大快朵頤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 naan4 dak1 lai4 dou3 ni1 dou6, jat1 ding6 jiu3 daai6 faai3 doe2 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们难得来到这里，一定要好好享受美食。
examples.english_sentence: Since we rarely come here, we must enjoy a delicious meal.

english_meaning: Fairwood (fast food restaurant chain)
explanation_mandarin: 香港一家连锁快餐店的名称。
explanation_english: The name of a fast-food restaurant chain in Hong Kong. Also used colloquially to refer to getting inexpensive and quick meals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋去大快活食嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daai6 faai3 wut6 sik6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚我们去大家乐吃饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Fairwood for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想煮飯，求其喺大快活買個外賣算數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 zyu2 faan6, kau4 kei4 hai2 daai6 faai3 wut6 maai5 go3 ngoi6 maai6 syun3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想做饭，随便在大家乐买个外卖算了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to cook. I'll just buy takeout from Fairwood.

mandarin_meaning: 真情流露; 性情率真
english_meaning: Having a very emotional and expressive personality; Open and honest with one's feelings; To be someone who acts on their emotions.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人感情丰富，性格率真，喜怒哀乐都表现得很明显。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very emotional, frank, and expresses their feelings (joy, anger, sorrow, etc.) openly and honestly. They are not afraid to show their emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人大情大性，鍾意就鍾意，唔鍾意就唔鍾意，好直接嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 daai6 cing4 daai6 sing3, zung1 yi3 zau6 zung1 yi3, m4 zung1 yi3 zau6 m4 zung1 yi3, hou2 zi6 zip3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很真情流露，喜欢就喜欢，不喜欢就不喜欢，很直接。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very emotional and expressive. If they like something, they like it; if they don't, they don't. They're very direct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我欣賞佢大情大性，起碼佢唔會收收埋埋，有咩都講出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jan1 soeng2 keoi5 daai6 cing4 daai6 sing3, hei2 maa5 keoi5 m4 wui5 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4, jau5 me1 dou1 gong2 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我欣赏他很真情流露，至少他不会藏着掖着，有什么都说出来。
examples.english_sentence: I admire their emotional openness; at least they don't keep things bottled up. They say what's on their mind.

english_meaning: utterly bewildered, completely puzzled, extremely confused and unable to understand
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某事物或情况感到非常迷惑，完全无法理解。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being completely bewildered and unable to understand something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢點解會咁做，我真係大惑不解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dim2 gaai2 wui5 gam2 zou6, ngo5 zan1 hai6 daai6 waak6 bat1 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为什么会这样做，我真的非常不理解。
examples.english_sentence: I'm utterly bewildered as to why he would do that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個決定令我哋大惑不解，完全唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 kyut3 ding6 ling6 ngo5 dei6 daai6 waak6 bat1 gaai2, wun4 cyun4 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的决定让我们非常不理解，完全不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: His decision left us completely puzzled, we have no idea what he's thinking.

english_meaning: pipe dream, unrealistic expectation, fanciful idea, having grand but impractical ideas
explanation_mandarin: 指不切实际的，过于理想化的想法或期望。
explanation_english: Refers to unrealistic, overly idealistic ideas or expectations. It describes someone who has grandiose schemes or plans that are unlikely to succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都發大想頭，諗住唔使做就有錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 faat3 daai6 soeng2 tau4, lam2 zyu6 m4 sai2 zou6 zau6 jau5 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是异想天开，想着不用工作就有钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always has pipe dreams, thinking that he can get money without working.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大想頭啦，腳踏實地做好眼前嘅嘢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 soeng2 tau4 laa1, goek3 taap3 sat6 dei6 zou6 hou2 ngaan5 cin4 ge3 je5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么异想天开，脚踏实地做好眼前的事情先。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have such unrealistic expectations. First, do the things in front of you properly in a down-to-earth manner.

english_meaning: careless, negligent, inattentive
explanation_mandarin: 指粗心大意，不细心，疏忽。
explanation_english: Refers to being careless, inattentive, or negligent; lacking attention to detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以大意，一定要小心檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 daai6 ji3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以粗心大意，一定要小心检查。
examples.english_sentence: We can't be careless, we must check carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時大意，搞到成件事都錯晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 daai6 ji3, gaau2 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 dou1 co3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时疏忽，搞得整件事都错了。
examples.english_sentence: He was careless for a moment, and made the whole thing go wrong.

english_meaning: Universal love, unconditional love, great love, altruism
explanation_mandarin: 指博大的爱，无私的爱，超越个人情感的爱。通常指对人类，社会，弱势群体的关怀和奉献。
explanation_english: Refers to a broad and selfless love, a love that transcends personal feelings. It usually refers to the care and dedication towards humanity, society, and vulnerable groups.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅行為充滿咗大愛，所以好多人都好尊敬佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hang4 wai4 cung1 mun5 zo2 daai6 oi3, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 hou2 zyun1 ging3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为充满了大爱，所以很多人都很尊敬他。
examples.english_sentence: His actions are full of universal love, so many people respect him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該用大愛嘅精神去幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 yung6 daai6 oi3 ge3 jing1 san4 heoi3 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该用大爱的精神去帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should use the spirit of universal love to help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生嘅工作需要有大愛，先可以好好照顧病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 ge3 gung1 zok3 seoi1 jiu3 jau5 daai6 oi3, sin1 ho2 ji5 hou2 hou2 ziu3 gu3 beng6 yan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生的工作需要有大爱，才可以好好照顾病人。
examples.english_sentence: A doctor's job requires great love to be able to take good care of patients.

english_meaning: absent-minded, scatterbrained, dopey, clueless, silly
explanation_mandarin: 形容人迷糊，不精明，容易犯傻。 指一个人反应慢，经常犯一些低级错误，或者容易被骗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is absent-minded, scatterbrained, not very smart, and prone to making silly mistakes. It implies that the person is slow to react, often makes basic errors, or is easily deceived.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好大懵㗎，成日唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daai6 mung2 gaa3, sing4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很糊涂，经常忘记带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: He's a really absent-minded person, he often forgets to bring his keys.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大懵啦，呢啲咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 mung2 laa1, ni1 di1 gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么糊涂了，这些这么简单的事情都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clueless, you can't even do these simple things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁大懵啦，俾人呃咗都唔知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 daai6 mung2 laa1, bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻了，被人骗了都不知道！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so silly, you wouldn't even know if you were being scammed!

english_meaning: scatterbrain, absent-minded person, ditz, silly person
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常健忘、迷糊、傻气，经常犯低级错误。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very forgetful, absent-minded, and silly, often making basic mistakes. It's a somewhat playful and teasing term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日唔記得帶鎖匙，真係大懵鬼嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4, zan1 hai6 daai6 mung2 gwai2 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你总是忘记带钥匙，真是个糊涂鬼。
examples.english_sentence: You always forget to bring your keys, you're such a scatterbrain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大懵鬼啦，下次記得帶齊文件啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 mung2 gwai2 laa1, haa6 ci3 gei3 dak1 daai3 cai4 man4 gin2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么糊涂了，下次记得带齐文件啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a ditz, remember to bring all the documents next time.

english_meaning: A lazy person commands another lazy person; One lazy person instructing another lazy person, resulting in further inefficiency.
explanation_mandarin: 形容懒人只会指使更懒的人做事，结果效率更低。强调的是懒惰造成的恶性循环。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a lazy person only orders even lazier people to do things, resulting in even lower efficiency. It emphasizes the vicious cycle caused by laziness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪諗住叫阿明幫手啦，佢都係大懶使二懶㗎，你叫佢做嘢不如自己做仲快啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 nam2 zyu2 giu3 aa3 ming4 bong1 sau2 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 daai6 laan5 sai2 ji6 laan5 gaa3, nei5 giu3 keoi5 zou6 je5 bat1 jyu4 zi6 gei2 zou6 zung1 faai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着叫阿明帮忙了，他也是懒人指使懒人，你让他做事不如自己做还快呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about asking Ah Ming for help, he's just a lazy person commanding another lazy person. It's faster to do it yourself than to ask him to do it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲嘢咁慢嘅，都係大懶使二懶，冇人肯認真做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 je5 gam3 maan6 ge3, dou1 hai6 daai6 laan5 sai2 ji6 laan5, mou5 jan4 hang2 jing6 zan1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的事情这么慢，都是懒人指使懒人，没人肯认真做。
examples.english_sentence: Things are so slow at this company, it's all just a case of lazy people commanding lazy people, no one wants to work seriously.

english_meaning: extremely lazy person; sluggard
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常懒惰的人，像一条懒惰的蛇一样。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely lazy, like a lazy snake. Often used playfully or in mild reprimand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你成日攤喺度，真係一條大懶蛇咁！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing4 jat6 taan1 hai2 dou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 daai6 laan5 se4 gam2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你整天躺在那儿，真是一条大懒蛇一样！
examples.english_sentence: You're always lying around, you're really like a big lazy snake!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做大懶蛇啦，起身幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 daai6 laan5 se4 laa1, hei2 san1 bong1 saa2 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做懒鬼了，起来帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a lazybones, get up and give a hand.

english_meaning: Great battle; major battle; fierce fight
explanation_mandarin: 指大规模的战斗或竞争。可以指军事上的战争，也可以指其他领域激烈的竞争。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale battle or competition. It can refer to military warfare or fierce competition in other fields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有場波，皇馬對巴塞，一定係一場大戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 coeng4 bo1, wong4 maa5 deoi3 baa1 sai3, jat1 ding6 hai6 jat1 coeng4 daai6 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有一场球赛，皇马对巴萨，肯定是一场大战。
examples.english_sentence: There's a football match tonight, Real Madrid versus Barcelona, it's definitely going to be a great battle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個為咗個升職機會，展開咗一場大戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 wai4 zo2 go3 sing1 jik1 gei1 wui6, zin2 hoi1 zo2 jat1 coeng4 daai6 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个为了升职的机会，展开了一场大战。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them launched a major battle for the promotion opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同啲蚊仔大戰咗成晚，都係訓唔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 di1 man1 zai2 daai6 zin3 zo2 seng4 maan5, dou1 hai6 fan3 m4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和蚊子大战了一晚上，还是睡不着。
examples.english_sentence: I fought a major battle with the mosquitoes all night and still couldn't fall asleep.

english_meaning: traditional Chinese opera; Cantonese opera
explanation_mandarin: 指传统中国戏曲，尤其是粤剧。
explanation_english: Refers to traditional Chinese opera, especially Cantonese opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆好鍾意睇大戲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 daai6 hei3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶很喜欢看戏曲。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma loves to watch Cantonese opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅大戲表演好精彩啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 daai6 hei3 biu2 jin2 hou2 zing1 coi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的戏曲表演很精彩啊！
examples.english_sentence: This year's Cantonese opera performance is amazing!

english_meaning: big client; wealthy person; big spender
explanation_mandarin: 指消费能力强或交易量大的顾客；也指有钱有势的人家。
explanation_english: Refers to a customer with strong spending power or a large transaction volume; also refers to a wealthy and influential family or person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我哋公司嘅大戶嚟㗎，對佢好啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 wu6 lei4 gaa3, deoi3 keoi5 hou2 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我们公司的大客户，对他好一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: He is a big client of our company, so be nice to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企係呢區嘅大戶，好有錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei1 hai6 ni1 khu1 ge3 daai6 wu6, hou2 jau5 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家是这一带的有钱人，很有钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is a wealthy family in this area, they are very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市大戶經常影響市場走勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 daai6 wu6 ging1 seong4 jing2 hoeng2 si5 coeng4 zau2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市大户经常影响市场走势。
examples.english_sentence: Big players in the stock market often influence market trends.

mandarin_meaning: 大客户, 大玩家, 大户人家
english_meaning: Big client, big player, wealthy family, influential family
explanation_mandarin: 指资金雄厚，交易量大的客户或投资者。也指家境富裕、有权势的人家。
explanation_english: Refers to a client or investor with substantial capital and large trading volumes. It can also refer to a wealthy and influential family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係股市嘅大戶，一買一賣都影響到個市。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 gu2 si5 ge3 daai6 wu6, jat1 maai5 jat1 maai6 dou1 jing2 hoeng2 dou3 go3 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是股市的大户，一买一卖都会影响到市场。
examples.english_sentence: They are big players in the stock market; their buying and selling affects the market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生係銀行嘅大戶，所以好多嘢都可以特別處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 hai6 ngan4 hong4 ge3 daai6 wu6, so2 ji5 ho2 do1 je5 dou1 ho2 ji5 dak6 bit1 chu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生是银行的大客户，所以很多事情都可以特别处理。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li is a big client of the bank, so many things can be handled specially.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企係當地嘅大戶，好多人都俾面佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 hai6 dong1 dei6 ge3 daai6 wu6, ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 bei2 min6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家是当地的大户人家，很多人都给他们面子。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is a big influential family in the area; many people give them face.

english_meaning: Wealthy family, well-to-do family, upper-class family
explanation_mandarin: 指富有且有地位的家庭。
explanation_english: Refers to a wealthy and influential family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺嗰間大屋度，睇嚟都係大戶人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 go2 gaan1 daai6 uk1 dou6, tai2 lai4 dou1 hai6 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在那栋大房子里，看来都是富裕人家。
examples.english_sentence: They live in that big house, they seem to be a wealthy family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋細個嗰陣時，屋企好窮，大個咗先至發咗達，唔再係咩大戶人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, uk1 kei1 hou2 kung4, daai6 go3 zo2 sin1 zi3 faat3 zo2 daat6, m4 zoi3 hai6 me1 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们小时候，家里很穷，长大了才发达起来，已经不是什么富裕人家了。
examples.english_sentence: When they were young, their family was very poor, they only became successful when they grew up, and are no longer a wealthy family (as in, the original wealthy family).

english_meaning: wealthy family, rich people, big spender
explanation_mandarin: 指家境富裕、经济实力雄厚的家庭或个人。 也指挥金如土，消费大手大脚的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a wealthy family or individual with significant financial resources. Can also refer to someone who spends money lavishly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企係大户嚟㗎，住緊山頂豪宅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 hai6 daai6 wu6 lai4 gaa3, zyu6 gan2 saan1 deng2 hou4 zaak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家是大户人家，住在山顶豪宅。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is wealthy, living in a luxury mansion on the Peak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個客好似係大户，一次過買咗好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haak3 hou2 ci5 hai6 daai6 wu6, jat1 ci3 gwo3 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个客人好像是大户，一次性买了好多东西。
examples.english_sentence: This customer seems to be a big spender, buying a lot of things at once.

mandarin_meaning: 富裕人家，有钱有势的家庭
english_meaning: Wealthy family, affluent household, influential family
explanation_mandarin: 指经济实力雄厚，社会地位较高的家庭。
explanation_english: Refers to a family with strong economic power and high social status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺大屋，又请埋工人，睇嚟都係大户人家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 daai6 uk1, jau6 ceng2 maai4 gung1 jan4, tai2 lai4 dou1 hai6 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在大房子里，还请了保姆，看来都是有钱人家。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a big house and even hired a helper, it seems like they come from a wealthy family.

english_meaning: generous spender; lavish spender; big spender; extravagant; generous; big hand
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费大方、阔绰的人；也指花钱数目大、花费多的行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who spends generously or lavishly. It can also refer to a large amount of money spent or a spending habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大手，成日買貴嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 sau2, seng4 jat6 maai5 gwai3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个大手笔，总是买很贵的东西。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a big spender, always buying expensive things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次間公司好大手，請咗好多明星嚟宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 daai6 sau2, ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 sing1 lai4 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次这家公司很是大手笔，请了很多明星来宣传。
examples.english_sentence: This time the company is being very generous, hiring a lot of celebrities for promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係大手嘅人，買嘢都好慳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 daai6 sau2 ge3 jan4, maai5 je5 dou1 hou2 haan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不是一个大手大脚的人，买东西都很节俭。
examples.english_sentence: I'm not a big spender, I'm very frugal when I buy things.

english_meaning: lavish, generous, grand scale, big spending, bold move
explanation_mandarin: 形容花钱很大方，投入很多资金，或者做事气魄很大。
explanation_english: Describes spending money generously, investing a lot of capital, or doing things on a grand scale with boldness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次搞個展覽真係大手筆，請咗好多明星嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 gaau2 go3 zin2 laam5 zan1 hai6 daai6 sau2 bat1, ceng2 zo2 hou2 do1 ming4 sing1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次办展览真是大手笔，请了很多明星来。
examples.english_sentence: He's really spending lavishly on this exhibition, he invited many celebrities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺研發方面投入咗好多錢，真係大手筆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 jin4 faat3 fong1 min6 tau4 jap6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 daai6 sau2 bat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在研发方面投入了很多钱，真是大手笔。
examples.english_sentence: This company has invested a lot of money in research and development, it's really generous spending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗幾百萬買呢幅畫，真係大手筆！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 gei2 baak3 maan6 maai5 ni1 fuk1 waa2, zan1 hai6 daai6 sau2 bat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他花了几百万买这幅画，真是大手笔！
examples.english_sentence: He spent several million to buy this painting, that's really lavish!

english_meaning: Generous, liberal, magnanimous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱或对待他人很大方，不吝啬。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is generous with money or treats others liberally, not stingy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大手骨，成日請人食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 sau2 gwat1, seng4 jat6 ceng2 jan4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很慷慨，经常请人吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: He's really generous, always treating people to meals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做老闆要大手骨啲，啲員工先會肯搏命幫你做嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 lou5 baan2 jiu3 daai6 sau2 gwat1 di1, di1 jyun4 gung1 sin1 wui5 hang2 bok3 ming6 bong1 nei5 zou6 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当老板要大方一点，员工才会肯拼命帮你工作。
examples.english_sentence: Bosses need to be more generous, only then will employees be willing to work hard for you.

english_meaning: to come to blows, to start fighting, to exchange blows
explanation_mandarin: 指发生激烈的肢体冲突，开始打架。
explanation_english: Refers to engaging in a physical fight, exchanging blows, or coming to blows.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗少少錢就大打出手，真係唔值得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 siu2 siu2 chin2 jau6 daai6 daa2 cheut1 sau2, zan1 hai6 m4 dak1 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了那么一点钱就大打出手，真是不值得。
examples.english_sentence: They started fighting over such a small amount of money, it's really not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個喺酒吧度飲醉酒，之後就大打出手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai2 jiu1 baa1 dou6 yam2 zeoi3 zau2, ji1 hau6 zau6 daai6 daa2 cheut1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个在酒吧里喝醉酒，之后就开始打架。
examples.english_sentence: The two of them got drunk at the bar and then started fighting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁衝動，有咩嘢都可以慢慢傾，唔好大打出手啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 chung1 dung6, yau5 me1 ye5 dou1 ho2 yi5 maan6 maan6 king1, m4 hou2 daai6 daa2 cheut1 sau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么冲动，有什么都可以慢慢谈，不要打架啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so impulsive, you can talk about anything slowly, don't start fighting.

mandarin_meaning: 大幅度地降低、打很大的折扣
english_meaning: to give a big discount; to be heavily discounted; to be greatly reduced; to fall far short
explanation_mandarin: 指大幅度降低价格，或者指事物不如预期。
explanation_english: Refers to a significant price reduction or that something falls short of expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲樓價大打折扣，係咪入市嘅好時機呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 lau2 gaa3 daai6 daa2 zit3 gau3, hai6 mai6 jap6 si5 ge3 hou2 si4 gei1 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的房价大幅度降低，是不是入市的好时机呢？
examples.english_sentence: The current property prices have been greatly reduced, is it a good time to enter the market?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅味道大打折扣，冇以前咁好食喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 mei6 dou6 daai6 daa2 zit3 gau3, mou5 ji5 cin4 gam3 hou2 sik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的味道大打折扣，没有以前那么好吃了。
examples.english_sentence: The taste of this restaurant has declined significantly, it's not as delicious as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢會幫我搞掂件事，點知最後大打折扣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 wui5 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 dim6 gin6 si6, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 daai6 daa2 zit3 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他会帮我搞定这件事，结果最后却远不如预期。
examples.english_sentence: He said he would help me sort things out, but in the end, it fell far short of expectations.

english_meaning: a large quantity; a large number; in bulk
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很多，一大群或一大堆。
explanation_english: Indicates a large quantity or number; a large group or a large pile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有大批難民湧入香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 daai6 pai1 naan6 man4 jung2 jap6 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有大批难民涌入香港。
examples.english_sentence: A large number of refugees flooded into Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋大批噉買入股票。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daai6 pai1 gam2 maai5 jap6 gu2 piu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们大批地买入股票。
examples.english_sentence: They bought stocks in bulk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭大批入貨，所以價錢先咁平。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau2 daai6 pai1 jap6 fo3, so2 ji5 gaa3 cin2 sin1 gam2 peng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店大批量进货，所以价格才这么便宜。
examples.english_sentence: This shop buys in bulk, so the price is so cheap.

english_meaning: plenty, a lot, loads, abundant
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，非常充足。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity; abundant, plentiful, a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大把時間，唔使咁趕嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 baa2 si4 gaan3, m4 sai2 gam3 gon2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有很多时间，不用这么赶。
examples.english_sentence: I have plenty of time, no need to rush.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大把錢，唔使擔心佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 baa2 cin2, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有很多钱，不用担心他。
examples.english_sentence: He has loads of money, don't worry about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度大把位，你隨便坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 daai6 baa2 wai2, nei5 ceoi4 bin6 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里有很多位置，你随便坐吧。
examples.english_sentence: There are plenty of seats here, you can sit anywhere you like.

mandarin_meaning: 前途无量, 大有可为
english_meaning: Unlimited potential; a whole world of opportunities; the sky's the limit
explanation_mandarin: 形容未来有无限可能，发展空间很大。
explanation_english: Describes a future with unlimited possibilities and a large scope for development. Implies a bright future with many opportunities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔，唔使咁灰心，你哋大把世界㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 sang1 zai2, m4 sai2 gam3 fui1 sam1, nei5 dei6 daai6 baa2 sai3 gaai3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人，不要灰心，你们前途无量！
examples.english_sentence: Young people, don't be discouraged, you have a whole world of opportunities!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁好，創業大把世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 hou2, cong3 jip6 daai6 baa2 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么好，创业大有可为。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so good right now, there are unlimited opportunities for starting a business.

english_meaning: a lot of money, loads of money, plenty of money
explanation_mandarin: 形容有很多的钱，非常富有。
explanation_english: Describes having a lot of money, being very wealthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，而家大把錢啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, ji4 gaa1 daai6 baa2 cin2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了六合彩，现在有很多钱了！
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and now he has loads of money!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有錢人都話自己唔係大把錢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cin2 jan4 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 m4 hai6 daai6 baa2 cin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有钱人都说自己不是有很多钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Rich people always say they don't have a lot of money.

english_meaning: generally; probably; roughly; in most cases
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概，一般情况下是这样。有时也表示推测的可能性。
explanation_english: Indicates generally, usually being this way. Sometimes expresses a speculative possibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大抵唔會嚟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 dai2 m4 wui5 lei4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大概不会来了。
examples.english_sentence: He probably won't come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食大抵都唔錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 daai6 dai2 dou1 m4 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物大致都不错。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is generally good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大抵係佢唔得閒啦，所以冇覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 dai2 hai6 keoi5 m4 dak1 haan4 laa1, so2 ji5 mou5 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大概是他没空吧，所以没回你。
examples.english_sentence: Probably he's not free, so he didn't reply to you.

english_meaning: pawnshop
explanation_mandarin: 指提供抵押贷款的商店，顾客可以将其贵重物品（如珠宝、手表等）作为抵押品，换取一定金额的现金。
explanation_english: A pawnshop is a shop where people can leave valuable items as security in order to borrow money. They can redeem the items later by paying back the loan plus interest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇錢使，拎啲金器去大押頂住先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 cin2 sai2, ling1 di1 gam1 hei3 heoi3 daai6 aap3 ding2 zyu6 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没钱用，把一些金器拿到当铺抵押一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: I'm short on money, let's take some gold jewelry to the pawnshop to tide us over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間大押嘅利息都幾高下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 daai6 aap3 ge3 lei6 sik1 dou1 gei2 gou1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家当铺的利息挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: The interest rate at this pawnshop is quite high.

english_meaning: thumb
explanation_mandarin: 手上的第一个手指，也叫拇指。
explanation_english: The first digit of the hand, also known as the thumb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揼咗個大拇指落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dam2 zo2 go3 daai6 mou5 zi2 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把大拇指竖下来了。
examples.english_sentence: He gave a thumbs down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我㩒親大拇指都好痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam6 can1 daai6 mou5 zi2 dou1 hou2 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我按到大拇指都很痛。
examples.english_sentence: It hurts whenever I press my thumb.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我成日吮大拇指。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 seng4 jat6 seon2 daai6 mou5 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常吮拇指。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often sucked my thumb.

english_meaning: curly braces, curly brackets
explanation_mandarin: 指数学或计算机编程中使用的符号“{}”。
explanation_english: Refers to the symbol '{}' used in mathematics or computer programming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫程式嘅時候，成日都要用到大括弧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 cing4 sik1 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jung6 dou2 daai6 kut3 wu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写程序的时候，经常都要用到大括号。
examples.english_sentence: When writing code, you often need to use curly braces.

english_meaning: curly brackets, braces
explanation_mandarin: 指数学或编程中使用的符号“{}”。
explanation_english: Refers to the curly brackets or braces "{}" used in mathematics or programming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺程式語言入邊，大括號通常用嚟界定程式碼嘅範圍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 cing4 sik1 jyu5 jin4 jap6 bin1, daai6 kut3 hou6 tung1 soeng4 yung6 lai4 gaai3 ding6 cing4 sik1 maa5 ge3 faan6 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在编程语言中，大括号通常用来界定代码的范围。
examples.english_sentence: In programming languages, curly brackets are often used to define the scope of the code.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份數學卷有好多要用大括號嘅題目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 sou3 hok6 gyun3 jau5 hou2 do1 jiu3 yung6 daai6 kut3 hou6 ge3 tai4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份数学卷有很多要用大括号的题目。
examples.english_sentence: There are many questions on this math paper that require the use of curly brackets.

english_meaning: A large amount; a considerable amount; a whopping [amount]
explanation_mandarin: 表示数量很大，相当于“一大把”、“这么多”。 通常带有夸张或不满的语气。
explanation_english: Indicates a large quantity or amount. It often carries a tone of exaggeration or dissatisfaction.  Implies that the amount is surprisingly or unexpectedly large.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大拿拿攞咗成萬蚊去買衫！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 naa1 naa1 lo2 zo2 seng4 maan6 man1 heoi3 maai5 saam1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一下子就拿了一万块去买衣服！
examples.english_sentence: He spent a whopping ten thousand dollars on clothes!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大拿拿等咗成個鐘，佢都未嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 naa1 naa1 dang2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, keoi5 dou1 mei6 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 整整等了一个小时，他都还没来。
examples.english_sentence: I've been waiting for a whole hour and he's still not here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大拿拿三百蚊個飯盒，搶錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 naa1 naa1 saam1 baak3 man1 go3 faan6 hap2, coeng2 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个饭盒竟然要三百块钱，抢钱吗？
examples.english_sentence: Three hundred dollars for a lunchbox? Is this a robbery?

english_meaning: spring cleaning; general cleaning; thorough cleaning
explanation_mandarin: 指年终岁末进行的大规模清洁活动，将家中或办公室彻底打扫干净，去除灰尘和污垢。
explanation_english: Refers to a thorough cleaning activity, usually performed at the end of the year, to clean the house or office completely, removing dust and dirt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 每年農曆新年之前，我哋屋企都會做大掃除。
