explanation_mandarin: 指重要的日子，例如结婚、生日、节日等。
explanation_english: Refers to an important day, such as a wedding, birthday, or holiday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日就係我嘅大日子，好緊張呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zau6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 daai6 jat6 zi2, hou2 gan2 zoeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天就是我的大日子，好紧张啊！
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is my big day, I'm so nervous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋揀咗下個月嘅良辰吉日做大日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan2 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 loeng4 san4 gat1 jat6 zou6 daai6 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们选了下个月的良辰吉日做大日子。
examples.english_sentence: They chose an auspicious day next month for their big day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日係阿爺八十大壽嘅大日子，全家人都返嚟慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hai6 aa3 je4 baat3 sap6 daai6 sau6 ge3 daai6 jat6 zi2, cyun4 gaa1 jan4 dou1 faan1 lai4 hing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天是我爷爷八十大寿的大日子，全家人都回来庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: Today is my grandfather's 80th birthday, a big day, and the whole family is back to celebrate.

english_meaning: early in the morning
explanation_mandarin: 指一天中很早的时候。
explanation_english: Refers to the very early part of the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋大早就出咗門口啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai6 zou2 zau6 ceot1 zo2 mun4 hau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一大早就出门了。
examples.english_sentence: We left the house early in the morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大早起身去跑步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 zou2 hei2 san1 heoi3 paau2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一大早起床去跑步。
examples.english_sentence: He gets up early in the morning to go running.

english_meaning: matters of principle; important questions of right and wrong
explanation_mandarin: 指重大原则问题、涉及正义与邪恶的大事。
explanation_english: Refers to important matters of principle, especially those involving right and wrong, justice and injustice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺大是大非嘅問題上面，我哋一定要企穩立場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 daai6 si6 daai6 fei1 ge3 man6 tai4 soeng6 min6, ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 kei5 wan2 lip6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大是大非的问题上，我们一定要站稳立场。
examples.english_sentence: On matters of principle, we must take a firm stand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 面對大是大非，唔可以模棱兩可。
examples.jyutping_sentence: min6 deoi3 daai6 si6 daai6 fei1, m4 ho2 ji5 mou4 ling4 loeng5 ho2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 面对大是大非，不能模棱两可。
examples.english_sentence: When faced with matters of principle, one cannot be ambiguous.

english_meaning: Major holidays; festive occasions
explanation_mandarin: 指重要的传统节日，例如春节、中秋节等。
explanation_english: Refers to important traditional festivals, such as Chinese New Year, Mid-Autumn Festival, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大時大節屋企人一定要齊齊整整食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 si4 daai6 zit3 uk1 kei2 jan4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 cai4 cai4 zing2 zing2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 重大节日家里人一定要整整齐齐地一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: During major holidays, the family must have a complete gathering to have dinner together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大時大節啲嘢通常都貴啲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 si4 daai6 zit3 di1 je5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 gwai3 di1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 重大节日的东西通常都贵一些。
examples.english_sentence: Things are usually more expensive during major holidays.

mandarin_meaning: 了不起；了不得；最大；说了算
english_meaning: be all-powerful; have the final say; be supreme; can do whatever one wants
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人或某事物非常厉害，权力很大，可以为所欲为。通常带有负面含义，表示不满或讽刺。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone or something is very powerful and has a lot of authority, able to do whatever they want. Usually carries a negative connotation, expressing dissatisfaction or sarcasm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你以為你大晒呀？咁惡死嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji5 wai4 nei5 daai6 saai3 aa3? gam2 ok3 sei2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你以为你很了不起吗？这么凶恶？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think you're all-powerful? Why are you being so fierce?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家佢升咗職，就以為自己大晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 keoi5 sing1 zo2 jik1, zau6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 daai6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在他升职了，就以为自己了不起。
examples.english_sentence: Now that he's been promoted, he thinks he's all-powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有錢就大晒咩？唔係㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 cin2 zau6 daai6 saai3 me1? m4 hai6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有钱就了不起吗？不是的！
examples.english_sentence: Does having money mean you can do whatever you want? No, it doesn't!

english_meaning: Seeming foolish while actually being intelligent; feigning ignorance
explanation_mandarin: 指有大智慧的人表面上看起来好像很愚笨。
explanation_english: Describes someone with great intelligence who appears foolish or simple-minded. It implies a deliberate concealment of one's abilities, often for strategic reasons or to avoid unwanted attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時好似乜都唔識咁，但其實佢大智若愚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 hou2 ci5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 gam2, daan6 kei4 sat6 keoi5 daai6 zi3 joek6 jyu4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时好像什么都不懂，但其实他大智如愚。
examples.english_sentence: He usually seems like he doesn't know anything, but in reality, he's feigning ignorance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日唔出聲，但佢嘅決定每次都啱，真係大智若愚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 m4 ceot1 seng1, daan6 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6 mui5 ci3 dou1 ngaam1, zan1 hai6 daai6 zi3 joek6 jyu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是沉默寡言，但他做的决定每次都是对的，真是大智如愚。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa is always quiet, but his decisions are always correct; he truly seems foolish but is actually intelligent.

synonyms: 深藏不露 (sam1 cong4 bat1 lou6)

english_meaning: Major Heat (one of the 24 solar terms)
explanation_mandarin: 二十四节气之一，指阳历七月二十二或二十三日。表示天气非常炎热。
explanation_english: Major Heat is one of the twenty-four solar terms in the traditional Chinese calendar. It falls around July 22nd or 23rd in the Gregorian calendar, signifying the period of the year when the weather is extremely hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅大暑熱到人都癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 daai6 syu2 jit6 dou3 jan4 dou1 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的大暑热得人都疯了。
examples.english_sentence: This year's Major Heat is so hot it's driving people crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大暑嗰陣，最好就係留喺屋企嘆冷氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 syu2 go2 zan6, zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 taan2 laang5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在大暑的时候，最好就是留在家里享受空调。
examples.english_sentence: During the Major Heat period, the best thing to do is stay home and enjoy the air conditioning.

mandarin_meaning: 了不起；拥有特权；说了算
english_meaning: The greatest; superior; having all the power; can do whatever one wants; having the final say; thinking one is all that.
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人自以为是，觉得自己很了不起，可以为所欲为，拥有最终决定权。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is arrogant, thinks they are superior, can do whatever they want, and has the final say. Usually has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以為自己好叻，喺公司大曬咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, hai2 gung1 si1 daai6 saai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以为自己很厉害，在公司里好像了不起一样。
examples.english_sentence: He thinks he's great and acts like he's all that at the office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你有錢就大曬呀，尊重人哋都好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 jau5 cin2 zau6 daai6 saai3 aa3, zyun1 zung6 jan4 dei6 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你有钱就可以为所欲为，尊重别人也很重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can do whatever you want just because you have money. Respecting others is very important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，就覺得自己大曬，態度差咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 daai6 saai3, taai3 dou6 caa1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，就觉得自己了不起，态度差了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he felt like he was all that, and his attitude became much worse.

english_meaning: general meeting; conference; convention; assembly
explanation_mandarin: 大型的会议，通常是正式的、有组织的。
explanation_english: A large, formal, and organized meeting or conference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日有個大會，我哋要早啲去霸位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jau5 go3 daai6 wui2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zou2 di1 heoi3 baa3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天有个大会，我们要早点去占位。
examples.english_sentence: There's a general meeting tomorrow, we need to go early to reserve seats.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大會上面發表咗重要嘅演講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 wui2 soeng6 min6 faat3 biu2 zo2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jin2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大会上发表了重要的演讲。
examples.english_sentence: He delivered an important speech at the conference.

english_meaning: City Hall, Town Hall
explanation_mandarin: 指一个城市或地区的大型公共建筑物，通常用于举办会议、展览、演出等活动。
explanation_english: A large public building in a city or town, typically used for meetings, exhibitions, performances, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺大會堂睇演唱會呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 hai2 daai6 wui2 tong4 tai2 jin2 cheung3 wui2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在大会堂看演唱会啊。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to a concert at City Hall tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港大會堂嘅建築好有特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 daai6 wui2 tong4 ge3 gin3 zuk1 hou2 jau5 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港大会堂的建筑很有特色。
examples.english_sentence: The architecture of Hong Kong City Hall is very distinctive.

english_meaning: Long month (with 31 days)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个月有31天的月份。
explanation_english: Refers to a month with 31 days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅大月有七個，都幾多喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 daai6 jyut6 jau5 cat1 go3, dou1 gei2 do1 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的大月有七个，还真多。
examples.english_sentence: There are seven long months this year, that's quite a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一月、三月、五月、七月、八月、十月同埋十二月都係大月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 jyut6, saam1 jyut6, ng5 jyut6, cat1 jyut6, baat3 jyut6, sap6 jyut6 tung4 maai4 sap6 ji6 jyut6 dou1 hai6 daai6 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一月、三月、五月、七月、八月、十月和十二月都是大月。
examples.english_sentence: January, March, May, July, August, October, and December are all long months.

english_meaning: There are plenty of people (who do/are)
explanation_mandarin: 指某种情况或行为并不罕见，有很多人都这样做或处于这种状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain situation or behavior is not rare; there are many people who do it or are in this state. It suggests that something is common or that many people share the same characteristic or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔係第一個咁樣諗嘅，大有人在㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hai6 dai6 jat1 go3 gam2 joeng2 nim2 ge3, daai6 jau5 jan4 zoi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不是第一个这样想的，有很多人都这么想。
examples.english_sentence: You're not the first person to think like that, there are plenty of people who think the same way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家後生仔唔想生仔嘅，大有人在啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hau6 sang1 zai2 m4 soeng2 sang1 zai2 ge3, daai6 jau5 jan4 zoi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻人不想生孩子的，大有人在。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, there are plenty of young people who don't want to have children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有錢過佢嘅，大有人在。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 cin2 gwo3 keoi5 ge3, daai6 jau5 jan4 zoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港比他有钱的人，大有人在。
examples.english_sentence: There are plenty of people in Hong Kong who are richer than him.

mandarin_meaning: 大有背景, 来头不小
english_meaning: To have a significant background; to be from an important family or organization; to be a person of consequence.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事背景深厚，不同寻常，具有很高的地位或影响力。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something with a significant and unusual background, possessing high status or influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺係創辦間公司嗰個，佢都算大有來頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 hai6 cong3 baan6 gaan1 gung1 si1 go2 go3, keoi5 dou1 syun3 daai6 jau5 loi4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的爷爷是创办那家公司的，他也可以算是有来头的。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather founded that company, so he can be considered to have a significant background.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢喺警隊入面大有來頭，所以先升得咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai2 ging2 deoi6 jap6 min6 daai6 jau5 loi4 tau4, so2 ji5 sin1 sing1 dak1 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他在警队里背景很强大，所以才升得这么快。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he has a very influential background in the police force, which is why he was promoted so quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間畫廊大有來頭，唔係普通人開嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 waa2 long4 daai6 jau5 loi4 tau4, m4 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 hoi1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家画廊背景很深厚，不是普通人开的。
examples.english_sentence: This gallery has a significant background; it's not run by ordinary people.

english_meaning: vastly different; poles apart; totally different
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物差别很大，几乎完全不同。
explanation_english: Describes things that are vastly different from each other, almost completely dissimilar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅睇法大有徑庭，好難達成共識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leong5 go3 ge3 tai2 faat3 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4, hou2 naan4 daat6 sing4 gung6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人的看法大相径庭，很难达成共识。
examples.english_sentence: Their views are vastly different, making it difficult to reach a consensus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅企業文化大有徑庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kei5 jip6 man4 faa3 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的企业文化大相径庭。
examples.english_sentence: The corporate cultures of these two companies are completely different.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢之前嘅生活同而家嘅生活大有徑庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 cin4 ge3 sang1 wut6 tung4 ji4 gaa1 ge3 sang1 wut6 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他之前的生活和现在的生活大相径庭。
examples.english_sentence: His life before and his life now are totally different.

english_meaning: vastly different; poles apart; completely different
explanation_mandarin: 指彼此之间差别很大，差异显著。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where things are vastly different or completely opposite from each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅意見大有逕庭，傾都傾唔埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4, king1 dou1 king1 m4 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的意见大相径庭，根本谈不到一块儿。
examples.english_sentence: Their opinions are vastly different, so they can't even come to an agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥同細佬嘅性格大有逕庭，一個靜，一個嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 tung4 sai3 lou2 ge3 sing3 gaak3 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4, jat1 go3 zing6, jat1 go3 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥和弟弟的性格大相径庭，一个安静，一个吵闹。
examples.english_sentence: The older and younger brother have vastly different personalities; one is quiet, the other is noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩間公司嘅文化大有逕庭，一間好保守，一間好開放。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 man4 faa3 daai6 jau5 ging3 ting4, jat1 gaan1 hou2 bou2 sau2, jat1 gaan1 hou2 hoi1 fong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两家公司的文化大相径庭，一家很保守，一家很开放。
examples.english_sentence: The cultures of these two companies are vastly different, one is very conservative, and the other is very open.

english_meaning: stupid; foolish; muddle-headed; scatterbrained
explanation_mandarin: 形容人迟钝，反应慢，容易犯错，比较糊涂或傻气。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is slow, slow to react, prone to mistakes, and generally muddle-headed or foolish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大懵嘅，點幫你做嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 mung2 ge3, dim2 bong1 nei5 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么糊涂，怎么帮你做事啊？
examples.english_sentence: You're so muddle-headed, how can I help you with your work?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人有啲大懵，成日唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 jau5 di1 daai6 mung2, seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人有点傻气，总是忘记带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: He's a bit scatterbrained, always forgetting to bring his keys.

english_meaning: headquarters; base camp; main base of operations
explanation_mandarin: 原指军队驻扎的总部或基地。现也比喻某个团体、组织或活动的中心地点。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the headquarters or base of a military force. Now also used metaphorically to refer to the central location of a group, organization, or activity; the main base of operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港係我哋嘅大本營，我哋要守住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 daai6 bun2 jing4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sau2 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港是我们的总部，我们要守住它。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is our headquarters, we must defend it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司喺深圳設立咗佢哋嘅大本營。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai2 sam1 zan3 sat3 lap6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 daai6 bun2 jing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司在深圳设立了他们的大本营。
examples.english_sentence: This company has established its headquarters in Shenzhen.

english_meaning: underutilization of talent; a waste of talent; using a sledgehammer to crack a nut
explanation_mandarin: 把大的材料用在小的地方。比喻使用人才不当，屈才。
explanation_english: Using a talent for a task beneath their abilities. It implies that someone is overqualified for their current role or that their skills are being wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請個博士嚟做樓下看更，真係大材小用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 go3 bok3 si6 lai4 zou6 lau4 haa6 hon1 gang1, zan1 hai6 daai6 coi4 siu2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请个博士来做楼下的保安，真是大材小用。
examples.english_sentence: Hiring a PhD to work as a security guard downstairs is a real waste of talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，喺呢間細公司做嘢，咪大材小用囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, hai2 ni1 gaan1 sai3 gung1 si1 zou6 je5, mai1 daai6 coi4 siu2 jung6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，在这家小公司工作，不是大材小用吗？
examples.english_sentence: You're so talented, working in this small company is a waste of your abilities, isn't it?

english_meaning: Sunset Peak (Lantau Island, Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港大屿山的一座山峰，以秋季的芒草和日落景色而闻名。
explanation_english: A mountain peak located on Lantau Island, Hong Kong, known for its silvergrass and sunset views, especially during autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年秋天去大東山睇芒草啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 cau1 tin1 heoi3 daai6 dung1 saan1 tai2 mong4 cou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年秋天去大东山看芒草吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Sunset Peak to see the silvergrass this autumn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大東山啲日落真係好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 dung1 saan1 di1 jat6 lok6 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大东山的日落真的很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The sunset on Sunset Peak is really beautiful.

english_meaning: Buck teeth; large front teeth
explanation_mandarin: 指突出的上门牙或下门牙。通常用于形容牙齿较大且向前突出。
explanation_english: Refers to prominent upper or lower incisors. It's usually used to describe teeth that are large and protrude forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對大板牙好得意呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 daai6 baan2 ngaa4 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的一对大门牙很可爱啊。
examples.english_sentence: His buck teeth are so cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣我都有啲大板牙，不過大個咗就冇咁明顯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ngo5 dou1 jau5 di1 daai6 baan2 ngaa4, bat1 gwo3 daai6 go3 zo2 zau6 mou5 gam3 ming5 hin2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候我也有些龅牙，但是长大了就没有那么明显了。
examples.english_sentence: I used to have some buck teeth when I was a kid, but it's not as noticeable anymore now that I'm older.

english_meaning: Something big, a major thing; a big deal
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情很大，很严重，或者指出现重大问题。
explanation_english: Used to describe a situation that is big, serious, or a major problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係大枝嘢喇，間公司可能要執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 daai6 zi1 je5 laa3, gaan1 gung1 si1 ho2 nang4 jiu3 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真是大事了，这家公司可能要倒闭。
examples.english_sentence: This is really a big deal, the company might have to close down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張啦，唔係咩大枝嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gin2 zoeng1 laa1, m4 hai6 me1 daai6 zi1 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么紧张，不是什么大事。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, it's not a big deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先差啲撞車，真係大枝嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 caa1 di1 zong6 ce1, zan1 hai6 daai6 zi1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才差点撞车，真是件大事。
examples.english_sentence: I almost had a car accident just now, that would have been a big deal.

english_meaning: clumsy person, big and awkward person
explanation_mandarin: 形容身材高大但行动笨拙的人，带贬义
explanation_english: Describes a person who is tall but clumsy in their movements, often used in a derogatory way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友生到咁大舊，但係論論盡盡，真係大柴咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 saang1 dou3 gam3 daai6 gau6, daan6 hai6 leon6 leon6 zeon6 zeon6, zan1 hai6 daai6 caai4 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人长得那么大块头，但是做事总是冒冒失失的，真是个笨拙的人。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is so big, but he's always clumsy and careless, truly a clumsy person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁勞氣啦，佢都係大柴啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou4 hei3 laa1, keoi5 dou1 hai6 daai6 caai4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么生气了，他只是个笨手笨脚的人罢了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry, he's just a clumsy person.

english_meaning: greenhouse, hothouse
explanation_mandarin: 指用透明或半透明材料覆盖的，用于植物种植的设施。
explanation_english: A structure with translucent or transparent coverings used for growing plants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺個大棚入面種咗好多菜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 go3 daai6 paang4 jap6 min6 zung2 zo2 ho2 do1 coi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在温室里种了很多蔬菜。
examples.english_sentence: They planted a lot of vegetables in the greenhouse.

english_meaning: uppercase; capital letter
explanation_mandarin: 指字母的大写形式。
explanation_english: Refers to the uppercase or capital form of a letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你用大楷寫你嘅名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 yung6 daai6 kaai2 se2 nei5 ge3 meng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你用大写写你的名字。
examples.english_sentence: Please write your name in capital letters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度要填大楷字母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 jiu3 tin4 daai6 kaai2 ji5 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里要填写大写字母。
examples.english_sentence: Capital letters are required here.

english_meaning: probably; approximately; roughly; about; maybe; perhaps
explanation_mandarin: 表示估量，不确定，可能。也可以表示粗略的，不精确的。
explanation_english: Indicates estimation, uncertainty, or possibility. Can also mean approximate or imprecise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大概聽日會去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 koi3 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大概明天会去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: I'll probably go to the cinema tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大概有十幾個人會嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 koi3 jau5 sap6 gei2 go3 jan4 wui5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大概有十几个人会来。
examples.english_sentence: There will be about a dozen people coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋大概需要兩個鐘先搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai6 koi3 seoi1 jiu3 loeng5 go3 zung1 sin1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们大概需要两个小时才能搞定。
examples.english_sentence: It will probably take us about two hours to finish.

english_meaning: probably, approximately, roughly, about
explanation_mandarin: 表示估计的程度，相当于“大约”、“大概”。
explanation_english: Indicates an estimated degree, equivalent to "approximately", "probably", "about".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大槪聽日先得閒覆你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 koi3 ting1 jat6 sin1 dak1 haan4 fuk1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大概明天才有空回复你。
examples.english_sentence: I will probably only be free to reply to you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告大槪有十頁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 daai6 koi3 jau5 sap6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告大概有十页。
examples.english_sentence: The report is approximately ten pages long.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大槪幾點鐘到啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 koi3 gei2 dim2 zung1 dou3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大概几点钟到啊？
examples.english_sentence: What time will you arrive approximately?

english_meaning: high-rise building, multi-storey building
explanation_mandarin: 指多层或高层的建筑物。
explanation_english: Refers to a multi-storey or high-rise building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰棟大樓係我哋公司嘅總部。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 dung6 daai6 lau4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 zung2 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那栋大楼是我们公司的总部。
examples.english_sentence: That high-rise building is the headquarters of our company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多大樓都好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 daai6 lau4 dou1 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多大楼都很高。
examples.english_sentence: Many high-rise buildings in Hong Kong are very tall.

english_meaning: Acting like a corpse, acting lifeless, putting on a deadpan/uninterested act; (slang) putting on airs, acting superior or arrogant.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人毫无生气，像死人一样；也指一个人装模作样，摆架子，显得高人一等。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is lifeless and without energy, like a corpse; also refers to someone who is putting on airs, acting superior, and trying to appear more important than they are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都大模屍樣，好似乜嘢都唔關佢事咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2, hou2 ci5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 gwaan1 keoi5 si6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是死样子，好像什么事情都与他无关一样。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting like a corpse, as if nothing concerns him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度大模屍樣啦，大家都知你扮嘢啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 baan6 je5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别在这里装模作样了，大家都知道你装样子而已。
examples.english_sentence: Stop putting on airs, everyone knows you're just pretending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後就大模屍樣，見到人都唔打招呼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6 zau6 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2, gin3 dou2 jan4 dou1 m4 daa2 zaau1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后就摆出一副高高在上的样子，见到人都不打招呼。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he started acting all high and mighty, not even greeting people.

synonyms: 死吓死吓 (sei2 haa2 sei2 haa2)

english_meaning: Acting in a pompous, self-important, or brazen manner; putting on airs; swaggering.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人装腔作势，摆出很了不起的样子。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone acting in a pretentious, self-important, or brazen way, often to impress others. It has a negative connotation, suggesting insincerity or arrogance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，日日都大模廝樣咁行嚟行去，好似自己好威咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, jat1 jat1 dou1 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2 gam2 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3, hou2 ci5 zi6 gei2 hou2 wai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，每天都大摇大摆地走来走去，好像自己很厉害似的。
examples.english_sentence: After his promotion, he's been swaggering around every day, acting like he's a big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好喺度大模廝樣啦，我知你乜都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2 laa1, ngo5 zi1 nei5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要在这里装模作样了，我知道你什么都不会。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so self-important here, I know you don't know anything.

english_meaning: putting on airs, acting pretentious, acting important
explanation_mandarin: 形容人装腔作势，摆出很了不起的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is putting on airs, acting in a pretentious manner, or trying to appear more important than they actually are.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，成日都大模斯樣咁，好似好巴閉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2 gam2, hou2 ci5 hou2 baa1 bai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，整天都装模作样的，好像很了不起似的。
examples.english_sentence: After he got promoted, he's been acting all high and mighty, as if he's a big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度大模斯樣啦，你都唔識做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 daai6 mou4 si1 joeng2 laa1, nei5 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在这里装模作样了，你根本不会做。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on airs here, you don't even know how to do it.

english_meaning: Jackfruit
explanation_mandarin: 一种热带水果，果实巨大，外皮有刺。
explanation_english: A tropical fruit with a very large, spiky outer rind and sweet, yellow flesh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個大樹菠蘿好重呀，我一個人搬唔郁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daai6 syu6 bo1 lo4 hou2 cung5 aa3, ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 m4 juk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个菠萝蜜很重啊，我一个人搬不动。
examples.english_sentence: This jackfruit is so heavy, I can't move it by myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆種咗棵大樹菠蘿，今年結咗好多個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 zung3 zo2 po1 daai6 syu6 bo1 lo4, gam1 nin4 git3 zo2 hou2 do1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶种了一棵菠萝蜜树，今年结了很多个果实。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma planted a jackfruit tree and it bore many fruits this year.

english_meaning: Open-air food stall; large-scale stall or operation; significant undertaking
explanation_mandarin: 指规模较大的摊位，尤指露天的大排档。也可以指大规模的生意或行动。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale stall, especially an open-air food stall (dai pai dong). Can also refer to a large-scale business or operation; a significant undertaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去大檔食嘢啦，好耐冇去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 daai6 dong3 sik6 je5 laa1, hou2 noi6 mou5 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去大排档吃饭吧，好久没去了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the open-air food stall for dinner tonight, it's been a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋搞緊個大檔，投資咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaau2 gan2 go3 daai6 dong3, tau4 zi1 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在搞一个大项目，投资了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: They're running a big project, they've invested a lot of money.

mandarin_meaning: 倒霉, 糟糕, 完蛋
english_meaning: Big trouble, screwed, doomed, in deep shit
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况非常糟糕，陷入困境，没有希望。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that is very bad, hopeless, or one is in deep trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次大檸樂喇，測驗肥佬，阿媽實鬧死我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daai6 ning4 lok6 laa3, cak1 jim6 fei4 lou2, aa3 maa1 sat6 naau6 sei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次倒霉了，考试不及格，我妈肯定会骂死我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in big trouble this time, I failed the exam, my mom is definitely going to scold me to death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁擔心啦，就算真係大檸樂，都總會有辦法嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daam1 sam1 laa1, zau6 syun3 zan1 hai6 daai6 ning4 lok6, dou1 zung2 wui5 jau5 baan6 faat3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要太担心了，就算真的完蛋了，总会有办法的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry too much, even if we're really screwed, there will always be a way.

english_meaning: great power; authority; full control
explanation_mandarin: 指很大的权力或控制权。
explanation_english: Refers to great power, authority, or full control over something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗公司嘅大權之後，好多政策都變咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 kyun4 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 zing3 caak3 dou1 bin3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他掌握了公司的大权之后，很多政策都变了。
examples.english_sentence: After he gained full control of the company, many policies changed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想攞晒啲大權，唔畀其他人有機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 lo2 saai3 di1 daai6 kyun4, m4 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 jau5 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想独揽大权，不给其他人机会。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to take all the power and not give others a chance.

english_meaning: Power slipping away; losing control; power falling into the hands of others
explanation_mandarin: 指原有的权力逐渐被他人或机构掌控，失去控制权。
explanation_english: Refers to the gradual loss of control of power to others or institutions; losing control of power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢退咗休之後，公司嘅大權就開始旁落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 teoi3 zo2 jau1 zi1 hau6, gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 kyun4 zau6 hoi1 chi2 pong4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他退休之后，公司的大权就开始旁落。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he retired, the power of the company has started to slip away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔努力，遲早大權旁落，俾競爭對手搶晒啲生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 nu5 lik6, chi4 zou2 daai6 kyun4 pong4 lok6, bei2 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 cheung2 saai3 di1 saang1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不努力，迟早大权旁落，被竞争对手抢走所有的生意。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't work hard, sooner or later the power will slip away and all the business will be taken by competitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅聯盟解體之後，各方勢力開始爭奪權力，導致大權旁落。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 lyun4 mang4 gaai2 tai2 zi1 hau6, gok3 fong1 sai3 lik6 hoi1 chi2 jaang1 dyut6 kyun4 lik6, dou6 zi3 daai6 kyun4 pong4 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的联盟解体之后，各方势力开始争夺权力，导致大权旁落。
examples.english_sentence: After their alliance disintegrated, various forces began to compete for power, leading to the power slipping away.

english_meaning: to monopolize power, to wield absolute power
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人或一个团体完全控制所有的权力，不容许他人参与或分享。
explanation_english: Describes a person or group who completely controls all the power, not allowing others to participate or share it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司大權獨攬，冇人敢反對佢嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 daai6 kyun4 duk6 laam5, mou5 jan4 gam2 faan2 doi3 keoi5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里大权独揽，没有人敢反对他的决定。
examples.english_sentence: He monopolizes power in the company, no one dares to object to his decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升職之後，就開始大權獨攬，唔聽其他人嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 hoi1 chi2 daai6 kyun4 duk6 laam5, m4 ting1 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职之后，就开始独揽大权，不听取其他人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Since he got promoted, he started to monopolize power and not listen to other people's opinions.

english_meaning: Troublesome; difficult; a hassle
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情很麻烦，难以处理。
explanation_english: Describes something as troublesome, difficult to handle, or a hassle. It can also imply something being a burden or a chore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋真係好大欖呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 laam5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家真是很麻烦啊！
examples.english_sentence: Moving house is such a hassle!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞簽證嘅手續好大欖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 cim1 zing3 ge3 sau2 zuk6 hou2 daai6 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 办签证的手续很麻烦。
examples.english_sentence: The visa application process is very troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事好大欖，我唔想搞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hou2 daai6 laam5, ngo5 m4 soeng2 gaau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事很麻烦，我不想管。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is too troublesome, I don't want to deal with it.

english_meaning: To enjoy to the fullest; to indulge oneself thoroughly; to live it up
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常尽情地享受，无拘无束地享受生活中的美好事物，强调享受的程度和状态。
explanation_english: Describes enjoying something to the fullest extent, freely indulging in the good things in life. It emphasizes the degree and state of enjoyment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗馬爾代夫大歎特歎咗一個星期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 maa5 ji5 doi6 fu1 daai6 taan3 dak6 taan3 zo2 jat1 go3 sing1 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去了马尔代夫尽情享受了一个星期。
examples.english_sentence: We went to the Maldives and thoroughly enjoyed ourselves for a week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，梗係要大歎特歎下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 caai2, gang2 hai6 jiu3 daai6 taan3 dak6 taan3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票，当然要好好享受一下啦。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery, of course he's going to live it up!

english_meaning: awesome; great; fantastic; excellent; impressive
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常棒，非常好，很厉害的意思。通常用于形容事物或人令人赞叹。
explanation_english: Expresses that something is awesome, great, or fantastic. It's used to describe things or people that are impressive and admirable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份報告寫得好大正呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 daai6 zing3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的报告写得真棒啊！
examples.english_sentence: Your report is written really well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食真係大正！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 daai6 zing3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物真棒！
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日嘅表現真係大正，攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 ge3 biu2 hin3 zan1 hai6 daai6 zing3, lo2 zo2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天的表现真棒，获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: His performance yesterday was fantastic; he won the championship.

english_meaning: To stride over, to get over (a difficulty), to move on (from a problem)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“大步跨过去”，比喻克服困难，顺利通过难关，或者放下过去的事情，继续前进。
explanation_english: Literally means "to stride over". Figuratively means to overcome difficulties, get through tough times, or to let go of the past and move forward.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好灰心，好多嘢大步揇過就冇事㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, hou2 do1 je5 daai6 bou6 naam5 gwo3 zau6 mou5 si6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要灰心，很多事情大步跨过去就没事了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be discouraged, many things will be fine if you just move on from them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然今次考試唔係咁理想，但係都要大步揇過，下次努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 m4 hai6 gam2 lei5 soeng2, daan6 hai6 dou1 jiu3 daai6 bou6 naam5 gwo3, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这次考试不是那么理想，但是也要跨过去，下次努力一些。
examples.english_sentence: Although this exam wasn't ideal, you have to get over it and work harder next time.

mandarin_meaning: 跨过难关; 度过难关
english_meaning: To overcome an obstacle; to get over a hurdle; to get through a difficult situation.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻勇敢地面对和克服困难，顺利度过难关。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning to take a bold step over a threshold or obstacle, metaphorically referring to overcoming a difficult situation or challenge with courage and determination.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚呀，大步檻過咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1 aa3, daai6 bou6 laam6 gwo3 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，大步跨过去就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid, just get over the hurdle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次生意雖然蝕咗少少，但我哋會大步檻過，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 seng1 ji3 seoi1 jin4 sit3 zo2 siu2 siu2, daan6 ngo5 dei6 wui5 daai6 bou6 laam6 gwo3, cung4 san1 hoi1 chi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次生意虽然亏损了一点，但我们会度过难关，重新开始。
examples.english_sentence: Although we lost a bit of money in this business deal, we will overcome this obstacle and start again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道呢件事對你嚟講好難，但係你要大步檻過，唔好放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 ni1 gin6 si6 deoi3 nei5 lei4 gong2 hou2 naan4, daan6 hai6 nei5 jiu3 daai6 bou6 laam6 gwo3, m4 hou2 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道这件事对你来说很难，但是你要勇敢面对，不要放弃。
examples.english_sentence: I know this is difficult for you, but you have to overcome this obstacle and don't give up.

mandarin_meaning: 大步跨过; 轻松度过
english_meaning: To stride over; to overcome (a difficulty) easily; to take something in stride
explanation_mandarin: 形容以自信和轻松的态度克服困难或问题。
explanation_english: Describes overcoming a difficulty or problem with confidence and ease. It implies a proactive and unfazed approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔合格都唔緊要，大步𨂾過，下次努力啲就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3, daai6 bou6 lam4 gwo3, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试不及格也没关系，轻松度过，下次努力一点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: It's okay if you failed this exam, take it in stride, just try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然公司執笠，但係佢決定大步𨂾過，重新開始。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gung1 si1 zap1 lap1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 kyut3 ding6 daai6 bou6 lam4 gwo3, cung4 san1 hoi1 ci2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然公司倒闭了，但是他决定重新开始，轻松度过。
examples.english_sentence: Although the company closed down, he decided to take it in stride and start again.

synonyms: 船到橋頭自然直 (syun4 dou3 kiu4 tau4 zi6 jin4 zik6)

mandarin_meaning: 大步跨过; 不拘小节; 毫不在意地忽略
english_meaning: Stride over; To not be bothered by (small issues); To gloss over; To not dwell on something.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是“大步跨过去”。比喻不拘小节，对小问题、小麻烦毫不在意地忽略过去，直接跳到下一个阶段。有时也指强行忽略问题，掩盖矛盾。
explanation_english: Literally means "to stride over". Figuratively, it means to not be bothered by small details or problems, to gloss over them and move on to the next stage directly. Sometimes it can also mean to forcibly ignore a problem and cover up a contradiction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好粗疏，有啲小問題都大步𨈇過就算。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 cou1 so1, jau5 di1 siu2 man6 tai4 dou1 daai6 bou6 lam1 gwo3 zau6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很粗心，有些小问题都忽略过去就算了。
examples.english_sentence: He's very careless in his work, he just glosses over minor problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事咁嚴重，唔可以大步𨈇過㗎，一定要查清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 gam3 jim4 zung6, m4 ho2 ji5 daai6 bou6 lam1 gwo3 gaa3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 caa4 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事这么严重，不可以忽略过去，一定要调查清楚。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is so serious, we can't just gloss over it, we must investigate thoroughly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋有啲爭拗，不過佢哋都選擇大步𨈇過，唔想影響感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jau5 di1 zaang1 aau3, bat1 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 dou1 syun2 zaak6 daai6 bou6 lam1 gwo3, m4 soeng2 jing2 hoeng2 gam2 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们有些争吵，不过他们都选择忽略过去，不想影响感情。
examples.english_sentence: They had some arguments, but they chose to gloss over them, not wanting to affect their relationship.

mandarin_meaning: 大显神威, 表现出色
english_meaning: to completely dominate, to show impressive power and skill, to utterly crush the competition
explanation_mandarin: 形容在某个领域或比赛中表现极其出色，将所有对手压倒。
explanation_english: Describes performing exceptionally well in a certain field or competition, overwhelming all opponents. It implies showing great power and skill, often in a competitive situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺場波度大殺三方，幫球隊攞咗冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 coeng4 bo1 dou6 daai6 saat3 saam1 fong1, bong1 kau4 deoi2 lo2 zo2 gun1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在比赛中大显身手，帮助球队获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He completely dominated in the game and helped the team win the championship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次考試佢大殺三方，攞咗全班第一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 haau2 si5 keoi5 daai6 saat3 saam1 fong1, lo2 zo2 cyun4 baan1 dai6 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试他表现出色，获得了全班第一。
examples.english_sentence: He performed exceptionally well in this exam and got first place in the class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺投資界大殺三方，賺咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tau4 zi1 gaai3 daai6 saat3 saam1 fong1, zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在投资界大显身手，赚了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He showed impressive skill in the investment world and made a lot of money.

english_meaning: to sweep all before one, to dominate the field, to be invincible
explanation_mandarin: 形容在某个领域或游戏中表现出色，战胜所有对手，无人能敌。
explanation_english: Describes someone performing exceptionally well in a certain field or game, defeating all opponents and being unmatched.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺場波度大殺四方，攞咗好多分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 coeng4 bo1 dou6 daai6 saat3 sei3 fong1, lo2 zo2 ho2 do1 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在球赛中大显身手，得了好多分。
examples.english_sentence: He dominated the game, scoring a lot of points.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個創業比賽佢哋隊大殺四方，最後攞到冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cong3 jip6 bei2 coi3 keoi5 dei6 deoi2 daai6 saat3 sei3 fong1, zeoi3 hau6 lo2 dou2 gwun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个创业比赛中，他们队大显身手，最后获得了冠军。
examples.english_sentence: Their team dominated the startup competition and finally won the championship.

english_meaning: general climate, overall situation, prevailing trend
explanation_mandarin: 指大的社会环境、经济环境、政治环境等，也指整体的趋势。
explanation_english: Refers to the general social, economic, or political environment; also refers to the overall trend or prevailing conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家嘅經濟大氣候唔好，搵工都難咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ge3 ging1 zai3 daai6 hei3 hau6 m4 hou2, wan2 gung1 dou1 naan4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的经济大环境不好，找工作也难了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The current economic climate is not good, making it much harder to find a job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺而家咁嘅大氣候底下，創業真係好大挑戰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji4 gaa1 gam3 ge3 daai6 hei3 hau6 dai2 haa6, cong3 jip6 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 tiu1 zin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在现在这样的大环境下，创业真的是很大的挑战。
examples.english_sentence: Under the current prevailing conditions, starting a business is a really big challenge.

english_meaning: atmospheric pressure
explanation_mandarin: 地球周围空气的压力。
explanation_english: The pressure exerted by the weight of the atmosphere above a given point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅大氣壓好似比較低，覺得有啲翳悶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 daai6 hei3 aat3 hou2 ci5 bei2 gaau3 dai1, gok3 dak1 jau5 di1 ai3 mun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的大气压好像比较低，觉得有点闷。
examples.english_sentence: The atmospheric pressure seems quite low today, I feel a bit stuffy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天氣報告話聽日大氣壓會上升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 hei3 bou3 gou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 daai6 hei3 aat3 wui5 soeng5 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天气预报说明天大气压会上升。
examples.english_sentence: The weather forecast says the atmospheric pressure will rise tomorrow.

english_meaning: atmosphere
explanation_mandarin: 包围地球或者其他星球的气体层。
explanation_english: The layer of gases surrounding the Earth or another planet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大氣層保護地球免受太陽嘅有害輻射。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 hei3 cang4 bou2 wu6 dei6 kau4 min5 sau6 taai3 joeng4 ge3 hau6 hoi6 fuk1 se6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大气层保护地球免受太阳的有害辐射。
examples.english_sentence: The atmosphere protects the Earth from the sun's harmful radiation.

mandarin_meaning: 无线电波；空气中的电波
english_meaning: radio waves; the airwaves
explanation_mandarin: 指通过大气层传播的无线电波，通常用于广播、电视等无线通讯。在口语中，有时也指无线电或电视广播。
explanation_english: Refers to radio waves that propagate through the atmosphere, commonly used for wireless communication such as radio and television broadcasting. In colloquial speech, it can also refer to radio or television broadcasts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先個電視節目嘅內容都唔錯，不過接收大氣電波差咗啲，有啲唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 go3 din6 si6 zit3 muk6 ge3 noi6 yung6 dou1 m4 co3, bat1 gwo3 zip3 sau1 daai6 hei3 din6 bo1 caa1 zo2 di1, jau5 di1 m4 cing1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那个电视节目的内容还不错，不过接收大气电波差了点，有些不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The content of that TV program was not bad, but the reception of radio waves was a bit poor and unclear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人好多都喺網上睇電視，好少用大氣電波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 hou2 do1 dou1 hai2 mong5 soeng6 tai2 din6 si6, hou2 siu2 yung6 daai6 hei3 din6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都在网上看电视，很少用无线电波。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people watch TV online and rarely use radio waves.

mandarin_meaning: 大水; 指慷慨解囊，大笔花费
english_meaning: Flood; Generous spending; big spender; lavish
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是大洪水。引申义指某人慷慨解囊，花钱大手大脚。形容一个人很阔绰，像水一样花钱。
explanation_english: Literally means 'big water' or 'flood.' Figuratively, it describes someone who spends money lavishly or is very generous. It can also be used to describe a big spender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日請我哋食飯，真係大水!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 dei6 sik6 faan6, zan1 hai6 daai6 seoi2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是请我们吃饭，真是太慷慨了！
examples.english_sentence: He always treats us to meals; he's such a big spender!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年落咗好多大水，好多地方都浸哂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 daai6 seoi2, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 zam3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年下了很多大雨，很多地方都被淹没了。
examples.english_sentence: There have been many floods this year, and many places are submerged.

english_meaning: Deep pockets; major financial backer; cash cow
explanation_mandarin: 指经济实力雄厚，提供大量资金支持的人或机构。通常用于形容主要的赞助者或投资者。
explanation_english: Refers to a person or organization with significant financial resources that provides substantial financial support. Commonly used to describe a major sponsor or investor; a 'cash cow'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司搞活動，間銀行係佢哋嘅大水喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 gaau2 wut6 dung6, gaan1 ngan4 hong4 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 daai6 seoi2 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司举办活动，那家银行是他们的主要赞助商。
examples.english_sentence: Their company is organizing an event, and that bank is their major financial backer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥中咗六合彩，依家佢變咗我哋屋企嘅大水喉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, ji1 gaa1 keoi5 bin3 zo2 ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ge3 daai6 seoi2 hau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥中了彩票，现在他变成我们家里的主要经济来源了。
examples.english_sentence: My brother won the lottery, and now he's become the cash cow for our family.

english_meaning: Tai Shui Hang (place name)
explanation_mandarin: 香港新界沙田区的一个地方名，位于马鞍山南部。
explanation_english: Tai Shui Hang is a place name in Sha Tin District, New Territories, Hong Kong, located in the south of Ma On Shan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺大水坑附近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 daai6 seoi2 haang1 fu6 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在靠近大水坑的地方。
examples.english_sentence: I live near Tai Shui Hang.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大水坑站係一個港鐵站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 seoi2 haang1 zaam6 hai6 jat1 go3 gong2 tit3 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大水坑站是一个港铁站。
examples.english_sentence: Tai Shui Hang Station is an MTR station.

english_meaning: idiot; fool; simpleton
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，指愚蠢、笨拙的人。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, refers to a stupid, clumsy, or foolish person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做乜嘢咁蠢啊？真係個大汗嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 mat1 je5 gam3 ceon2 aa3? zan1 hai6 go3 daai6 hon6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你怎么这么笨啊？真是个笨蛋。
examples.english_sentence: Why are you being so stupid? You're really an idiot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢講嘅嘢，佢係個大汗嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, keoi5 hai6 go3 daai6 hon6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他说的话，他是个傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says, he's a fool.

english_meaning: Sweating profusely, drenched in sweat (big sweat piling on small sweat)
explanation_mandarin: 形容因为非常劳累或天气炎热而大量出汗。
explanation_english: Describes the state of sweating profusely, usually due to strenuous activity or hot weather. The imagery is of large beads of sweat piling on smaller beads of sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬完屋，我已經大汗疊細汗喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 jyun4 uk1, ngo5 ji5 ging1 daai6 hon6 dip6 sai3 hon6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬完家，我已经汗流浃背了。
examples.english_sentence: After moving house, I'm already drenched in sweat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣真係熱到大汗疊細汗，一落街就濕晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 zan1 hai6 jit6 dou3 daai6 hon6 dip6 sai3 hon6, jat1 lok6 gaai1 zau6 sap1 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气真热，热得汗流浃背，一下街就湿透了。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so hot today that I'm drenched in sweat, I'm soaked as soon as I go outside.

english_meaning: bragging, boastful talk, a braggart
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人喜欢说大话，吹牛，夸大其词。也可以指说大话的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who likes to brag, boast, or exaggerate. It can also refer to a person who brags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪聽佢吹啦，佢成日都係度放大大沙炮㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 teng1 keoi5 cheoi1 laa1, keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hai6 dou6 fong3 daai6 daai6 saa1 paau3 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别听他吹牛了，他整天都在那里吹牛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to him bragging, he's always exaggerating there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條友仔真係成個大沙炮咁，講嘢都唔靠譜嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 jau5 zai2 zan1 hai6 sing4 go3 daai6 saa1 paau3 gam2, gong2 je5 dou1 m4 kaau3 pou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人真是个大话王，说话都不靠谱的。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is such a braggart, his words are not reliable.

mandarin_meaning: 大招 / 高招 / 好办法

explanation_english: Refers to a movie with a large budget, grand scenes, and high box office expectations. It implies a significant production and often refers to a blockbuster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年暑假有好多大片上映，好期待啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 syu2 gaa3 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 pin3 soeng5 jing2, hou2 kei4 doi6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年暑假有很多大制作电影上映，好期待啊！
examples.english_sentence: There are many blockbuster movies being released this summer, I'm really looking forward to them!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戏嘅制作好认真，睇得出系一部大片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 zai3 zok3 hou2 jin6 zan1, tai2 dak1 ceot1 hai6 jat1 bou6 daai6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的制作很认真，看得出来是一部大制作电影。
examples.english_sentence: The production of this movie is very serious, you can tell it's a blockbuster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想拍一部屬於香港嘅大片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 paak3 jat1 bou6 suk6 jyu1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 daai6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想拍一部属于香港的大制作电影。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to make a Hong Kong blockbuster.

english_meaning: Big shot, celebrity, to act like a big shot, to throw one's weight around
explanation_mandarin: 指名气很大，很有影响力的人；也指摆架子，自以为是，耍特权的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with great fame and influence; it also refers to someone putting on airs, being self-important, and abusing privileges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家好似變咗個大牌噉，成日都要人哋服侍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 ci5 bin3 zo2 go3 daai6 paai2 gam2, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 jan4 dei6 fuk6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在好像变成了一个大腕儿一样，总是要别人伺候。
examples.english_sentence: He seems to have turned into a big shot now, always wanting to be served.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大牌啦，大家同事嚟㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 paai2 laa1, daai6 gaa1 tung4 si6 lai4 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么耍大牌了，大家都是同事嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act like such a big shot, we are all colleagues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個明星真係好大牌，出入都要幾個人保護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ming4 sing1 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 paai2, ceot1 jap6 dou1 jiu3 gei2 go3 jan4 bou2 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个明星真是好大腕儿，出入都要几个人保护。
examples.english_sentence: This celebrity is really a big shot, needing several people to protect him when he goes out.

english_meaning: Open-air food stall; street food stall
explanation_mandarin: 香港一种露天经营的熟食档口，通常在街边或巷子里摆设，提供价廉物美的食物。
explanation_english: A type of open-air cooked food stall in Hong Kong, typically set up on streets or in alleys, offering affordable and delicious food.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去大牌檔食飯啦，好鬼抵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 daai6 paai4 dong3 sik6 faan6 laa1, hou2 gwai2 dai2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去大排档吃饭吧，非常划算。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go eat at a street food stall tonight, it's very affordable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前香港好多大牌檔，依家少咗好多喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 daai6 paai4 dong3, ji1 gaa1 siu2 zo2 hou2 do1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前香港有很多大排档，现在少了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: There used to be many open-air food stalls in Hong Kong, but there are much fewer now.

english_meaning: molar (tooth)
explanation_mandarin: 指口腔中用于磨碎食物的牙齿，位于口腔后部。
explanation_english: Refers to the teeth located at the back of the mouth that are used for grinding food. Molars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有隻大牙蛀咗，要去睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zek3 daai6 ngaa4 zyu3 zo2, jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ngaa4 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一颗臼齿蛀掉了，要去去看牙医。
examples.english_sentence: He has a molar that decayed, he needs to see the dentist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食嘢嘅時候要小心，唔好咬崩大牙呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 je5 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, m4 hou2 ngaau5 bang1 daai6 ngaa4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃东西的时候要小心，不要咬崩大牙啊。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when eating, don't chip your molar.

english_meaning: Big boss; powerful person; expert; (literally) big cow
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域非常厉害，非常权威的人物。也指黑社会中的大佬。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is very powerful and authoritative in a certain field. It can also refer to a big boss in the underworld/triads.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺金融界係個大牛嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam1 jung4 gaai3 hai6 go3 daai6 ngau4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在金融界是个大人物。
examples.english_sentence: He is a big shot in the financial world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好惹佢，佢係呢度嘅大牛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ze2 keoi5, keoi5 hai6 ni1 dou6 ge3 daai6 ngau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好别惹他，他是这里的老大。
examples.english_sentence: You better not mess with him, he's the big boss here.

mandarin_meaning: 固执的人; 不讲理的人; 死脑筋的人
english_meaning: Stubborn person; unreasonable person; blockhead; thickhead
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，不听劝告，不讲道理，像一头很大的牛和乌龟一样迟钝、顽固。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very stubborn, doesn't listen to advice, and is unreasonable, like a large ox and tortoise – slow and stubborn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大牛龜，講極都唔聽！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 ngau4 gwai1, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 teng1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是个榆木脑袋，怎么说都不听！
examples.english_sentence: You're such a stubborn person, you never listen no matter what I say!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大牛龜嚟㗎，你唔好期望佢會改變主意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 ngau4 gwai1 lai4 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 keoi5 wui5 goi2 bin3 zyu2 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个死脑筋，你别指望他会改变主意了。
examples.english_sentence: He's a real blockhead, don't expect him to change his mind.

synonyms: 死牛一面頸 (sei2 ngau4 jat1 min6 geng2)

english_meaning: Barrister, prominent lawyer, top litigator
explanation_mandarin: 在香港，指资深的、有经验的律师，尤其擅长诉讼的律师。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong, refers to a senior and experienced barrister, especially one skilled in litigation. Often implies a high degree of competence and success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好出名嘅大狀，好多官司都係佢打贏嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 daai6 zong6, hou2 do1 gun1 si1 dou1 hai6 keoi5 daa2 wing4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一个很有名的大律师，很多官司都是他打赢的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very famous barrister, and he has won many lawsuits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 想請個大狀嚟打呢單官司，費用可能好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng2 ceng2 go3 daai6 zong6 lai4 daa2 ni1 daan1 gun1 si1, fai3 jung6 ho2 nang4 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 想请一个大律师来打这场官司，费用可能很贵。
examples.english_sentence: Hiring a prominent barrister to handle this case might be very expensive.

english_meaning: To achieve a complete victory; to win a resounding victory
explanation_mandarin: 指获得全面的、彻底的胜利。
explanation_english: Refers to achieving a comprehensive and complete victory. Implies a resounding win with no significant setbacks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋大獲全勝呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 daai6 wok6 cyun4 sing3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们大获全胜啊！
examples.english_sentence: We achieved a complete victory in this competition!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多努力，我哋終於可以大獲全勝噉完成呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 nou5 lik6, ngo5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 daai6 wok6 cyun4 sing3 gam2 jyun4 sing4 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多努力，我们终于可以大获全胜地完成这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: After so much effort, we were finally able to complete this project with a resounding victory.

mandarin_meaning: 大王; 老大; 厉害的人
english_meaning: King; boss; big shot; powerful person; (in games) winning card
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指君主或首领。2. 比喻在某方面很厉害的人。 3. (游戏) 指牌面很大的牌。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to a king, monarch, or leader. 2. A metaphor for someone who is very skilled or powerful in a certain area. 3. (In games) Refers to a high-ranking card, like an Ace.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司係大王咁嘅地位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hai6 daai6 wong4 gam2 ge3 dei6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司里地位很高，像个老大一样。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very high position in the company, like a boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀好叻㗎，次次都攞到大王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 hou2 lek1 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 lo2 dou2 daai6 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将很厉害，每次都能拿到大牌。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good at playing mahjong, he always gets the winning card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地區佢係大王，冇人夠佢鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 keoi1 keoi5 hai6 daai6 wong4, mou5 jan4 gau3 keoi5 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这个地区他是老大，没人能和他斗。
examples.english_sentence: He is the boss in this area, no one can compete with him.

english_meaning: Dull eyes, lifeless eyes, fish eyes
explanation_mandarin: 形容眼睛无神，像死鱼一样，缺乏活力。通常指眼神呆滞、空洞，没有生气。
explanation_english: Describes eyes that are dull, lifeless, and lacking vitality, like a dead fish. Usually refers to a vacant, empty stare with no energy or spirit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對大王眼，好似成日都冇瞓醒咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 daai6 wong4 ngaan5, hou2 ci5 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 fan3 sing2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他眼睛无神，好像整天都没睡醒一样。
examples.english_sentence: His eyes are so dull, it's like he's never fully awake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日對住個電腦，對眼會變大王眼㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 deoi3 zyu6 go3 din6 nou5, deoi3 ngaan5 wui5 bin3 daai6 wong4 ngaan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要整天对着电脑，眼睛会变得无神的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't stare at the computer all day, your eyes will become dull.

english_meaning: Senior executive; boss; taipan (historical)
explanation_mandarin: 在香港，历史上指洋行的高级职员或老板。现在泛指公司或机构中的高级管理人员，也可用作对老板的称呼。
explanation_english: Historically, in Hong Kong, it referred to senior executives or bosses of foreign trading companies (Hongs). Now, it generally refers to senior management personnel in a company or organization. It can also be used as a term for "boss". It carries a connotation of power and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅大班好後生㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 baan1 hou2 hau6 saang1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的老板很年轻。
examples.english_sentence: The boss of their company is very young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講佢升咗做大班喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 daai6 baan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说他升职做高级管理人员了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he got promoted to a senior executive position.

english_meaning: Executive chair, boss's chair
explanation_mandarin: 通常指公司或机构的高级管理人员使用的椅子，通常比较舒适和气派。
explanation_english: Refers to the chair typically used by senior management in a company or organization, usually comfortable and imposing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，終於可以坐大班椅喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 co5 daai6 baan1 ji2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，终于可以坐老板椅了。
examples.english_sentence: After his promotion, he can finally sit in an executive chair.

english_meaning: Stadium, especially a large football stadium
explanation_mandarin: 指大型的足球比赛场地，通常指香港大球场。
explanation_english: Refers to a large football stadium. Commonly refers to the Hong Kong Stadium.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋去大球場睇波啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 daai6 kau4 coeng4 tai2 bo1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去大球场看球赛吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the stadium to watch the football match tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大球場個位好難book㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 kau4 coeng4 go3 wai2 hou2 naan4 buk1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大球场的位置很难预订的。
examples.english_sentence: The seats at the stadium are very difficult to book.

english_meaning: marble
explanation_mandarin: 一种具有美丽花纹的石材，常用于建筑和装饰。
explanation_english: A metamorphic rock with a distinct veined or mottled appearance, commonly used for building and decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張餐枱係用大理石做㗎，好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 caan1 toi2 hai6 yung6 daai6 lei5 sek6 zou6 gaa3, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张餐桌是用大理石做的，真漂亮！
examples.english_sentence: This dining table is made of marble, it's so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店嘅大堂鋪咗好多大理石，好豪華。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 daai6 tong4 pou1 zo2 hou2 do1 daai6 lei5 sek6, hou2 hou4 waa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店的大堂铺了很多大理石，很豪华。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel lobby is paved with a lot of marble, it's very luxurious.

english_meaning: Male chauvinist; Macho man
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性带有沙文主义思想，认为男性应该优于女性，并在家庭和社会中占据主导地位。
explanation_english: Describes a man who holds chauvinistic views, believing that men are superior to women and should dominate in family and society. It can also simply refer to a man who is perceived as overly masculine or macho, often in a negative way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好大男人，乜都話自己啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 daai6 naam4 jan2, mat1 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很具有大男子主义，什么都说自己是对的。
examples.english_sentence: He's a male chauvinist; he always says he's right about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大男人啦，都要尊重下人哋嘅意见嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 naam4 jan2 laa1, dou1 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么大男子主义，也要尊重一下别人的意见啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a male chauvinist; you should also respect other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔少人覺得佢太過大男人，唔識得體諒人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 siu2 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 taai3 gwo3 daai6 naam4 jan2, m4 sik1 dak1 tai2 loeng6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不少人觉得他太过于大男子主义，不懂得体谅人。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think he's too much of a macho man and doesn't know how to understand others.

english_meaning: roughly, approximately, generally, in outline
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概，不详细，不精确。
explanation_english: Indicates something is approximate, not detailed, or not precise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大略知道發生咩事啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 loek6 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大概知道发生什么事了。
examples.english_sentence: I roughly know what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個計劃大略係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gai3 waak6 daai6 loek6 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划大致是这样。
examples.english_sentence: The plan is roughly like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以大略估計下成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 daai6 loek6 gu2 gai3 haa5 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以大致估计一下成本。
examples.english_sentence: I can roughly estimate the cost.

english_meaning: big idiot, big fool, simpleton
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容一个人非常愚笨，头脑简单。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who is very foolish, stupid, or simple-minded. The literal translation is "big sweet potato."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁都唔識，真係大番薯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 daai6 faan1 syu4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个都不懂，真是个大笨蛋！
examples.english_sentence: You don't even know this? You're such a big idiot!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁蠢啦，唔好做隻大番薯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 ceon2 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 zek3 daai6 faan1 syu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么笨了，别做个傻瓜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, don't be a fool.

english_meaning: a large sum of money; wealthy; loaded
explanation_mandarin: 指很大的一笔钱，或者形容某人很有钱。
explanation_english: Refers to a large sum of money, or describes someone who is very wealthy; 'loaded'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間公司賺咗好多錢，真係大疊水啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 gung1 si1 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2, zan1 hai6 daai6 dip6 seoi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的公司赚了很多钱，真是很有钱了。
examples.english_sentence: His company made a lot of money, he's really loaded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明買咗層樓，睇嚟佢都幾大疊水喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 maai5 zo2 cang4 lau2, tai2 lai4 keoi5 dou1 gei2 daai6 dip6 seoi2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明买了套房子，看来他挺有钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming bought a flat, seems like he's quite wealthy.

english_meaning: Recovered from a serious illness (but still weak)
explanation_mandarin: 指大病刚刚痊愈，身体还比较虚弱，需要休养。
explanation_english: Describes the state of being newly recovered from a serious illness. Implies a state of weakness and a need for continued rest and recuperation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大病初癒，唔好叫佢做咁多嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 beng6 co1 jyu6, m4 hou2 giu3 keoi5 zou6 gam3 do1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大病初愈，不要叫他做那么多事了。
examples.english_sentence: He's just recovered from a serious illness, don't ask him to do so much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大病初癒，仲係有啲虛弱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 beng6 co1 jyu6, zung6 hai6 jau5 di1 heoi1 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大病初愈，还是有点虚弱。
examples.english_sentence: I've just recovered from a serious illness, and I'm still a bit weak.

english_meaning: strong addiction; strong craving; big appetite for something
explanation_mandarin: 指对某事物有很强的瘾头或强烈的爱好，无法自拔。
explanation_english: Refers to a strong addiction or intense passion for something, making it difficult to stop or resist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打機打到有大癮，日日都要打幾個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gei1 daa2 dou3 jau5 daai6 jan5, jat1 jat6 dou1 jiu3 daa2 gei2 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他玩游戏上瘾了，每天都要玩几个小时。
examples.english_sentence: He's addicted to playing video games and plays for several hours every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我食辣野食到有大癮，唔食就覺得唔夠喉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik6 laat6 je5 sik6 dou3 jau5 daai6 jan5, m4 sik6 zau6 gok3 dak1 m4 gau3 hau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我吃辣的吃上瘾了，不吃就觉得不过瘾。
examples.english_sentence: I'm addicted to eating spicy food, and I don't feel satisfied if I don't have it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇港劇睇到有大癮，一集接一集咁睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 gong2 kek6 tai2 dou3 jau5 daai6 jan5, jat1 zaap6 zip3 jat1 zaap6 gam2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看香港电视剧上瘾了，一集接着一集地看。
examples.english_sentence: I'm addicted to watching Hong Kong dramas, watching one episode after another.

english_meaning: Crazy; insane; mad; outrageous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为举止非常疯狂、不理智，超出常理范围。
explanation_english: Describes someone's behavior as extremely crazy, irrational, and beyond the bounds of normal reason. Can also be used to describe something outrageous or unbelievable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽人勸，走去跳海，真係大癲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 teng1 jan4 hyun3, zau2 heoi3 tiu3 hoi2, zan1 hai6 daai6 din1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听别人的劝告，跑去跳海，真是疯了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't listen to anyone's advice and went to jump into the sea, he's really crazy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你份工咁辛苦人工又低，仲唔辭職？你都大癲㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 gung1 gam3 san1 fu2 jan4 gung1 jau6 dai1, zung6 m4 ci4 zik1? nei5 dou1 daai6 din1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你工作这么辛苦工资又低，还不辞职？你都疯了吧！
examples.english_sentence: Your job is so hard and the salary is low, and you're still not quitting? You're crazy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食咁貴，真係大癲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 gam3 gwai3, zan1 hai6 daai6 din1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西这么贵，真是离谱！
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is so expensive, it's outrageous!

english_meaning: acting crazy, being completely bonkers
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人行为举止非常疯狂、不正常，失去理智的状态。
explanation_english: Describes someone behaving in an extremely crazy, erratic, or irrational manner; acting completely bonkers or out of control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日考試肥佬，今日就大癲大廢咁，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 haau2 si3 fei4 lou2, gam1 jat6 zau6 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 gam2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天考试不及格，今天就疯疯癫癫的，不知道搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam yesterday, and today he's acting completely crazy, I don't know what's going on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大癲大廢啦，會嚇親人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 laa1, wui5 haak3 can1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么疯疯癫癫的，会吓到人的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so crazy, you'll scare people.

english_meaning: Crazy and eccentric; acting like a madman
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人行为举止非常疯狂、不正常，像疯子一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is behaving in a crazy, erratic, or eccentric manner, as if they are mad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都大癲大癈咁，真係唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天都疯疯癫癫的，真不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting crazy, I really don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大癲大癈啦，人哋會以為你痴線㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 ji5 wai4 nei5 ci1 sin3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么疯疯癫癫的，别人会以为你疯了的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so crazy, people will think you're mad.

english_meaning: crazy, mad, scatterbrained, wild, erratic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人行为疯癫，不顾后果，像个疯子一样。
explanation_english: Describes someone who acts crazy, recklessly, and without consideration for the consequences; like a lunatic. Often used to describe someone who is overly energetic, excitable, and somewhat unpredictable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大癲大肺咁，真係唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 gam2, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 keoi5 lam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天疯疯癫癫的，真不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always acting so crazy; I really don't know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大癲大肺啦，靜啲得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 din1 daai6 fai3 laa1, zing6 di1 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么疯疯癫癫了，安静点行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so crazy, can you be a little quieter?

english_meaning: to strike it rich; to make a fortune; to have great luck
explanation_mandarin: 表示发大财，运气非常好。
explanation_english: To have great fortune, especially in a monetary sense; to strike it rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望今年可以大發啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 daai6 faat3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望今年可以大发呀！
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can strike it rich this year!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗隻熱門股票，結果大發。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 zek3 jit6 mun4 gu2 piu3, git3 gwo2 daai6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了热门股票，结果大发了。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a popular stock and ended up making a fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新年大發，萬事如意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 daai6 faat3, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年大发，万事如意！
examples.english_sentence: Wishing you great fortune and all the best in the New Year!

english_meaning: Nouveau riche; newly rich person; someone who has suddenly become wealthy
explanation_mandarin: 指突然变得富有的人，通常带有一定的贬义，暗示其品味或教养可能还不够高，即使很有钱。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who has suddenly become wealthy, often with a slightly negative connotation, implying that their taste or refinement may not be up to par, even though they are very rich.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，一下子變咗個大發仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, jat1 haa6 zi2 bin3 zo2 go3 daai6 faat3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票，一下子变成了一个爆发户。
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery and suddenly became a nouveau riche.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲講嘢，陣間畀人當你係大發仔就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 gong2 je5, zan6 gaan1 bei2 jan4 dong3 nei5 hai6 daai6 faat3 zai2 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大声说话，一会儿被人当成暴发户就不好了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk so loudly, or people will think you are a nouveau riche.

english_meaning: to show great mercy; to have a heart of gold; to be extremely kind
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人极具怜悯心，做出非常仁慈的行为。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely compassionate and performs a very merciful act. It often implies that the person is going above and beyond what is expected or deserved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到個乞丐咁慘，就大發慈悲畀咗好多錢佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 hat1 gaai2 gam3 caam2, zau6 daai6 faat3 ci4 bei1 bei2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到那个乞丐那么可怜，就大发慈悲给了他很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing how miserable the beggar was, he showed great mercy and gave him a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆今次大發慈悲，畀我哋放多一日假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 gam1 ci3 daai6 faat3 ci4 bei1, bei2 ngo5 dei6 fong3 do1 jat1 jat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板这次大发慈悲，让我们多放一天假。
examples.english_sentence: The boss was very generous this time and gave us an extra day off.

mandarin_meaning: 大发雷霆 (dà fā léi tíng)
english_meaning: to fly into a rage; to be furious; to blow one's top
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常生气，像打雷一样。
explanation_english: Describes being extremely angry, like a thunderclap.  It signifies losing control and becoming explosively angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸知道我考試唔合格，即刻大發雷霆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa1 zi1 dou3 ngo5 haau2 si5 m4 hap6 gaak3, zik1 hak1 daai6 faat3 leoi4 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸知道我考试不及格，立刻大发雷霆。
examples.english_sentence: My dad found out I failed the exam and immediately flew into a rage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢遲到咗成個鐘，老闆梗係大發雷霆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci4 dou3 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1, lou5 baan2 gang2 hai6 daai6 faat3 leoi4 ting4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他迟到了一个小时，老板肯定会大发雷霆的。
examples.english_sentence: He was an hour late, the boss was definitely going to blow his top.

english_meaning: Chinese cabbage, napa cabbage
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的蔬菜，叶子大而白，头部紧密。
explanation_english: A common vegetable with large white leaves and a tightly packed head; napa cabbage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日阿媽買咗棵大白菜，今晚有排骨煲大白菜食喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 aa3 maa1 maai5 zo2 fo2 daai6 baak6 coi3, gam1 maan5 jau5 paai4 gwat1 bou1 daai6 baak6 coi3 sik6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天妈妈买了一棵大白菜，今晚有排骨炖大白菜吃了。
examples.english_sentence: Today, mom bought a head of napa cabbage. We'll have pork rib and napa cabbage stew tonight.

mandarin_meaning: 形象工程，华而不实的昂贵项目
english_meaning: white elephant (a burdensome or useless possession)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻耗费大量金钱但毫无用处，或者效用不大的大型工程或项目。通常指政府或机构投资，但未能产生预期效益，反而成为负担。
explanation_english: A metaphor for a large, expensive project or possession that serves no real purpose and is often a financial burden. It usually refers to government or institutional investments that fail to generate the expected benefits and instead become a liability.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個機場起咗咁耐，都冇乜人用，真係一個大白象工程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gei1 coeng4 hei2 zo2 gam3 noi6, dou1 mou5 mat1 jan4 yung6, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 baak6 zoeng6 gung1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个机场建了这么久，都没什么人用，真是一个形象工程。
examples.english_sentence: This airport has been built for so long, but few people use it. It's really a white elephant project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府嗰個新起嘅體育館，又貴又少人用，擺明係大白象啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zheng3 fu2 go2 go3 san1 hei2 ge3 tai2 yuk6 gun2, jau6 gwai3 jau6 siu2 jan4 yung6, baai2 ming4 hai6 daai6 baak6 zoeng6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府新盖的那个体育馆，又贵又少人用，明显是形象工程了。
examples.english_sentence: The new stadium built by the government is expensive and rarely used. It's obviously a white elephant.
