examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢睇落好似大肚髧噉喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tai2 lok6 hou2 ci5 daai6 tou5 dam6 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她看起来好像怀孕了。
examples.english_sentence: She looks like she's pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔怪得佢條腰粗咗咁多，原來係大肚髧呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 gwaai3 dak1 keoi5 tiu4 jiu1 cou1 zo2 gam3 do1, jyun4 lai4 hai6 daai6 tou5 dam6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 难怪她的腰粗了这么多，原来是怀孕了啊！
examples.english_sentence: No wonder her waist is so much thicker, it turns out she's pregnant!

english_meaning: Pregnant (derogatory, referring to someone with a beer belly)
explanation_mandarin: 贬义词，形容男性肚子很大，像怀孕一样。通常指有啤酒肚。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used to describe a man with a large belly, resembling a pregnant woman. It usually refers to someone with a beer belly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條大肚腩咁大，成個大肚黃咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 daai6 tou5 naan5 gam3 daai6, seng4 go3 daai6 tou5 wong4 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的啤酒肚那么大，像个大肚子一样。
examples.english_sentence: His beer belly is so big, he looks like he's pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再飲啤酒喇，再飲落去就變咗大肚黃㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 yam2 be1 zau2 laa1, zoi3 yam2 lok6 heoi3 zau6 bin3 zo2 daai6 tou5 wong4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再喝啤酒了，再喝下去就要变成大肚汉了。
examples.english_sentence: You shouldn't drink beer anymore, if you keep drinking you'll turn into a potbelly.

english_meaning: thigh
explanation_mandarin: 指腿的上部，从髋关节到膝盖的部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the upper part of the leg, from the hip joint to the knee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條大肶好粗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 daai6 bei2 hou2 cou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的大腿很粗。
examples.english_sentence: His thighs are very thick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 跑步嘅時候，你會用到好多大肶嘅肌肉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: paau2 bou6 ge3 si4 hau6, nei5 wui5 yung6 dou2 hou2 do1 daai6 bei2 ge3 gei1 yuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步的时候，你会用到很多大腿的肌肉。
examples.english_sentence: When running, you use a lot of thigh muscles.

english_meaning: powerful, awesome, amazing, capable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事物非常厉害，能力很强，令人赞叹。 多用于口语，带有一种赞赏和略带夸张的语气。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being very powerful, awesome, amazing, or capable. It's often used in colloquial Cantonese and carries a tone of admiration and slight exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗經理，真係大能啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5, zan1 hai6 daai6 nang4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了经理，真是厉害啊！
examples.english_sentence: He became a manager at such a young age, he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦嘅性能好大能㗎，可以同時處理好多任務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 sing3 nang4 hou2 daai6 nang4 gaa3, ho2 ji5 tung4 si4 cyu5 lei5 hou2 do1 jam6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑的性能很强大，可以同时处理很多任务。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is very powerful; it can handle many tasks simultaneously.

english_meaning: thigh
explanation_mandarin: 指腿的上部，从臀部到膝盖之间的部分。
explanation_english: The upper part of the leg, from the hip to the knee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跑步跑到啲大脾好攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 paau2 bou6 paau2 dou3 di1 daai6 pei4 hou2 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他跑步跑得大腿很累。
examples.english_sentence: He ran so much that his thighs are very tired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條褲太窄，搞到我對大脾好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fu3 taai3 zaak3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 deoi3 daai6 pei4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裤子太紧了，弄得我的大腿很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: These pants are too tight, making my thighs feel uncomfortable.

english_meaning: brain
explanation_mandarin: 生物体控制神经系统的主要器官，负责思考、记忆、情感等功能。
explanation_english: The main organ of the nervous system in animals, responsible for functions such as thinking, memory, and emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅大腦好叻，好快就學識晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daai6 nou5 hou2 lek1, hou2 faai3 zau6 hok6 sik1晒 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的大脑很聪明，很快就把所有东西都学会了。
examples.english_sentence: His brain is very clever, he learned everything very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗嘢諗到大腦都停晒機噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 je5 nam2 dou3 daai6 nou5 dou1 ting4晒 gei1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我思考问题想到大脑都像死机了一样。
examples.english_sentence: I was thinking so much that my brain felt like it had crashed.

mandarin_meaning: 笨手笨脚，做事粗心大意
english_meaning: clumsy, heavy-handed, careless (in doing things)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事粗心大意，笨手笨脚，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is clumsy, heavy-handed, and careless in their actions, often resulting in mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好大腳㗎，交畀佢做嘢好牙煙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daai6 goek3 gaa3, gaau1 bei2 keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ngaa4 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很笨手笨脚的，交给他做事很危险。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very clumsy person, it's risky to let him handle the work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大腳啦，整爛晒啲嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 goek3 laa1, zing2 laan6晒啲嘢！
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨手笨脚的，把东西都弄坏了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you're breaking everything!

english_meaning: Bigfoot; someone with large feet
explanation_mandarin: 形容脚很大的人，也指传说中的野人。
explanation_english: Describes a person with large feet. It can also refer to the mythical creature Bigfoot (Sasquatch).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對鞋太大喇，睇嚟佢係大腳八。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 haai4 taai3 daai6 laa3, tai2 lai4 keoi5 hai6 daai6 goek3 baat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的鞋太大了，看来他是大脚。
examples.english_sentence: His shoes are too big, it seems he has big feet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有人話喺郊外見過大腳八，唔知係真定假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 jan4 waa6 hai2 gaau1 ngoi6 gin3 gwo3 daai6 goek3 baat3, m4 zi1 hai6 zan1 ding6 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有人说在郊外见过大脚怪，不知道是真是假。
examples.english_sentence: Some people say they've seen Bigfoot in the countryside, I don't know if it's true or false.

mandarin_meaning: 一笔勾销; 取消; 作废
english_meaning: To completely cancel; to write off; to void; to nullify
explanation_mandarin: 指完全取消或作废，不留任何痕迹。通常用于取消债务、协议或承诺等。
explanation_english: Refers to completely canceling or voiding something, leaving no trace behind. Usually used to cancel debts, agreements, or promises.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢爭我啲錢，我決定大腳勾銷，唔再追佢還啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaang1 ngo5 di1 cin2, ngo5 kyut3 ding6 daai6 goek3 ngau1 siu1, m4 zoi3 zeoi1 keoi5 waan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他欠我的钱，我决定一笔勾销，不再追他还了。
examples.english_sentence: He owes me money, but I've decided to write it off and won't ask him to pay it back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然佢哋肯道歉，不如將件事大腳勾銷算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 keoi5 dei6 hang2 dou6 hip3, bat1 jyu4 zoeng1 gin6 si6 daai6 goek3 ngau1 siu1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然他们肯道歉，不如就把这件事一笔勾销算了。
examples.english_sentence: Since they're willing to apologize, why don't we just call it even and forget about it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約如果搞唔掂，咪大腳勾銷囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 jyu4 gwo2 gaau2 m4 dim6, mai1 daai6 goek3 ngau1 siu1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果这份合同谈不拢，那就取消吧。
examples.english_sentence: If we can't work out this contract, then let's just cancel it.

mandarin_meaning: 指穿着大码鞋的人，也指与穿着大码鞋的人相关的群体或文化。
english_meaning: A person who wears large-sized shoes; also refers to the community or culture associated with people who wear large-sized shoes.
explanation_mandarin: 通常指脚比较大的人，或是指拥有特定鞋码（通常较大）的人群，有时也指与此相关的一种亚文化或群体。
explanation_english: Generally refers to people with large feet, or a group of people with a particular (usually large) shoe size. Sometimes also refers to a subculture or group associated with this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話自己係大腳友，好難買鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 daai6 goek3 jau2, hou2 naan4 maai5 haai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己是大脚，很难买鞋。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's a bigfoot and it's hard to buy shoes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家啲波鞋都有大腳友嘅尺碼，唔使驚買唔到啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 bo1 haai2 dou1 jau5 daai6 goek3 jau2 ge3 cek3 maa5, m4 sai2 geng1 maai5 m4 dou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的运动鞋都有大脚码的，不用担心买不到啦。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, sneakers have sizes for bigfoots, so don't worry about not being able to buy them.

mandarin_meaning: 手脚不干净的人, 小偷
english_meaning: Kleptomaniac, person who steals things, someone with sticky fingers
explanation_mandarin: 形容这个人经常偷东西，手脚不干净，喜欢占小便宜。
explanation_english: Describes someone who frequently steals things, has sticky fingers, and likes to take petty advantages. Literally translates to 'big foot clear'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁信佢啦，佢係個大腳清嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 seon3 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hai6 go3 daai6 goek3 ching1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么相信他，他是个小偷。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him so much, he's a kleptomaniac.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司唔見咗啲文具，懷疑係有個大腳清搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 m4 gin3 zo2 di1 man4 geoi6, waai4 ji4 hai6 jau5 go3 daai6 goek3 ching1 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司不见了一些文具，怀疑是有个手脚不干净的人在捣乱。
examples.english_sentence: Some stationery has gone missing in the company, I suspect someone with sticky fingers is causing trouble.

mandarin_meaning: 简单粗暴地解决问题，大力解围
english_meaning: To kick the ball away to clear the danger (football); A simple and forceful solution to a problem, a quick fix
explanation_mandarin: 源自足球术语，指在防守时，球员为了避免对方进攻，用大力将球踢出危险区域。引申义为简单粗暴地解决问题，通常是指缺乏技巧或考虑不周，但暂时有效的方法。
explanation_english: Originally a football term referring to a defender clearing the ball from a dangerous area with a strong kick. By extension, it means solving a problem in a simple and forceful manner, often lacking finesse or careful consideration, but effective in the short term.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司遇到財政危機，老細唯有大腳解圍，將啲資產賤賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 jyu6 dou2 coi4 zing3 ngai4 gei1, lou5 sai3 wai4 jau5 daai6 goek3 gaai2 wai4, zoeng1 di1 zi1 saan2 zin6 mai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司遇到财政危机，老板只好简单粗暴地解决问题，将一些资产贱卖。
examples.english_sentence: Their company faced a financial crisis, so the boss had to resort to a quick fix by selling off some assets at a low price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次單嘢咁急，我哋唯有大腳解圍住先，遲啲再諗個好啲嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 daan1 je5 gam3 gap1, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 daai6 goek3 gaai2 wai4 zyu6 sin1, ci4 di1 zoi3 nam2 go3 hou2 di1 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的事情这么紧急，我们只能先简单处理一下，以后再想更好的方法。
examples.english_sentence: The matter is so urgent this time that we can only do a quick fix for now, and think of a better method later.

english_meaning: large intestine, large bowel
explanation_mandarin: 指消化系统的一部分，位于小肠之后。
explanation_english: Part of the digestive system, located after the small intestine. Also refers to the culinary dish made from large intestine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想食碗豬雜麵，要多啲大腸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 wun2 zyu1 zaap6 min6, jiu3 do1 di1 daai6 coeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想吃一碗猪杂面，要多一点大肠。
examples.english_sentence: I want to eat a bowl of pork offal noodles, with more large intestine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱做完大腸鏡檢查。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 zou6 jyun4 daai6 coeng2 geng3 gim2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚刚做完大肠镜检查。
examples.english_sentence: He just finished a colonoscopy.

english_meaning: Escherichia coli (E. coli)
explanation_mandarin: 一种常见的细菌，存在于人和动物的肠道中。某些类型的大肠杆菌可能导致疾病。
explanation_english: A common bacterium found in the intestines of humans and animals. Some types of E. coli can cause illness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話我驗到大腸桿菌，要食藥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 jim6 dou2 daai6 coeng2 gon1 kwan2, jiu3 sik6 joek6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说我检查出大肠杆菌，要吃药。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that I tested positive for E. coli and need to take medication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好飲未煮熟嘅水，小心有大腸桿菌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jam2 mei6 zyu2 suk6 ge3 seoi2, siu2 sam1 jau5 daai6 coeng2 gon1 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要喝未煮熟的水，小心有大肠杆菌。
examples.english_sentence: Don't drink uncooked water, be careful of E. coli.

english_meaning: large intestine head (the fattier, upper part of the large intestine)
explanation_mandarin: 猪大肠中最肥美的部分，通常指大肠的起始端。
explanation_english: The fattier, upper part of the large intestine of a pig, considered a delicacy. It is often braised, deep-fried or used in hot pot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅滷味大腸頭好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lou5 mei6 daai6 coeng2 tau4 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的卤味肥肠头很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The braised large intestine head in this restaurant is delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意食炸大腸頭，夠晒香脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 zaa3 daai6 coeng2 tau4, gau3 saai3 hoeng1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢吃炸肥肠头，够香脆。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat deep-fried large intestine head the most; it's crispy and fragrant.

english_meaning: thigh
explanation_mandarin: 指人或动物从膝盖到臀部的那部分。
explanation_english: The part of the human or animal leg between the hip and the knee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙好短，成日都露出大腿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 dyun2, sing4 jat6 dou1 lou6 ceot1 daai6 teoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的裙子很短，总是露出大腿。
examples.english_sentence: Her skirt is very short, always revealing her thighs.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 跑步的时候要用大腿的力量。
examples.english_sentence: You need to use the strength of your thighs when running.

english_meaning: bold; daring; audacious; brave
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人有勇气，敢于冒险或做一些出乎意料的事情。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is courageous, daring, or willing to take risks or do something unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好大膽，走去同老細講佢嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 daam2, zau2 heoi3 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2 keoi5 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很胆大，跑去跟老板说他的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He is really bold, going to tell the boss his opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大膽，竟然敢偷嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 daam2, ging2 jin4 gam2 tau1 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么大胆，竟然敢偷东西！
examples.english_sentence: You are so audacious, how dare you steal!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大膽嘅計劃，最後成功咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 daam2 ge3 gai3 waak6, zeoi3 hau6 sing4 gung1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大胆的计划，最后成功了。
examples.english_sentence: His bold plan was ultimately successful.

english_meaning: Minister; high official; important person; VIP
explanation_mandarin: 指政府中职位很高，权力很大的人物，或者在某个领域里很重要的人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a high-ranking and powerful figure in the government, or an important person in a particular field. Can also refer to a VIP or influential person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家已經係公司嘅大臣，好有影響力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 san4, hou2 jau5 ying2 heong2 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在已经是公司的大人物了，很有影响力。
examples.english_sentence: He is now a VIP in the company and has a lot of influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目有好多大臣參與，成功機會好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 san4 caam1 yu5, sing4 gung1 gei1 wui2 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目有很多重要人物参与，成功的机会很大。
examples.english_sentence: Many important figures are involved in this project, so the chances of success are high.

english_meaning: nature
explanation_mandarin: 指地球上一切天然形成的事物，包括山川、河流、动植物等。
explanation_english: The phenomena of the physical world collectively, including plants, animals, the landscape, and other features and products of the earth, as opposed to humans or human creations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該好好保護大自然。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 hou2 hou2 bou2 wu6 daai6 zi6 jin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该好好保护大自然。
examples.english_sentence: We should protect nature well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意去大自然度行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 yi3 heoi3 daai6 zi6 jin4 dou6 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢去大自然里爬山。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to go hiking in nature.

english_meaning: roughly, approximately, more or less, in general
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概的情況；基本上。
explanation_english: Indicates the general situation; basically, approximately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋大致上傾掂咗個計劃嘅內容啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai6 zai3 soeng6 king1 dim6 zo2 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 noi6 jung4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们大致上把计划的内容谈妥了。
examples.english_sentence: We have roughly agreed on the content of the plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢大致估計咗個成本。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai6 zai3 gu2 gai3 zo2 go3 sing4 bun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他大致估计了成本。
examples.english_sentence: He roughly estimated the cost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大致都係噉啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 zai3 dou1 hai6 gam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大致就是这样了。
examples.english_sentence: That's about it.

english_meaning: generally, roughly, on the whole, more or less
explanation_mandarin: 表示大概的情况，整体上来看。
explanation_english: Indicates a general situation, viewed as a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大致上我都明白你講緊乜嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 zai3 soeng6 ngo5 dou1 ming4 baak6 nei5 gong2 gan2 mat1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大致上我都明白你在说什么了。
examples.english_sentence: Generally, I understand what you are saying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大致上個計劃都傾掂咗，剩低嘅就係啲細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 zai3 soeng6 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 king1 dim6 zo2, sing6 dai1 ge3 zau6 hai6 di1 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 基本上计划都谈妥了，剩下的就是些细节。
examples.english_sentence: The plan is generally settled; all that's left are the details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試大致上都算順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 daai6 zai3 soeng6 dou1 syun3 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试大致上都算顺利。
examples.english_sentence: This exam was, on the whole, quite smooth.

english_meaning: Elder maternal uncle; mother's elder brother
explanation_mandarin: 指母亲的哥哥。
explanation_english: Refers to the older brother of one's mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去大舅屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 daai6 kau5 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去大舅家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to my eldest maternal uncle's house to give New Year's greetings tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大舅對我好好，成日請我食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 kau5 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 ceng2 ngo5 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大舅对我很好，总是请我吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: My eldest maternal uncle is very nice to me, he often treats me to food.

english_meaning: to carry out large-scale construction; to engage in extensive building projects
explanation_mandarin: 大规模地进行土木建筑工程。
explanation_english: To undertake large-scale construction projects, often involving earthworks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府近年喺好多地方都大興土木，起咗好多新嘅建築。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 gan6 nin4 hai2 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 daai6 hing1 tou2 muk6, hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 san1 ge3 gin3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府近年来在很多地方都大兴土木，建了很多新的建筑。
examples.english_sentence: The government has been carrying out large-scale construction projects in many places in recent years, building many new buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗迎接奧運，北京大興土木，改善咗好多基建設施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 jing4 zip3 ou3 wan6, bak1 ging1 daai6 hing1 tou2 muk6, gai2 sin6 zo2 hou2 do1 gei1 cin3 sat1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了迎接奥运，北京大兴土木，改善了很多基础设施。
examples.english_sentence: In order to welcome the Olympics, Beijing carried out large-scale construction, improving a lot of infrastructure.

english_meaning: on a large scale; massive; in a big way
explanation_mandarin: 形容规模很大，行动声势浩大。
explanation_english: Describes a large scale operation or action with great momentum.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備大舉擴張業務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zyun2 bei6 daai6 geoi2 kwok3 zoeng1 jip6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司准备大规模地扩张业务。
examples.english_sentence: That company is preparing to expand its business on a large scale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃大舉進軍內地市場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 daai6 geoi2 zeon3 gwan1 noi6 dei6 si5 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划大规模进军内地市场。
examples.english_sentence: They plan to launch a large-scale offensive into the mainland market.

english_meaning: Large compartment; spacious place; a large room (often implying a chaotic or messy one)
explanation_mandarin: 指很大的房间或场所，通常带有杂乱或宽松的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a large room or place, often implying messiness or looseness; can also refer to a literal large compartment or cabin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房真係好似個大艙咁，亂到呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 go3 daai6 cong1 gam2, lyun6 dou3 ni1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这房间真像个大房间，乱成这样。
examples.english_sentence: This room is really like a large compartment, so messy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架船嘅大艙可以容納好多貨物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 syun4 ge3 daai6 cong1 ho2 ji5 jung4 naap6 hou2 do1 fo3 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这艘船的大舱可以容纳很多货物。
examples.english_sentence: The large compartment of this ship can hold a lot of cargo.

english_meaning: Daliang (a place name, a town in Shunde District, Foshan, Guangdong Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 大良，广东省佛山市顺德区的一个镇，是顺德区的中心城区。
explanation_english: Daliang is a town located in Shunde District, Foshan, Guangdong Province, China. It serves as the central urban area of Shunde.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下個月去大良食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 daai6 loeng4 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们下个月去大良吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to Daliang to eat next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大良嘅双皮奶好出名㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 loeng4 ge3 soeng1 pei4 naai5 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大良的双皮奶很有名。
examples.english_sentence: Daliang's double-layered milk custard is very famous.

english_meaning: Incompetent official; a useless official
explanation_mandarin: 指能力低下，无所作为的官员。 大良是广东顺德的一个地方，阿斗指三国时期的刘禅，以无能懦弱著称。合在一起形容像阿斗一样无用的官员。
explanation_english: Refers to an official who is incompetent and ineffective. Daliang is a place in Shunde, Guangdong. A-Dou (Liu Shan) refers to the son of Liu Bei in the Three Kingdoms period, known for his incompetence and weakness. Put together, it describes an official as useless as A-Dou.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢乜嘢都唔識，真係一個大良阿斗官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 loeng4 aa3 dau2 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他什么都不懂，真是一个庸官。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't know anything. He's really an incompetent official.

mandarin_meaning: 大手大脚, 挥霍浪费
english_meaning: extravagant, wasteful, spending money lavishly
explanation_mandarin: 形容花钱或使用东西很浪费，不节俭。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extravagant, wasteful, and does not economize with money or resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大花大朵，好快就冇晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 faa1 daai6 do2, hou2 faai3 zau6 mou5 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是大手大脚花钱，很快就会把钱花光。
examples.english_sentence: He's always spending money lavishly, he'll be broke very soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大花大朵啦，要儲多啲錢應急啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 faa1 daai6 do2 laa1, jiu3 cou5 do1 di1 cin2 ying3 gap1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么大手大脚了，要多存些钱以备不时之需啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so extravagant, you need to save more money for emergencies.

english_meaning: big spender; someone who spends money freely or extravagantly; extravagant person; spendthrift
explanation_mandarin: 形容人花钱大手大脚，没有节制，挥霍无度。
explanation_english: Describes a person who spends money extravagantly and without restraint; a big spender.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個大花灑，賺幾多都唔夠佢使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 daai6 faa1 saa2, zaan6 gei2 do1 dou1 m4 gau3 keoi5 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个挥霍无度的人，赚多少都不够他花。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a big spender, no matter how much he earns, it's not enough for him to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做大花灑啦，慳啲錢好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 daai6 faa1 saa2 laa1, haan1 di1 cin2 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别做个浪费者了，省点钱比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a big spender, it's better to save some money.

english_meaning: spendthrift; big spender; wasteful person
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人花钱很大方，没有节制，挥霍无度。 可以用作名词，指这样的人；也可以用作形容词，形容这种行为。
explanation_english: Describes a person who spends money very lavishly and without restraint; a spendthrift. It can be used as a noun to refer to such a person, or as an adjective to describe such behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個大花筒，一個月可以洗晒成萬蚊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 faa1 tung4, jat1 go3 jyut6 ho2 ji5 sai2晒 sing4 maan6 man1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个挥霍无度的人，一个月可以花掉一万块钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is really a spendthrift, he can spend ten thousand dollars a month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大花筒啦，儲返啲錢傍身好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 faa1 tung4 laa1, cou5 faan1 di1 cin2 pong4 san1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么大手大脚了，存一些钱在身边比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so wasteful, it's better to save some money for a rainy day.

synonyms: 洗腳唔抹腳 (sai2 goek3 m4 mut3 goek3)

mandarin_meaning: 脸被涂得很花的人；浓妆艳抹的人; 戏曲中的花脸
english_meaning: Someone with a heavily made-up face; clownish appearance; (in Cantonese opera) painted face character; someone who is embarrassed or humiliated
explanation_mandarin: 指脸上化了很浓的妆的人，有时带有贬义，指打扮得不雅观或像小丑。 也指粤剧中脸谱化的角色“花脸”。 另外，引申为因做错事或出丑而感到尴尬、丢脸。
explanation_english: Refers to someone with a heavily made-up face, sometimes with a negative connotation, implying they are dressed up in an unrefined or clownish manner. It also refers to the 'painted face' character in Cantonese opera. By extension, it can mean someone who is embarrassed or humiliated due to making a mistake or being exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日化到個妝好似大花面咁，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 faa3 dou3 go3 zong1 hou2 ci5 daai6 faa1 min6 gam2, m4 zi1 dou1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天化的妆好像大花脸一样，不知道做什么。
examples.english_sentence: She put on makeup like a heavily made-up face today, I don't know what she's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上表演甩碌，真係醜到大花面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 biu2 jin2 lat1 luk1, zan1 hai6 cau2 dou3 daai6 faa1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上表演失误，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a blunder during his performance on stage, he was so embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇粵劇最鍾意睇大花面嘅角色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 jyut6 kek6 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 daai6 faa1 min6 ge3 gok3 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看粤剧最喜欢看花脸的角色。
examples.english_sentence: I like watching the painted-face characters the most when watching Cantonese opera.

english_meaning: Big shot; Important person; VIP
explanation_mandarin: 指重要人物，大人物，有影响力的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a big shot, an important person, or someone influential.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅大茄，好多嘢都要問佢意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 ce2, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 keoi5 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是公司的大人物，很多事情都要问他的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He's a big shot in the company, a lot of things require his opinion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為自己係大茄，做人謙虛啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hai6 daai6 ce2, zou6 jan4 him1 heoi1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为自己是重要人物，做人谦虚一点比较好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're a big shot, it's better to be humble.

english_meaning: Big business; lucrative deal; a major undertaking
explanation_mandarin: 指大规模的生意，能带来丰厚利润的交易，或是指一件重大的事情或任务。
explanation_english: Refers to a large-scale business deal or transaction that yields substantial profits. Can also refer to a significant undertaking or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今次傾緊單大茶飯，話可以賺好多錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 ci3 king1 gan2 daan1 daai6 caa4 faan6, waa6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 hou2 do1 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这次在谈一笔大生意，说可以赚很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: They are discussing a big deal this time, saying it can make a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次真係要做單大茶飯，唔成功就冇面見人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 jiu3 zou6 daan1 daai6 caa4 faan6, m4 sing4 gung1 zau6 mou5 min6 gin3 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次真的要做成一个大买卖，不成功就没脸见人了。
examples.english_sentence: This time we really need to pull off a big deal; if we don't succeed, we'll be disgraced.

english_meaning: careless; negligent; sloppy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事不仔细，马虎大意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is careless, negligent, or sloppy in their work or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大草，實會出錯嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 cou2, sat6 wui5 chut1 cho3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么粗心，肯定会出错的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so careless, you're bound to make mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大草啦，做好啲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 cou2 laa1, zou6 hou2 di1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么粗心了，把它做好点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so careless, do it better.

english_meaning: Big fish eats small fish; The strong prey on the weak.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻强者吞并弱者，或势力大的人欺负势力小的人。
explanation_english: A metaphor for the strong preying on the weak, or those with greater power bullying those with less.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社會就係大菌食細菌，你唔夠強就會俾人吞併。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 zau6 hai6 daai6 gwan2 sik6 sai3 gwai2, nei5 m4 gau3 keung4 zau6 wui5 bei2 jan4 tan1 bing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社会就是大鱼吃小鱼，你不够强就会被人吞并。
examples.english_sentence: This society is like big fish eat small fish; if you're not strong enough, you'll be swallowed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間大公司成日搞收購，真係大菌食細菌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 daai6 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 gaau2 sau1 gau3, zan1 hai6 daai6 gwan2 sik6 sai3 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家大公司经常搞收购，真是大鱼吃小鱼。
examples.english_sentence: That big company is always doing acquisitions; it's really a case of big fish eating small fish.

cantonese: 大菌食細菌，細菌當補品
jyutping: daai6 kwan2 sik6 sai3 kwan2, sai3 kwan2 dong3 bou2 ban2
mandarin_meaning: 以毒攻毒；强者吞噬弱者，并且还能从中获利。
english_meaning: The big germ eats the small germ, and the small germ is considered a tonic. (Figurative: Using poison to fight poison; the strong eat the weak and profit from it.)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻以恶制恶，用更坏的东西来对抗坏的东西，或者比喻强者吞噬弱者，并且从中获利。通常带有负面含义。
explanation_english: This idiom is a metaphor for using evil to combat evil, or using something even worse to fight something bad. It can also refer to the strong preying on the weak and profiting from it. It usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個社會就係大菌食細菌，細菌當補品，你唔夠醒目好快俾人食咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 zau6 hai6 daai6 kwan2 sik6 sai3 kwan2, sai3 kwan2 dong3 bou2 ban2, nei5 m4 gau3 sing2 muk6 hou2 faai3 bei2 jan4 sik6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个社会就是以强凌弱，弱肉强食，你不够精明很快就会被人吞噬。
examples.english_sentence: This society is a case of the big germ eating the small germ, with the small germ being considered a tonic. If you're not smart enough, you'll be devoured quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅做法簡直係大菌食細菌，細菌當補品，完全唔理細公司嘅死活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 zou6 faat3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 daai6 kwan2 sik6 sai3 kwan2, sai3 kwan2 dong3 bou2 ban2, jyun4 cyun4 m4 lei5 sai3 gung1 si1 ge3 sei2 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的做法简直是以强凌弱，把小公司当补品，完全不顾小公司的死活。
examples.english_sentence: Their company's practices are simply the big germ eating the small germ, and considering the small germ a tonic, completely disregarding the life or death of small companies.

english_meaning: Agar jelly
explanation_mandarin: 一種用大菜（琼脂）做成的甜點，口感爽滑。
explanation_english: A type of dessert made from agar-agar, which has a smooth and refreshing texture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我好鍾意食大菜糕，尤其是芒果味嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 daai6 coi3 gou1, jau4 kei4 si6 mong1 gwo2 mei6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我很喜欢吃燕菜糕，尤其是芒果味的。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I loved eating agar jelly, especially the mango flavor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅大菜糕好出名，好多人排隊買㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau4 ge3 daai6 coi3 gou1 hou2 ceot1 ming4, hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2 maai5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店的燕菜糕很有名，很多人排队买的。
examples.english_sentence: The agar jelly from this shop is very famous, many people queue up to buy it.

mandarin_meaning: 笨拙、笨手笨脚、粗心大意
english_meaning: clumsy, awkward, butterfingered, careless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人动作笨拙，粗心大意，容易出错。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is clumsy, awkward, careless, and prone to making mistakes. Often used to describe someone who is physically uncoordinated or makes careless mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大葛樓，都係唔好掂啲易爛嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 got3 lau2, dou1 hai6 m4 hou2 dim2 di1 ji6 laan6 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨手笨脚的，还是别碰那些易碎的东西了。
examples.english_sentence: You're so clumsy, you'd better not touch those fragile things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日整跌嘢，真係大葛樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing2 dit3 je5, zan1 hai6 daai6 got3 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是弄掉东西，真是笨手笨脚。
examples.english_sentence: He always drops things, he's really clumsy.

synonyms: 笨手笨脚 (ban4 sau2 ban4 goek3)

english_meaning: scallion, green onion, Welsh onion
explanation_mandarin: 一种常用的食材，葱的一种，体型较大。
explanation_english: A commonly used cooking ingredient, a type of scallion with a larger size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買啲大葱返屋企炒餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 daai6 cung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 caau2 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买点大葱回家炒菜。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some scallions to cook dishes at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢碟姜葱炒蟹，啲大葱好香。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dip6 goeng1 cung1 caau2 haai5, di1 daai6 cung1 hou2 hoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这盘姜葱炒蟹，大葱很香。
examples.english_sentence: In this ginger and scallion stir-fried crab, the scallions are very fragrant.

english_meaning: A naive and easily infatuated woman; a woman who is easily smitten; a girl obsessed with idols
explanation_mandarin: 形容容易被异性或偶像吸引，天真烂漫，略带傻气的年轻女性。
explanation_english: Describes a young woman who is easily attracted to the opposite sex or idols, naive, innocent, and somewhat silly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日追星，真係一個大葵扇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zeoi1 sing1, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 kwai4 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是追星，真是一个花痴。
examples.english_sentence: She's always chasing after idols; she's such a ditz.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大葵扇啦，人哋講咩你都信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 kwai4 sin3 laa1, yan4 dei6 gong2 me1 nei5 dou1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么傻大姐了，别人说什么你都信。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so naive; you believe everything people say.

english_meaning: garlic
explanation_mandarin: 一种常用的调味蔬菜，味道辛辣。
explanation_english: A commonly used vegetable for seasoning, with a pungent taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意喺啲意粉度落多啲大蒜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 di1 ji3 fan2 dou6 lok6 do1 di1 daai6 syun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢在意大利面里放多一些大蒜。
examples.english_sentence: I like to put more garlic in my pasta.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食大蒜可以殺菌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 daai6 syun3 ho2 ji5 saat3 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃大蒜可以杀菌。
examples.english_sentence: Eating garlic can kill bacteria.

mandarin_meaning: 形容物品表面油腻、不干净
english_meaning: greasy; oily; grimy (describing a surface)
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体表面沾染了油脂或其他脏东西，看起来油腻、脏兮兮的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a surface that is covered in grease, oil, or other grime, making it look oily and dirty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你件衫咁大蓉，都唔知點解嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin6 saam1 gam3 daai6 yung4, dou1 m4 zhi1 dim2 gaai2 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的衣服这么油腻，都不知道是怎么回事？
examples.english_sentence: Your clothes are so greasy, I don't even know what happened?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲枱面大蓉蓉咁，好污糟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 toi2 min6 daai6 yung4 yung4 gam2, hou2 wu1 zou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的桌面油腻腻的，很脏。
examples.english_sentence: The tables in this restaurant are greasy, so dirty.

english_meaning: scallion, green onion; (slang) a fool, easily taken advantage of
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是葱，一种蔬菜。在粤语中，也常用来形容容易被欺骗、愚笨的人。
explanation_english: Literally means scallion or green onion, a type of vegetable. In Cantonese slang, it is also used to describe someone who is easily deceived, a fool, or gullible person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，成條大蔥咁，俾人賣咗都唔知！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, seng4 tiu4 daai6 cung1 gam3, bei2 jan4 maai6 zo2 dou1 m4 zi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么笨啦，像根大葱一样，被人卖了都不知道！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid! You're like a scallion, you wouldn't even know if someone sold you off!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日買咗紮大蔥返屋企炒餸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 zaat3 daai6 cung1 faan1 uk1 kei2 caau2 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天买了把大葱回家炒菜。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a bunch of scallions today to cook some dishes at home.

english_meaning: plantain; large banana
explanation_mandarin: 一种大型的香蕉，通常需要烹饪后食用，味道与香蕉不同。
explanation_english: A type of large banana that is usually cooked before being eaten. It has a different flavor profile compared to a regular banana.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日買大蕉返屋企煮飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 maai5 daai6 ziu1 faan1 uk1 kei2 zyu2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶经常买大香蕉回家做饭。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma often buys plantains to cook at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大蕉炸完好好味㗎，你試下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 ziu1 zaa3 jyun4 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3, nei5 si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 炸过的大香蕉很好吃的，你试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: Fried plantains are delicious, you should try them.

english_meaning: to defecate, to have a bowel movement
explanation_mandarin: 指排泄固体粪便。是一种委婉的说法。
explanation_english: A euphemism for defecating, having a bowel movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日大號唔係咁暢順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 daai6 hou6 m4 hai6 gam3 coeng3 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天大便不太顺畅。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't have a smooth bowel movement yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日去咗好耐廁所，唔知係咪大號唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 hou2 noi6 coi3 so2, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 daai6 hou6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天去了很久厕所，不知道是不是大便不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in the toilet for a long time today, I wonder if he's having trouble with his bowel movement.

english_meaning: To describe something progressing very slowly; like a large snake urinating (slow and drawn out)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻做事慢吞吞，节奏非常缓慢。 大蛇排尿的动作很慢很长，所以用来形容速度慢。
explanation_english: A metaphor for doing things very slowly, at a very slow pace. The action of a large snake urinating is slow and prolonged, so it is used to describe slowness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢好似大蛇屙尿咁，慢到呢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 daai6 se4 o1 niu6 gam2, maan6 dou3 ne1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做事像大蛇撒尿一样，太慢了！
examples.english_sentence: You work like a big snake peeing, so slow!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條隊排到大蛇屙尿咁長，唔知幾時先到我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 deoi2 paai4 dou3 daai6 se4 o1 niu6 gam2 coeng4, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 dou3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 队伍排得像大蛇撒尿一样长，不知道什么时候才能轮到我。
examples.english_sentence: The queue is as long as a big snake peeing, I don't know when it'll be my turn.

english_meaning: Wasteful, a waste (of time, money, resources, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容浪费，指花费很多资源却效果甚微，如同大蛇排泄，量大但无实际价值。
explanation_english: Describes something that is wasteful, like spending a lot of resources with little effect. It's like a large snake defecating - a lot of output but of little practical value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞咁多嘢，咪又係大蛇屙屎，冇乜用嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 gam3 do1 je5, mai1 jau6 hai6 daai6 se4 o1 si2, mou5 mat1 jung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞了这么多，还不是浪费，没什么用。
examples.english_sentence: Doing so much, it's all just a waste, not very useful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程搞咗咁耐，結果都係大蛇屙屎，完全唔work。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 cing4 gaau2 zo2 gam3 noi6, git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 daai6 se4 o1 si2, wun4 cyun4 m4 work1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程搞了这么久，结果还是浪费，完全不work。
examples.english_sentence: This project has been going on for so long, and the result is just a waste, it doesn't work at all.

english_meaning: To talk on and on at length; to ramble; to be long-winded.
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话冗长，没完没了，就像蛇尿一样，很久才滴完。
explanation_english: Describes someone who talks at great length and never seems to stop, similar to how a snake's urination is believed to be a long and drawn-out process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢開會成日都大蛇痾尿，講到冇人想聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hoi1 wui2 sing4 jat6 dou1 daai6 se4 o1 niu6, gong2 dou3 mou5 jan4 soeng2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开会总是长篇大论，讲到没人想听。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks on and on at meetings, to the point that no one wants to listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大蛇痾尿啦，快啲講重點啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 se4 o1 niu6 laa1, faai3 di1 gong2 zung2 dim2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么长篇大论了，快点说重点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded, just get to the point.

mandarin_meaning: 慢慢来; 进度慢; 效率低
english_meaning: To take a very long time; extremely slow progress; inefficient; like a snake defecating (little bit at a time).
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事非常缓慢，效率很低。就像蛇排泄一样，一点一点地来。
explanation_english: This idiom describes something that is progressing extremely slowly or inefficiently. It likens the progress to a snake defecating, implying that it happens in small, infrequent bursts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工程大蛇痾屎咁，唔知幾時先搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 ching4 daai6 se4 o1 si2 gam2, m4 zhi1 gei2 si4 sin1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程进度慢得像蛇拉屎一样，不知道什么时候才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This project is progressing as slowly as a snake defecating, I don't know when it will be finished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢大蛇痾屎，成日都拖慢進度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 daai6 se4 o1 si2, seng4 yat6 dou1 to1 maan6 jun3 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事慢吞吞的，总是拖慢进度。
examples.english_sentence: He works very slowly, always slowing down the progress.

english_meaning: bullying the weak
explanation_mandarin: 指强者欺负弱者。
explanation_english: Refers to the strong bullying the weak; taking advantage of someone smaller or less powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大隻，唔好大蝦細啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 zek3, m4 hou2 daai6 haa1 sai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么壮，不要以大欺小了！
examples.english_sentence: You're so big, don't bully the weak!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大蝦細，遲早會出事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 haa1 sai3, ci4 zou2 wui5 ceot1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是以大欺小，迟早会出事的。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the weak; sooner or later, he'll get into trouble.

jyutping: daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6
english_meaning: The big bullying the small; the powerful oppressing the weak.
explanation_mandarin: 形容强者欺负弱者，恃强凌弱的行为。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where the strong bully the weak, abusing their power to oppress others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大蝦細俾屎餵，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是以大欺小，真的很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the weak, he's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司啲高層成日大蝦細俾屎餵，啲細職員都好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 di1 gou1 cang4 seng4 jat6 daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6, di1 sai3 zik1 jyun4 dou1 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司的高层总是欺负底下的员工，员工们都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: The senior management in the company always bullies junior staff, the employees are very unhappy.

jyutping: daai6 haa1 sai3 mou5 ji3 wai6
english_meaning: To bully the weak; To use one's power to oppress the less powerful; Bullying and lacking intelligence
explanation_mandarin: 形容仗势欺人，欺负弱小的人，并且缺乏智慧。
explanation_english: Describes the act of bullying those who are weaker, using one's power to oppress, and highlights a lack of intelligence in doing so. It suggests that the bully is not only malicious but also foolish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大蝦細冇智慧，遲早會俾人教訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 haa1 sai3 mou5 ji3 wai6, ci4 zou2 wui5 bei2 jan4 gaau3 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天以大欺小，早晚会被人教训。
examples.english_sentence: He's always bullying the weak, he'll get his comeuppance sooner or later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好大蝦細冇智慧啦，咁樣做好冇意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai6 haa1 sai3 mou5 ji3 wai6 laa1, gam2 joeng2 zou6 hou2 mou5 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以大欺小了，这样做很没意思。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bully the weak, it's pointless to act like this.

jyutping: daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6
english_meaning: The big shrimp feeds the small one with shit; to bully the weak
explanation_mandarin: 比喻强者欺负弱者，仗势欺人。大虾指大的生物，细指小的生物，屎指不好的东西。 整个意思是大虾（强者）反而用不好的东西（屎）喂养小虾（弱者），引申为强者欺负弱者。
explanation_english: This idiom is a metaphor for the strong bullying the weak. 'Big shrimp' refers to a larger, stronger being, and 'small one' refers to a smaller, weaker being. 'Shit' represents something bad or harmful. The overall meaning is that the big shrimp (the strong) feeds the small shrimp (the weak) with shit (something bad), implying that the strong are taking advantage of or bullying the weak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司成日大蝦細畀屎餵，啲新人根本冇say。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 seng4 jat6 daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6, di1 san1 jan4 gan1 bun2 mou5 say2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司总是欺负新人，新人根本没有发言权。
examples.english_sentence: This company always bullies newcomers; the new employees have absolutely no say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好大蝦細畀屎餵啊，咁樣做好唔啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 daai6 haa1 sai3 bei2 si2 wai6 aa3, gam2 joeng2 zou6 hou2 m4 aam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要欺负弱小，这样做是不对的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bully the weak; it's not right to do that.

mandarin_meaning: 花花公子, 好色之徒
english_meaning: playboy, womanizer, lecherous man
explanation_mandarin: 指沉迷于女色，到处拈花惹草的男人。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who is obsessed with women and flirts around. It carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條衰仔成日溝女，真係一條大蝻蛇！

mandarin_meaning: 厉害的女人; 母老虎

english_meaning: the public; the masses; popular

explanation_english: Refers to the general public, or something that is popular or widespread.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲好受大衆歡迎。

examples.english_sentence: Smartphones are becoming more and more popular nowadays, and the prices have become much more accessible to the general public.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好好味，而且價錢大衆化，所以好多人幫襯。

english_meaning: mass media
explanation_mandarin: 指面向广大公众的信息传播媒介，如电视、报纸、广播、互联网等。

english_meaning: Common face, average looking
explanation_mandarin: 指长相普通，缺乏鲜明特点，很容易在人群中被忽略的面容。
explanation_english: Refers to a face that is common-looking, lacking distinctive features, and easily overlooked in a crowd. Can also be used adjectivally to describe someone as having a common face.

english_meaning: to pass away; to die (respectful)

examples.english_sentence: I heard that Mr. Lee passed away last month, it's such a pity.

english_meaning: to be popular, to be prevalent, to be all the rage

explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人花钱大手大脚，很阔气； 也指有权有势的人。

english_meaning: The Great Northwest (referring to remote and less developed areas, often used ironically or to indicate a far-off place)

explanation_english: Literally means the vast Northwest region. However, in Hong Kong, it's often used ironically to refer to the remote northwestern parts of the New Territories, such as Tuen Mun, Yuen Long, and Tin Shui Wai. It carries a somewhat sarcastic tone, implying that these areas are remote and inconvenient to reach.

explanation_english: A dice game where players take turns announcing the total number of dice showing a particular number, and can choose to increase the number or the dice value. If a player doesn't believe the previous announcement, they can call "Liar" (大話). If they are correct, the player who made the announcement loses a round. If they are wrong, the player who called "Liar" loses a round. The player who loses all their dice is eliminated, and the last player remaining wins.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so greedy, leave some for others.

english_meaning: Greedy ghost; excessively greedy person
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常贪婪，贪得无厌，像鬼一样贪得无厌。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely greedy and insatiable, like a greedy ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁大貪鬼啦，攞咗咁多仲要？
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 daai6 taam1 gwai2 laa1, lo2 zo2 gam3 do1 zung6 jiu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么贪心，拿了这么多还要？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so greedy, you've already taken so much, and you still want more?

english_meaning: to go to a lot of trouble; to make a great fuss; to go through a lot of trouble and effort
explanation_mandarin: 形容花费很多时间和精力去做某件事情，过程繁琐。
explanation_english: Describes the act of spending a lot of time and effort to do something, with a complicated and troublesome process.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗搞掂份文件，搞到大費周章。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 gaau2 dim6 fan6 man4 gin2, gaau2 dou3 daai6 fai3 zau1 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了搞定这份文件，搞得大费周折。
examples.english_sentence: To get this document done, it took a lot of trouble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋真係大費周章，執嘢執到傻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 zan1 hai6 daai6 fai3 zau1 zoeng1, zap1 je5 zap1 dou3 so4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家真是大费周折，收拾东西收拾到傻。
examples.english_sentence: Moving house is really troublesome, I was driven crazy by packing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁大費周章嘅，簡單啲搞掂咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 daai6 fai3 zau1 zoeng1 ge3, gaan2 daan1 di1 gaau2 dim6 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么大费周折的，简单点搞定不就行了吗？
examples.english_sentence: You don't have to go through so much trouble, just solve it simply.

english_meaning: Senior, veteran, someone with a lot of experience, old timer
explanation_mandarin: 指在某个领域经验丰富、资历很深的人。 通常带有一点尊敬的语气。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is experienced and highly qualified in a certain field. Usually used with a tone of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司做咗廿幾年，係個名副其實嘅大資爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zou6 zo2 jaa6 gei2 nin4, hai6 go3 ming4 fu3 kei4 sat6 ge3 daai6 zi1 je4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司工作了二十多年，是个名副其实的老前辈。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working in the company for over twenty years, he is a true veteran.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩唔識嘅嘢問下啲大資爺啦，佢哋經驗豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 m4 sik1 ge3 je5 man6 haa5 di1 daai6 zi1 je4 laa1, keoi5 dei6 ging1 gim6 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么不懂的问问那些老前辈吧，他们经验丰富。
examples.english_sentence: If there is anything you don't understand, ask the seniors, they are very experienced.

english_meaning: big thief; major criminal; bandit
explanation_mandarin: 指犯下重大罪行的盗贼或罪犯。
explanation_english: Refers to a thief or criminal who has committed a major crime; a bandit or a large-scale robber.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日講有個大賊喺呢個區出沒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 gong2 jau5 go3 daai6 caak6 hai2 ni1 go3 ku1 ceot1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是说有一个大盗在这个区出没。
examples.english_sentence: They always say there's a major criminal lurking in this district.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人捉咗個大賊，市民都好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 yan4 zuk1 zo2 go3 daai6 caak6, si5 man4 dou1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓了一个大盗，市民都很开心。
examples.english_sentence: The police caught a major criminal, and the citizens are very happy.

english_meaning: To sell well; To be a best-seller; A big hit (in terms of sales)
explanation_mandarin: 形容商品销售情况非常好，非常畅销。
explanation_english: Describes a product that sells very well; a best-seller. Often used in the context of movies, books, or other commercial products.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲票房大賣啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 piu3 fong2 daai6 maai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影票房大卖啊！
examples.english_sentence: This movie is a box office hit!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書一出版就大賣，好受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 jat1 ceot1 baan2 zau6 daai6 maai6, hou2 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书一出版就大卖，很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: This book became a best-seller as soon as it was published, it's very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司新出嘅產品希望可以大賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 san1 ceot1 ge3 caan2 ban2 hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 daai6 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司新出的产品希望可以大卖。
examples.english_sentence: We hope the company's new product will be a big hit.

english_meaning: competition, contest, tournament
explanation_mandarin: 大型的比赛。
explanation_english: A large-scale competition or contest, often with many participants and significant prizes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅歌唱大賽競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 go1 coeng3 daai6 coi3 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的歌唱大赛竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: This year's singing competition is very competitive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗國際象棋大賽，希望可以攞到冠軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 gwok3 zai3 keoi2 zoeng6 kei2 daai6 coi3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 lo2 dou2 gun3 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了国际象棋大赛，希望可以拿到冠军。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in the international chess tournament, hoping to win the championship.

english_meaning: general amnesty, pardon
explanation_mandarin: 国家元首或政府对犯人普遍赦免。 通常是指对政治犯的赦免。
explanation_english: A general pardon granted by a head of state or government, usually referring to the forgiveness of political offenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府決定嚟一次大赦，釋放所有政治犯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 kyut3 ding6 lai4 jat1 ci3 daai6 se3, sik1 fong3 so2 jau5 zing3 zi6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府决定进行一次大赦，释放所有政治犯。
examples.english_sentence: The government decided to grant a general amnesty and release all political prisoners.

english_meaning: Great ups and downs; dramatic rise and fall; roller coaster
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物经历大幅度的变化，一会儿上升，一会儿下降，变动非常剧烈。
explanation_english: Describes a situation that experiences significant and dramatic changes, fluctuating rapidly between highs and lows, similar to a roller coaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生好似坐過山車咁，大起大落，好刺激。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 hou2 ci5 co5 gwo3 saan1 ce1 gam2, daai6 hei2 daai6 lok6, hou2 ci1 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生就像坐过山车一样，大起大落，很刺激。
examples.english_sentence: His life is like riding a roller coaster, with great ups and downs, it's very exciting.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 股市嘅升跌真係大起大落，好多人輸晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si5 ge3 sing1 dit3 zan1 hai6 daai6 hei2 daai6 lok6, hou2 do1 jan4 syu1 saai3 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 股市的涨跌真是大起大落，很多人输光了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market's fluctuations are truly dramatic, many people have lost all their money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅事業大起大落，曾經風光一時，而家又跌落谷底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 si6 jip6 daai6 hei2 daai6 lok6, cang4 ging1 fung1 gwong1 jat1 si4, ji4 gaa1 jau6 dit3 lok6 guk1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的事业大起大落，曾经风光一时，现在又跌落谷底。
examples.english_sentence: His career has had its ups and downs; he was once glorious, but now he's hit rock bottom.

synonyms: 波瀾起伏 (bo1 laan4 hei2 fuk6)

english_meaning: commonplace, popular, mainstream, conventional
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物非常普遍，大众化，没什么特别之处。
explanation_english: Refers to something that is very common, popular, or mainstream, and not particularly special or unique.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲歌太過大路喇，冇乜特色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 go1 taai3 gwo3 daai6 lou6 laa3, mou5 mat1 dak6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些歌太大众化了，没什么特色。
examples.english_sentence: These songs are too mainstream, they don't have much character.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅設計好大路，冇乜新意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 daai6 lou6, mou5 mat1 san1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计很普通，没什么新意。
examples.english_sentence: His design is very conventional, there's nothing new about it.

mandarin_meaning: 随便应付的人；泛泛之辈
english_meaning: Someone who just goes through the motions; a mediocre or average person; a general term for an average Joe.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人做事只是敷衍了事，没有突出的能力或表现。 比喻能力平庸、没有特别才能的人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who just goes through the motions and doesn't have outstanding abilities or performance. It's a metaphor for someone with mediocre ability and no special talent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢永遠都係咁，好似大路元帥咁，唔肯落力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6嘢 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 gam2, hou2 ci5 daai6 lou6 jyun4 seoi3 gam2, m4 hang2 lok6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是这样，像个泛泛之辈，不愿意努力。
examples.english_sentence: He always works like that, like an average Joe, unwilling to put in the effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做大路元帥啦，俾心機做好啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 daai6 lou6 jyun4 seoi3 laa1, bei2 sam1 gei1 zou6 hou2 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别当个随便应付的人了，用心做好一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't just go through the motions, put your heart into it and do better!

english_meaning: common goods, mass-produced items, run-of-the-mill, commonplace
explanation_mandarin: 指普通，常見，品質一般的貨品。
explanation_english: Refers to common, easily accessible, and generally average-quality goods. It can also describe something that is unoriginal or lacks distinction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲衫都係大路貨，周街都見到人著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 saam1 dou1 hai6 daai6 lou6 fo3, zau1 gaai1 dou1 gin3 dou2 jan4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些衣服都是大路货，大街上到处都看到有人穿。
examples.english_sentence: These clothes are just common goods; you see people wearing them everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅設計好普通，只不過係大路貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 pou2 tung1, zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 daai6 lou6 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计很普通，只不过是普通货色。
examples.english_sentence: His design is very ordinary, just run-of-the-mill.

mandarin_meaning: 大型车辆; 大巴; 卡车
english_meaning: Large vehicle; bus; truck
explanation_mandarin: 指大型的车辆，通常指公共汽车、卡车等。
explanation_english: Refers to a large vehicle, usually a bus, truck, or other large vehicle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭大車去機場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 daai6 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐大巴去机场。
examples.english_sentence: We're taking the bus to the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 前面有架大車挡住咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 gaa3 daai6 ce1 dong2 zyu6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 前面有一辆大车挡住了。
examples.english_sentence: There's a large vehicle blocking the way ahead.

english_meaning: large army; large force; a large number of people
explanation_mandarin: 指数量庞大的人群或队伍，通常用来形容某件事情聚集了很多人。
explanation_english: Refers to a large group of people or a large army/force. Often used to describe a situation where many people are gathered for a particular purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚演唱會嚟咗好多大軍啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 lai4 zo2 hou2 do1 daai6 gwan1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚演唱会来了好多人啊！
examples.english_sentence: There's a huge crowd at the concert tonight!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司派咗大軍嚟參加呢個展覽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 paai3 zo2 daai6 gwan1 lai4 caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 zin2 laam5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司派了很多人来参加这个展览。
examples.english_sentence: Their company sent a large team to participate in this exhibition.

english_meaning: Big shot, important person, big wheel
explanation_mandarin: 指有权势，有影响力的大人物。
explanation_english: Refers to a powerful and influential person, a big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家係公司嘅大轆，好多嘢都要問過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 luk1, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在是公司的大人物，很多事情都要问过他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a big shot in the company now, many things have to be consulted with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好得罪佢，佢係呢度嘅大轆嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5, keoi5 hai6 ni1 dou6 ge3 daai6 luk1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要得罪他，他是这里的大人物。
examples.english_sentence: Don't offend him, he is a big shot here.

english_meaning: Blockhead; Dullard; Simpleton; Airhead; Idiot
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人愚笨、反应迟钝。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is foolish, slow-witted, or lacking intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係大轆木嚟㗎，講極都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 daai6 luk1 muk6 lai4 gaa3, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个笨蛋，怎么说都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a blockhead, he can't understand no matter how much you explain it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大轆木啦，醒醒定定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 luk1 muk6 laa1, sing2 sing2 ding6 ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么傻了，清醒一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a simpleton, be more aware!

english_meaning: A big, clumsy person; a lanky, awkward individual
explanation_mandarin: 形容身材高大但动作笨拙，不灵活的人。有时带有戏谑或略带贬义的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is tall and clumsy, lacking agility. Sometimes used playfully or with a slightly derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條仔咁高大，但係成日跌親，真係大轆竹咁款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 zai2 gam3 gou1 daai6, daan6 hai6 sing4 jat6 dit3 can1, zan1 hai6 daai6 luk1 zuk1 gam2 kwan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友那么高大，但是总是摔倒，真是个笨手笨脚的人。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend is so tall, but he's always tripping, he's such a clumsy person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪咁大轆竹啦，小心撞親啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 gam3 daai6 luk1 zuk1 laa1, siu2 sam1 zong6 can1 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么笨手笨脚的，小心撞到东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, be careful not to bump into things.

english_meaning: Slow-witted person; slow on the uptake; someone who is dense or clueless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应迟钝，领悟能力差。 藕是植物的根茎，将其比作人的脑袋，而“大轆”强调其笨重、迟缓。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is slow to understand or react to things; lacking in quick comprehension.  '藕' (ngau5) is lotus root, figuratively used to represent a person's head, and '大轆' (daai6 luk1) emphasizes its heaviness and slowness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁蠢，真係大轆藕嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 ceon2, zan1 hai6 daai6 luk1 ngau5 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么笨，真是个反应迟钝的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's so stupid, he's really slow-witted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，可能佢只係反應慢啲啫，唔係大轆藕嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, ho2 nang4 keoi5 zi2 hai6 faan2 jing3 maan6 di1 ze1, m4 hai6 daai6 luk1 ngau5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么说别人，也许他只是反应慢一点，不是迟钝的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about other people, maybe he's just a bit slow to react, he's not slow-witted.

english_meaning: To flatter excessively, to brown-nose, to suck up (to someone)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人极度谄媚，奉承，以求得对方的欢心或好处。 "大轆藕" 形容很大块的莲藕， "抬色" 意思是抬高脸色，即奉承。整个词语结合起来，形容非常用力的奉承。
explanation_english: Describes someone who excessively flatters or brown-noses in order to gain favor or advantages from the other person. "大轆藕" (daai6 luk1 ngau5) describes a large lotus root, and "抬色" (toi4 sik1) means to elevate someone's complexion, implying flattery. The whole phrase combines these elements to describe someone who is working very hard to flatter someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都喺老細面前大轆藕抬色，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 daai6 luk1 ngau5 toi4 sik1, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在老板面前拍马屁，想升职啊。
examples.english_sentence: He flatters the boss every day, hoping to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日大轆藕抬色啦，靠自己努力先至實際㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 seng4 jat6 daai6 luk1 ngau5 toi4 sik1 laa1, kaau3 zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 sin1 zai3 sat6 zai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是拍马屁了，靠自己的努力才实际。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always brown-nose, it's more practical to rely on your own efforts.

english_meaning: utterly rebellious; guilty of heinous crimes (especially against superiors or authority); treasonous; outrageous; extremely disrespectful
explanation_mandarin: 指触犯道德伦常，对尊长或权威极端叛逆，冒犯的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to behavior that violates ethical norms and is extremely rebellious and offensive towards elders or authorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 後生仔唔可以咁大逆不道㗎，點可以咁樣對你嘅父母呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hau6 sang1 zai2 m4 ho2 ji5 gam3 daai6 jik6 bat1 dou6 gaa3, dim2 ho2 ji5 gam3 joeng2 deoi3 nei5 ge3 fu6 mou5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 年轻人不可以这么大逆不道，怎么可以这样对待你的父母啊？
examples.english_sentence: Young people shouldn't be so outrageous, how can you treat your parents like that?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢居然想推翻公司嘅決定，真係大逆不道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 geoi1 jin4 soeng2 teoi1 faan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kyut3 ding6, zan1 hai6 daai6 jik6 bat1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他竟然想推翻公司的决定，真是大逆不道。
examples.english_sentence: He actually wants to overturn the company's decision, that's truly outrageous.

mandarin_meaning: 大肆宣扬; 大规模制作; 大张旗鼓
english_meaning: to promote heavily; to produce on a large scale; to make a big deal out of something; to exaggerate
explanation_mandarin: 指大规模地制作、宣传或宣扬某事物。也指把事情说得很夸张。
explanation_english: Refers to producing, promoting, or publicizing something on a large scale. It can also mean to exaggerate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司今年想大造呢隻新產品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 soeng2 daai6 zou6 ni1 zek3 san1 caan2 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司今年想大力推广这款新产品。
examples.english_sentence: The company wants to heavily promote this new product this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢只係跌親少少，就話自己斷咗手，真係大造。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi2 hai6 dit3 can1 siu2 siu2, zau6 waa6 zi6 gei2 dyun6 zo2 sau2, zan1 hai6 daai6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只是摔了一点，就说自己手断了，真是夸张。
examples.english_sentence: He just fell a little and said his hand was broken; he's really exaggerating.

synonyms: 大事宣傳 (daai6 si6 syun1 cyun4)

english_meaning: Bigger than heaven; of utmost importance; paramount
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物极其重要，高于一切，无可替代。
explanation_english: Describes something as being extremely important, above all else, and irreplaceable. It emphasizes the paramount importance of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對佢嚟講，屋企人咪大過天囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2, uk1 kei2 jan4 mai6 daai6 gwo3 tin1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对他来说，家人就是最重要的。
examples.english_sentence: To him, family is of utmost importance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺佢心目中，份工大過天，咩都擺埋一邊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 keoi5 sam1 muk6 zung1, fan6 gung1 daai6 gwo3 tin1, me1 dou1 baai2 maai4 jat1 bin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在他心中，工作是最重要的，什么都先放一边。
examples.english_sentence: In his mind, work is paramount, and everything else is put aside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為人父母，仔女梗係大過天啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai4 jan4 fu6 mou5, zai2 neoi5 gang2 hai6 daai6 gwo3 tin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为父母，子女肯定是至关重要的。
examples.english_sentence: Being parents, children are definitely the most important thing.

mandarin_meaning: 大路; 主要道路; 正道; 真理
english_meaning: main road; thoroughfare; boulevard; the right path; the great way; truth; principle
explanation_mandarin: 主要道路，寬闊的馬路；比喻正確的道路、原則、真理等。
explanation_english: A main road or thoroughfare. Figuratively, it refers to the correct path, principles, or truth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條大道好闊，揸車好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 daai6 dou6 hou2 fut3, zaa1 ce1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条大道很宽阔，开车很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This main road is very wide; it's comfortable to drive on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該行大道，唔好行歪路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 haang4 daai6 dou6, m4 hou2 haang4 waai1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该走正道，不要走歪路。
examples.english_sentence: We should follow the right path, not the wrong path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 社會嘅發展要符合自然嘅大道。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se5 wui2 ge3 faat3 zin2 yiu3 fu4 hap6 zi6 jin1 ge3 daai6 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 社会的发展要符合自然的规律。
examples.english_sentence: The development of society should conform to the natural laws.

english_meaning: general election
explanation_mandarin: 指大规模的选举，通常指国家或地区范围内选举领导人或议会代表的活动。
explanation_english: A general election, typically referring to a large-scale election at the national or regional level to elect leaders or representatives to a parliament or assembly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個月就係大選喇，你諗住投邊個？
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 jyut6 zau6 hai6 daai6 syun2 laa3, nei5 nam2 zyu6 tau4 bin1 go3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个月就是大选了，你打算投给谁？
examples.english_sentence: The general election is next month, who are you planning to vote for?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅大選競爭好激烈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 daai6 syun2 ging6 zang1 hou2 gik1 lit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的大选竞争很激烈。
examples.english_sentence: This year's general election is very competitive.

english_meaning: majority; most
explanation_mandarin: 指整体中的主要部分，占比较大。
explanation_english: Refers to the main part of a whole, accounting for a large proportion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部份學生都鍾意放假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 hok6 sang1 dou1 zung1 ji3 fong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分学生都喜欢放假。
examples.english_sentence: Most students like having holidays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司大部份同事都係後生仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 daai6 bou6 fan6 tung4 si6 dou1 hai6 hau6 saang1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司大部分同事都是年轻人。
examples.english_sentence: Most of my colleagues in the company are young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部份時間佢都喺屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan3 keoi5 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分时间他都在家里。
examples.english_sentence: He spends most of his time at home.

english_meaning: most; the majority; a large part
explanation_mandarin: 表示总体中的绝大部分。
explanation_english: Refers to the majority or a large proportion of a whole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部分學生都覺得呢個課程好有用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 hok6 sang1 dou1 gok3 dak1 ni1 go3 fo3 ching4 hou2 jau5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分学生都觉得这个课程很有用。
examples.english_sentence: Most students find this course very useful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部分香港人都識講廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 hoeng1 gong2 yan4 dou1 sik1 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分香港人都会说广东话。
examples.english_sentence: Most Hong Kong people can speak Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大部分時間我都喺屋企度過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan3 ngo5 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 dou6 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大部分时间我都在家里度过。
examples.english_sentence: I spend most of my time at home.

english_meaning: mostly, for the most part, in most cases
explanation_mandarin: 表示大多数情况下，大部分情况下。
explanation_english: Indicates in most cases, for the most part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生大都好乖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 saang1 daai6 dou1 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些学生大多都很乖。
examples.english_sentence: Most of these students are very well-behaved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅夏天大都好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 haa6 tin1 daai6 dou1 hou2 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的夏天大部分都很热。
examples.english_sentence: Summers in Hong Kong are mostly very hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲餐廳大都好貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 caan1 teng1 daai6 dou1 hou2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的餐厅大多都很贵。
examples.english_sentence: Most of the restaurants here are quite expensive.

mandarin_meaning: 土包子; 没见过世面的人
english_meaning: Bumpkin; hick; someone who is unsophisticated and naive, especially regarding urban life.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人没见过世面，缺乏都市生活的经验，通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unsophisticated and inexperienced, especially in urban environments, often used in a derogatory way. It implies a lack of awareness of modern trends and social norms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁大鄉里啦，入到嚟香港都唔識搭地鐵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 hoeng1 lei5 laa1, jap6 dou3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 dou1 m4 sik1 daap3 dei6 tit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么土包子了，来到香港都不会坐地铁。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a bumpkin, you've come to Hong Kong and still don't know how to take the subway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次去歐洲，咩都覺得好新奇，真係好似個大鄉里咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 heoi3 au1 zau1, me1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 san1 kei4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 go3 daai6 hoeng1 lei5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次去欧洲，什么都觉得很新奇，真像个土包子。
examples.english_sentence: It was his first time in Europe, and he found everything so new and interesting, he was really like a hick.

english_meaning: Hick comes to town; bumpkin in the city; country bumpkin visits the city; someone from the countryside feeling overwhelmed or naive in a city environment
explanation_mandarin: 形容来自乡下的人第一次到城市，对城市的一切感到新奇、不知所措，或行为举止显得笨拙、缺乏见识。
explanation_english: Describes someone from the countryside who is visiting the city for the first time and is either amazed and overwhelmed by everything or acts clumsy and unsophisticated due to a lack of familiarity with city life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次嚟香港，乜都覺得好新奇，真係好似大鄉里出城咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 lai4 hoeng1 gong2, mat1 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 san1 kei4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 daai6 hoeng1 lei5 ceot1 sing4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次来香港，什么都觉得很新奇，真像乡巴佬进城一样。
examples.english_sentence: It's his first time in Hong Kong, and he finds everything fascinating. He's really like a hick come to town.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑人哋大鄉里出城啦，你哋咪又係咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 jan4 dei6 daai6 hoeng1 lei5 ceot1 sing4 laa1, nei5 dei6 mai5 jau6 hai6 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘲笑别人乡巴佬进城了，你们以前不也是这样吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at others for being hicks coming to town, weren't you guys like that before too?

synonyms: 冇見過世面 (mou5 gin3 gwo3 sai3 min6) - never seen the world
井底之蛙 (zeng2 dai2 zi1 waa1) - frog at the bottom of a well

english_meaning: Luxury hotel; grand hotel
explanation_mandarin: 指规模大、服务好的高级酒店。
explanation_english: Refers to a large, high-class hotel with good service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋結婚嘅時候，想喺大酒店擺酒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 git3 fan1 ge3 si4 hau6, soeng2 hai2 daai6 zau2 dim3 baai2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们结婚的时候，想在高级酒店办婚宴。
examples.english_sentence: When we get married, we want to have the wedding banquet at a luxury hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日去大酒店食自助餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 heoi3 daai6 zau2 dim3 sik6 zi6 zo6 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们经常去高级酒店吃自助餐。
examples.english_sentence: They often go to luxury hotels to eat buffet.

english_meaning: large quantity; a lot; generous; magnanimous
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量很多，或者形容一个人心胸宽广。
explanation_english: Describes a large quantity of something, or describes a person as being generous and magnanimous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗大量嘅生果。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 daai6 loeng6 ge3 sang1 gwo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了很多水果。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a lot of fruit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅大量寬容令我好佩服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 daai6 loeng6 fun1 yung4 ling6 ngo5 hou2 pui3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的大量宽容令我很佩服。
examples.english_sentence: His magnanimity impressed me greatly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次嘅訂單數量好大量呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ge3 ding3 daan1 sou3 leong6 hou2 daai6 loeng6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的订单数量很大呀！
examples.english_sentence: The quantity of this order is very large!

english_meaning: to boast, to exaggerate, to tell tall tales
explanation_mandarin: 指说话夸张，不真实，有吹牛的成分。
explanation_english: Refers to speaking exaggeratedly or untruthfully, with an element of boasting or exaggeration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪聽佢大針啦，佢講嘢十句有九句都係假嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 teng1 keoi5 daai6 zam1 laa1, keoi5 gong2 je5 sap6 geoi3 jau5 gau2 geoi3 dou1 hai6 gaa2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别听他吹牛了，他说的话十句有九句都是假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't listen to him boasting, nine out of ten things he says are lies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日大針，話自己識好多有錢人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 daai6 zam1, waa6 zi6 gei2 sik1 hou2 do1 jau5 cin2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天吹牛，说自己认识很多有钱人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always boasting, saying that he knows a lot of rich people.

english_meaning: very slow-witted; dense; dull; stupid
explanation_mandarin: 形容人反应非常慢，理解能力差，笨拙。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very slow to react, has poor understanding, and is clumsy or stupid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁大鈍㗎，講咗咁多次都唔明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 daai6 deon6 gaa3, gong2 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3 dou1 m4 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么笨啊，说了这么多次都不明白。
examples.english_sentence: You're so dense, I've told you so many times and you still don't understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係大鈍，做嘢成日出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 daai6 deon6, zou6嘢seng4 jat6 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真的很笨，做事总是出错。
examples.english_sentence: He's really slow-witted, he always makes mistakes at work.

english_meaning: large denomination banknote; large bill
explanation_mandarin: 指面额较大的纸币，例如港币五百或一千元。
explanation_english: Refers to banknotes of large denominations, such as HKD 500 or 1000.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該幫我換啲散紙，我得大鈔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 wun6 di1 saan2 zi2, ngo5 dak1 daai6 caau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你帮我换些零钱，我只有大钞。
examples.english_sentence: Please help me break this into smaller bills, I only have large banknotes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗張大鈔出嚟俾錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 zoeng1 daai6 caau1 ceot1 lai4 bei2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿出一张大钞来付钱。
examples.english_sentence: He took out a large bill to pay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我找唔開大鈔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 zaau2 m4 hoi1 daai6 caau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我找不开大额钞票。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I can't break large bills.

english_meaning: big screen, movie screen
explanation_mandarin: 指电影院里或大型投影设备所使用的很大的屏幕。
explanation_english: Refers to the large screen used in cinemas or by large projection equipment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好耐冇喺大銀幕睇戲喇。
