examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa2 waa2 tin1 fu3 ji6 bing2, sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 ji5 ging1 lo2 zo2 ho2 do1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的绘画天赋异禀，从小就获得了很多奖项。
examples.english_sentence: He's exceptionally gifted at painting; he's won many awards since he was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺音樂方面真係天賦異稟，乜樂器都一學就識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 jam1 ngok6 fong1 min6 zan1 hai6 tin1 fu3 ji6 bing2, mat1 ngok6 hei3 dou1 jat1 hok6 zau6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在音乐方面真是天赋异禀，什么乐器一学就会。
examples.english_sentence: He is truly gifted in music, he can learn any instrument quickly.

jyutping: tin1 dit3 lok6 lai4 dong3 bei6 ham6
english_meaning: To take things as they come; to not worry about problems; to be nonchalant about serious situations
explanation_mandarin: 比喻遇到困难或危险时，不担心、不采取行动，抱着得过且过的态度。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a person who is extremely laid-back and doesn't worry about serious problems or potential disasters, essentially acting as if everything is alright even when it's not. It implies a somewhat irresponsible or carefree attitude towards serious situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都係咁，天跌落嚟當被冚，乜都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gam2, tin1 dit3 lok6 lai4 dong3 bei6 ham6, mat1 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这样，天塌下来当被盖，什么都不管。
examples.english_sentence: He's always like this, doesn't care about anything, takes everything as it comes, even if the sky is falling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁天跌落嚟當被冚啦，再唔做嘢就俾人炒魷魚㗎啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tin1 dit3 lok6 lai4 dong3 bei6 ham6 laa1, zoi3 m4 zou6 je5 zau6 bei2 jan4 caau2 jau4 jyu2 gaa3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么天塌下来当被盖了，再不做事就要被解雇了！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nonchalant! If you don't start working, you'll get fired!

english_meaning: A match made in heaven; a perfect match; divinely ordained
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物非常完美地结合在一起，好像是上天安排的一样。
explanation_english: Describes a perfect or ideal match, as if ordained or arranged by heaven. Often used to describe a couple who are perfectly suited for each other, or things that complement each other perfectly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個真係天造地設嘅一對。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 zan1 hai6 tin1 zou6 dei6 cit3 ge3 jat1 deoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个真是天造地设的一对。
examples.english_sentence: They are truly a match made in heaven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫同條裙真係天造地設，襯到絕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 tung4 tiu4 kwan4 zan1 hai6 tin1 zou6 dei6 cit3, can3 dou3 zyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衬衫和这条裙子真是天作之合，搭配得完美极了。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt and skirt are a perfect match, they go together incredibly well.

english_meaning: The chosen one; a person divinely selected or exceptionally gifted
explanation_mandarin: 指被上天选中的人，通常形容具有特殊才能、命运或责任的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person chosen by fate or destiny, typically used to describe someone with exceptional talent, luck, or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就做咗 CEO，真係天選之人啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 CEO, zan1 hai6 tin1 syun2 zi1 jan4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就当了CEO，真是天选之人啊！
examples.english_sentence: He became CEO at such a young age, he's truly the chosen one!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢個困境之下，佢竟然可以帶領團隊走出困境，簡直係天選之人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 go3 kwan3 ging2 zi1 haa6, keoi5 ging2 jin4 ho2 ji5 daai3 ling5 tyun4 deoi2 zau2 ceot1 kwan3 ging2, gaan2 zik6 hai6 tin1 syun2 zi1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种困境之下，他竟然可以带领团队走出困境，简直是天选之人。
examples.english_sentence: In this difficult situation, he was able to lead the team out of trouble, he is simply the chosen one.

english_meaning: horizon, edge of the sky, far away
explanation_mandarin: 天空的边缘；指很远的地方。
explanation_english: The edge of the sky; refers to a very distant place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺天邊咁遠嘅地方，好少見到佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 tin1 bin1 gam3 jyun5 ge3 dei6 fong1, hou2 siu2 gin3 dou2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在天边那么远的地方，很少见到他们。
examples.english_sentence: They live in a place so far away, on the edge of the earth, we rarely see them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等到天邊海角都搵唔到你，我就放棄啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 dou3 tin1 bin1 hoi2 gok3 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 nei5, ngo5 zau6 fong3 hei3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等到天涯海角都找不到你，我就放弃了。
examples.english_sentence: If I can't find you even at the ends of the earth, I'll give up.

english_meaning: eternal; everlasting; as long as the world lasts
explanation_mandarin: 形容时间非常长久，通常用来形容感情或友谊的永恒。
explanation_english: Describes something lasting forever, often used to describe eternal love or friendship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望我哋嘅友誼可以天長地久啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 jau5 ji5 ho2 ji5 tin1 coeng4 dei6 gau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望我们的友谊可以天长地久。
examples.english_sentence: I hope our friendship can last forever.

mandarin_meaning: 开了眼, 事情出现转机, 出现意外的转好
english_meaning: To have one's eyes opened; to see the light; a turn for the better; things unexpectedly taking a positive turn; to be lucky.
explanation_mandarin: 指本来很糟糕的局面突然好转，像是老天睁开了眼睛一样，看到了困境，给了好运。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to a situation that was originally very bad suddenly taking a turn for the better, as if heaven has opened its eyes and seen the hardship, thus bestowing good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住今次死梗，點知最尾天開眼，竟然俾我過到骨！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 gam1 ci3 sei2 gang2, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 mei5 tin1 hoi1 ngaan5, ging2 jin4 bei2 ngo5 gwo3 dou3 gwat1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为这次死定了，没想到最后竟然时来运转，竟然让我过关了！
examples.english_sentence: I thought I was done for this time, but unexpectedly, things took a turn for the better at the end, and I actually made it through!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本來間公司就嚟執笠，點知突然接到張大單，真係天開眼！
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 loi4 gaan1 gung1 si1 zau6 lai4 zap1 lap1, dim2 zi1 dat6 jin4 zip3 dou3 zoeng1 daai6 daan1, zan1 hai6 tin1 hoi1 ngaan5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 本来这家公司就要倒闭了，没想到突然接到一个大订单，真是时来运转！
examples.english_sentence: The company was about to close down, but suddenly it received a large order; it's truly a turn for the better!

english_meaning: overcast; cloudy
explanation_mandarin: 指天空被云层覆盖，阳光被遮蔽的天气。
explanation_english: Refers to weather where the sky is covered by clouds, blocking sunlight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天陰陰，好似會落雨噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 jam1 jam1, hou2 ci5 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天阴沉沉的，好像要下雨似的。
examples.english_sentence: It's overcast today, looks like it's going to rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意天陰嘅天氣，唔會曬到咁熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 tin1 jam1 ge3 tin1 hei3, m4 wui5 saai3 dou3 gam3 jit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢阴天的天气，不会晒得那么热。
examples.english_sentence: I like overcast weather, it's not as hot.

english_meaning: Overcast; cloudy; gloomy sky
explanation_mandarin: 形容天空阴暗，乌云密布，光线不足的状态。
explanation_english: Describes the state of the sky being dark, covered with dark clouds, and lacking sufficient light. Often implies that it might rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天陰陰咁嘅，好似就嚟落雨噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 jam1 jam1 gam3 ge3, hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 lok6 jyu5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天阴天，好像要下雨的样子。
examples.english_sentence: The sky is overcast today; it looks like it's going to rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天陰陰，唔好忘記帶遮呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 jam1 jam1, m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 daai3 ze1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天阴沉沉的，不要忘记带伞啊！
examples.english_sentence: The sky is overcast, don't forget to bring an umbrella!

synonyms: 烏雲密佈 (wu1 wan4 mat6 bou3)

english_meaning: horizon, skyline
explanation_mandarin: 天空与地面相接的地方。
explanation_english: The line at which the sky and earth appear to meet; the horizon or skyline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日落嗰陣，天際畀啲晚霞染到紅晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 lok6 go2 zan6, tin1 zai3 bei2 di1 maan5 haa4 jim5 dou3 hung4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 日落的时候，天边被晚霞染得通红。
examples.english_sentence: At sunset, the horizon was completely dyed red by the sunset glow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 由呢度望出去，天際線好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau4 ni1 dou6 mong6 cheut1 heoi3, tin1 zai3 sin3 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 从这里望出去，天际线很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Looking out from here, the skyline is very beautiful.

english_meaning: skullcap; top of the head; (slang) one's mind or brain
explanation_mandarin: 头顶的骨头；比喻脑子或思想。
explanation_english: The bones at the top of the head; figuratively, it can refer to one's mind or brain, often used in negative contexts implying stupidity or lack of understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講啲嘢咁蠢，真係想掀開佢個天靈蓋睇下入面係咪得豆腐渣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 di1 je5 gam3 ceon2, zan1 hai6 soeng2 hin1 hoi1 keoi5 go3 tin1 ling4 goi3 tai2 haa5 jap6 min6 hai6 mai6 dak1 dau6 fu6 zaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话这么蠢，真想掀开他的天灵盖看看里面是不是只有豆腐渣。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is so stupid, I really want to open up his skull and see if there's only tofu dregs inside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁蠢啦，諗嘢用下你個天靈蓋啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ceon2 laa1, nam2 je5 jung6 haa5 nei5 go3 tin1 ling4 goi3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么蠢了，想想办法用下你的脑子吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, use your brain a little!

english_meaning: roof; rooftop
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物最顶层的平面，通常是屋顶。
explanation_english: Refers to the uppermost horizontal surface of a building, typically the roof.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋上去天面曬衫啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seung5 heoi3 tin1 min6 saai3 saam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们上去屋顶晒衣服吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go up to the rooftop to dry the clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天面漏水，要搵人嚟整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 min6 lau6 seui2, jiu3 wan2 jan4 lai4 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 屋顶漏水，要找人来修理。
examples.english_sentence: The roof is leaking, we need to find someone to repair it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚喺天面睇星星好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 hai2 tin1 min6 tai2 sing1 sing1 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上在屋顶看星星很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: It's very beautiful to watch the stars on the rooftop at night.

english_meaning: unrestrained imagination; wild and fanciful; soaring imagination; thinking outside the box
explanation_mandarin: 比喻人的思想非常开放，不受拘束，想象力丰富。
explanation_english: Describes someone's thoughts being very open and unrestrained, with a rich imagination. Refers to imaginative and unrealistic ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲諗法成日都天馬行空，好難實現㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 naam2 faat3 sing4 jat6 dou1 tin1 maa5 hang4 hung1, hou2 naan4 sat6 jian6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法总是天马行空，很难实现。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are always wild and fanciful, and are difficult to realize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁天馬行空啦，實際啲得唔得呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 tin1 maa5 hang4 hung1 laa1, sat6 zai3 di1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么天马行空了，实际一点行不行啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unrealistic, can you be more practical?

english_meaning: nude; celestial body
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“天体”有两个主要意思。一个是与天文相关的，指宇宙中的星球等 celestial body。另一个是口语化的说法，指裸体，特别是女性的裸体。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "天體" has two main meanings. One is related to astronomy, referring to celestial bodies such as planets in the universe. The other is a colloquial term for nudity, especially female nudity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺沙灘度曬太陽，有啲人甚至變咗天體。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 saai3 tai3 joeng4, jau5 di1 jan4 sam3 zi3 bin3 zo2 tin1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在沙滩上晒太阳，有些人甚至裸体了。
examples.english_sentence: They were sunbathing on the beach, and some people even went nude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天文學家研究天體嘅運行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 man4 hok6 gaa1 jin4 gau3 tin1 tai2 ge3 wan6 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天文学家研究天体的运行。
examples.english_sentence: Astronomers study the movement of celestial bodies.

english_meaning: Nudist camp
explanation_mandarin: 指允许人们裸体活动的营地或场所。
explanation_english: A camp or place where people are allowed to be naked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講佢哋去咗個天體營度假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 teng1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 go3 tin1 tai2 ying4 dou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说他们去了一个裸体营地度假。
examples.english_sentence: I heard they went to a nudist camp for vacation.

english_meaning: swan
explanation_mandarin: 一种大型水鸟，颈长而弯曲，羽毛洁白或黑色，姿态优雅。
explanation_english: A large waterbird with a long, graceful neck and typically pure white plumage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公園入面見到好多天鵝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 jyun2 jap6 min6 gin3 dou2 ho2 do1 tin1 ngo4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公园里看到了很多天鹅。
examples.english_sentence: He saw many swans in the park.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 天鵝嘅姿態真係好優雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 ngo4 ge3 zi1 taai3 zan1 hai6 hou2 yau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 天鹅的姿态真是很优雅。
examples.english_sentence: The swan's posture is truly elegant.

english_meaning: velvet
explanation_mandarin: 一种表面有绒毛的丝织物或棉织物。
explanation_english: A type of woven fabric with a short, dense pile, giving it a soft, smooth feel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙係天鵝絨造嘅，好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hai6 tin1 ngo4 jung4 zou6 ge3, hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的裙子是天鹅绒做的，真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: Her dress is made of velvet, it's so beautiful!

english_meaning: to get dark; nightfall
explanation_mandarin: 指太阳下山后，天空变暗。
explanation_english: Refers to the sky becoming dark after the sun sets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 快啲返屋企啦，就嚟天黑喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faai3 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1, zau6 lai4 tin1 hak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快点回家吧，就要天黑了。
examples.english_sentence: Hurry home, it's going to get dark soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋天黑之前一定要到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 tin1 hak1 zi1 cin4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一定要在天黑之前到达。
examples.english_sentence: We must arrive before nightfall.

english_meaning: too; very; extremely; excessively
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很高或超出适当的范围。
explanation_english: Indicates a high degree or exceeding the appropriate range.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫太大件喇，唔啱我着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 taai3 daai6 gin6 laa3, m4 ngaam1 ngo5 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服太大了，不适合我穿。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is too big, it doesn't fit me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣太熱喇，最好唔好出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 taai3 jit6 laa3, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气太热了，最好不要出门。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is too hot today, it's best not to go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢太叻喇，乜嘢都識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 taai3 lek1 laa3, mat1 je5 dou1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太厉害了，什么都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He is too capable, he knows everything.

english_meaning: Retired Emperor, figure with influence behind the scenes
explanation_mandarin: 指已退位的皇帝，但仍具有影响力或权力的人。有时也用来比喻虽然卸任，但仍在幕后操控的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a retired emperor, but someone who still wields influence or power. Sometimes used as a metaphor for someone who has stepped down from a position but still manipulates things behind the scenes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然退休咗，但係公司嘅人都覺得佢好似太上皇咁，乜都要問過佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 teoi3 jau1 zo2, daan6 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 dou1 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 taai3 soeng6 wong4 gam2, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 man6 gwo3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然退休了，但是公司的人都觉得他好像太上皇一样，什么都要问过他。
examples.english_sentence: Although he's retired, people in the company still feel like he's the Emperor Emeritus; they have to consult him about everything.

english_meaning: Grand Supreme Elderly Lord (Taoist deity, also known as Laozi deified)
explanation_mandarin: 道教中地位极高的神祇之一，是道教创始人老子的神格化身。
explanation_english: One of the highest deities in Taoism, the deified form of Laozi, the founder of Taoism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講拜太上老君可以保平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 baai3 taai3 soeng6 lou5 gwan1 ho2 ji5 bou2 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 据说拜太上老君可以保平安。
examples.english_sentence: It is said that praying to the Grand Supreme Elderly Lord can protect you and bring peace.

english_meaning: Grand Tutor (historical official title)
explanation_mandarin: 古代官名，辅导太子的大臣。
explanation_english: An ancient official title. A minister who tutored the crown prince.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係太子嘅太傅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 taai3 zi2 ge3 taai3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前是太子的太傅。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be the crown prince's Grand Tutor.

mandarin_meaning: 外祖父; 爷爷的哥哥
english_meaning: maternal grandfather; great uncle (father's elder brother)
explanation_mandarin: 指外祖父，即母亲的父亲。有时也指爷爷的哥哥。
explanation_english: Refers to maternal grandfather (mother's father). Can also refer to a great uncle (father's elder brother).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去探我太公呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 taam3 ngo5 taai3 gung1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去探望我的外公。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to visit my maternal grandfather tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我太公好錫我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 taai3 gung1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的外公很疼爱我们。
examples.english_sentence: My maternal grandfather loves us very much.

english_meaning: Unequal distribution (of benefits or rewards); unfairly distributed
explanation_mandarin: 太公，指周朝姜太公姜子牙。相傳姜太公分豬肉時，分得好壞不一，有人分得多，有人分得少，導致不公平的結果。形容分配不均，造成怨言。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to Jiang Ziya (姜子牙), the Grand Duke (太公) of the Zhou Dynasty. It is said that when he distributed pork, the portions were unequal, with some receiving more and some receiving less, leading to unfairness and complaints. It describes an unfair distribution of benefits or rewards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次花紅咁分法，簡直係太公分豬肉，有人多到笑，有人少到喊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 faa1 hung4 gam2 fan1 faat3, gaan2 zik6 hai6 taai3 gung1 fan1 zyu1 juk6, jau5 jan4 do1 dou3 siu3, jau5 jan4 siu2 dou3 haam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次分红这样分配，简直就是分赃不均，有人多到笑，有人少到哭。
examples.english_sentence: The way bonuses are distributed this time is completely unfair, some people get so much they're laughing, some get so little they're crying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司升職永遠都係太公分豬肉，冇能力嘅人都可以升得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 sing1 zik1 wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 taai3 gung1 fan1 zyu1 juk6, mou5 nang4 lik6 ge3 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 sing1 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司升职永远都是分配不均，没有能力的人也可以升得很快。
examples.english_sentence: Promotions in this company are always unfairly distributed, people without ability can also get promoted quickly.

cantonese: 太公分豬肉 - 人人有份
jyutping: taai3 gung1 fan1 zyu1 juk6 － jan4 jan4 jau5 fan6
english_meaning: Everyone gets a share; Everyone has a part.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻公平分配，人人都能得到一份。
explanation_english: An idiom meaning that everyone gets a fair share, and everyone is entitled to a portion of something. It implies equal distribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次公司派花紅，太公分豬肉，個個都有份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gung1 si1 paai3 faa1 hung4, taai3 gung1 fan1 zyu1 juk6, go3 go3 dou1 jau5 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次公司发奖金，人人有份，大家都有份。
examples.english_sentence: This time the company is giving out bonuses, everyone gets a share, everyone has a part.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅利潤，太公分豬肉，大家都有得益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 lei6 jeon6, taai3 gung1 fan1 zyu1 juk6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 jau5 dak1 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的利润，大家都有份，每个人都有好处。
examples.english_sentence: The profits of this project, everyone gets a share, everyone benefits.

english_meaning: Taiyuan (capital of Shanxi Province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 中国山西省的省会
explanation_english: Taiyuan is the capital city of Shanxi Province in China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月要去太原出差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 jiu3 heoi3 taai3 jyun4 cheot1 chaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月要去太原出差。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Taiyuan on a business trip next month.

english_meaning: Taikoo (place name); Swire (company name)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的一个地名，也指太古集团。
explanation_english: A place name in Hong Kong; also refers to the Swire Group (a major conglomerate).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺太古附近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 taai3 gu2 fu6 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在太古附近。
examples.english_sentence: I live near Taikoo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太古城嘅嘢好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 gu2 sing4 ge3 je5 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太古城的东西很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: Things in Taikoo Shing are very expensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺太古公司返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 taai3 gu2 gung1 si1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在太古公司上班。
examples.english_sentence: He works at Swire.

english_meaning: Empress Dowager
explanation_mandarin: 古代皇帝的母亲，现任皇帝的母亲。
explanation_english: The mother of the emperor in ancient times; the mother of the current emperor. It can also be used metaphorically to describe a demanding or imperious older woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企嘅地位就好似太后咁，咩都要聽佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 dei6 wai2 zau6 hou2 ci5 taai3 hau6 gam2, me1 dou1 jiu3 teng1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在家里地位就像太后一样，什么都要听她的。
examples.english_sentence: Her position at home is like an Empress Dowager; everyone has to listen to her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日擺款，好似太后出巡咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 baai2 fun2, hou2 ci5 taai3 hau6 ceot1 seon4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老奶奶总是摆架子，好像太后出巡一样。
examples.english_sentence: The old lady always puts on airs, like an Empress Dowager on parade.

english_meaning: peace; tranquility; harmonious
explanation_mandarin: 形容太平安宁的状态，也指和平。
explanation_english: Describes a state of peace and tranquility; can also refer to peace in general. It can describe a harmonious atmosphere or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望世界永遠太和啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 sai3 gaai3 wing5 jyun5 taai3 wo4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望世界永远太平啦。
examples.english_sentence: I hope the world will always be peaceful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋裝修到好太和，住喺入面好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zong1 sau1 dou3 hou2 taai3 wo4, zyu6 hai2 jap6 min6 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房子装修得很和谐，住在里面很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The house is decorated in a very harmonious way, it's very comfortable to live in.

english_meaning: Mrs. / wife / married woman
explanation_mandarin: 已婚女性的称谓，通常指妻子。
explanation_english: A term of address for a married woman, usually referring to a wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生嘅太太好靚女呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 ge3 taai3 taai2 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生的太太很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee's wife is very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我太太好鍾意睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 taai3 taai2 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我太太很喜欢看电影。
examples.english_sentence: My wife loves watching movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢介紹佢太太俾我哋識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaai3 siu6 keoi5 taai3 taai2 bei2 ngo5 dei6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他介绍他太太给我们认识。
examples.english_sentence: He introduced his wife to us.

english_meaning: great-grandmother; old woman
explanation_mandarin: （1）称谓，指曾祖母。（2）年老的妇人。
explanation_english: (1) Term of address for one's great-grandmother. (2) An old woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿太婆今年九十幾歲，但係仲好精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 taai3 po4 gam1 nin4 gau2 sap6 gei2 seoi3, daan6 hai6 zung6 hou2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的曾祖母今年九十多岁了，但是还很有精神。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandmother is over ninety years old this year, but she is still very energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個太婆企係度等巴士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 taai3 po4 kei5 hai2 dou6 dang2 baa1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那位老太太站在那里等巴士。
examples.english_sentence: That old woman is standing there waiting for the bus.

english_meaning: great-grandmother (paternal)
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的祖母，即爷爷的母亲。
explanation_english: The paternal great-grandmother; the grandmother of one's father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我太嫲今年九十幾歲，但係仲好精神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 taai3 maa4 gam1 nin4 gau2 sap6 gei2 seoi3, daan6 hai6 zung6 hou2 zing1 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的曾祖母今年九十多岁，但是还很精神。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandmother is over ninety years old this year, but she is still very energetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我成日去太嫲屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 taai3 maa4 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我经常去曾祖母家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often went to my great-grandmother's house to play.

mandarin_meaning: 太子，储君；黑社会头目的儿子；比喻有权有势的人的儿子
english_meaning: Crown prince; Son of a triad boss; Metaphorically, son of a powerful or influential person
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是皇位继承人，后引申为黑社会头目的儿子，现在也用来比喻有权有势的人的儿子。
explanation_english: Literally means crown prince, heir to the throne. It is also used to refer to the son of a triad boss. Nowadays, it is also used metaphorically to refer to the son of a powerful or influential person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老豆係公司嘅大老闆，佢咪即係公司嘅太子囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 dau2 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 daai6 lou5 baan2, keoi5 mai1 zik1 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 taai3 zi2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是公司的大老板，他就是公司的太子爷了。
examples.english_sentence: His father is the big boss of the company, so he is the company's 'crown prince'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢係黑社會嘅太子，好惡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai6 hak1 se5 wui2 ge3 taai3 zi2, hou2 ok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他是黑社会头目的儿子，很凶恶的。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he is the son of a triad boss, very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你係太子就大晒，都要尊重其他人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 hai6 taai3 zi2 zau6 daai6 saai3, dou1 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 kei4 taa1 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你是太子就可以为所欲为，也要尊重其他人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that just because you're the 'crown prince' you can do whatever you want, you still need to respect others.

english_meaning: Daddy's girl, heiress, daughter of a wealthy and influential family
explanation_mandarin: 指富豪或有权势的人家的女儿，通常生活优越，备受宠爱。
explanation_english: Refers to the daughter of a wealthy or powerful family, usually living a privileged and pampered life. It carries connotations of being spoiled and reliant on her father's wealth and influence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個太子女嚟㗎，唔使做都大把錢洗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 taai3 zi2 neoi2 lai4 gaa3, m4 sai2 zou6 dou1 daai6 baa2 cin2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是个千金小姐，不用工作也有很多钱花。
examples.english_sentence: She's a daddy's girl; she doesn't need to work and still has plenty of money to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為佢淨係個太子女，佢都好有能力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 keoi5 zing6 hai6 go3 taai3 zi2 neoi2, keoi5 dou1 hou2 jau5 nang4 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为她只是个千金小姐，她也很有能力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think she's just a daddy's girl; she's actually quite capable.

english_meaning: Young master, rich young man, son of a wealthy or powerful person
explanation_mandarin: 指有钱人家的儿子，通常生活优越，不必为生活操心。也用来称呼地位高的人的儿子。
explanation_english: Refers to the son of a wealthy or powerful family, who usually lives a privileged life and doesn't need to worry about earning a living. Can also be used to refer to the son of someone in a high position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅太子爺返咗嚟接管生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 taai3 zi2 je4 faan1 zo2 lai4 zip3 gun2 sang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的少爷回来了接管生意。
examples.english_sentence: The young master of their company has returned to take over the business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁慣佢，佢淨係個太子爺嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gwaan3 keoi5, keoi5 zing6 hai6 go3 taai3 zi2 je4 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么惯着他，他不过是个少爷罢了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spoil him so much, he's just a rich boy.

english_meaning: Princelings, Crown Prince Party (referring to the offspring of prominent and influential communist party leaders in China)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国共产党高级领导干部子女组成的政治群体，他们通常利用家族的政治资源和影响力在政界、商界获得优势。
explanation_english: Refers to the political group formed by the offspring of high-ranking Chinese Communist Party leaders. They typically leverage their families' political resources and influence to gain advantages in politics and business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得依家啲太子黨好易上位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 ji1 ga1 di1 taai3 zi2 dong2 hou2 ji6 soeng5 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得现在的太子党很容易上位。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that the princelings nowadays have an easy time climbing the ranks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅背景咁勁，一定係太子黨㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 bui3 ging2 gam3 ging6, jat1 ding6 hai6 taai3 zi2 dong2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的背景这么强大，肯定是太子党了。
examples.english_sentence: With such a powerful background, he must be a princeling.

english_meaning: Grand tutor's chair, armchair (often ornate and traditional); to be in a comfortable and secure position (idiomatic)
explanation_mandarin: 太师椅是一种宽大舒适的椅子，通常有靠背和扶手，设计华丽。在比喻意义上，也指处于舒适和稳定的地位。
explanation_english: A grand tutor's chair is a large, comfortable chair, typically with a backrest and armrests, often ornately designed. Figuratively, it can also refer to being in a comfortable and stable position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職之後，就好似坐咗喺太師椅度，歎世界喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, zau6 hou2 ci5 co5 zo2 hai2 taai3 si1 ji2 dou6, taan3 sai3 gaai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职之后，就好像坐在太师椅上一样，享受生活了。
examples.english_sentence: After his promotion, it's like he's sitting in a grand tutor's chair, enjoying life to the fullest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺張太師椅，佢成日坐喺度睇報紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 zoeng1 taai3 si1 ji2, keoi5 seng4 jat6 co5 hai2 dou6 tai2 bou3 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷的那张太师椅，他经常坐在上面看报纸。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa's grand tutor's chair, he always sits there reading the newspaper.

english_meaning: peaceful; tranquil; calm; in good health
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境或局势安宁，没有骚乱或战争；也可以指身体健康。
explanation_english: Describing a peaceful and tranquil environment or situation, free from unrest or war; can also refer to being in good health.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望香港可以早啲太平落嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 hoeng1 gong2 ho2 ji5 zou2 di1 taai3 ping4 lok6 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望香港可以早点太平下来。
examples.english_sentence: Hoping that Hong Kong can be peaceful again soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近身体太平吗？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 san1 tai2 taai3 ping4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近身体好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you been in good health recently?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家世界好唔太平啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 sai3 gaai3 hou2 m4 taai3 ping4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在世界很不太平啊。
examples.english_sentence: The world is very turbulent now.

mandarin_meaning: 平胸女性；胸部平坦的女性
english_meaning: A woman with a flat chest; flat-chested woman
explanation_mandarin: 原指唐朝的太平公主。后来被用作形容胸部不丰满的女性，带有一种略带戏谑的意味。
explanation_english: Originally referring to Princess Taiping of the Tang Dynasty. Later used to describe a woman with a small or flat chest. Often used in a slightly teasing or humorous way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己係太平公主，唔想着啲太性感嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 taai3 ping4 gung1 zyu2, m4 soeng2 zoek3 di1 taai3 sing2 gam2 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是说自己是太平公主，不想穿太性感的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: She always says she's flat-chested and doesn't want to wear clothes that are too revealing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，話人係太平公主好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, waa6 jan4 hai6 taai3 ping4 gung1 zyu2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么说别人啦，说别人是太平公主很没礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about people, calling someone flat-chested is rude.

english_meaning: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom
explanation_mandarin: 指1851年至1864年间由洪秀全领导的农民起义建立的政权。
explanation_english: Refers to the rebel state established by Hong Xiuquan during the Taiping Rebellion from 1851 to 1864.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太平天國係中國歷史上好重要嘅一頁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 ping4 tin1 gwok3 hai6 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 soeng6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太平天国是中国历史上很重要的一页。
examples.english_sentence: The Taiping Heavenly Kingdom is a very important page in Chinese history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋讀歷史嘅時候，要學埋太平天國嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 duk6 lik6 si2 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 hok6 maai4 taai3 ping4 tin1 gwok3 ge3 gu3 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们读历史的时候，也要学习太平天国的故事。
examples.english_sentence: When we study history, we also need to learn about the story of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom.

mandarin_meaning: 太平山；香港岛最高的山峰，也指山顶
english_meaning: Victoria Peak; The Peak (Hong Kong's highest mountain on Hong Kong Island)
explanation_mandarin: 香港岛最高的山峰，是香港著名的旅游景点。也可指山顶缆车等相关设施所在的区域。
explanation_english: Victoria Peak, the highest mountain on Hong Kong Island, is a popular tourist attraction. It can also refer to the area at the top of the mountain, including the Peak Tram and other facilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日上太平山睇夜景啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 soeng5 taaai3 ping4 saan1 tai2 je6 ging2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天上太平山看夜景吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Victoria Peak to see the night view tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭山頂纜車上太平山好方便㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 saan1 ding2 laam6 ce1 soeng5 taaai3 ping4 saan1 hou2 fong1 bin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐山顶缆车上太平山很方便的。
examples.english_sentence: It's very convenient to take the Peak Tram to Victoria Peak.

english_meaning: Below Victoria Peak; In Hong Kong Island; Living in Hong Kong
explanation_mandarin: 字面上指太平山下面，即香港岛。引申为指香港，在香港生活。
explanation_english: Literally means 'below Victoria Peak', which refers to Hong Kong Island. By extension, it can refer to Hong Kong in general, or living in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺太平山下長大，對呢度嘅文化好熟悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 taaai3 ping4 saan1 haa6 zoeng2 daai6, deoi3 ni1 dou6 ge3 man4 faa3 hou2 suk6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港长大，对这里的文化很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: I grew up in Hong Kong, and I'm very familiar with the culture here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家搬咗去太平山下住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 bun1 zo2 heoi3 taaai3 ping4 saan1 haa6 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家搬去了香港岛住。
examples.english_sentence: Their family moved to live in Hong Kong Island.

english_meaning: fire escape, emergency exit stairs
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑物内用于紧急情况下疏散人员的楼梯。通常设置在楼房的后部或侧面，以确保在火灾或其他紧急情况发生时，人们可以迅速且安全地离开建筑物。
explanation_english: Refers to a staircase in a building used for evacuating people in case of an emergency. It is usually located at the back or side of the building to ensure that people can quickly and safely leave the building in the event of a fire or other emergency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果火燭嘅時候，記得行太平梯走啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 fo2 zuk1 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 haang4 taai3 ping4 tai1 zau2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果发生火灾的时候，记得走安全楼梯逃生啊。
examples.english_sentence: If there's a fire, remember to use the fire escape to evacuate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋間寫字樓有兩條太平梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 se2 zi6 lau2 jau5 loeng5 tiu4 taai3 ping4 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的办公室有两条安全楼梯。
examples.english_sentence: Our office has two fire escapes.

english_meaning: Pacific Ocean
explanation_mandarin: 地球上最大的海洋。
explanation_english: The largest ocean on Earth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港喺太平洋嘅邊緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai2 taai3 ping4 joeng4 ge3 bin1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港位于太平洋的边缘。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is on the edge of the Pacific Ocean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太平洋好大，要坐好耐船先可以去到美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 ping4 joeng4 hou2 daai6, jiu3 co5 hou2 noi6 syun4 sin1 ho2 ji5 heoi3 dou3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太平洋很大，要坐很久的船才可以到达美国。
examples.english_sentence: The Pacific Ocean is very large, it takes a long boat ride to get to America.

english_meaning: Taiping Qingjiao (Taoist ritual for peace and renewal)
explanation_mandarin: 香港新界乡村地区举行的一种传统道教仪式，目的是酬神祈福，超度亡灵，保佑地方平安。
explanation_english: A traditional Taoist ritual held in rural areas of the New Territories in Hong Kong, with the purpose of thanking the gods, praying for blessings, and delivering souls to the afterlife, ensuring peace and safety in the local area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 年年都搞太平清醮，希望可以保佑我哋条村风调雨顺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nin4 nin4 dou1 gaau2 taai3 ping4 cing1 ziu3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bou2 jau6 ngo5 dei6 tiu4 cyun1 fung1 diu4 jyu5 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 每年都举办太平清醮，希望可以保佑我们村风调雨顺。
examples.english_sentence: Every year, we hold the Taiping Qingjiao, hoping it can bless our village with good weather for crops.

english_meaning: Golden age of peace and prosperity; era of great peace and prosperity
explanation_mandarin: 指社会安定，政治清明，经济繁荣的时代。
explanation_english: Refers to a time of social stability, enlightened governance, and economic prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋希望香港可以回復返太平盛世嘅日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hei1 mong6 hoeng1 gong2 ho2 ji5 wui4 fuk1 faan1 taai3 ping4 sing6 sai3 ge3 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们希望香港可以恢复到太平盛世的日子。
examples.english_sentence: We hope Hong Kong can return to the days of peace and prosperity.

english_meaning: Justice of the Peace (Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港的太平绅士制度源于英国，由香港特别行政区行政长官委任，主要职能包括巡视监狱、接受市民投诉及作出调解等。太平绅士在香港社会扮演着一定的角色，通常是社会上的知名人士或对社会有贡献的人。
explanation_english: In Hong Kong, a Justice of the Peace is a person appointed by the Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Their main functions include visiting prisons, receiving public complaints, and conducting mediation. Justices of the Peace often play a certain role in Hong Kong society and are usually well-known individuals or people who have contributed to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為長期做義工，所以俾政府委任做太平紳士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 coeng4 kei4 zou6 ji6 gung1, so2 ji5 bei2 zing3 fu2 wai2 jam6 zou6 taai3 ping4 san1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他长期做义工，所以被政府委任为太平绅士。
examples.english_sentence: Because he has been a long-time volunteer, he was appointed as a Justice of the Peace by the government.

english_meaning: Hearse
explanation_mandarin: 指运送棺材或遗体的车辆，常用于丧葬场合。
explanation_english: A vehicle for conveying a coffin or corpse at a funeral.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋琴日見到架太平車駛過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kam4 jat6 gin3 dou2 gaa3 taai3 ping4 ce1 sai2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们昨天看到一辆灵车驶过。
examples.english_sentence: We saw a hearse drive by yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日講埋啲唔老嚟嘅嘢，好似太平車咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 gong2 maai4 di1 m4 lou5 lai4 ge3 je5, hou2 ci5 taai3 ping4 ce1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是说一些不吉利的话，好像灵车一样。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always say unlucky things, like a hearse.

english_meaning: an easy and comfortable job, a cushy job
explanation_mandarin: 指工作轻松舒适，没什么压力，待遇也不错的职位。
explanation_english: Refers to a job that is easy, comfortable, and not stressful, with good pay and benefits. Often implies a lack of challenge or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工真係太平鋪嚟嘅，日日都喺度Hea。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 taai3 ping4 pou1 lai4 ge3, jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 dou6 Hea1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作真是个舒服的工作，每天都在那里闲混。
examples.english_sentence: His job is really a cushy one, he just chills there every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你想揾份太平鋪，不如試吓考政府工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 wan2 fan6 taai3 ping4 pou1, bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5 haau2 zing3 fu2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你想找一份轻松的工作，不如试试考公务员。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to find a comfortable job, why not try applying for a government job?

english_meaning: Emergency exit; fire exit
explanation_mandarin: 指建筑中为了安全起见，在正常出入口之外设置的备用出口，通常在发生紧急情况时使用。
explanation_english: Refers to an auxiliary exit in a building, in addition to the normal entrance and exit, set up for safety purposes, usually used in emergencies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間戲院嘅太平門喺邊度啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 hei3 jyun2 ge3 taai3 ping4 mun4 hai2 bin1 dou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家电影院的太平门在哪里啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where is the emergency exit of this cinema?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 千祈唔好塞住太平門啊，萬一有事就麻煩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kei4 m4 hou2 sak1 zyu6 taai3 ping4 mun4 aa3, maan6 jat1 jau5 si6 zau6 maa4 faan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 千万不要堵住太平门啊，万一发生事故就麻烦了。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't block the emergency exit, it will be troublesome if something happens.

english_meaning: wife (respectful term)
explanation_mandarin: 对妻子的尊称，含有敬意。
explanation_english: A respectful term for one's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我太座今日唔得閒，唔可以同你哋食飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 taai3 zo6 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4, m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 dei6 sik6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我老婆今天没空，不能和你们吃饭了。
examples.english_sentence: My wife is not free today, she can't have dinner with you guys.

english_meaning: Tai chi (a Chinese martial art)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国传统武术，以柔克刚，动作缓慢而流畅。
explanation_english: A Chinese martial art and system of exercises that emphasizes balance, coordination, and the flow of energy (qi). It involves slow, deliberate movements and is often practiced for health benefits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆日日朝早都喺公園打太極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jat6 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 hai2 gung1 jyun2 daa2 taai3 gik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶每天早上都在公园打太极。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma practices Tai chi in the park every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打太極可以舒筋活絡，對身體好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 taai3 gik6 ho2 ji5 syu1 gan1 wut6 lok3, deoi3 san1 tai2 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 打太极可以舒缓筋骨，对身体非常好。
examples.english_sentence: Practicing Tai chi can relax your muscles and is very good for your health.

english_meaning: Tai Chi sword
explanation_mandarin: 一种太极拳的器械套路，使用剑进行演练。
explanation_english: A type of Tai Chi exercise using a sword.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺每日朝早都去公園打太極劍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 daa2 taai3 gik6 gim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷每天早上都去公园打太极剑。
examples.english_sentence: My grandpa goes to the park to practice Tai Chi sword every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅太極劍打得好有氣勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 taai3 gik6 gim3 daa2 dak1 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的太极剑打得很有气势。
examples.english_sentence: His Tai Chi sword form is very impressive.

english_meaning: Tai Chi Chuan, Taijiquan (a Chinese martial art)
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国传统武术，以柔和缓慢的动作为特点，注重身心结合。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese martial art characterized by slow, flowing movements, emphasizing the integration of body and mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每日朝早都會去公園打太極拳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 wui5 heoi3 gung1 jyun2 daa2 taai3 gik6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每天早上都会去公园打太极拳。
examples.english_sentence: I go to the park to practice Tai Chi Chuan every morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學咗太極拳好多年，打得好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 zo2 taai3 gik6 kyun4 hou2 do1 nin4, daa2 dak1 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学太极拳很多年了，打得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He has been learning Tai Chi Chuan for many years and is very good at it.

english_meaning: Grand Duke Jupiter; a deity believed to govern the fortunes of the year; bad luck (when one's zodiac sign clashes with the year's 太歲)
explanation_mandarin: 太岁是古代中国天文学中假设的星名，也是中国民间奉祀的神祇。一个人所属生肖如果与当年的太岁相冲，则被认为会带来坏运气。也指凶恶蛮横的人。
explanation_english: Tai Sui (Grand Duke Jupiter) is a deity in Chinese mythology believed to govern the fortunes of the year. It is believed that if your zodiac sign clashes with the Tai Sui of the year, you will experience bad luck. It can also refer to a fierce and unreasonable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年我犯太歲，乜嘢都唔順利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ngo5 faan6 taai3 seoi3, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 seon6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年我犯太岁，什么都不顺利。
examples.english_sentence: This year I clash with the Tai Sui, everything is going wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發脾氣，真係惡太歲咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, zan1 hai6 ok3 taai3 seoi3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是发脾气，真像个恶太岁。
examples.english_sentence: He's always throwing a tantrum, he's like a real tyrant.

jyutping: taai3 seoi3 tau4 soeng6 dung6 tou2
english_meaning: to provoke someone powerful; to court disaster; to tempt fate; to kick against the pricks
explanation_mandarin: 比喻冒犯强有力的人或势力，惹祸上身。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to provoking someone powerful and influential, leading to trouble and negative consequences. It originates from the belief that 'Tai Sui' is a powerful deity governing the year, and disturbing it brings bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做咪即係太歲頭上動土？小心俾佢哋搞死你呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 mai1 zik1 hai6 taai3 seoi3 tau4 soeng6 dung6 tou2? siu2 sam1 bei2 keoi5 dei6 gaau2 sei2 nei5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做不就是太岁头上动土吗？小心被他们整死你啊！
examples.english_sentence: Isn't what you're doing just provoking a powerful figure? Be careful they don't ruin you!

synonyms: 惹火燒身 (je5 fo2 siu1 san1)

english_meaning: Great-grandfather; old master; grandpa
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指祖父。2. 旧时对年长男子的尊称，尤指富家翁或地主。
explanation_english: 1. Great-grandfather. 2. (Archaic) A respectful term for an elderly man, especially a wealthy man or landlord.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我太爺以前係個大地主嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 taai3 je4 ji5 cin4 hai6 go3 daai6 dei6 zyu2 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我曾祖父以前是个大地主。
examples.english_sentence: My great-grandfather used to be a big landlord.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺屋企好似太爺咁，咩都唔使做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 ci5 taai3 je4 gam2, me1 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在家里像老太爷一样，什么都不用做。
examples.english_sentence: He's like an old master at home, he doesn't have to do anything.

english_meaning: potato starch
explanation_mandarin: 一種用馬鈴薯製成的澱粉，常用於烹飪中勾芡或油炸。
explanation_english: Potato starch, a starch extracted from potatoes. It is commonly used in cooking as a thickening agent for sauces and gravies, or for deep frying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想落啲太白粉埋個茨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 lok6 di1 taai3 baak6 fan2 maai4 go3 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想加点太白粉勾芡。
examples.english_sentence: I want to add some potato starch to thicken the sauce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用太白粉炸嘅嘢特別脆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 taai3 baak6 fan2 zaa3 ge3 je5 dak6 bit1 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用太白粉炸的东西特别脆。
examples.english_sentence: Things fried with potato starch are especially crispy.

english_meaning: eunuch
explanation_mandarin: 古代皇宫中被阉割后专门负责伺候皇帝及其家眷的男性。
explanation_english: A castrated man employed to guard the women's quarters in an imperial palace, especially in China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺套古裝戲度飾演一個太監。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou3 gu2 zong1 hei3 dou6 sik1 jin2 jat1 go3 taai3 gaam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在一部古装戏里饰演一个太监。
examples.english_sentence: He played the role of a eunuch in a period drama.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅太監喺皇宮裡面嘅地位都幾高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 taai3 gaam3 hai2 wong4 gung1 lei5 min6 ge3 dei6 wai2 dou1 gei2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的太监在皇宫里面的地位都挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, eunuchs held a relatively high position in the imperial palace.

english_meaning: Hypocritical; pointless (literally: a eunuch studying theology)
explanation_mandarin: 比喻徒有形式，没有实际意义或作用。因为太监无法生育，即使学习神学也无法成为神父传宗接代，所以是毫无意义的。
explanation_english: This idiom is used to describe something that is hypocritical or pointless. A eunuch, being castrated, cannot fulfill the traditional role of a priest or continue a family line, making the study of theology a futile exercise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你明明唔想幫手，仲要扮曬嘢，簡直係太監讀神學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ming4 ming4 m4 soeng2 bong1 sau2, zung6 jiu3 baan3 saai3 je5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 taai3 gaam3 duk6 san4 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你明明不想帮忙，还要装模作样，简直是假惺惺。
examples.english_sentence: You clearly don't want to help, yet you're pretending to, it's completely hypocritical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同佢哋講道理根本就係太監讀神學，嘥氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 keoi5 dei6 gong2 dou6 lei5 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 taai3 gaam3 duk6 san4 hok6, saai1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 跟他们讲道理根本就是没用，浪费力气。
examples.english_sentence: Reasoning with them is completely pointless, a waste of effort.

english_meaning: Superfluous, unnecessary; doing something that is ultimately pointless or ineffective.
explanation_mandarin: 太监阉割之后无法生育，骑马对他们来说没有意义，比喻做没有意义或者多余的事情。
explanation_english: This idiom literally translates to "an eunuch riding a horse." Eunuchs, having been castrated, cannot produce offspring. Therefore, the act of riding a horse, which could potentially lead to producing offspring, is pointless for them. It's used to describe actions that are superfluous, unnecessary, or ultimately ineffective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都已經買咗個新嘅電飯煲啦，仲要買多個，咪即係太監騎馬囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 ji5 ging1 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 din6 faan6 bou1 laa1, zung6 jiu3 maai5 do1 go3, mai1 zik1 hai6 taai3 gaam3 kei4 maa5 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都已经买了一个新的电饭煲了，还要再买一个，那不是多此一举吗！
examples.english_sentence: You've already bought a new rice cooker, and you want to buy another one? Isn't that superfluous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵佢幫手？佢都唔識，咪太監騎馬囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 keoi5 bong1 sau2? keoi5 dou1 m4 sik1, mai1 taai3 gaam3 kei4 maa5 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找他帮忙？他什么都不会，不是多此一举吗！
examples.english_sentence: Ask him for help? He doesn't know anything, it's pointless!

synonyms: 畫蛇添足 (waak6 se4 tim1 zuk1)

english_meaning: outer space, cosmos
explanation_mandarin: 指地球大气层以外的宇宙空间。
explanation_english: The region beyond Earth's atmosphere; outer space; the cosmos.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係去太空探險。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 heoi3 taai3 hung1 taam3 him2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是去太空探险。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to explore outer space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太空站入面嘅生活好唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 hung1 zaam6 jap6 min6 ge3 saang1 wut6 hou2 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太空站里的生活不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: Life in the space station is not easy.

mandarin_meaning: 太空人；指通过假结婚获得外国居留权的人
english_meaning: astronaut; (slang) a person who obtains foreign residency through a sham marriage
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是指宇航员。在香港俚语中，也指为了获得外国居留权而假结婚的人。 这些人通常是为了移民到其他国家，例如加拿大、美国或澳大利亚，并取得永久居民身份。
explanation_english: Literally, it means astronaut. In Hong Kong slang, it also refers to a person who obtains foreign residency through a sham marriage. These individuals typically do so to immigrate to countries such as Canada, the United States, or Australia and obtain permanent residency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候夢想係做太空人，可以飛上太空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 mung6 soeng2 hai6 zou6 taai3 hung1 jan4, ho2 ji5 fei1 soeng5 taai3 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候的梦想是当一名宇航员，可以飞上太空。
examples.english_sentence: When he was little, his dream was to be an astronaut and fly into space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢為咗攞外國居留權，做咗太空人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 wai6 zo2 lo2 ngoi6 gwok3 geoi1 lau4 kuen4, zou6 zo2 taai3 hung1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他为了获得外国居留权，做了太空人。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he became a 'spaceman' to get foreign residency.

mandarin_meaning: 一次性电话卡, 无需实名登记的电话卡
english_meaning: Disposable SIM card, unregistered SIM card
explanation_mandarin: 指不需要实名登记就可以使用的预付电话卡。通常价格低廉，用完即弃，因此得名。
explanation_english: Refers to a prepaid SIM card that can be used without real-name registration. It is usually inexpensive and disposable, hence the name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家買太空卡唔使登記㗎啦，好方便㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 maai5 taai3 hung1 kaat1 m4 sai2 dang1 gei3 gaa3 laa1, hou2 fong1 bin6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在买太空卡不用登记了，很方便。
examples.english_sentence: Now you don't need to register to buy a disposable SIM card, it's very convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲太空卡通常用嚟做一啲唔想俾人知嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 taai3 hung1 kaat1 tung1 soeng4 yung6 lai4 zou6 jat1 di1 m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 zi1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些太空卡通常用来做一些不想被人知道的事情。
examples.english_sentence: These disposable SIM cards are often used for things people don't want others to know.

mandarin_meaning: 太空卡 (指没有实名登记的电话卡)
english_meaning: Space card (refers to an unregistered SIM card)
explanation_mandarin: 指没有进行实名登记的电话卡，购买后即可使用，无需提供个人信息。 因其缺乏追踪性，有时被用于非法活动。
explanation_english: Refers to an unregistered SIM card. It can be used immediately after purchase without providing personal information. Due to its lack of traceability, it is sometimes used for illegal activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好用太空咭做犯法嘢呀，俾人捉到就弊傢伙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 yung6 taai3 hung1 kaat1 zou6 faan6 faat3 je5 aa3, bei2 yan4 zuk1 dou2 zau6 bai6 gaa1 fo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要用太空卡做违法的事情，被抓到就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't use an unregistered SIM card to do illegal things, it will be terrible if you get caught.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲太空咭都好難買㗎啦，政府管得好嚴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi4 gaa1 di1 taai3 hung1 kaat1 dou1 hou2 naan4 maai5 gaa3 laa1, zing3 fu2 gun2 dak1 hou2 yim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在太空卡很难买了，政府管得很严格。
examples.english_sentence: It's hard to buy unregistered SIM cards now, the government regulates them strictly.

english_meaning: Large, hard-shell suitcase; space case (slang, referring to someone eccentric or spaced out)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种大型的、硬壳的行李箱。在俚语中，也用来形容行为举止古怪、不着边际的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a large, hard-shell suitcase, often used for travel. As slang, it can also refer to someone who is eccentric, absent-minded, or not grounded in reality; similar to the English term "space case". The connection is that someone's mind is 'out there,' like outer space, and therefore doesn't fit in or is detached.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗個新嘅太空喼去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 taai3 hung1 gip1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一个新的太空箱去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a new hard-shell suitcase for traveling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發白日夢，真係似個太空喼噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 baak6 jat6 mung6, zan1 hai6 ci5 go3 taai3 hung1 gip1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天做白日梦，真像个太空箱一样（指行为举止古怪）。
examples.english_sentence: He's always daydreaming; he's really like a space case.

english_meaning: Space junk, space debris
explanation_mandarin: 指在地球轨道上运行的废弃人造物体，如废弃的卫星、火箭碎片等。
explanation_english: Refers to defunct human-made objects in Earth orbit, such as abandoned satellites, rocket fragments, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多太空垃圾，真係好危險㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 do1 taai3 hung1 laap1 saap3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么多太空垃圾，真的很危险啊！
examples.english_sentence: So much space junk, it's really dangerous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家要諗辦法清走啲太空垃圾先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 cing1 zau2 di1 taai3 hung1 laap1 saap3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家要想办法清理掉那些太空垃圾才行。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists need to find a way to clean up that space debris.

english_meaning: space telescope
explanation_mandarin: 在地球大气层外运行的望远镜，用于观测宇宙天体，不受大气干扰。
explanation_english: A telescope located in outer space to observe astronomical objects, free from atmospheric interference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 哈勃太空望遠鏡影咗好多靚嘅星雲相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa1 bat1 taai3 hung1 mong6 jyun5 geng3 ying2 zo2 hou2 do1 leng3 ge3 sing1 wan4 soeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哈勃太空望远镜拍摄了很多美丽的星云照片。
examples.english_sentence: The Hubble Space Telescope took many beautiful pictures of nebulae.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家用太空望遠鏡探索宇宙嘅奧秘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 yung6 taai3 hung1 mong6 jyun5 geng3 taam3 sok3 jyu5 zau6 ge3 ou3 mai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家用太空望远镜探索宇宙的奥秘。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists use space telescopes to explore the mysteries of the universe.

english_meaning: medicated oil, eucalyptus oil, aromatic medicated balm
explanation_mandarin: 一种薄荷味的药用油，通常用于缓解头痛、蚊虫叮咬等。
explanation_english: A mint-flavored medicated oil, commonly used to relieve headaches, mosquito bites, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 畀啲太空油我搽下，畀蚊咬到好痕呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bei2 di1 taai3 hung1 jau4 ngo5 caa1 haa5, bei2 man1 ngaau5 dou3 hou2 han4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 给我一点风油精擦一下，被蚊子咬了好痒啊。
examples.english_sentence: Give me some medicated oil to apply, the mosquito bites are very itchy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭赤啊，搽啲太空油會舒服啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 cek3 aa3, caa1 di1 taai3 hung1 jau4 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 头痛啊，擦点风油精会舒服一点。
examples.english_sentence: I have a headache, applying some medicated oil will make me feel better.

english_meaning: Microwave oven
explanation_mandarin: 指微波炉。因为微波炉最初出现时，科技感十足，给人一种来自太空的感觉，所以被戏称为“太空炉”。
explanation_english: Refers to a microwave oven. When microwave ovens first appeared, they were considered high-tech and futuristic, giving people the impression of something from space, hence the nickname "太空爐".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 叮個飯盒，用太空爐最快啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ding1 go3 faan6 hap2, yung6 taai3 hung1 lou4 zeoi3 faai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 加热个饭盒，用微波炉最快了。
examples.english_sentence: It's quickest to heat up a lunchbox using the microwave oven.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都話太空爐唔健康，唔俾我用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 taai3 hung1 lou4 m4 gin6 hong1, m4 bei2 ngo5 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说微波炉不健康，不让我用。
examples.english_sentence: Mom always says microwave ovens are unhealthy and doesn't let me use them.

english_meaning: Space shuttle
explanation_mandarin: 一种可以重复使用的航天运载工具，主要用于在地球和近地轨道之间运送人员和货物。
explanation_english: A reusable spacecraft designed to transport crew and cargo between Earth and near-Earth orbit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 美國太空穿梭機以前有好多用途，例如運送衛星上去太空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mei5 gwok3 taai3 hung1 cyun1 so1 gei1 ji5 cin4 jau5 hou2 do1 jung6 tou4,例 jyu4 yun6 sung3 wai6 sing1 soeng5 heoi3 taai3 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美国的航天飞机以前有很多用途，例如运送卫星到太空。
examples.english_sentence: The American space shuttle used to have many uses, such as transporting satellites into space.

english_meaning: space station
explanation_mandarin: 在太空中长期运行，可供宇航员居住和工作的设施。
explanation_english: A large artificial satellite used as a long-term base for manned operations in outer space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係第日可以去太空站做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 dai6 jat6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 taai3 hung1 zaam6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是将来可以去太空站工作。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to work on a space station in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太空站提供咗一個喺太空做科學研究嘅地方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 hung1 zaam6 tai4 gung1 zo2 jat1 go3 hai2 taai3 hung1 zou6 fo1 hok6 jin4 gau3 ge3 dei6 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太空站提供了一个在太空做科学研究的地方。
examples.english_sentence: The space station provides a place to conduct scientific research in space.

english_meaning: spaceship, spacecraft
explanation_mandarin: 一种能够在太空中飞行和作业的飞行器。
explanation_english: A vehicle designed for travel or operation in outer space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將來搭太空船去火星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 loi4 daap3 taai3 hung1 syun4 heoi3 fo2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我将来想搭宇宙飞船去火星。
examples.english_sentence: I want to travel to Mars in a spaceship in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太空船嘅設計好複雜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 hung1 syun4 ge3 sat3 gai3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宇宙飞船的设计很复杂。
examples.english_sentence: The design of a spaceship is very complex.

english_meaning: Space capsule; Space pod; Capsule hotel
explanation_mandarin: 指太空飞船上供宇航员居住和工作的密封舱；也指一种经济型的住宿设施，房间很小，像太空舱一样。
explanation_english: Refers to the sealed compartment on a spacecraft where astronauts live and work; also refers to a budget-friendly accommodation facility, where rooms are very small and resemble space capsules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我 book 咗間太空艙酒店，貪佢夠平又方便。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 buk1 zo2 gaan1 taai3 hung1 cong1 zau2 dim3, taam1 keoi5 gau3 peng4 jau6 fong1 bin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我订了一间太空舱酒店，贪它够便宜又方便。
examples.english_sentence: I booked a capsule hotel because it's cheap and convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅夢想係有朝一日可以搭太空艙去火星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 mung6 soeng2 hai6 jau5 ziu1 jat6 ho2 ji5 daap3 taai3 hung1 cong1 heoi3 fo2 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的梦想是有朝一日可以乘坐太空舱去火星。
examples.english_sentence: His dream is to one day travel to Mars in a space capsule.

english_meaning: Space jacket, Puffer jacket (often with a metallic or shiny finish)
explanation_mandarin: 指一种类似宇航员服装的外套，通常是蓬松的，有光泽或金属质感。
explanation_english: Refers to a type of jacket that resembles a spacesuit, usually puffy and with a glossy or metallic finish. Often called a puffer jacket in English, but specifically referring to the style with a shiny/metallic look.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁凍，記得著返件太空褸出街啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 dung3, gei3 dak1 zoek3 faan1 gin6 taai3 hung1 lau1 ceot1 gaai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天这么冷，记得穿上你的太空服外套出门啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's so cold today, remember to wear your space jacket when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件太空褸好暖㗎，落雪都唔怕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 taai3 hung1 lau1 hou2 nün5 gaa3, lok6 syut3 dou1 m4 paa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件太空服外套很暖和，下雪也不怕。
examples.english_sentence: This space jacket is very warm, I'm not afraid even if it snows.

english_meaning: excessive; too much; over the top
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度超过了适当的范围或限度，相当于“过于”，“太”。
explanation_english: Indicates that the degree exceeds the appropriate range or limit; equivalent to "too much" or "excessive".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做太過份喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 zou6 taai3 gwo3 fan6 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做太过分了！
examples.english_sentence: You're going too far with this!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗得太過複雜喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 dak1 taai3 gwo3 fuk1 zaap6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想得太复杂了。
examples.english_sentence: You're thinking too complicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對我太過熱情，有啲唔慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 taai3 gwo3 jit6 ching4, jau5 di1 m4 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对我太过热情，有点不习惯。
examples.english_sentence: He is being too enthusiastic towards me, I'm not used to it.

english_meaning: sun
explanation_mandarin: 指恒星太阳，是太阳系的中心天体。
explanation_english: The star that is the central body of the solar system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅太陽好猛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 taai3 joeng4 hou2 maang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的太阳很猛烈。
examples.english_sentence: The sun is very strong today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日曬太陽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 saai3 taai3 joeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常晒太阳。
examples.english_sentence: He often sunbathes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽升起喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 sing1 hei2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳升起来了。
examples.english_sentence: The sun has risen.

jyutping: taai3 joeng4 dai2 haa6 mou4 san1 si6
english_meaning: There is nothing new under the sun.
explanation_mandarin: 表示世间万物循环往复，没有真正新鲜的事情发生。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the idea that everything repeats itself and that there is nothing truly new in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你諗住搞啲乜嘢創新嘢吖？太陽底下無新事啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 lam2 zyu6 gaau2 di1 mat1 je5 cong3 san1 je5 aa1? taai3 joeng4 dai2 haa6 mou4 san1 si6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算搞什么创新啊？太阳底下无新事嘛。
examples.english_sentence: What kind of innovation are you planning? There is nothing new under the sun, you know.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 其實啲橋都係舊橋嚟啫，太陽底下無新事㗎嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kei4 sat6 di1 kiu2 dou1 hai6 gau6 kiu2 lai4 ze1, taai3 joeng4 dai2 haa6 mou4 san1 si6 gaa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 其实这些点子都是老点子，太阳底下无新事嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Actually, these ideas are all old ideas. There's nothing new under the sun.

jyutping: taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 tau4 hok3 deng2
english_meaning: The sun is directly overhead; The sun is high in the sky.
explanation_mandarin: 形容太阳的位置在正上方，通常也表示时间已经很晚，接近中午或中午刚过。
explanation_english: Describes the position of the sun directly overhead, often indicating that it is late in the morning or shortly after noon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽曬到頭殼頂，都仲唔返屋企食飯？
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 tau4 hok3 deng2, dou1 zung6 m4 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳都晒到头顶了，还不回家吃饭？
examples.english_sentence: The sun is already overhead, aren't you coming home for lunch?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋行咗成朝，依家太陽曬到頭殼頂，快啲搵個地方休息下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haang4 zo2 sing4 zaau1, ji1 gaa1 taai3 joeng4 saai3 dou3 tau4 hok3 deng2, faai3 di1 wan2 go3 dei6 fong1 jau1 sik1 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们走了一上午，现在太阳都晒到头顶了，快点找个地方休息一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: We've been walking all morning, now the sun is high in the sky, let's quickly find a place to rest.

english_meaning: sunscreen, suntan lotion
explanation_mandarin: 用于涂抹在皮肤上，以防止太阳的紫外线伤害的护肤品。
explanation_english: A lotion, cream, or spray applied to the skin to protect it from the sun's ultraviolet rays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去沙灘之前記得搽太陽油啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 saa1 taan1 zi1 cin4 gei3 dak1 caa4 taai3 joeng4 jau4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去沙滩之前记得擦防晒霜啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to apply sunscreen before we go to the beach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支太陽油有幾多度防曬？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 taai3 joeng4 jau4 jau5 gei2 do1 dou6 fong4 saai3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶防晒霜有多少度防晒？
examples.english_sentence: What is the SPF of this sunscreen?

english_meaning: sunglasses
explanation_mandarin: 用于遮挡阳光的眼镜。
explanation_english: Eyeglasses used to protect the eyes from the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好曬呀，記得戴太陽眼鏡出街呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 saai3 aa3, gei3 dak1 daai3 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng3 chut1 gaai1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天很晒，记得戴太阳镜出门啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's very sunny today, remember to wear sunglasses when you go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢副太陽眼鏡好型呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu3 taai3 joeng4 ngaan5 geng3 hou2 jing4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的太阳镜好酷啊！
examples.english_sentence: His sunglasses are so cool!

english_meaning: temple (of the head)
explanation_mandarin: 头部两侧，眼睛和前额之间的区域。
explanation_english: The temple is a region on each side of the head, behind the eye and between the forehead and ear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個頭痛到太陽穴都跳跳下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 tau4 tung3 dou3 taai3 joeng4 hyut3 dou1 tiu3 tiu3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他头痛得太阳穴都在跳。
examples.english_sentence: His headache is so bad that his temples are throbbing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 按壓太陽穴可以舒緩頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: on3 aat3 taai3 joeng4 hyut3 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 按压太阳穴可以缓解头痛。
examples.english_sentence: Pressing on the temples can relieve a headache.

english_meaning: solar system
explanation_mandarin: 包括太阳以及所有受到太阳引力约束的天体，如行星、卫星、小行星、彗星等。
explanation_english: The solar system, including the Sun and all celestial bodies bound to it by gravity, such as planets, satellites, asteroids, and comets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 太陽系裏面有八大行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 hai6 lei5 min6 jau5 baat3 daai6 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 太阳系里面有八大行星。
examples.english_sentence: There are eight planets in the solar system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意研究太陽系嘅行星。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 jin4 gau3 taai3 joeng4 hai6 ge3 hang4 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很喜欢研究太阳系的行星。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to study the planets of the solar system.

english_meaning: solar energy
explanation_mandarin: 利用太阳辐射产生的能量。
explanation_english: Energy derived from solar radiation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好多人都用太陽能板發電，環保又慳錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 jung6 taai3 joeng4 nang4 baan2 faat3 din6, waan4 bou2 jau6 haan1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都用太阳能板发电，环保又省钱。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people use solar panels to generate electricity, which is environmentally friendly and saves money.

english_meaning: solar panel
explanation_mandarin: 一种能够将太阳光转化为电能的装置。
explanation_english: A device that converts sunlight into electricity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企裝咗太陽能板之後，電費平咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei1 zong1 zo2 taai3 joeng4 nang4 baan2 zi1 hau6, din6 fai3 peng4 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里装了太阳能板之后，电费便宜了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After installing solar panels at home, the electricity bill became much cheaper.

english_meaning: Sunflower
explanation_mandarin: 指一种植物，花朵巨大，颜色鲜艳，花盘会随着太阳转动。
explanation_english: Refers to a plant with large, vibrant flowers that turn to face the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 花墟入邊好多太陽花賣呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa1 heoi1 jap6 bin6 hou2 do1 taai3 joeng4 faa1 maai6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花市里面有很多向日葵卖啊。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of sunflowers for sale in the flower market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鍾意喺花園種太陽花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung1 ji3 hai2 faa1 jyun2 zung3 taai3 joeng4 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很喜欢在花园里种向日葵。
examples.english_sentence: She likes to grow sunflowers in the garden.

english_meaning: Sunny-side up egg
explanation_mandarin: 煎蛋的一种，只煎一面，蛋黄保持液态。
explanation_english: A type of fried egg that is fried on one side only, leaving the yolk runny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝我整咗隻太陽蛋做早餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 ngo5 zing2 zo2 zek3 taai3 joeng4 daan2 zou6 zou2 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上我做了一个太阳蛋当早餐。
examples.english_sentence: I made a sunny-side up egg for breakfast this morning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食太陽蛋，蛋黃流心好好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 taai3 joeng4 daan2, daan2 wong4 lau4 sam1 hou2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃太阳蛋，蛋黄流心很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: I like eating sunny-side up eggs, the runny yolk is delicious.

mandarin_meaning: 太阳谷 (地名，指美国硅谷)
english_meaning: Silicon Valley (place name, referring to the American tech hub)
explanation_mandarin: 指美国加利福尼亚州北部以高科技产业著称的硅谷。
explanation_english: Refers to Silicon Valley, a region in Northern California known for its high-tech industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司打算去太陽谷開分公司。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 heoi3 taai3 joeng4 guk1 hoi1 fan1 gung1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司打算去硅谷开分公司。
examples.english_sentence: Their company plans to open a branch office in Silicon Valley.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多香港嘅創業家都夢想去太陽谷發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 cong3 jip6 gaa1 dou1 mung6 soeng2 heoi3 taai3 joeng4 guk1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多香港的创业家都梦想去硅谷发展。
examples.english_sentence: Many Hong Kong entrepreneurs dream of developing their careers in Silicon Valley.

english_meaning: Sunglasses
explanation_mandarin: 遮挡阳光的眼镜。
explanation_english: Eyeglasses used to protect the eyes from the sun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日咁曬，記得戴太陽鏡啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gam3 saai3, gei3 dak1 daai3 taai3 joeng4 geng3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天太阳这么大，记得戴太阳镜啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's so sunny today, remember to wear sunglasses.

english_meaning: husband; this, that (classical usage)
explanation_mandarin: 丈夫，配偶的男性一方；古典汉语中用作指示代词，相当于“这”、“那”。粤语保留了部分古汉语用法。
explanation_english: Husband, the male partner in a marriage. Also, in classical Chinese, used as a demonstrative pronoun, equivalent to "this" or "that". Cantonese retains some of these classical usages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅丈夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 cheung4 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的丈夫。
examples.english_sentence: He is my husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夫復何求？
examples.jyutping_sentence: fu1 fuk1 ho4 kau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 夫复何求？（这还有什么好要求的？）
examples.english_sentence: What more could one ask for? (What more could I want?) (Classical Usage)

english_meaning: Madam; Lady; Wife (formal)
explanation_mandarin: 对已婚妇女的尊称，通常指有一定社会地位或年纪稍大的女性。也用作外交场合对女性的正式称谓。
explanation_english: A respectful term for a married woman, usually referring to a woman with a certain social status or older. Also used as a formal title for women in diplomatic settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生嘅夫人好有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 ge3 fu1 yan4 hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生的夫人很有气质。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Lee's wife is very elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 總統夫人今晚會出席個晚宴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung2 tung2 fu1 yan4 gam1 maan1 wui5 cheut1 sik1 go3 maan5 yin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 总统夫人今晚会出席这个晚宴。
examples.english_sentence: The First Lady will attend the banquet tonight.

english_meaning: Man, husband, old man (often derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“夫佬”可以指男人，丈夫。有时也指年纪较大的男性，带有轻微的贬义，类似“老头”。具体含义需要根据语境判断。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "夫佬" can refer to a man or a husband. It can also refer to an older man, sometimes with a slightly derogatory connotation, similar to "old man". The specific meaning needs to be determined based on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條夫佬好鬼惡死㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 fu1 lou2 hou2 gwai2 ok3 sei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的丈夫很凶恶的。
examples.english_sentence: Her husband is very fierce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個夫佬喺度搞搞震，唔知想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 fu1 lou2 hai2 dou6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, m4 zi1 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老头在那里搞事，不知道想干什么。
examples.english_sentence: That old man is making trouble there, I don't know what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁叫人夫佬呀，好冇禮貌㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 giu3 yan4 fu1 lou2 aa3, hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要乱叫别人老头，很没礼貌的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't call people "old man" randomly, it's very impolite!

english_meaning: The husband sings, the wife follows; harmonious marriage (lit. and fig.)
explanation_mandarin: 形容夫妻关系和谐，妻子顺从丈夫。也用来形容配合默契。
explanation_english: Describes a harmonious relationship between husband and wife, where the wife follows the husband's lead. It can also describe a well-coordinated partnership.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆好恩愛，真係夫唱婦隨嘅典範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 hou2 yan1 oi3, zan1 hai6 fu1 coeng3 fu5 ceoi4 ge3 din2 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩很恩爱，真是夫唱妇随的典范。
examples.english_sentence: They are a loving couple, truly a model of a harmonious marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺呢間公司，經理嘅指示一落，下屬一定夫唱婦隨，效率好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1, ging1 lei5 ge3 zi2 si1 jat1 lok6, haa6 suk6 jat1 ding6 fu1 coeng3 fu5 ceoi4, haau6 leot2 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这家公司，经理的指示一下达，下属一定会夫唱妇随，效率很高。
examples.english_sentence: In this company, as soon as the manager gives an order, the subordinates will follow it harmoniously, resulting in high efficiency.

english_meaning: Playboy magazine
explanation_mandarin: 香港人对《花花公子》杂志的俗称。 "夫士"是"Playboy"的音译，"喼紙"是指杂志。
explanation_english: A colloquial term used in Hong Kong to refer to Playboy magazine. "夫士" is a transliteration of "Playboy", and "喼紙" refers to a magazine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣成日睇夫士喼紙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 sang1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 tai2 fu1 si6 gip1 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候经常看花花公子杂志。
examples.english_sentence: He used to read Playboy magazine a lot when he was young.

english_meaning: husband and wife; married couple
explanation_mandarin: 指结婚的男女双方。
explanation_english: Refers to a married couple, the husband and the wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚五年，感情都好好，真係一對恩愛夫妻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 ng5 nin4, gam2 cing4 dou1 hou2 hou2, zan1 hai6 jat1 deoi3 yan1 oi3 fu1 cai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚五年了，感情都很好，真是一对恩爱夫妻。
examples.english_sentence: They've been married for five years, and their relationship is still great. They really are a loving couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對夫妻好勤力，日頭返工，夜晚仲要做兼職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 fu1 cai1 hou2 kan4 lik6, jat6 tau4 faan1 gung1, je6 maan5 zung6 jiu3 zou6 gim1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这对夫妻很勤奋，白天上班，晚上还要做兼职。
examples.english_sentence: This couple is very diligent. They work during the day and also do part-time jobs at night.

english_meaning: husband and wife team; couple working together
explanation_mandarin: 指夫妻共同合作，一起工作或经营生意。
explanation_english: Refers to a husband and wife working together as a team, often in business or other ventures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆開咗間餐廳，真係夫妻檔嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 hoi1 zo2 gaan1 caan1 teng1, zan1 hai6 fu1 cai1 dong3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两口子开了一家餐厅，真是夫妻搭档。
examples.english_sentence: They opened a restaurant together, they are really a husband and wife team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多小食店都係夫妻檔經營嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 siu2 sik6 dim3 dou1 hai6 fu1 cai1 dong3 ging1 ying4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多小吃店都是夫妻搭档经营的。
examples.english_sentence: Many snack shops are run by husband and wife teams.

english_meaning: Sliced Beef and Offal in Chili Sauce (a cold Sichuan dish)
explanation_mandarin: 四川名菜，通常用牛肉、牛杂（牛心、牛肺、牛肚等）切片，再配以辣椒油、花椒面等调料凉拌而成。
explanation_english: A famous Sichuan cold dish made with sliced beef and beef offal (such as beef heart, beef lung, and beef stomach), seasoned with chili oil, Sichuan peppercorn powder, and other spices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食夫妻肺片㗎，麻辣麻辣好惹味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 fu1 cai1 fai3 pin2 gaa3, maa4 laat6 maa4 laat6 hou2 je5 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢吃夫妻肺片，麻辣麻辣的，非常美味。
examples.english_sentence: I really like eating sliced beef and offal in chili sauce, it's spicy and very flavorful.

english_meaning: husband's surname
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚女性所冠以丈夫的姓氏。
