explanation_english: The surname of a woman's husband, often taken or added to her own surname after marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚之後都冇改夫姓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 dou1 mou5 goi2 fu1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她结婚之后都没有改夫姓。
examples.english_sentence: She didn't change to her husband's surname after getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，好多女人結婚之後會喺自己個名前面加個夫姓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 do1 neoi5 jan2 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 wui5 hai2 zi6 gei2 go3 meng2 cin4 min6 gaa1 go3 fu1 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，很多女人结婚后会在自己的名字前面加上夫姓。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, many women add their husband's surname in front of their own name after getting married.

english_meaning: husband and wife, couple
explanation_mandarin: 指已结婚的男女双方。
explanation_english: Refers to a married couple, husband and wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩夫婦好恩愛㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 fu1 fu2 hou2 yan1 oi3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两夫妻很恩爱。
examples.english_sentence: They are a loving couple.

english_meaning: husband
explanation_mandarin: 书面语，指丈夫。
explanation_english: Formal term for husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱結咗婚，而家夫婿就喺外國做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 git3 zo2 fan1, ji4 gaa1 fu1 seoi3 zau6 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚刚结婚，现在丈夫在国外工作。
examples.english_sentence: They just got married, and now her husband is working abroad.

mandarin_meaning: 老师, 先生 (旧时对老师的尊称)
english_meaning: Teacher (formal, respectful term for a teacher, especially in olden times)
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对老师的尊称，多用于比较传统或正式的场合。也指孔子。
explanation_english: A respectful and formal term for a teacher, mainly used in traditional or formal contexts. It can also refer to Confucius.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以前嘅夫子好嚴㗎，成日罰人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 ge3 fu1 zi2 hou2 jim4 gaa3, seng4 jat6 fat6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以前的老师很严厉，经常惩罚人。
examples.english_sentence: Our teacher used to be very strict, always punishing people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想做個夫子，教書育人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 go3 fu1 zi2, gaau3 syu1 juk6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想当一名老师，教书育人。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to be a teacher, educating and nurturing people.

english_meaning: husband's family; in-laws (husband's side)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的家庭，包括丈夫的父母、兄弟姐妹等。
explanation_english: Refers to the husband's family, including his parents, siblings, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嫁咗之後，佢成日要返夫家食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 zo2 zi1 hau6, keoi5 seng4 jat6 jiu3 faan1 fu1 gaa1 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚以后，她经常要回婆家吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: After getting married, she often has to go back to her husband's family for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同夫家嘅關係好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 fu1 gaa1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她和婆家的关系很好。
examples.english_sentence: She has a very good relationship with her husband's family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，要同夫家拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 tung4 fu1 gaa1 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，要和婆家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, you have to pay a New Year's visit to your husband's family.

mandarin_meaning: 夫复何求 (fū fù hé qiú)
english_meaning: What more could one ask for?; What else can one desire?; To have reached a state of perfect contentment
explanation_mandarin: 表示对现状非常满意，没有任何更高的要求。
explanation_english: Expresses a feeling of complete satisfaction with the current situation, leaving no further desires or demands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有屋企人喺身邊，又有份好工，夫復何求啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 uk1 kei5 jan4 hai2 san1 bin1, jau6 jau5 fan6 hou2 gung1, fu1 fuk1 ho4 kau4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有家人在身边，又有一份好工作，夫复何求啊？
examples.english_sentence: With family by my side and a good job, what more could I ask for?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可以同你一齊咁耐，我夫復何求？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 ji5 tung4 nei5 jat1 cai4 gam3 noi6, ngo5 fu1 fuk1 ho4 kau4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 能和你在一起这么久，我夫复何求？
examples.english_sentence: Being able to be with you for so long, what more could I ask for?

synonyms: 心滿意足 (sam1 mun5 ji3 zuk1)
稱心如意 (cing3 sam1 jyu4 ji3)

english_meaning: couple (together); whole family; complete set (with spouse)
explanation_mandarin: 指夫妻一同出席或参加活动。也可用作形容词，表示齐全、完整，尤指夫妻都在。
explanation_english: Refers to a husband and wife attending an event or participating in an activity together. It can also be used as an adjective to mean complete or whole, especially when both the husband and wife are present. It emphasizes that the couple is there as a unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚擺酒我哋夫添出席。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 baai2 zau2 ngo5 dei6 fu1 tim1 ceot1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚婚宴我们夫妻一同出席。
examples.english_sentence: We will attend the wedding banquet tonight as a couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，今晚我得一個人嚟，唔係夫添。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gam1 maan5 ngo5 dak1 jat1 go3 jan4 lai4, m4 hai6 fu1 tim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，今晚我只能一个人来，不是夫妻一起来。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I can only come alone tonight, not as a couple.

mandarin_meaning: 夭折; 短命; 不成
english_meaning: To die young; to be nipped in the bud; premature death; unfinished; abortive
explanation_mandarin: 指未成年就死去；比喻事情中途失败，没有结果。
explanation_english: Refers to dying young, before reaching adulthood; also used metaphorically to describe something that fails or is aborted prematurely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就夭咗，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 jiu1 zo2, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就夭折了，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's such a pity that he died so young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃都夭咗，唔使再諗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 dou1 jiu1 zo2, m4 sai2 zoi3 lam2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划都夭折了，不用再想了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has been aborted, no need to think about it anymore.

english_meaning: affected; pretentious; melodramatic; excessively dramatic or sentimental
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人矫揉造作，过于做作，不自然，表现出过度的情感或行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is being affected, pretentious, or overly dramatic. It suggests insincerity or exaggeration in their behaviour or emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一講嘢就夭心夭肺咁，真係頂唔順。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 gong2 je5 zau6 jiu1 sam1 jiu1 fai3 gam2, zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一说话就娇声娇气，真受不了。
examples.english_sentence: The way he talks is so affected, it's really unbearable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺度夭心夭肺啦，有咩事咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 dou6 jiu1 sam1 jiu1 fai3 laa1, jau5 me1 si6 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别在这里装模作样了，有什么事就直接说吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so melodramatic, just say what's on your mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁夭心夭肺啦，睇到我好肉酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 jiu1 sam1 jiu1 fai3 laa1, tai2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 juk6 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么假惺惺的，看得我很恶心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so pretentious, it makes me cringe.

english_meaning: to die prematurely; to die young; to be cut short; to be aborted
explanation_mandarin: 指未成年或年轻时就死去；比喻事情中途失败。
explanation_english: Refers to dying before adulthood or at a young age; also used metaphorically to describe something failing midway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就夭折咗，真係好可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 jiu1 zit3 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就夭折了，真的很可惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's a pity that he died so young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃因為資金問題而夭折咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jan1 wai6 zi1 gam1 man6 tai4 ji4 jiu1 zit3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划因为资金问题而夭折了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan was aborted due to funding issues.

english_meaning: to beg, to plead, to entreat, to implore
explanation_mandarin: 请求，恳求，希望得到别人的帮助或同意。
explanation_english: To beg, plead, or implore someone to do something; to earnestly request something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好再央我啦，我真係幫唔到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 joeng1 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 zan1 hai6 bong1 m4 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要再求我了，我真的帮不了你。
examples.english_sentence: Please don't beg me anymore, I really can't help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢央咗我好耐，我先至應承幫佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng1 zo2 ngo5 hou2 noi6, ngo5 sin1 zi3 jing1 sing4 bong1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他求了我很久，我才答应帮他。
examples.english_sentence: He begged me for a long time before I agreed to help him.

english_meaning: to beg, to plead, to implore
explanation_mandarin: 恳求; 哀求。
explanation_english: To earnestly request someone to do something; to beg or plead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢央求咗阿媽好耐，阿媽先至肯買新玩具俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 joeng1 kau4 zo2 aa3 maa1 hou2 noi6, aa3 maa1 sin1 zi3 hang2 maai5 san1 wun2 geoi6 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他央求了妈妈很久，妈妈才肯买新玩具给他。
examples.english_sentence: He begged his mom for a long time before she agreed to buy him a new toy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我央求佢唔好走，但係佢都係決定要離開。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 joeng1 kau4 keoi5 m4 hou2 zau2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 hai6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 lei4 hoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我央求他不要走，但是他还是决定要离开。
examples.english_sentence: I begged him not to leave, but he still decided to go.

english_meaning: Central bank
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家的金融管理机构，负责发行货币，管理外汇，制定货币政策等。
explanation_english: The financial institution in a country responsible for issuing currency, managing foreign exchange reserves, setting monetary policy, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅央行係香港金融管理局。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 joeng1 hong4 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 gam1 jung4 gun2 lei5 guk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的中央银行是香港金融管理局。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's central bank is the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話央行會加息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 joeng1 hong4 wui5 gaa1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说中央银行会加息。
examples.english_sentence: They said the central bank will raise interest rates.

english_meaning: stupid, foolish, silly, dumb
explanation_mandarin: 形容人愚笨，头脑不灵光。
explanation_english: Describes someone as stupid, foolish, or lacking intelligence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁夯啦，咁簡單嘅嘢都唔識？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hong1 laa1, gam3 gaan2 daan1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 sik1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨了，这么简单的东西都不会？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stupid, you can't even understand something so simple?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做啲夯嘢出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 di1 hong1 je5 cheut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是做些蠢事。
examples.english_sentence: He always does stupid things.

mandarin_meaning: 失去; 丢失; 错过
english_meaning: to lose; to miss; to fail; to err
explanation_mandarin: 表示失去、丢失或错过某事物。
explanation_english: Indicates losing, missing, or failing to obtain something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我失咗條鎖匙呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sat1 zo2 tiu4 so2 si4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我丢了钥匙了。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my key.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我失咗份工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sat1 zo2 fan6 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我失业了。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我失約咗，真係唔好意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sat1 joek3 zo2, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我失约了，真的很不好意思。
examples.english_sentence: I missed our appointment, I'm really sorry.

english_meaning: loser; owner of lost property
explanation_mandarin: 丢失东西的人；遗失物的主人。
explanation_english: The person who lost something; the owner of lost property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幫失主搵返佢嘅銀包。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bong1 sat1 zyu2 wan2 faan1 keoi5 ge3 ngan4 baau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们帮失主找回了他的钱包。
examples.english_sentence: We helped the owner find their wallet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個銀包係失主留低嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ngan4 baau1 hai6 sat1 zyu2 lau4 dai1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个钱包是失主留下的。
examples.english_sentence: This wallet was left behind by the owner.

english_meaning: to miss something narrowly; to lose a golden opportunity; to just miss the chance
explanation_mandarin: 形容机会难得，却因疏忽或错过而未能把握。本意是擦肩而过，引申为错过良机。
explanation_english: Describes a valuable opportunity that is missed due to carelessness, oversight, or simply being too late. The literal meaning is to brush past someone's shoulder, but it is used figuratively to mean missing a golden opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢差啲就贏咗比賽，可惜最後失之交臂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa1 di1 zau6 wing4 zo2 bei2 coi3, ho2 sik1 zeoi3 hau6 sat1 zi1 gaau1 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他差点就赢了比赛，可惜最后失之交臂。
examples.english_sentence: He almost won the competition, but unfortunately, he just missed it in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋失之交臂，冇機會合作，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sat1 zi1 gaau1 bei3, mou5 gei1 wui2 hap6 zok3, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们失之交臂，没有机会合作，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: We missed the opportunity to collaborate, it's such a pity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次投資機會咁好，唔好再失之交臂啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 tau4 zi1 gei1 wui2 gam3 hou2, m4 hou2 zoi3 sat1 zi1 gaau1 bei3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次投资机会这么好，不要再失之交臂了！
examples.english_sentence: This investment opportunity is so good, don't miss it again!

english_meaning: to have an accident; accident; mishap
explanation_mandarin: 指发生意外事故，通常指交通工具（如飞机、船只、汽车等）发生的事故。
explanation_english: Refers to an unexpected accident, usually involving vehicles such as airplanes, ships, or cars.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架飛機失事，好多人死咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 fei1 gei1 sat1 si6, hou2 do1 jan4 si2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机失事，死了很多人。
examples.english_sentence: The plane crashed, and many people died.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋遇到交通失事，受咗傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jyu6 dou2 giao1 tung1 sat1 si6, sau6 zo2 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们遇到了交通事故，受了伤。
examples.english_sentence: They were involved in a traffic accident and got injured.

english_meaning: to break one's promise; to go back on one's word; to lose credibility
explanation_mandarin: 不遵守诺言，失去了信用。
explanation_english: To fail to keep a promise; to lose one's credibility due to not honoring commitments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日失信，冇人再信佢講嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 sat1 seon3, mou5 jan4 zoi3 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是失信，没人再相信他说的话了。
examples.english_sentence: He always breaks his promises, no one believes what he says anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司失信於客戶，會影響聲譽㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 sat1 seon3 jyu1 haak3 wu6, wui5 ying2 hoeng2 seng1 jyu6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司对客户失信，会影响声誉的。
examples.english_sentence: If a company breaks its promises to customers, it will affect its reputation.

english_meaning: out of repair; dilapidated; in disrepair; neglected
explanation_mandarin: 指物品、建筑物等因为缺乏维护和修理而损坏。
explanation_english: Refers to objects, buildings, etc. that are damaged due to lack of maintenance and repair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 棟樓失修咗好耐，好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dung6 lau4 sat1 sau1 zo2 hou2 noi6, hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼失修很久了，很危险。
examples.english_sentence: This building has been in disrepair for a long time, it's very dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部車失修，要拎去整返好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 ce1 sat1 sau1, jiu3 ling1 heoi3 zing2 faan1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车失修了，要拿去修好。
examples.english_sentence: The car is out of repair, it needs to be taken for repairs.

english_meaning: lost; become extinct; to be lost to posterity; tradition that has died out
explanation_mandarin: 指某种技艺、知识、文化等因为没有人继承而消失。
explanation_english: Refers to a skill, knowledge, culture, etc., that has disappeared because no one has inherited it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲傳統手藝好容易失傳㗎，冇後生仔肯學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 cyun4 tung2 sau2 ngai6 hou2 jung4 ji6 sat1 cyun4 gaa3, mou5 hau6 saang1 zai2 hang2 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些传统手艺很容易失传，没有年轻人肯学。
examples.english_sentence: These traditional crafts are easily lost because young people are unwilling to learn them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔保護，呢種獨特嘅文化就會失傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 bou2 wu6, ni1 zung2 duk6 dak6 ge3 man4 faa3 zau6 wui5 sat1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不保护，这种独特的文化就会失传。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't protect it, this unique culture will be lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋努力去搶救一啲差啲失傳嘅民間藝術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 nu5 lik6 heoi3 coeng2 gau3 jat1 di1 caa1 di1 sat1 cyun4 ge3 man4 gaan1 ngai6 seot3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们努力抢救一些差点失传的民间艺术。
examples.english_sentence: They are working hard to save some folk arts that were almost lost.

english_meaning: to lose decorum, to behave improperly, to be undignified, to commit a faux pas
explanation_mandarin: 指行为举止不合礼仪规范，失去了应有的庄重或得体的表现。
explanation_english: Refers to behavior that violates etiquette and decorum, losing the required solemnity or propriety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁隆重嘅場合失儀，真係好失禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 lung4 zung6 ge3 coeng4 hap6 sat1 ji4, zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这种隆重的场合失礼，真的很丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: It's really embarrassing to lose decorum in such a solemn occasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢飲醉酒之後，成日都會失儀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yam2 zeoi3 zau2 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 sat1 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喝醉酒之后，经常都会失礼。
examples.english_sentence: He often behaves improperly after getting drunk.

english_meaning: to lose points; to be marked down
explanation_mandarin: 在比赛、考试等场合失去分数。引申为表现不好，导致评价降低。
explanation_english: To lose points in a competition, exam, etc. By extension, it means performing poorly and causing a decrease in evaluation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試失咗好多分，今次考得唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 fan1, gam1 ci3 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试失了很多分，这次考得不好。
examples.english_sentence: I lost a lot of points in the exam; I didn't do well this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論比賽入面失咗啲分，因為佢講嘢唔夠清晰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 sat1 zo2 di1 fan1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 gong2 je5 m4 gau3 ching1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论比赛中失了一些分，因为他说得不够清晰。
examples.english_sentence: He lost some points in the debate competition because he didn't speak clearly enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為遲到，佢失咗印象分。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 chi4 dou3, keoi5 sat1 zo2 jan3 soeng6 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为迟到，他失去了印象分。
examples.english_sentence: He lost impression points because he was late.

english_meaning: to suffer a setback; to fail; to be defeated
explanation_mandarin: 遭受挫折，没有达到预期目标。
explanation_english: To experience a setback or failure; to not achieve the desired outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋隊波失利咗，希望下次可以做得更好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 sat1 lei6 zo2, hei1 mong6 haa6 ci3 ho2 ji5 zou6 dak1 gang3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们队输了，希望下次可以做得更好。
examples.english_sentence: Our team lost this match. Hopefully, we can do better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考車牌失利，要等下個月再考過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 ce1 paai4 sat1 lei6, jiu3 dang2 haa6 go3 jyut6 zoi3 haau2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考驾照没通过，要等下个月再考一次。
examples.english_sentence: He failed his driving test and has to wait until next month to take it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然今次投資失利，但係唔好灰心，下次再嚟過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gam1 ci3 tau4 zi1 sat1 lei6, daan6 hai6 m4 hou2 fui1 sam1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 lai4 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这次投资失败了，但是不要灰心，下次再来。
examples.english_sentence: Although this investment failed, don't be discouraged. Try again next time.

english_meaning: to lose power; to lose influence; to fall from grace; to lose favour; to lose momentum
explanation_mandarin: 失去原有的权势、影响力、地位等。
explanation_english: To lose one's power, influence, position, or momentum; to fall from a position of authority or favour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司失咗勢，冇晒話事權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 sat1 zo2 sai3, mou5 saai3 waa6 si6 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司失势了，没有了话语权。
examples.english_sentence: He lost power in the company and has no say anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從老闆換咗人，佢就開始失勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 lou5 baan2 wun6 zo2 jan4, keoi5 zau6 hoi1 chi2 sat1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从老板换了人，他就开始失势。
examples.english_sentence: Since the boss changed, he started losing power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個運動員受咗傷之後，喺比賽入面失晒勢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 wan6 dung6 jyun4 sau6 zo2 soeng1 zi1 hau6, hai2 bei2 choi3 jap6 min6 sat1 saai3 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个运动员受伤之后，在比赛中失去了优势。
examples.english_sentence: After the athlete got injured, he lost momentum in the competition.

mandarin_meaning: 丢了钥匙的保险箱; 比喻毫无用处，摆设
english_meaning: A safe without a key; useless; decorative but impractical
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词性短语 (ming ci xing duan yu)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指丢了钥匙的保险箱，无法打开，起不到保护财物的作用。引申义指事物或人失去了应有的作用或功能，如同摆设一般，毫无用处。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a safe without a key, which cannot be opened and serves no purpose in protecting valuables. The extended meaning refers to something or someone that has lost its/their intended function or use, becoming like a useless decoration.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你買咗部咁貴嘅電腦，但係又唔識用，咪即係失匙夾萬囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 zo2 bou6 gam3 gwai3 ge3 din6 nou5, daan6 hai6 jau6 m4 sik1 yung6, mai1 zik1 hai6 sat1 si4 gaap3 maan2 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你买了这么贵的电脑，但是又不会用，不就是个摆设吗！
examples.english_sentence: You bought such an expensive computer, but you don't know how to use it. It's just a safe without a key!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個部門嘅經理根本就係失匙夾萬，乜嘢都唔識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 bou6 mun4 ge3 ging1 lei5 gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 sat1 si4 gaap3 maan2, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个部门的经理根本就是个摆设，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: The manager of this department is basically useless, doesn't know anything.

english_meaning: to lose, to forfeit, to be deprived of
explanation_mandarin: 指失去或丧失原本拥有的东西或特质。
explanation_english: To lose or forfeit something that was originally possessed, whether it be a physical object, an ability, or a characteristic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失卻咗對未來嘅希望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 koek3 zo2 deoi3 mei6 loi4 ge3 hei1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失去了对未来的希望。
examples.english_sentence: He lost hope for the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年戰亂，好多傳統文化都失卻咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 zin3 lyun6, hou2 do1 tyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 dou1 sat1 koek3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过多年战乱，很多传统文化都丧失了。
examples.english_sentence: After years of war, many traditional cultures have been lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失卻咗記憶，唔記得自己係邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 koek3 zo2 gei3 jik1, m4 gei3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hai6 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失去了记忆，不记得自己是谁。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his memory and doesn't remember who he is.

english_meaning: to lose; to forfeit
explanation_mandarin: 丢失，丧失
explanation_english: To no longer have something; to be deprived of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔想失去呢個機會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 soeng2 sat1 heoi3 ni1 go3 gei1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不想失去这个机会。
examples.english_sentence: We don't want to lose this opportunity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失去咗佢嘅工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 heoi3 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失去了他的工作。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你失去咗我嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sat1 heoi3 zo2 ngo5 ge3 sun3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你失去了我的信任。
examples.english_sentence: You lost my trust.

english_meaning: to blurt out, to let slip, to make a slip of the tongue
explanation_mandarin: 不小心说出不该说的话。
explanation_english: To unintentionally reveal something that should have been kept secret or to make a mistake in speaking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失口講咗個秘密出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 hau2 gong2 zo2 go3 bei3 mat6 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不小心说漏了那个秘密。
examples.english_sentence: He blurted out the secret.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一時失口，唔應該喺佢面前咁講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 si4 sat1 hau2, m4 jing1 goi1 hai2 keoi5 min6 cin4 gam2 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一时失言，不应该在他面前这样说。
examples.english_sentence: I made a slip of the tongue; I shouldn't have said that in front of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張，就算失口都冇所謂嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, zau6 syun3 sat1 hau2 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么紧张，就算说错话也没关系。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, even if you slip up, it doesn't matter.

english_meaning: flustered, panicky, in a hurry and confused
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因为紧张或慌乱而显得手忙脚乱，不知所措的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is flustered, panicky, or in a hurry and confused, often resulting in making mistakes or acting without thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好失失慌啦，慢慢嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sat1 sat1 fong1 laa1, maan6 maan2 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要慌慌张张的，慢慢来。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so flustered, take your time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失失慌咁，唔知搞咩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 sat1 fong1 gam2, m4 zi1 gaau2 me1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他慌慌张张的，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's all panicky, I don't know what he's up to.

english_meaning: to lose face, to be humiliated, to suffer a loss of prestige
explanation_mandarin: 指丢脸，失去威风、颜面。
explanation_english: To lose face, prestige, or reputation; to be humiliated or embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺咁多人面前俾人串，真係好失威。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 jan4 chuan3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 wai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这么多人面前被人挖苦，真的很丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: He was ridiculed in front of so many people; it was really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試唔合格，真係失威啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 gok3 gaak3, zan1 hai6 sat1 wai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试没及格，真是丢脸啊。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time, it's really a loss of face.

english_meaning: divorced; to get divorced
explanation_mandarin: 指婚姻失败，离婚的状态或行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the state or act of divorce; having a failed marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結咗十年婚，最後都係失婚收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 zo2 sap6 nin4 fan1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 fan1 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年了，最后还是以离婚收场。
examples.english_sentence: They were married for ten years, but ultimately ended up divorced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失婚之後，成日都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 fan1 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他离婚之后，整天都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He's been unhappy all the time since he got divorced.

english_meaning: to be deprived of schooling; to drop out of school; to be unable to attend school
explanation_mandarin: 指因贫困或其他原因而无法继续接受教育。
explanation_english: Refers to being unable to continue one's education due to poverty or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企窮，冇錢俾佢讀書，所以佢失學咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 kung4, mou5 cin2 bei2 keoi5 duk6 syu1, so2 ji5 keoi5 sat1 hok6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家很穷，没钱供他读书，所以他失学了。
examples.english_sentence: His family is poor and couldn't afford to pay for his schooling, so he dropped out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多發展中國家嘅細路都因為戰亂而失學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 faat3 zin2 zung1 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 sai3 lou2 dou1 jan1 wai6 zin3 lyun6 ji4 sat1 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多发展中国家的孩子都因为战乱而失学。
examples.english_sentence: Many children in developing countries are deprived of schooling due to war.

english_meaning: to lose ground; to fall (e.g., a defensive position); to be breached; to lose control; to succumb
explanation_mandarin: 原本守住的地方被攻破；失去控制。
explanation_english: To lose a defensive position, allowing the enemy to advance; to lose control of something; to give in or succumb to temptation or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條防線失守咗，敵人入咗嚟喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 fong4 sin3 sat1 sau2 zo2, dik6 jan4 jap6 zo2 lai4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 防线失守了，敌人进来了！
examples.english_sentence: The defensive line has been breached, the enemy has entered!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢減肥減咗好耐，但係最後都係失守咗，食咗個蛋糕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaam2 fei4 gaam2 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 si6 sat1 sau2 zo2, sik6 zo2 go3 daan6 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她减肥减了很久，但是最后还是失守了，吃了个蛋糕。
examples.english_sentence: She had been dieting for a long time, but she eventually succumbed and ate a cake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港隊喺上半場失守一球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 deoi2 hai2 soeng6 bun3 coeng4 sat1 sau2 jat1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港队在上半场失守一球。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong team conceded a goal in the first half.

english_meaning: untrue, inaccurate, false, distorted
explanation_mandarin: 指内容与事实不符，不真实。
explanation_english: Referring to content that does not match the facts; untrue, inaccurate, or misleading.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢篇報道失實嘅地方太多喇，冇乜參考價值。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6 sat1 sat6 ge3 dei6 fong1 taai3 do1 laa3, mou5 mat1 caam1 kaau2 gaa3 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这篇报道失实的地方太多了，没什么参考价值。
examples.english_sentence: There are too many inaccuracies in this report. It's not very reliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅證供有啲失實，可能係想包庇其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zing3 gung1 jau5 di1 sat1 sat6, ho2 nang4 hai6 soeng2 baau1 bik1 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的证词有些失实，可能是想包庇其他人。
examples.english_sentence: His testimony is somewhat inaccurate; perhaps he is trying to protect someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告嘅宣傳手法好失實，誤導消費者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gwong2 gou3 ge3 syun1 cyun4 sau2 faat3 hou2 sat1 sat6, ng6 dou6 siu1 fai3 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个广告的宣传手法很失实，误导消费者。
examples.english_sentence: The promotional tactics in this advertisement are very misleading and misinform consumers.

english_meaning: to fall out of favor; to lose favour; to be out of favour
explanation_mandarin: 失去宠爱、不再受喜爱。多指失去上级或长辈的喜爱。
explanation_english: To lose favour, affection or preferential treatment, often referring to losing favour with superiors or elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從佢升咗職之後，我就失寵喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 sat1 cung2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从他升职之后，我就失宠了。
examples.english_sentence: Since he got promoted, I've fallen out of favour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為做錯嘢而失寵，老闆唔再信任佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 zou6 co3 je5 ji4 sat1 cung2, lou5 baan2 m4 zoi3 seon3 yam6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为做错事而失宠，老板不再信任他。
examples.english_sentence: He fell out of favour because he did something wrong, and the boss no longer trusts him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰隻狗仔失寵喇，因為主人領養咗隻新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 zek3 gau2 zai2 sat1 cung2 laa3, yan1 wai6 zyu2 yan4 ling5 yeung5 zo2 zek3 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那只小狗失宠了，因为主人领养了一只新的。
examples.english_sentence: That puppy has fallen out of favour because the owner adopted a new one.

english_meaning: abnormal; erratic; not functioning properly; to be out of order; to lose one's composure
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或人的表现不正常，超出正常范围或状态。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone behaving abnormally, exceeding the normal range or state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日考試失常，平時都考得好好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 haau2 si5 sat1 soeng4, ping4 si4 dou1 haau2 dak1 hou2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天考试失常了，平时都考得很好。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well on the exam yesterday, he usually does well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器失常，要攞去整。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 sat1 soeng4, jiu3 lo2 heoi3 zing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器出故障了，需要拿去修理。
examples.english_sentence: This machine is malfunctioning, we need to get it repaired.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他受到刺激之后，精神失常了。
examples.english_sentence: He became mentally unstable after being stimulated.

english_meaning: lack of virtue; immoral; unethical; to be devoid of morality
explanation_mandarin: 指缺乏道德，品行不好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks virtue, is immoral, or behaves unethically. It implies a deficiency in moral principles and behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做醫生收埋病人紅包，真係失德。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 yi1 sang1 sau1 maai4 beng6 jan4 hung4 baau1, zan1 hai6 sat1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做医生私下收病人的红包，真是缺德。
examples.english_sentence: He's a doctor who secretly accepts red envelopes from patients, it's really unethical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呃人錢財，真係失德嘅行為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aak1 jan4 cin2 coi4, zan1 hai6 sat1 dak1 ge3 hang4 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 骗取别人的钱财，真是缺德的行为。
examples.english_sentence: Cheating people out of their money is truly an immoral act.

english_meaning: disappointed; frustrated; disheartened; to lose hope; unsuccessful
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人不如意，心情不好，感到沮丧或失望。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is not satisfied, in a bad mood, and feels frustrated or disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試肥佬，好失意呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, hou2 sat1 ji3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试不及格，很失意啊。
examples.english_sentence: He failed the exam and is very disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢生意失敗咗，最近都好失意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saang1 ji3 sat1 baai6 zo2, zeoi3 gan6 dou1 hou2 sat1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他生意失败了，最近都很失意。
examples.english_sentence: His business failed, and he's been very disheartened lately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁失意啦，下次努力啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 sat1 ji3 laa1, haa6 ci3 nu5 lik6 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么失意啦，下次努力一点不就行了吗。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged, just try harder next time.

english_meaning: amnesia, memory loss
explanation_mandarin: 指失去记忆。可以指暂时性的，也可以指永久性的。
explanation_english: Refers to the loss of memory. It can be temporary or permanent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車之後失咗憶，咩都唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6 sat1 zo2 jik1, me1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他撞车之后失忆了，什么都不记得。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his memory after the car accident and doesn't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好扮失憶啦，你明明記得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 baan6 sat1 jik1 laa1, nei5 ming4 ming4 gei3 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别装失忆了，你明明记得的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend to have amnesia, you clearly remember it.

english_meaning: amnesia, memory loss
explanation_mandarin: 指记忆丧失的症状或疾病，可以是暂时性的或永久性的，也可能影响特定类型的记忆。
explanation_english: A condition characterized by loss of memory, either partial or complete, temporary or permanent. It may affect specific types of memories or all memories.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞車之後患咗失憶症，乜都唔記得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 ce1 zi1 hau6 waan6 zo2 sat1 yik1 zing3, mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他车祸后得了失忆症，什么都不记得了。
examples.english_sentence: He developed amnesia after the car accident and doesn't remember anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇戲成日都有啲劇情講主角失憶症，之後搵返啲記憶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 hei3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 di1 kek6 ching4 gong2 zyu2 gok3 sat1 yik1 zing3, zi1 hau6 wan2 faan1 di1 gei3 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看电影经常有一些剧情讲主角得了失忆症，然后找回一些记忆。
examples.english_sentence: Movies often have plots about the main character having amnesia and then regaining some memories.

english_meaning: to be lovelorn; to be heartbroken; to break up (with someone)
explanation_mandarin: 指恋爱失败，失去恋爱的对象。
explanation_english: To have a failed romance; to have lost the person one loves; to have broken up with a lover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，成日都唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，整天都不开心。
examples.english_sentence: After he became lovelorn, he was unhappy all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想失戀，所以會好好維繫呢段感情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 sat1 lyun2, so2 ji5 wui5 hou2 hou2 wai4 hai6 ni1 dyun6 gam2 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想失恋，所以会好好维系这段感情。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to be lovelorn, so I will maintain this relationship well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失戀嘅時候，最好就係搵朋友傾訴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 lyun2 ge3 si4 hau6, zeoi3 hou2 zau6 hai6 wan2 pang4 jau5 king1 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失恋的时候，最好就是找朋友倾诉。
examples.english_sentence: When you are lovelorn, the best thing to do is to confide in friends.

mandarin_meaning: 失误; 失败; 没拿稳
english_meaning: to make a mistake; to slip up; to fail; to lose one's grip
explanation_mandarin: 指因疏忽或技术不足而犯错、失败，或指没拿稳东西而掉落。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake or failing due to carelessness or lack of skill; also refers to losing one's grip on something and dropping it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日考試失咗手，所以成績唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 haau2 si3 sat1 zo2 sau2, so2 ji5 sing4 jik1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天考试失误了，所以成绩不太好。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake in the exam yesterday, so his results weren't very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我失手打爛咗隻杯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 sat1 sau2 daa2 laan6 zo2 zek3 bui1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我失手打碎了一个杯子。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I accidentally broke the cup.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次比賽唔小心失咗手，輸咗俾對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 m4 siu2 sam1 sat1 zo2 sau2, syu1 zo2 bei2 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次比赛不小心失误了，输给了对手。
examples.english_sentence: He accidentally slipped up in this competition and lost to his opponent.

english_meaning: To make a mistake; to blunder; to mess up; to screw up; to look foolish.
explanation_mandarin: 指因犯错、失误而显得笨拙或丢脸。通常指在某个情境下表现不佳，犯了不该犯的错误，导致尴尬或不理想的结果。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake, blunder, or messing up, often resulting in an embarrassing or undesirable outcome. It implies a failure to perform adequately in a specific situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺個presentation度我失打咗，講錯咗啲數據。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 hai2 go3 presentation dou6 ngo5 sat1 daa2 zo2, gong2 co3 zo2 di1 sou3 geoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在演示的时候我犯傻了，说错了一些数据。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up during the presentation earlier, I said the wrong data.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日比賽失打，輸咗俾對手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 bei2 coi3 sat1 daa2, syu1 zo2 bei2 deoi3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天比赛犯傻了，输给了对手。
examples.english_sentence: He screwed up in the competition yesterday and lost to his opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張，就算失打都唔緊要嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, zau6 syun3 sat1 daa2 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么紧张，就算犯错也没关系的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, even if you mess up it doesn't matter.

mandarin_meaning: 耽误; 延误; 错过
english_meaning: to delay; to postpone; to miss (a deadline, opportunity, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 耽误了时间或机会；没有按时完成。
explanation_english: To delay, postpone or miss an opportunity, deadline, or appointment; to not complete something on time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好失拖呀，聽日一定要交功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sat1 to1 aa3, ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要耽误啊，明天一定要交作业。
examples.english_sentence: Don't delay, you must hand in your homework tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋失拖咗成個鐘頭，塞車塞得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sat1 to1 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 tau4, sak1 che1 sak1 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们耽误了一个小时，堵车堵得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: We were delayed for a whole hour, the traffic jam was terrible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我再失拖，可能就冇咗呢個機會喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 zoi3 sat1 to1, ho2 nang4 zau6 mou5 zo2 ni1 go3 gei1 wui2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我再耽误，可能就失去这个机会了。
examples.english_sentence: If I delay any further, I might lose this opportunity.

english_meaning: out of control, to lose control
explanation_mandarin: 失去控制；无法控制局面。
explanation_english: To lose control; to be out of control; unable to control a situation or one's emotions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車突然失控撞埋去欄杆度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 dat6 jin4 sat1 hung3 zong6 maai4 heoi3 laan4 gon1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车突然失控撞到了护栏上。
examples.english_sentence: The car suddenly went out of control and crashed into the guardrail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一飲醉酒就失控，周圍搞搞震。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 zau6 sat1 hung3, zau1 wai4 gaau2 gaau2 zan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一喝醉酒就失控，到处惹事。
examples.english_sentence: He loses control as soon as he gets drunk and causes trouble everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情緒失控對身體唔好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 seoi5 sat1 hung3 deoi3 san1 tai2 m4 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情绪失控对身体不好。
examples.english_sentence: Losing control of your emotions is not good for your health.

english_meaning: crop failure, poor harvest
explanation_mandarin: 指农作物因自然灾害或其他原因导致收成不好，产量减少。
explanation_english: Refers to a poor harvest or crop failure due to natural disasters or other reasons resulting in reduced yields.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年啲橙樹失收，可能因為之前打風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 di1 caang2 syu6 sat1 sau1, ho2 nang4 jan1 wai6 zi1 cin4 daa2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的橙树歉收了，可能是因为之前刮台风。
examples.english_sentence: This year's orange trees have a crop failure, probably because of the typhoon before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年好多農作物都失收，菜價升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hou2 do1 nung4 zok6 mat6 dou1 sat1 sau1, coi3 gaa3 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年很多农作物都歉收了，菜价涨了很多。
examples.english_sentence: This year many crops have failed, and vegetable prices have risen a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果持續落雨，稻米就好可能失收。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ci4 zuk6 lok6 jyu5, dou6 mai5 zau6 hou2 ho2 nang4 sat1 sau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果持续下雨，稻米就很可能会歉收。
examples.english_sentence: If it continues to rain, the rice crop is very likely to fail.

english_meaning: to become ineffective; to lose effect; to expire; to become invalid
explanation_mandarin: 失去效力、失去作用。
explanation_english: To lose its effectiveness or validity; to expire or become invalid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張優惠券已經失效喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 jau1 wai2 hyun3 ji5 ging1 sat1 haau6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张优惠券已经失效了。
examples.english_sentence: This coupon has already expired.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔按時續期，個保險就會失效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 on3 si4 zuk6 kei4, go3 bou2 him2 zau6 wui5 sat1 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不按时续期，保险就会失效。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't renew on time, the insurance will become invalid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊嘅方法已經失效，我哋要諗新嘅辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 ge3 fong1 faat3 ji5 ging1 sat1 haau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lam2 san1 ge3 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧的方法已经失效，我们要想新的办法。
examples.english_sentence: The old method is no longer effective, we need to think of a new way.

mandarin_meaning: 失去抢救机会; 错过急救
english_meaning: failed to rescue; beyond rescue; past saving
explanation_mandarin: 指由于延误或条件限制等原因，错过了最佳的抢救时机，导致无法挽回局面。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation where the best opportunity for rescue or emergency treatment has been missed due to delays, limitations, or other reasons, resulting in an irrecoverable outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢送院嗰陣已經失救喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sung3 jyun2 go2 zan6 ji5 ging1 sat1 gau3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他送到医院的时候已经错过了抢救的机会。
examples.english_sentence: He was already beyond rescue when he was sent to the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔及時處理，病人好容易失救㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 kap6 si4 cyu5 lei5, beng6 jan4 hou2 yung4 yi6 sat1 gau3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不及时处理，病人很容易错过急救的机会。
examples.english_sentence: If not treated in time, the patient could easily be beyond rescue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞得咁嚴重，司機可能已經失救。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong6 dak1 gam3 jim4 zung6, si1 gei1 ho2 nang4 ji5 ging1 sat1 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞得这么严重，司机可能已经错过了抢救的机会。
examples.english_sentence: The car crash was so serious, the driver may have already been beyond rescue.

synonyms: 返魂乏術 (faan1 wan4 fat6 seot6)

english_meaning: failure, to fail
explanation_mandarin: 指事情没有达到预期的目标或结果。
explanation_english: The state or condition of not succeeding; lack of success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今次考試失敗咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 sat1 baai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这次考试失败了。
examples.english_sentence: I failed the exam this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好驚失敗，最緊要係學到嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 geng1 sat1 baai6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hok6 dou2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要害怕失败，最重要的是学到东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be afraid of failure, the most important thing is to learn something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅生意最後都係失敗收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 saang1 ji3 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的生意最终还是以失败告终。
examples.english_sentence: His business eventually ended in failure.

jyutping: sat1 baai6 naai5 sing4 gung1 zi1 mou5
english_meaning: Failure is the mother of success
explanation_mandarin: 指从失败中吸取教训，最终取得成功。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes that failure is a valuable learning experience and a necessary step towards eventual success. By learning from mistakes and persevering, one can ultimately achieve their goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁灰心，失敗乃成功之母，下次努力啲就得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1, sat1 baai6 naai5 sing4 gung1 zi1 mou5, haa6 ci3 nou5 lik6 di1 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别灰心，失败是成功之母，下次努力一点就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so discouraged, failure is the mother of success, just try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然今次考試唔合格，但係失敗乃成功之母，我會檢討下，下次考好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3, daan6 hai6 sat1 baai6 naai5 sing4 gung1 zi1 mou5, ngo5 wui5 gim2 tou2 haa5, haa6 ci3 haau2 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这次考试没及格，但是失败是成功之母，我会检讨一下，下次考好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Although I failed this exam, failure is the mother of success, I will review it and do better next time.

english_meaning: to end in failure; to conclude with failure; to fail
explanation_mandarin: 指某事最终以失败结束。
explanation_english: Refers to something ending in failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅計劃最後都係失敗吿終。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 gou3 chung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划最终还是以失败告终。
examples.english_sentence: His plan ultimately ended in failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢次嘅嘗試都係失敗吿終，下次再努力啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ci3 ge3 si4 soeng4 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 gou3 chung1, haa6 ci3 zoi3 nu5 lik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的尝试还是以失败告终，下次再努力吧。
examples.english_sentence: This attempt ended in failure, let's try harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論付出幾多努力，如果策略唔啱，都可能失敗吿終。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 fu6 ceot1 gei2 do1 nu5 lik6, jyu4 gwo2 chak1 leuk6 m4 aam1, dou1 ho2 nang4 sat1 baai6 gou3 chung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论付出多少努力，如果策略不对，都可能以失败告终。
examples.english_sentence: No matter how much effort you put in, if the strategy is wrong, it may still end in failure.

english_meaning: to end in failure, to end unsuccessfully, to come to a bad end
explanation_mandarin: 指事情最终以失败的结果结束。
explanation_english: Refers to a situation or endeavor that ultimately ends in failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅計劃最終都係失敗告終。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 gou3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的计划最终还是以失败告终。
examples.english_sentence: Their plan ultimately ended in failure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅擴張計劃因為資金不足而失敗告終。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 kwok3 zoeng1 gai3 waak6 jan1 wai6 zi1 gam1 bat1 zuk1 ji4 sat1 baai6 gou3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的扩张计划因为资金不足而以失败告终。
examples.english_sentence: This company's expansion plan failed due to insufficient funding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多次嘗試，佢嘅努力都係失敗告終，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 ci3 soeng4 si3, keoi5 ge3 nu5 lik6 dou1 hai6 sat1 baai6 gou3 zung1, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多次尝试，他的努力还是以失败告终，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: After so many attempts, his efforts still ended in failure, it's really a pity.

english_meaning: loser, failure
explanation_mandarin: 指在某件事情上失败的人，或者在生活中总是失败的人。
explanation_english: A person who has failed in something, or someone who consistently fails in life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日話自己係失敗者，試下努力啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 sat1 baai6 ze2, si3 haa5 nou5 lik6 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是说自己是失败者，尝试努力一点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't always call yourself a loser, try to work harder!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考得唔好，就覺得自己係個失敗者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 m4 hou2, zau6 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 hai6 go3 sat1 baai6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考得不好，就觉得自己是个失败者。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't do well in the exam and felt like a loser.

mandarin_meaning: 失散, 走散, 失蹤
english_meaning: to be separated, to get lost (from a group), to go missing
explanation_mandarin: 指人或物分散丢失，走散，通常指人群或集体中走失。
explanation_english: Refers to people or things being scattered and lost, usually refers to getting separated from a group or collective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋細個嗰陣時，喺海洋公園失散咗，好彩最後都搵得返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, hai2 hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jyun4 sat1 saan3 zo2, hou2 coi2 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 wan2 dak1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们小时候在海洋公园走散了，幸好最后都找回来了。
examples.english_sentence: We got separated in Ocean Park when we were kids, luckily we were found in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰亂嘅時候，好多家庭都失散咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 lyun6 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 dou1 sat1 saan3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战乱的时候，很多家庭都失散了。
examples.english_sentence: Many families were separated during the war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 人太多喇，小心唔好失散啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan4 taai3 do1 laa3, siu2 sam1 m4 hou2 sat1 saan3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人太多了，小心不要走散啊！
examples.english_sentence: There are too many people, be careful not to get separated!

english_meaning: Excuse me; pardon me; with all due respect; sorry to have inconvenienced you
explanation_mandarin: 一种客气的说法，表示对对方不够尊重或者打扰了对方，通常在离开时或做了冒犯行为后使用。
explanation_english: A polite expression used when apologizing for a lack of respect or for causing inconvenience. Often used when leaving or after committing an offensive act.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失敬失敬，頭先冇認得你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 ging3 sat1 ging3, tau4 sin1 mou5 jing6 dak1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失敬失敬，刚才没认出你。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I didn't recognize you just now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁夜仲要打擾你，真係失敬晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 je2 zung6 jiu3 daa2 jiu2 nei5, zan1 hai6 sat1 ging3 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么晚还要打扰你，真是太失敬了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry for bothering you so late, it's very impolite of me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，唔小心踩到你隻腳，失敬晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, m4 siu2 sam1 caai2 dou2 nei5 zek3 goek3, sat1 ging3 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，不小心踩到你的脚，失敬了！
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I accidentally stepped on your foot, sorry about that!

synonyms: 唔好意思 (m4 hou2 ji3 si1)

english_meaning: blindness; to lose sight
explanation_mandarin: 失去视力; 眼睛看不见东西的状态。
explanation_english: To lose the ability to see; the condition of being unable to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為意外而失明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yan1 wai6 yi3 ngoi6 yi4 sat1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为意外而失明。
examples.english_sentence: He became blind due to an accident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失明人士需要特別嘅幫助。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 ming4 yan4 si6 seoi1 yiu3 dak6 bit1 ge3 bong1 zo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失明人士需要特别的帮助。
examples.english_sentence: Blind people need special help.

english_meaning: disappointed, disappointment
explanation_mandarin: 感到不如意或希望没有实现
explanation_english: Feeling disappointed when expectations are not met, or hopes are unfulfilled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對你好失望呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 nei5 hou2 sat1 mong6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对你很失望啊！ (Wǒ duì nǐ hěn shīwàng a!)
examples.english_sentence: I'm so disappointed in you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試唔合格令我好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 m4 hap6 gaak3 ling6 ngo5 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试不及格令我很失望。(Kǎoshì bù jígé lìng wǒ hěn shīwàng.)
examples.english_sentence: Failing the exam made me very disappointed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅表現令人失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 biu2 hin3 ling6 jan4 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的表现令人失望。(Tāmen de biǎoxiàn lìng rén shīwàng.)
examples.english_sentence: Their performance was disappointing.

english_meaning: unemployment, to lose one's job, to be unemployed
explanation_mandarin: 失去工作，没有工作。
explanation_english: To be without a job; the state of being unemployed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，好多人都失業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，很多人都失业了。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is bad, and many people have lost their jobs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業咗三個月，壓力好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6, aat3 lik6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业三个月了，压力很大。
examples.english_sentence: He's been unemployed for three months and is under a lot of stress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府要諗辦法解決失業問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jiu3 nam2 baan6 faat3 gaai2 kyut3 sat1 jip6 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府要想办法解决失业问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government needs to think of ways to solve the unemployment problem.

english_meaning: unemployment rate
explanation_mandarin: 指在劳动力人口中，失业者所占的比例。
explanation_english: The percentage of the labor force that is unemployed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年香港嘅失業率升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 sat1 jip6 leut2 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年香港的失业率上升了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The unemployment rate in Hong Kong has increased a lot this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府好關注失業率嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 hou2 gwaan1 zyu3 sat1 jip6 leut2 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府很关注失业率的问题。
examples.english_sentence: The government is very concerned about the unemployment rate problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟唔好，失業率自然會高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, sat1 jip6 leut2 zi6 jin4 wui5 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济不好，失业率自然会高。
examples.english_sentence: If the economy is bad, the unemployment rate will naturally be high.

english_meaning: to make a mistake; to blunder; screw up
explanation_mandarin: 指犯错误，搞砸事情。
explanation_english: Refers to making a mistake, messing something up, or blundering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我失咗波，肥佬硬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 sat1 zo2 bo1, fei4 lou2 ngaang6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我失误了，肯定不及格了。
examples.english_sentence: I messed up on this exam, I'm definitely failing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁緊張，就算失波都唔緊要，下次做好啲咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gan2 zoeng1, zau6 syun3 sat1 bo1 dou1 m4 gan2 jiu3, haa6 ci3 zou6 hou2 di1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么紧张，就算失误了也没关系，下次做好一点就行了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so nervous, even if you mess up it's okay, just do better next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁做嘢法，好容易失波㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 zou6嘢 faat3, hou2 jung4 ji6 sat1 bo1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样工作方式，很容易出错的。
examples.english_sentence: The way you work, it's easy to make mistakes.

english_meaning: Hypothermia
explanation_mandarin: 指人体因暴露于寒冷环境中，导致体温异常降低的症状。
explanation_english: A condition in which the body temperature is dangerously low, typically due to prolonged exposure to cold temperatures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 行山嘅時候要小心，如果唔夠保暖，好容易會出現失温症。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haang4 saan1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 gau3 bou2 wun1, hou2 jung4 ji6 wui5 chut1 hin1 sat1 wan1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爬山的时候要小心，如果不注意保暖，很容易出现体温过低。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when hiking, you can easily get hypothermia if you don't keep yourself warm enough.

english_meaning: to be off one's game; to make a mistake; to perform below par; inaccurate
explanation_mandarin: 指表现不如平时好，发挥失常，不准确。
explanation_english: Refers to performing below the usual standard; not accurate; to be off one's game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日表現失準，平時唔係咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 biu2 hin6 sat1 zeon2, ping4 si4 m4 hai6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天表现失常，平时不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: He's off his game today, he's not usually like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試我失準咗，應該可以做得更好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 sat1 zeon2 zo2, jing1 goi1 ho2 ji5 zou6 dak1 gang3 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试我失常了，应该可以做得更好的。
examples.english_sentence: I was off my game in this exam, I should have been able to do better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個時鐘失準咗，慢咗成個鐘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 si4 zung1 sat1 zeon2 zo2, maan6 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个钟表不准了，慢了一个小时。
examples.english_sentence: This clock is inaccurate, it's an hour slow.

english_meaning: Hypothermia
explanation_mandarin: 指人体核心温度降低到足以导致代谢、心脏及脑部功能紊乱的状况。
explanation_english: A condition in which the body temperature is dangerously low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行山嗰陣遇上大雨，搞到有啲失溫症嘅徵狀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 jyu6 soeng5 daai6 jyu5, gaau2 dou3 jau5 di1 sat1 wan1 zing3 ge3 zing1 zong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他登山的时候遇到大雨，导致出现了一些失温症的症状。
examples.english_sentence: He encountered heavy rain while hiking, leading to some symptoms of hypothermia.

english_meaning: to catch fire; to be on fire; fire (outbreak)
explanation_mandarin: 指发生火灾；着火。
explanation_english: To catch fire; to be on fire. Also refers to an outbreak of fire.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日樓下間餐廳失火，好彩冇人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 lau4 haa2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sat1 fo2, hou2 coi2 mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天楼下的餐厅失火了，幸好没有人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The restaurant downstairs caught fire yesterday, luckily no one was injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你聞唔聞到有啲嘢燒燶咗嘅味？好似就嚟失火噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 man4 m4 man4 dou3 jau5 di1 je5 siu1 nung6 zo2 ge3 mei6? hou2 ci5 zau6 lai4 sat1 fo2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你闻没闻到有什么东西烧焦的味道？好像快要失火了。
examples.english_sentence: Can you smell something burning? It seems like a fire is about to break out.

english_meaning: out of focus; unfocused
explanation_mandarin: 指影像模糊不清，焦点没有对准。
explanation_english: Refers to an image being blurry or unfocused, meaning the focal point is not sharp.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲相影到失晒焦，睇唔清楚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 soeng2 ying2 dou3 sat1 saai3 ziu1, tai2 m4 ching1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 照片拍得失焦了，看不清楚。
examples.english_sentence: The photos are all out of focus, I can't see them clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好似失咗焦噉，成日唔知自己做緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 chi5 sat1 zo2 ziu1 gam2, seng4 jat6 m4 ji1 zi6 gei2 zou6 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天好像失焦了一样，总是不知道自己在做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He seems out of focus today, always unaware of what he's doing.

english_meaning: lost property; lost item
explanation_mandarin: 丢失的物品。
explanation_english: Items that have been lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺巴士上面唔見咗銀包，唔知失物認領處有冇人交返。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 baa1 si2 soeng6 min6 m4 gin3 zo2 ngan4 baau1, m4 zi1 sat1 mat6 jing6 ling5 cyu3 jau5 mou5 jan4 gaau1 faan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在巴士上丢了钱包，不知道失物招领处有没有人交还。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my wallet on the bus. I wonder if anyone has turned it in at the lost and found.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 失物招領處通常會有好多無人認領嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sat1 mat6 ziu1 ling5 cyu3 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 hou2 do1 mou4 jan4 jing6 ling5 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 失物招领处通常有很多无人认领的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Lost and found offices usually have a lot of unclaimed items.

english_meaning: to concede a goal (in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指在足球、篮球等比赛中，己方被对方攻入一球，导致比分落后。
explanation_english: Refers to conceding a goal in a sports game like football or basketball, resulting in the team falling behind in the score.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先場波我哋失咗兩球，輸咗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 cheung4 bo1 ngo5 dei6 sat1 zo2 loeng5 kau4, syu1 zo2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那场比赛我们失了两个球，输了。
examples.english_sentence: We conceded two goals in the game just now, so we lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋唔想輸波，就要避免失球。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 m4 seung2 syu1 bo1, jau6 jiu3 bei6 min5 sat1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们不想输球，就要避免丢球。
examples.english_sentence: If we don't want to lose the game, we need to avoid conceding goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋失咗一球之後，士氣就低落咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sat1 zo2 jat1 kau4 zi1 hau6, si6 hei3 zau6 dai1 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们失了一球之后，士气就低落了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After they conceded a goal, their morale dropped a lot.

english_meaning: inappropriate, improper, unsuitable, mismanagement
explanation_mandarin: 指行为、言语或处理方式不合适、不恰当。
explanation_english: Refers to actions, speech, or handling that is inappropriate, improper, or unsuitable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢處理呢件事嘅手法好失當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cyu5 lei5 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 sau2 faat3 hou2 sat1 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他处理这件事的方法非常不当。
examples.english_sentence: The way he handled this matter was very inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我認為呢個判決有啲失當。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jing6 wai4 ni1 go3 pun3 gyut3 jau5 di1 sat1 dong3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认为这个判决有些不当。
examples.english_sentence: I think this verdict is a bit inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅言論好失當，應該道歉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jin4 leon6 hou2 sat1 dong3, ying1 goi1 dou6 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的言论非常不当，应该道歉。
examples.english_sentence: His remarks were very inappropriate and he should apologize.

english_meaning: Distortion, to lose fidelity, inaccurate (representation)
explanation_mandarin: 指信息在传输或表达过程中发生偏差，导致与原始状态不符。形容不真实，失去原本的特性。
explanation_english: Refers to the deviation of information during transmission or expression, resulting in a state that is inconsistent with the original. Describes something as being untrue or losing its original characteristics, especially in the context of audio, video, or news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲相機影出嚟嘅顏色失咗眞，唔夠真實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 soeng3 gei1 ying2 ceot1 lai4 ge3 ngaan4 sik1 sat1 zo2 zan1, m4 gau3 zan1 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这相机拍出来的颜色失真了，不够真实。
examples.english_sentence: The colors captured by this camera are distorted; they aren't realistic enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢失咗眞，同事實唔符。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gong2 ge3 je5 sat1 zo2 zan1, tung4 si6 sat6 m4 fu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说的话失真了，和事实不符。
examples.english_sentence: What you're saying is distorted and doesn't match the facts.

english_meaning: to distort; distortion; to lose fidelity; unfaithful reproduction
explanation_mandarin: 指失去原来的真实性或准确性，扭曲事实或信息的真实面貌。
explanation_english: Refers to losing the original authenticity or accuracy; to distort the true appearance of facts or information. It can also refer to loss of fidelity in audio or visual reproduction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部錄音機嘅音質好差，播啲歌失晒真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 luk6 yam1 gei1 ge3 yam1 zat1 hou2 caa1, bo3 di1 go1 sat1晒 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台录音机的音质很差，播放歌曲都失真了。
examples.english_sentence: The sound quality of this recorder is very poor, the songs are all distorted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲新聞報道失晒真，根本唔可以信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 san1 man4 bou3 dou6 sat1晒 zan1, gan1 bun2 m4 ho2 ji5 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些新闻报道都失真了，根本不可以相信。
examples.english_sentence: Those news reports are all distorted, you can't trust them at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過咁多次嘅轉述，個故仔都失晒真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 gam3 do1 ci3 ge3 zyun2 seot6, go3 gu3 zai2 dou1 sat1晒 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过这么多次的转述，这个故事都失真了。
examples.english_sentence: After so many retellings, the story has become distorted.

english_meaning: insomnia, sleeplessness
explanation_mandarin: 指无法入睡或保持睡眠的状态。
explanation_english: The condition of being unable to fall asleep or stay asleep.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都失眠，好辛苦呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 dou1 sat1 min4, hou2 san1 fu2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我经常失眠，很辛苦啊。
examples.english_sentence: I often suffer from insomnia, it's so tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壓力太大會導致失眠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aat3 lik6 taai3 daai6 wui5 dou2 zi3 sat1 min4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 压力太大可能会导致失眠。
examples.english_sentence: Too much stress can lead to insomnia.

english_meaning: absent-minded, distracted, to be lost in thought, to be in a daze
explanation_mandarin: 指精神恍惚，注意力不集中，像失去了神志一样。
explanation_english: Refers to a state of mental distraction, absent-mindedness, or being lost in thought. It implies a lack of focus or awareness of one's surroundings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢聽到個消息之後，成個人失晒神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ting1 dou2 go3 siu1息 zi1 hau6, seng4 go3 jan4 sat1晒 san4.

english_meaning: to burst out laughing, to chuckle, to can't help but laugh

english_meaning: to break an appointment, to fail to keep an appointment, to stand someone up

examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, I broke our appointment yesterday because something urgent came up.

examples.english_sentence: If you have to break our appointment, remember to let me know earlier.

mandarin_meaning: 失而复得 (shī ér fù dé)

explanation_mandarin: 指无意中说出不该说的话，说错话。
explanation_english: Refers to unintentionally saying something that shouldn't be said; to make a slip of the tongue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我頭先失言，唔好意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 sin1 sat1 jin4, m4 hou2 ji3 si1.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日失言，所以啲人唔太信佢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常失言，所以人们不太相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He often says the wrong thing, so people don't really trust him.

english_meaning: mistake, error, fault, slip-up
explanation_mandarin: 指因疏忽或判断错误而造成的差错或失败。
explanation_english: Refers to an error or failure caused by negligence or misjudgment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試都有啲失誤，所以考得唔係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 dou1 jau5 di1 sat1 ng6, so2 ji5 haau2 dak1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试有一些失误，所以考得不是很好。
examples.english_sentence: He had some mistakes in this exam, so he didn't do very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為佢嘅失誤，搞到成個計劃都亂晒。

examples.english_sentence: Because of his mistake, the whole plan was messed up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要避免失誤，確保工程可以順利完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bei6 min5 sat1 ng6, kok3 bou2 gung1 cing4 ho2 ji5 seon6 lei6 waan4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要避免失误，确保工程可以顺利完成。
examples.english_sentence: We need to avoid mistakes to ensure the project can be completed smoothly.

english_meaning: imbalance, out of order, malfunction, derangement
explanation_mandarin: 指失去正常的调节或平衡状态。可以是生理上的，也可以是机器、系统等功能出现紊乱。
explanation_english: Refers to losing a normal state of regulation or balance. It can be physiological, or it can refer to malfunctions in machines, systems, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢內分泌失調，成日生暗瘡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 noi6 fan1 bei3 sat1 tiu4, seng4 jat6 saang1 am3 cong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她内分泌失调，总是长痘痘。
examples.english_sentence: Her endocrine system is out of balance, and she always gets acne.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣機失調，唔夠凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 sat1 tiu4, m4 gau3 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台空调失调了，不够冷。
examples.english_sentence: The air conditioner is malfunctioning and not cold enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 近年嚟氣候失調，好多地方都出現極端天氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gan1 nin4 lai4 hei3 hau6 sat1 tiu4, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 cheot1 hin3 gik1 dyun1 tin1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 近年来气候失调，很多地方都出现极端天气。
examples.english_sentence: In recent years, the climate has been imbalanced, and extreme weather has appeared in many places.

english_meaning: To miss (an opportunity) by a hair's breadth; to just miss an opportunity that was within one's reach.
explanation_mandarin: 指机会就在眼前，却因为疏忽或种种原因而错过，未能抓住。
explanation_english: Refers to missing an opportunity that was right in front of you, due to negligence or other reasons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日去咗演唱會門口排隊，點知最後都係失諸交臂，買唔到飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 jin2 coeng3 wui2 mun4 hau2 paai4 deoi2, dim2 zi1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 zyu1 gaau1 bei3, maai5 m4 dou2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天去演唱会门口排队了，结果最后还是失之交臂，没买到票。
examples.english_sentence: I queued up at the concert venue yesterday, but in the end, I just missed out and couldn't buy a ticket.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢差少少就攞到獎學金，可惜最後都係失諸交臂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caa1 siu2 siu2 zau6 lo2 dou2 zo2 zoeng2 hok6 gam1, ho2 sik1 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 sat1 zyu1 gaau1 bei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他差一点就拿到奖学金，可惜最后还是失之交臂。
examples.english_sentence: He was so close to getting the scholarship, but unfortunately, he just missed out in the end.

synonyms: 擦肩而過 (caat3 gin1 ji4 gwo3)

english_meaning: to lose face, to be embarrassed, to make a fool of oneself
explanation_mandarin: 表示丟臉，在公眾場合做了讓人感到尷尬或者滑稽的事情，導致失去面子。
explanation_english: To lose face, to be embarrassed, or to make a fool of oneself in public, resulting in a loss of reputation or dignity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先喺台上唱歌走晒音，真係失晒豬。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才在台上唱歌完全走音了，真是丢脸死了。
examples.english_sentence: Singing off-key on stage just now was so embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺婚禮上面飲醉酒大吵大鬧，失晒豬啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan1 lai5 soeng6 min6 jam2 zeoi3 zau2 daai6 caau2 daai6 naau6, sat1 saai3 zyu1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在婚礼上喝醉酒又吵又闹，丢尽了脸面。
examples.english_sentence: He got drunk and made a scene at the wedding, losing all face.

english_meaning: to lose one's footing; to slip; to fall; to go astray; to take a wrong step; to fall from grace; to fall into prostitution (euphemism)
explanation_mandarin: 本义指脚下不稳，跌倒。引申指犯错误，走上邪路。有时也用作委婉语，指女性从事性交易。
explanation_english: Literally, it means to lose one's footing and fall. By extension, it means to make a mistake or go astray. It can also be used as a euphemism for a woman engaging in prostitution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路嗰陣時失足跌咗落樓梯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hang4 lou6 go2 zan6 si4 sat1 zuk1 dit3 zo2 lok6 lau4 tai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走路的时候失足从楼梯上摔下来了。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his footing and fell down the stairs while walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一時貪心，失足犯咗法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 si4 taam1 sam1, sat1 zuk1 faan6 zo2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一时贪心，失足犯了法。
examples.english_sentence: He committed a crime out of greed, taking a wrong step.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好因為一時嘅挫折就失足呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jan1 wai4 jat1 si4 ge3 co3 zit3 zau6 sat1 zuk1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要因为一时的挫折就堕落啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't fall from grace because of temporary setbacks.

english_meaning: missing, disappeared
explanation_mandarin: 指人或物丢失，不知去向。
explanation_english: To go missing; to disappear; to be unaccounted for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔失踪咗成個禮拜啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 sat1 zung1 zo2 seng4 go3 lai5 bai1 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: His son has been missing for a whole week.

examples.english_sentence: The police are still investigating the missing persons case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰架飛機失踪咗，大家都好擔心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaa3 fei1 gei1 sat1 zung1 zo2, daai6 gaa1 dou1 hou2 daam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那架飞机失踪了，大家都非常担心。
examples.english_sentence: The plane went missing, everyone is very worried.

english_meaning: to stumble; to trip; to make a mistake; to slip up
explanation_mandarin: 本意指马等动物行走时跌倒。引申指人犯错误，栽跟头。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a horse or other animal stumbling or falling.  By extension, it refers to a person making a mistake or failing.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gin6 si6 soeng6 min6 sat1 zo2 tai4, gaau2 dou3 seng4 pun4 gai3 waak6 dou1 lyun6 saai3 lung1.

examples.jyutping_sentence: cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 jat1 si4 sat1 tai4, gam2 do1 nin4 ge3 nou5 lik6 zau6 baak6 fai3 gaa3 laa1.

examples.english_sentence: Don't stumble for a moment, all these years of effort will be wasted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁醒目都失蹄，真係估佢唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 sing2 muk6 dou1 sat1 tai4, zan1 hai6 gu2 keoi5 m4 dou3.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 飞机失踪事件引起全球关注。
examples.english_sentence: The plane disappearance incident attracted global attention.

explanation_mandarin: 指女性失去贞操，失去童贞。

examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economy seems to be losing momentum, there's not much growth.

english_meaning: unlucky; out of luck; to have bad luck

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近真係失運，做咩都唔順利。

examples.english_sentence: He has been out of luck for a long time, hopefully he will recover soon.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fui1 sam1, jat1 si4 sat1 wan6 ze1.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 zung6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近减了很多重量啊！
examples.english_sentence: I've lost a lot of weight recently!

english_meaning: Excuse me; I must leave you now; excuse my absence
explanation_mandarin: 客气话，表示因故要离开，向在场的人告辞。
explanation_english: A polite expression used when excusing oneself to leave a gathering or conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，失陪一陣，我去個洗手間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1, sat1 pui4 jat1 zan6, ngo5 heoi3 go3 sai2 sau2 gaan1.

examples.english_sentence: I must excuse myself then, I still have some things to do.

english_meaning: to fall (to enemy forces); to be captured; to be lost (territory)
explanation_mandarin: 指领土、阵地等被敌方攻占，失去控制。
explanation_english: Refers to territory, fortifications, etc., being captured by the enemy and losing control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個城市失陷咗之後，好多難民都走晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 sing4 si5 sat1 haam6 zo2 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 naan6 man4 dou1 zau2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个城市失守之后，很多难民都走了。
examples.english_sentence: After that city fell, many refugees fled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋防守唔住，成個防線就會失陷㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 fong4 sau2 m4 zyu6, seng4 go3 fong4 sin3 zau6 wui5 sat1 haam6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我们防守不住，整个防线就会失守的。
examples.english_sentence: If we can't defend, the entire defensive line will fall.

mandarin_meaning: 精神恍惚; 精神不集中
english_meaning: Absent-minded; distracted; inattentive; scatterbrained
explanation_mandarin: 形容人精神不集中，常常忘记事情，或者反应迟钝。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is absent-minded, often forgetting things, or slow to react. It suggests a lack of focus and a general air of confusion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢排成日失雞無神咁，係咪有咩心事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 sat1 gai1 mou4 san4 gam2, hai6 mai1 jau5 me1 sam1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近老是心不在焉的，是不是有什么心事啊？
examples.english_sentence: You've been so absent-minded lately, is something bothering you?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失雞無神咁樣，成日唔記得帶鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 gai1 mou4 san4 gam2 joeng2, seng4 jat6 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是精神恍惚，经常忘记带钥匙。
examples.english_sentence: He's so scatterbrained, he often forgets to bring his keys.

english_meaning: to malfunction; to fail to work; out of order
explanation_mandarin: 指机器或设备失去正常功能，无法正常运作。
explanation_english: Refers to a machine or device losing its normal function and being unable to operate properly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部冷氣機失靈咗，搞到成間房好熱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 sat1 ling4 zo2, gaau2 dou3 seng4 gaan1 fong2 hou2 jit6.

examples.english_sentence: The air conditioner malfunctioned, making the whole room very hot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車嘅制動系統失靈，好彩冇人受傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 ge3 zai3 dung6 hai6 tung2 sat1 ling4, hou2 coi2 mou5 jan4 sau6 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 车的制动系统失灵了，幸好没人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The car's braking system failed, luckily no one was injured.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對手好似失靈咁，郁都郁唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 sau2 hou2 ci5 sat1 ling4 gam2, juk1 dou1 juk1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的手好像失灵了一样，动都动不了。
examples.english_sentence: His hand seems to be malfunctioning, he can't move it at all.

english_meaning: to leak information; to give something away; to let the cat out of the bag; to blow one's cover
explanation_mandarin: 指泄露消息，原本不应该被知道的事情被公开了。
explanation_english: Refers to the leakage of information; when something that should not have been known is revealed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事原本想俾個surprise佢，點知俾你失風，搞到冇晒驚喜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 jyun4 bun2 soeng2 bei2 go3 seot1 paai1 si1 keoi5, dim2 zi1 bei2 nei5 sat1 fung1, gaau2 dou3 mou5 saai3 ging1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事原本想给他一个惊喜，结果被你泄露了消息，搞得一点惊喜都没有了。
examples.english_sentence: I originally wanted to surprise him, but you leaked the information, and now there's no surprise at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅計劃千祈唔好失風呀，如果唔係就前功盡廢㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gai3 waak6 cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 sat1 fung1 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 cin4 gung1 zeon6 fai3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的计划千万不要泄露出去呀，不然就前功尽弃了。
examples.english_sentence: Our plan must not be leaked, otherwise all our previous efforts will be wasted.

english_meaning: Suddenly, unexpectedly, out of the blue; without warning
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发生得突然，毫无预兆。
