examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅衣著品味真係好奇特，成日著啲人哋唔會著嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yi1 zoek3 ban2 mei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 kei4 dak6, seng4 jat6 zoek3 di1 jan4 dei6 m4 wui5 zoek3 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的穿着品味真的很奇特，经常穿一些别人不会穿的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: His fashion sense is really peculiar; he always wears clothes that other people wouldn't wear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修好奇特，啲枱凳都係用回收物料整嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 kei4 dak6, di1 toi2 dang3 dou1 hai6 yung6 wui4 sau1 mat6 liu2 zeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修很奇特，桌椅都是用回收材料做的。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is very peculiar; the tables and chairs are all made from recycled materials.

mandarin_meaning: 稀世珍宝, 珍稀宝物
english_meaning: rare treasures, exotic gems, precious and rare objects
explanation_mandarin: 罕见而珍贵的宝物。
explanation_english: Rare and precious treasures, things of extraordinary value and beauty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間博物館收藏咗好多奇珍異寶，真係大開眼界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 bok3 mat6 gun2 sau1 cong4 zo2 hou2 do1 kei4 zan1 ji6 bou2, zan1 hai6 daai6 hoi1 ngaan5 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家博物馆收藏了很多奇珍异宝，真是大开眼界。
examples.english_sentence: This museum has a lot of rare treasures; it's truly an eye-opener.

english_meaning: strange; peculiar; weird; exotic; fantastic
explanation_mandarin: 不寻常的，奇怪的，独特的。
explanation_english: Unusual, strange, peculiar, or unique. Often implying something interesting or intriguing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法好奇異，冇人明佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nam2 faat3 hou2 kei4 ji6, mou5 jan4 ming4 keoi5 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法很奇异，没人明白他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are very strange; no one understands what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方嘅風景好奇異，好似去咗另一個世界咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 ge3 fung1 ging2 hou2 kei4 ji6, hou2 ci5 heoi3 zo2 ling6 jat1 go3 sai3 gaai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方的风景很奇异，好像去了另一个世界一样。
examples.english_sentence: The scenery in this place is very exotic; it's like going to another world.

english_meaning: kiwi fruit
explanation_mandarin: 一种水果，果肉通常是绿色或金黄色，味道酸甜。
explanation_english: A fruit with a brown, fuzzy skin and green or golden flesh, known for its sweet-tart taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食奇異果，酸酸甜甜好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 kei4 ji6 gwo2, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4 hou2 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃奇异果，酸酸甜甜的很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat kiwi fruit, it's sweet and sour and very appetizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲奇異果幾靚喎，買啲返屋企食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 kei4 ji6 gwo2 gei2 leng3 wo3, maai5 di1 faan1 uk1 kei2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的奇异果看起来很漂亮，买一些回家吃。
examples.english_sentence: The kiwi fruits look nice today, let's buy some to take home and eat.

english_meaning: kiwi (bird)
explanation_mandarin: 指新西兰特有的不会飞的鸟，即几维鸟。
explanation_english: Refers to the kiwi, a flightless bird native to New Zealand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去動物園睇奇異鳥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 dung6 mat6 jyun2 tai2 kei4 ji6 niu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去动物园看奇异鸟。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to the zoo to see kiwis.

english_meaning: exotic flowers and rare herbs; rare and unusual plants; something rare and wonderful
explanation_mandarin: 罕见而奇异的花草。也用来比喻珍贵或罕见的事物。
explanation_english: Rare and unusual flowers and herbs. Figuratively used to describe something precious or rare.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花園入邊種滿咗奇花異草，真係好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 jyun4 jap6 bin1 zung2 mun5 zo2 kei4 faa1 ji6 cou2, zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花园里种满了奇花异草，真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: This garden is full of exotic flowers and rare herbs, it's really beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收藏咗好多奇花異草，好多我都未見過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 cong4 zo2 hou2 do1 kei4 faa1 ji6 cou2, hou2 do1 ngo5 dou1 mei6 gin3 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他收藏了很多奇花异草，很多我都没见过。
examples.english_sentence: He collected a lot of exotic flowers and rare herbs, many of which I have never seen before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲諗頭真係奇花異草，次次都咁出人意表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 nam2 tau2 zan1 hai6 kei4 faa1 ji6 cou2, ci3 ci3 dou1 gam3 ceot1 jan4 ji3 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法真是奇花异草，每次都那么出人意料。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are really like rare and unusual plants, always so unexpected.

english_meaning: weirdo, oddball, eccentric, strange flower, bizarre person or thing
explanation_mandarin: 指非常奇怪、与众不同的人或事物，多含贬义，有时也带调侃意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a very strange, unconventional, and often bizarre person or thing. It often carries a negative connotation, but sometimes it is used in a joking or teasing way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人真係好奇葩，成日做啲人哋諗都諗唔到嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 kei4 paa1, seng4 jat6 zou6 di1 jan4 dei6 lam2 dou1 lam2 m4 dou2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是个奇葩，总是做一些别人想不到的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a weirdo; he always does things that no one would ever think of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好騎呢，啲配搭真係奇葩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 ki4 le1, di1 pui3 daap3 zan1 hai6 kei4 paa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜很奇怪，那些搭配真是奇葩。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is very strange; the combinations are really bizarre.

english_meaning: bizarre attire; outlandish clothes; eccentric dress
explanation_mandarin: 指奇异古怪的服装。
explanation_english: Refers to clothing that is strange, peculiar, or unconventional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到奇裝異服咁，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 kei4 zong1 ji6 fuk6 gam2, m4 zi1 dou3 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得奇装异服的，不知道要做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's dressed in such bizarre attire today, I wonder what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個表演者著住奇裝異服上台。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 biu2 jin2 ze2 zoek3 zyu6 kei4 zong1 ji6 fuk6 soeng5 toi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个表演者穿着奇装异服上台。
examples.english_sentence: That performer went on stage wearing bizarre attire.

english_meaning: spectacle; wonder; amazing sight
explanation_mandarin: 罕见的、壮丽的景象或事物。
explanation_english: A rare and magnificent scene or thing; a spectacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 日出嘅時候，雲海真係一個奇觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat6 ceot1 ge3 si4 hau6, wan4 hoi2 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 kei4 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 日出的时候，云海真是一个奇观。
examples.english_sentence: At sunrise, the sea of clouds is truly a spectacle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著到咁騎呢，簡直係一個奇觀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 gam3 ki4 le1, gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 go3 kei4 gun1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿得那么奇怪，简直是一个奇观！
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so weirdly, it's a real spectacle!

english_meaning: to hoard rare goods in order to sell them at a high price; to speculate; to corner the market; to play the waiting game for better returns
explanation_mandarin: 指把稀少的货物储藏起来，等待高价出售。比喻利用某种专长或有用的东西以谋取私利。
explanation_english: Refers to hoarding rare goods and waiting for a high price to sell them. It is a metaphor for using a special skill or useful thing to seek personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見啲口罩咁搶手，就諗住奇貨可居，入咗好多貨返嚟等升價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 di1 haau2 zaau3 gam3 coeng2 sau2, zau6 nam2 zyu6 kei4 fo3 ho2 geoi1, jap6 zo2 hou2 do1 fo3 faan1 lai4 dang2 sing1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到口罩这么抢手，就想着囤积居奇，进了很多货回来等涨价。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing that face masks were in such high demand, he thought of hoarding them to sell them at a high price, so he bought a lot to wait for the price to increase.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲限量版嘅嘢，好多人都想奇貨可居，希望第日可以賣個好價錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 haan6 loeng6 baan2 ge3 je5, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 soeng2 kei4 fo3 ho2 geoi1, hei1 mong6 dai6 jat6 ho2 ji5 maai6 go3 hou2 gaa3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些限量版的东西，很多人都想囤积居奇，希望以后可以卖个好价钱。
examples.english_sentence: Many people want to hoard these limited edition items, hoping to sell them for a good price in the future.

english_meaning: Quirky and fun; strangely interesting; whimsical
explanation_mandarin: 指新奇而有趣。在香港俚语中，常用来形容一些古灵精怪、不寻常但又带点幽默感或吸引力的人、事、物。
explanation_english: Refers to things that are both strange and interesting. In Cantonese slang, it describes something quirky, eccentric, or offbeat that manages to be amusing or charming rather than just scary or weird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭賣啲嘢好奇趣，竟然有部舊式汽水機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 di1 je5 hou2 kei4 ceoi3, ging2 jin4 jau5 bou6 gau6 sik1 hei3 seoi2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店卖的东西挺奇趣的，居然有一台旧式汽水机。
examples.english_sentence: The stuff they sell in this shop is really quirky and cool; they even have an old-fashioned soda machine.

english_meaning: Miracle; wonder; (slang) a statistical anomaly or sarcastic 'achievement'
explanation_mandarin: 指极难发生但竟然发生的事。在俚语中常用于夸张表达，或者反讽那些把事情搞砸到‘前无古人’程度的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a miracle or an event that is highly unlikely to happen. In slang, it is used for hyperbolic emphasis or sarcastically to describe someone who has achieved a level of failure or absurdity that seems 'miraculous.'

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份功課可以錯到一個字都唔啱，都算係一種奇跡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 fo3 ho2 ji5 co3 dou3 jat1 go3 zi6 dou1 m4 ngaam1, dou1 syun3 hai6 jat1 zung2 kei4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的功课竟然能错到一个字都不对，也算是一种奇迹。
examples.english_sentence: He managed to get every single word of his homework wrong; it's honestly a bit of a miracle.

english_meaning: miracle
explanation_mandarin: 不寻常的、超出自然规律或科学理解范围的事件或成就。
explanation_english: An extraordinary and welcome event that is not explicable by natural or scientific laws and is therefore attributed to a divine agency.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾醫生話冇得醫㗎啦，但係佢竟然好返晒，真係一個奇蹟！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 yi1 sang1 waa6 mou5 dak1 yi1 gaa3 laa1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 ging2 jin4 hou2 faan1晒, zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 kei4 jik1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说他没得救了，但他竟然完全康复了，真是一个奇迹！
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said he was incurable, but he actually recovered completely, it's truly a miracle!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港經濟嘅快速發展，可以話係一個奇蹟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ging1 gai3 ge3 faai3 suk1 faat3 zin2, ho2 ji5 waa6 hai6 jat1 go3 kei4 jik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港经济的快速发展，可以说是一个奇迹。
examples.english_sentence: The rapid development of Hong Kong's economy can be said to be a miracle.

english_meaning: adventure; fortunate encounter; serendipitous experience
explanation_mandarin: 不平凡的经历或遭遇，多指幸运或出人意料的经历。
explanation_english: An unusual or remarkable experience, often fortunate or unexpected; a serendipitous encounter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺旅行嘅時候有個奇遇，識咗個好重要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 leoi5 hang4 ge3 si4 hau6 jau5 go3 kei4 jyu6, sik1 zo2 go3 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在旅行的时候有一个奇遇，认识了一个很重要的人。
examples.english_sentence: He had an adventure while travelling and met a very important person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個故仔講述一個小朋友嘅奇遇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gu3 zai2 gong2 syut6 jat1 go3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 kei4 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个故事讲述一个小朋友的奇遇。
examples.english_sentence: This story tells the tale of a child's adventure.

english_meaning: Qimen Dunjia; Mystical Doors Escaping Technique; A form of Chinese divination
explanation_mandarin: 奇门遁甲是中国古代术数著作，也是一种较为复杂的占卜方法，被誉为“帝王之学”。它利用洛书九宫，将天干、地支、八卦等信息结合起来，推算人事吉凶。
explanation_english: Qimen Dunjia is an ancient Chinese divination system, considered a complex and sophisticated form of prognostication. Literally translated as 'Mystical Doors Escaping Technique', it utilizes the Lo Shu Square, incorporating the Ten Heavenly Stems, Twelve Earthly Branches, Eight Trigrams, and other elements to predict auspiciousness or inauspiciousness in human affairs. Often associated with military strategy and fortune-telling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢識得用奇門遁甲嚟預測股票走勢，唔知堅唔堅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 sik1 dak1 yung6 kei4 mun4 deon6 gaap3 lai4 jyu6 cak1 gu2 piu3 zau2 sai3, m4 zi1 gin1 m4 gin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他会用奇门遁甲来预测股票走势，不知道真不真。
examples.english_sentence: I heard he knows how to use Qimen Dunjia to predict stock market trends. I wonder if it's true or not.

mandarin_meaning: 奇怪; 古怪; 离奇
english_meaning: strange; weird; bizarre; odd; uncanny; peculiar
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或人的行为、性格、外貌等不寻常，令人感到奇怪或无法理解。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone's behavior, personality, appearance, etc., that is unusual and makes people feel strange or incomprehensible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日嘅行為好奇離呀，唔知發生咩事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 ge3 hang4 wai4 hou2 kei4 lei4 aa3, m4 zi1 dou3 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天的行为很奇怪，不知道发生了什么事。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior today is very strange, I wonder what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情好奇離，睇到我一頭霧水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 ching4 hou2 kei4 lei4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 jat1 tau4 mou6 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情很离奇，看得我一头雾水。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is very bizarre, I'm totally confused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋裝修到奇離古怪，完全唔襯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 zong1 sau1 dou3 kei4 lei4 gu2 gwaai3, wun4 cyun4 m4 can3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋装修得很奇怪古怪，完全不搭配。
examples.english_sentence: The house is decorated in a strange and peculiar way, it doesn't match at all.

english_meaning: weird place; strange location; odd spot
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个地方很奇怪，不同寻常，让人觉得不舒服或者难以理解。
explanation_english: Describes a place that is weird, unusual, uncomfortable, or difficult to understand. It can refer to a physical location that is strange or an abstract situation that feels off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲裝修真係好奇離位，唔知想點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 zong1 sau1 zan1 hai6 hou2 kei4 lei4 wai2, m4 zi1 soeng2 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修真是很古怪，不知道想表达什么。
examples.english_sentence: The decor of this restaurant is really weird, I don't know what they're trying to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好坐喺度，呢個位好奇離位㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 co5 hai2 ni1 dou6, ni1 go3 wai2 hou2 kei4 lei4 wai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要坐在这里，这个位置很奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: Don't sit here, this spot is weird.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間房啲嘢擺到好奇離位，完全唔似人住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 di1 je5 baai2 dou3 hou2 kei4 lei4 wai2, jyun4 cyun4 m4 ci5 jan4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房间的东西摆放得非常古怪，完全不像人住的。
examples.english_sentence: The things in his room are arranged in a very weird way, it doesn't look like someone lives there.

mandarin_meaning: 古怪, 奇怪, 稀奇古怪
english_meaning: weird, strange, odd, bizarre, peculiar
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或行为非常奇怪，不寻常，不同于一般的认知或经验。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being very strange, odd, bizarre, or peculiar, deviating from what is considered normal or typical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲行為真係奇離怪，成日唔知佢諗乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 kei4 lei4 gwaai3, seng4 jat6 m4 zi1 keoi5 nam2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的行为真的很古怪，总是不知道他在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: His behavior is really weird; I never know what he's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修奇離怪怪咁，不過啲嘢食幾好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 kei4 lei4 gwaai3 gwaai3 gam2, bat1 gwo3 di1 je5 sik6 gei2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的装修稀奇古怪的，不过食物味道还不错。
examples.english_sentence: The decoration of this restaurant is quite bizarre, but the food is pretty delicious.

english_meaning: difficult and complicated cases; a variety of difficult and complicated problems
explanation_mandarin: 指各种各样棘手、难以解决的问题或疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to a variety of difficult and complicated problems or illnesses that are hard to solve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司有好多奇難雜症要處理，搞到我好頭痛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 kei4 naan4 zaap6 zing3 jiu3 cyu2 lei5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 hou2 tau4 tung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司有很多疑难杂症要处理，搞得我很头疼。
examples.english_sentence: The company has a lot of difficult and complicated problems to deal with, which gives me a headache.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個醫生專門醫啲奇難雜症，好多人都搵佢睇病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji1 sang1 zyun1 mun4 ji1 di1 kei4 naan4 zaap6 zing3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wan2 keoi5 tai2 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个医生专门医治疑难杂症，很多人都找他看病。
examples.english_sentence: This doctor specializes in treating difficult and complicated illnesses, and many people seek his medical advice.

synonyms: 棘手問題 (gik1 sau2 man6 tai4)

english_meaning: how; what to do; what can one do; to do
explanation_mandarin: 表示没有办法，或询问如何处理。相当于“何”、“怎样”。
explanation_english: Indicates helplessness or asks how to deal with something. Equivalent to "how" or "what to do". It's often used in expressions of frustration or resignation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你話我應該點奈呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ngo5 ying1 goi1 dim2 naai6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你说我应该怎么办呢？
examples.english_sentence: What do you think I should do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁你又想點奈？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 nei5 jau6 soeng2 dim2 naai6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那你又想怎样？
examples.english_sentence: So what do you want to do about it?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都唔知點奈佢好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 naai6 keoi5 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 真不知道该怎么处理他才好。
examples.english_sentence: I really don't know what to do with him.

mandarin_meaning: 拿...怎么办？/ 对...又能怎么样？
english_meaning: What can one do to...? / What can one do about...?
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事无能为力或无可奈何。中间可以插入需要面对的人或事。
explanation_english: Indicates a feeling of helplessness or resignation in the face of something. The middle part (...) is filled with the person or thing that one is facing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔聽話，奈佢乜何？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 ting1 waa6, naai5 keoi5 mat1 ho4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不听话，拿他怎么办？
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen, what can I do with him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆決定咗，奈佢哋嘅決定乜何？
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 kyut3 ding6 zo2, naai5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 kyut3 ding6 mat1 ho4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板已经决定了，对他们的决定又能怎么样呢？
examples.english_sentence: The boss has already decided, what can we do about their decision?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞得咁犀利，奈架車乜何？
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dak1 gam3 sai1 lei6, naai5 gaa3 ce1 mat1 ho4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵得这么厉害，对这辆车又能怎么样呢？
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is so terrible, what can we do about the car?

mandarin_meaning: 拿...怎么样？/又能把我怎么样？
english_meaning: What can ... do to me?/How can ... affect me?
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况不以为然，带有挑衅或轻蔑的语气。中间可以填入人或事。
explanation_english: Expresses indifference or defiance towards a situation, often with a provocative or contemptuous tone. The middle part can be filled with a person or thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你奈我乜何啫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 naai6 ngo5 mat1 ho4 ze1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能把我怎么样呢？
examples.english_sentence: What can you do to me?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯做嘢，老細奈佢乜何？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 zou6 je5, lou5 sai3 naai6 keoi5 mat1 ho4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不肯工作，老板能把他怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: He refuses to work, what can the boss do to him?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔鐘意咪唔好睇囉，奈我乜何？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 zung1 ji3 mai1 m4 hou2 tai2 lo1, naai6 ngo5 mat1 ho4?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不喜欢就别看呗，又能把我怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: If you don't like it, then don't watch it, how does that affect me?

mandarin_meaning: 拿...没办法 / 对...无可奈何
english_meaning: to be unable to do anything about.../ to be at a loss what to do about...
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人或某事感到无能为力，束手无策。
explanation_english: Expressing a feeling of helplessness or being unable to do anything to change a situation or affect someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，我都奈佢唔何。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, ngo5 dou1 naai6 keoi5 m4 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么坏，我也拿他没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He's so bad; there's nothing I can do about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個問題咁難，我都奈佢唔何呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 man6 tai4 gam3 naan4, ngo5 dou1 naai6 keoi5 m4 ho4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个问题这么难，我也无计可施啊。
examples.english_sentence: This problem is so difficult; I'm at a loss what to do about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 塞車塞到咁犀利，我都奈佢唔何。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 gam3 sai1 lei6, ngo5 dou1 naai6 keoi5 m4 ho4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 堵车堵得这么厉害，我也没办法。
examples.english_sentence: The traffic jam is so terrible, there's nothing I can do about it.

synonyms: 無計可施 (mou4 gai3 ho2 si1)

english_meaning: What to do?, How to deal with it?, Helpless
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某种情况无能为力，无可奈何；或者询问如何处理某件事。
explanation_english: Expresses helplessness or inability to do anything about a situation; or asks how to deal with something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都唔聽我講，我奈何佢唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 m4 teng1 ngo5 gong2, ngo5 noi6 ho4 keoi5 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他都不听我的话，我也拿他没办法。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't listen to me, there's nothing I can do about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 事已至此，奈何呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: si6 ji5 zi3 ci2, noi6 ho4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情已经到了这个地步，怎么办呢？
examples.english_sentence: The matter has come to this, what to do?

english_meaning: Bridge of Helplessness (in the afterlife)
explanation_mandarin: 在传统中国文化中，奈何桥是连接阳间和阴间的一座桥，位于阴间地府。传说人死后，会经过此桥，喝下孟婆汤，忘却前尘往事，才能投胎转世。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese culture, the Bridge of Helplessness is a bridge connecting the world of the living and the underworld. It is located in the underworld. Legend says that after death, people must cross this bridge and drink Meng Po's soup (Soup of Oblivion) to forget their past lives before reincarnation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話想去奈何橋行下，飲埋孟婆湯，乜都唔記得晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 soeng2 heoi3 naai6 ho4 kiu4 haang4 haa5, jam2 maai4 maang6 po4 tong1, mat1 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说想去奈何桥走走，喝了孟婆汤，什么都忘记。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he wants to walk on the Bridge of Helplessness, drink Meng Po's soup, and forget everything.

english_meaning: Bridge of Helplessness (in the afterlife)
explanation_mandarin: 佛教、道教传说中，人死后通往阴间的桥梁。传说桥下是忘川河，过了桥就会忘记前世的一切。
explanation_english: In Buddhist and Taoist legends, the Bridge of Helplessness is a bridge one must cross in the afterlife to reach the underworld. Legend says that below the bridge flows the River of Oblivion, and crossing the bridge causes one to forget everything from their previous life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日都聽人講奈河橋，真係覺得陰森恐怖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 dou1 ting1 jan4 gong2 naai6 ho4 kiu4, zan1 hai6 gok3 dak1 jam1 sam1 hung2 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们总是听人说奈何桥，真的觉得阴森恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: We always hear people talk about the Bridge of Helplessness, it really feels gloomy and terrifying.

english_meaning: nanometer, nanoscale
explanation_mandarin: 指十亿分之一米，即10⁻⁹米。 用于描述非常微小的尺寸或技术。
explanation_english: Refers to one billionth of a meter (10⁻⁹ meters). Used to describe extremely small sizes or technologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲產品用咗奈米技術。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 caan2 ban2 yung6 zo2 naai6 mai5 gei6 seot6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些产品使用了纳米技术。
examples.english_sentence: These products use nanotechnology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 奈米粒子嘅大小係非常之細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: naai6 mai5 lap1 zi2 ge3 daai6 siu2 hai6 fei1 soeng4 zi1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 纳米粒子的大小是非常小的。
examples.english_sentence: The size of nanoparticles is extremely small.

mandarin_meaning: 供奉; 奉献; 接受
english_meaning: to offer; to present; to revere; to receive (respectfully)
explanation_mandarin: 献出；恭敬地接受；供奉。
explanation_english: To offer or present something respectfully; to receive something with respect; to enshrine or worship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都奉神嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 fung6 san4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都供奉神。
examples.english_sentence: He worships the gods every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆好鍾意人奉承佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 hou2 zung1 ji3 jan4 fung6 sing4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板很喜欢别人奉承他。
examples.english_sentence: The boss likes people to flatter him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 茶嚟喇，奉旨飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa4 lai4 laa3, fung6 zi2 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 茶来了，奉旨饮茶（开玩笑，享受一下）。
examples.english_sentence: The tea is here, let's enjoy it (humorously implying we have the authority to enjoy tea).

english_meaning: to offer respectfully; to present as a gift; to dedicate
explanation_mandarin: 恭敬地献上，多用于正式场合或书面语。
explanation_english: To offer or present something respectfully, often used in formal occasions or written language. It implies a level of deference or respect in the act of offering.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司為咗慶祝周年紀念，特別奉上咗一份禮物畀長期服務嘅員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 wai4 zo2 hing3 zuk1 zau1 nin4 gei2 nim6, dak6 bit6 fung6 soeng5 zo2 jat1 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 coeng4 kei4 fuk6 mou6 ge3 wun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了庆祝周年纪念，我们公司特别为长期服务的员工献上了一份礼物。
examples.english_sentence: To celebrate the anniversary, our company specially offered a gift to the long-serving employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將自己嘅創作奉上俾佢嘅老師，以表謝意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 cong3 zok3 fung6 soeng5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 lou5 si1, ji5 biu2 ze6 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把自己创作的作品献给他的老师，以表达谢意。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his creative work to his teacher to express his gratitude.

english_meaning: law-abiding; abide by the law; observe the law and regulations
explanation_mandarin: 奉行公事，遵守法律规章。
explanation_english: To be law-abiding; to uphold public duties and abide by the law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋做市民，應該奉公守法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zou6 si5 man4, ying1 goi1 fung6 gung1 sau2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们作为市民，应该奉公守法。
examples.english_sentence: As citizens, we should be law-abiding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一向都奉公守法，唔會做犯法嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 fung6 gung1 sau2 faat3, m4 wui5 zou6 faan6 faat3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一向都奉公守法，不会做违法的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He has always been law-abiding and would not do anything illegal.

english_meaning: to advise sincerely; to urge; to caution
explanation_mandarin: 诚恳地劝告。
explanation_english: To sincerely advise or urge someone to do or not do something; to caution someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我奉勸你唔好咁做，真係好危險㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung6 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 zou6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngai4 him2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奉劝你不要这样做，真的很危险。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to do that, it's really dangerous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我奉勸你早啲瞓啦，聽日仲要返工㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung6 hyun3 nei5 zou2 di1 fan3 laa1, ting1 jat6 zung6 jiu3 faan1 gung1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奉劝你早点睡吧，明天还要上班呢。
examples.english_sentence: I urge you to go to bed early, you still have to go to work tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我奉勸你唔好咁天真啦，呢個世界冇咁多免費午餐㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung6 hyun3 nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 tin1 zan1 laa1, ni1 go3 sai3 gaai3 mou5 gam3 do1 min5 fai3 ng5 caan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奉劝你不要那么天真了，这个世界没有那么多免费的午餐。
examples.english_sentence: I advise you not to be so naive, there are no free lunches in this world.

english_meaning: to receive orders; to act under orders; by order
explanation_mandarin: 接受命令，按照命令行事。
explanation_english: To receive orders and act accordingly; carrying out instructions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我奉命嚟幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fung6 ming6 lai4 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奉命来帮助你。
examples.english_sentence: I am here to help you under orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋奉命行事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 fung6 ming6 hang4 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们奉命行事。
examples.english_sentence: We are acting under orders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢奉命去做呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fung6 ming6 heoi3 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他奉命去做这件事。
examples.english_sentence: He was ordered to do this thing.

english_meaning: to act under orders; to carry out instructions
explanation_mandarin: 按照命令去做事。
explanation_english: To act according to orders; to carry out instructions. Indicates that someone is acting on instructions from a superior and has no personal responsibility for the action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我只係奉命行事，你唔好怪我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi2 hai6 fung6 ming6 hang4 si6, nei5 m4 hou2 gwaai3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只是奉命行事，你不要怪我。
examples.english_sentence: I'm just acting under orders, don't blame me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋奉命行事，拆咗間舊樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fung6 ming6 hang4 si6, caak3 zo2 gaan1 gau6 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们奉命行事，拆了一栋旧楼。
examples.english_sentence: They were acting under orders and demolished an old building.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好問咁多，我淨係奉命行事㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 man6 gam3 do1, ngo5 zing6 hai6 fung6 ming6 hang4 si6 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要问那么多，我只是奉命行事而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask so many questions, I'm just acting under orders.

mandarin_meaning: 奉子成婚 (fèng zǐ chéng hūn)
english_meaning: shotgun wedding, to get married because the woman is pregnant
explanation_mandarin: 因女子怀孕而结婚。
explanation_english: To get married because the woman is pregnant; often implies that the marriage might not have happened otherwise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋奉子成婚，希望佢哋以後生活幸福啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fung6 zi2 sing4 fan1, hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 ji5 hau6 sang1 wut6 hang6 fuk1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们奉子成婚，希望他们以后生活幸福吧。
examples.english_sentence: They had a shotgun wedding, hopefully they'll have a happy life together in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋本來唔想咁快結婚，但係奉子成婚就冇辦法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bun2 lai4 m4 soeng2 gam3 faai3 git3 fan1, daan6 hai6 fung6 zi2 sing4 fan1 zau6 mou5 baan6 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们本来不想这么快结婚，但是奉子成婚就没有办法了。
examples.english_sentence: They didn't originally want to get married so soon, but there's no other way now that she's pregnant.

mandarin_meaning: 奉承, 吹捧, 谄媚
english_meaning: to flatter, to fawn on, to toady, to brown-nose
explanation_mandarin: 用好听的话或行动去讨好别人，以达到某种目的。
explanation_english: To flatter someone excessively in order to gain favor or advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日奉承老細，想升職囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 fung6 sing4 lou5 sai3, soeng2 sing1 zik1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天奉承老板，是想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He's always flattering the boss, trying to get a promotion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁奉承我啦，我會唔好意思㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 fung6 sing4 ngo5 laa1, ngo5 wui5 m4 hou2 ji3 si3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样奉承我啦，我会不好意思的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't flatter me so much, I'll be embarrassed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔使奉承我，我唔會改變決定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 fung6 sing4 ngo5, ngo5 m4 wui5 goi2 bin3 kyut3 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不用奉承我，我不会改变决定的。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to flatter me, I won't change my decision.

mandarin_meaning: 奉旨 (fèng zhǐ): 奉皇帝的旨意
english_meaning: On imperial orders; under royal command; with official sanction; acting on authority
explanation_mandarin: 原指奉皇帝的旨意，现在比喻奉上级的命令，或者得到某种授权而做某事。
explanation_english: Originally referred to acting on the Emperor's orders. Now it is used to describe acting on orders from superiors, or doing something with authorization or sanction.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢奉旨嚟捉你㗎，走佬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fung6 zi2 lai4 zuk1 nei5 gaa3, zau2 lou2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是奉命来抓你的，快跑吧！
examples.english_sentence: He's here on official orders to arrest you, run away!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為你奉旨咁樣，人人都要聽你話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 nei5 fung6 zi2 gam2 joeng2, jan4 jan4 dou1 jiu3 ting1 nei5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为你有了特权，每个人都要听你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you have the right to act like that, and that everyone should listen to you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細今日奉旨唔返工，我哋自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam1 jat6 fung6 zi2 m4 faan1 gung1, ngo5 dei6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板今天奉命不来上班，我们自己搞定吧。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is not coming to work today on orders, let's handle it ourselves.

english_meaning: to dedicate, to offer, to devote, to contribute
explanation_mandarin: 指恭敬地交付，或为集体或事业贡献力量。
explanation_english: To respectfully offer or dedicate something, or to contribute one's efforts to a group or cause.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一生奉獻俾教育事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sang1 fung6 hin3 bei2 gaau3 juk6 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生奉献给了教育事业。
examples.english_sentence: He dedicated his life to the cause of education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該奉獻多啲時間去幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 fung6 hin3 do1 di1 si4 gaan3 heoi3 bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该奉献更多的时间去帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should dedicate more time to helping people in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個醫生奉獻咗好多時間同精力去醫治病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ji1 sang1 fung6 hin3 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3 tung4 zing1 lik6 heoi3 ji1 zi6 beng6 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个医生奉献了很多时间和精力去医治病人。
examples.english_sentence: This doctor dedicated a lot of time and energy to treating patients.

english_meaning: to revere as a god; to treat with utmost respect; to worship
explanation_mandarin: 把某人或某事物看得非常重要，像对待神一样尊敬。
explanation_english: To regard someone or something as extremely important and treat them with the utmost respect, as if they were a god.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢個偶像奉若神明，咩都聽佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 go3 ngau5 zoeng6 fung6 joek6 san4 ming4, me1 dou1 ting1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的偶像奉若神明，什么都听他的。
examples.english_sentence: He reveres his idol as a god and listens to everything he says.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將老闆嘅說話奉若神明，要有自己嘅判斷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 lou5 baan2 ge3 syut3 waa2 fung6 joek6 san4 ming4, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 pun3 dyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把老板的话奉若神明，要有自己的判断。
examples.english_sentence: Don't treat the boss's words as gospel; you need to have your own judgment.

english_meaning: to follow, to practice, to implement
explanation_mandarin: 遵照（规章、制度、政策等）实行。
explanation_english: To follow or adhere to a principle, policy, rule, or doctrine; to put into practice; to implement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司一向奉行顧客至上嘅原則。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jat1 hoeng3 fung6 hang4 gu3 haak3 zi3 soeng6 ge3 jyun2 zak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司一向奉行顾客至上的原则。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has always adhered to the principle of 'customer first'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府應該奉行更加環保嘅政策。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 jing1 goi1 fung6 hang4 gang3 gaa1 waan4 bou2 ge3 zing3 caak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府应该奉行更加环保的政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government should implement more environmentally friendly policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢奉行簡約生活，唔追求物質享受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fung6 hang4 gaan2 joek3 sang1 wut6, m4 zeoi1 kau4 mat6 zik1 hoeng2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他奉行简约生活，不追求物质享受。
examples.english_sentence: He practices a minimalist lifestyle and does not pursue material pleasures.

english_meaning: to offer as a gift; to present as a gift; to give away for free
explanation_mandarin: 指无偿地赠送，敬献。
explanation_english: Refers to giving something as a gift or offering something respectfully without expecting anything in return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買滿一百蚊就奉送一個環保袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 mun5 jat1 baak3 man1 zau6 fung6 sung3 jat1 go3 waan4 bou2 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买满一百块钱就赠送一个环保袋。
examples.english_sentence: Spend over one hundred dollars and you'll get a free reusable bag.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司決定將呢批貨奉送俾慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 kyut3 ding6 zoeng1 ni1 bat1 fo3 fung6 sung3 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司决定将这批货物赠送给慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: Our company decided to donate this batch of goods to a charity organization.

english_meaning: to return (something respectfully), to give back, to revert
explanation_mandarin: 恭敬地归还。通常带有正式、客气的意味。
explanation_english: To return something respectfully. Usually implies formality and politeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我唔小心整爛咗你嘅嘢，我一定會奉還返俾你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 laan6 zo2 nei5 ge3 je5, ngo5 jat1 ding6 wui5 fung6 waan4 faan1 bei2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我不小心弄坏了你的东西，我一定会赔偿给你。
examples.english_sentence: If I accidentally break your things, I will definitely compensate you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔敢要你咁貴嘅禮物，奉還俾你好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gam2 jiu3 nei5 gam3 gwai3 ge3 lai5 mat6, fung6 waan4 bei2 nei5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不敢要你这么贵的礼物，还是还给你比较好。
examples.english_sentence: I don't dare to accept such an expensive gift from you. It's better to return it to you.

english_meaning: to accompany; to keep someone company (often in a reluctant or challenging way); I'll keep you company; I'm ready to play along (e.g., with a challenge)
explanation_mandarin: 陪伴，多含有一種應對挑戰或不情願的意味。表示願意與對方一同做某事，通常用於回應挑釁或表示願意承擔風險。
explanation_english: To accompany someone, often with a connotation of accepting a challenge or doing something reluctantly. It indicates a willingness to do something with someone, usually in response to a provocation or to show readiness to take on a risk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你想點玩啊？我奉陪到底！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng2 dim2 waan2 aa3? ngo5 fung6 pui4 dou3 dai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你想怎么玩？我奉陪到底！
examples.english_sentence: How do you want to play it? I'll go all the way with you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁有信心，我奉陪你賭一鋪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jau5 seon3 sam1, ngo5 fung6 pui4 nei5 dou2 jat1 pou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么有信心，我奉陪你赌一把。
examples.english_sentence: You're so confident, I'll take you up on your bet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你覺得咁做啱，我就奉陪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 gok3 dak1 gam2 zou6 ngaam1, ngo5 zau6 fung6 pui4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你觉得这样做对，我就奉陪。
examples.english_sentence: If you think this is the right thing to do, then I'll go along with it.

english_meaning: exert oneself; strive; vigorously; energetically
explanation_mandarin: 表示努力，尽力做某事。也形容精神振作的样子。
explanation_english: To exert oneself; to strive; to make great efforts. Also used to describe a spirited or vigorous appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你一定要奋发向上啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 fan5 fat3 hoeng3 soeng5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你一定要奋发向上啊！
examples.english_sentence: You must strive for progress!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要奋勇向前。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 fan5 jung5 hoeng3 cin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要奋勇向前。
examples.english_sentence: We must advance bravely.

english_meaning: Name of a star constellation; tall and sturdy
explanation_mandarin: 奎宿，二十八宿之一。也形容人魁梧。
explanation_english: "Kui" (奎) is one of the twenty-eight constellations in traditional Chinese astronomy. It can also describe a person as being tall and sturdy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條仔生得好奎喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zai2 saang1 dak1 hou2 fui1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个男孩长得真魁梧！
examples.english_sentence: That boy is really tall and sturdy!

english_meaning: quinine
explanation_mandarin: 一种药物，主要用于治疗疟疾。
explanation_english: A drug used to treat malaria.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生開咗啲奎寧俾佢醫瘧疾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 hoi1 zo2 di1 kwai1 ning4 bei2 keoi5 yi1 maak6 jik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生给他开了些奎宁来治疗疟疾。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor prescribed him some quinine to treat malaria.

english_meaning: to play (music); to perform; to present (a memorial to the emperor)
explanation_mandarin: 弹奏乐器；旧时指向皇帝呈奏章。
explanation_english: To play a musical instrument; formerly referred to presenting a memorial to the emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚有樂隊奏樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 jau5 lok6 deui2 zau3 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚有乐队演奏音乐。
examples.english_sentence: There will be a band playing music tonight.

english_meaning: memorial to the Emperor (in imperial China)
explanation_mandarin: 古代大臣上奏皇帝的公文。
explanation_english: A formal written report or memorial submitted by an official to the Emperor in imperial China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅文章寫得好，好似寫緊奏摺咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 hou2, hou2 ci5 se2 gan2 zau3 zip3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的文章写得很好，好像在写奏折一样。
examples.english_sentence: His writing is very formal, as if he's writing a memorial to the Emperor.

english_meaning: to be effective; to work; to produce results
explanation_mandarin: 指某种方法或措施产生了预期的效果。
explanation_english: Refers to a method or measure producing the desired effect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個方法好似唔係幾奏效喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gei2 zau3 haau6 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个方法好像不太奏效啊。
examples.english_sentence: This method doesn't seem to be working very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗藥之後，啲藥都好快奏效。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 joek6 zi1 hau6, di1 joek6 dou1 hou2 faai3 zau3 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了药之后，药很快就起作用了。
examples.english_sentence: After taking the medicine, the medicine took effect very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用呢種方法應該會奏效嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ni1 zung2 fong1 faat3 jing1 goi1 wui zau3 haau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用这种方法应该会奏效的。
examples.english_sentence: Using this method should be effective.

english_meaning: to play music; to perform music
explanation_mandarin: 演奏乐器，播放音乐。
explanation_english: To play a musical instrument; to perform music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗個樂隊嚟奏樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 ngok6 deoi2 lai4 zau3 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了一个乐队来演奏音乐。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a band to play music.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 典禮開始之前，先奏樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: din2 lai5 hoi1 ci2 zi1 cin4, sin1 zau3 ngok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 典礼开始之前，先演奏音乐。
examples.english_sentence: Before the ceremony begins, let's play music.

english_meaning: sonata
explanation_mandarin: 一种乐曲形式，通常由三到四个乐章组成，第一乐章通常是快板，采用奏鸣曲式。
explanation_english: A type of musical composition, usually consisting of three or four movements, the first of which is typically an allegro in sonata form.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我尋日聽咗一場好正嘅鋼琴奏鳴曲演奏會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cam4 jat6 teng1 zo2 jat1 coeng4 hou2 zeng3 ge3 gong3 kam4 zau3 ming4 kuk1 jin2 zau3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天听了一场很棒的钢琴奏鸣曲演奏会。
examples.english_sentence: I listened to a very good piano sonata concert yesterday.

english_meaning: to change; to renew; fresh; new
explanation_mandarin: 更换，改变；焕然一新，形容气象一新。
explanation_english: To change or replace; to take on a completely new look; fresh and new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過裝修之後，間屋變得煥然一新。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 zong1 sau1 zi1 hau6, gaan1 uk1 bin3 dak1 wun6 jin4 jat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 装修之后，房间变得焕然一新。
examples.english_sentence: After the renovation, the room looks brand new.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要奐一個新嘅方法去解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wun6 jat1 go3 san1 ge3 fong1 faat3 heoi3 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要更换一种新的方法来解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to change to a new approach to solve this problem.

english_meaning: To become sworn siblings; godparent-godchild relationship; adopted (in a non-legal sense)
explanation_mandarin: 指没有血缘关系的人之间，通过仪式结为亲属关系，如结拜兄弟姐妹；也可指认干亲，如干爹干妈、干儿子干女儿。
explanation_english: Refers to forming kinship relationships between people who are not related by blood through a ceremony, such as becoming sworn brothers and sisters. It can also refer to forming godparent-godchild relationships, such as godfather, godmother, godson, and goddaughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同佢契咗兄弟，以後就係一家人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 kai3 zo2 hing1 dai6, ji5 hau6 zau6 hai6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和他结拜为兄弟了，以后就是一家人了。
examples.english_sentence: I have become sworn brothers with him, so we are family from now on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋契咗爺，逢年過節都會去拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kai3 zo2 ye4, fung4 nin4 gwo3 zit3 dou1 wui5 heoi3 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们认了干爹，每逢过年过节都会去拜年。
examples.english_sentence: They have adopted a godfather, and they visit him every year during the festivals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆幫個孫契觀音，希望佢可以快高長大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 bong1 go3 syun1 kai3 gun1 jam1, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 faai3 gou1 zoeng2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶帮孙子认观音为干妈，希望他可以快快长大。
examples.english_sentence: The grandmother helped her grandson become a godchild of Guanyin, hoping that he would grow up healthy and quickly.

english_meaning: Khitan (a historical nomadic people of Northeast Asia)
explanation_mandarin: 指中国历史上一个游牧民族，曾建立辽朝。
explanation_english: Refers to the Khitan people, a nomadic group in Chinese history who established the Liao dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 契丹人以前喺中國北方建立咗個遼國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kai3 taan1 jan4 ji5 cin4 hai2 zung1 gwok3 bak1 fong1 gin3 lap6 zo2 go3 liu4 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 契丹人以前在中国北方建立了辽国。
examples.english_sentence: The Khitan people used to establish the Liao dynasty in northern China.

english_meaning: Godmother (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有血緣關係的母親，通常帶有貶義或輕蔑的意味，暗示關係並非真心或帶有其他目的。
explanation_english: Refers to a godmother, a woman who is not biologically related but assumes the role of a mother figure. Often used with a negative connotation, implying the relationship is insincere or driven by ulterior motives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁好咁幫你，唔通你想認佢做契乸呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hou2 gam3 bong1 nei5, m4 tung1 seong2 jing6 keoi5 zou6 kai3 naa2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么好心地帮你，难道你想认她做乾妈吗？(暗示关系不纯洁)
examples.english_sentence: She's helping you so much, do you want to recognize her as your godmother? (Implying the relationship is not genuine)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪成日黐住佢啦，人哋又唔係你契乸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 seng4 jat6 ci1 zyu6 keoi5 laa1, jan4 dei6 jau6 m4 hai6 nei5 kai3 naa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别总是缠着她，人家又不是你的乾妈。(暗示关系不应该过于亲密)
examples.english_sentence: Don't always stick to her, she's not your godmother. (Implying the relationship shouldn't be too intimate)

english_meaning: Godson
explanation_mandarin: 通过仪式认的儿子，没有血缘关系。
explanation_english: A godson, a son adopted through a ritual, with no blood relation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆幫佢個仔搵咗個契仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 bong1 keoi5 go3 zai2 wan2 zo2 go3 kai3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我奶奶帮她的儿子找了一个干儿子。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother found a godson for her son.

english_meaning: to agree, to tally, to coincide, to be in accord with
explanation_mandarin: 指双方意气相投，或事物相互吻合。
explanation_english: Refers to two parties having compatible personalities or ideals; or things coinciding or fitting together well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅性格好契合，好快就成為咗好朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 kai3 hap6, hou2 faai3 zau6 sing4 wai4 zo2 hou2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的性格很契合，很快就成为了好朋友。
examples.english_sentence: Their personalities are very compatible, and they quickly became good friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩份報告嘅結果好契合，可以確認我哋嘅假設係啱嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 git3 gwo2 hou2 kai3 hap6, ho2 ji5 kok3 jing6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 gaa2 syut3 hai6 aam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两份报告的结果很契合，可以确认我们的假设是对的。
examples.english_sentence: The results of these two reports are very consistent, confirming that our hypothesis is correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋對音樂嘅品味好契合，所以成日一齊去睇演唱會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 deoi3 jam1 ngok6 ge3 ban2 mei6 hou2 kai3 hap6, so2 ji5 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 tai2 jin2 cheung3 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们对音乐的品味很契合，所以经常一起去看演唱会。
examples.english_sentence: Their taste in music is very compatible, so they often go to concerts together.

english_meaning: God brother (older)
explanation_mandarin: 指没有血缘关系的，通过仪式或口头约定结成的哥哥关系。通常是由女性认的。比自己年长的非亲属男性朋友，通过某种仪式或者口头约定结成类似兄妹的关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a male who is not related by blood but is considered an older brother through a formal ceremony or informal agreement. Usually, a woman recognizes this person as her 'god brother'. It's a non-familial male friend older than oneself, with whom a sibling-like relationship is established through some ritual or verbal agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時已經認咗個契哥喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 ji5 ging1 jing6 zo2 go3 kai3 go1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候就已经认了个干哥哥了。
examples.english_sentence: She already recognized a god brother when she was little.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我契哥好錫我㗎，成日買嘢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kai3 go1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的干哥哥很疼我，总是给我买东西。
examples.english_sentence: My god brother loves me very much, he always buys me things.

english_meaning: Goddaughter
explanation_mandarin: 没有血缘关系，但通过仪式或口头约定建立关系的女儿。
explanation_english: A girl who is not related by blood, but has a formal, often ceremonial relationship with someone who is not her parent; a goddaughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我契女好乖㗎，成日都會嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kai3 neoi2 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 wui5 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的乾女儿很乖，常常会来看我。
examples.english_sentence: My goddaughter is very well-behaved and often comes to visit me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆冇仔女，所以認咗個遠房親戚嘅個女做契女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 mou5 zai2 neoi2, so2 ji5 jing6 zo2 go3 jyun5 fong2 can1 cik1 ge3 go3 neoi2 zou6 kai3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻没有子女，所以认了一个远房亲戚的女儿做乾女儿。
examples.english_sentence: The couple doesn't have children, so they adopted a distant relative's daughter as their goddaughter.

english_meaning: God sister; sworn sister (older)
explanation_mandarin: 指没有血缘关系，但通过仪式或口头约定结成的姐姐。
explanation_english: Refers to an older female friend who is considered as a sister but is not biologically related, often through a formal or informal agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅契姐，我哋細個就已經識得㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 kai3 ze1, ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 zau6 ji5 ging1 sik1 dak1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我的干姐姐，我们从小就认识了。
examples.english_sentence: She is my god sister, we have known each other since we were kids.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽幫個鄰居個女上契，認咗佢做契姐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 bong1 go3 leon4 geoi1 go3 neoi5 soeng5 kai3, jing6 zo2 keoi5 zou6 kai3 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈帮邻居的女儿结契，认她做了干姐姐。
examples.english_sentence: My mother helped the neighbor's daughter become a godchild, and acknowledged her as a god sister.

english_meaning: godmother
explanation_mandarin: 指经仪式确定的、非血缘关系的母亲。
explanation_english: A woman who is a child's godmother, a female sponsor at baptism, or a woman who has a similar formal relationship with a child but is not a blood relative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣，我媽咪幫我搵咗個契娘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6, ngo5 maa1 mi1 bong1 ngo5 wan2 zo2 go3 kai3 noeng4-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，我妈妈帮我找了个干妈。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my mother found me a godmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢個契娘好好㗎，成日都探佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 go3 kai3 noeng4-2 hou2 hou2 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 taam3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的干妈很好，经常去看她。
examples.english_sentence: He is very good to his godmother and visits her often.

english_meaning: Godmother (non-religious context, often a close female friend of the family)
explanation_mandarin: 指沒有血緣關係，但通過儀式或其他方式認定的母親。
explanation_english: Refers to a female who has no blood relation to a child but is recognized as a 'mother' figure, often through a ceremony or agreement. This signifies a close, familial bond.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家好熟，所以佢個女就認咗佢做契媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 hou2 suk6, so2 ji5 keoi5 go3 neoi2 zau6 jing6 zo2 keoi5 zou6 kai3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家关系很好，所以她的女儿就认她做乾妈。
examples.english_sentence: The two families are very close, so her daughter recognized her as her godmother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我契媽成日買嘢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kai3 maa1 sing4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的乾妈经常买东西给我。
examples.english_sentence: My godmother often buys me things.

english_meaning: the whole family; entire family
explanation_mandarin: 指整个家庭，全家人。
explanation_english: Refers to the entire family; all members of the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋契家一齊去飲茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 kai3 gaa1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们全家一起去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: During the new year, our whole family goes to have dim sum together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋契家都好錫隻狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 kai3 gaa1 dou1 hou2 sek3 zek3 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家都很疼爱那只狗。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family loves that dog very much.

english_meaning: Boyfriend
explanation_mandarin: 指女朋友的男朋友。 通常带有一种调侃或者亲昵的语气。
explanation_english: Refers to a girlfriend's boyfriend. Usually used in a playful or affectionate tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日同佢嘅契家佬去街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 tung4 keoi5 ge3 kai3 gaa1 lou2 heoi3 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是和她的男朋友去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: She always goes shopping with her boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知我個契家佬去咗邊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 ngo5 go3 kai3 gaa1 lou2 heoi3 zo2 bin1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道我的男朋友去哪里了。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know where my boyfriend has gone.

english_meaning: Godmother; a close female friend who is considered like family
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，指关系亲密的女性朋友，被视为家人，可以引申为干妈或教母。有时也用来指代亲密的女性朋友。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, refers to a close female friend who is considered like family. It can also refer to a godmother. Sometimes used to describe a close female friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅契家婆，對我好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 kai3 gaa1 po4, deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我的干妈，对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: She's my godmother, she's very good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個係契家婆，乜嘢都會同對方講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 kai3 gaa1 po4, mat1 je5 dou1 wui5 tung4 deoi3 fong1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们俩是好姐妹，什么都会跟对方说。
examples.english_sentence: We are very close female friends, we tell each other everything.

mandarin_meaning: 王八蛋, 混蛋, 龟儿子
english_meaning: Bastard, son of a bitch, rascal (term of abuse)
explanation_mandarin: 骂人的话，表示极度厌恶和鄙视。源于旧时一种认干亲的习俗，如果干儿子不孝顺，干爹就可以骂他“契弟”，后来泛指坏人、混蛋。
explanation_english: A derogatory term used as a term of abuse, expressing extreme dislike and contempt. It originates from an old custom of adopting a godson. If the godson was unfilial, the godfather could scold him as "kai dai". Later, it broadly refers to bad people or bastards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個契弟，成日搞搞震！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 kai3 dai2, sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个混蛋，整天搞事情！
examples.english_sentence: You bastard, you're always causing trouble!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係個契弟嚟嘅，成日呃人錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 go3 kai3 dai2 lai4 ge3, sing4 jat6 aak1 jan4 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是个混蛋，整天骗人钱。
examples.english_sentence: He really is a bastard, always cheating people out of their money.

english_meaning: The idiot is walking slowly.
explanation_mandarin: “契弟”是粤语中骂人的话，意思是“笨蛋、混蛋”。“走得嚤”是说走得很慢。“契弟走得嚤”合起来就是骂人笨蛋走路慢。
explanation_english: "契弟 (hai2 dai2)" is a Cantonese swear word meaning "idiot, bastard." "走得嚤 (zau2 dak1 mo1)" means "walks slowly." Together, "契弟走得嚤" means the idiot is walking slowly, often used in a derogatory and impatient way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，契弟走得嚤，快啲啦!
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, hai2 dai2 zau2 dak1 mo1, faai3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，笨蛋走得太慢了，快点啦！
examples.english_sentence: Hey, idiot, you're walking too slow, hurry up!

english_meaning: You bastard, walking so slowly!
explanation_mandarin: 这是一个粤语俚语，带有强烈的负面情绪，表示对对方的厌恶和不满。 “契弟” 是一个非常粗俗的骂人词，相当于普通话的“王八蛋”或者更严重的侮辱。 “走的嚤” 描述对方走路很慢，通常是因为说话者对对方的行为非常不满，希望对方赶快离开。
explanation_english: This is a Cantonese slang phrase with strong negative connotations, expressing disgust and dissatisfaction towards someone. "契弟" (kai3 dai2) is a very vulgar insult, roughly equivalent to "bastard" or a stronger insult in Mandarin or English. "走的嚤" (zau2 dik1 mo1) describes someone walking slowly, usually because the speaker is very displeased with the person's actions and wants them to leave quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂！契弟走的嚤！阻住晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3! kai3 dai2 zau2 dik1 mo1! zo2 zyu6 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂！王八蛋走得慢！挡路了！
examples.english_sentence: Hey! You bastard, walking so slowly! You're blocking the way!

english_meaning: opportunity; turning point; key moment; impetus
explanation_mandarin: 指事物发展变化的内在机会或条件，可以促进事情发展的关键。
explanation_english: Refers to an internal opportunity or condition in the development and change of things, a key moment that can promote the development of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次經濟唔景氣都係一個契機，畀我哋重新諗吓點樣發展經濟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 ging1 gai3 m4 ging2 hei3 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 kai3 gei1, bei2 ngo5 dei6 cung4 san1 lam2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 faat3 zin2 ging1 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次经济不景气也是一个契机，让我们重新思考如何发展经济。
examples.english_sentence: This economic downturn is also an opportunity for us to rethink how to develop the economy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅合作係一個好好嘅契機，可以促進兩間公司嘅發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 hap6 zok3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 kai3 gei1, ho2 ji5 cuk1 zeon3 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的合作是一个很好的契机，可以促进两家公司的发展。
examples.english_sentence: Their cooperation is a great opportunity to promote the development of both companies.

english_meaning: Godfather (in the context of a ritual adoption); sugar daddy (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过仪式认定的非亲生父亲。有时也指在经济上支持某人的人，带有负面含义。
explanation_english: Refers to a non-biological father recognized through a ritual adoption ceremony. It can also refer, in a derogatory sense, to a man who provides financial support to someone, often in exchange for companionship or sexual favours (i.e., a 'sugar daddy'). The meaning largely depends on context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候，佢阿媽幫佢搵咗個契爺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, keoi5 aa3 maa1 bong1 keoi5 wan2 zo2 go3 kai3 je4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候，他妈妈帮他找了个干爹。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, his mother found him a godfather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話佢有個契爺，乜都唔使做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 keoi5 jau5 go3 kai3 je4, mat1 dou1 m4 sai2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说他有个干爹，什么都不用做。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he has a sugar daddy, and doesn't have to do anything.

english_meaning: Kindred spirits; soulmates; bosom buddies (especially when referring to someone you feel close to despite just meeting them or not knowing them for very long)
explanation_mandarin: 指两个人一见如故，彼此很投缘，感觉像是认识了很久的老朋友一样。
explanation_english: Describes two people who instantly click, feel a strong connection, and feel like they've known each other for a long time, even if they've just met or haven't known each other for very long. Implies a deep connection and understanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋啱啱識冇幾耐，但係覺得好似契相知咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 sik1 mou5 gei2 noi6, daan6 hai6 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 kai3 soeng1 zi1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们刚认识没多久，但是感觉好像是知己一样。
examples.english_sentence: We've only just met, but it feels like we're kindred spirits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個一見面就契相知，成日黐埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jat1 gin3 min6 zau6 kai3 soeng1 zi1, sing4 jat6 chi1 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一见面就情投意合，整天黏在一起。
examples.english_sentence: They hit it off immediately and became kindred spirits, always hanging out together.

english_meaning: contract; agreement
explanation_mandarin: 具有法律约束力的书面或口头协议。
explanation_english: A legally binding written or spoken agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋簽咗份契約，要跟住嚟做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 cim1 zo2 fan6 hai2 joek3, jiu3 gan1 zeoi3 lai4 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们签了一份合同，要按照合同来做。
examples.english_sentence: We signed a contract and we have to follow it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇清楚份契約先好簽名呀，唔好咁快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 cing1 chu2 fan6 hai2 joek3 sin1 hou2 cim1 ming4 aa3, m4 hou2 gam3 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看清楚合同再签名啊，不要这么快。
examples.english_sentence: Read the contract carefully before signing, don't be so quick.

english_meaning: godbrother (younger)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过仪式或口头约定，结为干亲关系的弟弟。
explanation_english: Refers to a younger male who becomes a godbrother through a ritual or verbal agreement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我契細佬，有咩事你幫下手啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 kai3 sai3 lou2, jau5 me1 si6 nei5 bong1 haa5 sau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的干弟弟，有什么事你帮帮忙吧。
examples.english_sentence: He's my godbrother, please help him if he needs anything.

english_meaning: to open up; to spread out; to expand; ostentatious; extravagant
explanation_mandarin: 1. 张开，铺开。 2. 形容铺张浪费，炫耀。
explanation_english: 1. To open up, spread out. 2. To describe being extravagant, ostentatious, or showy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都咁奓，買嘢唔睇價錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 gam3 caa4, maai5 je5 m4 tai2 gaa3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是这么铺张浪费，买东西不看价钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is always so extravagant, buying things without looking at the price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁奓啦，慳啲錢好過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 caa4 laa1, haan1 di1 cin2 hou2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么铺张浪费了，省点钱更好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so extravagant, it's better to save some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚搞得好奓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 gaau2 dak1 hou2 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的婚礼办得很铺张。
examples.english_sentence: Their wedding was very extravagant.

english_meaning: to be smug, to be self-important, to be conceited, to be pleased with oneself
explanation_mandarin: 形容人因為一些成就而過於自滿，表現出得意忘形的樣子。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is overly pleased with themselves due to some achievement, displaying a smug and self-important demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個獎就開始奓鼻喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 zoeng2 zau6 hoi1 ci2 ze3 bei6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他得了奖就开始得意忘形了。
examples.english_sentence: He started being smug after winning the award.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁奓鼻啦，謙虛啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ze3 bei6 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么得意忘形了，谦虚一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so smug, it's better to be more humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好奓鼻住，仲有好多嘢要學㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze3 bei6 zyu6, zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 jiu3 hok6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别太得意忘形了，还有很多东西要学呢。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be too pleased with yourself yet, there's still a lot to learn.

english_meaning: to run, to rush, to dash
explanation_mandarin: 指快速地跑，或者为了某个目的而奔走。
explanation_english: Refers to running quickly, or rushing around for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都周圍奔波，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zau1 wai4 ban1 bo1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是到处奔波，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He's always rushing around, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗養家，佢要四處奔走搵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 joeng5 gaa1, keoi5 jiu3 sei3 cyu3 ban1 zau2 wan2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了养家糊口，他要四处奔波找吃的。
examples.english_sentence: In order to support his family, he has to rush around to find a living.

english_meaning: to hurry home for a funeral
explanation_mandarin: 指得知亲人去世的消息后，立即赶回家料理丧事。
explanation_english: To rush home to attend a funeral, especially after hearing news of a close relative's death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到阿爺過咗身，佢即刻要奔喪返鄉下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 dou2 aa3 je4 gwo3 zo2 san1, keoi5 zik1 hak1 jiu3 ban1 song1 faan1 hoeng1 haa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到爷爷去世了，他立刻要奔丧回老家。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing that his grandfather had passed away, he had to rush home to the countryside for the funeral immediately.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢收到屋企嘅電話，話阿婆走咗，所以佢要奔喪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau1 dou2 uk1 kei2 ge3 din6 waa2, waa6 aa3 po4 zau2 zo2, so2 ji5 keoi5 jiu3 ban1 song1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他接到家里的电话，说奶奶去世了，所以他要奔丧。
examples.english_sentence: He received a call from home saying his grandmother had passed away, so he had to go home for the funeral.

english_meaning: unrestrained, exuberant, bold and unrestrained
explanation_mandarin: 形容思想或行动不受拘束，不受限制，自由自在。
explanation_english: Describes someone's thoughts or actions as being unconstrained, unrestricted, and free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格好奔放，鍾意做自己想做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 hou2 ban1 fong3, zung1 yi3 zou6 zi6 gei2 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格很奔放，喜欢做自己想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is very unrestrained; he likes to do what he wants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞跳得好奔放，充滿活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 tiu3 dak1 hou2 ban1 fong3, cung1 mun5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她跳舞跳得很奔放，充满活力。
examples.english_sentence: She dances with great exuberance, full of energy.

english_meaning: to rush about; to run around; to be busy running around
explanation_mandarin: 形容为了达到某种目的而四处奔走，忙碌。强调劳累奔走。
explanation_english: Describes running around busily in order to achieve a certain goal. Emphasizes the labor of traveling around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗頭家，佢日日都要周圍奔波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 tau4 gaa1, keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 zau1 wai4 ban1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了家庭，他每天都要到处奔波。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his family, he has to rush around every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日要出差，搞到成日要喺唔同嘅城市奔波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 jiu3 ceot1 caai1, gaau2 dou3 seng4 jat6 jiu3 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 sing4 si5 ban1 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常要出差，搞得经常要在不同的城市奔波。
examples.english_sentence: He often has business trips, so he is always rushing around in different cities.

english_meaning: raid; to make a surprise attack; rapid assault
explanation_mandarin: 指快速地袭击；快速奔赴并袭击目标。
explanation_english: To make a swift and sudden attack; to rush to and assault a target quickly. Often used in military or sports contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋計劃夜晚奔襲敵軍嘅營地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gai3 waak6 ngaan5 maan1 ban1 sik6 dik6 gwan1 ge3 jing4 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们计划晚上奔袭敌军的营地。
examples.english_sentence: They planned to raid the enemy's camp at night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺足球比賽入面，快速嘅奔襲可以令對手措手不及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zuk1 kau4 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6, faai3 suk1 ge3 ban1 sik6 ho2 ji5 ling6 deoi3 sau2 co3 sau2 bat1 kap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在足球比赛中，快速的奔袭可以让对手措手不及。
examples.english_sentence: In football matches, a quick raid can catch the opponent off guard.

english_meaning: to run about; to be on the go; to exert oneself; to be busy running around
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某个目的而四处奔波，努力活动。
explanation_english: Refers to running around and working hard for a certain purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗幫個仔搵學校，日日都周圍奔走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 zo2幫 go3 zai2 wan2 hok6 haau6, jat6 jat6 dou1 zau1 wai4 ban1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了帮儿子找学校，他每天都到处奔走。
examples.english_sentence: He runs around everywhere every day to help his son find a school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一直為咗爭取權益而奔走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 zik6 wai4 zo2 zang1 ceoi2 kuen4 yik1 ji4 ban1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一直为了争取权益而奔走。
examples.english_sentence: They have been running around to fight for their rights.

english_meaning: to rush to; to hurry to; to hasten to
explanation_mandarin: 快速地前往某个地方，通常带有一定的目的性。
explanation_english: To rush or hurry to a place, usually with a specific purpose or goal in mind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋收到消息之後，即刻奔赴災區救援。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sau1 dou2 siu1 sik1 zi1 hau6, zik1 hak1 ban1 fu6 zoi1 keoi1 gau3 wun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们收到消息之后，立刻奔赴灾区救援。
examples.english_sentence: After receiving the news, they immediately rushed to the disaster area for rescue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗實現夢想，決定奔赴北京發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 sat6 hin6 mung6 soeng2, kyut3 ding6 ban1 fu6 bak1 ging1 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了实现梦想，他决定奔赴北京发展。
examples.english_sentence: In order to realize his dream, he decided to rush to Beijing for development.

english_meaning: to run; to sprint
explanation_mandarin: 指快速地跑。
explanation_english: To run quickly; to sprint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺操場上面奔跑緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 cou1 coeng4 soeng6 min6 ban1 paau2 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他正在操场上奔跑。
examples.english_sentence: He is running on the playground.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一齊奔跑去追巴士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 ban1 paau2 heoi3 zeoi1 baa1 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一起奔跑去追巴士。
examples.english_sentence: We ran together to catch the bus.

mandarin_meaning: 奔驰 (bēn chí) - 奔跑，疾驰
english_meaning: to run quickly; to gallop; (specifically) Mercedes-Benz
explanation_mandarin: 本意是快速奔跑、疾驰。但在粤语中，多指梅赛德斯-奔驰汽车品牌。
explanation_english: Originally it means to run quickly or gallop. In Cantonese, it mostly refers to the Mercedes-Benz car brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢架新奔馳好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 san1 ban1 ci4 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的新奔驰车很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: His new Mercedes-Benz car is so beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話想買架奔馳獎勵自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 soeng2 maai5 gaa3 ban1 ci4 zoeng2 lai6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说想买辆奔驰奖励自己。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wants to buy a Mercedes-Benz as a reward for himself.

english_meaning: to surge; to gallop; to surge forward; to roll on (of waves)
explanation_mandarin: 指（水流、马等）急速地跳跃着往前奔跑。
explanation_english: Describes the rapid galloping or surging movement of things like water or horses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條河嘅水奔騰得好犀利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 ho4 ge3 seoi2 ban1 tang4 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条河的水奔腾得非常厉害。
examples.english_sentence: The water in this river is surging very powerfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到咁多馬奔騰，真係好壯觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gam3 do1 maa5 ban1 tang4, zan1 hai6 hou2 zong3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到这么多马奔腾，真是很壮观。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing so many horses galloping is truly magnificent.

mandarin_meaning: 精神饱满, 神采奕奕
english_meaning: vigorous, spirited, full of spirit
explanation_mandarin: 形容精神饱满，容光焕发的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is vigorous, full of spirit, and radiant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日精神好奕㖞，係咪有咩開心事啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zing1 san4 hou2 jik6 wo3, hai6 mai1 jau5 me1 hoi1 sam1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天精神很奕啊，是不是有什么开心的事？
examples.english_sentence: He looks so full of spirit today, is there something good happening?

english_meaning: set; suite; cover; trap; scheme
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 量词, 名词, 动词
explanation_mandarin: 作为量词，用于成套的东西。作为名词，指罩子或圈套。作为动词，指欺骗或套取。
explanation_english: As a measure word, used for things that come in sets. As a noun, it refers to a cover or a trap. As a verb, it means to deceive or to obtain something by trickery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套衫幾靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 saam1 gei2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这套衣服真漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: This outfit is quite pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人套咗入局啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 tou3 zo2 jap6 guk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人套进圈套里了。
examples.english_sentence: He was trapped in a scheme.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買套床單返屋企先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 tou3 cong4 daan1 faan1 uk1 kei2 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 先买一套床单回家。
examples.english_sentence: Buy a set of bedsheets and go home first.

english_meaning: Loopholes in the Small House Policy; Profiteering from the Small House Policy
explanation_mandarin: 一种违反香港丁屋政策的行为。指原居民男性通过非法手段（例如：与发展商合作），将本应自用的丁权出售或转让，从而获取利益。通常涉及贿赂、伪造文件等非法活动。
explanation_english: "Tao Ding" refers to the illegal practices surrounding Hong Kong's Small House Policy (丁屋政策), where indigenous male villagers exploit loopholes, often in collaboration with developers, to profit by selling or transferring their "Ding Quan" (丁權 - right to build a small house) instead of building a house for their own occupancy. This often involves bribery and document forgery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 最近新聞好多都係講緊套丁嘅案件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeoi3 gan6 san1 man4 hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 gong2 gan2 tou3 ding1 ge3 on3 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近新闻很多都是在说丁屋套利的案件。
examples.english_sentence: Recently, a lot of news is about cases of profiteering from the Small House Policy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋比人拉咗，懷疑佢哋套丁囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2, waai4 ji4 keoi5 dei6 tou3 ding1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被人抓了，怀疑他们丁屋套利了。
examples.english_sentence: They were arrested, suspected of exploiting the Small House Policy.

english_meaning: arbitrage (currency)
explanation_mandarin: 利用不同市场上的汇率差异进行买卖，以赚取利润的行为。
explanation_english: The practice of exploiting tiny differences in exchange rates in different markets to buy and sell currencies for profit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司專門做套匯生意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 zyun1 mun4 zou6 tou3 wui6 saang1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司专门做套汇生意的。
examples.english_sentence: Their company specializes in currency arbitrage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果匯率唔波動，就冇得做套匯㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 wui6 leot2 m4 bo1 dung6, zau6 mou5 dak1 zou6 tou3 wui6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果汇率不波动，就没法做套汇了。
examples.english_sentence: If the exchange rates are not volatile, then there's no way to do arbitrage.

english_meaning: to sound someone out, to try to get information from someone indirectly, to probe someone's opinion
explanation_mandarin: 试探对方的口气或态度，从而了解对方的想法或意图。
explanation_english: To subtly try to find out someone's opinion, intentions, or information by indirect questioning or conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住套下佢口風，睇下佢對件事有咩睇法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 tou3 haa5 keoi5 hau2 fung1, tai2 haa5 keoi5 deoi3 gin6 si6 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算套一下他的口风，看看他对这件事有什么看法。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to sound him out to see what his opinion is on this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好醒目㗎，唔容易套到佢口風嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sing2 muk6 gaa3, m4 jung4 ji6 tou3 dou2 keoi5 hau2 fung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很精明，不容易套到他的口风的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very clever, it's not easy to sound him out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日想套我口風，問我有冇拍拖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 sing4 jat6 soeng2 tou3 ngo5 hau2 fung1, man6 ngo5 jau5 mou5 paak3 to1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是想套我的口风，问我有没有谈恋爱。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always tries to sound me out, asking if I have a boyfriend/girlfriend.

english_meaning: en-suite bathroom; bathroom suite
explanation_mandarin: 指房间内自带的，通常与卧室直接相连的卫生间。
explanation_english: Refers to a bathroom that is attached to and directly accessible from a bedroom, forming a suite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店房有個套廁，方便好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 fong2 jau5 go3 tou3 ci3, faang1 bin6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店房间里有个配套卫生间，方便多了。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel room has an en-suite bathroom, which is much more convenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想要間有套廁嘅房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 gaan1 jau5 tou3 ci3 ge3 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要一个有配套卫生间的房间。
examples.english_sentence: I want a room with an en-suite bathroom.

english_meaning: to take advantage of a situation; to try to get a share of the benefits; to join in the fun and get a piece of the action; to freeload
explanation_mandarin: 指看别人有利可图或有热闹可看，便趁机参与，希望能从中分一杯羹。
explanation_english: To join in an activity or event, especially when it is seen as beneficial or profitable, with the intention of gaining some advantage or benefit oneself. It implies a desire to capitalize on the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到人炒樓賺錢，又想套戥一份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 caau2 lau2 zaan6 cin2, jau6 soeng2 tou3 dang3 jat1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到别人炒房赚钱，也想分一杯羹。
examples.english_sentence: He saw that others were making money by speculating in real estate and wanted to get in on the action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住套戥人哋，自己都要努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 tou3 dang3 jan4 dei6, zi6 gei2 dou1 jiu3 nou5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老想着凑别人的热闹，自己也要努力的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always think about freeloading; you have to work hard yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司搞活動，班友仔梗係會嚟套戥㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 gaau2 wut6 dung6, baan1 jau5 zai2 gang2 hai6 wui4 lai4 tou3 dang3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司搞活动，那些家伙肯定会来凑热闹的啦。
examples.english_sentence: When the company organizes an event, those guys will definitely come to join in the fun and get freebies.

english_meaning: suite (of rooms); apartment
explanation_mandarin: 由多个房间组成的居住单元，通常包括卧室、客厅、浴室和厨房等。
explanation_english: A suite of rooms, typically including a bedroom, living room, bathroom, and kitchen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺酒店book咗間套房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zau2 dim3 book1 zo2 gaan1 tou3 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在酒店订了一间套房。
examples.english_sentence: We booked a suite at the hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間套房好寬敞，住得好舒服。
