examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 tou3 fong2 hou2 fun1 chong2, zyu6 dak1 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间套房很宽敞，住得很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This suite is very spacious and comfortable to live in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想買一間有獨立廚房嘅套房。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 maai5 jat1 gaan1 jau5 duk6 lap6 chu4 fong2 ge3 tou3 fong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想买一间有独立厨房的套房。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to buy a suite with a separate kitchen.

english_meaning: a set of prearranged moves (martial arts); a trick; a set of deceptive practices; a routine
explanation_mandarin: 原指武术中预先编排好的一套动作。引申为事先安排好的、带有欺骗性质的手段或程序。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a prearranged sequence of movements in martial arts. By extension, it refers to a pre-planned and often deceptive scheme or procedure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅銷售策略成日都係用啲套拳去呃啲客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 siu1 sau6 caak3 loek6 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 yung6 di1 tou3 kyun4 heoi3 aak1 di1 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的销售策略总是用一些套路去欺骗顾客。
examples.english_sentence: This company's sales strategy always uses tricks to deceive customers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲追求女仔嘅方法都係套拳嚟嘅，一啲都唔真誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 zeoi1 kiu4 neoi5 zai2 ge3 fong1 faat3 dou1 hai6 tou3 kyun4 lai4 ge3, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 zan1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他追求女孩的方法都是套路，一点都不真诚。
examples.english_sentence: His methods of pursuing girls are all tricks; they are not sincere at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為學咗幾招詠春嘅套拳就以為自己好打得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 hok6 zo2 gei2 ziu1 wing6 ceon1 ge3 tou3 kyun4 zau6 ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 daa2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为学了几招咏春的套拳就以为自己很能打。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you're a good fighter just because you've learned a few Wing Chun routines.

mandarin_meaning: 套取信息, 骗取信息
english_meaning: to extract information (often by deception); to pump for information; to fish for information; to con someone for information
explanation_mandarin: 通过欺骗或不正当手段获取信息。多指试图通过提问或引诱的方式，从对方口中得到想要的信息。
explanation_english: To extract information from someone, often through deception or manipulative tactics. It often refers to attempting to obtain desired information by posing questions or using enticing methods to get the other party to reveal it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻套料，成日問啲模棱兩可嘅問題，等你唔覺意講咗啲嘢俾佢知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 tou3 liu2, seng4 jat6 man6 di1 mou4 ling4 loeng5 ho2 ge3 man6 tai4, dang2 nei5 m4 gok3 ji3 gong2 zo2 di1 ye5 bei2 keoi5 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会套取信息，总是问些模棱两可的问题，让你不小心把一些事情告诉他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at extracting information, always asking ambiguous questions, so you unintentionally tell him things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要小心啲，唔好俾佢套到料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 tou3 dou2 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要小心点，不要被他套取到信息。
examples.english_sentence: We need to be careful, don't let him pump us for information.

english_meaning: to cash out, to liquidate (assets)
explanation_mandarin: 将资产、投资等转换为现金。
explanation_english: To convert assets, investments, etc., into cash; to liquidate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢決定將啲股票套現，攞嚟買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kyut3 ding6 zo2 zoeng1 di1 gu2 piu3 tou3 hin6, lo2 lai4 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他决定把一些股票变现，用来买房。
examples.english_sentence: He decided to cash out some of his stocks to buy a house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市唔好，佢想將間屋套現都難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 m4 hou2, keoi5 soeng2 zoeng1 gaan1 uk1 tou3 hin6 dou1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市不好，他想把房子变现都难。
examples.english_sentence: The housing market isn't good, it's hard for him to cash out his house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想套現手上嘅加密貨幣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 tou3 hin6 sau2 soeng6 ge3 gaa1 mat6 fo3 bai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想将手上的加密货币变现。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to cash out the cryptocurrency he has.

mandarin_meaning: 应用, 采用, 借鉴
english_meaning: to apply, to use, to adopt, to borrow (ideas, methods etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 将某种方法、理论等应用到实际情况中。
explanation_english: To apply a method, theory, etc., to a practical situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以套用呢個公式去計返個答案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 tou3 yung6 ni1 go3 gung1 sik1 heoi3 gai3 faan1 go3 daap3 aan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以套用这个公式去计算出答案。
examples.english_sentence: You can apply this formula to calculate the answer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將人哋嗰套套用喺我身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 yan4 dei6 go2 tou3 tou3 yung6 hai2 ngo5 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把别人的那套用在我身上。
examples.english_sentence: Don't apply other people's methods to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以套用之前嘅經驗嚟解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 tou3 yung6 zi1 cin4 ge3 ging1 jim6 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以应用之前的经验来解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We can apply our previous experience to solve this problem.

english_meaning: package ticket; combined ticket; bundle
explanation_mandarin: 指包含多个项目的票，通常比单独购买每个项目的票更便宜。
explanation_english: A package ticket or combined ticket, usually offering a discount compared to purchasing individual tickets for each item or event included in the package.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗海洋公園嘅套票，包埋入場券同餐券。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 hoi2 joeng4 gung1 jyun4 ge3 tou3 piu3, baau1 maai4 jap6 coeng4 hyun3 tung4 caan1 hyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了海洋公园的套票，包括入场券和餐券。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a package ticket for Ocean Park, which includes admission tickets and meal vouchers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店推出咗住宿套票，可以免費享用泳池同健身室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 tui1 ceot1 zo2 suk1 zuk6 tou3 piu3, ho2 ji5 min5 fai3 hoeng2 yung6 wing6 ci4 tung4 gin6 san1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店推出了住宿套票，可以免费享用游泳池和健身房。
examples.english_sentence: This hotel has launched an accommodation package that allows you to enjoy the swimming pool and gym for free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 買演唱會套票通常都會送啲紀念品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maai5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 tou3 piu3 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui sung3 di1 gei2 nim6 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 买演唱会套票通常都会送一些纪念品。
examples.english_sentence: Buying concert package tickets usually comes with some souvenirs.

english_meaning: suit (clothing); set (of items)
explanation_mandarin: 指成套的服装，或成套的物品。
explanation_english: Refers to a matching set of clothes, or a set of items that belong together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗套裝返工，好精神啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 tou3 zong1 faan1 gung1, hou2 zing1 san4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿着套装上班，很有精神啊！
examples.english_sentence: She wore a suit to work today, she looks very energetic!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套護膚品係一個套裝嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 wu6 fu1 ban2 hai6 jat1 go3 tou3 zong1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这套护肤品是一个套装。
examples.english_sentence: This set of skincare products is a set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗一套裝修工具。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 tou3 zong1 sau1 gung1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了一套装修工具。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a set of renovation tools.

english_meaning: Routine, formula, pre-set pattern; a set of skills or techniques; scheme, trick, con
explanation_mandarin: 指事先设计好的一系列步骤、方法或计划，通常带有一定的目的性。在网络语境中，常指带有欺骗或控制性质的手段、伎俩。
explanation_english: Refers to a pre-designed set of steps, methods, or plans, usually with a specific purpose. In internet slang, it often refers to schemes, tricks, or tactics with deceptive or controlling intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢追女仔嘅套路都幾老土。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi1 neoi5 zai2 ge3 tou3 lou6 dou1 gei2 lou5 tou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他追女孩的套路很老套。
examples.english_sentence: His pick-up lines are quite cliché.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅銷售套路好深，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 siu1 sau6 tou3 lou6 hou2 sam1, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的销售套路很深，要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: This company has elaborate sales tactics, so be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢哋嘅套路呃到啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 tou3 lou6 aak1 dou3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他们的套路骗了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't get fooled by their tricks.

english_meaning: set meal; combo meal
explanation_mandarin: 指搭配好的，包含多种食品或服务的组合，通常以优惠价格出售。
explanation_english: A set meal or combo meal is a combination of several food items or services offered together at a discounted price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想要一個A餐套餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 jat1 go3 ei1 caan1 tou3 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要一个A餐套餐。
examples.english_sentence: I would like to order set meal A.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲套餐好抵食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 tou3 caan1 hou2 dai2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的套餐很划算。
examples.english_sentence: The set meals in this restaurant are very worth the price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅套餐包埋飲品㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 tou3 caan1 baau1 maai4 jam2 ban2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的套餐包括饮料。
examples.english_sentence: Their set meal includes a drink.

english_meaning: Why; wherefore; how
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问，相当于“为什么”、“怎么”。在粤语中仍然保留古义。
explanation_english: Expresses a question, equivalent to "why" or "how". Retains its classical meaning in Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你奚唔開心呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai4 m4 hoi1 sam1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你为什么不开心啊？
examples.english_sentence: Why are you not happy?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知點解佢要咁做，我都唔知佢奚解。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 dim2 gai2 keoi5 jiu3 gam2 zou6, ngo5 dou1 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai4 gaai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不知道为什么他要这么做，我都不知道他为何如此。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know why he does that, I don't even know the reason he does that.

english_meaning: to ridicule, to mock, to deride
explanation_mandarin: 嘲笑、讥讽。
explanation_english: To mock or ridicule someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日奚落人哋啦，好唔尊重人㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai4 lok6 jan4 dei6 laa1, hou2 m4 zyun1 zung6 jan4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是嘲笑别人，很不尊重人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always mock other people; it's very disrespectful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為講錯嘢俾人奚落咗好耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 gong2 co3 je5 bei2 jan4 hai4 lok6 zo2 hou2 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他因为说错了话被别人嘲笑了很久。
examples.english_sentence: He was ridiculed for a long time because he said something wrong.

english_meaning: to establish, to lay the foundation; to offer libation
explanation_mandarin: 1. 奠定：使基础稳固。2. 奠酒：古代祭祀时，把酒浇在地上表示祭奠。
explanation_english: 1. To establish, to lay the foundation: To make the foundation solid and stable. 2. To offer libation: In ancient rituals, to pour wine on the ground as a form of sacrifice and remembrance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為公司嘅成功奠定咗基礎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai4 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1 din6 ding6 zo2 gei1 co2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为公司的成功奠定了基础。
examples.english_sentence: He laid the foundation for the company's success.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺儀式入面，佢哋會奠酒嚟紀念先人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 ji4 sik1 jap6 min6, keoi5 dei6 wui5 din6 zau2 lai4 gei3 nim6 sin1 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在仪式中，他们会奠酒来纪念先人。
examples.english_sentence: During the ceremony, they will offer libation to commemorate their ancestors.

english_meaning: to lay a foundation (stone); to break ground; groundbreaking ceremony

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個彎位好奪命㗎，揸車要小心啲。

examples.english_sentence: This bend is very dangerous, you need to be careful when driving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啲辣麵辣到奪命咁滯。

mandarin_meaning: 致命四招; 快速解决问题的四个步骤

explanation_english: Originally referring to four lethal moves in martial arts that can quickly defeat an opponent. Nowadays, it is often used to describe four methods or steps to quickly solve a problem, often with a humorous or exaggerated tone.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 要完成这个项目，我打算用夺命四式：首先头脑风暴，然后分工，再跟进进度，最后庆功宴！
examples.english_sentence: To complete this project, I plan to use the 'lethal four moves': first brainstorm, then delegate, then follow up on the progress, and finally have a celebration party!

examples.english_sentence: He used the 'lethal four moves' to study before the exam and finally got an A.

mandarin_meaning: 夺命连环call (夺命追魂连环call)

explanation_english: Describes someone calling relentlessly and incessantly, often to the point of being annoying or suffocating. It carries a sense of exaggeration and humor, implying that the person is being chased relentlessly by calls, as if haunted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日奪命追魂call，真係頂唔順。

examples.english_sentence: She has always wanted to play the female lead, but there aren't many opportunities.

english_meaning: woman, female
explanation_mandarin: 指女性，成年女性
explanation_english: Refers to a female, an adult female.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好叻嘅女人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 lek1 ge3 neoi5 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一个很能干的女人。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very capable woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個女人著住紅色裙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 neoi5 jan2 zoek3 zyu6 hung4 sik1 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个女人穿着红色的裙子。
examples.english_sentence: That woman is wearing a red dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好睇小女人啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tai2 siu2 neoi5 jan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要小看女人啊！
examples.english_sentence: Don't underestimate women!

english_meaning: femininity, womanliness
explanation_mandarin: 指女性所特有的魅力和气质。
explanation_english: Refers to the charm and qualities that are specifically associated with women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有女人味，好多男仔都鍾意佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 neoi5 jan2 mei6, hou2 do1 naam4 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她很有女人味，很多男孩子都喜欢她。
examples.english_sentence: She is very feminine; many boys like her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 着咗呢條裙，成個人即刻變得有女人味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoek3 zo2 ni1 tiu4 kwan4, seng4 go3 jan4 zik1 hak1 bin3 dak1 jau5 neoi5 jan2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 穿了这条裙子，整个人立刻变得有女人味。
examples.english_sentence: Wearing this dress, the whole person immediately becomes more feminine.

english_meaning: effeminate; sissy
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性行为举止、言语或外貌像女性。
explanation_english: Describes a male who behaves, speaks, or looks like a female; effeminate or sissy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢成日翹起隻手指尾，好似女人型咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 kiu5 hei2 zek3 sau2 zi2 mei1, hou2 ci5 neoi5 jan2 jing4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话总是翘起小拇指，很娘娘腔。
examples.english_sentence: He always raises his pinky finger when he speaks, it's so effeminate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁女人型啦，男人老狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 neoi5 jan2 jing4 laa1, naam4 jan2 lou5 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么娘娘腔了，一个大男人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so effeminate, you're a grown man.

jyutping: neoi5 jan2 sam1, hoi2 dai2 zam1
mandarin_meaning: 女人心，海底针 (nǚ rén xīn, hǎi dǐ zhēn)
english_meaning: A woman's heart is like a needle at the bottom of the sea (hard to fathom); a woman's mind is unfathomable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女人的心思难以捉摸，像海底的针一样，难以寻找。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's thoughts and feelings as being difficult to understand, like trying to find a needle at the bottom of the sea.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，女人心，海底針，你永遠都唔知佢諗緊乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, neoi5 jan2 sam1, hoi2 dai2 zam1, nei5 wing2 jyun5 dou1 m4 zi1 geoi5 lam2 gan2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，女人心，海底针，你永远都不知道她在想什么。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, a woman's heart is like a needle at the bottom of the sea, you never know what she's thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好估佢嘅諗法喇，女人心，海底針，你估唔到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gu2 geoi5 ge3 lam2 faat3 laa1, neoi5 jan2 sam1, hoi2 dai2 zam1, nei5 gu2 m4 dou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别猜她的想法了，女人心，海底针，你猜不到的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't try to guess her thoughts, a woman's mind is unfathomable, you won't be able to guess it.

english_meaning: A metaphor for a clumsy, slow-witted woman; airhead (female)
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容女性笨拙、反应慢、或者比较天真。
explanation_english: Used to describe a woman who is clumsy, slow to react, or naive. It's often used in a derogatory or teasing way, implying a lack of intelligence or common sense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都烏龍百出，真係女人湯丸嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 wu1 lung4 baak3 ceot1, zan1 hai6 neoi5 jan2 tong1 jyun2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是出洋相，真是个笨女人。
examples.english_sentence: She's always making mistakes. She's such an airhead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講佢啦，佢只係比較慢熱啫，唔係女人湯丸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 zi2 hai6 bei2 gaau3 maan6 jit6 ze1, m4 hai6 neoi5 jan2 tong1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那样说她啦，她只是比较慢热而已，不是笨女人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about her. She's just a bit slow to warm up, she's not an airhead.

mandarin_meaning: 女人说话不算数，靠不住
english_meaning: A woman's words are unreliable/untrustworthy; a woman's promise is not worth much
explanation_mandarin: 形容女人说话不算数，经常变卦，靠不住。带贬义。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a woman's words as unreliable, often changing her mind and being untrustworthy. It carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢嘅承諾啦，女人湯圓嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 ge3 sing4 nok6 laa1, neoi5 jan2 tong1 jyun2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别相信她的承诺了，女人说的话靠不住。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust her promises, a woman's words are unreliable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講就兇狠，到時又縮沙，真係女人湯圓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 zau6 hung1 han2, dou3 si4 jau6 suk1 saa1, zan1 hai6 neoi5 jan2 tong1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说的时候很凶，到时候又退缩，真是说话不算数。
examples.english_sentence: She speaks fiercely, but retreats when the time comes, truly a woman's words are unreliable.

english_meaning: Popularity with women; having a way with women; having good rapport with women.
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性很受女性欢迎，能容易地吸引女性的注意和好感。
explanation_english: Describes a man who is popular with women, easily attracting their attention and fondness; having good rapport and relationships with women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好有女人緣，個個女仔都鍾意同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 neoi5 jan2 jyun4, go3 go3 neoi5 zai2 dou1 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很有女人缘，每个女孩都喜欢和他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He really has a way with women, every girl likes to chat with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明咁靚仔又識氹女仔，梗係有女人緣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 gam3 leng3 zai2 jau6 sik1 tam5 neoi5 zai2, gang2 hai6 jau5 neoi5 jan2 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明那么帅又会哄女孩子，肯定有女人缘啦。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is so handsome and knows how to please girls, of course he has popularity with women.

mandarin_meaning: 女人街 (香港的街道名称)
english_meaning: Ladies' Market (street name in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港旺角的一条著名街道，主要售卖女性服装、饰品、化妆品等。
explanation_english: A famous street in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, mainly selling women's clothing, accessories, cosmetics, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去女人街行下，睇下有冇嘢啱買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 heoi3 neoi5 jan2 gaai1 haang4 haa5, tai2 haa5 jau5 mou5 je5 ngaam1 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去女人街逛逛，看看有没有什么适合买的。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to Ladies' Market tonight and see if there's anything we want to buy.

english_meaning: girl
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a young female.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個女仔好靚女啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 neoi5 zai2 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个女孩很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: That girl is very pretty!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，成日同啲女仔玩煮飯仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 neoi5 zai2 waan2 zyu2 faan6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，经常和女孩子们玩过家家。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often played house with the girls.

mandarin_meaning: 女孩子气的家/全是女孩子的家
english_meaning: A girly house / A house full of girls / a house predominantly occupied or styled for girls and women
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个家庭或地方，里面住的多数是女性，或者内部装饰和风格非常女性化。
explanation_english: Describes a home or place where the majority of inhabitants are female or where the interior decor and style are very feminine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企真係女仔之家，周圍都係粉紅色。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 zan1 hai6 neoi5 zai2 zi1 gaa1, zau1 wai4 dou1 hai6 fan2 hung4 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她家真是女孩子之家，到处都是粉红色。
examples.english_sentence: Her house is really a girly house; everything is pink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從阿婆走咗之後，呢度就變成女仔之家喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi6 cung4 aa3 po4 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, ni1 dou6 zau6 bin3 sing4 neoi5 zai2 zi1 gaa1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 自从奶奶走了之后，这里就变成女孩子之家了。
examples.english_sentence: Since grandma passed away, this has become a house full of girls.

english_meaning: female companion, girlfriend, date
explanation_mandarin: 女性的伴侣；女朋友；约会对象。
explanation_english: A female companion; girlfriend; date.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴晚帶咗個女伴去睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 maan1 daai3 zo2 go3 neoi5 bun6 heoi3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨晚带了一个女伴去看电影。
examples.english_sentence: He brought a female companion to the cinema last night.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅女伴好靚女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 neoi5 bun6 hou2 leng3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的女朋友很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: His girlfriend is very pretty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢今晚冇女伴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gam1 maan1 mou5 neoi5 bun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他今晚没有女伴。
examples.english_sentence: He said he doesn't have a female companion tonight.

english_meaning: actress, female performer (especially in traditional Chinese opera)
explanation_mandarin: 指从事表演艺术的女性，尤指传统戏曲中的女演员。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who engages in performing arts, especially a female actor in traditional Chinese opera.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候就開始做粵劇女伶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 zau6 hoi1 ci2 zou6 jyut6 kek6 neoi5 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候就开始做粤剧女演员。
examples.english_sentence: She started working as a Cantonese opera actress when she was young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢齣戲嘅女主角係一個好出名嘅女伶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ceot1 hei3 ge3 neoi5 zyu2 gok3 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 neoi5 ling4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏的女主角是一位很有名的女演员。
examples.english_sentence: The leading actress in this play is a very famous female performer.

english_meaning: female domestic helper, maid
explanation_mandarin: 指从事家务劳动的女性佣人，多为外籍人士。
explanation_english: Refers to a female domestic worker, often of foreign origin, who performs household chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企請咗個賓妹做女傭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ceng2 zo2 go3 ban1 mui1 zou6 neoi5 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家请了一个菲律宾女佣。
examples.english_sentence: Our family hired a Filipina maid as a domestic helper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多家庭都有請女傭幫手照顧小朋友同打理家務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ho2 do1 gaa1 ting4 dou1 jau5 ceng2 neoi5 jung6 bong1 sau2 ziu3 gu3 siu2 pang4 jau5 tung4 daa2 lei5 gaa1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多家庭都请女佣帮忙照顾小孩和打理家务。
examples.english_sentence: Many families in Hong Kong hire domestic helpers to help take care of children and manage household chores.

english_meaning: maid, female servant
explanation_mandarin: 指从事家务劳动的女性雇佣人员。
explanation_english: Refers to a female hired worker who performs household chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請咗個女僕返嚟幫手湊小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 go3 neoi5 puk6 faan1 lai4 bong1 sau2 cou3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她请了个女佣回来帮忙照顾孩子。
examples.english_sentence: She hired a maid to help take care of the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅大戶人家通常都會請好多女僕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1 tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 ceng2 hou2 do1 neoi5 puk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时候的有钱人家通常都会请很多女佣。
examples.english_sentence: Wealthy families in the old days usually hired many maids.

mandarin_meaning: 女演员, 尤指AV女演员
english_meaning: Actress, especially an AV actress (Adult Video Actress)
explanation_mandarin: 指女演员，但通常特指在日本成人影片（AV）中演出的女演员。
explanation_english: Refers to an actress, but usually specifically refers to an actress who performs in Japanese Adult Videos (AV). It's a loanword from Japanese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前係日本嘅女優。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 hai6 jat6 bun2 ge3 neoi5 jau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前是日本的AV女演员。
examples.english_sentence: She used to be an AV actress in Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日睇啲女優啦，出去做啲有意義嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 tai2 di1 neoi5 jau2 laa1, cheut1 heoi3 zou6 di1 jau5 ji3 yi6 ge3 ye5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是看那些AV女演员啦，出去做一些有意义的事情吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always watch those AV actresses, go out and do something meaningful.

english_meaning: daughter
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的孩子。
explanation_english: A female offspring; a girl or woman in relation to her parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我得一個女兒，佢今年十歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dak1 jat1 go3 neoi5 ji4, keoi5 gam1 nin4 sap6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我只有一个女儿，她今年十岁。
examples.english_sentence: I only have one daughter, and she's ten years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋好錫佢個女兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 neoi5 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们很疼爱他们的女儿。
examples.english_sentence: They are very fond of their daughter.

english_meaning: Daughter Red (wine)
explanation_mandarin: 一种绍兴黄酒，通常在女儿出生时酿造，待女儿出嫁时饮用，象征着对女儿的祝福。
explanation_english: A type of Shaoxing rice wine. Traditionally, this wine is brewed when a daughter is born and saved until her wedding day, symbolizing blessings for the daughter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋阿爺話細個阿婆生咗我阿媽嗰陣，已經開始釀女兒紅喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 aa3 je4 waa6 sai3 go3 aa3 po4 saang1 zo2 ngo5 aa3 maa1 go2 zan6, ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 joeng6 neoi5 ji4 hung4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷说小时候我奶奶生了我妈的时候，就已经开始酿女儿红了。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather said that when my grandmother gave birth to my mother when he was young, they already started brewing Daughter Red wine.

english_meaning: To describe a woman as weak, spoiled, or overly sensitive; girly; princess-like.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性比较娇气，遇到困难容易退缩，依赖性强，缺乏独立性，有时带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is perceived as delicate, easily overwhelmed by difficulties, dependent, lacking independence, and sometimes used in a derogatory way. The nuance is someone who avoids hardship and expects to be taken care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁大個人都仲係咁女包，咩都靠屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 daai6 go3 jan4 dou1 zung6 hai6 gam3 neoi5 baau1, me1 dou1 kaau3 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么大的人了还这么娇气，什么都靠家里人。
examples.english_sentence: She's so old, but still so girly, relying on her family for everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁女包啦，自己搞掂佢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 neoi5 baau1 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么娇气啦，自己搞定它！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so girly, handle it yourself!

english_meaning: girlfriend
explanation_mandarin: 女性朋友，特指恋爱关系中的女性伴侣。
explanation_english: A female friend, specifically a female partner in a romantic relationship; girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日同我女友去咗睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 tung4 ngo5 neoi5 jau5 heoi3 zo2 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天和我女朋友去看电影了。
examples.english_sentence: I went to see a movie with my girlfriend yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有個好靚嘅女友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jau5 hou2 leng3 ge3 neoi5 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一个很漂亮的女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very beautiful girlfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我仲未有女友呀，好dry呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung6 mei6 jau5 neoi5 jau5 aa3, hou2 dry aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我还没有女朋友，好干燥啊！
examples.english_sentence: I still don't have a girlfriend, it's so dry (lonely)!

english_meaning: lesbian
explanation_mandarin: 指女性同性恋者。
explanation_english: Refers to a female homosexual person; a lesbian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好坦白嘅女同志。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 taan2 baak6 ge3 neoi5 tung4 zi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一个很坦诚的女同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very open lesbian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家社會對女同志嘅接受程度高咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 se5 wui2 deoi3 neoi5 tung4 zi3 ge3 zip3 sau6 cing4 dou6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会对女同性恋的接受程度高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, society's acceptance of lesbians is much higher.

english_meaning: women's singles (in sports)
explanation_mandarin: 指体育比赛项目中的女子单打项目。
explanation_english: Refers to the women's singles event in sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴日睇咗場羽毛球女單決賽，好精彩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 jat6 tai2 zo2 coeng4 wu5 mou4 kau4 neoi5 daan1 kyut3 coi3, hou2 zing1 coi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨天看了场羽毛球女子单打决赛，很精彩啊！
examples.english_sentence: I watched the badminton women's singles final yesterday, it was amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年目標係拎到奧運女單金牌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 muk6 biu1 hai6 ling1 dou2 ou3 wan6 neoi5 daan1 gam1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今年的目标是拿到奥运会女子单打金牌。
examples.english_sentence: Her goal this year is to win the Olympic women's singles gold medal.

english_meaning: girl group
explanation_mandarin: 指由多名女性成员组成的音乐或表演团体。

english_meaning: lady, madam, woman

examples.cantonese_sentence: 各位先生、女士，歡迎嚟到我哋嘅餐廳！

mandarin_meaning: 女大不中留 (nǚ dà bù zhōng liú)
english_meaning: A daughter will not stay forever once she's grown up; daughters eventually leave the nest.
explanation_mandarin: 女儿长大后，总要离开父母，嫁人或独立生活。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the natural tendency of daughters to leave their parents' home once they reach adulthood, typically to get married or live independently. It emphasizes that daughters won't stay under their parents' roof forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都話女大不中留㗎啦，佢哋結咗婚咪搬走囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 waa6 neoi5 daai6 bat1 zung1 lau4 gaa3 laa1, keoi5 dei6 git3 zo2 fan1 mai1 bun1 zau2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都说女大不中留嘛，她们结婚了就会搬走的。
examples.english_sentence: It's always said that daughters leave the nest when they're grown up, they'll move out once they're married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我明女大不中留嘅道理，但係真係有啲唔捨得個女嫁出去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ming4 neoi5 daai6 bat1 zung1 lau4 ge3 dou6 lei5, daan6 hai6 zan1 hai6 jau5 di1 m4 se2 dak1 go3 neoi2 gaa3 ceot1 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明白女大不中留的道理，但是真的很舍不得女儿嫁出去。
examples.english_sentence: I understand the principle that daughters leave the nest when they're grown up, but I really can't bear to see my daughter get married and leave.

english_meaning: A girl changes a lot between childhood and adulthood; a girl changes dramatically as she grows up.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女孩在成长过程中，容貌和气质变化很大。
explanation_english: Describes the significant changes in a girl's appearance and demeanor as she matures from childhood to adulthood. It often implies a positive transformation, highlighting how a girl can become much more beautiful or sophisticated over time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時好似唔係咁靚，但係女大十八變，而家真係靚女嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 hou2 ci5 m4 hai6 gam3 leng3, daan6 hai6 neoi5 daai6 sap6 baat3 bin3, ji4 gaa1 zan1 hai6 leng3 neoi2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候好像不是那么漂亮，但是女大十八变，现在真是个美女。
examples.english_sentence: She didn't seem that pretty when she was little, but as the saying goes, a girl changes a lot as she grows up, and now she's a real beauty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，你個女大個咗咁多，真係女大十八變，認唔到佢喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, nei5 go3 neoi2 daai6 go3 zo2 gam3 do1, zan1 hai6 neoi5 daai6 sap6 baat3 bin3, ying6 m4 dou2 keoi5 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，你女儿长大这么多了，真是女大十八变，都认不出她了！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, your daughter has grown up so much! She's really changed a lot as she's grown, I can barely recognize her!

english_meaning: A daughter should be married off when she grows up; It's time for a daughter to get married when she's reached a marriageable age.
explanation_mandarin: 形容女儿长大后就应该出嫁，指女儿到了结婚的年龄。
explanation_english: Describes the idea that a daughter should get married when she reaches a marriageable age. It's a traditional saying emphasizing the importance of marriage for women at a certain age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都講女大當嫁，想我快啲結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 neoi5 daai6 dong1 gaa3, soeng2 ngo5 faai3 di1 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是说女大当嫁，想让我快点结婚。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always says a daughter should be married off when she grows up, she wants me to get married soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋個女仲後生，但屋企人都覺得女大當嫁，開始安排佢哋相睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 go3 neoi5 zung6 hau6 saang1, daan6 uk1 kei2 jan4 dou1 gok3 dak1 neoi5 daai6 dong1 gaa3, hoi1 chi2 on1 paai4 keoi5 dei6 soeng1 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们的女儿还年轻，但是家人都觉得女大当嫁，开始安排他们相亲。
examples.english_sentence: Although their daughter is still young, the family believes that it's time for her to get married, and they are starting to arrange blind dates for her.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人关注女权问题。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people pay attention to women's rights issues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要爭取更多女權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zaang1 ceoi2 gang3 do1 neoi5 kyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要争取更多的女权。
examples.english_sentence: We need to fight for more women's rights.

english_meaning: Queen
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义指女性的君主。 在口语中，也指在恋爱关系中占据主导地位的女性，或是指非常自信、有气场的女性。
explanation_english: Literally means a female monarch. In colloquial Cantonese, it also refers to a dominant female partner in a relationship, or a confident and charismatic woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢男朋友好聽佢話，成日俾人笑佢係女王。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 hou2 teng1 keoi5 waa2, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 siu3 keoi5 hai6 neoi5 wong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友很听她的话，经常被人笑是女王。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend listens to her a lot; people often laugh and say she's a queen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有氣勢，好似個女王咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 hei3 sai3, hou2 ci5 go3 neoi5 wong4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在公司很有气势，像个女王一样。
examples.english_sentence: She has a very strong presence in the company, like a queen.

english_meaning: female student, girl
explanation_mandarin: 指女学生或年轻的女孩。
explanation_english: Refers to a female student or a young girl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個好聰明嘅女生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hou2 cung1 ming4 ge3 neoi5 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一个很聪明的女生。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very smart female student.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校有好多女生讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 jau5 hou2 do1 neoi5 sang1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间学校有很多女生读书。
examples.english_sentence: There are many female students studying at this school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候係個好怕醜嘅女生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hai6 go3 hou2 paa3 cau2 ge3 neoi5 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候是个很害羞的女生。
examples.english_sentence: I was a very shy girl when I was young.

english_meaning: A daughter's affections turn outward (towards her husband and his family)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女儿长大后，心思和感情更多地放在夫家，而对自己的娘家关心较少。通常带有一些无奈或埋怨的意味。
explanation_english: Describes the tendency of a daughter, after marriage, to prioritize her husband and his family over her own family. Often carries a sense of resignation or complaint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，啲人成日話女生外向，結咗婚嘅女咪一樣成日返老爺奶奶屋企囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 neoi5 sang1 ngoi6 hoeng3, git3 zo2 fun1 ge3 neoi2 mai1 jat1 joeng6 seng4 jat6 faan1 lou5 je4 naai4 naai4 uk1 kei2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，人们总是说女大不中留，结了婚的女儿还不是一样总是回公婆家。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, people always say a daughter's affections turn outward, but married daughters are the same, always going back to her in-laws' home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講啦，雖然佢嫁咗人，但係都成日返嚟探你哋，唔算係女生外向嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1, seoi1 jin4 keoi5 gaa3 zo2 jan4, daan6 hai6 dou1 seng4 jat6 faan1 lai4 taam3 nei5 dei6, m4 syun3 hai6 neoi5 sang1 ngoi6 hoeng3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说啦，虽然她嫁人了，但是也经常回来探望你们，不算女大不中留。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, even though she's married, she still often comes back to visit you, it doesn't count as a daughter's affections turning outward.

english_meaning: women's circles; the world of women; the female sex (collectively)
explanation_mandarin: 指妇女的社会、群体，或与妇女相关的事物。
explanation_english: Refers to the social circles, groups, or affairs related to women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺女界好出名㗎，做咗好多婦女權益嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 neoi5 gaai3 hou2 ceot1 ming4 gaa3, zou6 zo2 hou2 do1 fu5 neoi5 kuen4 jik1 ge3 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在妇女界很有名，做了很多妇女权益的事情。
examples.english_sentence: She is very famous in women's circles, having done a lot for women's rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家越來越多女仔投身男界嘅行業喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 yut6 lei4 yut6 do1 neoi5 zai2 tau4 san1 naam4 gaai3 ge3 hang4 jip6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在越来越多的女孩子投身男性主导的行业了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, more and more girls are joining male-dominated industries.

english_meaning: Queen
explanation_mandarin: 女性君主。也指在某个领域非常杰出、具有领导地位的女性。
explanation_english: Female monarch; queen. Can also refer to a woman who is highly successful or dominant in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司係個女皇，咩都佢話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hai6 go3 neoi5 wong4, me1 dou1 keoi5 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在公司里是个女王，什么都她说了算。
examples.english_sentence: She's like a queen in the company; she's in charge of everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我婆婆成日話自己係屋企嘅女皇，要我哋聽佢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 po4 po2 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 hai6 uk1 kei2 ge3 neoi5 wong4, jiu3 ngo5 dei6 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我婆婆经常说自己是家里的女王，要我们听她的话。
examples.english_sentence: My grandma always says she's the queen of the house and we have to listen to her.

english_meaning: Queen's Head (hairstyle); refers to someone who is bossy, demanding, or high-maintenance
explanation_mandarin: 原本指一种发型，形状类似英国邮票上的女王头像。现在多用来形容一个人（通常是女性）非常霸道、高傲、爱指使人。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a hairstyle resembling the profile of the Queen on British stamps. Now commonly used to describe someone (usually a woman) who is bossy, demanding, or high-maintenance; a 'queen' in the sense of someone who always wants their own way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係女皇頭嚟㗎，咩都要跟佢意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 neoi5 wong4 tau4 lei4 gaa3, me1 dou1 jiu3 gan1 keoi5 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她真的是个女王头，什么都要按照她的意思。
examples.english_sentence: She's a real queen, everything has to be done her way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁女皇頭啦，試下體諒下人哋啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 neoi5 wong4 tau4 laa1, si3 haa5 tai2 loeng6 haa5 yan4 dei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么女王头了，试着体谅一下别人吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a queen, try to be considerate of others.

english_meaning: Jurchen (a Tungusic people who founded the Jin dynasty in northern China)
explanation_mandarin: 指历史上居住在东北地区的通古斯族群，建立了金朝。
explanation_english: Refers to the Jurchen people, a Tungusic people who historically inhabited the Northeast region of China and founded the Jin dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 女眞人以前喺東北建立咗金朝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: neoi5 zan1 jan4 ji5 cin4 hai2 dung1 bak1 gin3 lap6 zo2 gam1 ciu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 女真人在以前在东北建立了金朝。
examples.english_sentence: The Jurchens established the Jin dynasty in the Northeast region in the past.

english_meaning: Jurchen (historical people in Northeast Asia)
explanation_mandarin: 古代东北亚的一个民族，是清朝的建立者。
explanation_english: An ancient people of Northeast Asia, the founders of the Qing dynasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 滿族人嘅祖先係女真人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mun5 zuk6 jan4 ge3 zou2 sin1 hai6 neoi5 zan1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 满族人的祖先是女真人。
examples.english_sentence: The ancestors of the Manchus were the Jurchens.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歷史書有記載女真族嘅歷史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lik6 si2 syu1 jau5 gei3 zai2 neoi5 zan1 zuk6 ge3 lik6 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 历史书有记载女真族的历史。
examples.english_sentence: History books record the history of the Jurchen people.

english_meaning: Goddess, idolized woman
explanation_mandarin: 指男性心目中非常完美，遥不可及的女性，通常容貌出众，气质高雅。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman who is considered perfect and unattainable in the eyes of men, typically with outstanding looks and elegant demeanor. It's often used to describe an idolized woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺我心目中係永遠嘅女神。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ngo5 sam1 muk6 zung1 hai6 wing5 jyun5 ge3 neoi5 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在我的心目中永远是女神。
examples.english_sentence: She is my goddess forever.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一出現，成班男仔都當佢係女神咁拜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 ceot1 jin6, sing4 baan1 naam4 zai2 dou1 dong3 keoi5 hai6 neoi5 san4 gam2 baai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一出现，整群男生都把她当成女神一样崇拜。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as she appeared, the whole group of boys worshipped her like a goddess.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將人哋擺上神枱，佢都係普通人啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 jan4 dei6 baai2 soeng5 san4 toi2, keoi5 dou1 hai6 pou2 tung1 jan4 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把别人捧上神坛，她也是普通人而已。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put people on a pedestal, she's just an ordinary person.

mandarin_meaning: 豪华的、适合女神居住的套房
english_meaning: Luxury suite fit for a goddess; lavish accommodations designed for a woman perceived as very attractive and desirable.
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常豪华，装修精致，适合女性居住，尤其是形容受到男性追捧、视为女神的女性居住的套房。通常暗示价格昂贵，设施齐全，充满浪漫情调。
explanation_english: Describes a luxurious and exquisitely decorated suite suitable for a woman, particularly one who is highly sought after and considered a goddess by men. It usually implies a high price, complete facilities, and a romantic atmosphere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢男朋友為咗氹佢開心，特登訂咗間女神套房俾佢住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 wai6 zo2 tam2 keoi5 hoi1 sam1, dak6 deng6 ding6 zo2 gaan1 neoi5 san4 tou3 fong2 bei2 keoi5 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友为了哄她开心，特意订了一间女神套房给她住。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend specially booked a goddess suite for her to stay in to make her happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間酒店啲宣傳相影到啲套房好似女神套房咁，但係實際上差好遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zau2 dim3 di1 syun1 cyun4 soeng2 ying2 dou3 di1 tou3 fong2 hou2 ci5 neoi5 san4 tou3 fong2 gam2, daan6 hai6 sat6 zeoi3 soeng6 caa1 hou2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的宣传照片把套房拍得像女神套房一样，但实际上差很远。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel's promotional photos make the suites look like goddess suites, but in reality, they are very different.

english_meaning: girl; female child
explanation_mandarin: 指年纪尚小的女性儿童。
explanation_english: Refers to a young female child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間幼稚園有好多女童讀緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 jau1 zi1 yun4 jau5 hou2 do1 neoi5 tung4 duk6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间幼儿园有很多女童在读书。
examples.english_sentence: There are many girls studying in this kindergarten.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 走失嗰個女童已經搵返喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 sat1 go2 go3 neoi5 tung4 ji5 ging1 wan2 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 走失的那个女童已经找到了。
examples.english_sentence: The missing girl has been found.

english_meaning: Girls' Reformatory; Girls' Industrial School
explanation_mandarin: 收容和教育有不良行为或者触犯法律的未成年女性的机构。
explanation_english: An institution for the care and education of young girls with behavioral problems or who have committed offenses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嘅時候成日逃學，結果俾人送咗去女童院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 sing4 jat6 tou4 hok6, git3 gwo2 bei2 jan4 sung3 zo2 heoi3 neoi5 tung4 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候经常逃学，结果被人送去了女子少年教养院。
examples.english_sentence: She often skipped school when she was little, and as a result, she was sent to a girls' reformatory.

english_meaning: needlework; sewing; women's work (referring to sewing, embroidery, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性所做的纺织、缝纫、刺绣等手工活。
explanation_english: Refers to the traditional crafts and skills practiced by women, such as spinning, weaving, sewing, embroidery, and other related needlework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿嫲好叻做女紅，佢整嘅衫好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa4 hou2 lek1 zou6 neoi5 gung1, keoi5 zing2 ge3 saam1 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶很擅长女红，她做的衣服很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma is very good at needlework; the clothes she makes are beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲後生女好少學女紅㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 neoi2 hou2 siu2 hok6 neoi5 gung1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在年轻女孩很少学女红了。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, young girls rarely learn needlework.

english_meaning: female beauty; sensuality; sexual allure of women
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的美貌和吸引力，多含贬义，指沉迷于女色。
explanation_english: Refers to the beauty and attractiveness of women, often with a negative connotation, implying indulgence in female beauty or lust.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就沉迷女色，真係可惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 cam4 mai4 neoi5 sik1, zan1 hai6 ho2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就沉迷女色，真是可惜。
examples.english_sentence: It's such a pity that he's indulged in female beauty at such a young age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日掛住女色，公司嘅嘢都唔理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 gwaa3 zyu6 neoi5 sik1, gung1 si1 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板整天惦记着女色，公司的事情都不管。
examples.english_sentence: The boss is always thinking about women, neglecting company matters.

english_meaning: women's clothing; women's wear
explanation_mandarin: 女性穿的服装。
explanation_english: Clothing designed for and typically worn by women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭賣好多唔同款式嘅女裝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 maai6 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 kwan2 sik1 ge3 neoi5 zong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家商店卖很多不同款式的女装。
examples.english_sentence: This shop sells a lot of different styles of women's clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着咗一套好靚嘅女裝返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 jat1 tou3 hou2 leng3 ge3 neoi5 zong1 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一套很漂亮的女装上班。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a very beautiful set of women's clothing to work today.

english_meaning: women's football (soccer)
explanation_mandarin: 指女子参与的足球运动或女子足球队。
explanation_english: Refers to women's football (soccer) or a women's football team.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚一齊睇女足嘅比賽啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 jat1 cai4 tai2 neoi5 zuk1 ge3 bei2 coi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚一起看女子足球比赛吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's watch the women's football match together tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港女足嘅實力近年提升咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 neoi5 zuk1 ge3 sat6 lik6 gan1 nin4 tai4 sing1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港女子足球的实力近年来提升了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The strength of Hong Kong women's football has improved a lot in recent years.

english_meaning: girl, young woman
explanation_mandarin: 指年輕的女子。在香港較少使用，通常用於文學作品或較為正式的場合。
explanation_english: Refers to a young woman. In Hong Kong Cantonese, it is less frequently used in everyday conversation and more common in literature or more formal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好有氣質嘅女郎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 hei3 zik1 ge3 neoi5 long4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是一个很有气质的女子。
examples.english_sentence: She is a very elegant young woman.

english_meaning: female ghost; female spirit
explanation_mandarin: 指女性的鬼魂。
explanation_english: Refers to the ghost of a female.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋聽講有女鬼出沒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ting1 gong2 jau5 neoi5 gwai2 ceot1 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这间屋子有女鬼出没。
examples.english_sentence: It's said that this house is haunted by a female ghost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢見到個女鬼喺條街度行嚟行去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 gin3 dou2 go3 neoi5 gwai2 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他看见一个女鬼在街上走来走去。
examples.english_sentence: He said he saw a female ghost walking back and forth on the street.

english_meaning: Dragon Lady; female devil; bossy woman
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常厉害、霸道、专断独行的女性领导或女性。
explanation_english: Describes a powerful, domineering, and autocratic female leader or woman, often with negative connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係公司嘅女魔頭，個個都驚咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 gung1 si1 ge3 neoi5 mo1 tau4, go3 go3 dou1 geng1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是公司的女魔头，每个人都怕她。
examples.english_sentence: She's the dragon lady of the company; everyone is afraid of her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惡啦，唔好做女魔頭啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 laa1, m4 hou2 zou6 neoi5 mo1 tau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么凶啦，不要做女魔头啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so fierce, don't be a dragon lady.

english_meaning: slave, servant
explanation_mandarin: 指失去自由，受人驱使的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has lost their freedom and is forced to serve another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲人如果冇錢就會賣身做奴隸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 jyu4 gwo2 mou5 cin2 zau6 wui5 maai6 san1 zou6 nou4 dai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时的人如果没钱就会卖身做奴隶。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, people would sell themselves into slavery if they had no money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁奴性啦，唔使乜都聽晒老闆嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 nou4 sing3 laa1, m4 sai2 mat1 dou1 teng1晒 lou5 baan2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么奴性啦，不用什么都听老板的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so subservient! You don't have to listen to everything the boss says.

english_meaning: servant, slave
explanation_mandarin: 指受人奴役，被迫从事劳动的男仆或女仆。
explanation_english: A male or female servant or slave who is forced to work and subjected to servitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅大戶人家好多都有奴僕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 daai6 wu6 jan4 gaa1 hou2 do1 dou1 jau5 nou4 puk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 旧时的大户人家很多都有奴仆。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, many wealthy families had servants.

english_meaning: slave; servant (historical term, now mostly used figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 古代指被主人役使的男女。现在多用于讽刺或自嘲，表示卑微、顺从。
explanation_english: Historically refers to male and female servants who were made to work for their masters. Nowadays, it is mostly used sarcastically or self-deprecatingly to indicate being humble and submissive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁奴婢啦，有咩唔滿意咪直接講囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 nou4 bei6 laa1, jau5 me1 m4 mun5 ji3 mai6 zik6 zip3 gong2 lo1.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so subservient, just say directly if you're not satisfied.

examples.english_sentence: He's like a slave in front of his boss, he listens to everything he says.

english_meaning: to enslave; to put into servitude; enslavement; servitude
explanation_mandarin: 使人成为奴隶，或处于奴隶地位；指被剥夺自由，受强制支配的地位或状态。
explanation_english: To enslave someone; to put someone into a state of servitude; the state of being enslaved or in servitude, where one is deprived of freedom and subjected to forced control.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋被迫做嘢，受盡奴役。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 bei6 bik1 zou6 je5, sau6 zeon6 nou4 yik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们被迫工作，受尽奴役。
examples.english_sentence: They were forced to work and suffered enslavement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰啲工人長期受到剝削同奴役。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 di1 gung1 jan4 coeng4 kei4 sau6 dou3 bok1 syut3 tung4 nou4 yik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些工人长期受到剥削和奴役。
examples.english_sentence: Those workers have been subjected to exploitation and enslavement for a long time.

english_meaning: servility, slavishness, submissiveness
explanation_mandarin: 指像奴隶一样顺从、缺乏自主意识和反抗精神的性格或心态。
explanation_english: Refers to a character or mentality that is obedient like a slave, lacking autonomy, independent thinking, and a spirit of resistance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁聽老細話，真係奴性重。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么奴性，要有自己的想法。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so submissive, have your own opinions.

explanation_mandarin: 指那些为了讨好上级，不顾尊严，极力奉承的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who abandons dignity and excessively flatters superiors in order to please them; a sycophant, lackey, or bootlicker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老細面前擦鞋，真係一個奴才樣。

examples.english_sentence: He's always sucking up to the boss, he really acts like a bootlicker.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做奴才，要有自己的原则。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a sycophant, have your own principles.

english_meaning: slave

explanation_english: A person who is owned by another person and forced to work for them without pay.

examples.english_sentence: He works like a slave every day, but the salary is not high.

explanation_english: 1. Milk. 2. Breast. 3. (Slang) To coddle; to be overprotective of someone; to nurse a wound/injury.

english_meaning: To suck up to the CCP (Chinese Communist Party), to be pro-CCP

explanation_english: Refers to the act of flattering and sucking up to the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and its policies for personal gain. Usually carries a derogatory connotation, accusing someone of sacrificing principles and stance in order to obtain benefits.

explanation_english: A pacifier or the nipple of a baby bottle used for babies to suck on.

explanation_mandarin: 指奸诈狡猾、擅长权谋且位高权重的人，通常带有贬义。来源于古代小说、戏曲中经常出现的奸臣形象，例如《说岳全传》中的秦桧。

examples.english_sentence: Don't trust what he says, he's obviously a Machiavellian figure.

cantonese: 奸奸狡狡朝煎晚炒，忠忠直直終歸乞食
jyutping: gaan1 gaan1 gaau2 gaau2 ziu1 zin1 maan5 caau2, zung1 zung1 zik6 zik6 zung1 gwai1 gat1 sik6
mandarin_meaning: 狡猾奸诈的人即使朝夕算计，最终富裕；忠厚老实的人到头来却一无所有。
english_meaning: The cunning and sly may scheme and calculate from dawn till dusk, but they will become rich; the honest and straightforward will eventually end up begging for food.
explanation_mandarin: 形容社会上存在的一种不公平现象。意思是说，奸诈狡猾的人，即使每天算计，想方设法占便宜，最后往往能得到好处，变得富有；而忠厚老实的人，即使安分守己，最终却可能生活困苦，一无所有。表达了一种对社会不公的无奈和讽刺。
explanation_english: Describes a societal injustice. It means that cunning and sly people, even if they scheme and try to take advantage of others daily, often end up benefiting and becoming rich. On the other hand, honest and straightforward people, even if they are content and law-abiding, may eventually live a difficult life and end up with nothing. It expresses a sense of helplessness and irony towards social injustice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，而家啲社會就係咁㗎啦，奸奸狡狡朝煎晚炒，忠忠直直終歸乞食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, ji4 gaa1 di1 se5 wui2 zau6 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1, gaan1 gaan1 gaau2 gaau2 ziu1 zin1 maan5 caau2, zung1 zung1 zik6 zik6 zung1 gwai1 gat1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，现在的社会就是这样的，狡猾奸诈的人即使朝夕算计，忠厚老实的人到头来却一无所有。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, that's how society is nowadays. The cunning and sly scheme from dawn till dusk, while the honest and straightforward end up begging.

mandarin_meaning: 奸诈的人也有失败的时候
english_meaning: Even the cunning can lose; the wicked will eventually meet their match; evil doesn't always prosper.
explanation_mandarin: 形容即使是再奸诈狡猾的人，也总会有失败的时候。意思是作恶多端终将受到惩罚，恶人自有恶报。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that even the most cunning and treacherous individuals will eventually face defeat or consequences for their actions. It implies that evil-doing will not always be successful and that there is a karmic balance or justice in the world where wrongdoing eventually catches up with perpetrators.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住呃人發達，但係奸有奸輸，最後都係俾人告到破產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nam2 zyu6 aak1 jan4 faat3 daat6, daan6 hai6 gaan1 jau5 gaan1 syu1, zeoi3 hau6 dou1 hai6 bei2 jan4 gou3 dou3 po3 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想通过欺骗别人发财，但是奸有奸输，最后还是被人告到破产。
examples.english_sentence: He thought he could get rich by scamming people, but even the cunning can lose, and he ended up being sued into bankruptcy.

english_meaning: Go for it! / Keep going! / Add oil!

explanation_english: An encouragement phrase used to motivate someone to keep going and not give up. It's similar to 'Go for it!' or 'Keep going!' and ultimately derives from Japanese (ganbatte).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 仲差少少就做完喇，奸爸爹！

examples.english_sentence: It's almost finished, keep going!

english_meaning: cunning, sly, crafty, treacherous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人为人处世非常狡猾，善于欺骗和算计他人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is cunning, sly, and uses deceptive or manipulative tactics to achieve their goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔好奸狡㗎，要小心啲啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 gaan1 gaau2 gaa3, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很狡猾，要小心点啊。
examples.english_sentence: That guy is very cunning, you need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個生意佬奸狡到死，唔好信佢講嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 saang1 ji3 lou2 gaan1 gaau2 dou3 sei2, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个商人狡猾至极，不要相信他说的东西。
examples.english_sentence: This businessman is extremely cunning, don't trust what he says.

english_meaning: to smirk maliciously; to chuckle evilly
explanation_mandarin: 指心怀鬼胎，带着恶意或阴谋的笑容。
explanation_english: To laugh in a sneaky, malicious, or wicked manner; a smirk that suggests evil intent or secret satisfaction at another's misfortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一諗到個計劃就奸笑出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 nim2 dou3 go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 gaan1 siu3 chut1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一想到那个计划就奸笑起来。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he thought of the plan, he smirked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁樣奸笑啦，好恐怖㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 joeng2 gaan1 siu3 laa1, hou2 hung2 bou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样奸笑啦，很恐怖的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't smirk like that, it's scary!

english_meaning: spy; mole; double agent; traitor
explanation_mandarin: 指暗中为敌方效力，出卖己方利益的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who secretly works for the enemy and betrays their own side's interests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，我懷疑佢係奸細嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, ngo5 waai4 ji4 keoi5 hai6 gaan1 sai3 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别相信他，我怀疑他是内奸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, I suspect he's a mole.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲講嘅就係點樣搵出公司入面嘅奸細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 gong2 ge3 zau6 hai6 dim2 joeng2 wan2 ceot1 gung1 si1 jap6 min6 ge3 gaan1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部戏讲的是如何找出公司里的内奸。
examples.english_sentence: The movie is about how to find the spy within the company.

english_meaning: crafty, cunning, sly, treacherous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人为人狡猾奸诈，善于钻空子，占便宜，心思不正。
explanation_english: Describes someone as cunning, sly, and treacherous, often taking advantage of others and having dishonest intentions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好奸茅㗎，唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaan1 maau4 gaa3, m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很狡猾，不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very cunning person, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁奸茅啦，成日諗住搵人笨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaan1 maau4 laa1, seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 jan4 ban6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么狡猾了，总是想着占别人便宜。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cunning, always thinking about taking advantage of others.

english_meaning: villain (in a drama, movie, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指影视作品、戏剧等中的反面人物，通常是使坏、作恶的角色。
explanation_english: Refers to the villainous character in movies, dramas, theatre, etc. These characters usually commit bad deeds or act maliciously.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做奸角，做得好入型入格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 zou6 gaan1 gok3, zou6 dak1 hou2 jap6 ying4 jap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是演反派角色，演得非常到位。
examples.english_sentence: He always plays villainous roles and does it very convincingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套劇嘅奸角好搶戲，風頭甚至蓋過咗主角。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 kek6 ge3 gaan1 gok3 hou2 cheung2 hei3, fung1 tau4 sim3 chi3 koi3 gwo3 zo2 zyu2 gok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部剧的那个反派角色非常抢镜，风头甚至盖过了主角。
examples.english_sentence: The villain in this drama is very attention-grabbing, even overshadowing the main character.

english_meaning: cunning plan, evil scheme, treachery, trickery
explanation_mandarin: 指阴险毒辣的计谋。
explanation_english: Refers to a sinister and malicious plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日諗埋晒啲奸計去害人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nam2 maai4 saai3 di1 gaan1 gai3 heoi3 hoi6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想一些奸计去害人。
examples.english_sentence: He always comes up with evil schemes to harm people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，佢好多奸計㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 hou2 do1 gaan1 gai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他有很多奸计的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he has many evil schemes.

english_meaning: treacherous; cunning; sly; crafty; deceitful
explanation_mandarin: 指人狡猾奸诈，不可信任。
explanation_english: Describing someone as cunning, treacherous, and untrustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好奸詐㗎，千祈唔好信佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaan1 zaa3 gaa3, cin1 kai4 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很奸诈，千万不要相信他。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very cunning person, don't trust him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁奸詐啦，做生意要老老實實。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 gaan1 zaa3 laa1, zou6 seng1 ji3 jiu3 lou5 lou5 sat6 sat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么奸诈了，做生意要老老实实。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so cunning, you need to be honest in business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅行為真係好奸詐，呃人嘅錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 hang4 wai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaan1 zaa3, aak1 jan4 ge3 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的行为真的很奸诈，骗人的钱。
examples.english_sentence: Your behaviour is truly treacherous, swindling people's money.

english_meaning: Sly person, crafty person, cunning person
explanation_mandarin: 形容人狡猾、不老实、爱耍小聪明。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is sly, dishonest, and likes to use petty tricks or cleverness to their advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係隻奸貓，成日諗住佔人哋便宜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 zek3 gaan1 maau1, seng4 jat6 lam2 zyu6 zim3 jan4 dei6 bin4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个奸诈的人，总是想着占别人的便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a sly person, always trying to take advantage of others.

english_meaning: to act shamelessly; to play the rogue; to act like a scoundrel; to deny something brazenly
explanation_mandarin: 指用不正当的手段或找借口来逃避责任或义务；形容一个人不讲道理，蛮横无理。
explanation_english: Refers to using improper means or excuses to evade responsibility or obligations; describes a person who is unreasonable and truculent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁奸賴啦，輸咗就輸咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 gaan1 laai6 laa1, syu1 zo2 zau6 syu1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么耍赖了，输了就是输了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so shameless, you lost, you lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都奸賴，啲錢借咗唔肯還。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 gaan1 laai6, di1 cin2 ze3 zo2 m4 hang2 waan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是耍赖，借了钱不肯还。
examples.english_sentence: He always acts like a rogue, borrowing money and refusing to return it.

english_meaning: Sly, deceitful, and unreasonable person; a cunning person who tries to get away with things; a cheat
explanation_mandarin: 形容人狡猾、不讲理、耍赖，想方设法占便宜，不遵守规则。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is sly, unreasonable, tries to take advantage of others, and doesn't follow the rules. They are often cunning and deceitful in their actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咪咁奸賴貓啦，做錯嘢就認咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai5 gam3 gaan1 laai6 maau1 laa3, zou6 co3 je5 zau6 jing6 zo2 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么狡猾耍赖了，做错事就承认了吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so sly and unreasonable. Just admit that you did something wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個老細成日都諗住點樣慳錢，真係奸賴貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 lou5 sai3 seng4 jat6 dou1 lam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 saan1 cin2, zan1 hai6 gaan1 laai6 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个老板总是想着怎么省钱，真是个狡猾耍赖的人。
examples.english_sentence: That boss is always thinking about how to save money. He's such a sly and deceitful person.

english_meaning: treacherous, insidious, cunning, malicious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人心术不正，居心不良，常常暗地里使坏。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is wicked, malicious, and often harms others secretly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個人好奸險㗎，小心啲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 jan4 hou2 gaan1 him2 gaa3, siu2 sam1 di1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个人很奸诈阴险的，小心他。
examples.english_sentence: That person is very treacherous, be careful of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好奸險，成日喺背後搞小動作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 gaan1 him2, seng4 jat6 hai2 bui3 hau6 gaau2 siu2 dung6 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很阴险，总是背地里搞小动作。
examples.english_sentence: He's very cunning in his work, always doing sneaky things behind people's backs.

english_meaning: crafty person, sly person, sneaky devil
explanation_mandarin: 指非常狡猾，喜欢耍手段，不值得信任的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is very crafty, likes to use tricks, and is not trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一隻奸鬼，成日諗住搵著數。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 zek3 gaan1 gwai2, seng4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 wan2 zoek3 sou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个狡猾的人，整天想着占便宜。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a sly person, always thinking about getting advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好信佢啊，佢係隻奸鬼嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 hai6 zek3 gaan1 gwai2 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要相信他，他是个奸诈的人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust him, he's a sly person.

english_meaning: she, her
explanation_mandarin: 女性第三人称代词。
explanation_english: Third-person singular feminine pronoun. Refers to a female person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅朋友，佢好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 pang4 jau5, keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是我的朋友，她很棒的。
examples.english_sentence: She is my friend. She is very capable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日見到佢同佢阿媽去咗行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 gin3 dou2 keoi5 tung4 keoi5 aa3 maa1 heoi3 zo2 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天看到她和她的妈妈去逛街了。
examples.english_sentence: I saw her and her mother go shopping yesterday.

english_meaning: they (feminine)
explanation_mandarin: 指称多个女性，第三人称复数。
explanation_english: Refers to multiple females, third person plural pronoun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 她們好熟㗎，成日一齊行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: taa1 mun4 hou2 suk6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们很熟，经常一起逛街。
examples.english_sentence: They are very close, they often go shopping together.

mandarin_meaning: 妖艳; 娇艳; 艳丽
english_meaning: gaudy; colourful; gorgeous; dazzling
explanation_mandarin: 形容颜色鲜艳、美丽。
explanation_english: Describes colours that are bright, vivid, and beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到好奼呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 caa2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得很鲜艳！
examples.english_sentence: She is wearing very brightly today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 幅畫畫得好奼，好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fuk1 waa2 waa2 dak1 hou2 caa2, hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画画得很艳丽，很吸引眼球。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is very colourful and eye-catching.

english_meaning: bright and beautiful colors (of flowers); brilliant and colorful (scenery)
explanation_mandarin: 形容各种花朵鲜艳娇美的颜色。也形容艳丽的景色。
explanation_english: Describes the bright and beautiful colors of various flowers. Also used to describe gorgeous and colorful scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 花園入面嘅花奼紫嫣紅，真係靚到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faa1 jyun4 jap6 min6 ge3 faa1 caa3 zi2 jin1 hung4, zan1 hai6 leng3 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 花园里的花姹紫嫣红，真是美极了。
examples.english_sentence: The flowers in the garden are so bright and colorful, they are incredibly beautiful.

english_meaning: good; fine; well; okay; very
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词, 副词, 动词
explanation_mandarin: 表示好的状态，认可，同意等。根据语境可以有多种含义。
explanation_english: Indicates a good state, approval, agreement, or readiness. The meaning varies depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好好呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气真好啊。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is so good today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好呀，聽日見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 aa3, ting1 jat6 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好啊，明天见。
examples.english_sentence: Okay, see you tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害的。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable.

english_meaning: Good grades; to get good grades
explanation_mandarin: 指取得好的成绩，通常在学业方面。
explanation_english: Refers to getting good grades, usually in academic studies. It's a Cantonese-English blend, using the English word "grade".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今個sem一定要好grade！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 go3 sem1 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hou2 gwaa1 dei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我这学期一定要拿好成绩！
examples.english_sentence: I must get good grades this semester!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好搏命讀書，就係想好grade啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bok3 ming6 duk6 syu1, zau6 hai6 soeng2 hou2 gwaa1 dei2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力读书，就是想拿好成绩而已。
examples.english_sentence: He studies very hard, just wants to get good grades.

english_meaning: Well-paid, good salary, good compensation
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作或职位薪水高，福利待遇好。
explanation_english: Describes a job or position that offers a high salary and good benefits; well-compensated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好pay，又有醫療福利，好多人爭住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 pe1, jau6 jau5 ji1 liu4 fuk1 lei6, hou2 do1 jan4 zaang1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作薪水高，还有医疗福利，很多人争着做。
examples.english_sentence: This job is well-paid and has medical benefits, so many people are competing for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢轉咗份好pay嘅工，而家生活好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun2 zo2 fan6 hou2 pe1 ge3 gung1, ji4 gaa1 sang1 wut6 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他换了一份薪水高的工作，现在生活好多了。
examples.english_sentence: He switched to a well-paid job, and now his life is much better.

english_meaning: Very good, awesome, great
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物非常好，很棒，通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Describes something as being very good, awesome, or great. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日個髮型好q喎!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 go3 faat3 ying4 hou2 kiu1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天的发型很棒哦!
examples.english_sentence: Your hairstyle looks great today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳啲嘢食好q好食㗎!
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 ye5 sik6 hou2 kiu1 hou2 sik6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西非常好吃!
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is so good!

english_meaning: Very...not...
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度的一种说法，强调介于好与不好之间，可以根据语境表达还不错、一般般、勉强可以等意思。中间可以插入不同的形容词。
explanation_english: Expresses a degree between good and bad, implying 'not bad,' 'so-so,' 'barely acceptable,' etc., depending on the context. An adjective is inserted in the middle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好食唔好食？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 sik6 m4 hou2 sik6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好吃不好吃？
examples.english_sentence: Is the food in this restaurant good or not?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工好做唔好做㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hou2 zou6 m4 hou2 zou6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作好做不好做啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is his job easy or difficult?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好睇唔好睇呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 tai2 m4 hou2 tai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影好看不好看啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is this movie good to watch or not?

english_meaning: not easy; with great difficulty; after a lot of trouble
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情做起来很困难，需要付出很大的努力才能完成。
explanation_english: Describes something that is difficult to do, requiring great effort to accomplish. It emphasizes the hardship and effort involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好不容易先搶到呢張演唱會嘅飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 bat1 jung4 ji6 sin1 coeng2 dou2 ni1 zoeng1 jin2 coeng3 wui2 ge3 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好不容易才抢到这张演唱会的票。
examples.english_sentence: I finally managed to snatch this concert ticket after a lot of effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好不容易先搵到份人工高啲嘅工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 bat1 jung4 ji6 sin1 wan2 dou2 fan6 jan4 gung1 gou1 di1 ge3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好不容易才找到一份工资高一点的工作。
examples.english_sentence: It wasn't easy but I finally found a job with a higher salary.

mandarin_meaning: 好日子; 好地方; 美好世界
english_meaning: Good times; good place; a wonderful world; a good outcome (often used sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 可以指美好的生活或环境，也可以用作感叹词，表示事情发展顺利或状况良好。有时也反讽地指事情发展不顺利，情况糟糕。
explanation_english: Can refer to a good life or environment. It can also be used as an exclamation to express that things are going well or the situation is good. Sometimes it is also used sarcastically to mean that things are not going well and the situation is bad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟咁差，邊有好世界呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 gam3 caa1, bin1 jau5 hou2 sai3 gaai3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济这么差，哪里有什么好日子啊？
examples.english_sentence: The economy is so bad now, how can there be good times?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂呢份project，就真係好世界啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 ni1 fan6 project, zau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai3 gaai3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搞定这个项目，就真是好日子了！
examples.english_sentence: Once we finish this project, it will truly be a good outcome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢中咗六合彩，真係好世界呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai3 gaai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他中了彩票，真是好日子啊！
examples.english_sentence: He won the lottery, he's really living the good life!

mandarin_meaning: 爱管闲事的人，喜欢惹事生非的人
english_meaning: busybody, meddler, troublemaker
explanation_mandarin: 指喜欢多管闲事，甚至煽风点火，制造麻烦的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who enjoys meddling in other people's affairs, often stirring up trouble or creating problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢班好事之徒日日都喺度搞搞震，搞到成個社區都烏煙瘴氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 baan1 hou2 si6 zi1 tou4 jat6 jat6 dou1 hai2 dou6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, gaau2 dou3 seng4 go3 se5 keoi1 dou1 wu1 jin1 zoeng3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些爱管闲事的人每天都在这里搞事情，搞得整个社区都乌烟瘴气。
examples.english_sentence: These busybodies are stirring up trouble here every day, making the whole community chaotic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好做個好事之徒，人哋兩公婆嘅事，你唔好理咁多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zou6 go3 hou2 si6 zi1 tou4, jan4 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 ge3 si6, nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 gam3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要做一个爱管闲事的人，人家夫妻的事情，你不要管这么多啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a busybody. It's a matter between a married couple, don't interfere so much.

english_meaning: Do more good deeds; it's always good to do good things.
explanation_mandarin: 劝人多做善事，多多益善。表示做好事总是有好处的，应该多做。
explanation_english: An idiom encouraging people to do more good deeds, as doing good is always beneficial. It suggests that one should actively seek opportunities to do good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該好事多為，幫吓有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 hou2 si6 do1 wai4, bong1 haa5 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多做好事，帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more good deeds and help those in need.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日捐錢做義工，真係好事多為。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gyun1 cin2 zou6 ji6 gung1, zan1 hai6 hou2 si6 do1 wai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是捐钱做义工，真是多做好事。
examples.english_sentence: He always donates money and volunteers, truly doing many good deeds.

english_meaning: Do more good deeds; It's good to do good deeds.
explanation_mandarin: 劝人多做好事，积累功德。表示应该积极主动地去做对社会有益的事情。
explanation_english: An exhortation to do more good deeds and accumulate merit. It suggests that one should be proactive in doing things that benefit society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該好事多爲，幫助有需要嘅人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 hou2 si6 do1 wai4, bong1 zo6 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该多做好事，帮助有需要的人。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more good deeds and help those in need.

english_meaning: Good things take time and effort; Good things don't come easy; Many difficulties are involved in accomplishing something good.
explanation_mandarin: 指好的事情在实现的过程中常常会遇到许多阻碍和困难。
explanation_english: This idiom refers to the fact that good things often encounter many obstacles and difficulties in the process of being realized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然搞呢個project好辛苦，但係都話好事多磨，希望最後可以成功啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 gaau2 ni1 go3 project hou2 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 dou1 waa6 hou2 si6 do1 mo4, hei1 mong6 zeoi3 hau6 ho2 ji5 sing4 gung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然做这个项目很辛苦，但是都说好事多磨，希望最后可以成功啦。
examples.english_sentence: Although working on this project is very hard, it is said that good things don't come easy, so I hope we can succeed in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結婚嘅準備功夫真係好多，不過都話好事多磨，最緊要開心咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 fan1 ge3 zeon2 bei6 gung1 fu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 do1, bat1 gwo3 dou1 waa6 hou2 si6 do1 mo4, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hoi1 sam1 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚的准备工作真的很多，不过都说好事多磨，最重要的是开心就好了。
examples.english_sentence: There's so much to prepare for a wedding, but it is said good things take time, the most important thing is to be happy.

mandarin_meaning: 好事将近; 喜事临近
english_meaning: Good things are coming; a happy event is approaching (often used to refer to an impending marriage or birth)
explanation_mandarin: 表示好事即将发生，多指结婚或生育等喜事快要到来。
explanation_english: Indicates that good things are about to happen, often referring to an impending marriage or the arrival of a new baby.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋拍咗拖咁耐，大家都估計佢哋好事近喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paak3 zo2 to1 gam3 noi6, daai6 gaa1 dou1 gu2 gai3 keoi5 dei6 hou2 si6 gan6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们谈恋爱这么久了，大家都估计他们的好事快要来了。
examples.english_sentence: They've been dating for so long, everyone guesses their good news (marriage) is approaching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見你肚仔咁大，唔通好事近呀？
