examples.english_sentence: Instead of learning good things, he went and learned to fight from those gangsters.

english_meaning: hospitable, welcoming
explanation_mandarin: 指主人热情好客，喜欢招待客人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is hospitable, enjoys having guests, and is welcoming to visitors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人都好客，成日請朋友嚟屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 dou1 hou2 haak3, seng4 jat6 ceng2 pang4 jau5 lai4 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人都很热情好客，经常请朋友来家里吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family is very hospitable and often invites friends over for dinner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港人都幾好客㗎，通常都會好好招待遊客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jan4 dou1 gei2 hou2 haak3 gaa3, tung1 soeng4 dou1 wui5 hou2 hou2 ziu1 doi6 jau4 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港人也挺好客的，通常都会好好招待游客。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong people are quite hospitable, and they usually treat tourists very well.

english_meaning: very easy; easily; liable to; prone to
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情做起来非常简单，容易做到。也表示某事容易发生。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very easy to do or achieve. Can also mean something is likely to happen or prone to occurring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個功課好容易㗎，你一定做得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 fo3 hou2 jung4 ji6 gaa3, nei5 jat1 ding6 zou6 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个作业很容易的，你一定能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This homework is very easy, you will definitely be able to finish it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好容易發脾氣㗎，你要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 jung4 ji6 faat3 pei4 hei3 gaa3, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很容易发脾气的，你要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: He's a person who gets angry easily, you need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲舊樓好容易漏水㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 gau6 lau2 hou2 jung4 ji6 lau6 seoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些旧楼很容易漏水的。
examples.english_sentence: These old buildings are prone to leaking.

english_meaning: very few; very little; rarely
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量极少或频率不高。
explanation_english: Describes a small quantity or infrequent occurrence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好少飲咖啡㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 siu2 yam2 gaa3 fe1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很少喝咖啡的。
examples.english_sentence: I rarely drink coffee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度好少落雪㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hou2 siu2 lok6 syut3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里很少下雪的。
examples.english_sentence: It rarely snows here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少出街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 chut1 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很少出门。
examples.english_sentence: He rarely goes out.

english_meaning: Very little; extremely rare; hardly any
explanation_mandarin: 形容数量非常少，几乎没有。
explanation_english: Describes a very small quantity, almost none at all. Emphasizes the scarcity of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少何會遲到㗎，今日唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 ho4 wui5 ci4 dou3 gaa3, gam1 jat6 m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很少迟到的，今天不知道怎么了。
examples.english_sentence: He's hardly ever late, I wonder what happened today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家好少何人會寫信啦，大家都用電話或者電郵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 hou2 siu2 ho4 jan4 wui5 se2 seon3 laa1, daai6 gaa1 dou1 yung6 din6 waa2 waak6 ze2 din6 yau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很少有人会写信了，大家都用电话或者电子邮件。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, very few people write letters anymore, everyone uses phones or emails.

english_meaning: rarely, seldom, uncommon
explanation_mandarin: 表示某件事发生的频率很低，不常见。 相当于普通话的“很少”、“难得”。
explanation_english: Indicates that something happens infrequently or is uncommon. Equivalent to "rarely" or "seldom" in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少可會遲到㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 ho2 wui5 ci4 dou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很少会迟到的。
examples.english_sentence: He rarely arrives late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好少可咁多人一齊食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 siu2 ho2 gam3 do1 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很少有这么多人一起吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to have so many people eating together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好少可見到佢笑得咁開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 siu2 ho2 gin3 dou2 keoi5 siu3 dak1 gam3 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很少看到他笑得这么开心。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to see him smile so happily.

english_meaning: Doesn't really care; not bothered; to not pay much attention
explanation_mandarin: 形容对某件事情或某个人不太关心，不在乎。表示一种冷漠或者不感兴趣的态度。
explanation_english: Describes a state of not caring much about something or someone, indicating indifference or lack of interest. It can also imply a dismissive attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好少理人哋點諗㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 siu2 lei5 jan4 dei6 dim2 nam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不太在意别人怎么想的。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't really care what other people think.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好理佢啦，佢好少理呢啲嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lei5 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 siu2 lei5 ni1 di1 je5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别理他了，他不太在意这些事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother with him, he doesn't really care about these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對考試成績好少理，成日都掛住玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 haau2 si5 sing4绩 hou2 siu2 lei5, seng4 jat6 dou1 gwaa3 zyu6 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对考试成绩不太在意，整天只想着玩。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't really care about his exam results, he's always thinking about playing.

mandarin_meaning: 股市行情好; 生意兴隆
english_meaning: Bull market; Thriving business; Prosperous market
explanation_mandarin: 指股市行情很好，股票价格上涨，交易活跃；也指生意兴隆，市场繁荣。
explanation_english: Refers to a bull market in the stock market, with rising stock prices and active trading. Also refers to a thriving business and a prosperous market.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅股市真係好市呀，好多人都賺咗錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 gu2 si5 zan1 hai6 hou2 si5 aa3, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zaan6 zo2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的股市真是行情好啊，很多人都赚了钱。
examples.english_sentence: The stock market is really good this year; many people have made money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望聽日生意好市啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 ting1 jat6 seng1 ji3 hou2 si5 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望明天生意兴隆！
examples.english_sentence: Hope business will be good tomorrow!

english_meaning: several, quite a few
explanation_mandarin: 表示比“几”多，但不很多。
explanation_english: Indicates more than 'a few', but not a great number.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好幾年冇見過佢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gei2 nin4 mou5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我好几年没见过他了。
examples.english_sentence: I haven't seen him for several years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有好幾本書都好好睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 hou2 gei2 bun2 syu1 dou1 hou2 hou2 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有好几本书都很好看。
examples.english_sentence: He has several books that are very good to read.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去咗好幾次旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 hou2 gei2 ci3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去了好几次旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We went on quite a few trips.

english_meaning: Luckily, fortunately, thankfully
explanation_mandarin: 表示幸运，幸好，事情没有变得更糟。
explanation_english: Expressing luck or good fortune, indicating that things could have been worse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好彩我帶咗遮，如果唔係就淋濕晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 coi2 ngo5 daai3 zo2 ze1, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 lam4 sip3 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好我带了伞，不然就淋湿了。
examples.english_sentence: Luckily I brought an umbrella, otherwise I would have been soaked.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試好彩合格咋，下次要努力啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 hou2 coi2 hap6 gaak3 zaa3, haa6 ci3 jiu3 nu5 lik6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试幸好及格了，下次要努力点。
examples.english_sentence: Fortunately, I just barely passed the exam this time; I need to work harder next time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好彩你提醒我，唔係我就唔記得咗帶passport啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 coi2 nei5 tai4 sing2 ngo5, m4 hai6 ngo5 zau6 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 daai3 passport laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 幸好你提醒了我，不然我就忘记带护照了。
examples.english_sentence: Thankfully you reminded me, otherwise I would have forgotten to bring my passport.

mandarin_meaning: 好心肠, 善良, 好意
english_meaning: kind-hearted, kind intentions, well-meaning, good intentions
explanation_mandarin: 形容人心地善良，有同情心；或指好的意图、善意。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is kind-hearted and compassionate; or refers to good intentions and goodwill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好心，成日幫人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1, seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是好心，经常帮助别人。
examples.english_sentence: He is really kind-hearted, always helping others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知你係好心，但係咁做唔一定幫到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 nei5 hai6 hou2 sam1, daan6 hai6 gam2 zou6 m4 jat1 ding6 bong1 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你是好意，但是这样做不一定能帮到他。
examples.english_sentence: I know you have good intentions, but doing this might not necessarily help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢講嘢唔好聽，但都係好心提你啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 gong2 je5 m4 hou2 teng1, daan6 dou1 hai6 hou2 sam1 tai4 nei5 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他说的话不好听，但也是好意提醒你而已。
examples.english_sentence: Although what he says isn't pleasant to hear, he's just kindly reminding you.

english_meaning: Good news; a happy event; a good thing
explanation_mandarin: 指令人高兴，值得庆祝的事情或消息。
explanation_english: Refers to a happy, celebratory event or piece of news. Something good that has happened or is going to happen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 恭喜你哋有咗BB，真係一件好心事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 hei2 nei5 dei6 jau5 zo2 BB, zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 sam1 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 恭喜你们有了宝宝，真是一件好事！
examples.english_sentence: Congratulations on having a baby! It's truly a happy event!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢升咗職，係一件好心事嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zik1, hai6 jat1 gin6 hou2 sam1 si6 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他升职了，这是一件好事。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted, that's a good thing.

english_meaning: Good begets good; good deeds will be rewarded.
explanation_mandarin: 做了好事终究会有好的回报。
explanation_english: This idiom expresses the belief that kindness and good deeds will eventually lead to positive outcomes and rewards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要多啲做好事，因為好心有好報嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 do1 di1 zou6 hou2 si6, jan1 wai6 hou2 sam1 jau5 hou2 bou3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要多做善事，因为善有善报嘛。
examples.english_sentence: We should do more good deeds, because good begets good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁熱心幫人，好心有好報，將來一定會有好運。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jit6 sam1 bong1 jan4, hou2 sam1 jau5 hou2 bou3, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 wui5 jau5 hou2 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么热心地帮助别人，善有善报，将来一定会有好运。
examples.english_sentence: You are so enthusiastic in helping others. Good begets good. You will surely have good luck in the future.

english_meaning: patient, diligent, attentive (implying putting a lot of care and effort into something)
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事情非常有耐心，很细心，很专注，花费很多心思。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very patient, meticulous, and focused, putting a lot of thought and effort into something. It implies a high degree of attentiveness and care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整呢個模型整得好心機㗎，用咗成個月時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 ni1 go3 mou4 jing4 zing2 dak1 hou2 sam1 gei1 gaa3, yung6 zo2 seng4 go3 jyut6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做这个模型做得很有耐心，用了一个月的时间。
examples.english_sentence: He put a lot of effort into making this model, it took him a whole month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教小朋友真係要好心機先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 sam1 gei1 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教小孩真的需要很有耐心才行。
examples.english_sentence: Teaching children really requires a lot of patience.

mandarin_meaning: 好心没好报; 好心不得好报
english_meaning: To do a good deed and be repaid with evil; Good intentions repaid with bad consequences; No good deed goes unpunished.
explanation_mandarin: 指做了好事反而得到坏的报应，形容好心没有好结果，白费心机。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where someone does a good deed or has good intentions but is rewarded with negative consequences. It implies that their good intentions were wasted and they were treated unfairly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我見佢咁慘咪借錢俾佢囉，點知佢走佬，真係好心着雷劈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gin3 keoi5 gam3 caam2 mai1 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi5 lo1, dim2 zi1 keoi5 zau2 lou2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sam1 zoek3 leoi4 pek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我看他那么可怜就借钱给他了，没想到他跑路了，真是好心没好报。
examples.english_sentence: I saw that he was so pitiful, so I lent him money, but who knew he would run away. It really feels like no good deed goes unpunished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢幫人抬嘢上樓，點知整親條腰，好心着雷劈啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bong1 jan4 toi4 je5 soeng5 lau2, dim2 zi1 zing2 san1 tiu4 jiu1, hou2 sam1 zoek3 leoi4 pek3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他帮人搬东西上楼，没想到弄伤了腰，真是好心没好报啊！
examples.english_sentence: He helped someone carry things upstairs, but ended up hurting his back. What a thankless job!

english_meaning: easy to bully; easily taken advantage of; pushover
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人性格懦弱，容易被欺负或占便宜。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is weak, submissive, and easily bullied or taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁老實，好恰㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 lou5 sat6, hou2 hap1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人这么老实，很好欺负的。
examples.english_sentence: He is such an honest person, he's easy to bully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁好恰啦，人哋會睇你唔起㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 hap1 laa1, jan4 dei6 wui5 tai2 nei5 m4 hei2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么好欺负了，别人会看不起你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so easy to take advantage of, people will look down on you.

english_meaning: easy to bully; easily provoked; easily offended
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人性格软弱，容易被欺负；或者形容某件事容易引起麻烦或争端。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easily bullied due to a weak or docile personality; or describes something that easily provokes trouble or disputes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁好惹，成日俾人蝦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 hou2 re2, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 haa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人太好欺负了，总是被人欺负。
examples.english_sentence: He is so easy to bully; he is always being bullied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲事好惹麻煩，最好唔好理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 si6 hou2 re2 maa4 faan4, zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些事情容易惹麻烦，最好不要管。
examples.english_sentence: These things are likely to cause trouble, so it's best to ignore them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞佢，佢好惹火㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5, keoi5 hou2 re2 fo2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要惹他，他很容易被激怒的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with him, he's easily provoked/angered.

synonyms: 容易激嬲 (jung4 ji6 gik1 nau1)

english_meaning: good intention; kindness; goodwill
explanation_mandarin: 善意的想法或行为。
explanation_english: A kind intention or act; goodwill.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁做都係一片好意啫，你唔好咁嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 zou6 dou1 hai6 jat1 pin3 hou2 ji3 ze1, nei5 m4 hou2 gam2 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做也是一片好意，你不要这么生气了。
examples.english_sentence: He did it with good intentions, don't be so angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 多謝你嘅好意，但我真係唔需要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: do1 ze6 nei5 ge3 hou2 ji3, daan6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 m4 seoi1 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 谢谢你的好意，但我真的不需要。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you for your kindness, but I really don't need it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我知道你係好意，但係咁做唔 work 㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 dou3 nei5 hai6 hou2 ji3, daan6 hai6 gam2 zou6 m4 wok1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我知道你是好意，但是这样做行不通的。
examples.english_sentence: I know you mean well, but it won't work this way.

mandarin_meaning: 意思, 不好意思, 脸皮厚
english_meaning: to have the nerve to; to be shameless; to have the audacity to; to feel embarrassed; to feel ashamed
explanation_mandarin: 1. （形容词）指不知羞耻，脸皮厚。2. （动词）表示感到不好意思，害羞。
explanation_english: 1. (adjective) Describes someone who is shameless or has thick skin. 2. (verb) Expresses feeling embarrassed or ashamed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你借咗人哋咁多錢，都唔還，好意思嘅？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ze3 zo2 jan4 dei6 gam3 do1 cin2, dou1 m4 waan4, hou2 yi3 si1 ge3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你借了人家这么多钱，都不还，好意思吗？
examples.english_sentence: You borrowed so much money from them and haven't paid it back. Do you even feel any shame?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我遲到咗咁耐，真係唔好意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2 gam3 noi6, zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 yi3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我迟到了这么久，真是不好意思。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so late, I'm really sorry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁貴嘅禮物，我點好意思收啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 gwai3 ge3 lai5 mat6, ngo5 dim2 hou2 yi3 si1 sau1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这么贵的礼物，我怎么好意思收啊？
examples.english_sentence: How could I possibly accept such an expensive gift? (I feel embarrassed)

english_meaning: good omen; auspicious
explanation_mandarin: 表示好的预兆或象征，通常用于形容事物或言语带有吉利的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to a good omen or auspicious symbol, often used to describe things or words that carry a lucky meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年流流，講啲好意頭嘅嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 lau4 lau4, gong2 di1 hou2 ji3 tau4 ge3 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间，说些吉利的话吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's New Year, let's say some auspicious things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買咗個8字嘅車牌，貪佢好意頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 zo2 go3 baat3 zi6 ge3 ce1 paai4, taam1 keoi5 hou2 ji3 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他买了一个带8的车牌，贪图它好兆头。
examples.english_sentence: He bought a license plate with the number 8 because it's considered auspicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭改咗個名，想好意頭啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 goi2 zo2 go3 ming2, soeng2 hou2 ji3 tau4 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店改了名字，想要更吉利一些。
examples.english_sentence: This shop changed its name to have a more auspicious meaning.

english_meaning: good impression; favourable impression; liking; positive feeling
explanation_mandarin: 好的感觉或印象。
explanation_english: A feeling of liking or approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅印象唔錯，幾有好感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 jam3 seung6 m4 co3, gei2 jau5 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的印象不错，挺有好感的。
examples.english_sentence: I have a good impression of him, quite a liking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅幽默感令我對佢產生咗好感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jau1 mak6 gam2 ling6 ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 chan2 sang1 zo2 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的幽默感让我对他产生了有好感。
examples.english_sentence: His sense of humour made me develop a liking for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋第一次見面，佢就俾咗我一個好好嘅好感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 min6, keoi5 zau6 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 go3 hou2 hou2 ge3 hou2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们第一次见面，他就给了我一个很好的好感。
examples.english_sentence: We met for the first time, and he gave me a very good first impression.

english_meaning: warlike; bellicose; belligerent
explanation_mandarin: 形容喜欢战争，主张用战争解决问题。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is eager for or characterized by war; inclined to aggression and conflict.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋國家嘅領導人好戰，成日想打仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 ling5 dou6 jan4 hou3 zin3, seng4 jat6 soeng2 daa2 zoeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们国家的领导人好战，总是想打仗。
examples.english_sentence: The leader of their country is warlike and always wants to wage war.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得佢好戰，成日同人嘈交。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou3 zin3, seng4 jat6 tung4 jan4 cou4 gaau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得他好战，总是和别人吵架。
examples.english_sentence: I think he's belligerent; he's always arguing with people.

english_meaning: a good show; an exciting performance; a good act (deception or manipulation)
explanation_mandarin: 指精彩的表演，通常指戏剧、电影、或者其他形式的娱乐表演。 也可指某人做出的巧妙的伪装或操作，类似“好戏”上演。
explanation_english: Refers to a good or exciting show, often referring to a theatrical performance, movie, or other forms of entertainment. It can also refer to someone's clever disguise or manipulation, similar to 'a good act' being put on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚齣戲真係好戲，我哋睇得好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan1 ceot1 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hei3, ngo5 dei6 tai2 dak1 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的戏真是精彩，我们看得很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's show was really good, we enjoyed watching it very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺度扮嘢，睇嚟又有排好戲睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dou6 baan6 je5, tai2 lai4 jau6 jau5 paai4 hou2 hei3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在那里装模作样，看来又有一场好戏看了。
examples.english_sentence: He's acting up over there, looks like there's going to be a good show to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電影嘅演員都好落力，真係一套好戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 ying2 ge3 yin2 yun4 dou1 hou2 lok6 lik6, zan1 hai6 jat1 tou3 hou2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的演员都很努力，真是一部好戏。
examples.english_sentence: The actors in this movie worked very hard, it's truly a great show.

english_meaning: The best is yet to come; You haven't seen anything yet.
explanation_mandarin: 指精彩的部分还在后面，还没到最精彩的时候。
explanation_english: Indicates that the most exciting or important part is yet to come. It implies that what has happened so far is just a prelude to something even more significant or dramatic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你而家覺得好震驚呀？ 好戲在後頭呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ji4 gaa1 gok3 dak1 hou2 zan3 ging1 aa3? hou2 hei3 zoi6 hau6 tau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你现在觉得很震惊吗？好戏还在后头呢！
examples.english_sentence: You feel shocked now? The best is yet to come!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快開心住，好戲在後頭，睇定啲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 faai3 hoi1 sam1 zyu6, hou2 hei3 zoi6 hau6 tau4, tai2 ding6 di1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快高兴，好戏还在后头，先看清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be happy so soon, the best is yet to come, let's wait and see.

english_meaning: expert; master; skillful person
explanation_mandarin: 指在某方面技术或技能很高超的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone with high skills or expertise in a particular area.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢整嘢食真係好手，咩都識煮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zing2 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 hou2 sau2, me1 dou1 sik1 zyu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做饭真是个高手，什么都会做。
examples.english_sentence: He's really an expert at cooking; he knows how to cook everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀好手嚟㗎，次次都贏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 hou2 sau2 lai4 gaa3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将很厉害，每次都赢。
examples.english_sentence: He's an expert at playing mahjong; he wins every time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明喺電腦方面好手嚟㗎，有咩問題問佢就啱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai2 din6 nou5 fong1 min6 hou2 sau2 lai4 gaa3, jau5 me1 man6 tai4 man6 keoi5 zau6 aam1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明在电脑方面是个高手，有什么问题问他就对了。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is an expert in computers; you should ask him if you have any problems.

english_meaning: to clean up after oneself; to leave things in good order; to be responsible and tidy
explanation_mandarin: 指做事有始有终，能妥善处理后续事宜，不留下麻烦。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to handle subsequent matters properly after completing a task, leaving no trouble behind; to be responsible and tidy in leaving things as you found them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好手尾，唔使人跟尾執手尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 sau2 mei1, m4 sai2 jan4 gan1 mei1 zap1 sau2 mei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很有善后能力，不需要别人跟在后面收拾。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very responsible person who always cleans up after himself, so no one needs to tidy up after him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做完嘢要好手尾，唔好留低垃圾呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jyun4 je5 jiu3 hou2 sau2 mei1, m4 hou2 lau4 dai1 laap6 saap3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完事情要好好善后，不要留下垃圾啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to clean up properly after you're done, don't leave any trash behind.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要教小朋友養成好手尾嘅習慣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau3 siu2 pang4 jau5 joeng5 sing4 hou2 sau2 mei1 ge3 zaap6 gwaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要教小朋友养成有善后的习惯。
examples.english_sentence: We need to teach children to develop a habit of cleaning up after themselves.

english_meaning: Good luck (specifically referring to luck in games of chance or skill requiring dexterity)
explanation_mandarin: 指在赌博、抽奖或其他需要技巧和运气的游戏中，运气非常好。
explanation_english: Refers to having good luck, especially in games of chance, lotteries, or any activity requiring both skill and luck with one's hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，你今日好手氣喎，次次都贏錢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 sau2 hei3 wo3, ci3 ci3 dou1 wing4 cin2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，你今天手气真好，每次都赢钱！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, you have really good luck today, winning money every time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，我今日好手氣，自摸！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 sau2 hei3, zi6 mo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我今天手气很好，自摸！
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I have good luck today, self-draw (Mahjong)!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打麻雀成日都好手氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 maa4 zoek3 sing4 jat6 dou1 hou2 sau2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打麻将总是手气很好。
examples.english_sentence: He always has good luck when playing mahjong.

english_meaning: nimble; quick-witted and skillful; capable; efficient
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事手脚麻利，动作快且利索，也指人能干，有能力。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is nimble and quick-witted, or someone who is capable and efficient in their work. It emphasizes both the speed and skill involved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好手腳，咩都做得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 sau2 goek3, me1 dou1 zou6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人手脚麻利，什么都做得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very capable person, he does everything very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工人好手腳，好快就搞掂晒啲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 jan4 hou2 sau2 goek3, hou2 faai3 zau6 gaau2 dim6 saai3 di1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工人手脚利索，很快就把所有的事情都处理好了。
examples.english_sentence: This worker is very efficient and quickly finished everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢廚藝好手腳，煮乜都咁好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 chu4 ngai6 hou2 sau2 goek3, zyu2 mat1 dou1 gam3 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的厨艺很好，做什么都那么好吃。
examples.english_sentence: He's very skillful in cooking, everything he makes tastes so good.

english_meaning: good at fighting; tough; capable of fighting well; skilled in combat
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人很会打架，体格强壮，或者在打斗方面很有能力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is good at fighting, physically strong, or skilled in combat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好打㗎，你唔好惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 daa2 gaa3, nei5 m4 hou2 je5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能打的，你最好别惹他。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at fighting, you better not mess with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個角色要搵啲好打嘅人嚟做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gok3 sik1 jiu3 wan2 di1 hou2 daa2 ge3 jan4 lai4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个角色要找一些能打的人来演。
examples.english_sentence: This role requires someone who's good at fighting to play it.

english_meaning: Easy to take advantage of, easily bullied, gullible
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人容易被人欺负，容易占便宜。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is easily taken advantage of, easily bullied, or gullible.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人咁老實，成日俾人覺得佢好抽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gam3 lou5 sat6, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 cau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很老实，总是被人觉得他好欺负。
examples.english_sentence: He's such an honest person, people always think he's easy to take advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我好抽呀，唔係咁容易俾你呃到㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 hou2 cau1 aa3, m4 hai6 gam2 jung4 ji6 bei2 nei5 aak1 dou3 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为我好欺负啊，我没那么容易被你骗到的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I'm easy to bully, I'm not that easily fooled!

synonyms: 老實 (lou5 sat6) - in some contexts

mandarin_meaning: 厉害；厉害的；很棒；非常优秀
english_meaning: impressive; formidable; capable; awesome; excellent
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物很厉害，很棒，非常优秀。通常用于口语。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing as impressive, formidable, capable, awesome, or excellent. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日喺籃球比賽入面表現好揪啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 hai2 laam4 kau4 bi2 coi3 jap6 min6 biu2 hin3 hou2 ciu1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天在篮球比赛中的表现非常棒！
examples.english_sentence: He performed really well in the basketball game yesterday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃真係好揪，一定會成功。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zan1 hai6 hou2 ciu1, jat1 ding6 wui5 sing4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划真的很厉害，一定会成功。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is really impressive, it will definitely succeed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就做完份功課，真係好揪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 zou6 jyun4 fan6 gung1 fo3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ciu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就做完功课了，真厉害。
examples.english_sentence: You finished your homework so quickly, that's really impressive.

english_meaning: easy to earn (money), lucrative
explanation_mandarin: 形容容易赚到钱，收入不错。
explanation_english: Describes something that is easy to earn money from, or a job that is lucrative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家做IT好揾㗎，好多公司都要請人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 zou6 ai1 ti1 hou2 wan2 gaa3, hou2 do1 gung1 si1 dou1 jiu3 ceng2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在做IT行业很容易赚钱，很多公司都要请人。
examples.english_sentence: It's easy to earn money working in IT now, many companies are hiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講呢份工好揾，但係都好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 wan2, daan6 hai6 dou1 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说这份工作很容易赚钱，但是也很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: I heard this job is easy to earn money from, but it's also very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市咁旺，賣樓應該都幾好揾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 gam3 wong6, mai6 lau2 jing1 goi1 dou1 gei2 hou2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市这么火爆，卖房子应该也挺容易赚钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The property market is so hot, selling houses should be quite lucrative.

english_meaning: Of all things to do, (you) choose to do this; Why do (you) choose to do this in particular?; Of all the things you could have done, you did this.
explanation_mandarin: 指有很多其他选择或事情可以做，但偏偏选择了做不应该做或令人意外的事情。通常带有一种不满或不赞同的语气。
explanation_english: Expresses disapproval or surprise that someone chose to do something unexpected or inappropriate when there were many other options available. It often implies a sense of 'why this in particular?' or 'of all things to do...' and has a slightly negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁多嘢做，你好搞唔搞走咗去打機？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 do1 je5 zou6, nei5 hou2 gaau2 m4 gaau2 zau2 zo2 heoi3 daa2 gei1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有这么多事情要做，你偏偏跑去打游戏？
examples.english_sentence: With so much to do, of all things, you went to play video games?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好搞唔搞，佢走咗去得罪個老細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 gaau2 m4 gaau2, keoi5 zau2 zo2 heoi3 dak1 zeoi5 go3 lou5 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 偏偏，他跑去得罪了老板。
examples.english_sentence: Of all the things he could have done, he went and offended the boss.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好搞唔搞，你揀呢件咁貴嘅衫？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 gaau2 m4 gaau2, nei5 gaan2 ni1 gin6 gam3 gwai3 ge3 saam1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你干嘛非要选这件这么贵的衣服？
examples.english_sentence: Why would you pick this expensive piece of clothing of all things?

english_meaning: easy to find (especially referring to money or a job)
explanation_mandarin: 容易找到（尤指容易找到錢或工作）。形容某事有利可圖，容易賺錢，或者某個工作容易找到。
explanation_english: Easy to find, especially referring to money or a job. Describes something profitable, easy to make money from, or a job that is easy to obtain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講而家啲IT工好搵喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 ji4 gaa1 di1 IT gung1 hou2 wan2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说现在IT行业的工作很好找。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that IT jobs are easy to find these days.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工都幾好搵㗎，做多啲嘢就有多啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 dou1 gei2 hou2 wan2 gaa3, zou6 do1 di1 je5 zau6 jau5 do1 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作还挺赚钱的，多做些事情就有更多的钱。
examples.english_sentence: This job is quite profitable; the more you do, the more money you earn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家經濟唔好，唔係咁好搵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 wan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，不太容易赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: The economy isn't good now, it's not easy to make money.

english_meaning: easy to earn a living; lucrative; easy to find food (literally)
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作或行业容易赚钱，收入可观。
explanation_english: Describes a job or industry that is easy to make money in and provides a good income. Literally translates to 'easy to find food'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: IT 呢行而家都幾好搵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1 ti1 ni1 hang4 ji4 gaa1 dou1 gei2 hou2 wan2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: IT这个行业现在还挺容易赚钱的。
examples.english_sentence: The IT industry is quite lucrative nowadays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港做生意唔係咁好搵食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 sang1 ji3 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2 wan2 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港做生意不是那么容易赚钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing business in Hong Kong isn't that easy to make money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個工作好搵食，所以好多人爭住做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gung1 zok3 hou2 wan2 sik6, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 zaang1 zyu6 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工作很赚钱，所以很多人争着做。
examples.english_sentence: This job is lucrative, so many people are scrambling to do it.

synonyms: 搵錢 (wan2 cin2) - to earn money

english_meaning: know when to quit; know when to stop; know when to fold
explanation_mandarin: 在事情发展到一定程度时，知道何时停止，以避免损失或不利后果。形容懂得在有利时机及时退出。
explanation_english: To know when to quit or stop an activity or situation, especially to avoid potential loss or negative consequences. It describes someone who knows when it's advantageous to withdraw at the right time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你賭錢唔好咁大貪，要識得好收手勢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou2 cin2 m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 taam1, jiu3 sik1 dak1 hou2 sau1 sau2 sai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你赌钱不要太贪心，要知道适可而止。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be too greedy when gambling. You need to know when to quit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢炒股票賺咗好多，好彩佢好收手勢，唔係就蝕死啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caau2 gu2 piu3 zaan6 zo2 hou2 do1, hou2 coi2 keoi5 hou2 sau1 sau2 sai3, m4 hai6 zau6 sit3 sei2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他炒股赚了很多，幸好他见好就收，不然就赔死了。
examples.english_sentence: He made a lot of money speculating in stocks. Luckily he knew when to stop, otherwise he would have lost everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事你都做得差唔多啦，都係時候好收手勢喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 nei5 dou1 zou6 dak1 caa1 m4 do1 laa1, dou1 hai6 si4 hau6 hou2 sau1 sau2 sai3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事你都做得差不多了，也是时候适可而止了。
examples.english_sentence: You've done almost everything on this matter. It's about time to stop.

english_meaning: good day; auspicious day
explanation_mandarin: 指适合做某些事情的好日子，通常指黄道吉日，例如：结婚、搬家等。
explanation_english: Refers to a good day suitable for doing certain things, usually an auspicious day according to the Chinese calendar, such as for weddings, moving houses, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想揀個好日結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 gaan2 go3 hou2 jat6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想选一个好日子结婚。
examples.english_sentence: We want to choose a good day to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係好日，適合搬屋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 hou2 jat6, sik1 hap6 bun1 uk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是好日子，适合搬家。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is an auspicious day, suitable for moving house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日都睇通勝揀好日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 dou1 tai2 tung1 sing3 gaan2 hou2 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是看黄历选好日子。
examples.english_sentence: My mom always consults the Chinese almanac to choose an auspicious day.

english_meaning: Good day; auspicious day; a day for celebration
explanation_mandarin: 指好的日子，通常用于形容值得庆祝或纪念的日子，比如结婚、搬家、生日等。也指运气好的日子。
explanation_english: Refers to a good day, usually used to describe days worthy of celebration or commemoration, such as weddings, moving houses, birthdays, etc. It can also refer to a day of good fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係個好日子，我哋一齊慶祝啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 go3 hou2 jat6 zi2, ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 hing3 zuk1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是个好日子，我们一起庆祝吧！
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is a good day, let's celebrate together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揀咗個好日子結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan2 zo2 go3 hou2 jat6 zi2 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他选了个好日子结婚。
examples.english_sentence: He chose an auspicious day to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你早日過返好日子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 zou2 jat6 gwo3 faan1 hou2 jat6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你早日过回好日子。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you'll return to good times soon.

cantonese: 好時糖黐豆，唔好時水摳油
jyutping: hou2 si4 tong4 ci1 dau6, m4 hou2 si4 seoi2 kau1 jau4
mandarin_meaning: 顺利时如胶似漆，不顺时一毛不拔
english_meaning: In good times, they're inseparable like candy stuck to beans; in bad times, they're unwilling to part with even a drop of oil from water.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人际关系或情侣关系，顺利的时候非常亲密，一旦遇到困难或利益冲突，就变得非常冷漠或吝啬。
explanation_english: This idiom describes relationships (romantic or otherwise) that are very close and affectionate during good times, but become distant and unwilling to help or share during difficult times or when conflicts of interest arise.  The first part compares the relationship to candy stuck to beans, emphasizing their closeness. The second part describes someone scraping oil from water (an extremely difficult and stingy act), implying that they are unwilling to part with even the smallest thing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱結婚嗰時好似糖黐豆咁，但係依家經濟唔好，佢哋就變成好時糖黐豆，唔好時水摳油咁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 git3 fan1 go2 si4 hau2 hou2 ci5 tong4 ci1 dau6 gam2, daan6 hai6 ji1 ga1 ging1 gai3 m4 hou2, keoi5 dei6 zau6 bin3 sing4 hou2 si4 tong4 ci1 dau6, m4 hou2 si4 seoi2 kau1 jau4 gam2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚结婚的时候如胶似漆，但是现在经济不好，他们就变得顺利时如胶似漆，不顺利时一毛不拔了。
examples.english_sentence: When they first got married, they were inseparable, but now that the economy is bad, they've become like candy stuck to beans in good times, and unwilling to part with even a drop of oil in bad times.

english_meaning: good times; prosperous times; boom period
explanation_mandarin: 指经济或事业繁荣兴旺的时期。也泛指好的境况或光景。
explanation_english: Refers to a period of economic or business prosperity and boom. Generally refers to good times or prosperous circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅經濟以前都幾好景㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 ji5 cin4 dou1 gei2 hou2 ging2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的经济以前还是挺繁荣的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economy used to be quite prosperous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望下年嘅經濟都可以咁好景啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 haa6 nin4 ge3 ging1 zai3 dou1 ho2 ji5 gam2 hou2 ging2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望明年的经济也可以这么繁荣。
examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, the economy next year can be just as good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 樓市好景嘅時候，好多人都賺到錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 si5 hou2 ging2 ge3 si4 hau2, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 zaan6 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 楼市繁荣的时候，很多人都赚到钱。
examples.english_sentence: Many people made money when the property market was booming.

english_meaning: Good times don't last forever; all good things must come to an end.
explanation_mandarin: 美好的情景不会持续长久。形容幸福或顺利的时光短暂。
explanation_english: Used to describe situations where good or favorable circumstances are temporary and will eventually end. It implies that nothing lasts forever, and that positive situations will eventually give way to negative ones.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭幾年盤生意做得幾好，點知好景不常，過多幾年就執笠喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 gei2 nin4 pun4 sang1 ji3 zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2, dim2 zi1 hou2 ging2 bat1 soeng4, gwo3 do1 gei2 nin4 zau6 zap1 lap1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 头几年这生意做得很好，谁知好景不长，过了几年就倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: The business did very well in the first few years, but good times don't last forever; it closed down a few years later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋啱啱結婚嗰陣好恩愛，可惜好景不常，好快就離婚收場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 git3 fan1 go2 zan6 hou2 yan1 oi3, ho2 sik1 hou2 ging2 bat1 soeng4, hou2 faai3 zau6 lei4 fan1 sau1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚结婚的时候很恩爱，可惜好景不长，很快就离婚收场。
examples.english_sentence: They were very loving when they first got married, but unfortunately, good times don't last forever, and they soon ended up divorced.

english_meaning: good friend, close friend
explanation_mandarin: 关系亲密的朋友，友谊深厚的朋友。
explanation_english: A close friend; someone with whom one shares a strong bond of friendship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係我嘅好朋友，我哋識咗好耐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 hou2 pang4 jau5, ngo5 dei6 sik1 zo2 hou2 noi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是我的好朋友，我们认识很久了。
examples.english_sentence: He's my good friend, we've known each other for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我啲好朋友成日一齊去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 di1 hou2 pang4 jau5 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我常常和我的好朋友一起去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I often go shopping with my good friends.

english_meaning: Excellent, extremely good, fantastic
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，非常好，达到极点。
explanation_english: Indicates a very high degree of goodness, meaning extremely good or excellent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食好極呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 hou2 gik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物好极了！
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is fantastic!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好極，最啱去行山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 gik1, zeoi3 aam1 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天天气好极了，最适合去爬山。
examples.english_sentence: The weather is excellent today, perfect for hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得好極。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si5 haau2 dak1 hou2 gik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得好极了。
examples.english_sentence: He did extremely well in the exam this time.

mandarin_meaning: 好不了多少; 好不到哪里去
english_meaning: Not much better; Can't be much better; Limited improvement; Only so good
explanation_mandarin: 表示情况不会有太大的改善，好的程度很有限。
explanation_english: Indicates that the situation will not improve much, and the degree of goodness is very limited. It implies a pessimistic or realistic assessment of potential improvement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績都係咁上下啦，就算俾佢補習，都好極有限啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 jik1 dou1 hai6 gam2 seung6 haa6 laa1, jau6 syun3 bei2 keoi5 bou2 sik1, dou1 hou2 gik6 jau5 haan6 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩就那样了，就算给他补习，也好不了多少。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are just so-so, even if he gets tutoring, it won't improve much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅服務好極有限，你唔好期望太高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 hou2 gik6 jau5 haan6, nei5 m4 hou2 kei4 mong6 taai3 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的服务好不到哪里去，你不要期望太高。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this restaurant can't be much better, don't expect too much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部舊電腦就算升級，都好極有限，不如換過部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 jau6 syun3 sing1 kap1, dou1 hou2 gik6 jau5 haan6, bat1 jyu4 wun6 gwo3 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台旧电脑就算升级，也不会好多少，不如换一台新的。
examples.english_sentence: Even if this old computer is upgraded, it won't be much better, you might as well get a new one.

synonyms: 唔會好得去邊 (m4 wui5 hou2 dak1 heoi3 bin1)
冇乜改善 (mou5 mat1 goi2 sin6)

english_meaning: good show; well done (often used sarcastically)
explanation_mandarin: 原意是赞扬某人做得好，有本事。但更多时候用于反语，表示对某人行为的嘲讽或不满，指责其愚蠢或不自量力。
explanation_english: Originally means 'well done' or 'good show,' praising someone for their ability or accomplishment. However, it's often used sarcastically to express disapproval, mockery, or frustration with someone's actions, implying they are foolish or overconfident.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你夠膽喺老細面前咁樣講嘢，真係好樣呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gau3 daam2 hai2 lou5 sai3 min6 cin4 gam2 joeng2 gong2 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 joeng2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你敢在老板面前这么说话，真是好样的！
examples.english_sentence: You dare to talk to the boss like that, that's just great! (sarcastic)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人走去挑戰成班人，真係好樣嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zau2 heoi3 tiu1 zin3 sing4 baan1 jan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 joeng2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人跑去挑战一群人，真是好样的。
examples.english_sentence: He went to challenge a whole group of people by himself, that's just great (sarcastic).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考成科都唔合格，好樣啊你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 sing4 fo1 dou1 m4 hap6 gaak3, hou2 joeng2 aa3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试每科都不及格，真有你的。
examples.english_sentence: You failed every subject in the exam, well done (sarcastic).

synonyms: 巴閉 (baa1 bai3) - slang, sarcastic, meaning boastful, impressive

mandarin_meaning: 无论如何; 好坏; 无论好坏
english_meaning: in any case; anyhow; anyway; good or bad; whether good or bad
explanation_mandarin: 1. 无论如何，总归 (副词)。 2. 好坏；不论情况好坏 (名词)。
explanation_english: 1. In any case, regardless of the circumstances (adverb). 2. Good or bad; whether the situation is good or bad (noun).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好歹都試下啦，唔試點知得唔得？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 daai2 dou1 si3 haa5 laa1, m4 si3 dim2 zi1 dak1 m4 dak1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何都试一下吧，不试怎么知道行不行？
examples.english_sentence: Try it anyway. How would you know if it works if you don't try?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 無論好歹，我都支持你嘅決定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou4 leon6 hou2 daai2, ngo5 dou1 zi1 chi4 nei5 ge3 kyut3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论好坏，我都支持你的决定。
examples.english_sentence: For better or worse, I support your decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好歹都係一條人命，唔可以咁樣對待佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 daai2 dou1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 jan4 ming6, m4 ho2 ji5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 doi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 无论如何也是一条人命，不可以这样对待他。
examples.english_sentence: It's still a human life, no matter what, you can't treat him like that.

english_meaning: to die a good death; to die peacefully and painlessly; to die well (often used as a curse)
explanation_mandarin: 指死得安详，没有痛苦。但也常用于诅咒别人，希望别人不得好死。
explanation_english: Literally means 'to die well' or 'to die a good death', implying a peaceful and painless passing. However, it is often used as a curse, wishing someone a terrible death.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一世人做好事，希望佢可以好死。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 sai3 jan4 zou6 hou2 si6, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 hou2 sei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一生都在做好事，希望他可以善终。
examples.english_sentence: He did good deeds his whole life, I hope he can die peacefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁衰，肯定唔會好死㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 seoi1, hak1 ding6 m4 wui5 hou2 sei2 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么坏，肯定不会有好下场的！
examples.english_sentence: You're so terrible, you definitely won't have a good death!

english_meaning: Of all the things (that could happen), (this) had to happen; Incredibly bad luck; Just my luck
explanation_mandarin: 表示一种倒霉，不凑巧，偏偏发生不希望发生的事情。
explanation_english: Expresses a sense of bad luck or misfortune, where something undesirable or unlikely happens, especially at an inconvenient time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴日想去睇戲，好死唔死撞正打風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 jat6 soeng2 heoi3 tai2 hei3, hou2 sei2 m4 sei2 zong6 zeng3 daa2 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天想去看电影，偏偏碰上刮台风。
examples.english_sentence: I wanted to go see a movie yesterday, but of all things, I ran into a typhoon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕住返工，好死唔死架車又壞咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 faan1 gung1, hou2 sei2 m4 sei2 gaa3 che1 jau6 waai6 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶着上班，偏偏车又坏了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry to get to work, and just my luck, the car broke down again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試前一晚好死唔死發燒，搞到考唔好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 cin4 jat1 maan1 hou2 sei2 m4 sei2 faat3 siu1, gaau2 dou3 haau2 m4 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试前一晚偏偏发烧了，导致没考好。
examples.english_sentence: He got a fever the night before the exam, of all the things, which caused him to not do well.

synonyms: 咁啱得咁蹺 (gam2 ngaam1 dak1 gam2 kiu1)
衰到貼地 (seoi1 dou3 tip3 dei6)

mandarin_meaning: 好比; 好像; 犹如
english_meaning: to be like; to be similar to; comparable to; as if; just like
explanation_mandarin: 表示比较，相当于“好像”、“如同”。 用于比喻。
explanation_english: Used to make a comparison, similar to "as if" or "just like." Used in similes and metaphors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好比一隻甩繩馬騮咁，周圍亂咁走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 bei2 jat1 zek3 lat1 seng2 maa5 lau1 gam2, zau1 wai4 lyun6 gam2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像一只脱缰的猴子，到处乱跑。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a monkey off the leash, running around everywhere.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個地方好比係香港嘅後花園，環境好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 bei2 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hau6 faa1 jyun2, waan4 ging2 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个地方好比是香港的后花园，环境很好。
examples.english_sentence: This place is like Hong Kong's back garden, the environment is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀書好比起樓，要打好個根基先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 syu1 hou2 bei2 hei2 lau2, jiu3 daa2 hou2 go3 gan1 gei1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 读书好比盖楼，要打好基础才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: Studying is like building a building, you have to lay a good foundation first.

english_meaning: patience; good temper
explanation_mandarin: 指有耐心，不轻易发脾气。
explanation_english: Refers to having patience, not easily losing one's temper; good temper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可唔可以俾啲好氣？我而家好忙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 di1 hou2 hei3? ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你能不能有点耐心？我现在很忙。
examples.english_sentence: Can you please have some patience? I'm very busy right now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教細路仔要好氣先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau3 sai3 lou2 zai2 jiu3 hou2 hei3 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教小孩子要耐心才行。
examples.english_sentence: You need patience to teach children.

english_meaning: good complexion; rosy cheeks; healthy look
explanation_mandarin: 指脸色红润，健康，精神状态好。
explanation_english: Refers to having a rosy and healthy complexion, indicating good health and vitality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日睇落好氣色喎！係咪有咩開心事呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 tai2 lok6 hou2 hei3 sik1 wo3! hai6 mai6 jau5 me1 hoi1 sam1 si6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天看起来气色很好啊！是不是有什么开心的事呀？
examples.english_sentence: You look like you have a good complexion today! Is there something happy happening?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 瞓飽啲，自然就有好氣色啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan3 baau2 di1, zi6 jin4 zau6 jau5 hou2 hei3 sik1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 睡饱一点，自然就会有好气色了。
examples.english_sentence: If you get enough sleep, you will naturally have a good complexion.

synonyms: 面色紅潤 (min6 sik1 hung4 jeon6)

english_meaning: Good shot; well done; good job (mostly in sports context)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指球类运动中打得好的球，现在也用来赞扬别人做得好，干得漂亮。
explanation_english: Originally referring to a good shot in ball games, it is now also used to praise someone for doing well or a good job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先個罰球你射得好波呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 go3 fat6 kau4 nei5 se6 dak1 hou2 bo1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才那个罚球你射得真好！
examples.english_sentence: You shot that penalty kick really well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次project做得幾好喎，好波！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 project zou6 dak1 gei2 hou2 wo3, hou2 bo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的企划做得挺好的，干得好！
examples.english_sentence: This project is done pretty well, good job!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個反手拍真係好波!
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 faan2 sau2 paak1 zan1 hai6 hou2 bo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的反手拍真厉害！
examples.english_sentence: His backhand is really good!

english_meaning: Very clear; crystal clear; very obvious; very distinct; easy to understand
explanation_mandarin: 表示非常清楚、明白、明显，容易理解或识别。
explanation_english: Indicates something is very clear, obvious, distinct, and easy to understand or identify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講得好清，我哋全部都明晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1, ngo5 dei6 cyun4 bou6 dou1 ming4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他讲得很清楚，我们全部都明白了。
examples.english_sentence: He explained it very clearly, we all understood completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張相影得好清，睇到每個細節。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 soeng2 ying2 dak1 hou2 cing1, tai2 dou2 mui5 go3 sai3 zit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张照片拍得很清晰，能看到每个细节。
examples.english_sentence: This photo is very clear, you can see every detail.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條橋好清，一定成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kiu2 hou2 cing1, jat1 ding6 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的计划很明显可行，一定能成功的。
examples.english_sentence: His plan is very clearly achievable, it will definitely succeed.

english_meaning: hero; brave man; tough guy
explanation_mandarin: 指勇敢、坚强、有气概的男子。
explanation_english: Refers to a brave, strong, and courageous man; a hero.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個好漢，咁嘅環境都頂得住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 hon3, gam2 ge3 waan4 ging2 dou1 ding2 dak1 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个好汉，这样的环境都能挺住。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a hero, he can withstand such an environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要做個好漢，唔好咁易放棄。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 zou6 go3 hou2 hon3, m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 fong3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要做个好汉，不要那么容易放弃。
examples.english_sentence: To be a person, you should be a tough guy, don't give up so easily.

mandarin_meaning: 好东西总是最后才被发现; 压轴好戏
english_meaning: The best things are often at the bottom; saving the best for last; the best is yet to come.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻最好的东西或最精彩的部分通常在最后出现，或者需要深入挖掘才能发现。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that the best or most impressive things are often found at the end, or only discovered after some digging. It can also imply that the best is yet to come.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先啲表演都幾好睇，但係我覺得好物沉歸底，壓軸嗰個一定會更加精彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 di1 biu2 jin2 dou1 gei2 hou2 tai2, daan6 hai6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 mat6 cam4 gwai1 dai2, aat3 zuk6 go2 go3 jat1 ding6 wui5 gang3 ga1 zing1 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才的表演都挺好看的，但是我觉得好戏在后头，压轴的那个一定会更加精彩。
examples.english_sentence: The previous performances were pretty good, but I think the best is yet to come; the finale will definitely be even more amazing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搵工有時都係咁，唔好灰心住，好物沉歸底，可能最後先搵到份最好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wan2 gung1 jau5 si4 dou1 hai6 gam2, m4 hou2 fui1 sam1 zyu6, hou2 mat6 cam4 gwai1 dai2, ho2 nang4 zeoi3 hau6 sin1 wan2 dou2 fan6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 找工作有时候就是这样，不要灰心，好东西总是最后才被发现，可能最后才找到一份最好的。
examples.english_sentence: Job hunting is sometimes like that; don't be discouraged. The best is yet to come; you might find the best job in the end.

english_meaning: A good dog doesn't block the way.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻有身份或地位的人不应该阻碍别人或为难别人，也指有素质的人不会故意挡住别人的去路。
explanation_english: This idiom means that a person of good character or high status shouldn't obstruct or make things difficult for others. It also implies that a person with good manners wouldn't deliberately block someone's path.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都做到經理喇，仲要搞啲咁嘅嘢，真係好狗唔攔路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 zou6 dou3 ging1 lei5 laa3, zung6 jiu3 gaau2 di1 gam2 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 hou2 gau2 m4 laan4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都做到经理了，还要搞这些事情，真是好狗不挡道。
examples.english_sentence: You've already become a manager, and you're still messing with these things, it's really like a good dog shouldn't block the way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，唔該借借，好狗唔攔路嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, m4 goi1 ze3 ze3, hou2 gau2 m4 laan4 lou6 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶时间，麻烦让一下，好狗不挡道嘛。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in a hurry, excuse me, a good dog doesn't block the way, right?

english_meaning: very powerful, very strong, intense, impressive, formidable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事非常厉害，有很大的力量或影响力。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as very powerful, strong, intense, or impressive. It can be used to describe physical strength, skill, intensity, or overall formidable quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢打波好猛㗎，冇人夠佢嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 bo1 hou2 maang5 gaa3, mou5 jan4 gau3 keoi5 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他打球很厉害，没人比得上他。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at playing ball; no one can compare to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排啲流感好猛，你要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 di1 lau4 gam2 hou2 maang5, nei5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近流感很厉害，你要小心一点。
examples.english_sentence: The flu is very intense these days; you need to be careful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個氣勢好猛，真係唔敢惹佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 hei3 sai3 hou2 maang5, zan1 hai6 m4 gam2 re2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的气势很强大，真是不敢惹他。
examples.english_sentence: His aura is very formidable; I really don't dare to provoke him.

english_meaning: fun; amusing; enjoyable
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物有趣，令人感到愉快。
explanation_english: Describes something that is fun, amusing, or enjoyable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個遊樂場好好玩呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jau4 lok6 coeng4 hou2 hou2 waan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个游乐场真好玩啊！
examples.english_sentence: This amusement park is so much fun!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 同你哋一齊玩真係好玩！
examples.jyutping_sentence: tung4 nei5 dei6 jat1 cai4 waan2 zan1 hai6 hou2 waan2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 和你们一起玩真好玩！
examples.english_sentence: It's really fun to play with you guys!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲好唔好玩㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 hou2 m4 hou2 waan2 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影好不好看啊？
examples.english_sentence: Is that movie fun to watch?

jyutping: hou2 naam4 bat1 jyu5 neoi5 dau3
english_meaning: A good man doesn't argue/fight with women.
explanation_mandarin: 指有风度的男人不应该和女人一般见识，避免争执或冲突。含有一定的性别刻板印象，认为男性应该谦让女性。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that a gentleman should not argue or fight with women. It carries a certain gender stereotype, implying that men should be accommodating and tolerant towards women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 算啦，好男不與女鬥，唔好同佢嘈啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: syun3 laa1, hou2 naam4 bat1 jyu5 neoi5 dau3, m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 cou4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 算了，好男不跟女的斗，别和她吵了。
examples.english_sentence: Forget it, a good man doesn't argue with women. Don't argue with her.

english_meaning: to recover; to get well; to be healed; to return to normal (after being sick or damaged)
explanation_mandarin: 表示恢复健康，回到正常状态。可以指身体上的康复，也可以指事物恢复原状。
explanation_english: Indicates recovery to a healthy or normal state. It can refer to physical recovery, or the restoration of something to its original state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你病咗咁耐，終於好番啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 beng6 zo2 gam3 noi6, zung1 jyu1 hou2 faan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你病了这么久，终于好了。
examples.english_sentence: You've been sick for so long, you're finally better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦整好番啦，可以用返喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 zeng2 hou2 faan1 laa3, ho2 ji5 yung6 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑修好了，可以用回了。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is fixed, you can use it again.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋鬧完交之後，而家好番晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 naau6 jyun4 gaau1 zi1 hau6, ji4 gaa1 hou2 faan1 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们吵完架之后，现在完全和好了。
examples.english_sentence: After they argued, they've made up completely now.

english_meaning: easy to get along with, accommodating, agreeable
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人性格好，容易相处，愿意迁就别人。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easy to get along with, agreeable, and willing to accommodate others' needs or preferences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好好相就㗎，同佢合作冇問題嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 hou2 soeng1 zau6 gaa3, tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3 mou5 man6 tai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很好说话，和他合作没有问题的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very accommodating person; there will be no problem working with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心啦，我好相就㗎，你點安排都得嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1 laa1, ngo5 hou2 soeng1 zau6 gaa3, nei5 dim2 on1 paai4 dou1 dak1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心吧，我很好说话的，你怎样安排都可以的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I'm very accommodating; however you arrange it is fine with me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅老闆好好相就，可以俾我哋改餐單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 lou5 baan2 hou2 hou2 soeng1 zau6, ho2 ji5 bei2 ngo5 dei6 goi2 caan1 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的老板很好说话，可以让我们修改菜单。
examples.english_sentence: The owner of this restaurant is very accommodating, allowing us to modify the menu.

english_meaning: easy to get along with; agreeable; approachable; easygoing
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人性格随和，容易相处，不难打交道。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is easy to get along with, agreeable, and approachable.  It implies that the person is not difficult to deal with and is generally friendly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好相與，同佢合作好舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 soeng1 jyu5, tung4 keoi5 hap6 jok3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很好相处，和他合作很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very easy person to get along with; it's very comfortable working with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅新老細好相與，大家有咩意見都可以直接同佢講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 san1 lou5 sai3 hou2 soeng1 jyu5, daai6 gaa1 jau5 me1 ji3 gin3 dou1 ho2 ji5 zik6 zip3 tung4 keoi5 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的新老板很好相处，大家有什么意见都可以直接跟他讲。
examples.english_sentence: Our new boss is easy to get along with; everyone can tell him their opinions directly.

mandarin_meaning: 长得体面, 仪表堂堂
english_meaning: having a presentable appearance; good-looking; decent appearance
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人外表端正体面，容貌不错。并非单纯指五官，也包含整体给人的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone with a presentable and decent appearance. It refers not only to the facial features but also to the overall impression a person gives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然窮，但係都好眉好貌嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 kung4, daan6 hai6 dou1 hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他虽然穷，但是长相还算体面。
examples.english_sentence: Although he is poor, he has a decent appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你見工要執正啲，好眉好貌會畀人好印象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gin3 gung1 jiu3 zap1 zeng3 di1, hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 wui5 bei2 jan4 hou2 jan3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你面试的时候要打扮得体面些，好的外表会给人留下好印象。
examples.english_sentence: You should dress presentably for job interviews; a good appearance will leave a good impression.

jyutping: hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 sang1 saa1 sat1
mandarin_meaning: 金玉其外，败絮其中 (jīnyùqíwài, bàixùqízhōng)
english_meaning: Fair without and foul within; All that glitters is not gold; Beautiful appearance concealing inner corruption/defect.
explanation_mandarin: 形容外表好看，但内在不好，品行不端正，或者事物质量很差。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something with a beautiful or pleasing appearance that conceals inner corruption, a bad character, or poor quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣就生得好眉好貌，點知做埋啲咁嘅嘢！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 zau6 saang1 dak1 hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6, dim2 zi1 zou6 maai4 di1 gam3 ge3 je5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她长得漂亮，没想到竟然做出这种事！
examples.english_sentence: She looks so beautiful, who would have thought she would do such a thing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車睇落好靚，但其實好眉好貌生沙虱，成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 ce1 tai2 lok6 hou2 leng3, daan6 kei4 sat6 hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 sang1 saa1 sat1, seng4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车看起来很漂亮，但其实金玉其外，败絮其中，经常坏。
examples.english_sentence: This car looks beautiful, but it's actually fair without and foul within, it's always breaking down.

jyutping: hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 saang1 saa1 sat1
english_meaning: Appearances can be deceiving; fine feathers do not make fine birds; a handsome exterior may conceal inner flaws.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人外表看起来很不错，但实际上内在或者行为举止并不好。比喻人不可只看外表。
explanation_english: This idiom describes someone who looks good or respectable on the outside, but is actually flawed or behaves poorly. It emphasizes the idea that appearances can be deceptive and that one should not judge a book by its cover.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得幾好，但係個人就成日偷呃拐騙，真係好眉好貌生沙蝨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 saang1 dak1 gei2 hou2, daan6 hai6 go3 jan4 zau6 seng4 jat6 tau1 aak1 gwaai2 pin3, zan1 hai6 hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 saang1 saa1 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他长得挺好看的，但是这个人总是偷拐骗抢，真是人不可貌相。
examples.english_sentence: He has quite a good appearance, but he's always stealing and deceiving people. It's truly a case of appearances being deceiving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快信佢講嘅嘢，好眉好貌生沙蝨，睇清楚啲先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5, hou2 mei4 hou2 maau6 saang1 saa1 sat1, tai2 cing1 chu2 di1 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快相信他说的话，人不可貌相，先看清楚一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe what he says so quickly. Appearances can be deceiving; take a closer look first.

english_meaning: Good-looking, beautiful, pretty; good to watch, interesting
explanation_mandarin: 形容外貌美丽、吸引人；形容电影、电视等节目精彩、有趣。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as beautiful, attractive, or pleasing to the eye. Also describes a movie, TV show, etc., as enjoyable or interesting to watch.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日着到好靚啊，真係好睇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 leng3 aa3, zan1 hai6 hou2 hon3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得很漂亮，真好看！
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so beautifully today, she really looks good!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好睇，我睇咗兩次喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 hon3, ngo5 tai2 zo2 loeng5 ci3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影很好看，我已经看了两次了。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is good to watch, I've already seen it twice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好睇呀，好襯你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 hon3 aa3, hou2 can3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很好看，很适合你。
examples.english_sentence: This piece of clothing looks good, it suits you well.

english_meaning: to have good eyesight; to have a discerning eye; to be perceptive
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人眼力好，看东西看得清楚，或者形容一个人很有眼光，能做出正确的判断。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has good eyesight and can see things clearly, or describes someone who has good judgment and can make correct decisions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你真係好眼，咁都睇到佢!
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaan5, gam3 dou1 tai2 dou2 keoi5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你真是有眼光，这样都能看到他！
examples.english_sentence: You really have good eyesight, you can even see him!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好眼，一眼就睇得出邊件係假嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ngaan5, jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dak1 cheut1 bin1 gin6 hai6 gaa2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有眼光，一眼就能看出哪个是假货。
examples.english_sentence: He has a discerning eye; he can tell which one is fake at a glance.

mandarin_meaning: 好眼光; 很有鉴赏力
english_meaning: Good eye; Good taste; Having good judgment or discernment (especially in assessing quality or value)
explanation_mandarin: 称赞别人有很好的鉴赏能力，能看出事物的优点或价值。
explanation_english: Used to praise someone for having good judgment and the ability to see the merits or value of things. It implies that the person has discerning taste and can appreciate quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你揀呢幅畫真係好眼界喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan2 ni1 fuk1 waa2 zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaan5 gaai3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你选的这幅画真有眼光！
examples.english_sentence: You have a good eye for choosing this painting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢買親嘅嘢都好靚，真係好眼界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maai5 cin1 ge3 je5 dou1 hou2 leng3, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaan5 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她买的东西都很漂亮，真是有眼光。
examples.english_sentence: Everything she buys is beautiful; she really has good taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁快就睇到呢間公司嘅潛力，真係好眼界呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 tai2 dou2 ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 cim4 lik6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ngaan5 gaai3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么快就看到了这家公司的潜力，真有眼光啊！
examples.english_sentence: You saw the potential of this company so quickly, you really have a good eye!

mandarin_meaning: 好穿; 好穿戴; 方便
english_meaning: comfortable to wear; easy to wear; convenient (referring to clothing)
explanation_mandarin: 形容衣服穿着舒服，或者方便穿戴。
explanation_english: Describes clothes that are comfortable to wear or easy to put on and take off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫好着，質地又舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 hou2 zoek3, zat1 dei6 jau6 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服很好穿，质地也很舒服。
examples.english_sentence: This shirt is comfortable to wear and the material is also comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意着啲好着嘅衫，唔想着啲太焗促嘅衫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 zoek3 di1 hou2 zoek3 ge3 saam1, m4 soeng2 zoek3 di1 taai3 guk1 cuk1 ge3 saam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢穿一些好穿的衣服，不想穿太紧的衣服。
examples.english_sentence: I like to wear clothes that are comfortable to wear. I don't want to wear clothes that are too restrictive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋好着，行路都唔會攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 hou2 zoek3, haang4 lou6 dou1 m4 wui5 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋很好穿，走路也不会累。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are comfortable to wear, and you won't get tired from walking in them.

english_meaning: good-looking; attractive; worth watching; entertaining
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物的外观或表现令人满意，具有吸引力。可以用于形容人、电影、电视节目等。
explanation_english: Describes something that is pleasing to the eye or is enjoyable to watch. Can be used to describe a person, a movie, a TV show, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲真係好睇，我推薦你睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2, ngo5 tui1 gin3 nei5 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影真好看，我推荐你看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie is really good, I recommend you watch it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著得好靚，好睇好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dak1 hou2 leng3, hou2 tai2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿得很漂亮，好看多了。
examples.english_sentence: She looks very pretty today, much more attractive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人幾好睇嘅，不過性格麻麻哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 gei2 hou2 tai2 ge3, bat1 gwo3 sing3 gaak3 maa4 maa4 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她长得还不错，但是性格一般般。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is quite good-looking, but the personality is so-so.

english_meaning: Looks good but not practical; Visually appealing but not functional
explanation_mandarin: 形容某事物外表吸引人，但是实际上并不实用，功能不佳。
explanation_english: Describes something that is visually appealing or aesthetically pleasing, but lacks practical value or functionality. It looks good but is not effective or efficient in its purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部車好睇唔好用，成日壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 che1 hou2 tai2 m4 hou2 yung6, sing4 jat6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车好看不好用，经常坏。
examples.english_sentence: This car looks good but is not practical; it breaks down all the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個設計好睇唔好用，根本解決唔到問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 chit3 gai3 hou2 tai2 m4 hou2 yung6, gan1 bun2 gaai2 kyut3 m4 dou2 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的设计好看不好用，根本解决不了问题。
examples.english_sentence: His design looks good but is impractical, it doesn't solve the problem at all.

english_meaning: Looks good but doesn't taste good; Appealing appearance but lacking substance.
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物外表吸引人，但实际品质或味道却不佳。
explanation_english: Describes something that is visually appealing or attractive but lacks substance, quality, or good taste. It is commonly used to describe food but can apply to other things as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好睇唔好食，影相就一流，食落就麻麻哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 tai2 m4 hou2 sik6, ying2 soeng2 zau6 jat1 lau1, sik6 lok6 zau6 maa4 maa2 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西好看不好吃，拍照是一流，吃起来就一般般。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant looks good but doesn't taste good. It's great for taking photos, but the taste is just so-so.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰套戲啲特效好勁，但係劇情好空洞，真係好睇唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 tou3 hei3 di1 dak6 haau6 hou2 ging6, daan6 hai6 kek6 cing4 hou2 hung1 dung6, zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影的特效很厉害，但是剧情很空洞，真是好看不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: That movie has amazing special effects, but the plot is very hollow. It's a case of looks good, tastes bad.

english_meaning: to sleep well; good sleep
explanation_mandarin: 形容睡眠质量好，睡得很舒服。
explanation_english: Describes a good quality of sleep, sleeping comfortably and soundly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 琴晚我好瞓，一瞓就瞓到天光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: kam4 ngaan1 ngo5 hou2 fan3, jat1 fan3 zau6 fan3 dou3 tin1 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 昨晚我睡得很好，一睡就睡到天亮。
examples.english_sentence: I slept well last night; I slept straight through until dawn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 食咗呢隻藥會好瞓啲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sik6 zo2 ni1 zek3 joek6 wui5 hou2 fan3 di1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 吃了这个药会睡得好一些的。
examples.english_sentence: Taking this medicine will help you sleep better.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望你今晚好瞓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 nei5 gam1 maan1 hou2 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望你今晚睡个好觉。
examples.english_sentence: I hope you sleep well tonight.

english_meaning: Horlicks (a malted milk drink)
explanation_mandarin: 好立克是一种麦芽饮料，在香港非常受欢迎，通常作为早餐或睡前饮品。
explanation_english: Horlicks is a malted milk drink that is very popular in Hong Kong, often consumed as a breakfast or bedtime drink.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣成日飲好立克，覺得好甜好好味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 jam2 hou2 lap1 hak1, gok3 dak1 hou2 tim4 hou2 hou2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常喝好立克，觉得很甜很好喝。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I often drank Horlicks. I thought it was very sweet and delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚好凍，不如沖杯好立克暖下身啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 dung3, bat1 jyu4 cung1 bui1 hou2 lap1 hak1 nym5 haa5 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚很冷，不如泡一杯好立克暖暖身吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's very cold tonight, why don't we make a cup of Horlicks to warm up?

english_meaning: funny, laughable, ridiculous
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物或行为滑稽，引人发笑；也可形容事物荒谬可笑。
explanation_english: Describes something that is funny, amusing, or ridiculous; capable of causing laughter. It can also be used to describe something absurd or laughable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢真係好笑，成日都氹到我哋笑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3, seng4 jat6 dou1 tam5 dou3 ngo5 dei6 siu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话真好笑，总是逗得我们笑。
examples.english_sentence: What he says is really funny; he always makes us laugh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你個解釋太過好笑啦，根本冇人信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 go3 gaai2 sik1 taai3 gwo3 hou2 siu3 laa1, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的解释太好笑了，根本没有人相信。
examples.english_sentence: Your explanation is too ridiculous; nobody believes it at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲啲情節好笑得滯，我笑到肚都痛埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 di1 cing4 zit3 hou2 siu3 dak1 zai6, ngo5 siu3 dou3 tou5 dou1 tung3 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的情节太搞笑了，我笑得肚子都疼了。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is so funny that I laughed until my stomach hurt.

english_meaning: Always smiling; having a smiling face; happy disposition
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人面带笑容，喜欢笑，性格开朗。
explanation_english: Describes someone who has a smiling face, likes to smile, and has a cheerful and outgoing personality. It often implies a pleasant and approachable demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都笑咪咪咁，真係好笑口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 siu3 mei1 mei1 gam2, zan1 hai6 hou2 siu3 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是笑眯眯的，真是爱笑。
examples.english_sentence: She's always smiling, she really has a smiling face.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做服務行業嘅人，最好都係好笑口啲，咁客人先會覺得親切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 fuk6 mou6 hang4 jip6 ge3 jan4, zeoi3 hou2 dou1 hai6 hou2 siu3 hau2 di1, gam2 haak3 jan4 sin1 wui5 gok3 dak1 can1 cit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做服务行业的人，最好还是爱笑一点，这样客人才会觉得亲切。
examples.english_sentence: People working in the service industry should preferably have a smiling face, so customers will feel friendly.

english_meaning: to recover; to get better; to be healed
explanation_mandarin: 指（身体、心情等）恢复到良好的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to (body, mood, etc.) returning to a good state; to recover, heal or improve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾日，終於好翻喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, zung1 jyu1 hou2 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了几天，终于好起来了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a few days, and he finally recovered.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心，休息多啲就會好翻㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1, jau1 sik1 do1 di1 zau6 wui5 hou2 faan1 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心，多休息就会好起来的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, you'll get better if you rest more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份工做得唔開心，不如辭職，等自己好翻啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 m4 hoi1 sam1, bat1 jyu4 ci4 zik1, dang2 zi6 gei2 hou2 faan1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作做得不开心，不如辞职，让自己好过一点。
examples.english_sentence: If you're not happy with your job, why not resign and feel better.

cantonese: 好老怕爛佬，爛佬怕潑婦
jyutping: hou2 lou5 paa3 laan6 lou2, laan6 lou2 paa3 put3 fu5
mandarin_meaning: 老实人怕无赖，无赖怕泼妇
english_meaning: An honest man fears a scoundrel, and a scoundrel fears a shrew.
explanation_mandarin: 形容不同类型的人之间存在相互制约的关系。老实人因为循规蹈矩，害怕不讲理的无赖；无赖虽然不讲理，但更害怕胡搅蛮缠、更加不讲理的泼妇。
explanation_english: This proverb describes a hierarchy of fear based on different types of personalities and their methods of interacting. An honest, law-abiding person is afraid of a scoundrel who doesn't play by the rules, and a scoundrel is in turn afraid of a shrew, who is even more unreasonable and troublesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪以為惡就大晒，好老怕爛佬，爛佬怕潑婦，總有人制到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 ji5 wai4 ok3 zau6 daai6 saai3, hou2 lou5 paa3 laan6 lou2, laan6 lou2 paa3 put3 fu5, zung2 jau5 jan4 zai3 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为凶狠就了不起，老实人怕无赖，无赖怕泼妇，总有人能制住你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think being fierce makes you all-powerful. An honest man fears a scoundrel, and a scoundrel fears a shrew. Someone will always be able to control you.

english_meaning: a long time
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间很长，已经过去很长时间。
