explanation_english: Indicates a long period of time has passed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐冇見，你最近點呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, nei5 zeoi3 gan6 dim2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好久不见，你最近怎么样？
examples.english_sentence: Long time no see, how have you been lately?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋好耐之前已經識㗎喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hou2 noi6 zi1 cin4 ji5 ging1 sik1 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们很久以前就认识了。
examples.english_sentence: We've known each other for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份報告要好耐先可以完成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 bou3 gou3 jiu3 hou2 noi6 sin1 ho2 ji5 wun4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告要很久才能完成。
examples.english_sentence: This report will take a long time to complete.

english_meaning: a long time ago
explanation_mandarin: 指过去很长的一段时间
explanation_english: Refers to a period of time far back in the past.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好耐之前已經聽過呢首歌啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 noi6 zi1 cin4 ji5 ging1 ting1 gwo3 ni1 sau2 go1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很久以前就听过这首歌了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard this song a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐之前香港唔係咁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 zi1 cin4 hoeng1 gong2 m4 hai6 gam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很久以前香港不是这样的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong wasn't like this a long time ago.

english_meaning: a long time ago
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间很久以前，指过去很长一段时间。
explanation_english: Indicates a time far back in the past, a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好耐以前已經聽過呢首歌喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 noi6 ji5 cin4 ji5 ging1 teng1 gwo3 ni1 sau2 go1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很久以前就听过这首歌了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard this song a long time ago.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐以前，呢度係一片田嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 ji5 cin4, ni1 dou6 hai6 jat1 pin3 tin4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很久以前，这里是一片田地。
examples.english_sentence: A long time ago, this place was a field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好耐以前就移民咗去加拿大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 noi6 ji5 cin4 zau6 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很久以前就移民去加拿大了。
examples.english_sentence: He immigrated to Canada a long time ago.

english_meaning: Long time no see
explanation_mandarin: 表示很久没有见面，用于熟人或朋友之间。
explanation_english: A common greeting used when you haven't seen someone in a long time, usually used among friends or acquaintances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，阿明，好耐冇見，你做緊乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, aa3 ming4, hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, nei5 zou6 gan2 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，阿明，好久不见，你现在在做什么呢？
examples.english_sentence: Wow, Ah Ming, long time no see, what are you doing now?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐冇見，上次見你都仲係中學嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3, soeng6 ci3 gin3 nei5 dou1 zung1 hai6 zung1 hok6 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好久不见，上次见你还是中学的时候。
examples.english_sentence: Long time no see, the last time I saw you was still in secondary school.

synonyms: 好耐唔見 (hou2 noi6 m4 gin3)
隔咗好耐 (gaak3 zo2 hou2 noi6)

mandarin_meaning: 很久都没联络了，客气客气
english_meaning: Long time no see, thanks for (remembering/contacting me).
explanation_mandarin: 一句客套话，表示很久没有联系或见面，并且感谢对方还能想起自己或主动联系。
explanation_english: A polite phrase used when you haven't seen or been in contact with someone for a long time, and you want to express gratitude for them remembering you or reaching out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩！Peter，好耐都唔該你仲記得我呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1! peter, hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 goi1 nei5 zung6 gei3 dak1 ngo5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇！Peter，很久不见，谢谢你还记得我呀！
examples.english_sentence: Wow! Peter, long time no see, thank you for still remembering me!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好耐都唔該你仲搵我幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 goi1 nei5 zung6 wan2 ngo5 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很久都没联系了，还谢谢你还找我帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: Long time no see, thank you for still asking for my help.

jyutping: hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 goi1 saai3
english_meaning: Thanks a lot for (everything, even though it was) a long time ago.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对过去很久以前受到的帮助或恩惠表达感谢，即使时间已经过去很久，仍然心存感激。
explanation_english: Expresses gratitude for help or favors received a long time ago. It implies that you still remember and appreciate the kindness despite the passage of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次你幫我搬屋，好耐都唔該晒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: seong6 ci3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1, hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 goi1 saai3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次你帮我搬家，很久都非常感谢！
examples.english_sentence: Thanks a lot for helping me move house last time!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣你教我游水，好耐都唔該晒你啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 nei5 gaau3 ngo5 jau4 seoi2, hou2 noi6 dou1 m4 goi1 saai3 nei5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候你教我游泳，很久都非常感谢你啊。
examples.english_sentence: Thank you so much for teaching me how to swim when I was little, even though it was a long time ago.

english_meaning: good ear; well-informed; having good sources of information
explanation_mandarin: 形容人耳朵灵敏，能迅速听到或得知消息，消息灵通。
explanation_english: Describes someone with a good ear, meaning they are sensitive to sounds or well-informed and able to quickly obtain information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好耳㗎，乜嘢八卦嘢都知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ji5 gaa3, mat1 je5 baat3 gwaa3 je5 dou1 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他消息很灵通，什么八卦的事情都知道。
examples.english_sentence: He's well-informed; he knows all the gossip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁好耳，邊度聽到呢啲嘢㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hou2 ji5, bin1 dou6 teng1 dou2 ni1 di1 je5 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你消息这么灵通，从哪里听到的这些事？
examples.english_sentence: How are you so well-informed? Where did you hear about these things?

english_meaning: pleasant-sounding; nice voice
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音悦耳动听。通常用于称赞别人的歌声、说话的声音等。
explanation_english: Describes a sound that is pleasant and melodious. Usually used to compliment someone's singing voice, speaking voice, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把聲好聲喎，唱歌一定好好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 seng1 hou2 seng1 wo3, cheung3 go1 yat1 ding6 hou2 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的声音真好听，唱歌一定很好听。
examples.english_sentence: Your voice sounds nice, you must sing very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好聲，所以好多人鍾意聽佢講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 seng1, so2 ji5 hou2 do1 jan4 jung1 yi3 teng1 keoi5 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的声音很好听，所以很多人喜欢听他说话。
examples.english_sentence: His voice is pleasant, so many people like listening to him speak.

english_meaning: in a gentle and amiable tone; speaking nicely; politely
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话语气温和、客气。
explanation_english: Describes speaking in a gentle, kind, and polite tone. Often used when asking for a favor or trying to calm someone down.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你 好 聲 好 氣 同 老闆 傾， 佢 可能 會 考慮 加 人工 俾 你 㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hou2 seng1 hou2 hei3 tung4 lou5 baan2 king1, keoi5 ho2 nang4 wui5 haam1 leoi6 gaa1 yan4 gung1 bei2 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你 好好 地 和 老板 谈谈，他可能会考虑给你涨工资的。
examples.english_sentence: If you talk to the boss nicely, he might consider giving you a raise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁惡死啦，好聲好氣講咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ok3 sei2 laa1, hou2 seng1 hou2 hei3 gong2 mai1 dak1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么凶，好好说话不就好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so fierce, just speak nicely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好聲好氣咁問你，你都唔答？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 seng1 hou2 hei3 gam2 man6 nei5, nei5 dou1 m4 daap3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我客客气气地问你，你都不回答？
examples.english_sentence: I asked you nicely, and you still don't answer?

english_meaning: Agreeable, amenable; to be easy to talk to and negotiate with; to be reasonable
explanation_mandarin: 形容人态度友善，容易沟通和商量。指态度温和，可以好好地进行谈判或沟通。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is friendly and easy to communicate and negotiate with. Refers to someone with a mild manner who allows for easy negotiation or communication.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個人好好聲行㗎，你同佢傾下應該冇問題嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 hou2 seng1 hang4 gaa3, nei5 tung4 keoi5 king1 haa5 ying1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很好说话的，你和他谈谈应该没问题的。
examples.english_sentence: This person is very agreeable; you should talk to them, there shouldn't be any problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果佢唔好聲行，我哋就搵第二個供應商啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 hou2 seng1 hang4, ngo5 dei6 zau6 wan2 dai6 ji6 go3 gung1 ying3 seung1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果他不好说话，我们就找第二个供应商吧。
examples.english_sentence: If he is not agreeable, we'll find a second supplier.

english_meaning: pleasant to hear; sounds good; melodious; nice (sound)
explanation_mandarin: 形容声音悦耳，令人感到舒适。
explanation_english: Describes a sound that is pleasant and comfortable to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌真係好聽呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 zan1 hai6 hou2 teng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌真好听啊！ (zhè shǒu gē zhēn hǎotīng a!)
examples.english_sentence: This song is really nice!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你把聲好好聽，好似唱歌咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baa2 seng1 hou2 hou2 teng1, hou2 ci5 cheung3 go1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的声音很好听，像唱歌一样。(nǐ de shēngyīn hěn hǎotīng, xiàng chànggē yīyàng.)
examples.english_sentence: Your voice is very pleasant, like singing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢把聲唔好聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 baa2 seng1 m4 hou2 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话的声音不好听。(tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn bù hǎotīng.)
examples.english_sentence: His voice is not pleasant when he speaks.

english_meaning: good omen; good luck (associated with someone entering a place)
explanation_mandarin: 指某人初次到访某个地方或参与某项活动，能带来好运或顺利的结果。通常形容某人运气好，能带来好的开端。
explanation_english: Refers to someone bringing good luck or a positive outcome upon their first visit to a place or participation in an activity. Usually describes someone who is lucky and brings a good start.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日第一日返工就簽咗張大單，真係好腳頭啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 dai6 jat1 jat6 faan1 gung1 zau6 cim1 zo2 zoeng1 daai6 daan1, zan1 hai6 hou2 goek3 tau4 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天第一天上班就签了一张大单，真是好兆头啊！
examples.english_sentence: He signed a big deal on his first day of work, that's really good luck!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你今日第一個入嚟我哋鋪頭，希望你有好腳頭啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam1 jat6 dai6 jat1 go3 jap6 lai4 ngo5 dei6 pou1 tau4, hei1 mong6 nei5 jau5 hou2 goek3 tau4 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你今天第一个进我们店，希望你有好兆头啦！
examples.english_sentence: You're the first customer to enter our shop today, hopefully you'll bring us good luck!

english_meaning: very brave; daring; bold; audacious
explanation_mandarin: 形容人胆子很大，敢于冒险，不怕困难或危险。
explanation_english: Describes someone as being very brave, daring, and willing to take risks, unafraid of difficulties or danger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人走去嗰度，真係好膽喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 zau2 heoi3 go2 dou6, zan1 hai6 hou2 daam2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人去那里，真是好大的胆子啊！
examples.english_sentence: He went there alone, he's really got guts!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣同老細講嘢，都幾好膽喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 tung4 lou5 sai3 gong2 je5, dou1 gei2 hou2 daam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样跟老板说话，也挺大胆的。
examples.english_sentence: You're quite bold, talking to the boss like that.

english_meaning: Look after yourself; take care of yourself; you'd better behave yourself; mind your own business (with a warning)
explanation_mandarin: 指自己好好地行事，多用于警告或劝诫的语气，暗示对方的行为可能会带来不好的后果，要自己承担。
explanation_english: A phrase used to advise or warn someone to take care of themselves and be responsible for their own actions, often implying that negative consequences may result from their behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做，到時出咗事就好自為之啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6, dou3 si4 chut1 zo2 si6 zau6 hou2 zi6 wai4 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做，到时出了事就自己负责吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you do it this way, you'd better be responsible if something goes wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經勸咗你咁多次，你唔聽嘅話，咁你好自為之啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hyun3 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 ci3, nei5 m4 teng1 ge3 waa2, gam2 nei5 hou2 zi6 wai4 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经劝了你这么多次，如果你不听，那就好自为之吧。
examples.english_sentence: I've advised you so many times, if you don't listen, then you're on your own.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆都唔幫你，你好自為之啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 dou1 m4 bong1 nei5, nei5 hou2 zi6 wai4 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板都不帮你，你好自为之吧。
examples.english_sentence: The boss isn't going to help you, so you're on your own.

english_meaning: Take care of yourself; look after yourself; you're on your own.
explanation_mandarin: 指好好地自己做主，自己处理事情，多含告诫或放弃不管的意思，通常是警告对方要为自己的行为负责，或表示不再干涉对方的事务。
explanation_english: It means to take good care of yourself and handle your own affairs. It often contains a warning or an implication of giving up. It is usually used to warn someone to be responsible for their own actions or to indicate that one will no longer interfere in their affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經提醒咗你咁多次，你都唔聽，到時出事嘅話，好自爲之啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai4 sing2 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 ci3, nei5 dou1 m4 teng1, dou3 si4 ceot1 si6 ge3 waa2, hou2 zi6 wai4 zi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经提醒你很多次了，你都不听，到时候出事的话，好自为之吧。
examples.english_sentence: I've reminded you so many times, but you don't listen. If something goes wrong, then take care of yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你哋決定要咁做，咁你哋好自爲之喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 jiu3 gam2 zou6, gam2 nei5 dei6 hou2 zi6 wai4 zi1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你们决定要这样做，那么你们好自为之吧。
examples.english_sentence: Since you've decided to do it this way, then you're on your own.

english_meaning: lecherous, lustful, horny, womanizing (if referring to a man)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常喜欢异性，或者对性有着强烈的欲望。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very fond of the opposite sex or has a strong sexual desire; lecherous; lustful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條仔好色㗎，成日望住啲女仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 zai2 hou2 sik1 gaa3, sing4 jat6 mong6 zyu6 di1 neoi5 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她男朋友很色，整天盯着女孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: Her boyfriend is lecherous, always staring at girls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁好色啦，專心啲做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 sik1 laa1, zyun1 sam1 di1 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么好色了，专心点工作。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so horny, focus on your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲男人唔好咁好色就好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 naam4 jan2 m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 sik1 zau6 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些男人不要那么好色就好了。
examples.english_sentence: It would be good if those men weren't so lustful.

english_meaning: Erotic, sexually suggestive, pornographic (often used to describe images or videos)
explanation_mandarin: 形容图像或影片内容带有性暗示，或直接包含性行为，带有色情成分。
explanation_english: Describes images or videos with sexual undertones or explicit sexual content; pornographic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲雜誌嘅封面好色水，唔啱細路睇嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 zaap6 zi3 ge3 fung1 min2 hou2 sik1 seoi2, m4 ngaam1 sai3 lou2 tai2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些杂志的封面很色情，不适合小孩子看。
examples.english_sentence: The covers of these magazines are very erotic, not suitable for children to see.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 網上有好多好色水嘅嘢，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mong5 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 hou3 sik1 seoi2 ge3 je5, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 网上有很多色情的东西，要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of erotic things online, you need to be careful.

english_meaning: advantage, benefit, good point, profit
explanation_mandarin: 优点，益处，对人或事物有利的方面。
explanation_english: Advantages, benefits, the good points or profitable aspects of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做運動對身體有好多好處嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 wan6 dung6 deoi3 san1 tai2 jau5 hou2 do1 hou2 cyu3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做运动对身体有很多好处的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing exercise has many benefits for the body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有咩好處啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 me1 hou2 cyu3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划有什么好处啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are the benefits of this plan?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用呢隻牌子嘅護膚品有咩好處？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ni1 zek3 paai4 zi2 ge3 wu6 fu1 ban2 jau5 me1 hou2 cyu3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用这个牌子的护肤品有什么好处？
examples.english_sentence: What are the benefits of using this brand of skincare products?

english_meaning: easy to walk; easy to traverse; passable
explanation_mandarin: 形容道路平坦，容易行走；也指道路畅通，便于通行。
explanation_english: Describes a road that is flat and easy to walk on; also refers to a road being clear and easy to pass through.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條路好行好多，啱啱鋪咗新嘅瀝青。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 lou6 hou2 haang4 hou2 do1, ngaam1 ngaam1 pou3 zo2 san1 ge3 lik1 cing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条路好走多了，刚刚铺了新的沥青。
examples.english_sentence: This road is much easier to walk on now, they just paved it with new asphalt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家條隧道通咗，去機場好行好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 tung1 zo2, heoi3 gei1 coeng4 hou2 haang4 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在隧道通了，去机场容易多了。
examples.english_sentence: Now that the tunnel is open, it's much easier to get to the airport.

english_meaning: Good riddance; I'm glad to see you go; You're not welcome back.
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某人离开感到高兴，不希望他们再回来。通常带有厌恶、不欢迎的态度。
explanation_english: An idiom used to express the feeling that someone is not welcome and their departure is welcomed. It implies a sense of dislike or animosity towards the person leaving, suggesting they should not return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日搞搞震，走咗咪好囉，好行夾唔送啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gaau2 gaau2 zan3, zau2 zo2 mai1 hou2 lo1, hou2 haang4 gaap3 m4 sung3 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是惹麻烦，走了更好，走好不送！
examples.english_sentence: He always causes trouble. It's better that he's gone. Good riddance!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然你咁唔滿意呢份工，辭職咪辭職囉，好行夾唔送。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 nei5 gam3 m4 mun5 yi3 ni1 fan6 gung1, ci4 zik1 mai1 ci4 zik1 lo1, hou2 haang4 gaap3 m4 sung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然你这么不满意这份工作，辞职就辞职吧，走好不送。
examples.english_sentence: Since you are so dissatisfied with this job, just quit. Good riddance.

mandarin_meaning: 穿好的衣服，吃好的食物
english_meaning: To wear nice clothes and eat nice food; to live a comfortable and luxurious life.
explanation_mandarin: 指生活富裕，能穿好的衣服，吃好的食物。形容生活条件优越。
explanation_english: Describes a prosperous life where one can afford to wear nice clothes and eat good food. It implies having a high standard of living and a comfortable lifestyle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家發咗達，日日好衣好着，生活不知幾寫意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 faat3 zo2 daat6, jat6 jat6 hou2 ji1 hou2 zoek3, sang1 wut6 bat1 zi1 gei2 se2 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在发达了，每天穿好的衣服，吃好的食物，生活非常惬意。
examples.english_sentence: Now that he's rich, he wears nice clothes and eats good food every day, his life is so comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前窮嘅時候邊有得好衣好着啊，依家啲後生真係唔知醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 kung4 ge3 si4 hau6 bin1 jau5 dak1 hou2 ji1 hou2 zoek3 aa3, ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 sang1 zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前穷的时候哪有机会穿好的衣服吃好的食物啊，现在的年轻人真是不知羞耻。
examples.english_sentence: When we were poor, there was no chance to wear nice clothes and eat good food. These youngsters these days are shameless.

mandarin_meaning: 生活富裕，有好的生活条件
english_meaning: To have a good livelihood, to live comfortably, to have good food and clothing
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活条件优越，吃穿不愁，经济状况良好。
explanation_english: Describes a comfortable life with good living conditions, where one doesn't have to worry about food and clothing, and the financial situation is good. Implies a certain level of prosperity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家人而家好衣食喇，住緊大屋，揸緊靚車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 ji4 gaa1 hou2 ji1 sik6 laa3, zyu6 gan2 daai6 uk1, zaa1 gan2 leng3 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家人现在生活很富裕了，住着大房子，开着好车。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is living comfortably now, living in a big house and driving a fancy car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日話以前生活艱苦，依家啲後生好衣食好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 sing4 jat6 waa6 ji5 cin4 sang1 wut6 gaan1 fu2, ji1 gaa1 di1 hau6 saang1 hou2 ji1 sik6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是说以前生活艰苦，现在的年轻人生活富裕多了。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always says that life used to be hard, and the young people these days have a much better livelihood.

mandarin_meaning: 很坏; 真讨厌; 令人讨厌
english_meaning: very bad; awful; nasty; annoying; mean
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事很不好，很差劲，让人讨厌，也可以表示程度非常高。
explanation_english: Describes something or someone as being very bad, awful, nasty, annoying, or mean. It can also indicate a high degree of something negative.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日蝦啲細路，真係好衰！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 haa1 di1 sai3 lou6, zan1 hai6 hou2 seoi1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是欺负小孩子，真是很讨厌！
examples.english_sentence: He always bullies the children, he's so mean!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日落咁大雨，好衰呀，搞到我出唔到街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5, hou2 seoi1 aa3, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 ceot1 m4 dou2 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天下这么大的雨，真讨厌，害得我出不了门。
examples.english_sentence: It's raining so heavily today, it's awful, I can't go out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣對佢，好衰㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 keoi5, hou2 seoi1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样对他，太坏了！
examples.english_sentence: It's mean of you to treat him like that!

mandarin_meaning: 偏偏; 倒霉; 凑巧
english_meaning: Of all things; to make matters worse; unfortunately; of all times
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情发生的时间或方式非常不巧，令人感到倒霉或无奈。
explanation_english: Indicates that something unfortunate or inconvenient happened at the worst possible time or in the worst possible way. Often used to express frustration or bad luck.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我趕住返工，好衰唔衰，架車竟然撻唔著！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 faan1 gung1, hou2 seoi1 m4 seoi1, gaa3 ce1 ging2 jin4 taat3 m4 zoek3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我赶着上班，好衰唔衰的，车竟然发动不起来！
examples.english_sentence: I was rushing to work, and of all things, the car wouldn't start!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日考試，好衰唔衰，今日發燒！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 haau2 si3, hou2 seoi1 m4 seoi1, gam1 jat6 faat3 siu1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天考试，偏偏今天发烧了！
examples.english_sentence: I have an exam tomorrow, and to make matters worse, I have a fever today!

english_meaning: to advise earnestly
explanation_mandarin: 用和缓友好的言语劝告别人。
explanation_english: To advise or persuade someone earnestly and patiently with kind and gentle words; to reason with someone in a gentle manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我已經好言相勸佢唔好再賭錢喇，但係佢都係唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hou2 jin4 soeng1 kuen3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dou2 cin2 laa3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 si6 m4 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经好好劝他不要再赌钱了，但是他还是不听。
examples.english_sentence: I have already earnestly advised him not to gamble anymore, but he still doesn't listen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 見到佢咁沮喪，我哋唯有好言相勸，希望可以幫到佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou3 keoi5 gam3 zeoi2 song3, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau2 hou2 jin4 soeng1 kuen3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看到他这么沮丧，我们只好耐心劝导，希望能帮助他。
examples.english_sentence: Seeing him so depressed, we can only advise him earnestly, hoping to help him.

english_meaning: nice words; compliments; flattery
explanation_mandarin: 指动听的话语，通常指赞扬或奉承的话。
explanation_english: Refers to pleasant words to hear, often compliments or flattery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講啲好話氹阿媽開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 gong2 di1 hou2 waa6 tam5 a3 maa1 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常说些好听的话哄妈妈开心。
examples.english_sentence: He often says nice things to make his mom happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係聽佢啲好話，要睇佢實際嘅行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 teng1 keoi5 di1 hou2 waa6, jiu3 tai2 keoi5 sat6 zai3 ge3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只听他的好话，要看他实际的行动。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just listen to his flattering words, look at his actual actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔信佢講嘅好話，佢講嘅野都唔係真嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 hou2 waa6, keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 dou1 m4 hai6 zan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不相信他说的好话，他说的都不是真的。
examples.english_sentence: I don't believe his nice words, what he says is not true.

synonyms: 讚美之詞 (zaan3 mei5 zi1 ci4)
甜言蜜語 (tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5)

mandarin_meaning: 说好听的话不中听，忠言逆耳
english_meaning: Truth hurts (literally: Good words are not pleasant to listen to); Plain speaking is often unwelcome.
explanation_mandarin: 指一些忠告或实话，虽然对人有益，但听起来并不舒服，容易让人反感。 通常用于引出一些不太好听但却是事实的陈述。
explanation_english: Refers to advice or truth that, although beneficial, is unpleasant to hear and easily causes resentment. It is often used to introduce a statement that may be unwelcome but is nevertheless true. It implies that what will follow may be difficult to accept but is necessary to hear.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好話唔好聽，你咁樣落去，遲早乞食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 waa2 m4 hou2 teng1, nei5 gam2 joeng2 lok6 heoi3, chi4 zou2 hat1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好听的话说在前头，你这样下去，迟早会乞讨。
examples.english_sentence: Truth hurts, if you continue like this, you'll end up begging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好話唔好聽啊，你啲英文真係要加把勁啦，唔係好難升職㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 waa2 m4 hou2 teng1 aa3, nei5 di1 ying1 man2 zan1 hai6 jiu3 gaa1 baa2 ging6 laa1, m4 hai6 hou2 naan4 sing1 jik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好听的话说在前头啊，你的英语真的要加油了，不然很难升职的。
examples.english_sentence: To be honest, you really need to improve your English, otherwise it'll be hard to get a promotion.

synonyms: 忠言逆耳 (zung1 jin4 jik6 ji5)

english_meaning: Easily said; easier said than done
explanation_mandarin: 表示一件事情说起来容易，做起来难。通常带有一种轻微的讽刺意味。
explanation_english: This idiom means that something is easily said but difficult to do. It often carries a slightly sarcastic tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減肥好話為啫，真係要做就知難啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 fei4 hou2 waa6 wai4 ze1, zan1 hai6 jiu3 zou6 zau6 zi1 naan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 减肥好说而已，真的要做才知道难。
examples.english_sentence: Losing weight is easier said than done. You'll realize how difficult it is when you actually try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 升職加薪好話為啫，冇咁容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing1 zik1 gaa1 san1 hou2 waa6 wai4 ze1, mou5 gam3 jung4 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 升职加薪好说，没那么容易的。
examples.english_sentence: Promotion and salary increase are easier said than done; it's not that easy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 創業好話為啫，要成功就要付出好多努力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cong3 jip6 hou2 waa6 wai4 ze1, jiu3 sing4 gung1 zau6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 hou2 do1 nu5 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 创业好说，要成功就要付出很多努力。
examples.english_sentence: Starting a business is easier said than done; to succeed, you need to put in a lot of effort.

english_meaning: to sell well; to be popular (of a product)
explanation_mandarin: 形容商品销售情况良好，受欢迎。
explanation_english: Describes a product that sells well and is popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢款手袋好賣到斷晒貨呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 kwan2 sau2 doi2 hou2 maai6 dou3 tyun5晒貨 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这款手提包卖得太好了，都断货了。
examples.english_sentence: This handbag is selling so well that it's completely out of stock.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅月餅好賣喎，我哋要入多啲貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 jyut6 beng2 hou2 maai6 wo3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jap6 do1啲貨.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的月饼卖得很好啊，我们要多进点货。
examples.english_sentence: The mooncakes are selling well this year; we need to order more.

english_meaning: Profitable; lucrative; easy to make money
explanation_mandarin: 容易赚钱，利润高的。
explanation_english: Describing something that is profitable, lucrative, or easy to make money from. It suggests that the earning potential is high and the effort required is relatively low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢排炒股好賺啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 paai4 caau2 gu2 hou2 zyun2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 最近炒股很赚钱啊！
examples.english_sentence: Recently, investing in stocks is very profitable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話賣口罩好賺，所以轉行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 maai6 haau2 zaau3 hou2 zyun2, so2 ji5 zyun2 hong4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说卖口罩很赚钱，所以转行了。
examples.english_sentence: He said selling face masks is profitable, so he changed careers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間餐廳啲嘢又貴又唔好食，都唔知點解咁好賺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 jau6 gwai3 jau6 m4 hou2 sik6, dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 gaai2 gam3 hou2 zyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家餐厅的东西又贵又不好吃，都不知道为什么那么赚钱。
examples.english_sentence: That restaurant's food is expensive and not delicious, I don't know why it's so profitable.

english_meaning: good idea, good approach, good way to do things
explanation_mandarin: 形容某種做法或方法是有效的，可行的，並且有可能成功。
explanation_english: Describes a method, approach or idea that is effective, feasible, and likely to be successful. It implies a good understanding of the situation and a smart strategy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project，我覺得你個plan幾好路數喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project, ngo5 gok3 dak1 nei5 go3 plan gei2 hou2 lou6 sou3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目，我觉得你的计划挺有办法的。
examples.english_sentence: For this project, I think your plan is a pretty good approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣做生意，真係好路數！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 seng1 ji3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lou6 sou3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样做生意，真是有门道！
examples.english_sentence: The way he does business is really smart!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 用呢個app嚟學廣東話，都幾好路數嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jung6 ni1 go3 app lai4 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2, dou1 gei2 hou2 lou6 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 用这个app来学习粤语，也算是个好办法。
examples.english_sentence: Using this app to learn Cantonese is quite a good way.

english_meaning: to improve; to take a turn for the better
explanation_mandarin: 情况变好。
explanation_english: To become better or improve in condition or situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅病情開始好轉喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 beng6 cing4 hoi1 ci2 hou2 zyun2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的病情开始好转了。
examples.english_sentence: His condition has started to improve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟情況有啲好轉嘅跡象。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 cing4 fong3 jau5 di1 hou2 zyun2 ge3 zik1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济状况有些好转的迹象。
examples.english_sentence: There are signs that the economy is improving.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過治療之後，佢嘅情況明顯好轉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 gwo3 zi6 liu4 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 cing4 fong3 ming4 hin2 hou2 zyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经过治疗之后，他的情况明显好转。
examples.english_sentence: After treatment, his condition has clearly improved.

english_meaning: Argumentative, fond of arguing, contentious
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人喜欢争辩，总是要争论个输赢。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is fond of arguing and always wants to win an argument.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好辯駁，咩都要拗一餐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 bin6 bok3, me1 dou1 jiu3 ngaau2 yat1 caan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很爱争辩，什么都要争论一番。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very argumentative person, he argues about everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢講咁多嘢啦，佢好辯駁㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 gong2 gam3 do1 ye5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 bin6 bok3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别和他讲那么多，他很爱辩论的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't talk to him too much, he's very argumentative.

english_meaning: very near; very close
explanation_mandarin: 形容距离非常短，接近。
explanation_english: Describes a very short distance, being close to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企離地鐵站好近㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 lei4 dei6 tit3 zaam6 hou2 gan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家离地铁站很近的。
examples.english_sentence: My home is very close to the subway station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你間學校喺呢度好近，行幾分鐘就到㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hai2 ni1 dou6 hou2 gan6, haang4 gei2 fan1 zung1 zau6 dou3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的学校离这里很近，走几分钟就到了。
examples.english_sentence: Your school is very close to here, you can get there in a few minutes by walking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩個國家嘅關係好近。
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 gan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两个国家的关系很密切。
examples.english_sentence: The relationship between the two countries is very close.

english_meaning: to recover; to get well; to be healed; to return to normal
explanation_mandarin: 指从疾病或不好的状态中恢复过来，恢复到原来的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to recovering from an illness or a bad state, returning to the original state of health or normalcy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病咗幾日，依家好返喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 zo2 gei2 jat6, ji1 gaa1 hou2 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病了几天，现在已经好了。
examples.english_sentence: He was sick for a few days, but he has recovered now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電腦整好返喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 nou5 zing2 hou2 faan1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电脑修好了。
examples.english_sentence: The computer is fixed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事搞好返晒未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si4 gaau2 hou2 faan1 saai3 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情都处理好了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you finished dealing with the matter?

mandarin_meaning: 好逸恶劳 (hào yì wù láo)
english_meaning: to love ease and hate work; to be lazy
explanation_mandarin: 喜欢安逸，厌恶劳动。指贪图安逸，躲避劳动。
explanation_english: Describes someone who loves to be comfortable and avoids hard work. It implies a preference for ease and aversion to labor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好逸惡勞，成日淨係識得嘆世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 jat6 ok3 lou4, seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 taan3 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人好逸恶劳，整天就知道享乐。
examples.english_sentence: He's a lazy person, always just wanting to enjoy life and not work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你唔改掉好逸惡勞嘅習慣，第日一定會後悔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 m4 goi2 diu6 hou2 jat6 ok3 lou4 ge3 zaap6 gwaan3, dai6 jat6 ding6 waai5 hau6 fui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不改掉好逸恶劳的习惯，将来一定会后悔。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't change your lazy habit, you'll definitely regret it in the future.

synonyms: 好吃懶做 (hou2 hek3 laan5 zou6)
遊手好閒 (jau4 sau2 hou2 haan4)

english_meaning: good luck
explanation_mandarin: 指好的运气，顺利的机会。
explanation_english: Good luck; fortune. Refers to having favorable circumstances or positive outcomes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你考試好運！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 haau2 si5 hou2 wan6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你考试好运！
examples.english_sentence: Good luck with your exam!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次真係行好運，執到咁多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 zan1 hai6 haang4 hou2 wan6, zap1 dou2 gam3 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次真是走好运，捡到这么多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He's really lucky this time, he found so much money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望下次我都會咁好運啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 haa6 ci3 ngo5 dou1 wui5 gam3 hou2 wan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望下次我也会这么好运了。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I'll be so lucky next time.

english_meaning: Better than; preferable to; to surpass; to be better off (than)
explanation_mandarin: 表示比另一个情况更好，更优越，或过得更好。既可以指物质条件，也可以指精神状态。
explanation_english: Indicates that something is better or more preferable than another situation. It can refer to material conditions or mental states.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 留喺屋企好過出去迫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 gwo3 cheot1 heoi3 bik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 待在家里好过出去拥挤。
examples.english_sentence: Staying at home is better than going out to be crowded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅成績好過我好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing1 jik1 hou2 gwo3 ngo5 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的成绩比我好很多。
examples.english_sentence: His grades are much better than mine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 噉樣做會好過之前嘅方法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam2 joeng2 zou6 wui5 hou2 gwo3 ji1 chin4 ge3 fong1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样做会比之前的方法好。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way will be better than the previous method.

english_meaning: Better than nothing; something is better than nothing.
explanation_mandarin: 表示有总比没有好，即使得到的不多或质量不高，也比什么都没有要好。
explanation_english: Indicates that it is better to have something than nothing at all, even if it is not much or of high quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然份工人工唔高，但係好過冇啦，起碼有收入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 hou2 gwo3 mou5 laa1, hei2 maa5 jau5 sau1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然这份工作工资不高，但是总比没有好，起码有收入。
examples.english_sentence: Although this job doesn't pay much, it's better than nothing. At least I have an income.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲嘢食唔係好好味，但係好過冇嘢食，餓死就唔好啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 je5 sik6 m4 hai6 hou2 hou2 mei6, daan6 hai6 hou2 gwo3 mou5 je5 sik6, ngo6 sei2 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些食物不是很好吃，但是总比没东西吃好，饿死就不好啦。
examples.english_sentence: This food isn't very tasty, but it's better than nothing. It's better than starving.

english_meaning: Good and bad; beautiful and ugly; advantages and disadvantages; pros and cons
explanation_mandarin: 指事物的优点和缺点，好的一面和坏的一面；亦可指外貌的美丽与丑陋。
explanation_english: Refers to the advantages and disadvantages of something, the good and the bad sides. It can also refer to the beauty and ugliness of appearance; pros and cons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都要諗清楚件事嘅好醜先好做決定呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 hou2 cau2 sin1 hou2 zou6 kyut3 ding6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你也要想清楚这件事的好坏再做决定。
examples.english_sentence: You need to think clearly about the pros and cons of this matter before making a decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇人哋嘅好，都要睇下佢哋嘅醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 yan4 dei6 ge3 hou2, dou1 jiu3 tai2 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看别人的好，也要看看他们的坏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at people's good sides, you have to see their bad sides too.

english_meaning: One's fate, whether good or bad, is predetermined; you get what you're given.
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的命运，无论是好是坏，都是天生注定的，难以改变。强调命运的不可预测性和不可抗拒性，也带有一定程度的宿命论色彩。
explanation_english: This proverb suggests that a person's fate, whether good or bad, is predetermined from birth and is difficult to change. It emphasizes the unpredictability and inevitability of fate and carries a sense of fatalism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 都話好醜命生成，唔好咁執著啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: dou1 waa6 hou2 cau2 ming6 sang1 sing4, m4 hou2 gam3 zap1 zoek6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都说好坏都是命注定的，不要太执着了！
examples.english_sentence: It's said that one's fate is predetermined, don't be so obsessed with it!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢好努力，但係事業都係唔順利，真係好醜命生成。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6, daan6 hai6 si6 jip6 dou1 hai6 m4 seon6 lei6, zan1 hai6 hou2 cau2 ming6 sang1 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他很努力，但是事业还是不顺利，真是好坏都是命注定的。
examples.english_sentence: Although he works very hard, his career is still not going well. It's really like fate is predetermined.

english_meaning: Very free, have nothing to do, not busy
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人非常空闲，没什么事情做，时间很多。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very free, has nothing to do, and has a lot of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日好閒，不如我哋出去行街啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 haan4, bat1 jyu4 ngo5 dei6 chut1 heoi3 haang4 gaai1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天很闲，不如我们出去逛街吧？
examples.english_sentence: I'm very free today, how about we go out for a walk?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢退休之後，生活就好閒咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6, sang1 wut6 zau6 hou2 haan4 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他退休之后，生活就很清闲了。
examples.english_sentence: After he retired, his life became very free.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使擔心我，我而家好閒，有時間幫你手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 ngo5, ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 haan4, jau5 si4 gaan3 bong1 nei5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用担心我，我现在很空闲，有时间帮你忙。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry about me, I'm very free now, I have time to help you.

english_meaning: honorable, glorious, prestigious, bringing honor to someone, giving someone face
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或某人使另一个人感到光荣，有面子。通常用于描述好的结果或成就给他人带来荣誉。
explanation_english: Refers to something or someone bringing honor and prestige to another person. Usually used to describe good results or achievements that bring honor to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔考到大學，真係俾我哋好面光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 haau2 dou3 daai6 hok6, zan1 hai6 bei2 ngo5 dei6 hou2 min6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子考上大学，真给我们长脸。
examples.english_sentence: My son got into university, it really brings honor to us.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺國際比賽攞到獎，好面光啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gwok3 zai3 bei2 coi3 lo2 dou3 zoeng2, hou2 min6 gwong1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在国际比赛中获奖了，真光荣啊。
examples.english_sentence: He won an award in an international competition, it's so honorable!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次project成功，老闆都覺得我哋好面光。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 project sing4 gung1, lou5 baan2 dou1 gok3 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hou2 min6 gwong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次项目成功，老板都觉得我们很有面子。
examples.english_sentence: This project was a success, and the boss thinks it brings honor to us.

jyutping: hou2 tau4 bat1 jyu4 hou2 mei5
english_meaning: A good ending is better than a good beginning.
explanation_mandarin: 指事情的开头好，不如结尾好。强调事情的最终结果比起始阶段更为重要。
explanation_english: This idiom means that it's more important to have a good ending than a good start. It emphasizes the significance of the final outcome of a matter, suggesting that a successful conclusion outweighs a promising beginning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢哋間公司開始嘅時候好威水，但係而家執咗笠，真係好頭不如好尾。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 hoi1 chi2 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 wai1 seoi2, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 zap1 zo2 lap1, zan1 hai6 hou2 tau4 bat1 jyu4 hou2 mei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他们公司开始的时候很风光，但是现在倒闭了，真是善始不如善终。
examples.english_sentence: Although their company was very impressive at the beginning, it has now closed down. It's a case of a good beginning not being as good as a good ending.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢最緊要唔好爛尾，好頭不如好尾嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 m4 hou2 laan6 mei5, hou2 tau4 bat1 jyu4 hou2 mei5 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作最重要的是不要半途而废，要善始善终。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing when working is not to leave things unfinished. A good ending is better than a good beginning.

english_meaning: A good beginning and a good end; to see something through to the end; to finish well.
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事有始有终，认真负责，结果圆满。
explanation_english: Describes doing something from beginning to end in a responsible and thorough manner, leading to a satisfactory outcome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個project你一定要好頭好尾咁做完佢啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 project nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 hou2 tau4 hou2 mei5 gam2 zou6 jyun4 gei3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个项目一定要有始有终地完成它啊。
examples.english_sentence: You must finish this project with a good beginning and a good end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人最緊要好頭好尾，唔好半途而廢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hou2 tau4 hou2 mei5, m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人最重要的是有始有终，不要半途而废。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in life is to see things through to the end; don't give up halfway.

english_meaning: stubborn, obstinate
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常固执，不听劝告，很难改变其想法或决定。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very stubborn, unwilling to listen to advice, and difficult to change their mind or decision.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人真係好頸，講極都唔聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 geng2, gong2 gik1 dou1 m4 ting1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人真是固执，怎么说都不听。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a stubborn person; he won't listen no matter how much you tell him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁好頸啦，聽下人哋意見都好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 geng2 laa1, ting1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ji3 gin3 dou1 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么固执了，听听别人的意见也好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listening to other people's opinions is also good.

english_meaning: delicious; tasty; good to eat
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物味道好，美味。
explanation_english: Describes food that tastes good; delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢好食㗎，試吓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 hou2 sik6 gaa3, si3 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西很好吃，试试吧。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is delicious, give it a try.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個蛋糕真係好食到停唔到口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 daan6 gou1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个蛋糕真的好吃到停不下来。
examples.english_sentence: This cake is so delicious that I can't stop eating it.

english_meaning: to eat well and live comfortably; to have a good life with good food and accommodation
explanation_mandarin: 形容生活条件优越，吃得好，住得好，生活舒适。
explanation_english: Describes a life with excellent living conditions, where one eats well, lives comfortably, and enjoys a good life.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢移民咗去加拿大之後，就過住好食好住嘅生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 man4 zo2 heoi3 gaa1 naa4 daai6 zi1 hau6, zau6 gwo3 zyu6 hou2 sik6 hou2 zyu6 ge3 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他移民到加拿大之后，就过着吃好住好的生活。
examples.english_sentence: After he immigrated to Canada, he lived a life of eating well and living comfortably.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅願望就係以後可以好食好住，唔使擔心咁多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 jyun6 mong6 zau6 hai6 ji5 hau6 ho2 ji5 hou2 sik6 hou2 zyu6, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 gam3 do1 ye5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的愿望就是以后可以吃好住好，不用担心那么多事情。
examples.english_sentence: My wish is that in the future I can eat well, live comfortably, and not have to worry about so many things.

english_meaning: Gluttonous and lazy; someone who enjoys eating but dislikes working
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人贪吃又懒惰，喜欢享受而不愿意付出劳动。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is gluttonous and lazy, enjoying pleasure but unwilling to work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好食懶飛，成日攤喺梳化度睇電視。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sik6 laan5 fei1, seng4 jat6 taan1 hai2 so1 faa2 dou6 tai2 din6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是好吃懒做，整天躺在沙发上看电视。
examples.english_sentence: He's really gluttonous and lazy, always lying on the sofa watching TV.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁好食懶飛啦，幫手做下家務啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 sik6 laan5 fei1 laa1, bong1 sau2 zou6 haa5 gaa1 mou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别那么好吃懒做了，帮帮忙做点家务吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so gluttonous and lazy, please help with some housework.

synonyms: 遊手好閒 (jau4 sau2 hou3 haan4)
好吃懶做 (hou2 chik3 laan5 zou6)

english_meaning: tasty (to drink); delicious (drink); palatable
explanation_mandarin: 形容饮料味道好，容易入口，令人喜欢。
explanation_english: Describes a drink that tastes good, is easy to drink, and is enjoyable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢杯奶茶真係好飲呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bui1 naai5 caa4 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这杯奶茶真好喝啊！
examples.english_sentence: This milk tea is really delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你試下呢杯嘢飲，睇下好唔好飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 si3 haa5 ni1 bui1 je5 jam2, tai2 haa5 hou2 m4 hou2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你试试这杯饮料，看看好不好喝。
examples.english_sentence: Try this drink and see if it's tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅檸檬茶出名好飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ning4 mung1 caa4 ceot1 ming4 hou2 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的柠檬茶出名好喝。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant's lemon tea is famous for being delicious.

english_meaning: delicious to drink and eat; good food and drink
explanation_mandarin: 形容食物和饮料都非常好。通常用于形容宴席、聚餐等场合的食物和饮料。
explanation_english: Describes food and drinks that are both delicious. Usually used to describe food and drinks at banquets, gatherings, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚間酒樓啲嘢真係好飲好食，食到我飽晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 gaan1 zau2 lau4 di1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam2 hou2 sik6, sik6 dou3 ngo5 baau2晒.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚酒楼的东西真是好吃好喝，我吃饱了。
examples.english_sentence: The food at the restaurant tonight was really delicious, I'm so full.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，屋企人會準備好多好飲好食嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, uk1 kei2 jan4 wui5 zyun2 bei6 hou2 do1 hou2 jam2 hou2 sik6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，家人会准备很多好吃好喝的东西。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, family members will prepare a lot of delicious food and drinks.

synonyms: 美味佳餚 (mei5 mei6 gaai1 jiu4)
珍饈百味 (zan1 siu1 baak3 mei6)

english_meaning: able to drink a lot; a good drinker; having a high alcohol tolerance
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人很能喝酒，酒量很好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who can drink a lot of alcohol without getting easily drunk; a person with a high tolerance for alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好飲得，飲咗咁多都面不改容。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 jam2 dak1, jam2 zo2 gam3 do1 dou1 min6 bat1 goi2 jung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真能喝，喝了这么多都面不改色。
examples.english_sentence: He can really drink! He's drunk so much and his face hasn't even changed color.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好同佢鬥酒啦，佢好飲得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 tung4 keoi5 dau3 zau2 laa1, keoi5 hou2 jam2 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要和他拼酒了，他很能喝的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't compete with him in drinking, he's a really good drinker.

english_meaning: good dish; delicious food; a good deal (figuratively)
explanation_mandarin: 指味道好、品质佳的菜肴。也可用作比喻，指好的事情或交易。
explanation_english: Refers to a dish that tastes good or is of high quality. Figuratively, it can also refer to a good thing or a good deal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚啲餸好鬼正啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 di1 sung3 hou2 gwai2 zeng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚的菜非常好吃！
examples.english_sentence: Tonight's dishes are really delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢真係好餸，一定要做！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sung3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这笔交易真是太好了，一定要做！
examples.english_sentence: This deal is really good, we must do it!

english_meaning: Easy to use and very practical; handy and useful
explanation_mandarin: 指某物容易操作，并且非常实用，有价值。
explanation_english: Describes something that is easy to operate and very practical, valuable, and useful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電話又輕又細，真係好駛好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 jau6 hing1 jau6 sai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai2 hou2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台手机又轻又小，真是好用。
examples.english_sentence: This phone is light and small, it's really easy to use and very practical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廚房小工具好駛好用，幫我慳咗好多時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 chu4 fong2 siu2 gung1 geoi2 hou2 sai2 hou2 yung6, bong1 ngo5 haam1 zo2 hou2 do1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个厨房小工具很好用，帮我节省了很多时间。
examples.english_sentence: This kitchen gadget is very handy and useful, it saves me a lot of time.

english_meaning: to aim too high; to be overambitious; unrealistic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人不切实际，追求过高的目标。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is unrealistic, pursuing overly high and unattainable goals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁好高騖遠啦，一步一步嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hou2 gou1 mou6 jyun5 laa1, jat1 bou6 jat1 bou6 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么好高骛远了，一步一步来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so overambitious, take it one step at a time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都諗住一年發達，真係好高騖遠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 nam2 zyu6 jat1 nin4 faat3 daat6, zan1 hai6 hou2 gou1 mou6 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是想着一年发财，真是好高骛远。
examples.english_sentence: He always thinks about getting rich in a year, it's really overambitious.

english_meaning: very, extremely
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度，相当于“很”、“非常”。 鬼是粤语中常用的加强语气词。
explanation_english: An adverb indicating a high degree, equivalent to "very" or "extremely." "鬼" (gwai2) is a common Cantonese word used to intensify the meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食好鬼好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 gwai2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物非常好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is extremely delicious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日好鬼唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gwai2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天非常不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very unhappy today.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰部戲好鬼恐怖㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 bou6 hei3 hou2 gwai2 hung2 bou3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那部电影非常恐怖。
examples.english_sentence: That movie is extremely scary.

english_meaning: extremely, terribly, awfully, deadly (used as an intensifier)
explanation_mandarin: 表示程度很深，非常。通常用在形容词或动词前，表达强烈的语气。
explanation_english: An intensifier, used before an adjective or verb to indicate a very high degree or intensity. Often implies a negative or exaggerated feeling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日好鬼死凍啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hou2 gwai2 sei2 dung3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天非常冷啊！
examples.english_sentence: It's terribly cold today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好鬼死鍾意睇戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gwai2 sei2 zung1 ji3 tai2 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他非常喜欢看电影。
examples.english_sentence: He really loves watching movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鬼死攰，想瞓覺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 gwai2 sei2 gui6, soeng2 fan3 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我累死了，想睡觉。
examples.english_sentence: I'm awfully tired, I want to sleep.

english_meaning: matchmaker; go-between
explanation_mandarin: 旧时介绍婚姻的人。比喻居中介绍、撮合的人。
explanation_english: In old times, a person who introduces marriages; a matchmaker. By analogy, someone who introduces or brings things together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠妁人介紹識咗佢老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 sok3 jan4 gaai3 siu6 sik1 zo2 keoi5 lou5 po4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他通过媒人介绍认识了他的妻子。
examples.english_sentence: He met his wife through a matchmaker.

english_meaning: like, as if, if, such as
explanation_mandarin: 表示相似，如同；表示假设，如果；用于举例，例如
explanation_english: Indicates similarity, like or as; Indicates a hypothesis, if; Used for giving examples, such as.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好似如你所講咁，佢真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 ci5 jyu4 nei5 so2 gong2 gam2, keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 好像如你所说的那样，他真的很棒。
examples.english_sentence: As you said, he is really great.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我中咗六合彩，我就會環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 zung3 zo2 luk6 hap6 coi2, ngo5 zau6 wui5 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果我中了彩票，我就会环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: If I win the lottery, I will travel around the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多唔同嘅娛樂，如行山、購物同埋食嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 jyu4 lok6, jyu4 haang4 saan1, kau3 mat6 tung4 ma4 sik6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多不同的娱乐，如徒步旅行、购物和吃东西。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many different forms of entertainment, such as hiking, shopping, and eating.

english_meaning: nowadays, now, at present
explanation_mandarin: 指现在这个时间点或时期。
explanation_english: Refers to the present time or period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如今啲嘢貴咗好多喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gam1 di1 je5 gwai3 zo2 hou2 do1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的东西贵了很多了。
examples.english_sentence: Things are much more expensive nowadays.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如今我哋嘅生活好咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gam1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6 hou2 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在我们的生活好了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Our lives are much better now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢如今喺邊度做嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyu4 gam1 hai2 bin1 dou6 zou6 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在哪里工作啊？
examples.english_sentence: Where does he work now?

english_meaning: if; in case; supposing that
explanation_mandarin: 表示假设，相当于“如果”或“假如”。
explanation_english: Expressing a hypothetical situation, equivalent to "if" or "in case".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如估聽日落雨，我哋就唔去行山啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gu2 ting1 jat6 lok6 jyu5, ngo5 dei6 zau6 m4 heoi3 haang4 saan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 假如明天下雨，我们就不去爬山了。
examples.english_sentence: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go hiking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如估你唔舒服，就早啲瞓啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gu2 nei5 m4 syu1 fuk6, zau6 zou2 di1 fan3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不舒服，就早点睡觉吧。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't feel well, go to bed early.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如估你唔明，可以問我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gu2 nei5 m4 ming4, ho2 ji5 man6 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你不明白，可以问我。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't understand, you can ask me.

english_meaning: how; what; what way
explanation_mandarin: 表示询问方式、方法、原因等。
explanation_english: Used to ask about the manner, method, or reason for something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你打算如何解決呢個問題啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 daa2 syun3 jyu4 ho4 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算怎么解决这个问题呢？
examples.english_sentence: How are you planning to solve this problem?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知應該如何做先至啱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 ying1 goi1 jyu4 ho4 zou6 sin1 zi3 aam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道应该怎么做才对。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to do it correctly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你會如何慶祝生日啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wui5 jyu4 ho4 hing3 zuk1 saang1 jat6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你会如何庆祝生日啊？
examples.english_sentence: How will you celebrate your birthday?

english_meaning: Tathagata Buddha
explanation_mandarin: 佛教中的至高佛陀，也被认为是西游记中的强大神仙。
explanation_english: The Tathagata Buddha, the supreme Buddha in Buddhism, also regarded as a powerful deity in Journey to the West.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間廟好大，中間坐住如來佛祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 miu2 hou2 daai6, zung1 gaan1 co5 zyu6 jyu4 loi4 fat6 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这座庙很大，中间坐着如来佛祖。
examples.english_sentence: This temple is very big, and in the middle sits the Tathagata Buddha.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 遇到搞唔掂嘅事，就求如來佛祖保佑啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu6 dou3 gaau2 m4 dim6 ge3 si6, zau6 kau4 jyu4 loi4 fat6 zou2 bou2 jau6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 遇到解决不了的事情，就求如来佛祖保佑吧。
examples.english_sentence: When you encounter problems you can't solve, pray to the Tathagata Buddha for blessing.

mandarin_meaning: 如来神掌 (如来佛祖的神掌)
english_meaning: Buddha's Palm (referring to a powerful martial arts technique)
explanation_mandarin: 原指佛教中如来佛祖的手掌。在香港，通常指一种武功招式，尤其是在武侠小说和电影中经常出现。也比喻压倒性的力量或权威。
explanation_english: Originally refers to the palm of Buddha in Buddhism. In Hong Kong, it usually refers to a martial arts technique, often seen in wuxia novels and movies. It can also be used metaphorically to describe overwhelming power or authority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰招簡直係如來神掌，一出手就將對手打到飛起。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 ziu1 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jyu4 loi4 san4 zoeng2, jat1 chut1 sau2 zau6 zoeng1 deoi3 sau2 daa2 dou3 fei1 hei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那一招简直是如来神掌，一出手就把对手打飞了。
examples.english_sentence: His move was practically Buddha's Palm, knocking the opponent flying with a single strike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日用如來神掌壓住啲伙計，搞到個個都唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 sing4 jat6 yung6 jyu4 loi4 san4 zoeng2 aat3 zyu6 di1 fo2 gai2, gaau2 dou3 go3 go3 dou1 m4 gam2 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是用如来神掌压着员工，搞得每个人都不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always uses his authority to suppress the employees, leaving everyone afraid to speak up.

english_meaning: Genuine article, guaranteed; what you see is what you get
explanation_mandarin: 保证是真货，如果是假的，可以赔偿。
explanation_english: Guaranteeing the authenticity of the product; promising it is genuine and offering compensation if it's proven fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭嘅海味如假包換㗎，你放心買啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 ge3 hoi2 mei6 jyu4 gaa2 baau1 wun6 gaa3, nei5 fong3 sam1 maai5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺的海味保证是真货，你放心买吧。
examples.english_sentence: The seafood in this store is guaranteed genuine, so feel free to buy it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司嘅服務如假包換，一定令你滿意。

english_meaning: Exactly the same; cut from the same cloth; identical; of a piece.
explanation_mandarin: 指两件事情或两个人的做法、想法完全一样，没有差别。
explanation_english: Describes two things, methods, or people being exactly the same, with no difference.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個嘅畫風如出一轍，睇落好似同一個人畫咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 ge3 waa2 fung1 jyu4 ceot1 jat1 cit3, tai2 lok6 ho2 ci5 tung4 jat1 go3 jan4 waa2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的画风如出一辙，看起来好像同一个人画的。
examples.english_sentence: Their painting styles are exactly the same, it looks like they were painted by the same person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司嘅營銷策略如出一轍，都係靠低價競爭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 ying4 siu1 caak3 leok6 jyu4 ceot1 jat1 cit3, dou1 hai6 kaau3 dai1 gaa3 ging6 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司的营销策略如出一辙，都是靠低价竞争。
examples.english_sentence: The marketing strategies of the two companies are identical, both relying on low-price competition.

english_meaning: as if; like; similar to; as
explanation_mandarin: 表示相似、好像；如同。
explanation_english: Indicates similarity; as if; like.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹如同餅印一樣，真係好似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 jyu4 tung4 beng2 jan3 jat1 joeng6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹如同一个模子刻出来的，真的很相像。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters are like they were made from the same mold; they really look alike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間屋亂到如同打完仗咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 uk1 lyun6 dou3 jyu4 tung4 daa2 jyun4 zoeng3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间乱得好像打完仗一样。
examples.english_sentence: The room is so messy, it's as if a war just ended.

english_meaning: to sit on pins and needles; to feel very uncomfortable or uneasy (as if sitting on a bed of needles)
explanation_mandarin: 形容心情极为不安，好像坐在满是针的毡子上一样。
explanation_english: Describes a feeling of extreme discomfort and unease, as if sitting on a felt mat covered in needles. It's used when someone feels anxious, restless, or embarrassed in a particular situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺個會議入面，佢畀老細問到口啞啞，真係如坐針氈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 go3 wui2 ji5 jap6 min6, keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 man6 dou3 hau2 aa2 aa2, zan1 hai6 jyu4 zo6 zam1 zin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在会议里，他被老板问得哑口无言，真是如坐针毡。
examples.english_sentence: In the meeting, he was rendered speechless by the boss's questions, truly feeling like he was sitting on pins and needles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等緊考試成績嗰陣，我成日都如坐針氈，好驚唔合格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 gan2 haau2 si5 sing4 zik1 go2 zan6, ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 jyu4 zo6 zam1 zin1, hou2 geng1 m4 hap6 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等待考试成绩的时候，我整天都如坐针毡，很怕不及格。
examples.english_sentence: While waiting for the exam results, I felt like I was sitting on pins and needles all day, fearing that I might fail.

english_meaning: as if awakening from a dream; to come to one's senses; to suddenly realize something
explanation_mandarin: 好像刚从梦中醒来。比喻从糊涂、错误的认识中醒悟过来。
explanation_english: Describes a state of sudden realization or awakening from a state of confusion, delusion, or ignorance. It implies a transition from a dreamlike state to clear awareness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人呃咗咁耐，而家先至如夢初醒，都算好彩啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 gam3 noi6, ji4 gaa1 sin1 zi3 jyu4 mung6 co1 sing2, dou1 syun3 hou2 coi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人骗了这么久，现在才如梦初醒，也算幸运了。
examples.english_sentence: He was scammed for so long, it's lucky that he's only just now coming to his senses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽完佢嘅解釋，我先如夢初醒，原來係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jyun4 keoi5 ge3 gaai2 sik1, ngo5 sin1 jyu4 mung6 co1 sing2, jyun4 loi4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听完他的解释，我才如梦初醒，原来是这样。
examples.english_sentence: After hearing his explanation, I finally came to my senses; so that's how it is.

synonyms: 幡然醒悟 (faan1 jin4 sing2 ng6)
恍然大悟 (fong2 jin4 daai6 ng6)

english_meaning: truthfully; factually; as is; according to the facts
explanation_mandarin: 按照实际情况，不加虚假地。
explanation_english: According to the actual situation, without adding falsehoods; truthfully, factually.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你如實咁講就得喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jyu4 sat6 gam2 gong2 zau6 dak1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你如实地讲就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: Just tell it truthfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將件事如實咁報告咗俾老細聽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gin6 si6 jyu4 sat6 gam2 bou3 gou3 zo2 bei2 lou5 sai3 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把事情如实地报告给了老板听。
examples.english_sentence: He reported the matter to the boss truthfully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我會如實反映你嘅意見俾管理層知。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wui5 jyu4 sat6 faan2 jing2 nei5 ge3 ji3 gin3 bei2 gun2 lei5 cang4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我会如实地反映你的意见给管理层知道。
examples.english_sentence: I will truthfully reflect your opinion to the management.

english_meaning: as if treading on thin ice; to feel like one is treading on eggshells; to be very cautious
explanation_mandarin: 比喻行事极为谨慎，怕稍有疏忽会发生意外。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where one is extremely cautious and careful, fearing that any carelessness could lead to disaster or negative consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家公司財政唔係咁好，所以做嘢要如履薄冰，唔可以出錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 gung1 si1 coi4 zing3 m4 hai6 gam2 hou2, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 jiu3 jyu4 lei5 bok6 bing1, m4 ho2 ji5 ceot1 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在公司的财政状况不是很好，所以工作要如履薄冰，不可以出错。
examples.english_sentence: The company's finances aren't doing so well right now, so we have to be extremely careful at work and can't afford to make any mistakes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺上司面前，佢講嘢永遠都如履薄冰，驚講錯嘢得罪佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng6 si1 min6 cin4, keoi5 gong2 je5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 jyu4 lei5 bok6 bing1, geng1 gong2 co3 je5 dak1 zeoi6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在上司面前，他说话永远都如履薄冰，怕说错话得罪他。
examples.english_sentence: In front of his boss, he always speaks as if treading on thin ice, afraid of saying the wrong thing and offending him.

english_meaning: as usual; as normal; as before
explanation_mandarin: 像往常一样，没有变化。
explanation_english: As usual; as normal; without any change; as before.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢病好返之後，都係如常咁返工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 beng6 hou2 faan1 zi1 hau6, dou1 hai6 jyu4 soeng4 gam2 faan1 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他病好之后，还是照常上班。
examples.english_sentence: After he recovered from his illness, he went back to work as usual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然經濟唔好，但係佢哋嘅生活都如常咁過。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 sang1 wut6 dou1 jyu4 soeng4 gam2 gwo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然经济不好，但是他们的生活还是照常过。
examples.english_sentence: Although the economy is not good, they are still living their lives as usual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨之後，交通都如常擠塞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, gaau1 tung1 dou1 jyu4 soeng4 zai1 sak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下完雨之后，交通还是照常拥堵。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, the traffic is still congested as usual.

english_meaning: to go to the toilet; to use the restroom
explanation_mandarin: 婉转地说去厕所，比较正式的说法。
explanation_english: A polite and formal way of saying 'to go to the toilet' or 'to use the restroom'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我想如廁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 soeng2 jyu4 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问，我想去洗手间。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I would like to use the restroom.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他要去上厕所，所以先走了。
examples.english_sentence: He said he needed to use the restroom, so he left early.

english_meaning: Inseparable; Like a shadow follows the body
explanation_mandarin: 像影子总是跟随着身体一样，形容关系密切，经常在一起。
explanation_english: Describes something that is inseparable or always follows something else closely, like a shadow follows a body. It implies a very close relationship or constant presence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個如影隨形，去邊都一齊去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jyu4 jing2 ceoi4 jing4, heoi3 bin1 dou1 jat1 cai4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人如影随形，去哪里都一起去。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are inseparable, they go everywhere together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 壓力如影隨形咁跟住我，搞到我透唔過氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aat3 lik6 jyu4 jing2 ceoi4 jing4 gam2 gan1 zyu6 ngo5, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 tau3 m4 gwo3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 压力如影随形地跟着我，搞得我喘不过气。
examples.english_sentence: Pressure follows me like a shadow, making me feel suffocated.

english_meaning: As one wishes; according to one's wishes; satisfactory; fulfilling; a scepter (symbol of good fortune)
explanation_mandarin: 形容事情发展顺利，符合心愿。 也指一种象征吉祥的器物。
explanation_english: Describes something going smoothly and according to one's wishes. It can also refer to a 'ruyi' scepter, a traditional Chinese ornamental object symbolizing good fortune and power.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 祝你新年快樂，萬事如意！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zuk1 nei5 san1 nin4 faai3 lok6, maan6 si6 jyu4 ji3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 祝你新年快乐，万事如意！
examples.english_sentence: Happy New Year! May all your wishes come true!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工做得好如意，人工又高，福利又好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 zou6 dak1 hou2 jyu4 ji3, jan4 gung1 jau6 gou1, fuk1 lei6 jau6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作做得很顺心，工资又高，福利又好。
examples.english_sentence: He's very satisfied with his job; the salary is high and the benefits are good.

english_meaning: wishful thinking; pie in the sky; to count one's chickens before they hatch
explanation_mandarin: 比喻考虑问题过于乐观，盘算事情过于美好，往往与实际情况相差甚远。
explanation_english: An idiom describing unrealistic or overly optimistic plans and calculations, often failing to consider potential obstacles or difficulties. It implies that someone is counting on a favorable outcome that is unlikely to materialize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲未開始做嘢就諗住可以賺大錢，真係打如意算盤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 mei6 hoi1 chi2 zou6 je5 zau6 nam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 zaan6 daai6 chin2, zan1 hai6 daa2 jyu4 ji3 syun3 pun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还没开始工作就想着能赚大钱，真是打如意算盘。
examples.english_sentence: He hasn't even started working yet and he's already dreaming of making big money. He's really indulging in wishful thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁打如意算盤啦，件事冇你諗得咁簡單㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 daa2 jyu4 ji3 syun3 pun4 laa1, gin6 si6 mou5 nei5 nam2 dak1 gam3 gaan2 daan1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么打如意算盘了，事情没有你想的那么简单。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unrealistic; the matter isn't as simple as you think it is.

english_meaning: Chinese decorative knot; good luck knot
explanation_mandarin: 一种中国传统的装饰结，象征吉祥如意。通常用丝线或其他材料编织而成，具有精美的外观和美好的寓意。
explanation_english: A traditional Chinese decorative knot, symbolizing good luck and auspiciousness. It is usually woven from silk threads or other materials, with an exquisite appearance and beautiful connotations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣好多人都會掛返個如意結喺屋企，希望嚟緊一年順順利利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 gwaa3 faan1 go3 jyu4 ji3 git3 hai2 uk1 kei2, hei1 mong6 lai4 gan2 jat1 nin4 seon6 seon6 lei6 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过新年的时候很多人都会挂一个吉祥结在家里，希望来年一年顺顺利利。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many people hang a good luck knot at home, hoping for a smooth and successful year ahead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個如意結嘅手工好精緻，睇得出花咗好多心機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jyu4 ji3 git3 ge3 hung1 sau2 hou2 zing1 zi3, tai2 dak1 chut1 faa1 zo2 hou2 do1 sam1 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个吉祥结的手工很精致，看得出花了很多心思。
examples.english_sentence: The craftsmanship of this good luck knot is exquisite; you can tell a lot of effort went into it.

english_meaning: ideal husband; Mr. Right
explanation_mandarin: 指符合心意的理想丈夫。
explanation_english: Refers to an ideal husband who meets one's expectations and desires.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻女，一定搵到個如意郎君啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1 neoi5, jat1 ding6 wan2 dou2 go3 jyu4 ji3 long4 gwan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这么优秀，一定能找到一个如意郎君。
examples.english_sentence: She's so capable, she's sure to find an ideal husband.

english_meaning: to enumerate treasures; to recite something as if listing family treasures; to know something intimately and be able to discuss it in great detail
explanation_mandarin: 好像数自己家里的珍宝一样。比喻对所讲的事情非常熟悉。
explanation_english: Like counting one's own family treasures. A metaphor for being very familiar with the topic being discussed, able to recount details effortlessly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對香港嘅歷史如數家珍，你問乜嘢佢都答到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 lik6 si2 jyu4 sou3 gaa1 zan1, nei5 man6 mat1 je5 keoi5 dou1 daap3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对香港的历史如数家珍，你问什么他都能回答。
examples.english_sentence: He knows the history of Hong Kong intimately; he can answer anything you ask.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 講起佢啲模型，佢就如數家珍噉樣，講到冇停。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gong2 hei2 keoi5 di1 mou4 jing2, keoi5 zau6 jyu4 sou3 gaa1 zan1 gam2 joeng2, gong2 dou3 mou5 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 说起他的模型，他就如数家珍一样，说个不停。
examples.english_sentence: When it comes to his models, he's like listing family treasures, talking non-stop.

english_meaning: at the height of one's power, at the zenith of one's career, in one's prime
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物正处于兴盛时期，像太阳在正午时一样光芒四射。
explanation_english: Describes something that is at its peak or in its golden age, like the sun at midday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家事業如日中天，好難搵到佢。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在事业如日中天，很难找到他。
examples.english_sentence: His career is at its peak right now, it's hard to get ahold of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司近年發展如日中天，前途無限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gan6 nin4 faat3 zin2 jyu4 jat6 zung1 tin1, cin4 tou4 mou4 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司近年来发展如日中天，前途无限。
examples.english_sentence: This company's development has been at its peak in recent years, its future is limitless.

synonyms: 盛極一時 (sing6 gik1 jat1 si4)

english_meaning: at the height of one's career or power; in one's prime
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物正处于发展最旺盛的阶段，比喻事业或影响力达到顶峰。
explanation_english: Describes something at the peak of its development, metaphorically referring to a career or influence reaching its highest point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家事業如日方中，好難抽出時間陪屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 si6 jip6 jyu4 jat6 fong1 zung1, hou2 naan4 cau1 chut1 si4 gaan3 pui4 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在事业如日中天，很难抽出时间陪伴家人。
examples.english_sentence: He is at the height of his career right now, so it's hard for him to find time to spend with his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司如日方中，發展潛力無限。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 jyu4 jat6 fong1 zung1, faat3 zin2 cim4 lik6 mou4 haan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司如日中天，发展潜力无限。
examples.english_sentence: This company is at its peak, with unlimited development potential.

english_meaning: In that case; thus; therefore; as a result
explanation_mandarin: 表示承接上文，引出结论或结果。相当于“因此”、“所以”、“这样一来”。
explanation_english: Used to indicate a consequence or conclusion based on the preceding statement. Equivalent to 'therefore', 'thus', 'as a result', or 'in that case'. It often implies a causal relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔肯聽你講，如是者，我哋都冇辦法幫佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hang2 ting1 nei5 gong2, jyu4 si6 ze2, ngo5 dei6 dou1 mou5 baan6 faat3 bong1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不愿意听你的，如此一来，我们也没办法帮他了。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to listen to you, so in that case, we can't help him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋唔夠錢，如是者，就唔可以去旅行啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 m4 gau3 cin2, jyu4 si6 ze2, zau6 m4 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们钱不够，这样一来，就不能去旅行了。
