examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹感情很好啊。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters have a very good relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋係好姊妹嚟㗎，咩都會同對方講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 hou2 zi2 mui2 lai4 gaa3, me1 dou1 wui5 tung4 deoi3 fong1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们是好姐妹，什么都会和对方说。
examples.english_sentence: We are very close female friends, we tell each other everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一對姊妹，一齊喺同志遊行出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 zi2 mui2, jat1 cai4 hai2 tung4 zi3 jau4 hang4 ceot1 jin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们是一对女同性恋，一起在同志游行出现。
examples.english_sentence: They are a lesbian couple and appeared together at the pride parade.

english_meaning: bridesmaids
explanation_mandarin: 指婚礼上陪伴新娘的一群女性朋友，通常未婚，帮助新娘处理婚礼事务。
explanation_english: A group of female friends who accompany the bride at a wedding, usually unmarried, and help the bride with wedding matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢請咗成班姊妹團幫手搞婚禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ceng2 zo2 seng4 baan1 zi2 mui6 tyun4 bong1 sau2 gaau2 fan1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她请了一群伴娘帮忙筹备婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: She hired a group of bridesmaids to help with the wedding preparations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個姊妹團個個都靚女嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zi2 mui6 tyun4 go3 go3 dou1 leng3 neoi2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的伴娘团个个都是美女。
examples.english_sentence: All of her bridesmaids are beautiful.

english_meaning: older sister
explanation_mandarin: 称谓，指比自己年长的女性同胞。
explanation_english: Term of address for one's older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姊姊好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze2 ze1 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姐姐很疼我的。
examples.english_sentence: My older sister loves me very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同姊姊一齊去行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ze2 ze1 jat1 cai4 heoi3 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和姐姐一起去逛街。
examples.english_sentence: I went shopping with my older sister.

english_meaning: May-December romance (where the woman is older than the man)
explanation_mandarin: 指女性比男性年龄大的恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a romantic relationship where the woman is older than the man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋發展緊一段姊弟戀，個女仔大過個男仔五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 faat3 zin2 gan2 jat1 dyun6 zi2 dai6 lyun2, go3 neoi5 zai2 daai6 gwo3 go3 naam4 zai2 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在发展一段姐弟恋，那个女孩比那个男孩大五年。
examples.english_sentence: They are in a May-December romance; the girl is five years older than the boy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 依家社會對姊弟戀嘅接受程度高咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 se5 wui2 deoi3 zi2 dai6 lyun2 ge3 zip3 sau6 cing4 dou6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会对姐弟恋的接受程度高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Society is now much more accepting of May-December romances.

english_meaning: to begin; to start; beginning
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的开始或起始阶段。
explanation_english: Indicates the beginning or initial stage of something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日始開始做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 ci2 hoi1 chi2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天才开始工作。
examples.english_sentence: We will start working tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 本書始寫咗兩頁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun2 syu1 ci2 se2 zo2 loeng5 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书才写了两页。
examples.english_sentence: Only two pages of this book have been written so far.

mandarin_meaning: 始乱终弃 (shǐ luàn zhōng qì)
english_meaning: To seduce and abandon; to start recklessly and abandon in the end; to use and discard.
explanation_mandarin: 开始时引诱玩弄，最后抛弃。形容玩弄女性后抛弃的行为，也指做事不负责任，有头无尾。
explanation_english: Describes the act of seducing and taking advantage of someone, especially a woman, and then abandoning them. It can also refer to starting something without properly finishing it, being irresponsible and inconsistent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁樣對你，簡直係始亂終棄！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 deoi3 nei5, gaan2 zik6 hai6 ci2 lyun6 zung1 hei3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这样对你，简直是始乱终弃！
examples.english_sentence: The way he treats you is simply seducing and abandoning you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好始亂終棄呀，份功課要做完佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ci2 lyun6 zung1 hei3 aa3, fan6 gung1 fo3 jiu3 zou6 jyun4 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要半途而废啊，这份功课要做完。
examples.english_sentence: Don't start and abandon this; you have to finish this assignment.

synonyms: 玩弄感情 (waan2 nung6 gam2 ching4)

english_meaning: The originator of a bad practice; the first to use human figures as burial objects; originator of an evil practice or precedent.
explanation_mandarin: 原指开始用俑殉葬的人。后比喻恶劣风气的创始者。
explanation_english: Originally referred to the person who first used burial figures (俑) in funerals. Later, it became a metaphor for the originator of a bad or evil practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就係始作俑者，發起喺課室入面玩手機嘅風氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 hai6 ci2 zok3 jung2 ze2, faat3 hei2 hai2 fo3 sat1 jap6 min6 waan2 sau2 gei1 ge3 fung1 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是始作俑者，发起在教室里玩手机的风气。
examples.english_sentence: He's the originator, starting the trend of playing mobile phones in the classroom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司濫用個人資料，真係始作俑者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 laam6 jung6 go3 jan4 zi1 liu2, zan1 hai6 ci2 zok3 jung2 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司滥用个人资料，真是始作俑者。
examples.english_sentence: This company is the originator of the abuse of personal data.

english_meaning: to found, to create, to originate
explanation_mandarin: 开始创建；首次创立。
explanation_english: To found or establish something for the first time; to originate something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司係佢始創㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 keoi5 ci2 cong3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司是他创立的。
examples.english_sentence: He founded this company.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個品牌始創於1950年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 ban2 paai4 ci2 cong3 jyu1 jat1 gau2 ng5 ling4 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个品牌始创于1950年。
examples.english_sentence: This brand was founded in 1950.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話呢個理論係佢始創嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 ni1 go3 lei5 leon6 hai6 keoi5 ci2 cong3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说这个理论是他首创的。
examples.english_sentence: They say he originated this theory.

english_meaning: unexpected; unforeseen; not anticipated
explanation_mandarin: 一开始没有预料到，表示事情的发展出乎意料之外。
explanation_english: Used to describe something that was not expected or anticipated; something that happened surprisingly or unexpectedly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就走咗，真係始料不及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zau2 zo2, zan1 hai6 ci2 liu6 bat1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就去世了，真是始料未及。
examples.english_sentence: He passed away so young, it's truly unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住佢唔會嚟，點知佢又突然出現，真係始料不及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 keoi5 m4 wui5 lei4, dim2 zi1 keoi5 jau6 dat6 jin4 ceot1 hin3, zan1 hai6 ci2 liu6 bat1 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以为他不会来，没想到他又突然出现了，真是始料未及。
examples.english_sentence: I thought he wouldn't come, but unexpectedly he suddenly appeared, it was truly unforeseen.

english_meaning: unexpected; unforeseen; beyond expectation
explanation_mandarin: 起初没有预料到，出乎意料。
explanation_english: Something that was not expected or foreseen in the beginning; beyond one's initial expectations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 估唔到佢咁快就成功，真係始料未及。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 m4 dou3 keoi5 gam3 faai3 zau6 sing4 gung1, zan1 hai6 ci2 liu6 mei6 kap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没想到他这么快就成功了，真是始料未及。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't expect him to succeed so quickly, it was truly unexpected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 件事嘅發展始料未及，我哋都唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 ge3 faat3 zin2 ci2 liu6 mei6 kap6, ngo5 dei6 dou1 m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 事情的发展始料未及，我们都不知道怎么办好。
examples.english_sentence: The development of the matter was unexpected, we don't know what to do.

english_meaning: to begin at; to originate from; to stem from
explanation_mandarin: 表示事情的起始点，从哪里开始。
explanation_english: Indicates the starting point of something, where it begins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目始於去年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ci2 jyu1 heoi3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目始于去年。
examples.english_sentence: This project started last year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅友誼始於中學時期。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jau5 ji5 ci2 jyu1 zung1 hok6 si4 kei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的友谊始于中学时期。
examples.english_sentence: Their friendship began in middle school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司始於一間細嘅工作室。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ci2 jyu1 jat1 gaan1 sai3 ge3 gung1 zok3 sat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司始于一间小的工作室。
examples.english_sentence: This company originated from a small workshop.

english_meaning: the whole story; the ins and outs; the complete course of events
explanation_mandarin: 事情的起因、经过和结果。
explanation_english: The beginning, process, and end of a matter or event; the whole story.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你同我講清楚件事嘅始末。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tung4 ngo5 gong2 cing1 co2 gin6 si6 ge3 ci2 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你跟我说清楚这件事的始末。
examples.english_sentence: Tell me the whole story of what happened.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想知道成件事嘅始末。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zi1 dou3 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 ci2 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想知道整件事的始末。
examples.english_sentence: I want to know the whole story of the matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢詳細咁解釋咗件事嘅始末。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 coeng4 sai3 gam2 gai2 sik1 zo2 gin6 si6 ge3 ci2 mut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他详细地解释了这件事的始末。
examples.english_sentence: He explained the whole story in detail.

english_meaning: founder; originator; ancestor
explanation_mandarin: 最初的祖先；某一种学说、流派或行业的创始人。
explanation_english: The earliest ancestor; the founder of a school of thought, style, or industry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢就係呢個電腦遊戲嘅始祖嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau6 hai6 ni1 go3 din6 nou5 jau4 hei3 ge3 ci2 zou2 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他就是这个电脑游戏的始祖。
examples.english_sentence: He is the originator of this computer game.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢被認為係詠春拳嘅始祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei6 jing6 wai4 hai6 wing6 ceon1 kuen4 ge3 ci2 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被认为是咏春拳的始祖。
examples.english_sentence: He is considered the founder of Wing Chun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋話佢係 rap 嘅始祖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 waa6 keoi5 hai6 rap ge3 ci2 zou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们说他是说唱乐的始祖。
examples.english_sentence: They say he is the originator of rap.

english_meaning: from beginning to end; all along; always; after all
explanation_mandarin: 表示从开始到结束，一直如此；毕竟，终究。
explanation_english: Indicates from beginning to end, always so; after all, in the end.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋始終都係朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ci2 zung1 dou1 hai6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们始终都是朋友。
examples.english_sentence: We are always friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢始終都冇出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ci2 zung1 dou1 mou5 ceot1 hin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他始终都没有出现。
examples.english_sentence: He never showed up after all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我始終相信佢嘅清白。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ci2 zung1 soeng1 seon3 keoi5 ge3 cing1 baak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我始终相信他的清白。
examples.english_sentence: I always believe in his innocence.

english_meaning: consistent from beginning to end; true to oneself throughout
explanation_mandarin: 指从开始到结尾都一样，没有改变。形容人做事或态度自始至终保持一致。
explanation_english: Describes someone who remains consistent and unchanged from beginning to end. It implies a steadfastness in behavior, attitude, or principles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對朋友始終如一，好值得信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 pang4 jau5 ci2 zung1 jyu4 jat1, hou2 zik6 dak1 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对朋友始终如一，非常值得信任。
examples.english_sentence: He is consistent to his friends from beginning to end, very trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅食物質素始終如一，所以咁多年嚟都咁受歡迎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 sik6 mat6 zat1 so3 ci2 zung1 jyu4 jat1, so2 ji5 gam3 do1 nin4 lai4 dou1 gam3 sau6 fun1 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物质量始终如一，所以这么多年来都很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: The food quality of this restaurant has been consistent from beginning to end, so it has been so popular for so many years.

english_meaning: to arrive late; to be tardy
explanation_mandarin: 形容来得很晚。通常用于“姗姗来迟”这个词语中。
explanation_english: Describes arriving very late. Usually used in the phrase "姍姍來遲 (saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4)".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都姍姍來遲，真係好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是姗姗来迟，真令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: He's always arriving late, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部戲都開咗場，佢先至姍姍來遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 hei3 dou1 hoi1 zo2 coeng4, keoi5 sin1 zi3 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影都开场了，他才姗姗来迟。
examples.english_sentence: The movie already started, and only then did he arrive late.

english_meaning: to arrive late; to be late (usually of a woman arriving gracefully)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子迟来的样子。也泛指来得很晚。
explanation_english: Describes a woman arriving late, often in a graceful or unhurried manner. It can also generally refer to arriving very late.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都姍姍來遲，搞到我哋要等佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dang2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是姗姗来迟，搞得我们都要等她。
examples.english_sentence: She is always late, causing us to wait for her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經開始咗個會，佢先姍姍來遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 hoi1 chi2 zo2 go3 wui2, keoi5 sin1 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经开始开会了，她才姗姗来迟。
examples.english_sentence: We had already started the meeting when she finally arrived late.

english_meaning: elder sister; (respectful) term for a young woman
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己年长的女性，可以是亲生姐姐，也可以是对年轻女性的尊称。
explanation_english: Refers to a female older than oneself. Can be a biological elder sister or a respectful term for a young woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿姐好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 ze1 hou2 sik3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姐姐很疼爱我。
examples.english_sentence: My elder sister loves me very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姐，唔該幫我攞返個外賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze1, m4 goi1 bong1 ngo5 lo2 faan1 go3 ngoi6 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 美女，麻烦你帮我拿一下外卖。
examples.english_sentence: Miss, please help me get my takeout.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋三個女仔，大姐最叻女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saam1 go3 neoi5 zai2, daai6 ze1 zeoi3 lek1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们三个女孩，大姐最能干。
examples.english_sentence: Among those three girls, the eldest sister is the most capable.

english_meaning: That is to say, meaning, in other words
explanation_mandarin: 表示解释说明，相当于“就是说”、“也就是说”。口语中常用，有时作为语气词，没有实际意义。
explanation_english: Used to clarify or explain something, similar to 'that is to say', 'meaning', or 'in other words'. Commonly used in spoken Cantonese, sometimes as a filler word with little to no real meaning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日冇嚟，姐係佢病咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 lai4, ze2 hai6 keoi5 beng6 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没来，也就是说他病了。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come yesterday, meaning he's sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姐係...我唔知點講好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 hai6... ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 gong2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就是说...我不知道怎么说好。
examples.english_sentence: Well... I don't know how to put it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姐係你唔想去啦？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ze2 hai6 nei5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 laa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 也就是说你不想去吗？
examples.english_sentence: So you don't want to go?

english_meaning: That is to say; in other words; meaning
explanation_mandarin: 表示进一步解释或说明前面所说的话。
explanation_english: Used to introduce a further explanation or clarification of what has been said. Acts as a connector to rephrase or specify.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日冇返工，姐係話佢病咗囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 mou5 faan1 gung1, ze2 hai6 waa6 keoi5 beng6 zo2 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他昨天没上班，也就是说他病了吧。
examples.english_sentence: He didn't come to work yesterday, that is to say, he's probably sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要早起，姐係話我今晚要早啲瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 zou2 hei2, ze2 hai6 waa6 ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 zou2 di1 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要早起，也就是说我今晚要早点睡。
examples.english_sentence: I have to wake up early tomorrow, that is to say, I need to go to bed earlier tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳好多人排隊，姐係話佢啲嘢食應該好好味啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 do1 jan4 paai4 deoi2, ze2 hai6 waa6 keoi5 di1 je5 sik6 jing1 goi1 hou2 hou2 mei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅很多人排队，也就是说他们做的东西应该很好吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: There's a long queue at this restaurant, that is to say, their food must be very delicious.

english_meaning: older sister's husband; brother-in-law
explanation_mandarin: 姐姐的丈夫。
explanation_english: Husband of one's older sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去我姐夫屋企食飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 ngo5 je2 fu1 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天去我姐夫家吃饭。
examples.english_sentence: We're going to my brother-in-law's house for dinner tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姐夫係一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je2 fu1 hai6 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姐夫是一位医生。
examples.english_sentence: My brother-in-law is a doctor.

english_meaning: sisters; female friends (close and intimate)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指同一父母的女儿。2. 指关系亲密的女性朋友。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to daughters of the same parents. 2. Refers to close and intimate female friends, often implying a bond like that between sisters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我嘅姐妹好耐無見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 ge3 ze2 mui2 hou2 noi6 mou5 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我的姐妹很久没见面了。
examples.english_sentence: My sisters and I haven't seen each other for a long time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係好姐妹，成日一齊行街。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 hou2 ze2 mui2, seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 haang4 gaai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们是好姐妹，经常一起逛街。
examples.english_sentence: They are good sisters, and they often go shopping together.

english_meaning: elder sister
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己年长的女性同胞，即姐姐。
explanation_english: Refers to a female sibling who is older than oneself; elder sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姐姐對我好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ze1 ze1 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姐姐对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: My elder sister is very good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有個家姐，大過佢五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 go3 gaa1 ze1, daai6 gwo3 keoi5 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有一个姐姐，比他大五年。
examples.english_sentence: He has an elder sister who is five years older than him.

english_meaning: little girl; young lady; Miss
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻未婚的女子，通常带有亲切或略微随便的语气。可以指小女孩，也可以指年轻的成年女性，视语境而定。有时用于称呼年轻女服务员等。
explanation_english: Refers to a young, unmarried woman or a little girl. It carries a friendly or slightly casual tone. The specific age range implied depends on the context. Sometimes used to address young female service staff.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個姐姐仔好乖，幫手睇住細佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 ze1 ze1 zai2 hou2 gwaai1, bong1 sau2 tai2 zyu6 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小女孩很乖，帮忙照顾弟弟。
examples.english_sentence: That little girl is very well-behaved, helping to look after her younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該姐姐仔，埋單。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 ze1 ze1 zai2, maai4 daan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦这位小姐，结账。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, Miss, the bill, please.

english_meaning: elder sister and younger brother
explanation_mandarin: 姐姐和弟弟。指姐姐和弟弟的关系。
explanation_english: Elder sister and younger brother. Refers to the relationship between an elder sister and a younger brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我屋企得我同我細佬，即係姐弟囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 dak1 ngo5 tung4 ngo5 sai3 lou2, jik1 hai6 ze2 dai6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我家只有我和我弟弟，就是姐弟关系。
examples.english_sentence: In my family, there's only me and my younger brother, so we're siblings (elder sister and younger brother).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一對姐弟，感情好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 ze2 dai6, gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一对姐弟，感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: They are siblings (elder sister and younger brother), and they have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: relationship where the woman is older than the man
explanation_mandarin: 指女性比男性年长的恋爱关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a romantic relationship where the woman is older than the man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係姐弟戀，阿嫂大過佢五年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 ze2 dai6 lyun2, aa3 so2 daai6 gwo3 keoi5 ng5 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是姐弟恋，嫂子比他大五年。
examples.english_sentence: They are in a relationship where the woman is older. His wife is five years older than him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家社會接受姐弟戀嘅程度高咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 se5 wui2 zip3 sau6 ze2 dai6 lyun2 ge3 cing4 dou6 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在社会对姐弟恋的接受程度高了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Society's acceptance of relationships where the woman is older is much higher now.

english_meaning: clumsy, awkward, all thumbs
explanation_mandarin: 形容人动作不灵活、笨拙。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is clumsy, awkward, and uncoordinated in their movements.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁姐手姐腳啦，整爛晒啲嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 ze1 sau2 ze1 goek3 laa1, zing2 laan6 saai3 di1 je5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么笨手笨脚的，会把东西都弄坏的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clumsy, you'll break everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢平時好精明，但係一做手工就姐手姐腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ping4 si4 hou2 zing1 ming4, daan6 hai6 jat1 zou6 sau2 gung1 zau6 ze1 sau2 ze1 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他平时很精明，但是一做手工就很笨手笨脚。
examples.english_sentence: He is usually very clever, but he is clumsy when doing handicrafts.

mandarin_meaning: 姑姑, 姑妈, 姑丈
english_meaning: paternal aunt, father's sister, husband of father's sister
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的姐妹；丈夫是姑丈。
explanation_english: Father's sister; her husband is called 'father's sister's husband'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我有個姑姑喺英國住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jau5 go3 gu1 hai2 jing1 gwok3 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有一个姑姑住在英国。
examples.english_sentence: I have a paternal aunt living in England.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要去姑丈屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 gu1 zoeng6 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要去姑丈家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to visit my aunt's husband's house for Chinese New Year tomorrow.

english_meaning: uncle (father's sister's husband)
explanation_mandarin: 称谓，父亲的姐妹的丈夫。
explanation_english: A term of address for one's father's sister's husband; uncle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個成日去姑丈屋企玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 heoi3 gu1 zoeng6 uk1 kei2 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候经常去姑父家玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young, I often went to my uncle's house to play.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑丈對我好好，成日買嘢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 zoeng6 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 姑父对我很好，总是买东西给我。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle is very good to me, always buying me things.

english_meaning: for the time being; tentatively; provisionally; let's for now
explanation_mandarin: 表示暂时或姑且这样做。
explanation_english: Indicates doing something temporarily or for the time being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋姑且信佢一次啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gu1 ce2 seon3 keoi5 jat1 ci3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们姑且相信他一次吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's trust him for once.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 情況唔明朗，我哋姑且咁樣處理住先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing4 fong3 m4 ming4 long5, ngo5 dei6 gu1 ce2 gam2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5 zyu6 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 情况不明朗，我们姑且这样处理着先。
examples.english_sentence: The situation is unclear, let's handle it this way for the time being.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑且試下，睇下得唔得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 ce2 si3 haa5, tai2 haa5 dak1 m4 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 姑且试一下，看看行不行。
examples.english_sentence: Let's give it a try and see if it works.

english_meaning: husband's sister; sister-in-law (sister of one's husband)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的妹妹。
explanation_english: Refers to the sister of one's husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姑仔好錫佢啲仔女㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu1 zai2 hou2 sik3 keoi5 di1 zai2 neoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的小姑子很疼爱她的孩子们。
examples.english_sentence: My husband's sister loves her children very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同姑仔關係好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 gu1 zai2 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和小姑子关系很好。
examples.english_sentence: I have a very good relationship with my husband's sister.

english_meaning: regardless of; leaving aside; irrespective of
explanation_mandarin: 表示先不考虑某种情况或问题，转而讨论其他情况或问题。
explanation_english: Indicates that a certain situation or problem is not being considered for the time being, and the discussion is turning to other situations or problems. It's used to introduce a point that will not be argued or considered, before moving on to the main point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑勿論你鍾唔鍾意佢，佢嘅能力係值得肯定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 mat6 leon6 nei5 zung1 m4 zung1 ji3 keoi5, keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 hai6 zik6 dak1 hang2 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暂且不论你是否喜欢他，他的能力是值得肯定的。
examples.english_sentence: Regardless of whether you like him or not, his ability is worth acknowledging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑勿論價錢，最緊要係品質好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 mat6 leon6 gaa3 cin2, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 ban2 zat1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 且不论价格，最重要的是品质好。
examples.english_sentence: Leaving aside the price, the most important thing is the quality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑勿論佢嘅背景，我哋應該公平噉看待每一個人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 mat6 leon6 keoi5 ge3 bui3 ging2, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 gung1 ping4 gam2 hon3 doi6 mui5 jat1 go3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 且不论他的背景，我们应该公平地看待每一个人。
examples.english_sentence: Irrespective of his background, we should treat everyone fairly.

explanation_english: 1. Father's sister; aunt (on the father's side). 2. (Sometimes derogatory) Refers to a woman who is bossy, unreasonable, and doesn't listen to others.

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so bossy, let's discuss things together.

事頭婆 (si6 tau4 po4 - bossy woman, similar derogatory meaning)

english_meaning: Paternal aunt (father's sister); (informal) term of address for a spoiled or demanding young woman; a term of self-reference used by a woman to indicate she is being treated poorly or taken advantage of.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意义为父亲的姐妹。在粤语和普通话中，也可用作对年轻女性的昵称，或者在女性表示不满或认为自己被怠慢时自称。
explanation_english: Literally, it refers to a father's sister. In both Cantonese and Mandarin, it can also be used as a term of endearment or a way to address a young woman, or as a self-referential term used by a woman when she is unhappy with a situation or feels mistreated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大聲啦，姑奶奶！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 seng1 laa1, gu1 naai5 naai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么大声啦，大小姐！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so loud, young lady!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔係你姑奶奶，唔使咁服侍我呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 hai6 nei5 gu1 naai5 naai2, m4 sai2 gam3 fuk6 si6 ngo5 aa3.

examples.english_sentence: I'm not your queen, you don't need to serve me like this.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 又要呢樣，又要嗰樣，當自己係姑奶奶呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 jiu3 ni1 joeng6, jau6 jiu3 go2 joeng6, dong3 zi6 gei2 hai6 gu1 naai5 naai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 又要这个，又要那个，当自己是大小姐啊？
examples.english_sentence: You want this and that, do you think you're a princess?

english_meaning: father's sister; paternal aunt
explanation_mandarin: 指父亲的姐妹。
explanation_english: Refers to one's father's sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姑姐對我好好㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu1 ze1 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姑姑对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: My paternal aunt is very good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日阿媽要帶我去姑姐屋企拜年。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天妈妈要带我去姑姑家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow, my mother will take me to my paternal aunt's house for Chinese New Year visits.

english_meaning: father's sister; paternal aunt
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的姐妹；也可用作对年长女性的尊称。
explanation_english: Father's sister; paternal aunt. Can also be used as a respectful term of address for an older woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姑姑下個禮拜會嚟香港。

examples.english_sentence: My aunt will come to Hong Kong next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑姑，呢個位冇人坐㗎，你坐啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 gu1, ni1 go3 wai2 mou5 jan4 co5 gaa3, nei5 co5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿姨，这个位子没人坐，您坐吧。
examples.english_sentence: Auntie, this seat is empty, please sit down.

english_meaning: young woman; girl; unmarried woman

explanation_english: A young unmarried woman; girl.

examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 gu1 noeng4 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个姑娘很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: That girl is very beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗個姑娘嚟湊小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 gu1 noeng4 lai4 cau3 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们请了一个保姆来照顾孩子。
examples.english_sentence: They hired a young woman to take care of the children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間茶餐廳啲姑娘好勤力嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 di1 gu1 noeng4 hou2 kan4 lik6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家茶餐厅的服务员很勤劳的。
examples.english_sentence: The waitresses in this tea restaurant are very diligent.

english_meaning: young girl, little girl
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的女孩，通常是未成年的。
explanation_english: Refers to a young girl, usually a minor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個姑娘仔好得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gu1 noeng4 zai2 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小姑娘好可爱呀！
examples.english_sentence: That little girl is so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣時成日扮靚，好似個大姑娘仔咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 baan6 leng3, hou2 ci5 go3 daai6 gu1 noeng4 zai2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她小时候总是打扮得很漂亮，好像个大姑娘似的。
examples.english_sentence: When she was little, she always dressed up nicely, like a young lady.

english_meaning: Old maid, spinster, old auntie (derogatory or humorous term for a woman who is perceived as being unmarried and past her prime)
explanation_mandarin: 指年龄较大但仍然未婚的女性，有时带有贬义或戏谑的意味。也泛指年长的姑母。
explanation_english: Refers to an older woman who is still unmarried, sometimes with a derogatory or humorous connotation. Can also refer to an older paternal aunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁大個都仲未嫁，唔通想做姑婆咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 daai6 go3 dou1 zung1 mei6 gaa3, m4 tung1 soeng2 zou6 gu1 po4 me1?

examples.english_sentence: She's so old and still hasn't married. Does she want to become an old maid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁老土啦，依家啲女仔唔結婚都大把，邊個仲會叫人姑婆啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 lou5 tou2 laa1, ji1 gaa1 di1 neoi5 zai2 m4 git3 fan1 dou1 daai6 baa2, bin1 go3 zung1 wui5 giu3 jan4 gu1 po4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么老土了，现在很多女孩都不结婚，谁还会叫别人老处女啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so old-fashioned. Many girls these days don't get married. Who would still call someone an old maid?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日去咗姑婆屋企拜年。

examples.english_sentence: Today I went to my paternal aunt's house to celebrate Chinese New Year.

english_meaning: House for spinsters (women who vowed never to marry)
explanation_mandarin: 指自梳女（发誓终身不嫁的女性）居住的地方。通常是她们自己出资购买或由族人共同出资建造，供这些女性安度晚年。
explanation_english: Refers to a place where self-combed women (women who vowed never to marry) live. It is usually purchased with their own funds or built jointly by members of the clan to provide a safe haven for these women to spend their later years.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前順德好多姑婆屋，住喺入面嘅都係自梳女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 seon6 dak1 hou2 do1 gu1 po4 uk1, zyu6 hai2 jap6 min6 ge3 dou1 hai6 zi6 so1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前顺德有很多姑婆屋，住在里面的人都是自梳女。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, there were many spinsters' houses in Shunde, and the people living inside were all self-combed women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講間姑婆屋已經好耐歷史，變咗古蹟喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gaan1 gu1 po4 uk1 ji5 ging1 hou2 noi6 lik6 si2, bin3 zo2 gu2 zik1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说那间姑婆屋已经有很长的历史，变成古迹了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that the spinster house has a long history and has become a historical site.

english_meaning: paternal aunt (father's sister)
explanation_mandarin: 称谓，父亲的姐妹。
explanation_english: A term of address for one's father's sister; paternal aunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候，姑媽成日帶我去公園玩。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候，姑妈经常带我去公园玩。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, my aunt often took me to the park to play.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姑妈做饭很好吃！
examples.english_sentence: My aunt cooks really well!

english_meaning: Gusao Wan (a type of traditional Chinese medicine)
explanation_mandarin: 一种传统中成药，主要用于调经止痛，治疗月经不调，经期腹痛等症状。
explanation_english: A type of traditional Chinese medicine, mainly used for regulating menstruation and relieving pain, treating irregular menstruation, menstrual cramps, and other symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽話食姑嫂丸可以舒緩經痛。

examples.english_sentence: My mother said that taking Gusao Wan can relieve menstrual cramps.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近成日經痛，不如試吓食姑嫂丸？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 sing4 jat6 ging1 tung3, bat1 jyu4 si3 haa5 sik6 gu1 sou2 jyun2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近总是经痛，不如试试吃姑嫂丸？
examples.english_sentence: You've been having menstrual cramps a lot lately, why don't you try taking Gusao Wan?

english_meaning: to be considerate; to show compassion; to take into consideration; to have mercy
explanation_mandarin: 考虑到对方的处境，表示体谅或宽恕。
explanation_english: To take someone's situation into consideration, expressing understanding or forgiveness. Often used to suggest leniency or showing compassion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢第一次犯錯，大家姑念下佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dai6 jat1 ci3 faan6 co3, daai6 gaa1 gu1 nim6 haa5 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他第一次犯错，大家就体谅一下他吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's his first mistake, let's be considerate of him.

examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, the judge can consider his family situation and give him a lighter sentence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望老闆可以姑念下我哋，俾多幾日時間交貨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 lou5 baan2 ho2 ji5 gu1 nim6 haa5 ngo5 dei6, bei2 do1 gei2 jat6 si4 gaan3 gaau1 fo3.

examples.english_sentence: Hopefully, the boss can be considerate of us and give us a few more days to deliver the goods.

english_meaning: to tolerate; to condone; to indulge; to appease

explanation_english: To tolerate or condone wrongdoing, allowing it to develop and worsen.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能姑息他的坏习惯，不然他会变本加厉的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't condone his bad habits, or he'll become even worse.

examples.english_sentence: If we condone corruption, society will become more and more corrupt.

explanation_english: To show excessive tolerance towards evildoers, which allows them to grow stronger and more emboldened to commit further misdeeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好姑息養奸呀，如果唔係佢會越嚟越過份㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gu1 sik1 joeng5 gaan1 aa3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 keoi5 wui5 yut6 lai4 yut6 gwo3 fan6 gaa3.

examples.english_sentence: Don't indulge evil-doers, otherwise they'll become increasingly excessive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以姑息養奸，一定要嚴懲啲罪犯。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不可以姑息养奸，一定要严惩这些罪犯。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot indulge evil-doers, we must severely punish these criminals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果我哋對啲細嘅錯都唔理，咁咪即係姑息養奸囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 ngo5 dei6 deoi3 di1 sai3 ge3 co3 dou1 m4 lei5, gam2 mai1 zik1 hai6 gu1 sik1 joeng5 gaan1 lo1.

examples.english_sentence: If we ignore even small mistakes, isn't that just indulging evil-doers?

english_meaning: paternal aunt; father's sister
explanation_mandarin: 父亲的姐妹。
explanation_english: Father's sister; paternal aunt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姑母好錫我，成日買嘢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gu1 mou5 hou2 sek3 ngo5, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姑母很疼爱我，总是买东西给我。

english_meaning: husband of one's father's sister; uncle (paternal aunt's husband)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日要去姑婆屋企拜年，到時見到姑爺要叫人。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 姑爺對我好好，成日買嘢俾我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu1 jaa4 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2, seng4 jat6 maai5 je5 bei2 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 姑父对我很好，经常买东西给我。
examples.english_sentence: My uncle (aunt's husband) is very nice to me, he often buys me things.

english_meaning: gigolo, kept man, boy toy
explanation_mandarin: 指靠女人供养的男人，通常是年轻男子依靠年长的富有女性。
explanation_english: Refers to a man who is financially supported by a woman, often a younger man who relies on an older, wealthy woman. It carries a negative connotation, implying the man is exploiting the woman for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人話係姑爺仔，靠晒佢老婆養。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 waa6 hai6 gu1 je4 zai2, kaau3 saai3 keoi5 lou5 po4 joeng5.

examples.english_sentence: People say he's a kept man, completely dependent on his wife.

english_meaning: Suzhou (city in Jiangsu province, China)
explanation_mandarin: 苏州，中国江苏省的一个城市。
explanation_english: Suzhou, a city in Jiangsu province, China, known for its canals, gardens, and classical Chinese architecture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候去過姑蘇玩。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你姓乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 sing3 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你姓什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What is your surname?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我姓陳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing3 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我姓陈。
examples.english_sentence: My surname is Chan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多人都姓李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sing3 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多人都姓李。
examples.english_sentence: Many people in Hong Kong have the surname Lee.

english_meaning: full name
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人的姓和名。
explanation_english: A person's full name, including both surname and given name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅姓名係乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 sing3 ming4 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的姓名是什么？
examples.english_sentence: What is your name?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請你喺呢度寫低你嘅姓名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 nei5 hai2 ni1 dou6 se2 dai1 nei5 ge3 sing3 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请你在这里写下你的姓名。
examples.english_sentence: Please write down your name here.

english_meaning: to feel wronged; to be unfairly treated; to be aggrieved
explanation_mandarin: 表示受到不公正的待遇，感到委屈、冤枉。
explanation_english: To feel unjustly treated; to feel wronged or aggrieved.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢覺得自己姓屈，所以好唔開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gok3 dak1 zi6 gei2 sing3 wat1, so2 ji5 hou2 m4 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他觉得自己受了委屈，所以很不开心。
examples.english_sentence: He feels wronged, so he's very unhappy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 明明唔係我做嘅，你話我做，真係姓屈咯！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ming4 ming4 m4 hai6 ngo5 zou6 ge3, nei5 waa6 ngo5 zou6, zan1 hai6 sing3 wat1 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明明不是我做的，你说是我做的，真是冤枉啊！
examples.english_sentence: It clearly wasn't me who did it, and you're saying I did it. I really feel wronged!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁易就話人哋姓屈，查清楚先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 ji6 zau6 waa6 jan4 dei6 sing3 wat1, caa4 cing1 chu2 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易就说别人受委屈，查清楚再说。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so quick to say someone is wronged. Investigate properly first.

english_meaning: surname; family name
explanation_mandarin: 指家族的姓和氏，现在一般指姓。
explanation_english: Surname or family name. Refers to the name that identifies a person as a member of a family or clan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請問你貴姓呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 man6 nei5 gwai3 sing3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问您贵姓？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask your surname?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅姓氏係陳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 sing3 si6 hai6 can4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的姓氏是陈。
examples.english_sentence: My surname is Chan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺香港，好多姓氏都係源自中國大陸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 hoeng1 gong2, hou2 do1 sing3 si6 dou1 hai6 jyun4 zi6 zung1 gwok3 daai6 luk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在香港，很多姓氏都源自中国大陆。
examples.english_sentence: In Hong Kong, many surnames originate from mainland China.

english_meaning: to deny responsibility; to renege; to go back on one's word; to cheat; to act shamelessly; to play the rogue
explanation_mandarin: 指不讲道理，不承认错误或责任，或者故意违反承诺。
explanation_english: Refers to acting unreasonably, denying mistakes or responsibilities, or deliberately breaking promises. It suggests a lack of integrity and a willingness to act dishonestly to avoid consequences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你應承咗嘅嘢，唔好姓賴呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ying1 sing3 zo2 ge3 ye5, m4 hou2 sing3 laai6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你答应的事情，不要耍赖啊！
examples.english_sentence: You promised, don't go back on your word!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢輸咗錢就想姓賴，真係無品。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 syu1 zo2 chin2 jau6 seung2 sing3 laai6, zan1 hai6 mou4 ban2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他输了钱就想耍赖，真是没品。
examples.english_sentence: He lost money and wanted to renege, he's really despicable.

english_meaning: to entrust, to commission; to feel wronged; to shirk
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示委托，委任。作为形容词，表示受委屈，不舒服。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to entrust, to commission. As an adjective, it means to feel wronged, uncomfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔想委屈自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 soeng2 wai2 kuk1 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不想委屈自己。
examples.english_sentence: I don't want to wrong myself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你委託佢做呢件事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 wai2 tok3 keoi5 zou6 ni1 gin6 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你委托他做这件事？
examples.english_sentence: Did you entrust him with this matter?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好委過於人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 wai2 gwo3 jyu1 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要推卸责任给别人啦。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shirk the responsibility to others.

english_meaning: to entrust with a heavy responsibility; to assign a major task to
explanation_mandarin: 把重要的任务交给某人。
explanation_english: To give someone a significant and important task or responsibility, implying trust and confidence in their abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細咁睇得起你，委以重任，你一定要做好佢呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 gam3 tai2 dak1 hei2 nei5, wai2 ji5 zung6 jam6, nei5 jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 hou2 keoi5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板这么看得起你，委以重任，你一定要做好它啊！
examples.english_sentence: The boss thinks so highly of you, entrusting you with a heavy responsibility, you must do it well!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱畢業就俾公司委以重任，真係好叻仔！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 bat1 jip6 zau6 bei2 gung1 si1 wai2 ji5 zung6 jam6, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 zai2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他刚毕业就被公司委以重任，真是很厉害！
examples.english_sentence: He was entrusted with a major task by the company right after graduation, he's really capable!

english_meaning: to appoint, to assign, appointment
explanation_mandarin: 任命，委派。也指委任的职位或职务。
explanation_english: To officially assign a task or responsibility to someone; to appoint someone to a position. Also refers to the position itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋委任咗佢做經理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai2 jam6 zo2 keoi5 zou6 ging1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们委任他当经理。
examples.english_sentence: They appointed him as manager.

english_meaning: Certificate of appointment; Letter of authorization
explanation_mandarin: 证明被委任的凭证，一种正式的文件。
explanation_english: A formal document that serves as proof of appointment or authorization.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞住張委任証，入去間公司傾生意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zyu6 zoeng1 wai2 jam6 zing3, jap6 heoi3 gaan1 gung1 si1 king1 saang1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿着委任状，去那家公司谈生意。
examples.english_sentence: He held the certificate of appointment and went into the company to discuss business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好出示你嘅委任証，證明你係代表公司嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 cheut1 si6 nei5 ge3 wai2 jam6 zing3, zing3 ming4 nei5 hai6 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好出示你的委任状，证明你是代表公司来的。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better show your certificate of appointment to prove you represent the company.

english_meaning: identification card; warrant card; appointment card; certificate of authorization
explanation_mandarin: 用于证明被委任者身份的证件。
explanation_english: A document or card used to prove the identity of a person who has been appointed or authorized to perform certain duties or hold a specific position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警察查身份證嘅時候，通常會出示埋佢哋嘅委任證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 caat3 caa4 san1 fan6 zing3 ge3 si4 hau6, tung1 soeng4 wui5 ceot1 si6 maai4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 wai2 jam6 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察查身份证的时候，通常会一起出示他们的委任证。
examples.english_sentence: When the police check your ID, they usually show their warrant card as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢張係我嘅委任證，你可以睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 wai2 jam6 zing3, nei5 ho2 ji5 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我的委任证，你可以看看。
examples.english_sentence: This is my identification card, you can take a look.

english_meaning: Venezuela
explanation_mandarin: 南美洲国家委内瑞拉
explanation_english: Venezuela, a country in South America.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽講委內瑞拉嘅經濟好差。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 gong2 wai2 noi6 seoi3 laai1 ge3 ging1 zai3 hou2 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我听说委内瑞拉的经济很差。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that the economy of Venezuela is very bad.

english_meaning: committee member; committee
explanation_mandarin: 指委员会的成员，或指委员会本身。
explanation_english: A member of a committee; also refers to the committee itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係學生會嘅委員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hok6 sang1 wui2 ge3 wai2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是学生会的委员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a committee member of the student union.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要選出新嘅委員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 syun2 ceot1 san1 ge3 wai2 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要选出新的委员。
examples.english_sentence: We need to elect new committee members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 委員會決定咗咁樣做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2 jyun4 wui2 kyut3 ding6 zo2 gam2 joeng2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 委员会决定这样做。
examples.english_sentence: The committee decided to do it this way.

english_meaning: committee, commission
explanation_mandarin: 为了完成特定任务而组成的团体，通常由多人组成。
explanation_english: A group of people officially delegated to perform a specific function, typically consisting of multiple members.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司成立咗一個安全委員會去檢討安全措施。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 sing4 lap6 zo2 jat1 go3 on1 cyun4 wai2 jyun4 wui2 heoi3 gim2 tou2 on1 cyun4 co3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司成立了一个安全委员会去审查安全措施。
examples.english_sentence: Our company established a safety committee to review the safety measures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個項目嘅進展要經過委員會嘅批准先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zeon3 zin2 jiu3 ging1 gwo3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 ge3 pai1 zhun2 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目的进展要经过委员会的批准才行。
examples.english_sentence: The progress of this project needs the approval of the committee.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係財政委員會嘅成員之一。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 coi4 zing3 wai2 jyun4 wui2 ge3 sing4 jyun4 zi1 jat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是财政委员会的成员之一。
examples.english_sentence: He is one of the members of the Finance Committee.

english_meaning: euphemistic, tactful, indirect, subtle
explanation_mandarin: 指说话或表达方式含蓄，不直接，留有余地。
explanation_english: Referring to a way of speaking or expressing oneself that is indirect, tactful, and leaves room for interpretation; euphemistic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢好委婉，唔會直接批評人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 hou2 wai2 jyun2, m4 wui5 zik6 zip3 pai1 ping3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话很委婉，不会直接批评人。
examples.english_sentence: He speaks very tactfully and doesn't directly criticize people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要委婉啲噉表達我哋嘅意見，唔好咁直接。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai2 jyun2 di1 gam2 biu2 daat6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3, m4 hou2 gam3 zik6 zip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要委婉一点表达我们的意见，不要那么直接。
examples.english_sentence: We should express our opinions more subtly, not so directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多委婉嘅措辭嚟避免引起爭拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 wai2 jyun2 ge3 co3 ci4 lai4 bei6 min5 hei2 yan5 zaang1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了许多委婉的措辞来避免引起争吵。
examples.english_sentence: He used a lot of euphemistic phrases to avoid causing arguments.

english_meaning: euphemism
explanation_mandarin: 用比较含蓄、温和的方式来表达某种不愉快或敏感的话题。
explanation_english: A mild or indirect word or expression substituted for one considered to be too harsh or blunt when referring to something unpleasant or embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗好多委婉語嚟講阿婆過咗身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 zo2 ho2 do1 wai2 jyun2 jyu5 lai4 gong2 a3 po4 gwo3 zo2 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用了许多委婉语来说奶奶去世了。
examples.english_sentence: He used many euphemisms to say that his grandmother passed away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「炒魷魚」係一個委婉語，其實即係解僱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caau2 yau4 yu2 hai6 jat1 go3 wai2 jyun2 jyu5, kei4 sat6 jik1 hai6 gaai2 goo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “炒鱿鱼”是一个委婉语，其实就是解雇。
examples.english_sentence: "Fired" is a euphemism, it actually means being dismissed.

english_meaning: to feel wronged; to nurse a grievance; to cause (someone) to feel wronged; injustice; grievance
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公平的待遇或冤枉，心里感到难过或不满。也可以用来表示使人受到委屈。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling sad or dissatisfied because of being treated unfairly or wrongly accused. It can also mean to cause someone to feel wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人屈咗，覺得好委屈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 wat1 zo2, gok3 dak1 hou2 wai1 kwut1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冤枉了，觉得很委屈。
examples.english_sentence: He was wrongly accused and feels very wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好委屈自己啦，做你想做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai1 kwut1 zi6 gei2 laa1, zou6 nei5 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要委屈自己了，做你想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wrong yourself, do what you want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁委屈佢啦，佢都唔係有心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 wai1 kwut1 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 dou1 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么委屈他了，他也不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make him feel so wronged, he didn't mean to.

english_meaning: to entrust; to commission; to authorize
explanation_mandarin: 把事情托付给别人办理。
explanation_english: To entrust someone with a task; to commission someone to do something; to authorize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我委托咗律師幫我搞離婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai2 tok3 zo2 leot6 si1 bong1 ngo5 gaau2 lei4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我委托了律师帮我办理离婚。
examples.english_sentence: I have entrusted a lawyer to handle my divorce.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司委托佢负责呢个项目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai2 tok3 keoi5 fu6 zaak3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司委托他负责这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The company has commissioned him to be in charge of this project.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我可以委托你幫我買飛嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ho2 ji5 wai2 tok3 nei5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 fei1 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我可以委托你帮我买票吗？
examples.english_sentence: Can I entrust you to buy tickets for me?

english_meaning: feeling wronged; unjustly treated; grievance; to feel aggrieved
explanation_mandarin: 指受到不公平的待遇而感到难过或不舒服。可以是形容词，表示一种感受状态；也可以是动词，表示使人感到委屈。
explanation_english: Refers to feeling sad, uncomfortable, or aggrieved due to unfair treatment. Can be an adjective describing a state of feeling, or a verb describing the act of causing someone to feel wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢畀人冤枉，覺得好委曲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 jyun1 wong2, gok3 dak1 hou2 wai2 kuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人冤枉了，觉得很委屈。
examples.english_sentence: He was wrongly accused and feels very wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁樣做會委曲咗佢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam2 joeng2 zou6 wui5 wai2 kuk1 zo2 keoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这样做会委屈他的。
examples.english_sentence: Doing it this way will make him feel wronged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好委曲自己，有咩唔開心就講出嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 wai2 kuk1 zi6 gei2, jau5 me1 m4 hoi1 sam1 zau6 gong2 chut1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要委屈自己，有什么不开心就说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't suppress yourself; if you are unhappy about something, just say it.

english_meaning: to appoint; to assign; to delegate
explanation_mandarin: 指派遣某人担任某种职务或负责某项工作。
explanation_english: To officially assign someone to a position or task; to delegate authority or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司委派佢去香港做代表。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 wai2 paai3 keoi5 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 doi6 biu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司委派他去香港做代表。
examples.english_sentence: The company appointed him as a representative to go to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細委派咗我負責呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 wai2 paai3 zo2 ngo5 fu6 zaak3 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板委派我负责这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: The boss has assigned me to be in charge of this project.

english_meaning: to entrust; to commission; to authorize; to trust; to leave in someone's care; consignment
explanation_mandarin: 把事情托付给别人办理。
explanation_english: To entrust someone to handle a matter; to commission or authorize someone to do something on one's behalf.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我委託咗律師幫我處理呢單案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wai2 tok3 zo2 leot6 si1 bong1 ngo5 cyu5 lei5 ni1 daan1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我委托了律师帮我处理这个案子。
examples.english_sentence: I entrusted the lawyer to help me handle this case.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢委託我幫佢買演唱會飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai2 tok3 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 maai5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他委托我帮他买演唱会门票。
examples.english_sentence: He commissioned me to buy concert tickets for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以委託運輸公司將啲貨運去外國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 wai2 tok3 wan6 syu1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 di1 fo3 wan6 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以委托运输公司将这些货物运到国外。
examples.english_sentence: You can entrust a transportation company to ship the goods abroad.

english_meaning: to arrive late; to come tardily
explanation_mandarin: 形容慢腾腾地来晚了。姗姗：形容走路缓慢从容的样子。
explanation_english: Describes arriving late in a slow and unhurried manner. 姗姗 (saan1 saan1) describes a slow and graceful walk.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都姗姗來遲，搞到我哋要等佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dang2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是姗姗来迟，搞得我们要等他。
examples.english_sentence: He always arrives late, making us wait for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲都開咗場，佢先至姗姗來遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 dou1 hoi1 zo2 coeng4, keoi5 sin1 zi3 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影都开场了，他才姗姗来迟。
examples.english_sentence: The movie had already started when he finally arrived late.

english_meaning: to arrive late; to be late
explanation_mandarin: 形容来得很晚，慢吞吞的样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone arriving very late, in a slow and unhurried manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都姍姍來遲，搞到我哋要等佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4, gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 dang2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是姗姗来迟，害得我们都要等他。
examples.english_sentence: He's always late, causing us to wait for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話塞車，所以先會姍姍來遲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 sak1 ce1, so2 ji5 sin1 wui5 saan1 saan1 loi4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说堵车，所以才会姗姗来迟。
examples.english_sentence: He said there was traffic, so he was late.

english_meaning: to shake; to rock; to sway
explanation_mandarin: 使物体来回晃动。
explanation_english: To cause an object to shake back and forth.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢姚咗杯嘢飲兩嘢，先至飲落肚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jiu4 zo2 bui1 ye5 yam2 loeng5 je5, sin1 zi3 yam2 lok6 tou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摇晃了两下饮料，才喝下去。
examples.english_sentence: He shook the drink a couple of times before drinking it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好姚嚟姚去，會整瀉啲嘢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jiu4 lai4 jiu4 heoi3, wui5 zing2 se3 di1 ye5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要摇来摇去，会弄洒东西的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't shake it around, you'll spill something.

english_meaning: ginger
explanation_mandarin: 植物名，根茎可作调味料或药用。
explanation_english: A plant with a pungent, spicy rhizome (ginger) that is used as a spice and in medicine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我煮餸會落啲姜辟腥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu2 sung3 wui5 lok6 di1 goeng1 pik1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我做菜会放一些姜去腥。
examples.english_sentence: I add some ginger when cooking to remove the fishy smell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 飲碗姜茶驅寒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yam2 wun2 goeng1 caa4 keoi1 hon4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喝碗姜茶驱寒。
examples.english_sentence: Drink a bowl of ginger tea to ward off the cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢薑越老越辣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 goeng1 yut6 lou5 yut6 laat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她姜还是老的辣。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is like old ginger, spicier with age.

cantonese: 姜太公封神 - 漏咗自己
jyutping: goeng1 taai3 gung1 fung1 san4 -- lau6 zo2 zi6 gei2
english_meaning: Jiang Taigong enfeoffs the gods – forgets about himself; to forget about one's own interests or needs when focusing on others; to be so preoccupied with giving or helping others that you neglect yourself.
explanation_mandarin: 姜太公是神话人物，负责封神。这个谚语比喻帮助别人安排好了，却忘了给自己安排，形容考虑别人周到，却忘了自己。通常带有自嘲的意味。
explanation_english: Jiang Taigong (姜太公) is a mythological figure responsible for enfeoffing the gods. This idiom is a metaphor for helping others arrange things well but forgetting to arrange things for oneself. It describes someone who is considerate of others but forgets about themselves. It often carries a self-deprecating tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日幫人執手尾，到頭來姜太公封神——漏咗自己，乜都冇撈到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 bong1 jan4 zap1 sau2 mei1, dou3 tau4 lai4 goeng1 taai3 gung1 fung1 san4 -- lau6 zo2 zi6 gei2, mat1 dou1 mou5 laau4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是帮别人收拾烂摊子，到头来姜太公封神——忘了自己，什么都没捞到。
examples.english_sentence: I'm always cleaning up other people's messes, and in the end, it's like Jiang Taigong enfeoffing the gods – I forgot about myself and didn't get anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次升職佢哋個個都有份，得我冇，真係姜太公封神，漏咗自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 sing1 zik1 keoi5 dei6 go3 go3 dou1 jau5 fan6, dak1 ngo5 mou5, zan1 hai6 goeng1 taai3 gung1 fung1 san4, lau6 zo2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次升职他们每个人都有份，只有我没有，真是姜太公封神，忘了自己。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone got promoted this time except me. It's really like Jiang Taigong enfeoffing the gods and forgetting about himself.

english_meaning: Jiang Taigong fishing: only those who are willing will be caught; to let those who want to be caught take the bait; to patiently wait for an opportunity, only those who are willing to be hooked up will come.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻心甘情愿地上当，或者等待机会，愿者上钩。
explanation_english: It refers to willingly falling into a trap, or patiently waiting for the right opportunity; only those who want to be caught will take the bait. It implies letting things take their course and waiting for the opportunity to present itself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好似姜太公釣魚噉，慢慢嚟，唔急。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 ci5 goeng1 taai3 gung1 diu3 jyu4 gam2, maan6 maan2 lai4, m4 gap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事好像姜太公钓鱼一样，慢慢来，不着急。
examples.english_sentence: He does things like Jiang Taigong fishing, taking it slow and not rushing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃就係姜太公釣魚，睇下邊個會自動獻身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zau6 hai6 goeng1 taai3 gung1 diu3 jyu4, tai2 haa5 bin1 go3 wui5 zi6 dung6 hin3 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划就像姜太公钓鱼，看看谁会自投罗网。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is like Jiang Taigong fishing, to see who will volunteer.

english_meaning: slutty, flirtatious, provocative (usually used negatively to describe a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子卖弄风情，行为轻浮，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is overly flirtatious, provocative, and sexually suggestive, often in a negative and judgmental way. It implies a perceived lack of class or morals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著到咁姣，梗係想引人注意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 dou3 gam3 haau4, gang2 hai6 soeng2 jan5 jan4 zyu3 ji3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿得这么暴露，肯定是想引起别人注意啦。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so provocatively, she's definitely trying to get attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁姣啦，斯文啲好睇啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 haau4 laa1, si1 man4 di1 hou2 tai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么风骚啦，文静一点比较好看。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so slutty, being more elegant looks better.

mandarin_meaning: 妖娆; 妩媚; 美丽
english_meaning: Sultry; flirtatious; attractive (often used to describe a woman); alluring
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性姿态妖娆，充满诱惑力。也指容貌姣好，美丽动人，但带有一种比较轻佻的意味。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is sultry and alluring. It can also refer to someone who is beautiful and attractive, but with a slightly provocative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打扮得好姣好，唔怪得咁多人望佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2扮baan6 dak1 hou2 haau4 hou2, m4 gwaai3 dak1 gam3 do1 jan4 mong6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得很妖娆，难怪这么多人看她。
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed so alluringly today, no wonder so many people are looking at her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁姣好啦，人哋會覺得你好隨便㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 haau4 hou2 laa1, yan4 dei6 wui5 gok3 dak1 nei5 hou2 ceoi4 bin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么妖娆了，别人会觉得你很随便的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so flirtatious, people will think you're easy.

english_meaning: slut, promiscuous woman, sexually provocative woman
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性卖弄风骚，行为放荡。
explanation_english: A derogatory term for a woman who is considered to be overly flirtatious, promiscuous, or sexually provocative. It is often used in a judgmental and offensive way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日着到咁少布，真係姣婆上身咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 zoek3 dou3 gam3 siu2 bou3, zan1 hai6 haau4 po4 soeng5 san1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是穿得那么暴露，真像个荡妇一样。
examples.english_sentence: She always dresses so revealingly, she's like a slut.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做姣婆啦，正经啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 haau4 po4 laa1, zing3 ging1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要当荡妇了，正经点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a slut, be more proper.

jyutping: haau4 po4 sau2 m4 dou2 gwaa2
english_meaning: A flirtatious woman cannot remain a widow (idiom); someone who is easily tempted cannot resist temptation.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个生性风骚，容易受到诱惑的女人很难保持单身状态。也泛指意志不坚定的人，难以抵挡诱惑。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a flirtatious woman who is unable to remain a widow because she is easily tempted. It can also be used more generally to describe someone who lacks willpower and easily gives in to temptation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁鍾意蒲，真係姣婆守唔到寡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 zung1 ji3 pou1, zan1 hai6 haau4 po4 sau2 m4 dou2 gwaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么喜欢出去玩，真是风骚的女人守不住寡。
examples.english_sentence: She likes to go out so much; she really is like a flirtatious woman who cannot remain a widow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話要減肥，點知第二日就食咗成個蛋糕，真係姣婆守唔到寡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 jiu3 gaam2 fei4, dim2 zi1 dai6 ji6 jat6 zau6 sik6 zo2 seng4 go3 daan6 gou1, zan1 hai6 haau4 po4 sau2 m4 dou2 gwaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说要减肥，结果第二天就吃了一整个蛋糕，真是风骚的女人守不住寡。
examples.english_sentence: She said she wanted to lose weight, but the next day she ate a whole cake. She really is like a flirtatious woman who cannot remain a widow (easily tempted).

english_meaning: gaudy purple, a purple color associated with flirtatious or promiscuous women
explanation_mandarin: 形容一种俗艳、过于鲜艳的紫色，通常被认为是不端庄或带有挑逗意味的颜色。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a gaudy, overly bright shade of purple that is often associated with flirtatious or promiscuous women. It carries a pejorative connotation, suggesting a lack of sophistication or even vulgarity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着咗條姣婆紫嘅裙，真係好搶眼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 haau4 po4 zi2 ge3 kwan4, zan1 hai6 hou2 coeng2 ngaan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她穿了一条俗艳紫色的裙子，真的很抢眼。
examples.english_sentence: She wore a gaudy purple dress, it's really eye-catching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得呢隻姣婆紫嘅口紅色太誇張啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 zek3 haau4 po4 zi2 ge3 hau2 hung4 sik1 taai3 kwaa1 zoeng1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得这只俗艳紫色的口红太夸张了。
examples.english_sentence: I think this gaudy purple lipstick is too exaggerated.

mandarin_meaning: 放荡的女人穿着蓝色衣物；指打扮妖艳的女性穿蓝色
english_meaning: A promiscuous woman wearing blue; refers to a woman who dresses seductively and wears blue.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个穿着蓝色衣服，打扮妖艳，行为放荡的女人。 含有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who dresses seductively in blue clothing and is perceived as promiscuous. It carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日著到姣婆藍咁，唔怪得咁多男人追啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoek3 dou3 haau4 po4 laam4 gam2, m4 gwaai3 dak1 gam3 do1 naam4 jan2 zeoi1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是穿得像个放荡的女人，难怪这么多男人追她。
examples.english_sentence: She always dresses in a way that is considered slutty, no wonder so many men are chasing after her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好著到姣婆藍咁去見工呀，人哋會覺得你唔專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoek3 dou3 haau4 po4 laam4 gam2 heoi3 gin3 gung1 aa3, jan4 dei6 wui5 gok3 dak1 nei5 m4 zyun1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要穿得那么妖艳去面试啊，别人会觉得你不专业。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dress so provocatively for the job interview, people will think you are unprofessional.

jyutping: haau4 po4 jyu6 soeng5 zi1 fan2 haak3
mandarin_meaning: 不正经的女人遇上好色的男人；臭味相投
english_meaning: A promiscuous woman meets a lecherous man; a match made in hell; birds of a feather flock together (in a negative sense)
explanation_mandarin: 形容男女双方都比较放荡，臭味相投，一拍即合。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where both the man and woman are licentious and attracted to each other, a match made in hell. Usually carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢兩個咁快就喺埋一齊，真係姣婆遇上脂粉客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 loeng5 go3 gam3 faai3 zau6 hai2 mai4 jat1 cai4, zan1 hai6 haau4 po4 jyu6 soeng5 zi1 fan2 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个这么快就在一起了，真是不正经的女人遇上好色的男人。
examples.english_sentence: They got together so quickly, it's really a promiscuous woman meeting a lecherous man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事擺明係姣婆遇上脂粉客，冇得拗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 baai2 ming4 hai6 haau4 po4 jyu6 soeng5 zi1 fan2 haak3, mou5 dak1 aau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事明显是臭味相投，没什么好争辩的。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is clearly a case of a promiscuous woman meeting a lecherous man, there's no arguing about it.

jyutping: haau4 po4 jyu6 zoek6 zi1 fan2 haak3
english_meaning: A flirtatious woman meets a philanderer; a perfect match (in a negative way, implying both are undesirable).
explanation_mandarin: 形容男女双方都好色，臭味相投，一拍即合。多含贬义，指双方都不是正经人。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where a promiscuous woman meets a womanizer/philanderer. They are a 'perfect' match because they share the same (negative) characteristic. It often carries a derogatory connotation, implying neither party is virtuous or respectable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個咁快就喺埋一齊，真係姣婆遇着脂粉客，啱晒key。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam3 faai3 zau6 hai2 mai4 jat1 cai4, zan1 hai6 haau4 po4 jyu6 zoek6 zi1 fan2 haak3, ngaam1 saai3 key1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个这么快就在一起了，真是色女遇到好色之徒，非常合拍。
examples.english_sentence: They got together so quickly; it's really a flirtatious woman meeting a philanderer, a perfect match.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講啦，話唔定佢哋真心相愛呢，唔一定係姣婆遇着脂粉客嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1, waa6 m4 ding6 keoi5 dei6 zan1 sam1 soeng1 oi3 ne1, m4 jat1 ding6 hai6 haau4 po4 jyu6 zoek6 zi1 fan2 haak3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说，说不定他们真心相爱呢，不一定是色女遇到好色之徒。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, maybe they genuinely love each other; it doesn't necessarily mean it's a flirtatious woman meeting a philanderer.

english_meaning: Acting flirtatiously; trying to be seductive (often in a distasteful or excessive way)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性过分卖弄风骚，行为举止轻浮，令人反感。带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is overly flirtatious or seductive in a vulgar or distasteful manner. It carries a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺男人面前姣屍扽篤，好惹人厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 naam4 jan2 min6 cin4 haau4 si1 dan2 duk1, hou2 je5 jan4 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是在男人面前搔首弄姿，非常惹人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: She is always acting flirtatiously in front of men, which is very annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好再姣屍扽篤啦，睇到都覺得肉酸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 haau4 si1 dan2 duk1 laa1, tai2 dou3 dou1 gok3 dak1 juk6 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要再卖弄风骚了，看着都觉得恶心。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so flirtatious anymore, it's disgusting to watch.

english_meaning: To act coy and flirtatious; to put on a show of being sexy and alluring
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性故意做出娇媚姿态以吸引他人注意。带有贬义，指行为轻佻。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who deliberately acts coy and flirtatious in order to attract attention. It carries a negative connotation, implying that the behavior is frivolous and inappropriate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺啲男人面前姣屍燉篤，好鬼煩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 di1 naam4 jan2 min6 cin4 haau4 si1 deon1 duk1, hou2 gwai2 faan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她整天在男人面前装模作样，真是很烦。
examples.english_sentence: She's always acting all coy and flirtatious in front of the men, it's really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁姣屍燉篤啦，人哋睇到會覺得你好cheap㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 haau4 si1 deon1 duk1 laa1, jan4 dei6 tai2 dou2 wui5 gok3 dak1 nei5 hou2 cheap gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么装模作样了，别人看到会觉得你很廉价的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't act so coy and flirtatious, people will think you're cheap.

english_meaning: flirtatious, seductive, suggestive of lewdness
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性打扮或举止轻佻，故意引人注目，带贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's appearance or behavior as flirtatious and deliberately provocative, often with negative connotations. It implies an attempt to attract attention through seductive or lewd behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日打扮得好姣氣喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 daa2 bun3 dak1 hou2 haau4 hei3 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天打扮得很妖媚！
examples.english_sentence: She's dressed very flirtatiously today!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路個樣咁姣氣，擺明想引人注意啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 go3 joeng2 gam3 haau4 hei3, baai2 ming4 soeng2 jan5 zyu3 yi3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她走路的样子那么妖媚，摆明就是想引人注意啦。
examples.english_sentence: The way she walks is so flirtatious; she's obviously trying to attract attention.

english_meaning: old
explanation_mandarin: （粤语）表示年老，衰老。
explanation_english: (Cantonese) meaning old, aged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁姥，行路都唔方便啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lou4, haang4 lou6 dou1 m4 fong1 bin6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么老了，走路都不方便了。
examples.english_sentence: He's so old, even walking is inconvenient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電視機好姥啦，應該換部新嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 si6 gei1 hou2 lou4 laa1, ying1 goi1 waan6 bou6 san1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电视机很旧了，应该换一台新的。
examples.english_sentence: This TV is very old, we should get a new one.

english_meaning: maternal grandmother
explanation_mandarin: 指母亲的母亲，即外婆。
explanation_english: Refers to one's mother's mother, the maternal grandmother.
