examples.english_sentence: They are female cousins (daughters of each other's mother's sister), and they often played together when they were young.

english_meaning: year
explanation_mandarin: 通常用于口语，指“年”。作为量词，表示年纪。
explanation_english: Colloquial term for "year". As a measure word, it indicates age.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年幾多姩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 gei2 do1 nin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年多大年纪了？
examples.english_sentence: How old is he this year?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今年廿幾姩嘞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 nin4 jaa6 gei2 nin1 laak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今年二十几岁了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm in my twenties this year.

english_meaning: nephew / niece
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟姐妹的儿子称为侄子，女儿称为侄女。
explanation_english: The son of one's brother or sister is called a nephew, and the daughter is called a niece.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪好乖㗎，成日幫屋企人做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 bong1 uk1 kei2 jan4 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄子很乖，经常帮家里人做事。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew is very well-behaved and often helps his family with chores.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一家人好錫我個姪女㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 hou2 sek3 ngo5 go3 dit6 neoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一家人都很疼爱我的侄女。
examples.english_sentence: Our whole family loves my niece very much.

english_meaning: nephew (son of one's sibling)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟姐妹的儿子。
explanation_english: Son of one's sibling (brother or sister).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪仔今年五歲，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 zai2 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄子今年五岁，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew is five years old this year, he's very cute.

english_meaning: nephew (brother's or sister's son)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟或姐妹的儿子。
explanation_english: The son of one's brother or sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪兒今年五歲，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 ji4 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄子今年五岁，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew is five years old this year, he's very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽好錫佢個姪兒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 dit6 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈很疼爱她的侄子。
examples.english_sentence: Mum loves her nephew very much.

english_meaning: niece (brother's or sister's daughter)
explanation_mandarin: 兄弟或姐妹的女儿。
explanation_english: The daughter of one's brother or sister.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪女今年五歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 neoi5 gam1 nin4 ng5 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄女今年五岁。
examples.english_sentence: My niece is five years old this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好錫佢個姪女㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sek3 keoi5 go3 dit6 neoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很疼爱他的侄女。
examples.english_sentence: He dotes on his niece.

english_meaning: niece-in-law; wife of a nephew
explanation_mandarin: 指兄弟的儿子（即侄子）的妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to the wife of one's nephew (son of one's sibling).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大伯嘅姪婦琴日生咗個仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 baak3 ge3 dit6 fu5 kam4 jat6 saang1 zo2 go3 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我大伯的侄媳妇昨天生了个儿子！
examples.english_sentence: My father's elder brother's niece-in-law gave birth to a son yesterday!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢姪婦好乖，成日幫佢手做家務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dit6 fu5 hou2 gwaai1, seng4 jat6 bong1 keoi5 sau2 zou6 gaa1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他侄媳妇很乖，经常帮他做家务。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that his niece-in-law is very well-behaved, often helping him with housework.

english_meaning: grandnephew (male cousin's grandson)
explanation_mandarin: 指兄弟姐妹的孙子（男性）。
explanation_english: Refers to the grandson (male) of one's sibling or cousin (if the cousin is considered a brother).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成家都好錫個姪孫仔㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 gaa1 dou1 hou2 sek3 go3 dit6 syun1 zai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们全家都很疼爱这个侄孙。
examples.english_sentence: Our whole family loves this grandnephew very much.

mandarin_meaning: 贴心人, 亲近的人, 疼爱的人
english_meaning: Close and caring person, someone who understands and is considerate of your feelings; a darling.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常贴心，了解你的心思，对你很好。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very thoughtful and considerate, understands your feelings, and treats you well. Often used to describe a child or someone younger who is particularly endearing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個孫仔真係姪心抱，成日都氹我開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 syun1 zai2 zan1 hai6 dit6 sam1 pou5, seng4 jat6 dou1 tam5 ngo5 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的孙子真是个贴心人，总是哄我开心。
examples.english_sentence: My grandson is such a darling, he always tries to cheer me up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好姪心抱，識得照顧其他人嘅感受。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 dit6 sam1 pou5, sik1 dak1 ziu3 gu3 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 gam2 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她这个人很贴心，懂得照顾其他人的感受。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a very thoughtful person, knowing how to take care of other people's feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個細路女好姪心抱，會主動幫手做家務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 sai3 lou6 neoi2 hou2 dit6 sam1 pou5, wui5 zyu2 dung6 bong1 sau2 zou6 gaa1 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个小女孩很贴心，会主动帮忙做家务。
examples.english_sentence: This little girl is very thoughtful, she will actively help with household chores.

english_meaning: niece's wife; nephew's wife
explanation_mandarin: 指侄子的妻子。
explanation_english: The wife of one's nephew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪新婦好乖，成日嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 san1 fu5 hou2 gwaai1, seng4 jat6 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的侄媳妇很乖，经常来看我。
examples.english_sentence: My nephew's wife is very well-behaved, she often comes to visit me.

english_meaning: niece-in-law (wife of one's nephew)
explanation_mandarin: 指侄子的妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to the wife of one's nephew.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個姪新抱好乖㗎，成日嚟探我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 dit6 san1 pou5 hou2 gwaai1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 lai4 taam3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我侄媳妇很乖的，经常来看我。
examples.english_sentence: My niece-in-law is very well-behaved; she often comes to visit me.

english_meaning: Lesbian; a woman's given name (less common now); concubine (historical)
explanation_mandarin: 现代通常指女同性恋，尤其年轻女性。
explanation_english: In modern Cantonese slang, it commonly refers to a lesbian, especially a young woman. It can also refer to a woman's given name (less common these days). Historically, it meant concubine.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個姬嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 gei1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她是个女同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: She is a lesbian.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔應該歧視啲姬仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 jing1 goi1 kei4 si6 di1 gei1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不应该歧视女同性恋。
examples.english_sentence: We should not discriminate against lesbians.

english_meaning: marriage, matrimonial affinity; destiny of marriage
explanation_mandarin: 婚姻，指男女结婚的喜事；姻缘，指婚姻的缘分。
explanation_english: Marriage, referring to the joyful event of a man and woman getting married; matrimonial affinity, referring to the predestined connection for marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅姻緣係天注定嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 jan1 jyun4 hai6 tin1 zyu3 ding6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的姻缘是天注定的。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage is predestined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望佢可以揾到一段好姻緣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 jat1 dyun6 hou2 jan1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望她可以找到一段好姻缘。
examples.english_sentence: I hope she can find a good marriage.

english_meaning: fate (in marriage); predestined relationship; marital affinity
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间由命运注定的婚姻缘分。
explanation_english: Refers to the predestined fate or connection between a man and a woman that leads to marriage. Often associated with the idea that marriage is determined by destiny.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅姻緣係天注定㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 jan1 jyun4 hai6 tin1 zyu3 ding6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的姻缘是天注定的。
examples.english_sentence: Their marriage is predestined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 希望今年可以搵到好姻緣啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hei1 mong6 gam1 nin4 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou2 hou2 jan1 jyun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 希望今年可以找到好姻缘。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can find a good match this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信唔信姻緣呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 m4 seon3 jan1 jyun4 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你相信姻缘吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you believe in fate in marriage?

english_meaning: Marriage is predestined by fate; Marriages are made in heaven.
explanation_mandarin: 指男女之间的婚姻是命中注定的，是上天安排好的。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that the connection and eventual marriage between two individuals are predestined by fate or by a higher power. It implies that their union was meant to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個咁夾，真係姻緣天注定囉！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gam3 gaap3, zan1 hai6 jan1 jyun4 tin1 zyu3 ding6 lo1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们俩这么合得来，真是姻缘天注定啊！
examples.english_sentence: They get along so well, it really is a marriage made in heaven!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔信姻緣天注定，我覺得愛情要自己爭取。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 seon3 jan1 jyun4 tin1 zyu3 ding6, ngo5 gok3 dak1 oi3 ching4 jiu3 zi6 gei2 zaang1 cheoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不相信姻缘天注定，我觉得爱情要自己争取。
examples.english_sentence: I don't believe that marriages are made in heaven; I think you have to work for love.

english_meaning: Marriage is predestined by fate; destined marriage; a match made in heaven.
explanation_mandarin: 指婚姻是由上天安排好的，是命中注定的缘分。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that marriage is predetermined by fate or destiny. It implies that certain people are meant to be together and their union is divinely ordained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個真係姻緣天註定，一見鍾情，好快就結婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 leong5 go3 zan1 hai6 jan1 jyun4 tin1 zyu3 ding6, jat1 gin3 zung1 cing4, hou2 faai3 zau6 git3 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个人真是姻缘天注定，一见钟情，很快就结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: They are truly a match made in heaven; they fell in love at first sight and got married very quickly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然經歷咗好多波折，但佢哋最終都喺埋一齊，可能真係姻緣天註定。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ging1 lik6 zo2 hou2 do1 bo1 zit3, daan6 keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 zung1 dou1 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4, ho2 nang4 zan1 hai6 jan1 jyun4 tin1 zyu3 ding6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然经历了很多波折，但他们最终还是在一起了，可能真是姻缘天注定。
examples.english_sentence: Although they went through many twists and turns, they ended up together in the end; perhaps it's truly a destined marriage.

english_meaning: relatives by marriage, affinal relatives
explanation_mandarin: 因婚姻关系而产生的亲戚关系。包括配偶的亲戚、亲戚的配偶，以及配偶亲戚的配偶。
explanation_english: Relating to relatives by marriage; specifically, relatives who are related to a person through his or her spouse's family, the spouses of one's relatives, and the relatives of one's spouse's relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚之後，我同佢屋企人就變咗姻親關係啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6, ngo5 tung4 keoi5 uk1 kei5 jan4 zau6 bin3 zo2 jan1 can1 gwaan1 hai6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚之后，我和他们家人就变成姻亲关系了。
examples.english_sentence: After they got married, I became related to their family by marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，我哋要拜訪好多姻親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 baai3 fong2 hou2 do1 jan1 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，我们要拜访很多姻亲。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, we need to visit many relatives by marriage.

english_meaning: beautiful; pretty; good-looking
explanation_mandarin: 指女子容貌美丽动人。也泛指美好。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's appearance as beautiful and attractive. Can also generally refer to something being beautiful or good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得好姼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 sang1 dak1 hou2 ci1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她长得很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個花瓶雕得好姼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 faa1 ping4 diu1 dak1 hou2 ci1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个花瓶雕刻得很精美。
examples.english_sentence: This vase is exquisitely carved.

english_meaning: posture; appearance; form; figure; manner
explanation_mandarin: 指身体的姿势或形态；也指事物的样子或形态。
explanation_english: Refers to the posture or form of the body; also refers to the appearance or form of things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺嘅姿势好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ge3 zi1 sai3 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她摆的姿势很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The pose she struck was very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞嘅姿态好优雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu3 mou5 ge3 zi1 taai3 hou2 jau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她跳舞的姿态很优雅。
examples.english_sentence: Her dancing posture is very elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵树嘅姿态好特别。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go1 syu6 ge3 zi1 taai3 hou2 dak6 bit6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵树的姿态很特别。
examples.english_sentence: The form of this tree is very special.

mandarin_meaning: 姿势; 姿态; 样子
english_meaning: posture; gesture; stance; style; pose; manner
explanation_mandarin: 身体呈现的姿态、样子；也可以指一种风格、态度或做事的方法。
explanation_english: The posture, gesture, or manner in which someone or something holds their body. It can also refer to a style, attitude, or way of doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你擺呢個姿勢好靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 baai2 ni1 go3 zi1 sai3 hou2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你摆的这个姿势很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The pose you're making is very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅跑步姿勢好標準。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 paau2 bou6 zi1 sai3 hou2 biu1 zeon2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的跑步姿势很标准。
examples.english_sentence: His running posture is very standard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好擺出咁嘅姿勢啦，好假㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 baai2 ceot1 gam3 ge3 zi1 sai3 laa1, hou2 gaa2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要摆出那样的姿态了，很假的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't put on such a pose, it's so fake.

mandarin_meaning: 讲究，注重外表，装模作样
english_meaning: Fussy, meticulous, prim and proper, affectedly elegant, overly concerned with appearance
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常讲究，注重外表，甚至有点装模作样，给人一种做作的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very fussy, meticulously attentive to their appearance, sometimes to the point of being affected or pretentious. Implies artificiality or an over-the-top concern with outward presentation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都姿姿整整咁返工，以為自己好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zi1 zi1 zing2 zing2 gam2 faan1 gung1, ji5 wai4 zi6 gei2 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都打扮得花枝招展去上班，以为自己很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: She goes to work all primped and preened every day, thinking she's so beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁姿姿整整啦，我哋又唔係去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 zi1 zi1 zing2 zing2 laa1, ngo5 dei6 jau6 m4 hai6 heoi3 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么讲究啦，我们又不是去喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother being so fussy, we're not going out for drinks.

synonyms: 矯揉造作 (giu2 jau4 zou6 jok3)

english_meaning: posture, attitude, manner, stance
explanation_mandarin: 指人的姿势、态度或做事的风度。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's posture, attitude, or manner of doing things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢擺出高姿態，好似好巴閉咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baai2 ceot1 gou1 zi1 taai3, hou2 ci5 hou2 baa1 bai3 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他摆出高姿态，好像很了不起似的。
examples.english_sentence: He's putting on airs, acting as if he's a big shot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢嘅姿態好專業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 ge3 zi1 taai3 hou2 chuyên1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事的样子很专业。
examples.english_sentence: His manner of working is very professional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁低姿態，應該爭取自己嘅權益。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 dai1 zi1 taai3, ying1 goi1 zang1 cheui2 zi6 gei2 ge3 kuen4 yik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么低姿态，应该争取自己的权益。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so humble, you should fight for your rights.

mandarin_meaning: 讲究打扮; 注重仪表
english_meaning: to be fussy about one's appearance; to primp; to be meticulous about one's appearance; to be vain
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常注重外表打扮，花很多时间和心思在穿着、发型、化妆等方面。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very particular about their appearance, spending a lot of time and effort on their clothes, hairstyle, makeup, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都姿整到出街，真係好花時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 zi1 zing2 dou3 chut1 gaai1, zan1 hai6 hou2 faa1 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每天都打扮得很精心才出门，真是很花时间。
examples.english_sentence: She takes so much time to primp before going out every day, it's really time-consuming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁姿整啦，又唔係去飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 zi1 zing2 laa1, jau6 m4 hai6 heoi3 jam2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用那么讲究，又不是去喝东西。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to be so fussy, we're not going for drinks.

english_meaning: looks; appearance; attractiveness; beauty
explanation_mandarin: 指容貌和姿态。多用于评价女性的外貌。
explanation_english: Refers to physical appearance and bearing. Often used to evaluate the appearance of women.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢天生麗質，姿色過人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tin1 sang1 lai6 zat1, zi1 sik1 gwo3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她天生丽质，姿色过人。

explanation_english: Refers to the reputation and influence gained in society or a group due to ability, achievements, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司嘅威望好高，個個都聽佢話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 ge3 wai1 mong6 hou2 gou1, go3 go3 dou1 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在公司的威望很高，每个人都听他的。
examples.english_sentence: His prestige in the company is very high, everyone listens to him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位教授學術成就好高，喺學界好有威望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 gaau3 sau6 hok6 seot6 sing4 zau6 hou2 gou1, hai2 hok6 gaai3 hou2 jau5 wai1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位教授学术成就很高，在学术界很有威望。
examples.english_sentence: This professor has high academic achievements and has a lot of prestige in academia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅威望係靠自己嘅努力建立返嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 wai1 mong6 hai6 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nou5 lik6 gin3 lap6 faan1 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的威望是靠自己的努力建立起来的。
examples.english_sentence: His prestige was built through his own efforts.

english_meaning: Authoritarianism
explanation_mandarin: 一种政治制度，强调国家权力至上，个人自由受到限制。
explanation_english: A political system that emphasizes state power and restricts individual freedoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人覺得香港嘅政治環境越來越傾向威權主義。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zing3 zi6 waan4 ging2 jyuet6 lai4 yuet6 hing1 hoeng3 wai1 kyun4 zyu2 ji2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人觉得香港的政治环境越来越倾向威权主义。
examples.english_sentence: Some people feel that Hong Kong's political environment is increasingly leaning towards authoritarianism.

english_meaning: powerful and imposing; majestic; awe-inspiring
explanation_mandarin: 形容气势强大，令人敬畏。
explanation_english: Describes a powerful, impressive, and awe-inspiring aura or appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺台上嘅表現好威武，震懾全場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 toi4 soeng6 ge3 biu2 jin6 hou2 wai1 mou5, zan3 sip3 cyun4 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在台上的表现非常威武，震慑全场。
examples.english_sentence: His performance on stage was very imposing, and it shocked the entire audience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支軍隊行起上嚟好威武。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 gwan1 deoi2 haang4 hei2 soeng5 lai4 hou2 wai1 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这支军队走起来很威武。
examples.english_sentence: This army looks very majestic when they march.

english_meaning: glorious; prestigious; impressive; to bring honour
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事非常光荣、出色，令人羡慕和敬佩。 可以用来形容人，也可以形容事。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is glorious, outstanding, admirable and respectable. Can be used to describe people or events. Often used to describe accomplishments or situations that bring honor or pride.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗奧運金牌，真係好威水呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 ou3 wan6 gam1 paai4, zan1 hai6 hou2 wai1 seoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他获得了奥运金牌，真是太光荣了！
examples.english_sentence: He won an Olympic gold medal, that's really glorious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁後生就做咗經理，好威水喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 zou6 zo2 ging1 lei5, hou2 wai1 seoi2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么年轻就当了经理，很威风啊！
examples.english_sentence: You became a manager at such a young age, that's really impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間公司起咗棟咁靚嘅大廈，好威水㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 gung1 si1 hei2 zo2 dung6 gam3 leng3 ge3 daai6 haa6, hou2 wai1 seoi2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司盖了这么漂亮的大厦，很光荣的。
examples.english_sentence: Their company built such a beautiful building, it's very prestigious.

mandarin_meaning: 光荣史, 辉煌的历史
english_meaning: glorious past, impressive history, tales of past glory
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人或团队过去取得的辉煌成就和值得骄傲的经历。 通常带有炫耀或回忆的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's or group's glorious achievements and praiseworthy experiences in the past. Often used with a hint of boasting or reminiscence. Literally, 'impressive water history'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日講佢嘅威水史，聽到我都厭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 gong2 keoi5 ge3 wai1 seoi2 si2, teng1 dou3 ngo5 dou1 jim3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是讲他光荣的历史，听得我都厌烦了。
examples.english_sentence: He always talks about his glorious past, I'm sick of hearing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺成日同啲孫仔講佢後生嗰陣嘅威水史。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 seng4 jat6 tung4 di1 syun1 zai2 gong2 keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 ge3 wai1 seoi2 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷总是跟孙子们讲他年轻时候的辉煌事迹。
examples.english_sentence: Grandpa always tells his grandchildren about his glorious deeds when he was young.

mandarin_meaning: 威尔士; 有威势; 气派
english_meaning: Wales; powerful; prestigious; imposing
explanation_mandarin: 威尔士，英国的一个地区; 形容人或事物很有威势，有气派。
explanation_english: Wales, a region in the UK; Used to describe something or someone as powerful, prestigious, or imposing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢住喺威爾斯，講緊威爾斯文。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu6 hai2 wai1 ji5 si1, gong2 gan2 wai1 ji5 si1 man2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他住在威尔士，说着威尔士语。
examples.english_sentence: He lives in Wales and speaks Welsh.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司個名改到好威爾斯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 go3 ming2 goi2 dou3 hou2 wai1 ji5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的名字改得很气派。
examples.english_sentence: The company's name is very prestigious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車裝修到好威爾斯咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 zong1 sau1 dou3 hou2 wai1 ji5 si1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这辆车装修得很气派。
examples.english_sentence: This car is decorated very imposingly.

english_meaning: Prince of Wales
explanation_mandarin: 英国王位继承人的封号。
explanation_english: The title traditionally held by the heir apparent to the British throne.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 威爾斯親王查理斯繼承咗佢阿媽嘅皇位，而家係查理斯三世。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai1 ji5 si1 ceon1 wong4 caa4 lei5 si1 gai3 sing4 zo2 keoi5 aa3 maa1 ge3 wong4 wai2, ji4 gaa1 hai6 caa4 lei5 si1 saam1 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 威尔士亲王查尔斯继承了他母亲的王位，现在是查尔斯三世。
examples.english_sentence: The Prince of Wales, Charles, inherited his mother's throne and is now Charles III.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 威爾斯親王醫院係香港一間好出名嘅醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai1 ji5 si1 ceon1 wong4 ji1 yun2 hai6 hoeng1 gong2 jat1 gaan1 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 ji1 yun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 威尔士亲王医院是香港一家很有名的医院。
examples.english_sentence: The Prince of Wales Hospital is a very famous hospital in Hong Kong.

english_meaning: powerful and imposing; mighty; virile
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物有力量、有气势，给人一种强壮、雄伟的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something powerful, imposing, and giving a feeling of strength and grandeur. Can also imply virility in a man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身型好威猛，一定好多女仔鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 jing4 hou2 wai1 maang5, jat1 ding6 hou2 do1 neoi5 zai2 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身材很威猛，一定有很多女孩喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: He has a very powerful physique, I'm sure many girls like him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻獅子睇落好威猛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 si1 zi2 tai2 lok6 hou2 wai1 maang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只狮子看起来很威猛。
examples.english_sentence: This lion looks very mighty.

english_meaning: Viagra
explanation_mandarin: 治疗男性勃起功能障碍的药物的商品名。
explanation_english: The trade name for a drug used to treat erectile dysfunction in men.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢要買啲威而鋼，唔知做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jiu3 maai5 di1 wai1 ji4 gong3, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说他要买一些伟哥，不知道要做什么。
examples.english_sentence: He said he wanted to buy some Viagra, I don't know what for.

english_meaning: threaten, threat
explanation_mandarin: 以实力或权利使人屈服；使人感到恐惧而被迫去做某事；也指威胁性的言语或行为。
explanation_english: To intimidate someone into doing something through the use of power or force; to create a feeling of fear that forces someone to do something. Also refers to threatening words or actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢威脅我唔好講出去，如果唔係就對我唔客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai1 hip3 ngo5 m4 hou2 gong2 chut1 heoi3, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 zau6 deoi3 ngo5 m4 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他威胁我不要说出去，不然就对我不客气。
examples.english_sentence: He threatened me not to tell anyone, or else he would be rude to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢嘅威脅嚇到，企硬啲！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 ge3 wai1 hip3 haak3 dou3, kei5 ngaang6 di1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要被他的威胁吓到，坚持住！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be intimidated by his threats, stand firm!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係赤裸裸嘅威脅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 cek3 lo2 lo2 ge3 wai1 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是赤裸裸的威胁。
examples.english_sentence: These are blatant threats.

english_meaning: to coerce, to intimidate, to threaten
explanation_mandarin: 用权势或压力强迫。
explanation_english: To coerce or intimidate someone into doing something through the use of power or pressure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋威迫我簽份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai1 bik1 ngo5 cim1 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们威逼我签一份合约。
examples.english_sentence: They coerced me into signing a contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔可以威迫佢做佢唔想做嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 ho2 ji5 wai1 bik1 keoi5 zou6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 zou6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不能威逼他做他不想做的事情。
examples.english_sentence: You cannot coerce him into doing things he doesn't want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢受到威迫之下，先至講出真相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sau6 dou3 wai1 bik1 zi1 haa6, sin1 zi3 gong2 ceot1 zan1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在受到威逼的情况下，才说出真相。
examples.english_sentence: He only told the truth under duress.

mandarin_meaning: 软硬兼施, 威逼利诱
english_meaning: to coerce and bribe; to use both threats and inducements; carrot and stick
explanation_mandarin: 使用威胁和利益引诱相结合的手段，达到某种目的。
explanation_english: To use a combination of threats (coercion) and attractive offers (bribes/inducements) to achieve a goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想威迫利誘我哋幫佢做啲非法嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wai1 bik1 lei6 jau5 ngo5 dei6 bong1 keoi5 zou6 di1 fei1 faat3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想威逼利诱我们帮他做一些非法的事情。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to coerce and bribe us into doing some illegal things for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老闆成日威迫利誘員工加班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 wai1 bik1 lei6 jau5 jyun4 gung1 gaa1 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 老板总是威逼利诱员工加班。
examples.english_sentence: The boss always coerces and bribes employees to work overtime.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住可以威迫利誘我，我唔會就範㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 ho2 ji5 wai1 bik1 lei6 jau5 ngo5, ngo5 m4 wui5 zau6 faan6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别想着可以威逼利诱我，我是不会屈服的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can coerce and bribe me; I won't give in.

english_meaning: to force; to coerce; to intimidate
explanation_mandarin: 用威胁、恐吓的手段强迫别人做事情。
explanation_english: To compel or force someone to do something through threats, intimidation, or coercion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋威逼我簽份合約。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai1 bik1 ngo5 cim1 fan6 hap6 joek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们威逼我签一份合同。
examples.english_sentence: They coerced me into signing a contract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以靠威逼嚟解決問題㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 kaau3 wai1 bik1 lai4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能靠威逼来解决问题的。
examples.english_sentence: You can't solve problems by coercion.

english_meaning: to use both threats and promises; to coerce and entice; to use carrot and stick
explanation_mandarin: 用威胁和利诱的手段达到目的。
explanation_english: To achieve one's goal by using both threats and enticing promises, essentially a 'carrot and stick' approach.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想威逼利誘我幫佢做啲犯法嘢，我梗係唔肯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 wai1 bik1 lei6 yau5 ngo5 bong1 keoi5 zou6 di1 faan6 faat3 je5, ngo5 gang2 hai6 m4 hang2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想威逼利诱我帮他做一些犯法的事情，我当然不会答应。
examples.english_sentence: He tried to coerce and entice me into doing some illegal things for him, of course, I wouldn't agree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個老闆成日用威逼利誘嘅手段去剝削啲員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lou5 baan2 seng4 jat6 yung6 wai1 bik1 lei6 yau5 ge3 sau2 dyun6 heoi3 bok1 soek3 di1 yun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个老板经常用威逼利诱的手段去剥削员工。
examples.english_sentence: This boss often uses coercion and enticement to exploit the employees.

english_meaning: Extremely impressive; very powerful; to be more impressive than whiskey (strong alcohol)
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事非常厉害，非常威风。威士忌是一种烈酒，用来比喻超出一般的程度。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone or something that is very impressive and powerful. Whiskey, being a strong alcoholic beverage, is used as a comparison to indicate exceeding the ordinary level of impressiveness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試攞第一，真係威過威士忌！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 lo2 dai6 jat1, zan1 hai6 wai1 gwo3 wai1 si6 gei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试得了第一名，真是太厉害了！
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam this time, he's really impressive!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你架新車咁靚，真係威過威士忌！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaa3 san1 ce1 gam3 leng3, zan1 hai6 wai1 gwo3 wai1 si6 gei2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的新车这么漂亮，真是太威风了！
examples.english_sentence: Your new car is so beautiful, it's really impressive!

mandarin_meaning: 威灵顿牛排; 牛气、厉害
english_meaning: Wellington beef; impressive, powerful, awesome (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 原本指威灵顿牛排，一种西餐。在粤语俚语中，引申为形容某人或某事很厉害，很牛气。
explanation_english: Originally refers to Wellington beef, a type of Western cuisine. In Cantonese slang, it is extended to describe someone or something as impressive, powerful, or awesome.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試攞到第一名，真係威靈頓呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 lo2 dou3 dai6 jat1 ming4, zan1 hai6 wai1 ling4 deon6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考了第一名，真是太厉害了！
examples.english_sentence: He got first place in the exam this time, he's really awesome!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅威靈頓牛排真係好好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 wai1 ling4 deon6 ngau4 paai2 zan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的威灵顿牛排真的很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The Wellington beef at this restaurant is really delicious.

english_meaning: prestige; imposing appearance; impressive demeanor; dignified
explanation_mandarin: 形容气势或声势令人敬畏。
explanation_english: Describing an imposing or impressive manner that inspires awe or respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢着住晒軍裝，真係好威風。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 saai3 gwan1 zong1, zan1 hai6 hou2 wai1 fung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着全套军装，真的很威风。
examples.english_sentence: He's wearing his full military uniform, he looks really impressive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸住架跑車，行出嚟好威風咁嘅樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 zyu6 gaa3 paau2 ce1, haang4 chut1 lai4 hou2 wai1 fung1 gam2 ge3 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开着跑车，走出来一副很威风的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He was driving a sports car and walked out looking very dignified.

english_meaning: impressive, awe-inspiring, having great prestige and influence; radiating power and authority
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物气势强大，令人敬畏。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something with an imposing presence, commanding respect and admiration; suggesting an aura of power and authority emanating from all directions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日升咗做經理，行出嚟真係威風八面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5, haang4 ceot1 lai4 zan1 hai6 wai1 fung1 baat3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天升职做了经理，走出来真是威风凛凛。
examples.english_sentence: He got promoted to manager today. He looks so impressive walking around.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部新戰機喺空中表演嘅時候，真係威風八面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 san1 zin3 gei1 hai2 hung1 zung1 biu2 jin2 ge3 si4 hau6, zan1 hai6 wai1 fung1 baat3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新战机在空中表演的时候，真是威风凛凛。
examples.english_sentence: The new fighter jet looked absolutely awe-inspiring when it performed in the air.

english_meaning: imposing; awe-inspiring; majestic; dignified and impressive
explanation_mandarin: 形容气势威严，令人敬畏。
explanation_english: Describes a dignified and imposing manner, inspiring awe and respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著住套軍裝，企喺度威風凜凜噉樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 tou3 gwan1 zong1, kei5 hai2 dou6 wai1 fung1 lam5 lam5 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他穿着一身军装，站在那里威风凛凛的样子。
examples.english_sentence: He was wearing his military uniform, standing there looking very imposing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班醒獅隊威風凜凜咁跳緊舞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 sing2 si1 deoi2 wai1 fung1 lam5 lam5 gam2 tiu3 gan2 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 舞狮队正在威风凛凛地跳舞。
examples.english_sentence: The lion dance team is dancing in a majestic and awe-inspiring way.

english_meaning: doll; baby
explanation_mandarin: 指婴儿或小孩，也指玩具娃娃。
explanation_english: Refers to a baby or young child; also refers to a toy doll.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個娃好得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 waa1 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个娃娃很可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: This baby is so cute!

explanation_english: A type of vegetable, a small variety of Chinese cabbage (Napa cabbage), known for its tender texture.

english_meaning: baby doll dress, babydoll dress
explanation_mandarin: 一种宽松、通常为A字形的连衣裙，通常带有较高的腰线，让人看起来像洋娃娃一样。
explanation_english: A loose-fitting, often A-line dress, typically with a high waistline, designed to resemble clothing worn by dolls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗件娃娃裝，好可愛啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 waa1 waa1 zong1, hou2 ho2 oi3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一件娃娃衫，好可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: She's wearing a babydoll dress today, so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我覺得娃娃裝好舒服，唔會焗身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gok3 dak1 waa1 waa1 zong1 hou2 syu1 fuk6, m4 wui5 guk6 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我觉得娃娃衫很舒服，不会闷热。
examples.english_sentence: I think babydoll dresses are comfortable, they're not stuffy.

english_meaning: to engage, to employ, to betroth (archaic)
explanation_mandarin: 雇请；聘用；(古)订婚
explanation_english: To engage someone for work; to employ. Archaically, it also meant to betroth someone, particularly referring to the formal engagement process initiated by the man's family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司娉請咗個新嘅設計師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ping3 cing2 zo2 go3 san1 ge3 sat3 gai3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司聘请了一个新的设计师。
examples.english_sentence: Their company has hired a new designer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代人會用「娉」嚟形容男方去女方屋企提親。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 jan4 wui5 yung6 "ping3" lai4 jing4 yung4 naam4 fong1 heoi3 neoi5 fong1 uk1 kei5 tai4 can1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候的人会用「娉」来形容男方去女方家提亲。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, people would use "娉" to describe the man's family going to the woman's family to propose marriage.

english_meaning: graceful and composed; poised and calm
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态优美，举止从容镇定，不慌不忙。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is graceful in appearance and deportment, composed and calm in her actions, and unhurried.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路嘅時候娉婷淡定，好有氣質。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 ge3 si4 hau6 ping3 ting4 daam6 ding6, hou2 jau5 hei3 zat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她走路的时候姿态优雅，从容镇定，很有气质。
examples.english_sentence: She walks with grace and composure, possessing a refined air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺咁多人面前表演，佢依然可以保持娉婷淡定嘅姿態，真係好厲害。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 biu2 jin2, keoi5 ji1 jin4 ho2 ji5 bou2 ci4 ping3 ting4 daam6 ding6 ge3 zi1 taai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 lai6 hoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么多人面前表演，她依然可以保持姿态优雅，从容镇定的姿态，真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Performing in front of so many people, she can still maintain a graceful and composed demeanor, it's really amazing.

mandarin_meaning: 老幺，最小的 (lǎoyāo, zuì xiǎo de)
english_meaning: youngest (child)
explanation_mandarin: 指家中最小的子女。
explanation_english: Refers to the youngest child in a family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係屋企嘅孻仔，所以特別受寵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 uk1 kei5 ge3 laai1 zai2, so2 ji5 dak6 bit6 sau6 cung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是家里的老幺，所以特别受宠。
examples.english_sentence: He is the youngest son in the family, so he is particularly spoiled.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企嘅孻女好鬼得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 laai1 neoi2 hou2 gwai2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家的小女儿非常可爱。
examples.english_sentence: Our youngest daughter is very cute.

english_meaning: to rub; to stroke; to touch gently
explanation_mandarin: 用手轻轻地摩擦或触摸。
explanation_english: To rub gently with the hand; to stroke or touch softly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都娑佢隻貓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 so1 keoi5 zek3 maau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是抚摸他的猫。
examples.english_sentence: He always strokes his cat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日娑個傷口，會感染㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 so1 go3 soeng1 hau2, wui5 gam2 jim5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是摩擦伤口，会感染的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't keep rubbing the wound, it will get infected.

english_meaning: to talk eloquently and persuasively
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话连续不断，详细而动听
explanation_english: Describes speaking continuously, in a detailed and pleasing manner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢娓娓道嚟，講咗成晚嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mei5 mei5 dou6 lai4, gong2 zo2 seng4 maan5 ge3 gu3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他娓娓道来，讲了一整晚的故事。
examples.english_sentence: He talked eloquently and persuasively, telling stories all night long.

english_meaning: to narrate slowly and clearly; to relate in detail; to tell (a story) in a flowing manner
explanation_mandarin: 形容说话或叙述时, 态度从容不迫, 语气委婉动听，详细地讲述。
explanation_english: Describes speaking or narrating in a slow, deliberate, and gentle manner, elaborating on details to make the story clear and engaging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢娓娓道嚟佢細個嗰陣嘅經歷，聽落好引人入勝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mei5 mei5 dou6 lai4 keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 ge3 ging1 lik6, teng1 lok6 hou2 jan5 jap6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他娓娓道来他小时候的经历，听起来很引人入胜。
examples.english_sentence: He narrated his childhood experiences slowly and clearly, making it very captivating to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用平靜嘅語氣，娓娓道嚟成件事嘅來龍去脈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 yung6 ping4 zing6 ge3 yu5 hei3, mei5 mei5 dou6 lai4 sing4 gin6 si6 ge3 loi4 lung4 heoi3 mak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他用平静的语气，娓娓道来整件事的来龙去脉。
examples.english_sentence: He used a calm tone to explain the whole story from beginning to end, in detail.

mandarin_meaning: 女性化的；没有男子气概的
english_meaning: Effeminate; unmanly; sissy
explanation_mandarin: 用来形容男性缺乏男子气概，行为举止女性化。带有贬义色彩。
explanation_english: Used to describe a male who lacks masculinity and behaves in a feminine manner. It has a pejorative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢咁扭扭擰擰，好娘㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 gam3 nau1 nau1 ning2 ning2, hou2 noeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事扭扭捏捏的，很娘。
examples.english_sentence: He is so effeminate in his work, it's very sissy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁娘啦，似個男人咁啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 noeng4 laa1, ci5 go3 naam4 jan2 gam2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要那么娘了，像个男人一样！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so effeminate, act like a man!

english_meaning: effeminate, sissy, girly (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 形容男子举止、言语像女子一样，带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a man who behaves or speaks in a feminine way. It's a derogatory term often used to insult or ridicule someone's masculinity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扭腰擺臀，俾人話佢娘丙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 nau2 jiu1 baai2 tyun4, bei2 jan4 waa6 keoi5 noeng4 bing2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是扭腰摆臀，被人说他娘娘腔。
examples.english_sentence: He always wiggles his hips, people say he's effeminate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁娘丙啦，男人老狗！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 noeng4 bing2 laa1, naam4 jan4 lou5 gau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么娘娘腔，你是个男人！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so effeminate, you're a man!

mandarin_meaning: 皇后; 女神; 形容嬌生慣養、愛撒嬌的女性
english_meaning: Empress; Goddess; (slang) used to describe a pampered, spoiled woman, or a woman who likes to act spoiled/cute.
explanation_mandarin: 在古代，娘娘是对皇后的尊称。也指神话传说中的女神。在现代粤语中，有时也用来形容娇生惯养、爱撒娇、爱抱怨的女性，带有一点贬义，但有时也可以是朋友间的一种戏谑称呼。
explanation_english: Historically, '娘娘' was a respectful term for the Empress. It also refers to Goddesses in mythology. In modern Cantonese, it can be used to describe a woman who is pampered, spoiled, likes to act cute and complain. It can be slightly derogatory, but sometimes used playfully between friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日發脾氣，真係當自己係娘娘噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faat3 pei4 hei3, zan1 hai6 dong3 zi6 gei2 hai6 noeng4 noeng2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是发脾气，真把自己当成皇后一样。
examples.english_sentence: She always throws tantrums, she really thinks she's an Empress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，娘娘，今日想食乜嘢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, noeng4 noeng2, gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，大小姐，今天想吃什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: Hey, Your Highness, what do you want to eat today?

english_meaning: Mother; Mom
explanation_mandarin: 粤语口语称呼母亲的常用词。
explanation_english: A common colloquial term in Cantonese for 'mother'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 娘媽，我返嚟喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: noeng4 maa1, ngo5 faan1 lai4 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈，我回来了！
examples.english_sentence: Mom, I'm back!

examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 daai3 noeng4 maa1 heoi3 jam2 chaa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要带妈妈去喝茶。
examples.english_sentence: I'm taking my mother out for dim sum tomorrow.

english_meaning: maiden home; wife's parents' home; wife's natal family
explanation_mandarin: 指已婚妇女的父母家或娘家的亲戚。
explanation_english: Refers to the home of a married woman's parents or her natal family relatives.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日返娘家探佢阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 faan1 noeng4 gaa1 taam3 keoi5 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她经常回娘家看她妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: She often goes back to her maiden home to visit her mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 結咗婚嘅女人得閒應該返娘家睇下。
examples.jyutping_sentence: git3 zo2 fan1 ge3 neoi5 jan2 dak1 haan4 ying1 goi1 faan1 noeng4 gaa1 tai2 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 结婚的女人有空应该回娘家看看。
examples.english_sentence: Married women should visit their maiden home when they have time.

mandarin_meaning: 娘娘腔，形容男性女性化
english_meaning: effeminate, sissy, girly (derogatory, used to describe a male)
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性行为举止像女性，带有贬义。
explanation_english: A derogatory term to describe a male whose behaviour, mannerisms, or appearance is considered effeminate or girly. It's often used in a negative or insulting way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁娘炳啦，男人老狗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 noeng4 bing2 laa1, naam4 jan2 lou5 gau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么娘娘腔了，一个大男人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so effeminate, you're a grown man.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢有啲娘炳，所以我唔係好鍾意同佢傾偈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jau5 di1 noeng4 bing2, so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 tung4 keoi5 king1 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说话有点娘娘腔，所以我不太喜欢跟他聊天。
examples.english_sentence: He talks a bit effeminately, so I don't really like chatting with him.

synonyms: 基佬 (sometimes used, depending on context and intent)

english_meaning: Extremely effeminate; sissy; very girly (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 形容男性过于女性化，缺乏男子气概。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Describes a male who is excessively feminine and lacks masculine characteristics. Usually carries a derogatory connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢著粉紅色衫，行為又咁嬌嗲，真係娘爆。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁娘爆啦，男人嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 noeng4 baau3 laa1, naam4 jan2 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么娘炮了，是男人啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so effeminate, you're a man.

english_meaning: Mother
explanation_mandarin: 对母亲的称呼，较为正式或古雅的说法。
explanation_english: A formal or somewhat archaic term for 'mother'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽，妳即係我嘅娘親呀嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1, nei5 zik1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 noeng4 can1 aa3 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈，你就是我的母亲嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Mom, you are my mother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嘅娘親好錫我。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ge3 noeng4 can1 hou2 sek3 ngo5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的母亲很疼我。

english_meaning: to amuse, to entertain; entertainment, amusement
explanation_mandarin: 使人快乐，消遣，娱乐。
explanation_english: To provide amusement or enjoyment; to entertain. Also, the state of being entertained or amused; entertainment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鐘意睇戲嚟娛己。

english_meaning: Entertainment; recreation; amusement
explanation_mandarin: 使人快乐或消遣的活动。
explanation_english: Activities that provide pleasure and amusement; recreation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚去睇戲當娛樂下啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 tai2 hei3 dong3 jyu4 lok6 haa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚去看电影当娱乐一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go to the movies tonight for some entertainment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅娛樂就係睇電視同埋打機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jyu4 lok6 zau6 hai6 tai2 din6 si6 tung4 ma4 daa2 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的娱乐就是看电视和打游戏。
examples.english_sentence: His entertainment is watching TV and playing video games.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個節目都幾有娛樂性嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 dou1 gei2 jau5 jyu4 lok6 sing3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个节目挺有娱乐性的。
examples.english_sentence: This show is quite entertaining.

english_meaning: entertainment industry
explanation_mandarin: 指以电影、电视、音乐、表演等为主要内容的产业。
explanation_english: Refers to the industry primarily focused on movies, television, music, performing arts, and other forms of entertainment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都好想入娛樂圈發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 soeng2 jap6 jyu4 lok6 hyun1 faat3 zin2.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 娛樂圈嘅競爭好激烈㗎。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 娱乐圈的竞争非常激烈。
examples.english_sentence: The competition in the entertainment industry is very fierce.

english_meaning: entertainment venue, casino
explanation_mandarin: 提供娱乐活动的场所，通常指赌场。
explanation_english: A place that provides entertainment activities, typically referring to a casino.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都去娛樂場賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 heoi3 jyu4 lok6 coeng4 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常去娱乐场所赌钱。
examples.english_sentence: He often goes to the casino to gamble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 澳門有好多大型娛樂場。
examples.jyutping_sentence: Ou3 mun2 jau5 hou2 do1 daai6 hing1 jyu4 lok6 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 澳门有很多大型娱乐场所。

english_meaning: entertainment value, entertainment quality
explanation_mandarin: 指事物或活动的娱乐价值或娱乐质量。
explanation_english: Refers to the entertainment value or entertainment quality of something or an activity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲娛樂性好高，好啱放鬆心情睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 jyu4 lok6 sing3 hou2 gou1, hou2 ngaam1 fong3 sung1 sam1 ching4 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影娱乐性很高，很适合放松心情看。
examples.english_sentence: This movie has high entertainment value, it's perfect for relaxing and watching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲綜藝節目淨係得嚟搞笑，冇乜娛樂性嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 zung3 ngai6 zit3 muk6 zing6 hai6 dak1 lai4 gaau2 siu3, mou5 mat1 jyu4 lok6 sing3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些综艺节目只是为了搞笑，没什么娱乐性。
examples.english_sentence: Some variety shows are just for laughs, they don't have much entertainment value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然劇情唔係好嚴肅，但係勝在娛樂性十足。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 kek6 ching4 m4 hai6 hou2 jim4 suk1, daan6 hai6 sing3 zoi6 jyu4 lok6 sing3 sap6 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然剧情不是很严肃，但是胜在娱乐性十足。
examples.english_sentence: Although the plot isn't very serious, it's strong on entertainment value.

english_meaning: Entertainment section (of a newspaper)
explanation_mandarin: 报纸或杂志中专门报道娱乐新闻的部分。
explanation_english: The section of a newspaper or magazine dedicated to entertainment news, covering celebrities, movies, music, television, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都睇娛樂版，好鍾意睇明星啲八卦嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 tai2 jyu4 lok6 baan2, hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 ming4 sing1 di1 baat3 gwaa3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都看娱乐版，很喜欢看明星的八卦新闻。
examples.english_sentence: He reads the entertainment section every day, he really likes reading gossip about celebrities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報紙嘅娛樂版寫得幾生動，好多人鍾意睇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 zi2 ge3 jyu4 lok6 baan2 se2 dak1 gei2 sang1 dung6, hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 tai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报纸的娱乐版写得很生动，很多人喜欢看。
examples.english_sentence: The entertainment section of this newspaper is written quite vividly, many people like to read it.

english_meaning: Entertainment reporter, gossip columnist
explanation_mandarin: 指专门报道娱乐新闻的记者。 通常指香港娱乐记者，有时带贬义，指专门挖掘明星隐私、制造绯闻的记者。
explanation_english: Refers to reporters who specialize in entertainment news. Usually refers to Hong Kong entertainment reporters, sometimes with a derogatory connotation, referring to reporters who specialize in digging up celebrities' privacy and creating scandals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲娛記日日都想挖我啲緋聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jyu4 gei3 jat6 jat6 dou1 soeng2 waat3 ngo5 di1 fei1 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些娱乐记者每天都想挖我的绯闻。
examples.english_sentence: Those entertainment reporters want to dig up my scandals every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信曬啲娛記寫嘅嘢，好多都係誇大嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 saai3 di1 jyu4 gei3 se2 ge3 je5, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 kwaa1 daai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要全信那些娱乐记者写的东西，很多都是夸大的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't believe everything the entertainment reporters write, a lot of it is exaggerated.

english_meaning: to entertain guests, to amuse guests
explanation_mandarin: 使宾客感到快乐和满意。
explanation_english: To provide entertainment and amusement to guests, making them feel happy and satisfied.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搞呢個派對都係想娛賓啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaau2 ni1 go3 paai3 deoi2 dou1 hai6 soeng2 jyu4 ban1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们举办这个派对就是想娱乐宾客。
examples.english_sentence: We are throwing this party to entertain the guests.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得講笑話娛賓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 gong2 siu3 waa2 jyu4 ban1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会讲笑话来娱乐宾客。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at telling jokes to entertain the guests.

english_meaning: Entertainment headline; gossip news
explanation_mandarin: 指报纸、杂志或新闻节目中放在开头或显眼位置的娱乐新闻，通常是一些比较轻松、吸引眼球的花边新闻或八卦。
explanation_english: Refers to entertainment news that is placed at the beginning or in a prominent position in newspapers, magazines, or news programs, usually lighthearted and eye-catching gossip or scandalous news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅報紙頭版唔係乜嘢重要新聞，而係娛頭嚟㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 bou3 zi2 tau4 baan2 m4 hai6 mat1 je5 zung6 jiu3 san1 man4, ji4 hai6 jyu4 tau4 lai4 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的报纸头版不是什么重要新闻，而是娱乐头条而已。
examples.english_sentence: Today's front page of the newspaper isn't any important news, just an entertainment headline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都留意娛樂新聞，特別係啲娛頭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lau4 ji3 jyu4 lok6 san1 man4, dak6 bit1 hai6 di1 jyu4 tau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是关注娱乐新闻，特别是那些娱乐头条。
examples.english_sentence: He always pays attention to entertainment news, especially those entertainment headlines.

mandarin_meaning: 婀娜多姿 (ē nuó duō zī)
english_meaning: graceful and elegant (usually referring to a woman's posture or gait)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态柔美，轻盈飘逸。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's posture as graceful, elegant, and light.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢行路嘅姿態好娜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haang4 lou6 ge3 zi1 taai3 hou2 no4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她走路的姿态很婀娜。
examples.english_sentence: Her walking posture is very graceful.

english_meaning: beautiful, graceful, elegant
explanation_mandarin: 形容容貌或事物美好，秀丽。
explanation_english: Describes beauty, gracefulness, and elegance in appearance or things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個字寫得好娟秀啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zi6 se2 dak1 hou2 gyun1 sau3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的字写得很娟秀啊！
examples.english_sentence: Her handwriting is so elegant!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢幅畫畫得好娟麗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fuk1 waa2 waa2 dak1 hou2 gyun1 lai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这幅画画得很娟丽。
examples.english_sentence: This painting is painted beautifully.

english_meaning: pregnant
explanation_mandarin: 指妇女怀孕的状态。
explanation_english: Refers to the state of being pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有咗三個月，已經見到肚仔，佢嘅娠象好明顯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6, ji5 ging1 gin3 dou3 tou5 zai2, keoi5 ge3 san1 zoeng6 hou2 ming4 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她怀孕三个月了，已经看到肚子了，她的怀孕迹象很明显。
examples.english_sentence: She is three months pregnant and you can already see her belly. Her pregnancy symptoms are very obvious.

english_meaning: Chang'e (Chinese moon goddess); woman (often used as a nickname or term of endearment)
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指嫦娥，中国神话人物，住在月亮上。 2. 用作女性的昵称或爱称，带有亲切感。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to Chang'e, a Chinese mythological figure who lives on the moon. 2. Used as a nickname or term of endearment for women, conveying affection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇下個個月亮咁圓，真係好似娥姐住喺上面咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 haa5 go3 go3 jyut6 loeng6 gam3 jyun4, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 ngo4 ze1 zyu6 hai2 soeng6 min6 gam3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看那个月亮那么圆，真的好像嫦娥住在上面一样。
examples.english_sentence: Look at how round the moon is, it really looks like Chang'e lives up there.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 娥姐，你今日好靚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo4 ze1, nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小娥，你今天很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: Dear Xiao'e, you look beautiful today!

english_meaning: to give birth; to deliver (a baby)
explanation_mandarin: 指妇女生产，生孩子。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman giving birth; to deliver a child.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱喺醫院娩咗個女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 hai2 ji1 jyun2 min5 zo2 go3 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她刚刚在医院分娩了一个女儿。
examples.english_sentence: She just gave birth to a daughter in the hospital.

english_meaning: to marry (a woman); to take a wife
explanation_mandarin: 男人和女人结婚。
explanation_english: For a man to marry a woman; to take a wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下年娶老婆啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 nin4 ceoi2 lou5 po4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明年要娶老婆了。
examples.english_sentence: He's getting married next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥就嚟娶新抱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 go1 zau6 lai4 ceoi2 san1 pou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥就要娶媳妇了。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother is going to take a wife (marry his son's wife).

english_meaning: When marrying a wife, one should seek a virtuous woman.
explanation_mandarin: 指娶妻应当选择品德贤淑的女子，重视女性的内在美和品格。
explanation_english: This idiom emphasizes the importance of a woman's virtue and character when choosing a wife. It suggests that inner beauty and virtuous qualities are more important than outward appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古時嘅人成日話「娶妻求淑女」，都係想娶個好老婆啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 si4 ge3 jan4 seng4 jat6 waa6 "ceoi2 cai1 kau4 suk6 neoi5", dou1 hai6 soeng2 ceoi2 go3 hou2 lou5 po2 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古时候的人经常说“娶妻求淑女”，都只是想娶个好老婆罢了。
examples.english_sentence: People in ancient times often said "When marrying a wife, one should seek a virtuous woman", they just wanted to marry a good wife.

english_meaning: When marrying, one should seek a virtuous and gentle woman.
explanation_mandarin: 指娶妻子应该选择品德贤淑，温柔贤惠的女子。
explanation_english: This proverb emphasizes the importance of marrying a woman who is virtuous, gentle, and possesses good moral character. It highlights the traditional value placed on a wife's character and her role in maintaining a harmonious household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗱，古時就話「娶妻求淑婦」，而家都係差唔多，最緊要心地好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: laa4, gu2 si4 zau6 waa6 "ceoi2 cai1 kau4 suk6 fu5", ji4 gaa1 dou1 hai6 caa1 m4 do1, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 sam1 dei6 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看，古时候就说“娶妻求淑妇”，现在也差不多，最重要的是心地好。
examples.english_sentence: See, in ancient times they said, "When marrying, one should seek a virtuous woman," and it's still pretty much the same now. The most important thing is that she has a good heart.

english_meaning: to take a daughter-in-law (to marry a son's wife)
explanation_mandarin: 指儿子结婚，迎娶妻子。表达了家庭迎来新成员的意思。
explanation_english: To marry a son's wife, referring to the act of welcoming a daughter-in-law into the family through the son's marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年終於可以娶心抱啦，好開心啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 sam1 pou5 laa1, hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年终于可以娶媳妇了，好开心啊！
examples.english_sentence: We can finally take a daughter-in-law this year, we're so happy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日都話想快啲娶心抱，抱孫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 sing4 jat6 dou1 waa6 soeng2 faai3 di1 ceoi2 sam1 pou5, pou5 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶总是说想快点娶媳妇，抱孙子。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma always says she wants to take a daughter-in-law and have grandsons as soon as possible.

english_meaning: to take a daughter-in-law; for a son to get married (from the perspective of the parents)
explanation_mandarin: 指儿子结婚，父母迎娶儿媳妇。
explanation_english: Refers to a son getting married, specifically from the perspective of the parents gaining a daughter-in-law. It's about the parents' perspective of welcoming a new member into the family through their son's marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日阿仔娶新抱，我哋好開心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 aa3 zai2 ceoi2 san1 pou5, ngo5 dei6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天儿子娶媳妇，我们很高兴呀！
examples.english_sentence: Our son is getting married tomorrow, we are so happy!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企今年雙喜臨門，仔仔娶新抱，個女又嫁人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 gam1 nin4 soeng1 hei2 lam4 mun4, zai2 zai2 ceoi2 san1 pou5, go3 neoi2 jau6 gaa3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家今年双喜临门，儿子娶媳妇，女儿又出嫁。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has double happiness this year, their son is getting married and their daughter is also marrying.

english_meaning: to marry a wife, to take a wife
explanation_mandarin: 男子结婚，把女子娶回家作为妻子。
explanation_english: For a man to get married; to take a woman as his wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今年終於娶老婆喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 nin4 zung1 jyu1 ceoi2 lou5 po2 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今年终于娶妻了。
examples.english_sentence: He's finally getting married this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿哥話想快啲娶老婆，生個BB。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥说想快点娶妻，生个孩子。
examples.english_sentence: My older brother said he wants to get married and have a baby soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲樓咁貴，唔知幾時先可以娶老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 lau2 gam3 gwai3, m4 zi1 gei2 si4 sin1 ho2 ji5 ceoi2 lou5 po2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的房子这么贵，不知道什么时候才能娶妻。
examples.english_sentence: Houses are so expensive nowadays, I don't know when I'll be able to get married.

english_meaning: prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指以卖淫为生的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who engages in sexual activity for payment; a prostitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前做過娼，而家已經從良。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zou6 gwo3 coeng1, ji4 gaa1 ji5 ging1 cung4 loeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她以前做过妓女，现在已经从良了。
examples.english_sentence: She used to be a prostitute, but she has now turned over a new leaf.

english_meaning: prostitute
explanation_mandarin: 指以卖淫为生的女性。
explanation_english: A woman who engages in sexual activity for payment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅社會，好多女人為咗生存，被迫去做娼妓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 se5 wui2, hou2 do1 neoi5 jan2 wai6 zo2 sang1 cyun4, bei2 bik1 heoi3 zou6 coeng1 gei6.

examples.english_sentence: In the old society, many women were forced to become prostitutes in order to survive.

english_meaning: An interjection, often used at the end of a sentence or in response, expressing acknowledgement, agreement, or confirmation. Can also imply reluctance or hesitation depending on the tone.
explanation_mandarin: 语气词，常放在句尾，表示应答、同意、确认等语气。也可能根据语气带有迟疑或不情愿的意味。
explanation_english: An interjection commonly placed at the end of a sentence. It signifies agreement, acknowledgement, or confirmation. Depending on the tone, it can also convey reluctance or hesitation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你講嘅嘢我都明㗎，娿。

examples.english_sentence: Yeah, I don't even know what to do.

english_meaning: long-winded, verbose, naggy
explanation_mandarin: 形容人說話很長，很繁瑣，讓人覺得很煩。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is long-winded, verbose, and naggy, often causing annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁娿哿啦，我都知點做嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 o1 go4 laa1, ngo5 dou1 zi1 dim2 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么囉唆了，我都知道怎么做的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so long-winded, I already know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆成日喺度娿哿，講埋晒啲陳年舊事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 o1 go4, gong2 maai4 saai3 di1 can4 nin4 gau6 si6.

english_meaning: graceful, charming, lithe (describing a woman's figure or manner)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态柔美轻盈。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's figure or manner as graceful, charming, and lithe.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條裙好襯佢婀娜嘅身段。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 hou2 can3 keoi5 o1 no4 ge3 san1 dyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子很衬她婀娜的身材。
examples.english_sentence: This dress really complements her graceful figure.

mandarin_meaning: 婀娜多姿 (ē nuó duō zī)
english_meaning: graceful and charming; lithe and beautiful
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态柔美，体态轻盈。也常用来形容花草树木的形态优美。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's graceful and charming demeanor, often referring to her lithe and beautiful figure. It can also be used to describe the graceful appearance of plants and trees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢跳舞嘅時候婀娜多姿，好吸引人㗎。

english_meaning: to accompany, to coax, to humour (especially a child)

explanation_english: To accompany, humour, or coax, especially to soothe a child.
