examples.mandarin_sentence: 他最近总是出去追求女生，不知道追到了没有。
examples.english_sentence: He's been going out to chase girls a lot recently, I wonder if he's succeeded yet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係顧住打機啦，得閒出去媾下女啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 gu3 zyu6 daa2 gei1 laa1, dak1 haan4 ceot1 heoi3 gau3 haa5 neoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只顾着玩游戏了，有空出去追一下女生吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just focus on playing games, go out and chase some girls when you have time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢媾女好叻㗎，成日都換畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gau3 neoi5 hou2 lek1 gaa3, sing4 jat6 dou1 wun6 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他追女生很厉害的，经常换女朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He's very good at picking up girls, he's always changing girlfriends.

english_meaning: To pursue/woo/flirt with a queen (referring to a confident, attractive, and popular woman)
explanation_mandarin: “媾”的意思是追求、勾搭。“女王”指那些自信、有魅力、受欢迎的女性。整个短语指追求或试图勾搭一位很有魅力的女性。
explanation_english: "媾 (gau3)" means to pursue, to flirt with, or to hit on. "女王 (neoi5 wong4)" refers to a queen, which in this context describes a confident, attractive, and popular woman. The whole phrase means to pursue or try to woo a very attractive woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁靚女，好多人想媾女王㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 leng3 neoi5, hou2 do1 jan4 soeng2 gau3 neoi5 wong4 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她那么漂亮，很多人想追她这个女王啊。
examples.english_sentence: She's so pretty, many people want to woo this queen.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好諗住淨係送禮物就媾到女王啦，要真心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nim2 zyu6 zing6 hai6 sung3 lai5 mat6 zau6 gau3 dou3 neoi5 wong4 laa1, jiu3 zan1 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别想着只是送礼物就能追到女王，要真心啊。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can woo the queen just by giving gifts, you need to be sincere.

english_meaning: to marry (of a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指女子结婚，出嫁。
explanation_english: To marry (used specifically for women)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下年就嫁喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 nin4 zau6 gaa3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明年就要嫁了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm getting married next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫁咗個有錢佬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 zo2 go3 jau5 cin2 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她嫁了个有钱人。
examples.english_sentence: She married a rich guy.

english_meaning: to marry (said of a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 指女子结婚，成为别人的妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to a woman getting married and becoming someone's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢終於都嫁人喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dou1 gaa3 jan4 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她终于要嫁人了。
examples.english_sentence: She is finally getting married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽成日催我嫁人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 ceoi1 ngo5 gaa3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈总是催我嫁人。
examples.english_sentence: My mother always urges me to get married.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢唔想咁早嫁人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 m4 soeng2 gam3 zou2 gaa3 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她不想这么早嫁人。
examples.english_sentence: She said she doesn't want to get married so early.

english_meaning: to marry off a daughter
explanation_mandarin: 指女儿结婚，父母送女儿出嫁。
explanation_english: Refers to a daughter getting married and the parents sending her off in marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋下個月嫁女，屋企好忙呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 haa6 go3 jyut6 gaa3 neoi5, uk1 kei2 hou2 mong4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们下个月嫁女儿，家里很忙啊。
examples.english_sentence: They are marrying off their daughter next month, the house is very busy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆話最開心嘅事就係睇住個女嫁女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 waa6 zeoi3 hoi1 sam1 ge3 si6 zau6 hai6 tai2 zyu6 go3 neoi2 gaa3 neoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶说最高兴的事情就是看着女儿出嫁。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma said the happiest thing is to see her daughter get married.

english_meaning: dowry
explanation_mandarin: 指女子出嫁时带到夫家的财物，包括金银首饰、衣服、家具等。
explanation_english: The property or money that a bride brings to her husband in marriage; dowry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企好有錢，個女嘅嫁妝一定好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 hou2 jau5 cin2, go3 neoi5 ge3 gaa3 zong1 jat1 ding6 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家很有钱，女儿的嫁妆一定很多。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very rich, the daughter's dowry must be a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅嫁妝通常會有龍鳳鈪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 gaa3 zong1 tong1 soeng4 wui5 jau5 lung4 fung6 ngaak2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的嫁妆通常会有龙凤镯。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, dowries usually included dragon and phoenix bangles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人結婚，嫁妝都簡單咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 git3 fan1, gaa3 zong1 dou1 gaan2 daan1 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人结婚，嫁妆都简单了很多。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, people's dowries are much simpler when they get married.

english_meaning: marriage; wedding
explanation_mandarin: 指男子娶妻，女子出嫁，泛指结婚。
explanation_english: Refers to a man marrying a wife and a woman getting married; generally refers to marriage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋今年年底會辦嫁娶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam1 nin4 nin4 dai2 wui5 baan6 gaa3 ceoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们今年年底会举办婚礼。
examples.english_sentence: They will hold their wedding at the end of this year.

english_meaning: grafting (horticulture); to graft; to transfer; to apply (a method or technique from one field to another)
explanation_mandarin: 本意指园艺中把一种植物的枝或芽接到另一种植物的茎或根上，使两者结合在一起生长。也比喻把一种方法、技术等应用到另一种事物上。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the horticultural practice of joining a part of one plant (such as a bud or branch) to another to grow as one. It is also used metaphorically to mean applying a method, technique, or idea from one area to another.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個技術可以嫁接到其他行業上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gei6 seot6 ho2 ji5 gaa3 zip3 dou3 kei4 taa1 hang4 jip6 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这项技术可以嫁接到其他行业上。
examples.english_sentence: This technology can be applied to other industries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘗試將人工智能嫁接到醫療系統入面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng4 si3 zoeng1 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 gaa3 zip3 dou3 ji1 liu4 hai6 tung2 jap6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们尝试将人工智能嫁接到医疗系统里。
examples.english_sentence: They are trying to incorporate artificial intelligence into the healthcare system.

english_meaning: to shift the blame onto someone else, to frame someone, to pass the buck
explanation_mandarin: 把罪过或灾祸转嫁给别人，使别人受害。通常指故意陷害。
explanation_english: To shift blame or misfortune onto someone else, often with malicious intent to frame or incriminate them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明明自己做錯嘢，但係就想嫁禍俾其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 zi6 gei2 zou6 co3 je5, daan6 hai6 zau6 soeng2 gaa3 wo6 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他明明是自己做错了，但是就想嫁祸给其他人。
examples.english_sentence: He clearly made a mistake himself, but he wants to shift the blame to others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁容易信人哋，小心俾人嫁禍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 jung4 ji6 seon3 jan4 dei6, siu2 sam1 bei2 jan4 gaa3 wo6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么容易相信别人，小心被人嫁祸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust people so easily, be careful of being framed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋想嫁禍俾我，等我孭鑊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 soeng2 gaa3 wo6 bei2 ngo5, dang2 ngo5 be1 wok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们想嫁祸给我，让我背黑锅。
examples.english_sentence: They want to frame me and make me take the blame.

english_meaning: wedding dress; bridal gown
explanation_mandarin: 结婚时穿的礼服。比喻为他人辛苦劳动却为别人做了嫁衣。
explanation_english: Wedding dress. Figuratively, to work hard for someone else's benefit; to do something only for someone else to profit from it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋咁努力，結果都係幫人哋著嫁衣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gam3 nou5 lik6, git3 gwo2 dou1 hai6 bong1 yan4 dei6 zoek3 gaa3 ji1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们这么努力，结果还是为别人做了嫁衣。
examples.english_sentence: They worked so hard, but in the end, they just paved the way for someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰件嫁衣真係好靚呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gin6 gaa3 ji1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那件嫁衣真漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: That wedding dress is really beautiful!

english_meaning: When a woman marries a chicken, she follows the chicken; a woman should follow her husband's lead.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻女子出嫁后，无论丈夫好坏，都要顺从丈夫。
explanation_english: This idiom means that after a woman marries, she should follow her husband's lead, regardless of his character or circumstances. It implies that a woman should adapt to her husband's life and support him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 就算佢老公咁衰，佢都認命，嫁雞隨雞啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau6 syun3 keoi5 lou5 gung1 gam3 seoi1, keoi5 dou1 jing6 ming6, gaa3 gai1 ceoi4 gai1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 就算她丈夫这么坏，她也认命了，嫁鸡随鸡。
examples.english_sentence: Even though her husband is so bad, she accepts her fate; she follows her husband's lead.

english_meaning: A woman should follow her husband wherever he goes (like a hen following a rooster).
explanation_mandarin: 旧时比喻女子出嫁后，不论丈夫好坏都要一生相随。
explanation_english: An idiom expressing the traditional view that a woman, once married, should follow her husband's lead and stay with him, no matter his character or circumstances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢老公賭錢，但係佢都嫁鷄隨鷄，唔肯離婚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 lou5 gung1 dou2 cin2, daan6 hai6 keoi5 dou1 gaa3 gai1 ceoi4 gai1, m4 hang2 lei4 fan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然她老公赌钱，但是她还是嫁鸡随鸡，不肯离婚。
examples.english_sentence: Although her husband gambles, she still believes in 'following the hen' and refuses to divorce.

english_meaning: elder brother's wife
explanation_mandarin: 称呼兄长的妻子。
explanation_english: A term of address for one's elder brother's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嫂嫂好識煮嘢食㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sou2 sou2 hou2 sik1 zyu2 je5 sik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我嫂子很会做饭。
examples.english_sentence: My sister-in-law is a good cook.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿哥同嫂嫂琴日去咗旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 go1 tung4 sou2 sou2 kam4 jat6 heoi3 zo2 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哥哥和嫂子昨天去旅行了。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother and sister-in-law went on a trip yesterday.

english_meaning: Elder brother's wife, sister-in-law (older brother's wife)
explanation_mandarin: 称呼哥哥的妻子。
explanation_english: A term of address for one's elder brother's wife.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嫂子，你煮嘅嘢食好好味呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: sou2 zi2, nei5 zyu2 ge3 je5 sik6 hou2 hou2 mei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫂子，你做的饭菜很好吃啊！
examples.english_sentence: Sister-in-law, the food you cooked is very delicious!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哥哥同嫂子聽日返嚟探我哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go1 go1 tung4 sou2 zi2 ting1 jat6 faan1 lai4 taam3 ngo5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我哥哥和嫂子明天回来探望我们。
examples.english_sentence: My elder brother and sister-in-law are coming back to visit us tomorrow.

english_meaning: jealous; envious
explanation_mandarin: 因为别人比自己好而心怀怨恨或不满。
explanation_english: To feel resentment or discontent towards someone because they have something that you want or that you think you deserve.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁叻，梗係有人嫉佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 lek1, gang2 hai6 jau5 jan4 dzit1 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么厉害，肯定有人嫉妒他。
examples.english_sentence: He's so talented, of course, some people are jealous of him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嫉人哋有錢，自己努力啲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 dzit1 jan4 dei6 jau5 cin2, zi6 gei2 nu5 lik6 di1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嫉妒别人有钱，自己努力一点吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be jealous of others for being rich, work harder yourself.

english_meaning: jealous, envy
explanation_mandarin: 因别人比自己好而心怀怨恨 (yīn biérén bǐ zìjǐ hǎo ér xīnhuái yuànhèn)
explanation_english: To feel resentful and envious of someone else's success or advantages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢見到人哋升職，就好嫉妒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 dei6 sing1 zik1, zau6 hou2 zat6 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他看到别人升职，就很嫉妒。
examples.english_sentence: He feels very jealous when he sees others get promoted.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嫉妒人哋嘅成功，努力啲做好自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zat6 dou3 jan4 dei6 ge3 sing4 gung1, nu5 lik6 di1 zou6 hou2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嫉妒别人的成功，努力做好自己。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be jealous of other people's success, work hard and do your best.

english_meaning: to hate evil as if it were one's personal enemy; to detest evil as one would an enemy
explanation_mandarin: 憎恨邪恶就像憎恨仇人一样。形容非常憎恨坏人坏事。
explanation_english: To hate evil with the same intensity as one would hate a personal enemy. It describes a strong aversion and hatred towards evil people and deeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅性格嫉惡如仇，絕對唔會對啲壞事坐視不理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing3 gaak3 jik6 ok3 jyu4 cau4, zyut6 deoi3 m4 wui5 deoi3 di1 waai6 si6 zo6 si6 bat1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的性格疾恶如仇，绝对不会对坏事坐视不理。
examples.english_sentence: His personality is such that he hates evil as if it were his personal enemy, and he would never turn a blind eye to bad deeds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貪官污吏，真係令人嫉惡如仇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 taam1 gun1 wu1 lei2, zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 jik6 ok3 jyu4 cau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些贪官污吏，真是令人疾恶如仇。
examples.english_sentence: These corrupt officials truly make people hate evil as if it were their enemy.

english_meaning: graceful; slender and delicate; charming (usually referring to a woman)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态柔美，体态轻盈。 也可用于形容某些植物细长柔弱。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's graceful and delicate appearance, often slender and charming. Can also describe plants that are slender and fragile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得好嫋娜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 saang1 dak1 hou2 niu5 no5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的样子长得很娇媚。
examples.english_sentence: She has a very graceful appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棵柳樹好嫋呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 ko1 lau5 syu6 hou2 niu5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这棵柳树很婀娜。
examples.english_sentence: This willow tree is very graceful.

synonyms: 婀娜多姿 (o1 no4 do1 zi1)

english_meaning: Amazing; awesome; impressive; very capable
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人或某事非常出色、优秀，令人印象深刻。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something as being very outstanding, excellent, and impressive. Often used to express admiration or approval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試考到全級第一，真係嫋bang bang 㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 haau2 dou3 cyun4 gap1 dai6 jat1, zan1 hai6 niu1 bang1 bang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试考了全年级第一名，真是太厉害了！
examples.english_sentence: He came first in the whole grade in the exam, he's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅點心做得好正，真係嫋bang bang 㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 dim2 sam1 zou6 dak1 hou2 zeng3, zan1 hai6 niu1 bang1 bang1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的点心做得很好，真是了不起！
examples.english_sentence: The dim sum in this restaurant is really well-made, it's really awesome!

english_meaning: slender, slim and delicate
explanation_mandarin: 形容身材非常纤细苗条，带有一种弱不禁风的感觉。
explanation_english: Describes a figure that is very slender and slim, often with a delicate or fragile appearance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個身形嫋嫋瘦瘦，望落好似好弱咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 san1 ying4 niu5 niu5 sau3 sau3, mong6 lok6 hou2 ci5 hou2 joek6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的身材纤细苗条，看起来好像很虚弱的样子。
examples.english_sentence: Her figure is slender and slim, she looks quite fragile.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然嫋嫋瘦瘦，但係好有活力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 niu5 niu5 sau3 sau3, daan6 hai6 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她虽然纤细苗条，但是很有活力。
examples.english_sentence: Although she's slender and slim, she is very energetic.

english_meaning: slim and graceful; slender
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子身材纤细苗条，姿态优美。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is slim, slender, and graceful in figure and posture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條裙好襯佢嫋瘦嘅身材。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 hou2 can3 keoi5 niu1 sau3 ge3 san1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条裙子很衬她纤细苗条的身材。
examples.english_sentence: That dress really complements her slim and graceful figure.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢雖然生完仔，但係都Keep住好嫋瘦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seoi1 jin4 sang1 jyun4 zai2, daan6 hai6 dou1 Keep1 zyu6 hou2 niu1 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她虽然生完孩子，但是仍然保持得很纤细苗条。
examples.english_sentence: Even though she's given birth, she's still kept herself slim and graceful.

english_meaning: to show off; to flaunt; to put on airs; to be snobbish
explanation_mandarin: 指炫耀、摆谱，表现出自己优越于他人，常带贬义。
explanation_english: To show off, to flaunt one's wealth, status, or abilities, often in a negative or arrogant way. It implies an attitude of superiority.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發咗達之後就成日喺人面前嫋高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6 zau6 seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 niu1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发财以后就总是在人面前炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: After he got rich, he always shows off in front of people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嫋高啦，謙虛啲好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 niu1 gou1 laa1, him1 heoi1 di1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么炫耀了，谦虚一点好。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so showy, it's better to be humble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好低調，從來都唔會喺人哋面前嫋高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 dai1 diu6, cung4 loi4 dou1 m4 wui5 hai2 jan4 dei6 min6 cin4 niu1 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他为人很低调，从来都不会在别人面前炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very low-key person and never shows off in front of others.

english_meaning: to dislike; to complain of; to find fault with; to嫌弃; to mind
explanation_mandarin: 对事物或人感到不满意，从而产生厌恶或抱怨的情绪。
explanation_english: To dislike or complain about something or someone; to find fault with.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好嫌啲嘢唔夠好啦，有得食就食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 him4 di1 je5 m4 gau3 hou2 laa1, jau5 dak1 sik6 zau6 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要嫌弃东西不够好，有的吃就吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't complain that the food isn't good enough, just eat what's available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫌份工人工太低。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him4 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 taai3 dai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嫌这份工作工资太低。
examples.english_sentence: He complains that the salary for this job is too low.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫌我煮飯唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him4 ngo5 zyu2 faan6 m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他嫌我煮的饭不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: He complains that my cooking is not delicious.

english_meaning: to be picky; to be fussy; to find fault with everything
explanation_mandarin: 形容人非常挑剔，对什么都不满意。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very picky and dissatisfied with everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嫌三嫌四啦，有得食咪食囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 him4 saam1 him4 sei3 laa1, jau5 dak1 sik6 mai1 sik6 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么挑三拣四了，有的吃就吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, if there's food, just eat it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好嫌三嫌四，好難服侍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 him4 saam1 him4 sei3, hou2 naan4 fuk6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很挑剔，很难伺候。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very picky person, difficult to please.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嫌三嫌四，呢件已經係最靚㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 him4 saam1 him4 sei3, ni1 gin6 ji5 ging1 hai6 zeoi3 leng3 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要挑三拣四了，这件已经是最好看的了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so picky, this one is already the prettiest.

english_meaning: Courting death, looking for trouble, having a death wish, tired of living
explanation_mandarin: 表示某人做的事情非常危险或愚蠢，好像嫌自己的命太长了，巴不得早点死。
explanation_english: Indicates that someone is doing something very dangerous or foolish, as if they think their life is too long and they want to die sooner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你係咪嫌命長呀？咁樣過馬路！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hai6 mai1 him4 ming6 coeng4 aa3? gam2 joeng2 gwo3 maa5 lou6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你是不是活腻了？这样过马路！
examples.english_sentence: Are you courting death? Crossing the road like that!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲唔走？嫌命長啊？啲警察嚟緊喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 m4 zau2? him4 ming6 coeng4 aa3? di1 ging2 caat3 lai4 gan2 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还不走？想找死啊？警察快来了！
examples.english_sentence: Aren't you leaving? Do you have a death wish? The police are coming!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢啦，佢好打得㗎，你嫌命長咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 re2 keoi5 laa1, keoi5 hou2 daa2 dak1 gaa3, nei5 him4 ming6 coeng4 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他了，他很能打的，你是不是不想活了？
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess with him, he's a good fighter. Do you have a death wish?

english_meaning: to dislike and reject; to disdain; to scorn
explanation_mandarin: 不喜欢并拒绝；看不起。
explanation_english: To dislike and reject someone or something; to feel contempt or disdain for.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嫌棄我窮，所以同我分手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 him4 hei2 ngo5 kung4, so2 ji5 tung4 ngo5 fan1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她嫌弃我穷，所以和我分手了。
examples.english_sentence: She dumped me because she disliked that I was poor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嫌棄啲嘢唔靚，最緊要係好用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 him4 hei2 di1 je5 m4 leng3, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 hou2 yung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嫌弃东西不好看，最重要的是好用。
examples.english_sentence: Don't dislike things for not being beautiful; the most important thing is that they are useful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁好條件，唔會有人嫌棄你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 hou2 tiu4 gin2, m4 wui5 jau5 jan4 him4 hei2 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你条件这么好，不会有人嫌弃你的。
examples.english_sentence: You're so eligible, no one would dislike you.

english_meaning: suspicion; suspect
explanation_mandarin: 指受到怀疑的可能性或状态。 也指被怀疑的对象。
explanation_english: Suspicion; the state of being suspected of something; or the object of suspicion (the suspect).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家重有好大嫌疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zung6 jau5 hou2 daai6 him4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在还有很大的嫌疑。
examples.english_sentence: He is still under strong suspicion now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 差人捉咗個有嫌疑嘅人返差館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: caa1 jan2 zuk1 zo2 go3 jau5 him4 ji4 ge3 jan4 faan1 caai1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警察抓了一个有嫌疑的人回警局。
examples.english_sentence: The police arrested a suspect and took him back to the police station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 洗清嫌疑
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai2 cing1 him4 ji4
examples.mandarin_sentence: 洗清嫌疑
examples.english_sentence: to clear suspicion

english_meaning: To be too good to take money, or to pretend to be above being motivated by money.
explanation_mandarin: 表面上不爱钱，装作清高，实际上内心可能非常渴望金钱。 形容人虚伪，假装不在乎金钱。
explanation_english: Literally, "dislike the smell of money". This idiom describes someone who pretends to be above being motivated by money or doesn't want to touch money, often implying hypocrisy because they are secretly very interested in it. It's used to describe someone who acts as though they are too refined or virtuous to care about money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都話嫌錢腥，但係轉頭又走去炒股票，真係口不對心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 waa6 him4 cin2 seng1, daan6 hai6 zyun2 tau4 jau6 zau2 heoi3 caau2 gu2 piu3, zan1 hai6 hau2 bat1 deoi3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说嫌钱脏，但是转头又去炒股票，真是口是心非。
examples.english_sentence: He always says he's above money, but then he goes and speculates on the stock market. He's such a hypocrite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講啦，唔通真係嫌錢腥咩？邊個唔想搵多啲錢啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 laa1, m4 tung1 zan1 hai6 him4 cin2 seng1 me1? bin1 go3 m4 soeng2 wan2 do1 di1 cin2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么说，难道真的嫌钱脏吗？谁不想多赚点钱啊？
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that, does anyone really think money is dirty? Who wouldn't want to earn more money?

english_meaning: to visit prostitutes; to solicit prostitutes
explanation_mandarin: 指男子花钱与妓女发生性关系的行为。
explanation_english: Refers to the act of a man paying money to have sexual relations with a prostitute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人捉到去嫖妓，真係醜死人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 zuk1 dou2 heoi3 piu4 gei6, zan1 hai6 cau2 sei2 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人抓到去嫖娼，真是丢死人了。
examples.english_sentence: He was caught visiting prostitutes, it's really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪以為有錢就可以去嫖。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 ji5 wai4 jau5 cin2 zau6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 piu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为有钱就可以去嫖娼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think you can just visit prostitutes because you have money.

english_meaning: to patronize prostitutes, to visit prostitutes, whoring
explanation_mandarin: 指男性通过支付金钱来与性工作者发生性关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a man paying money to engage in sexual relations with a sex worker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人發現咗去嫖妓，真係好失禮。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 faat3 hin1 zo2 heoi3 piu4 gei6, zan1 hai6 hou2 sat1 lai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被人发现去嫖娼了，真是很丢脸。
examples.english_sentence: He was discovered patronizing prostitutes, it's really embarrassing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲人咁開放，仲有冇人會覺得嫖妓係一件大件事？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 jan4 gam3 hoi1 fong3, zung6 jau5 mou5 jan4 wui5 gok3 dak1 piu4 gei6 hai6 jat1 gin6 daai6 gin2 si6?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的人这么开放，还有没有人会觉得嫖娼是一件大事？
examples.english_sentence: Now that people are so open-minded, does anyone still think visiting prostitutes is a big deal?

english_meaning: to solicit prostitutes; to engage in prostitution
explanation_mandarin: 指男子通过金钱交易与妓女发生性关系。
explanation_english: Refers to a man engaging in sexual relations with a prostitute in exchange for money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港以前有好多人上去大陸嫖娼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ji5 cin4 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4 seung5 heoi3 daai6 luk6 piu4 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前有很多香港人去大陆嫖娼。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, many Hong Kong people went to mainland China to solicit prostitutes.

english_meaning: customer of a prostitute, patron of a sex worker
explanation_mandarin: 指光顾妓女的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who patronizes a prostitute or sex worker.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店成日都有好多嫖客出入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 seng4 jat6 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 piu4 haak3 ceot1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店经常有很多嫖客出入。
examples.english_sentence: This hotel always has a lot of customers of prostitutes coming and going.

english_meaning: Visiting prostitutes, gambling, drinking alcohol, and bragging/boasting.
explanation_mandarin: 指沉迷于不良嗜好，生活腐化堕落。嫖娼，赌博，酗酒，吹牛是旧社会一些人堕落的表现。
explanation_english: Refers to being addicted to vices and leading a decadent and corrupt lifestyle. Visiting prostitutes, gambling, excessive drinking, and bragging were considered signs of moral decay in old society. It generally describes a dissipated lifestyle characterized by these four vices.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從發咗達之後，就日日嫖賭飲吹，好快就會洗晒啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6, zau6 jat6 jat6 piu4 dou2 jam2 cheui1, hou2 faai3 zau6 wui5 sai2晒啲錢。
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自从发财之后，就天天嫖娼赌博喝酒吹牛，很快就会把钱都花光。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he got rich, he's been visiting prostitutes, gambling, drinking and bragging every day, and he'll soon spend all his money.

english_meaning: Visiting prostitutes, gambling, drinking, squandering money, boasting
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人生活放荡，沉迷于声色犬马，挥霍无度。
explanation_english: Describes a dissolute lifestyle involving visiting prostitutes, gambling, excessive drinking, squandering money, and boasting about achievements or experiences.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自從發咗達之後，就日日都喺度嫖賭飲蕩吹，搞到家破人亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 cung4 faat3 zo2 daat6 zi1 hau6, zau6 jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 dou6 piu4 dou2 jam2 dong6 ceoi1, gaau2 dou3 gaa1 po3 jan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他自从发财之后，就天天都在吃喝嫖赌，搞得家破人亡。
examples.english_sentence: Ever since he got rich, he's been indulging in visiting prostitutes, gambling, and excessive drinking every day, leading to his family's ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日諗住嫖賭飲蕩吹，做返啲正經嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 nam2 zyu6 piu4 dou2 jam2 dong6 ceoi1, zou6 faan1 di1 zing3 ging1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是想着吃喝嫖赌，做回一些正经事吧。
examples.english_sentence: Stop thinking about visiting prostitutes, gambling, and excessive drinking all the time, and start doing something worthwhile.

english_meaning: old woman, crone
explanation_mandarin: 指年老的妇人。
explanation_english: Refers to an old woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 村口企咗個嫗，好似睇緊啲乜嘢噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun1 hau2 kei5 zo2 go3 jyu2, hou2 ci5 tai2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 村口站着一个老妇人，好像在看什么东西似的。
examples.english_sentence: An old woman was standing at the village entrance, seemingly watching something.

english_meaning: of direct descent (from the first wife); legitimate; principal; direct line
explanation_mandarin: 指正妻所生的，或指嫡系。
explanation_english: Refers to being born of the principal wife, or belonging to the direct line of descent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係嫡子，所以有權繼承家業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 dik1 zi2, so2 ji5 jau5 kuyen4 gai3 sing4 gaa1 yip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是嫡子，所以有权继承家业。
examples.english_sentence: He is the legitimate son, so he has the right to inherit the family business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅產品都係嫡系生產嘅，品質有保證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 caan2 ban2 dou1 hai6 dik1 hai6 sang1 caan2 ge3, ban2 zat1 jau5 bou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的产品都是嫡系生产的，质量有保证。
examples.english_sentence: This company's products are all produced by the direct line, and the quality is guaranteed.

english_meaning: legitimate son; son of the principal wife
explanation_mandarin: 旧时指正妻所生的儿子，有继承权。
explanation_english: In traditional Chinese society, refers to the son born to the principal wife (as opposed to concubines). The legitimate son typically had inheritance rights and a higher social standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係大老爺嘅嫡子，將來一定繼承家業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 daai6 lou5 je4 ge3 dik1 zi2, zoeng1 loi4 jat1 ding6 gai3 sing4 gaa1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是老爷的嫡子，将来一定会继承家业。
examples.english_sentence: He is the master's legitimate son and will definitely inherit the family business in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺舊時，嫡子嘅地位比庶子高好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gau6 si4, dik1 zi2 ge3 dei6 wai2 bei2 syu3 zi2 gou1 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在古代，嫡子的地位比庶子高很多。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, the status of a legitimate son was much higher than that of a son born to a concubine.

english_meaning: direct line, direct descendant, directly affiliated, core (group)
explanation_mandarin: 指直接的系统、派系或后代，多用于政治、商业等领域，表示核心成员或直接继承者。
explanation_english: Refers to a direct line, faction, or descendant, often used in political or business contexts to indicate core members or direct successors. It can also mean directly affiliated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係老細嘅嫡系，升職梗係快過人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lou5 sai3 ge3 dik1 hai6, sing1 zik1 gang2 hai6 faai3 gwo3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是老板的嫡系，升职肯定比别人快。
examples.english_sentence: He's the boss's directly affiliated person, so he'll definitely get promoted faster than others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅嫡系人馬都係跟佢一齊創業嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 dik1 hai6 jan4 maa5 dou1 hai6 gan1 keoi5 jat1 cai4 cong3 jip6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的核心成员都是跟他一起创业的。
examples.english_sentence: The core members of this company are all those who started the business with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋幾個喺政治上都算係同一派嘅嫡系。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gei2 go3 hai2 zing3 zi6 soeng6 dou1 syun3 hai6 tung4 jat1 paai3 ge3 dik1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在政治上都算是同一派的嫡系。
examples.english_sentence: Politically, those few are considered the core members of the same faction.

english_meaning: beautiful; charming
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子容貌美好，也用于形容花朵鲜艳美丽。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's appearance as beautiful and charming. Also used to describe flowers as bright and beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得好明豔照人，笑起嚟更加嬌嫣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 saang1 dak1 hou2 ming4 jim6 ziu3 jan4, siu3 hei2 lai4 gang3 gaak3 giu1 jin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她长得很明艳动人，笑起来更加娇美。
examples.english_sentence: She is very beautiful and radiant, and even more charming when she smiles.

mandarin_meaning: 嫣然一笑 (yān rán yī xiào)
english_meaning: A sweet and charming smile; a radiant smile
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子笑容甜美、动人。
explanation_english: Describes a woman's smile as sweet, charming, and captivating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對住我嫣然一笑，我即刻暈晒浪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zyu6 ngo5 yin1 jin4 yat1 siu3, ngo5 zik1 haak1 wan4 saai3 long6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她对着我嫣然一笑，我立刻晕了。
examples.english_sentence: She gave me a radiant smile, and I immediately swooned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅嫣然一笑，好似陽光咁燦爛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 yin1 jin4 yat1 siu3, hou2 ci5 yeung4 gwong1 gam3 caan3 laan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的嫣然一笑，好像阳光一样灿烂。
examples.english_sentence: Her radiant smile was as brilliant as the sunshine.

english_meaning: Chang'e, the Chinese moon goddess
explanation_mandarin: 嫦娥是中国神话中的月亮女神。
explanation_english: Chang'e is the Chinese moon goddess in mythology.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嫦娥奔月係一個好浪漫嘅傳說。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng4 ngo4 ban1 jyut6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 long5 maan6 ge3 cyun4 syut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫦娥奔月是一个非常浪漫的传说。
examples.english_sentence: Chang'e flying to the moon is a very romantic legend.

english_meaning: Chang'e (Chinese moon goddess)
explanation_mandarin: 中国神话传说中的月亮女神。据说她偷吃了丈夫后羿从西王母那里求来的长生不死药，飞升到月宫中。
explanation_english: Chang'e is the Chinese moon goddess in mythology. Legend says she consumed the elixir of immortality obtained by her husband Hou Yi from the Queen Mother of the West, and ascended to the moon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 中秋節嘅時候，我哋會望住月光，諗起嫦娥嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 cau1 zit3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 mong6 zyu6 jyut6 gwong1, nam2 hei2 soeng4 ngo4 ge3 gu3 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中秋节的时候，我们会望着月光，想起嫦娥的故事。
examples.english_sentence: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, we look at the moonlight and think about the story of Chang'e.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿婆同細路仔講嫦娥奔月嘅故事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 tung4 sai3 lou6 zai2 gong2 soeng4 ngo4 ban1 jyut6 ge3 gu3 si2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶和小孩子讲嫦娥奔月的故事。

english_meaning: Hippie
explanation_mandarin: 指20世纪60年代出现的一种反主流文化的社会群体，他们追求自由、和平、爱与音乐，通常穿着色彩鲜艳、风格独特的服装。
explanation_english: Refers to a counterculture social movement that originated in the 1960s, characterized by a desire for freedom, peace, love, and music, often expressed through brightly colored and unique clothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢後生嗰陣成日扮嬉皮士，着曬啲紮染衫褲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hau6 saang1 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 baan6 hei1 pei4 si6, zoek3 saai3 di1 zaat3 jim5 saam1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他年轻的时候经常打扮成嬉皮士，穿着扎染的衣服裤子。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, he often dressed up as a hippie, wearing tie-dye clothes.

english_meaning: smiling insincerely; putting on a smiling face in a frivolous or cheeky manner; flippant; grinning obsequiously
explanation_mandarin: 形容态度轻浮，嬉闹而不严肃的样子。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude of being frivolous, playful, and unserious, often involving insincere smiles or a lack of respect for the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做錯嘢重喺度嬉皮笑臉，真係唔知醜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 co3 je5 cung4 hai2 dou6 hei1 pei4 siu3 lim5, zan1 hai6 m4 zi1 cau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做错了事还嬉皮笑脸的，真是不知羞耻。
examples.english_sentence: You made a mistake and you're still grinning obsequiously. You really have no shame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日嬉皮笑臉，認真啲做嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 hei1 pei4 siu3 lim5, jing6 zan1 di1 zou6 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是嬉皮笑脸的，认真一点工作吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be so flippant. Be serious about your work.

english_meaning: to laugh and joke; to jest
explanation_mandarin: 指欢笑、开玩笑。
explanation_english: Refers to laughing, joking, or making merry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日喺課室入面嬉笑，搞到其他人冇得專心上堂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 hai2 fo3 sat1 jap6 min6 hei1 siu3, gaau2 dou3 gei2 taa1 jan4 mou5 dak1 zyun1 sam1 soeng5 tong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是课室里嬉笑，搞得别人没法专心上课。
examples.english_sentence: They are always laughing and joking in the classroom, which prevents others from concentrating on the lesson.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好喺莊嚴嘅場合嬉笑，要尊重場合。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 hai2 zong1 jim4 ge3 coeng4 hap6 hei1 siu3, jiu3 zyun1 zung6 coeng4 hap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要在庄严的场合嬉笑，要尊重场合。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh and joke in solemn occasions. You must respect the occasion.

english_meaning: To jest, mock, rage, and scold; to express oneself freely and unreservedly through humor, anger, and criticism.
explanation_mandarin: 指用各种方式（欢笑、玩笑、愤怒、斥责）来表达自己的情感、观点或进行评论。常用於形容文笔生动活泼，能嬉笑怒骂，直抒胸臆。
explanation_english: Refers to expressing one's emotions, viewpoints, or offering commentary through various means, including laughter, jokes, anger, and scolding. It is often used to describe lively and vivid writing styles that can freely express thoughts and feelings through humor, anger, and criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲文章寫得好生動，嬉笑怒罵，乜都講得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 man4 zoeng1 se2 dak1 hou2 sang1 dung6, hei1 siu3 nou6 maa6, mat1 dou1 gong2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的文章写得很生动，嬉笑怒骂，什么都说得出来。
examples.english_sentence: His articles are very lively; he can express anything with humor, anger, and criticism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個棟篤笑表演者好鬼叻，可以嬉笑怒罵咁樣講出社會嘅問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 dung6 duk1 siu3 biu2 jin2 ze2 hou2 gwai2 lek1, ho2 ji5 hei1 siu3 nou6 maa6 gam2 joeng2 gong2 ceot1 se5 wui2 ge3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个栋笃笑表演者很厉害，可以用嬉笑怒骂的方式说出社会的问题。
examples.english_sentence: This stand-up comedian is very talented; he can express social problems through humor, anger, and criticism.

english_meaning: to laugh, joke, get angry, and scold; to express oneself freely and unreservedly
explanation_mandarin: 指态度随意，敢于表达自己的喜怒哀乐，不受拘束。
explanation_english: Describes an attitude of freely expressing one's emotions, including happiness, anger, and criticism, without restraint.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好真，鍾意嬉笑怒駡，唔會收收埋埋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zan1, zung1 yi3 hei1 siu3 nou6 maa6, m4 wui5 sau1 sau1 maai4 maai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很真诚，喜欢嬉笑怒骂，不会藏着掖着。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very genuine person who likes to express himself freely and unreservedly, not hiding anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲棟篤笑藝人就係靠嬉笑怒駡嚟諷刺時弊嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 dung3 duk1 siu3 ngai6 jan4 zau6 hai6 kaau3 hei1 siu3 nou6 maa6 lai4 fung3 ci3 si4 bai6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些单口相声演员就是靠嬉笑怒骂来讽刺时弊的。
examples.english_sentence: Those stand-up comedians rely on humor and satire to criticize current affairs.

english_meaning: Beautiful woman; beautiful, graceful
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子姿态美好或指美女。也可用作人名。
explanation_english: Describes a woman as beautiful and graceful. Can also be used as a given name.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個名有個「嬋」字，聽落好優雅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 meng2 jau5 go3 "sim4" zi6, teng1 lok6 hou2 jau1 ngaa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的名字里有个“婵”字，听起来很优雅。
examples.english_sentence: Her name has the character "婵" in it, it sounds very elegant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢舞姿好似仙女咁，真係好嬋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mou5 zi1 hou2 ci5 sin1 neoi5 gam2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的舞姿好像仙女一样，真是很美好。
examples.english_sentence: Her dance is like a fairy, truly beautiful and graceful.

mandarin_meaning: 娇气; 娇嫩; 撒娇
english_meaning: spoiled; pampered; delicate; tender; to act like a spoiled child; to be coquettish
explanation_mandarin: 形容人娇气，娇柔，或指撒娇的行为。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is spoiled, delicate, or refers to the act of acting spoiled and coquettish.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好嬌，成日扭計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 giu1, seng4 jat6 nau2 gai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这个人很娇气，总是闹别扭。
examples.english_sentence: She is very spoiled and always throws tantrums.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁嬌啦，自己搞掂佢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 giu1 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6 keoi5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么娇气了，自己搞定它吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so spoiled, sort it out yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢扮嬌嘅樣好可愛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baan6 giu1 ge3 joeng2 hou2 ho2 oi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她装娇的样子很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: She looks cute when she acts spoiled.

english_meaning: dainty and charming; petite and pretty; cute and lively
explanation_mandarin: 形容女子娇小可爱，容貌美丽俏丽，举止活泼。
explanation_english: Describes a woman who is petite and adorable, with a beautiful and lively appearance and demeanor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個樣生得好嬌俏，好得人鍾意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 joeng2 saang1 dak1 hou2 giu1 ciu3, hou2 dak1 jan4 zung1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的样子长得很娇俏，很讨人喜欢。
examples.english_sentence: She has a very dainty and charming appearance, very likeable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫著喺你身上，襯托出你嬌俏嘅一面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 zoek3 hai2 nei5 san1 soeng6, can3 tok3 chut1 nei5 giu1 ciu3 ge3 jat1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服穿在你身上，衬托出你娇俏的一面。
examples.english_sentence: This dress brings out your dainty and charming side.

english_meaning: soft panting (often associated with sexual arousal)
explanation_mandarin: 形容女性发出娇媚的喘息声，通常带有性暗示。
explanation_english: Describes the soft panting sound made by a woman, often with sexual undertones. It can imply coyness, pleasure, or feigned helplessness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺套戲入面扮嬌喘，真係好假。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 baan2 giu1 cyun2, zan1 hai6 hou2 gaa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她在电影里装娇喘，真的很假。
examples.english_sentence: She feigned soft panting in the movie, it sounded so fake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日都咁樣嬌喘啦，聽落好奇怪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 dou1 gam2 joeng2 giu1 cyun2 laa1, teng1 lok6 hou2 kei4 gwaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是这样娇喘，听起来很奇怪。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always pant softly like that, it sounds weird.

english_meaning: to act coquettishly; to be a clingy and sweet; to be babyish; to whine sweetly
explanation_mandarin: 指人（尤指女性）用甜言蜜语或装出可爱的样子来讨人喜欢或要求某种东西。带有依赖，黏人的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person (especially a female) acting in a coquettish or babyish way to please someone or to ask for something. It carries a sense of dependence and clinginess. It can also be used to describe the voice or tone used while acting in this way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都對住佢男朋友嬌嗲，想佢買嘢俾佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 dou1 deoi3 zyu6 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 giu1 de2, soeng2 keoi5 maai5 je5 bei2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是对着她男朋友撒娇，想要他给她买东西。
examples.english_sentence: She always acts coquettishly towards her boyfriend, wanting him to buy her things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬌嗲啦，自己搞得掂㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 giu1 de2 laa1, zi6 gei2 gaau2 dak1 dim6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么撒娇啦，自己能搞定的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so clingy, you can handle it yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢把聲好嬌嗲，聽落好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 baa2 seng1 hou2 giu1 de2, teng1 lok6 hou2 dak1 ji3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的声音很娇嗲，听起来很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: Her voice is very coquettish, it sounds very cute.

english_meaning: beloved wife; darling wife; pampered wife
explanation_mandarin: 指受到丈夫宠爱、娇惯的妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to a wife who is loved and pampered by her husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺朋友面前讚佢個嬌妻又靚又叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 pang4 jau5 min6 cin4 zaan3 keoi5 go3 giu1 cai1 jau6 leng3 jau6 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经常在朋友面前称赞他的娇妻又漂亮又聪明。
examples.english_sentence: He often praises his darling wife for being beautiful and smart in front of his friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚十年，依然咁恩愛，佢將佢老婆當嬌妻咁錫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 sap6 nin4, ji1 jin4 gam3 yan1 oi3, keoi5 zoeng1 keoi5 lo2 po2 dong3 giu1 cai1 gam3 sek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们结婚十年了，仍然这么恩爱，他把他的妻子当娇妻一样疼爱。
examples.english_sentence: They have been married for ten years and are still so loving. He cherishes his wife like a beloved wife.

english_meaning: Pretty woman, beautiful girl, babe
explanation_mandarin: 指漂亮、娇媚的年轻女子。
explanation_english: Refers to a beautiful and charming young woman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嘩，個嬌娃真係好靚女啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: waa1, go3 giu1 waa1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 neoi2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哇，那个娇娃真是很漂亮啊！
examples.english_sentence: Wow, that babe is really beautiful!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅女朋友係個大眼嘅嬌娃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 hai6 go3 daai6 ngaan5 ge3 giu1 waa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的女朋友是个大眼睛的美女。
examples.english_sentence: His girlfriend is a big-eyed beauty.

english_meaning: delicate; tender; fragile
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物细嫩、柔弱，容易受到伤害。
explanation_english: Describing something as delicate, tender, or fragile, easily damaged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢朵花好嬌嫩，要小心啲呵護。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 do2 faa1 hou2 giu1 nung6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1 ho1 wu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这朵花很娇嫩，要小心呵护。
examples.english_sentence: This flower is very delicate, we need to take good care of it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB嘅皮膚好嬌嫩，唔可以用刺激性嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: BB ge3 pei4 fu1 hou2 giu1 nung6, m4 ho2 ji5 yung6 cik1 gik1 sing3 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝的皮肤很娇嫩，不可以用刺激性的东西。
examples.english_sentence: A baby's skin is very delicate, you can't use anything irritating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好嬌嫩，受唔住啲壓力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 giu1 nung6, sau6 m4 zyu6 di1 aat3 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她这个人很娇嫩，承受不住压力。
examples.english_sentence: She is very delicate and can't handle the pressure.

english_meaning: petite, dainty, small and delicate
explanation_mandarin: 形容体态娇小玲珑，惹人怜爱。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is petite, dainty, and often seen as cute or endearing due to their small size.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身形好嬌小，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 san1 jing4 hou2 giu1 siu2, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她身材很娇小，很可爱。
examples.english_sentence: She is very petite and cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件衫啱曬你呢啲嬌小嘅女仔著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 saam1 ngaam1 saai3 nei5 di1 giu1 siu2 ge3 neoi5 zai2 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件衣服最适合你这种娇小的女孩子穿。
examples.english_sentence: This dress is perfect for petite girls like you.

mandarin_meaning: 娇小玲珑 (jiāo xiǎo líng lóng)
english_meaning: petite and exquisite; daintily small and charming; delicately built
explanation_mandarin: 形容身材娇小，体态轻盈美好，小巧可爱。
explanation_english: Describes someone (usually a woman) who is petite, has a slender and beautiful figure, and is dainty and lovely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢身材嬌小玲瓏，著咩衫都咁好睇。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她身材娇小玲珑，穿什么衣服都好看。
examples.english_sentence: She has a petite and exquisite figure, so she looks good in everything she wears.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個女仔雖然唔高，但係好嬌小玲瓏，好吸引人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 neoi5 zai2 seui1 jin4 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 hou2 giu1 siu2 ling4 lung4, hou2 kap1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个女孩虽然不高，但是很娇小玲珑，很吸引人。
examples.english_sentence: Although this girl isn't tall, she's petite and attractive.

english_meaning: Affectedly dainty; delicate and sweet in a way that might be perceived as artificial or exaggerated.
explanation_mandarin: 形容人娇气，带有做作的成分，通常形容女性。
explanation_english: Describes someone, typically a woman, who is delicate, sweet, and acts in a somewhat affected or artificial manner. It often implies a degree of affectation or over-the-top sweetness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢嬌滴滴，好似好怕醜咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 giu1 dik1 dik1, hou2 ci5 hou2 paa3 cau2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说话娇滴滴的，好像很害羞似的。
examples.english_sentence: She speaks in an affectedly sweet voice, as if she's very shy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔係真係咁嬌滴滴㗎，佢係扮㗎咋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 hai6 zan1 hai6 gam3 giu1 dik1 dik1 gaa3, keoi5 hai6 baan6 gaa3 zaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她不是真的那么娇滴滴的，她是装的。
examples.english_sentence: She isn't really that affectedly dainty, she's just pretending.

synonyms: 嗲聲嗲氣 (de2 seng1 de2 hei3)

english_meaning: pampered, spoiled
explanation_mandarin: 指在娇生惯养的环境中长大，缺乏独立生活能力。
explanation_english: Used to describe someone who has been brought up in a pampered environment and lacks independence and self-reliance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自細就嬌生慣養，乜都唔識做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 sai3 zau6 giu1 sang1 gwaan3 joeng5, mat1 dou1 m4 sik1 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就娇生惯养，什么都不会做。
examples.english_sentence: He was pampered since childhood and can't do anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁嬌生慣養你個仔，第時佢會食苦頭㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 giu1 sang1 gwaan3 joeng5 nei5 go3 zai2, dai6 si4 keoi5 wui sik6 fu2 tau4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么娇生惯养你的儿子，以后他会吃苦的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spoil your son so much, he will suffer in the future.

english_meaning: radiant and beautiful; exquisitely beautiful and delicate
explanation_mandarin: 形容花朵、女子等美丽动人，娇嫩而鲜艳。
explanation_english: Describes something (especially flowers or women) as being radiantly beautiful, delicate, and vibrant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗件紅色嘅裙，顯得好嬌艷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 gin6 hung4 sik1 ge3 kwan4, hin2 dak1 hou2 giu1 jim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她今天穿了一件红色的裙子，显得很娇艳。
examples.english_sentence: She looks radiant today wearing a red dress.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢朵花開得好嬌艷啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 do2 faa1 hoi1 dak1 hou2 giu1 jim6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这朵花开得很娇艳啊！
examples.english_sentence: This flower is blooming so beautifully!

mandarin_meaning: 娇嫩的花朵，比喻娇弱的女子
english_meaning: Delicate flower; used figuratively to describe a delicate and pampered woman.
explanation_mandarin: 本义是指娇嫩的花朵。常用来比喻体弱多病、需要呵护的女子。多带有一种怜惜的意味，有时也略带贬义，指过度娇气。
explanation_english: Literally refers to a delicate flower. Figuratively used to describe a fragile and pampered woman, often implying she needs special care and attention. Can carry a sense of pity or, sometimes, a slightly negative connotation of being overly delicate and demanding.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似朵嬌花咁，要好好照顧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 do2 giu1 faa1 gam2, jiu3 hou2 hou2 ziu3 gu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她好像一朵娇花，需要好好照顾。
examples.english_sentence: She's like a delicate flower; she needs to be taken good care of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將個女湊到好似嬌花咁，要佢學吓獨立。

explanation_english: Refers to a woman who is prone to scolding and arguing loudly, often in public; a derogatory term.

english_meaning: love, affection
explanation_mandarin: 喜爱；怜爱；爱惜
explanation_english: To love, cherish, or have affection for someone or something.

english_meaning: Grandmother (maternal or paternal, depending on context)
explanation_mandarin: 在粤语中，“嬤” 可以指外婆 (母亲的母亲) 或奶奶 (父亲的母亲), 具体含义需要根据上下文判断. 虽然正式的称谓是外婆 (ngoi6 po4) 和 奶奶 (naai5 naai2)，但在口语中用 “嬤” 非常普遍。
explanation_english: In Cantonese, "嬤" (maa4) can refer to either maternal grandmother (mother's mother) or paternal grandmother (father's mother). The precise meaning depends on the context. While the formal terms are 外婆 (ngoi6 po4) for maternal grandmother and 奶奶 (naai5 naai2) for paternal grandmother, "嬤" is a very common colloquial term for either.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日去探我嬤。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 taam3 ngo5 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天去看我外婆/奶奶。
examples.english_sentence: I'm going to visit my grandmother tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嬤好錫我㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maa4 hou2 sek3 ngo5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我外婆/奶奶很疼我的。
examples.english_sentence: My grandmother loves me very much.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 maa4 san1 tai2 hou2 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你外婆/奶奶身体好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Is your grandmother in good health?

english_meaning: imperial concubine (of a certain rank)

examples.mandarin_sentence: 她梦想可以做皇帝的妃嫔。
examples.english_sentence: She dreams of becoming the emperor's concubine.

english_meaning: baby, infant
explanation_mandarin: 指刚出生不久的小孩。
explanation_english: Refers to a very young child, a newborn or infant.

english_meaning: baby, infant

examples.english_sentence: That baby is sleeping soundly.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们刚刚生了一个婴儿。
examples.english_sentence: They just had a baby.

english_meaning: baby carriage, stroller, pram
explanation_mandarin: 用于运载婴儿或幼儿的车辆。
explanation_english: A vehicle used to transport babies or young children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗架新嘅嬰兒車俾個BB。

explanation_mandarin: 指人的额头。
explanation_english: Refers to the forehead of a person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢撞親個頭，搞到個嬰堂紅晒。

examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 dit3 can1, seng4 go3 jing1 tong4 dou1 zung2 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子摔倒了，整个额头都肿了。
examples.english_sentence: The child fell, and his entire forehead is swollen.

english_meaning: baby, infant

english_meaning: angry, annoyed, irritated
explanation_mandarin: 表示生气、恼怒的情绪。
explanation_english: Expressing the emotion of anger, annoyance, or irritation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁遲返屋企，阿媽梗係嬲啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 ci4 faan1 uk1 kei2, aa3 maa1 gang2 hai6 nau1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么晚回家，妈妈肯定生气了。
examples.english_sentence: You came home so late, your mother must be angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日遲到，搞到老細好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3, gaau2 dou3 lou5 sai3 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是迟到，搞得老板很生气。
examples.english_sentence: He is always late, which makes the boss very angry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好惹佢，佢依家好嬲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ze2 keoi5, keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hou2 nau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要惹他，他现在很生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't provoke him, he is very angry right now.

english_meaning: angry; upset; sulky
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人因为不满意或受到委屈而生气，情绪低落，闷闷不乐的样子。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being angry, upset, or sulky due to dissatisfaction or grievance. It conveys a mood of depression and unhappiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完之後，成日都嬲休休咁樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 nau1 jau1 jau1 gam2 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，整天都闷闷不乐。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he's been sulky all day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好嬲休啦，我請你食嘢賠罪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 nau1 jau1 laa1, ngo5 cheng2 nei5 sik6 je5 pui4 zui6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要生气了，我请你吃东西赔罪好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be upset anymore, I'll treat you to something as an apology, okay?

mandarin_meaning: 形容一个人非常生气，怒气冲冲的样子
english_meaning: Describes someone who is very angry, looking furious and sulky.
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常生气，气呼呼的，而且可能会有点撅嘴，闷闷不乐的样子。 "嬲"是生气的口语说法， "休僂" 形容弯腰弓背的样子，这里引申为很不高兴， 耷拉着头。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely angry, often with a sulky or grumpy expression. "嬲 (nau1)" is a colloquial way to say "angry". "休僂 (jau1 lau4)" literally describes a hunched or bent posture, but here it implies a sullen, dejected mood and a downcast demeanor due to anger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾老細鬧完，嬲休僂斗咁返屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6 jyun4, nau1 jau1 lau4 dau2 gam2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被老板骂完之后，气呼呼地回家了。
examples.english_sentence: After being scolded by the boss, he went home looking furious and sulky.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嬲休僂斗啦，件事都過咗去喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nau1 jau1 lau4 dau2 laa1, gin6 si6 dou1 gwo3 zo2 heoi3 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要生气了，事情都过去了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so angry and sulky, it's all in the past.

english_meaning: A little angry; slightly annoyed; somewhat upset
explanation_mandarin: 表示稍微生气或者有点不高兴的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being a little angry, slightly annoyed, or somewhat upset. The '哋' suffix softens the intensity of the anger, suggesting it's not a full-blown rage but a mild annoyance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔睬我，我嬲嬲哋。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日要返工，所以而家嬲嬲哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 jiu3 faan1 gung1, so2 ji5 ji4 gaa1 nau1 nau1 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天要上班，所以现在有点不高兴。
examples.english_sentence: I have to go to work tomorrow, so I'm a little upset now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嬲嬲哋佢成日遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nau1 nau1 dei2 keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有点生气他总是迟到。
examples.english_sentence: I'm a little annoyed that he's always late.

english_meaning: Slightly angry; a bit annoyed
explanation_mandarin: 表示轻微的生气状态，程度比“嬲”轻。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being slightly angry or annoyed. The degree of anger is less intense than just being '嬲' (nau1).

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 nau1 dei2 gam2 zau2 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有点生气地走了。
examples.english_sentence: He left, looking a bit annoyed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我嬲嬲地，但係都原諒咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nau1 nau1 dei2, daan6 hai6 dou1 jyun4 loeng6 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我有点生气，但是还是原谅他了。
examples.english_sentence: I was a bit annoyed, but I forgave him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好嬲嬲地啦，我請你食飯咪得囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 nau1 nau1 dei2 laa1, ngo5 ceng2 nei5 sik6 faan6 mai6 dak1 lo1.

english_meaning: Looking angry; being sulky; acting in a huff
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人（通常是小孩子）生气，嘟着嘴，鼓着腮帮子的可爱样子。
explanation_english: Describes someone, usually a child, who is pouting or sulking, looking cute while angry. The term implies a slight, childish anger rather than a deep rage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲嬲豬咁，唔睬我。

explanation_mandarin: 形容非常生气，愤怒到极点，甚至快要爆炸的状态。
explanation_english: Describes a state of extreme anger, so angry that one is about to explode with rage.

examples.english_sentence: He lost the game and stormed off in a furious mood.

examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 keoi5 aa3, keoi5 ji4 gaa1 nau1 baa3 baa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别惹他，他现在非常生气。
examples.english_sentence: Don't bother him, he's extremely angry right now.

english_meaning: to win; to beat; to gain; to profit
explanation_mandarin: 在竞争、比赛等活动中胜过对方，获得胜利。
explanation_english: To win or beat someone in a competition, game, or other activity; to gain or profit from something.

explanation_english: A term of address for a woman of similar age to one's aunt; paternal aunt younger than one's father.
