examples.english_sentence: The police found a lot of bullet casings at the scene.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇子彈就唔好搞咁多嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 zi2 daan6 zau6 m4 hou2 gaau2 gam3 do1 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没钱就不要搞这么多事情了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't have the money, don't get involved in so many things.

synonyms: 經費 (ging1 fai3) - more formal for funds

mandarin_meaning: 指非常节俭，把钱省下来投资或用于关键用途的人
english_meaning: Someone who is extremely frugal, saving money to invest or for essential purposes; A 'bullet person' (metaphorically representing someone focused and streamlined on financial goals)
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人非常节俭，把钱节省下来用于投资、储蓄或者关键性的用途，就像子弹一样，目标明确且有动力。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely frugal, saving money for investment, savings, or essential purposes. The metaphor likens them to a bullet, with a clear target and strong motivation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個子彈人，平時慳到不得了，但係買股票就唔手軟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 zi2 daan6 jan4, ping4 si4 haan1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5, daan6 hai6 maai5 gu2 piu3 zau6 m4 sau2 jyun5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个非常节俭的人，平时省吃俭用，但是买股票的时候毫不手软。
examples.english_sentence: He's really a frugal person, saving every penny usually, but he doesn't hesitate when it comes to buying stocks.

synonyms: 孤寒鬼 (gu1 hon4 gwai2) - stingy person (with a negative connotation)

english_meaning: Short person; shorty; a small person
explanation_mandarin: 指身材矮小的人，带有略微贬义的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is short in stature. It can be slightly derogatory depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個仔細細粒粒，成日俾人笑係子彈仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zai2 sai3 sai3 lap1 lap1, seng4 jat6 bei2 jan4 siu3 hai6 zi2 daan6 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的儿子个头小小的，经常被人嘲笑是矮个子。
examples.english_sentence: His son is small, and he's often laughed at for being a shorty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁講人哋啦，叫人子彈仔好冇禮貌㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam2 gong2 jan4 dei6 laa1, giu3 jan4 zi2 daan6 zai2 hou2 mou5 lai5 maau6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这样说别人了，叫别人矮个子很不礼貌的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't say that about people, calling someone 'shorty' is very impolite.

mandarin_meaning: 高速列车; 子弹头列车
english_meaning: Bullet train; high-speed train
explanation_mandarin: 指速度非常快的列车，通常指高速铁路上的列车。
explanation_english: Refers to a very fast train, usually referring to trains on high-speed railways. Literally translates to 'bullet train'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港都有子彈火車去大陸喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 dou1 jau5 zi2 daan6 fo2 ce1 heoi3 daai6 luk6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港也有高速列车去大陆了。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong also has bullet trains going to mainland China now.

english_meaning: High-speed elevator; bullet elevator
explanation_mandarin: 形容速度非常快的电梯。因为电梯速度很快，如同子弹一样，所以称为“子弹𨋢”。
explanation_english: Describes an elevator that moves at a very high speed. The term comes from the fact that the elevator travels as fast as a bullet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢棟樓嘅子彈𨋢真係好快，幾秒就上到頂樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dung6 lau2 ge3 zi2 daan6 lip1 zan1 hai6 hou2 faai3, gei2 miu5 zau6 soeng5 dou3 ding2 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这栋楼的子弹电梯真快，几秒就到顶楼了。
examples.english_sentence: The high-speed elevator in this building is really fast; it goes to the top floor in a few seconds.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司話要裝子彈𨋢，等我哋唔使等咁耐。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 waa6 jiu3 zong1 zi2 daan6 lip1, dang2 ngo5 dei6 m4 sai2 dang2 gam3 noi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司说要安装高速电梯，这样我们就不用等那么久了。
examples.english_sentence: The company said they will install a high-speed elevator so we don't have to wait so long.

english_meaning: Extension phone; Sub-machine; Side chick (slang)
explanation_mandarin: 指电话系统中的分机，也指备用的机器或设备。在网络用语中，也可指备胎，尤其是指女性的备胎，较为贬义。
explanation_english: Literally refers to an extension phone in a phone system, or a spare machine/equipment. In internet slang, it can also refer to a backup plan, especially a female 'side chick', carrying a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，可唔可以幫我駁去經理嘅子機啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai2, ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 bok3 heoi3 ging1 lei5 ge3 zi2 gei1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，可以帮我转接到经理的分机吗？
examples.english_sentence: Hello, can you transfer me to the manager's extension?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢明知自己係人哋嘅子機，但係都唔肯放手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 zi1 zi6 gei2 hai6 jan4 dei6 ge3 zi2 gei1, daan6 hai6 dou1 m4 hang2 fong3 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她明明知道自己是别人的备胎，但是还是不肯放手。
examples.english_sentence: She knows perfectly well that she is someone else's side chick, but she is still unwilling to let go.

english_meaning: Bunk bed; a bed with a smaller bed underneath (trundle bed)
explanation_mandarin: 一种床的类型，通常指上下铺的床，或者是指下面可以拉出一张小床的床。
explanation_english: A type of bed, usually referring to bunk beds or a bed with a smaller pull-out bed underneath (trundle bed).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房太細，買張子母床慳位啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 taai3 sai3, maai5 jeung1 zi2 mou5 chong4 haan1 wai2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间太小，买张子母床节省空间。
examples.english_sentence: The room is too small, buying a bunk bed will save space.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣瞓過子母床，覺得好得意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2陣 fan3 gwo3 zi2 mou5 chong4, gok3 dak1 hou2 dak1 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候睡过上下铺，觉得很有趣。
examples.english_sentence: I used to sleep in a bunk bed when I was a kid, I thought it was very interesting.

english_meaning: Bunk bed (with a larger bed on the bottom and a smaller bed on the top, or a bed with a pull-out trundle bed)
explanation_mandarin: 一种上下铺的床，通常下铺比上铺大，或者是一种带可拉出床架的床。
explanation_english: A type of bunk bed, usually with a larger bed on the bottom and a smaller bed on the top. It can also refer to a bed with a pull-out trundle bed underneath.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗張子母床畀兩個細路瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 mou5 cong4 bei2 loeng5 go3 sai3 lou2 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了一张子母床给两个小孩睡。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a bunk bed for the two kids to sleep in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房咁細，放張子母床就啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 gam3 sai3, fong3 zoeng1 zi2 mou5 cong4 zau6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间这么小，放一张子母床就刚好合适。
examples.english_sentence: The room is so small, a bunk bed fits just right.

english_meaning: Bunk bed (specifically, a bunk bed with a larger bed on the bottom and a smaller bed on top)
explanation_mandarin: 一种上下铺的床，下铺比上铺大，通常是双人床，上铺是单人床。
explanation_english: A type of bunk bed where the bottom bunk is larger (often a double bed) and the top bunk is smaller (often a single bed). It's designed to accommodate a parent and child or two children with different space needs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房細，擺張子母牀啱啱好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 sai3, baai2 zoeng1 zi2 mou5 cong4 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间小，放张子母床刚刚好。
examples.english_sentence: The room is small, a bunk bed with a larger bottom bunk fits just right.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋買咗張子母牀，等個仔大個啲就可以自己瞓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 zi2 mou5 cong4, dang2 go3 zai2 daai6 go3 di1 zau6 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们买了一张子母床，等儿子长大一些就可以自己睡了。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a bunk bed with a larger bottom bunk so that our son can sleep alone when he's older.

english_meaning: subjects, citizens (of a ruler or country)
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或统治者的百姓，民众。
explanation_english: Refers to the people or citizens of a country or ruler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅皇帝好重視佢哋啲子民。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 wong4 dai3 hou2 zung6 si6 keoi5 dei6 di1 zi2 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的皇帝很重视他们的子民。
examples.english_sentence: The emperors in the past valued their subjects a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一個好嘅領袖會為子民著想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 go3 hou2 ge3 ling5 siu6 wui5 wai6 zi2 man4 zoek3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一个好的领袖会为人民着想。
examples.english_sentence: A good leader will consider the well-being of the people.

english_meaning: Viscount
explanation_mandarin: 欧洲贵族爵位的一种，等级低于伯爵，高于男爵。
explanation_english: A title of nobility in Europe, ranking below an earl (count) and above a baron; viscount.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅家族歷史好悠久，以前仲出過子爵添。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaa1 zuk6 lik6 si2 hou2 jau4 gau2, ji5 cin4 zung2 ceot1 gwo3 zi2 zoek3 tim1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的家族历史很悠久，以前还出过子爵呢。
examples.english_sentence: His family has a very long history, and they even had a viscount before.

english_meaning: ginger shoots, young ginger
explanation_mandarin: 指姜的嫩芽，通常用于腌制或烹饪，口感鲜嫩。
explanation_english: Refers to the young ginger sprouts. It is usually pickled or used in cooking, with a tender taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食醋子薑，酸酸甜甜好開胃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 cou3 zi2 goeng1, syun1 syun1 tim4 tim4 hou2 hoi1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我喜欢吃酸姜，酸酸甜甜的，很开胃。
examples.english_sentence: I like to eat pickled ginger, it's sweet and sour and very appetizing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 子薑炒牛肉都幾好味㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi2 goeng1 caau2 ngau4 juk6 dou1 gei2 hou2 mei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 嫩姜炒牛肉也很好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Beef stir-fried with young ginger is also quite delicious.

english_meaning: purely fictitious; baseless; fabricated
explanation_mandarin: 指虚构的、不存在的事物。形容完全是虚构或捏造的。
explanation_english: Refers to something fictitious or non-existent. Describes something that is completely fabricated or made up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢全部都係子虛烏有，唔可以信㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 zi2 heoi1 wu1 jau5, m4 ho2 ji5 seon3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话全部都是子虚乌有，不可以相信的。
examples.english_sentence: Everything he said is purely fictitious, you can't trust it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個傳聞真係子虛烏有，唔好當真啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 cyun4 man4 zan1 hai6 zi2 heoi1 wu1 jau5, m4 hou2 dong3 zan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个传闻真的是子虚乌有，不要当真了。
examples.english_sentence: This rumor is completely baseless, don't take it seriously.

english_meaning: spring chicken; young chicken
explanation_mandarin: 指还未成熟的小鸡，通常指可食用的幼鸡。在口语中，有时也用来形容年轻人。
explanation_english: Literally, 'young chicken', referring to a young, immature chicken, often used for food. Colloquially, it can also describe a young person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今晚煮子雞食啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 zyu2 zi2 gai1 sik6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今晚煮童子鸡吃吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's cook a spring chicken for dinner tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢仲係條子雞，咩都唔識㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung6 hai6 tiu4 zi2 gai1, me1 dou1 m4 sik1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他还是个小年轻，什么都不懂。
examples.english_sentence: He's still a spring chicken, doesn't know anything.

english_meaning: consonant
explanation_mandarin: 语音学中的概念，指发音时气流受到阻碍而形成的音。
explanation_english: In phonetics, a consonant is a speech sound that is articulated with complete or partial closure of the vocal tract.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廣東話入面都有好多子音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwong2 dung1 waa2 jap6 min6 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 zi2 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 粤语里面也有很多辅音。
examples.english_sentence: There are many consonants in Cantonese as well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學語言要學埋子音同母音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 jyu5 jin2 jiu3 hok6 maai4 zi2 jam1 tung4 mou5 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习语言也要学习辅音和元音。
examples.english_sentence: When learning a language, you also need to learn consonants and vowels.

english_meaning: Chicken, chick (small chicken)
explanation_mandarin: 指小鸡，未成年的鸡。
explanation_english: Refers to a small chicken, a young chicken.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場入邊養咗好多子鷄，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 jap6 bin1 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 zi2 gai1, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场里养了很多小鸡，非常可爱。
examples.english_sentence: There are many chicks raised in the farm, they are very cute.

english_meaning: single, solitary
explanation_mandarin: 单只，孤单的。通常与“然一身”一起使用，表示独自一人。
explanation_english: Single, solitary. Often used together with "然一身" (yin4 jan4 jat1 san1) to indicate being alone, isolated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢走咗之後，我就孑然一身啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zau2 zo2 zi1 hau6, ngo5 zau6 kit3 jin4 jat1 san1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他走了之后，我就孤身一人了。
examples.english_sentence: After he left, I was all alone.

english_meaning: mosquito larva, wriggler
explanation_mandarin: 蚊子的幼虫，生活在水中，身体细长，游泳时弯曲伸直。
explanation_english: The larva of a mosquito, found in water. They have a long, slender body and swim with a wriggling motion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲水缸入面有好多孑孓，一定要清理乾淨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 seoi2 gong1 jap6 min6 jau5 ho2 do1 kit3 gyut3, jat1 ding6 jiu3 cing1 lei5 gon1 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 水缸里面有很多蚊子的幼虫，一定要清理干净。
examples.english_sentence: There are a lot of mosquito larvae in the water tank, it must be cleaned up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 落完雨之後，啲積水好易滋生孑孓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 zi1 hau6, di1 zik1 seoi2 hou2 ji6 zi1 sang1 kit3 gyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下雨之后，积水很容易滋生蚊子的幼虫。
examples.english_sentence: After the rain, stagnant water easily breeds mosquito larvae.

english_meaning: all alone, completely alone, solitary
explanation_mandarin: 指孤单一人，没有依靠。
explanation_english: Describes being completely alone, without any support or companionship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企人全部移民走晒，佢而家孑然一身喺香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei5 jan4 cyun4 bou6 ji4 man4 zau2晒，keoi5 ji4 gaa1 kit3 jin4 jat1 san1 hai2 hoeng1 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他家人都移民走了，他现在孤身一人在香港。
examples.english_sentence: His family all emigrated, and he is now all alone in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢經歷咁多嘢之後，變得孑然一身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ging1 lik6 gam3 do1 je5 zi1 hau6, bin3 dak1 kit3 jin4 jat1 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经历这么多事情后，变得孤身一人。
examples.english_sentence: After experiencing so much, he became completely alone.

english_meaning: Mosquito larva; wiggler
explanation_mandarin: 蚊子的幼虫，也叫孑孓。
explanation_english: The larva of a mosquito; also known as a wiggler.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企唔好有積水，容易滋生孓㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 m4 hou2 jau5 zik1 seoi2, jung4 ji6 zi1 sang1 gaat6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里不要有积水，容易滋生蚊子幼虫的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't have stagnant water at home; it's easy to breed mosquito larvae.

english_meaning: hole
explanation_mandarin: 洞，孔洞
explanation_english: A hole; an opening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 牆上面有個孔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 soeng6 min6 jau5 go3 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 墙上有一个洞。
examples.english_sentence: There is a hole in the wall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲衫爛咗個孔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 saam1 laan6 zo2 go3 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 衣服破了一个洞。
examples.english_sentence: There's a hole in the clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 支筆冇墨，寫唔到，可能塞咗個孔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zi1 bat1 mou5 mak6, se2 m4 dou2, ho2 nang4 sak1 zo2 go3 hung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 笔没墨了，写不了，可能孔被堵住了。
examples.english_sentence: The pen has no ink and can't write. The opening might be blocked.

english_meaning: Confucius
explanation_mandarin: 中国古代思想家、教育家，儒家学派创始人。
explanation_english: Confucius, an ancient Chinese philosopher and educator, the founder of Confucianism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孔子係中國歷史上好重要嘅思想家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hung2 zi2 hai6 zung1 gwok3 lik6 si2 soeng6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 si1 soeng2 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 孔子是中国历史上非常重要的思想家。
examples.english_sentence: Confucius is a very important thinker in Chinese history.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要學習孔子嘅思想。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 hok6 zaap6 hung2 zi2 ge3 si1 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要学习孔子的思想。
examples.english_sentence: We should learn Confucius's philosophy.

mandarin_meaning: 诸葛亮; 形容聪明, 有智慧的人
english_meaning: Zhuge Liang (historical figure); (figuratively) wise, intelligent, resourceful person; genius
explanation_mandarin: 孔明，指三国时期蜀汉丞相诸葛亮。因为诸葛亮非常聪明，足智多谋，所以“孔明”也用来比喻聪明、有智慧、有谋略的人。
explanation_english: "Kong Ming" refers to Zhuge Liang, the prime minister of Shu Han during the Three Kingdoms period. Because Zhuge Liang was very intelligent, resourceful, and full of strategies, "Kong Ming" is also used as a metaphor for a clever, wise, and strategic person; a genius.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好似孔明咁，咩計仔都諗得出。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 hung2 ming4 gam2, me1 gai3 zai2 dou1 nam2 dak1 ceot1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很像诸葛亮，什么主意都想得出来。
examples.english_sentence: He is really like Zhuge Liang, he can come up with all sorts of ideas.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你咁叻，咪當自己係孔明囉？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 lek1, mai5 dong3 zi6 gei2 hai6 hung2 ming4 lo1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这么聪明，把自己当诸葛亮啦？
examples.english_sentence: You're so smart, do you think you're Zhuge Liang?

cantonese: 孔明撞到周瑜 - 一味靠激
jyutping: hung2 ming4 zong6 dou3 zau1 jyu4 -- jat1 mei6 kaau3 gik1
mandarin_meaning: 诸葛亮碰到周瑜——总是靠激将法
english_meaning: Like Zhuge Liang meeting Zhou Yu - always relying on provocation to get things done.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻像诸葛亮对付周瑜一样，总是用激将法来达到目的。形容人喜欢用激将法。
explanation_english: An idiom comparing the situation to Zhuge Liang dealing with Zhou Yu, always using provocation (guilting, pushing someone's buttons) to achieve one's goals. Describes someone who likes to use provocation as a tactic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日都孔明撞到周瑜——一味靠激啦，試吓直接講你嘅諗法啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 dou1 hung2 ming4 zong6 dou3 zau1 jyu4 -- jat1 mei6 kaau3 gik1 laa1, si3 haa5 zik6 zip3 gong2 nei5 ge3 lam2 faat3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是像诸葛亮碰到周瑜——总是靠激将法了，试着直接说你的想法吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always be like Zhuge Liang meeting Zhou Yu - always relying on provocation, try to directly express your thoughts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都孔明撞到周瑜——一味靠激，搞到同事好反感。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 sing4 jat6 dou1 hung2 ming4 zong6 dou3 zau1 jyu4 -- jat1 mei6 kaau3 gik1, gaau2 dou3 tung4 si6 hou2 faan2 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事总是像诸葛亮碰到周瑜——总是靠激将法，搞得同事很反感。
examples.english_sentence: He always relies on provocation to get things done, like Zhuge Liang meeting Zhou Yu, which makes his colleagues very resentful.

english_meaning: sky lantern, Kongming lantern
explanation_mandarin: 一种用纸或布制成的灯笼，底部开口，利用加热空气上升的原理使其升空。
explanation_english: A type of small hot air balloon made of paper or cloth, with an opening at the bottom where a small fire is suspended. The fire heats the air inside, causing the lantern to rise into the air.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，好多人都會放孔明燈，希望願望成真。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 wui5 fong3 hung2 ming4 dang1, hei1 mong6 jyun6 mong6 sing4 zan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，很多人都会放孔明灯，希望愿望成真。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, many people release sky lanterns, hoping their wishes will come true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放孔明燈嘅時候要小心啲，費事引起火災。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 hung2 ming4 dang1 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1, fai3 si6 hing2 hei2 fo2 zoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放孔明灯的时候要小心点，以免引起火灾。
examples.english_sentence: Be careful when releasing sky lanterns, in order to avoid causing a fire.

english_meaning: strong and powerful; robust
explanation_mandarin: 形容人身体非常强壮，很有力量。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is very strong and powerful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個身形孔武有力，一定好打得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 san1 jing4 hung2 mou5 jau5 lik6, jat1 ding6 hou2 daa2 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身材非常强壮，一定很能打。
examples.english_sentence: His physique is very strong and powerful; he must be a good fighter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個後生仔孔武有力，搬嘢都唔使人幫手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hau6 sang1 zai2 hung2 mou5 jau5 lik6, bun1 je5 dou1 m4 sai2 jan4 bong1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个年轻人非常强壮，搬东西都不需要人帮忙。
examples.english_sentence: This young man is very strong and powerful, he doesn't need help to move things.

english_meaning: peacock
explanation_mandarin: 一种大型的雉科鸟类，雄鸟有美丽的尾羽，可以展开成扇形。
explanation_english: A large pheasant-like bird, the male of which has a magnificent tail that can be displayed in a fan shape.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個動物園有好多孔雀，好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 dung6 mat6 jyun2 jau5 hou2 do1 hung2 zoek3, hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 动物园里有很多孔雀，很漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: There are many peacocks in the zoo, they are very beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好似孔雀開屏噉，成日喺人面前show off。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 ci5 hung2 zoek3 hoi1 ping4 gam2, seng4 jat6 hai2 jan4 min6 cin4 show1 off.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他好像孔雀开屏一样，整天在别人面前炫耀。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a peacock displaying its feathers, always showing off in front of others.

english_meaning: Peacock displaying its tail feathers; to show off
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是孔雀展开尾羽。比喻人为了炫耀自己而过分地表现自己。
explanation_english: Literally means a peacock displaying its tail feathers. Figuratively, it means to show off or flaunt one's abilities, possessions, or appearance in an ostentatious way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一攞到個獎就孔雀開屏咁，周圍同人講。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lo2 dou2 go3 zoeng2 zau6 hung2 zoek3 hoi1 ping4 gam2, zau1 wai4 tung4 jan4 gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一拿到奖就孔雀开屏一样，到处跟人说。
examples.english_sentence: As soon as he got the award, he started showing off like a peacock, telling everyone about it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使咁孔雀開屏嘅，大家都知你叻啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 gam3 hung2 zoek3 hoi1 ping4 ge3, daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 nei5 lek1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用这么孔雀开屏，大家都知道你厉害啦。
examples.english_sentence: You don't need to show off so much, everyone knows you're capable.

english_meaning: pregnant
explanation_mandarin: 指女性怀有身孕
explanation_english: Refers to the state of a woman being pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢話佢有咗三個月喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waa6 keoi5 jau5 zo2 saam1 go3 jyut6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她说她怀孕三个月了。
examples.english_sentence: She said she's been pregnant for three months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話佢冇咁容易會孕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 mou5 gam3 jung4 ji6 wui5 wan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说她不容易怀孕。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said that it wouldn't be easy for her to get pregnant.

english_meaning: the look of pregnancy; pregnancy glow
explanation_mandarin: 指女性怀孕后所表现出的外貌或气质上的变化，例如气色红润、神采奕奕等，暗示或显露出怀孕的迹象。
explanation_english: Refers to the changes in a woman's appearance or demeanor that suggest she is pregnant, such as a rosy complexion or a radiant glow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢最近塊面紅卜卜，好似有啲孕味噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeoi3 gan6 faai3 min6 hung4 buk1 buk1, hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 wan6 mei6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她最近脸色红润润的，好像有点怀孕的迹象。
examples.english_sentence: Her face has been rosy lately, she seems to have the pregnancy glow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你睇佢咁，行路都慢咗好多，應該有咗，有晒孕味啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 tai2 keoi5 gam2, haang4 lou6 dou1 maan6 zo2 hou2 do1, jing1 goi1 jau5 zo2, jau5 saai3 wan6 mei6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你看她那样，走路都慢了很多，应该怀孕了，非常有孕相了。
examples.english_sentence: Look at her, she walks much slower now, she must be pregnant, she clearly has the look of pregnancy.

english_meaning: pregnant woman
explanation_mandarin: 懷孕的婦女。
explanation_english: A woman who is pregnant.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搭地鐵嘅時候要讓座畀孕婦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daap3 dei6 tit3 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 joeng6 zo6 bei2 wan6 fu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐地铁的时候要给孕妇让座。
examples.english_sentence: You should give up your seat to pregnant women on the subway.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生叫孕婦唔好食生冷嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi1 sang1 giu3 wan6 fu5 m4 hou2 sik6 saang1 laang5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生叫孕妇不要吃生冷的食物。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor told the pregnant woman not to eat raw or cold food.

english_meaning: to breed, to nurture, to foster, to give rise to
explanation_mandarin: 指怀胎生育，也比喻产生、酝酿。
explanation_english: Literally refers to conceiving and giving birth. Figuratively, it means to breed, nurture, foster, or give rise to something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅環境孕育咗好多獨特嘅生物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 waan4 ging2 wan6 juk6 zo2 hou2 do1 duk6 dak6 ge3 sang1 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的环境孕育了很多独特的生物。
examples.english_sentence: The environment here has fostered many unique creatures.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間大學孕育咗好多傑出嘅人才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 daai6 hok6 wan6 juk6 zo2 hou2 do1 git6 cheut1 ge3 jan4 choi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所大学孕育了很多杰出的人才。
examples.english_sentence: This university has nurtured many outstanding talents.

english_meaning: double, twin, pair
explanation_mandarin: 表示两个、双数。通常指双胞胎，或者成对的东西。
explanation_english: Indicates two, double or pairs. Often refers to twins, or things that come in pairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係孖生姊妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 maa1 sang1 zi2 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们是双胞胎姐妹。
examples.english_sentence: They are twin sisters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我買咗孖裝可樂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 maa1 zong1 ho2 lok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我买了双包装可乐。
examples.english_sentence: I bought a double pack of Coke.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋孖住上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maa1 zyu6 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个一起上。
examples.english_sentence: They two go together.

english_meaning: Double B (BB)
explanation_mandarin: 指婴儿用的尿布品牌“帮宝适”（Pampers）的昵称，因其英文商标为“BB”而来。
explanation_english: A nickname for the Pampers diaper brand, derived from the "BB" in its logo.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋去買多幾包孖B啦，就嚟用晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 maai5 do1 gei2 baau1 maa1 bi1 laa1, zau6 lai4 yung6 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们去多买几包帮宝适吧，快用完了。
examples.english_sentence: Let's go buy a few more packs of Pampers, we're almost out.

english_meaning: Mercedes-Benz car
explanation_mandarin: 指梅赛德斯-奔驰（Mercedes-Benz）汽车。 其中“孖B”是“奔驰”的粤语谐音。
explanation_english: Refers to a Mercedes-Benz car. "Maa1 bi1" (孖B) is a Cantonese homophone for "Benz".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢揸緊架新款嘅孖B車，好型仔呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaa1 gan2 gaa3 san1 fun1 ge3 maa1 bi1 ce1, hou2 ying4 zai2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他开着一辆新款的奔驰车，好帅啊！
examples.english_sentence: He's driving a new Mercedes-Benz car, he looks so cool!

english_meaning: Double Q (playing cards); a particularly unlucky hand (referring to having two Queens in Texas Hold'em)
explanation_mandarin: 在德州扑克中，指手牌是两张Q（葵，也称皇后），有时意味着不太走运的牌。
explanation_english: In Texas Hold'em poker, it refers to having two Queens (Qs) as one's hole cards. Sometimes considered an unlucky or less desirable hand because it's easily beaten by higher pairs or drawing a better hand for opponents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唉，今晚手風唔順，攞親都係孖Q。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ai1, gam1 maan1 sau2 fung1 m4 seon6, lo2 can1 dou1 hai6 maa1 kiu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 唉，今晚手气不好，拿到的都是双Q。
examples.english_sentence: Sigh, my luck is bad tonight, I keep getting dealt double Qs.

english_meaning: Matching T-shirts (usually worn by couples or siblings); identical or paired items.
explanation_mandarin: 指两件一模一样的T恤，通常是情侣或兄弟姐妹穿的。引申为成双成对，相似的意思。
explanation_english: Refers to two identical T-shirts, usually worn by couples or siblings. By extension, it means 'a pair', 'identical', or 'matching'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋着住孖T，睇落好襯啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoek3 zyu6 maa1 ti1, tai2 lok6 hou2 can3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们穿着情侣T恤，看起来很配啊！
examples.english_sentence: They are wearing matching T-shirts, they look great together!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同細佬有件孖T，細個成日一齊着。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 sai3 lou2 jau5 gin6 maa1 ti1, sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和弟弟有一件一样的T恤，小时候经常一起穿。
examples.english_sentence: My younger brother and I have matching T-shirts, we used to wear them together all the time when we were young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢两间铺头嘅装修好似孖T咁，完全一样。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 leong5 gaan1 pou1 tau2 ge3 zong1 sau1 hou2 ci5 maa1 ti1 gam2, wun4 cyun4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两间店铺的装修就像一对T恤一样，完全一样。
examples.english_sentence: The decorations of these two shops are like matching T-shirts, completely the same.

english_meaning: twins
explanation_mandarin: 指同时出生的两个孩子，即双胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to two children born at the same time, i.e., twins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識得一對孖仔，佢哋兩個都好叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 dak1 jat1 deoi3 maa1 zai2, keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 dou1 hou2 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认识一对双胞胎，他们两个都很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: I know a pair of twins, they are both very smart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係孖仔，但係性格完全唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 maa1 zai2, daan6 hai6 sing3 gaak3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是双胞胎，但是性格完全不同。
examples.english_sentence: They are twins, but their personalities are completely different.

english_meaning: double portion; two shares
explanation_mandarin: 指两份相同的东西；双份。
explanation_english: Refers to two portions of the same thing; double portion; two shares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，我要孖份雲吞麵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, ngo5 jiu3 maa1 fan6 wan4 tan1 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦，我要双份的云吞面。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, I want a double portion of wonton noodles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋夾錢買禮物，佢出孖份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaap3 cin2 maai5 lai5 mat6, keoi5 ceot1 maa1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们凑钱买礼物，他出双份。
examples.english_sentence: We're pooling money to buy a gift, he's paying for two shares.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢食嘢好大食，成日都要孖份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sik6 je5 hou2 daai6 sik6, seng4 jat6 dou1 jiu3 maa1 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能吃，总是要双份。
examples.english_sentence: He eats a lot, he always needs a double portion.

english_meaning: Inseparable, like two dolls stuck together
explanation_mandarin: 形容两个人关系非常亲密，总是形影不离，像一对连体的娃娃一样。
explanation_english: Describes two people who are very close and always together, inseparable like two dolls attached to each other. It can also refer to matching items, usually in a pair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹成日孖公仔咁，去邊都一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui6 sing4 jat6 maa1 gung1 zai2 gam2, heoi3 bin1 dou1 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹总是形影不离的，去哪儿都一起。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters are always inseparable, going everywhere together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個人好似孖公仔咁，成日喺埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jan4 hou2 ci5 maa1 gung1 zai2 gam2, sing4 jat6 hai2 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个人就像形影不离一样，总是在一起。
examples.english_sentence: We are like inseparable dolls, always together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對孖公仔匙扣幾得意喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 maa1 gung1 zai2 ci4 kau3 gei2 dak1 ji3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这对连体钥匙扣挺可爱的。
examples.english_sentence: This pair of inseparable doll keychains is quite cute.

mandarin_meaning: 马叉, 蹩脚, 不好, 差劲
english_meaning: bad, lousy, terrible, awful; (referring to quality or performance)
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物质量不好，或者表现很差。通常带有轻蔑的语气。
explanation_english: Describes something of poor quality or performed poorly. Often carries a tone of contempt or disdain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食真係孖叉，唔好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 zan1 hai6 maa1 caa1, m4 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的东西真难吃，不好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food at this restaurant is really terrible, not tasty.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次考試考得好孖叉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 haau2 dak1 hou2 maa1 caa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次考试考得很差。
examples.english_sentence: He did terribly in the exam this time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好搞到咁孖叉啦，執醒啲佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gaau2 dou3 gam3 maa1 caa1 laa1, zap1 sing2 di1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要弄得那么糟糕，收拾得好一点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't make it so awful, tidy it up a bit.

mandarin_meaning: 两手空空; 白跑一趟; 一无所获
english_meaning: To come away empty-handed; to strike out; to draw a blank; to get nothing
explanation_mandarin: 指做了某件事却没有任何收获，最终结果是空手而归。通常用于描述努力之后没有得到预期的结果，例如寻找某物没有找到，或者投资失败。
explanation_english: Refers to doing something but gaining nothing; to end up empty-handed. It's often used to describe situations where efforts don't yield the expected results, such as searching for something unsuccessfully or failing in an investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今日去咗搵工，但係都係孖吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zo2 wan2 gung1, daan6 hai6 dou1 si6 maa1 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今天去找工作了，但是还是两手空空。
examples.english_sentence: I went to look for a job today, but I still came away empty-handed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢投資股票，點知孖吉，蝕咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau4 zi1 gu2 piu3, dim2 zi1 maa1 gat1, sit3 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他投资股票，没想到一无所获，亏了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He invested in stocks, but unexpectedly struck out and lost a lot of money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我搵咗成日都搵唔到條鎖匙，真係孖吉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 wan2 zo2 seng4 jat6 dou1 wan2 m4 dou2 tiu4 so2 si4, zan1 hai6 maa1 gat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我找了一整天都没找到钥匙，真是白跑一趟。
examples.english_sentence: I searched all day but couldn't find the key; it was a fruitless endeavor.

english_meaning: A pair (of police officers) patrolling together; partner; duo
explanation_mandarin: 指警察两个人一组进行巡逻。也泛指两人一组的搭档。
explanation_english: Refers to two police officers patrolling together. It can also refer to any pair of partners.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日孖咇喺條街度行嚟行去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 maa1 bit1 hai2 tiu4 gaai1 dou6 haang4 lai4 haang4 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是两人一组在这条街上走来走去。
examples.english_sentence: They always patrol this street as a pair.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋兩個係孖咇，一齊做呢個project。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 maa1 bit1, jat1 cai4 zou6 ni1 go3 project.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们两个是搭档，一起做这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We're partners, doing this project together.

mandarin_meaning: 双人自行车; 比喻关系密切的朋友或情侣
english_meaning: Tandem bicycle; Metaphor for close friends or lovers.
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是双人自行车。通常比喻关系非常亲密的朋友或情侣，他们像骑双人自行车一样，需要同步行动，互相配合。
explanation_english: Literally means a tandem bicycle. It's often used as a metaphor for close friends or lovers who need to coordinate and work together, like riding a tandem bicycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日一齊出現，真係好似孖啤車咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 jat1 cai4 ceot1 jin6, zan1 hai6 hou2 ci5 maa1 be1 ce1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个总是同时出现，真像骑双人自行车一样。
examples.english_sentence: Those two always appear together, just like riding a tandem bicycle.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同佢男朋友係孖啤車，去邊都一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 keoi5 naam4 pang4 jau5 hai6 maa1 be1 ce1, heoi3 bin1 dou1 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她和她男朋友形影不离，去哪里都一起。
examples.english_sentence: She and her boyfriend are inseparable; they go everywhere together.

english_meaning: equal, even, to be on par
explanation_mandarin: 表示双方实力或条件相同，势均力敌，不相上下。也指打平。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where two sides are equal in strength, ability, or condition; evenly matched; on par. Can also refer to a tie or draw.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個嘅實力孖四咁上下，好難分勝負。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 ge3 sat6 lik6 maa1 sei3 gam2 soeng1 haa6, hou2 naan4 fan1 sing3 fu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个的实力差不多，很难分出胜负。
examples.english_sentence: Their abilities are roughly equal, it's difficult to determine a winner.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋同對手打成孖四。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 tung4 deoi3 sau2 daa2 sing4 maa1 sei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们和对手打成了平局。
examples.english_sentence: We drew with our opponents in this match.

english_meaning: twin daughters
explanation_mandarin: 指双胞胎女儿。
explanation_english: Refers to twin daughters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企有對孖女，好得意㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 jau5 deoi3 maa1 neoi2, hou2 dak1 ji3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家有一对双胞胎女儿，很可爱的。
examples.english_sentence: They have twin daughters at home, they are very cute.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候成日都想有個孖女嘅細妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 dou1 soeng2 jau5 go3 maa1 neoi2 ge3 sai3 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候总是想要有个双胞胎妹妹。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I always wanted to have twin younger sisters.

english_meaning: a pair; duo; double treasure; a dynamic duo
explanation_mandarin: 原指成双成对的宝贝，现在多指合作默契的两人组合，或指某人重视的两个人/两件物品。
explanation_english: Originally referred to a pair of treasures. Now it often refers to a well-coordinated duo, or two people/items that someone values.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個簡直係最佳孖寶，合作無間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gaan2 zik6 hai6 zeoi3 gaai1 maa1 bou2, hap6 jok3 mou4 gaan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个简直是最佳搭档，合作无间。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are simply the best duo; their collaboration is seamless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對孖寶胎好得意呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 maa1 bou2 toi1 hou2 dak1 ji3 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这对双胞胎真可爱啊！
examples.english_sentence: These twins are so cute!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司嘅銷售孖寶，個個都覺得好勁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 ge3 siu1 sau6 maa1 bou2, go3 go3 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 ging6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司的销售双人组，每个人都觉得很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: Everyone thinks their company's sales duo is amazing.

mandarin_meaning: 双层巴士；双层公共汽车
english_meaning: Double-decker bus
explanation_mandarin: 香港粤语口语，指双层公共汽车，因为其形状像木屐叠加而成。
explanation_english: Cantonese slang for a double-decker bus, referring to its appearance resembling a pair of wooden clogs stacked on top of each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺巴士站等緊架孖屐亭，準備去尖沙咀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 baa1 si6 zaam6 dang2 gan2 gaa3 maa1 gik1 ting4, zeon2 bei6 heoi3 zim1 saa1 zeoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在巴士站等双层巴士，准备去尖沙咀。
examples.english_sentence: We're waiting for a double-decker bus at the bus stop, getting ready to go to Tsim Sha Tsui.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 坐孖屐亭上層風景好靚㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: co5 maa1 gik1 ting4 soeng6 cang4 fung1 ging2 hou2 leng3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 坐在双层巴士上层风景很漂亮的。
examples.english_sentence: The view from the upper deck of the double-decker bus is very beautiful.

english_meaning: Margin trading
explanation_mandarin: 指投资者使用少量自有资金，向券商借入资金进行股票或其他金融产品交易。借入资金的额度通常是自有资金的数倍，从而放大投资收益或损失。
explanation_english: Refers to trading on margin, where investors borrow funds from brokers to trade stocks or other financial instruments using only a small amount of their own capital. The amount borrowed is typically several times the investor's own capital, thereby amplifying both potential profits and losses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都用孖展炒股票，好刺激㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 yung6 maa1 zin2 caau2 gu2 piu3, hou2 ci1 gik1 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是用融资炒股票，很刺激的！
examples.english_sentence: He always uses margin to trade stocks, it's very exciting!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 玩孖展風險好大，要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waan2 maa1 zin2 fung1 him2 hou2 daai6, jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 玩保证金交易风险很大，要小心点。
examples.english_sentence: Margin trading is very risky, you have to be careful.

english_meaning: cheating (in an exam)
explanation_mandarin: 指在考试中通过不正当手段获取答案或帮助，以求取得更好的成绩。
explanation_english: Refers to using dishonest methods during an exam to obtain answers or assistance in order to achieve a better grade. It means to cheat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考試嘅時候孖必，畀老師捉到正。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 si5 ge3 si4 hau6 maa1 bit1, bei2 lou5 si1 zuk1 dou2 zeng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考试的时候作弊，被老师当场抓住了。
examples.english_sentence: He cheated during the exam and was caught red-handed by the teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好諗住孖必呀，靠自己實力先至係最好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 maa1 bit1 aa3, kaau3 zi6 gei2 sat6 lik6 sin1 zai3 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要想着作弊，依靠自己的实力才是最好的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think about cheating, relying on your own ability is the best.

english_meaning: twins
explanation_mandarin: 指同时出生的两个孩子，即双胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to two children born at the same time, i.e., twins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我朋友生咗孖指，一仔一女，好開心呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 saang1 zo2 maa1 zi2, jat1 zai2 jat1 neoi2, hou2 hoi1 sam1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的朋友生了双胞胎，一男一女，真开心啊！
examples.english_sentence: My friend gave birth to twins, a boy and a girl, so happy!

english_meaning: Twin popsicle; Twins (usually refers to ice cream, sometimes used figuratively for other pairs)
explanation_mandarin: 原指一种中间分开成两半的双条冰棍，可以两个人一起分享。现在也用来比喻其他成对出现的事物，例如双胞胎。
explanation_english: Originally refers to a type of popsicle that is split in the middle into two halves, allowing two people to share it. It is now also used metaphorically to describe other things that come in pairs, such as twins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時成日同阿哥一人一半食孖條。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4 seng4 jat6 tung4 aa3 go1 jat1 jan4 bun3 sik6 maa1 tiu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候经常和哥哥一人一半吃双条冰棍。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often shared a twin popsicle with my brother, half each.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹生得好似孖條咁，真係認唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 saang1 dak1 hou2 ci5 maa1 tiu4 gam3, zan1 hai6 jing6 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们姐妹俩长得像双胞胎一样，真的认不出来。
examples.english_sentence: Those two sisters look like twins, it's really hard to tell them apart.

english_meaning: so-so, just passable, mediocre
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物质量一般，不太好也不太坏，勉强过得去。
explanation_english: Describes something that is just average, not particularly good or bad, but barely acceptable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次考試嘅成績都係孖池頭啫，唔算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 haau2 si3 ge3 sing4 zik1 dou1 hai6 maa1 ci4 tau4 ze1, m4 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次考试的成绩也就是马马虎虎，不算好。
examples.english_sentence: The results of this exam are just so-so, not very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食都係孖池頭，唔算好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 dou1 hai6 maa1 ci4 tau4, m4 syun3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的食物也就是马马虎虎，不算好吃。
examples.english_sentence: The food in this restaurant is just passable, not very delicious.

english_meaning: Chinese-style sausage, glossy and plump
explanation_mandarin: 一种粤式腊肠，外表油润光亮，口感肥美。
explanation_english: A type of Cantonese sausage, characterized by its glossy, oily appearance and rich, fatty taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年買咗好多孖潤腸，過年嗰陣慢慢食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 maai5 zo2 hou2 do1 maa1 jeon6 coeng2, gwo3 nin4 go2 zan6 maan6 maan6 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今年买了好多润肠，过年的时候慢慢吃。
examples.english_sentence: We bought a lot of Chinese sausages this year to enjoy slowly during Chinese New Year.

english_meaning: Twins
explanation_mandarin: 指双胞胎，尤其是指长相非常相似的双胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to twins, especially identical twins who look very much alike. The literal meaning is "twin chimney," referring to the visual similarity of two chimneys standing side-by-side.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩姊妹係孖煙囪，唔係好熟嘅人好難分得出邊個打邊個。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zi2 mui2 hai6 maa1 jin1 cung1, m4 hai6 hou2 suk6 ge3 jan4 hou2 naan4 fan1 dak1 ceot1 bin1 go3 daa2 bin1 go3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两姐妹是双胞胎，不太熟悉的人很难分清楚谁是谁。
examples.english_sentence: The two sisters are twins, and it's hard for people who don't know them well to tell them apart.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋孖煙囪咁，着埋一樣衫，更加難認啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maa1 jin1 cung1 gam3, zoek3 maai4 jat1 joeng6 saam1, gang3 gaa1 naan4 jing6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们长得像双胞胎一样，还穿一样的衣服，更难认了。
examples.english_sentence: They look like twins, and they even wear the same clothes, making it even harder to recognise them.

english_meaning: Binoculars; Eyeglasses
explanation_mandarin: 原指双筒望远镜，因其有两个筒，像两个并排的烟囱。后来也用来指眼镜，尤其是指戴眼镜的人。
explanation_english: Originally refers to binoculars because they have two barrels, resembling two chimneys side by side. Later, it is also used to refer to eyeglasses, especially people wearing eyeglasses.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢戴咗副孖煙通，睇嘢清楚好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 fu3 maa1 jin1 tung1, tai2 je5 cing1 co2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他戴了副眼镜，看东西清楚很多。
examples.english_sentence: He put on his eyeglasses, and he can see things much clearer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 拎住個孖煙通，可以睇到遠啲嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ling1 zyu6 go3 maa1 jin1 tung1, ho2 ji5 tai2 dou2 jyun5 di1 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿着望远镜，可以看到远一些的东西。
examples.english_sentence: Holding the binoculars, you can see things that are further away.

english_meaning: twins
explanation_mandarin: 指一次怀孕生育的两个孩子，通常指同卵双胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to two children born from one pregnancy, usually referring to identical twins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係孖生嘅，樣好似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 maa1 sang1 ge3, joeng2 hou2 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是双胞胎，长得很像。
examples.english_sentence: They are twins, they look very alike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我識得一對孖生兄弟，佢哋都好叻仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sik1 dak1 jat1 deoi3 maa1 sang1 hing1 dai6, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hou2 lek1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我认识一对双胞胎兄弟，他们都很聪明。
examples.english_sentence: I know a pair of twin brothers, they are both very smart.

english_meaning: twins
explanation_mandarin: 指同一胎生的两个孩子。
explanation_english: Refers to two children born from the same pregnancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係孖胎，所以樣貌好似。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 maa1 toi1, so2 ji5 joeng2 maau6 hou2 ci5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是双胞胎，所以长得很像。
examples.english_sentence: They are twins, so they look very alike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿嫂生咗對孖胎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 so2 saang1 zo2 deoi3 maa1 toi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我嫂子生了一对双胞胎。
examples.english_sentence: My sister-in-law gave birth to a pair of twins.

english_meaning: Double serving of pork liver sausage, or figuratively: something occurring twice, or two things that are very similar (like twins)
explanation_mandarin: 字面上是指双份的猪肝肠。引申义可以表示同样的事物发生两次，或者两个非常相似的东西，如同双胞胎。
explanation_english: Literally means a double portion of pork liver sausage. Figuratively, it can mean something occurring twice, or two things that are very similar, like twins. The 'double' nature of the sausage is used as a comparison.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個孖膶腸咁，成日都一齊出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 maa1 jeon2 cheung2 gam2, seng4 jat6 dou1 jat1 cai4 cheot1 hin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个就像双份的猪肝肠一样，总是同时出现。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are like twins (or a double serving of liver sausage); they always appear together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今朝返工遲到，仲要畀老細鬧，真係孖膶腸咁嘅bad luck!
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ziu1 faan1 gung1 chi4 dou3, zung6 jiu3 bei2 lou5 sai3 naau6, zan1 hai6 maa1 jeon2 cheung2 gam3 ge3 bad luck!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天早上上班迟到，还要被老板骂，真是双重倒霉！
examples.english_sentence: I was late for work this morning, and I got scolded by the boss; it's like double bad luck!

english_meaning: Double cheese
explanation_mandarin: 指双份的芝士，通常用于快餐店点餐。
explanation_english: Refers to double cheese, usually used when ordering at fast food restaurants.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想嗌個孖芝漢堡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 aai3 go3 maa1 zi1 hon3 bou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想要一个双层芝士汉堡。
examples.english_sentence: I want a double cheese burger.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，要個孖芝，唔要洋蔥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, jiu3 go3 maa1 zi1, m4 jiu3 joeng4 cung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦，要一个双层芝士的，不要洋葱。
examples.english_sentence: Please, one with double cheese, no onions.

mandarin_meaning: 双胞胎；两张连在一起的叶子
english_meaning: Twins; Two leaves joined together (sometimes used to describe something linked or identical); Double feature (of movies)
explanation_mandarin: 原指两片连在一起的叶子，引申指双胞胎。也可用作电影的连映。
explanation_english: Originally referring to two leaves joined together, it is extended to mean twins. Can also be used to describe a double feature of movies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係孖葉嚟㗎，所以個樣咁似樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 maa1 jip6 lai4 gaa3, so2 ji5 go3 joeng2 gam3 ci5 joeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是双胞胎，所以长得这么像。
examples.english_sentence: They are twins, that's why they look so alike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日戲院做緊孖葉戲，可以一次過睇兩套戲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 hei3 yun2 zou6 gan2 maa1 jip6 hei3, ho2 ji5 jat1 ci3 gwo3 tai2 loeng5 tou3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天电影院正在放映连映电影，可以一次性看两部电影。
examples.english_sentence: Today the cinema is showing a double feature, you can watch two movies at once.

english_meaning: Double Steamed; Double Distilled (Rice Wine)
explanation_mandarin: 孖蒸是一种广东米酒，经过两次蒸馏，酒精度数较高，味道也更浓烈。
explanation_english: "Maa1 Zing1" is a type of Guangdong rice wine that undergoes a double distillation process. This results in a higher alcohol content and a stronger flavor compared to regular rice wine. It's a common ingredient in Cantonese cuisine and sometimes consumed directly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢支孖蒸好夠力呀，飲咗幾杯就覺得暈暈地。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zi1 maa1 zing1 hou2 gau3 lik6 aa3, yam2 zo2 gei2 bui1 zau6 gok3 dak1 wan4 wan4 dei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这瓶双蒸酒劲真大，喝了几杯就觉得有点晕。
examples.english_sentence: This bottle of double-distilled rice wine is strong. After drinking a few cups, I feel a bit dizzy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺好鍾意飲孖蒸，佢話可以暖身。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hou2 zung1 ji3 yam2 maa1 zing1, keoi5 waa6 ho2 ji5 nuun5 san1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷很喜欢喝双蒸，他说可以暖身。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather likes to drink double-distilled rice wine. He says it warms the body.

mandarin_meaning: （旧时称）男同性恋关系；断袖之癖
english_meaning: (old term) male homosexual relationship; a male couple
explanation_mandarin: 旧时对男同性恋关系的称谓，带有贬义。 相当于“断袖之癖”。
explanation_english: An old term for a male homosexual relationship, often with a negative connotation. Similar to '断袖之癖' in Mandarin, which refers to the practice of male homosexuality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個係孖襟㗎，成日都孖住出現。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 hai6 maa1 kam1 gaa3, seng4 jat6 dou1 maa1 zyu6 ceot1 hin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个是同性恋关系，总是成双成对地出现。
examples.english_sentence: They are a male couple, they always appear together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人會用「孖襟」嚟形容兩個男人嘅關係，但係依家比較少用喇。

examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zoeng1 sau1 geoi3 ge3 cyun4 gan1 ngo5 baai2 zo2 hai2 go3 file dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张收据的存根我放在了文件里。
examples.english_sentence: I've put the stub of this receipt in the file.

english_meaning: to file; to put on record; to register (with authorities)
explanation_mandarin: 指把某件事或某个文件记录下来，以便将来查阅或作为证据。
explanation_english: To file something for record-keeping purposes; to register something officially, usually with a government agency or other relevant authority. It implies the creation of a record for future reference or potential use as evidence.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份合約要攞去律師樓存案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hap6 joek3 jiu2 lo2 heoi3 leot6 si1 lau2 cyun4 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同要拿到律师事务所备案。
examples.english_sentence: This contract needs to be filed with the law firm.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將所有嘅投訴都存案處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 tau4 sou3 dou1 cyun4 on3 chu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们将所有的投诉都备案处理。
examples.english_sentence: We will file all complaints and handle them accordingly.

english_meaning: to archive; to save (a file)
explanation_mandarin: 指将文件、数据等保存起来，以便将来使用或恢复。
explanation_english: To save a file or data for future use or retrieval; to archive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記得要存檔呀，唔係陣間無咗就弊傢伙啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 dak1 jiu3 cyun4 dong2 aa3, m4 hai6 zan6 gaan1 mou5 zo2 zau6 bai6 gaa1 fo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记得要存档啊，不然等一下没了就糟糕了。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to save the file, otherwise it'll be terrible if it disappears later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日都唔記得存檔，搞到要做多次。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sing4 jat6 dou1 m4 gei3 dak1 cyun4 dong2, gaau2 dou3 jiu3 zou6 do1 ci3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我总是忘记存档，导致要做多次。
examples.english_sentence: I always forget to save, which leads to having to do it again.

english_meaning: deposit; bank savings
explanation_mandarin: 名词：存入银行的钱款。动词：把钱存入银行。
explanation_english: Noun: Money deposited in a bank. Verb: To deposit money in a bank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住下個月攞啲錢去銀行存款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 jyu6 haa6 go3 jyut6 lo2 di1 chin2 heoi3 ngan4 hong4 chyun4 款.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算下个月拿一些钱去银行存款。
examples.english_sentence: I plan to take some money to the bank to deposit next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲存款多到數都數唔晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 chyun4 款 do1 dou3 sou2 dou3 sou2 m4 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的存款多到数都数不清。
examples.english_sentence: His savings are so much that it is uncountable.

english_meaning: Certificate of Deposit (CD)
explanation_mandarin: 一种银行存款凭证，约定存款期限和利率，到期后可以取款。
explanation_english: A certificate issued by a bank to a person depositing money for a specified length of time at a specified interest rate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住買張三年嘅存款證，利息會高啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 jyu6 maai5 jeung1 saam1 nin4 ge3 chyun4款jing4, lei6 sik1 wui5 gou1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算买一张三年的存款证，利息会高一些。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of buying a three-year Certificate of Deposit; the interest rate will be higher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲存款證嘅利息都唔係好高，唔抵買。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yi4 ga1 di1 chyun4款jing4 ge3 lei6 sik1 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 gou1, m4 dai2 maai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的存款证的利息都不是很高，不划算。
examples.english_sentence: The interest rates on Certificates of Deposit aren't very high these days; it's not worth buying them.

english_meaning: to survive, to exist
explanation_mandarin: 指在困难或危险的情况下继续生存下去。
explanation_english: To continue to live or exist, especially in difficult or dangerous conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺噉惡劣嘅環境下，能夠存活落嚟真係好叻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gam2 ok3 lyut3 ge3 waan4 ging2 haa6, nang4 gau3 cyun4 wut6 lok6 lai4 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在这么恶劣的环境下，能够存活下来真的很厉害。
examples.english_sentence: It's really amazing to be able to survive in such harsh conditions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多動物都因為棲息地被破壞而難以存活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 dung6 mat6 dou1 yan1 wai4 cai1 sik1 dei6 bei2 po3 waai6 ji4 naan4 ji5 cyun4 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多动物都因为栖息地被破坏而难以生存。
examples.english_sentence: Many animals find it difficult to survive because their habitats have been destroyed.

mandarin_meaning: 怀疑, 疑问, 存有疑问
english_meaning: to have doubts; to be questionable; doubtful
explanation_mandarin: 表示心中存在疑问，对某事或某人的真实性、可靠性等持有怀疑态度。
explanation_english: To have doubts or reservations about something; to consider something questionable or uncertain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅講法存疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 gong2 faat3 cyun4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的说法存有疑问。
examples.english_sentence: I have doubts about what he said.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢嘅真相仍然存疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 ge3 zan1 seong3 jing4 jin4 cyun4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事的真相仍然存有疑问。
examples.english_sentence: The truth of this matter is still questionable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅能力有啲存疑。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 jau5 di1 cyun4 ji4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的能力有些令人怀疑。
examples.english_sentence: His ability is somewhat doubtful.

english_meaning: inventory, stock
explanation_mandarin: 指仓库里储存的货物。
explanation_english: Goods or items held in stock or inventory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間鋪頭啲存貨唔夠，好多嘢都賣晒啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou1 tau2 di1 cyun4 fo3 m4 gau3, hou2 do1 je5 dou1 maai6 saai3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺的库存不够，很多东西都卖完了。
examples.english_sentence: The shop doesn't have enough stock; many items are sold out.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要盤點一下存貨，睇下仲有幾多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 pun4 dim2 jat1 haa5 cyun4 fo3, tai2 haa5 zung6 jau5 gei2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要盘点一下库存，看看还有多少。
examples.english_sentence: We need to take stock to see how much inventory we have left.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司需要增加存貨，以應付聖誕節嘅需求。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 seoi1 jiu3 zeng1 gaa1 cyun4 fo3, ji5 ying3 fu6 sing3 daan3 zit3 ge3 seoi1 kau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司需要增加库存，以应付圣诞节的需求。
examples.english_sentence: The company needs to increase its stock to meet the demand for Christmas.

english_meaning: to save money
explanation_mandarin: 把钱储存起来，不使用，为了以后使用或增值。
explanation_english: To save money, usually in a bank account or other financial institution, for future use or investment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個月都會存錢，為咗將來買樓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 wui2 cyun4 cin2, wai6 zo2 zoeng1 loi4 maai5 lau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个月都会存钱，为了将来买房。
examples.english_sentence: I save money every month in order to buy a house in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最好存多啲錢，以備不時之需。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 hou2 cyun4 do1 di1 cin2, ji5 bei6 bat1 si4 zi1 seoi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最好多存点钱，以备不时之需。
examples.english_sentence: You'd better save more money for a rainy day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得存錢，儲咗好多錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 cyun4 cin2, cyu5 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很会存钱，存了很多钱。
examples.english_sentence: He is good at saving money and has saved a lot of money.

english_meaning: to inspire confidence; to trust; to believe in
explanation_mandarin: 使人信服，有信用；也指信任，信服。
explanation_english: To inspire confidence and trust in others; to be trustworthy. Also refers to the act of trusting or believing in something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅誠信好令人信孚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 sing4 seon3 hou2 ling6 jan4 seon3 fu1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的诚实非常令人信服。
examples.english_sentence: His honesty is very convincing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅能力好有信孚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 nang4 lik6 hou2 jau5 seon3 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对他的能力很有信心。
examples.english_sentence: I have a lot of confidence in his ability.

english_meaning: rash, impetuous, reckless
explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事鲁莽，不顾后果，非常冲动。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is rash, reckless, and doesn't consider the consequences of their actions; impetuous.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢條友仔好孛㗎，成日唔諗清楚就做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tiu4 jau5 zai2 hou2 but6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 m4 nim2 cing1 co2 zau6 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很鲁莽，总是没想清楚就做事。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very rash person, he always does things without thinking clearly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁孛啦，咁樣好容易出事㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 but6 laa1, gam2 joeng2 hou2 jung4 ji6 ceot1 si6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么鲁莽了，这样很容易出事的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so rash, it's easy to get into trouble that way.

english_meaning: diligent, industrious, hardworking
explanation_mandarin: 形容人勤劳努力，不懈怠。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is diligent, hardworking, and not slackening.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好孜，日頭黑夜都唔停手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zi1, jat6 tau4 hak1 je2 dou1 m4 ting4 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很勤奋，白天黑夜都不停手。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent at work, never stopping day or night.

english_meaning: diligent and tireless; assiduous
explanation_mandarin: 指勤奋努力，不知疲倦。
explanation_english: Describes being diligent and tireless in one's work or studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢孜孜不倦噉讀書，終於考到大學啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi1 zi1 bat1 gyun6 gam2 duk6 syu1, zung1 jyu1 haau2 dou2 daai6 hok6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他孜孜不倦地读书，终于考上大学了。
examples.english_sentence: He studied diligently and tirelessly, and finally got into university.

english_meaning: Cumin powder
explanation_mandarin: 由孜然种子磨成的粉末，常用作调味料。
explanation_english: Ground cumin, a spice made from the seeds of the Cuminum cyminum plant, commonly used as a seasoning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買啲孜然粉返屋企整羊肉串。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 di1 zi1 jin1 fan2 faan1 uk1 kei2 zing2 joeng4 juk6 cyun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买一些孜然粉回家做羊肉串。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy some cumin powder to make lamb skewers at home.

english_meaning: filial piety, to be filial
explanation_mandarin: 指尊敬、顺从父母长辈的美德。
explanation_english: Refers to the virtue of respecting and obeying one's parents and elders; filial piety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿仔好孝順父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 zai2 hou2 haau3 seon6 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 儿子很孝顺父母。
examples.english_sentence: The son is very filial to his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孝順，一定會照顧好屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 haau3 seon6, jat1 ding6 wui5 ziu3 gu3 hou2 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么孝顺，一定会照顾好家人。
examples.english_sentence: Because he is so filial, he will definitely take good care of his family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做到孝順仔女唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 dou2 haau3 seon6 zai2 neoi5 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做一个孝顺的子女不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to be a filial son or daughter.

english_meaning: ancestral hall; funeral hall; place where mourning rituals are conducted
explanation_mandarin: 指丧事期间设置的、供奉死者灵位的场所，通常设有祭坛、供品等。
explanation_english: A place where mourning rituals are conducted for the deceased, usually set up during a funeral. It typically includes an ancestral altar and offerings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺孝堂度守夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 haau3 tong4 dou6 sau2 je2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在灵堂守夜。
examples.english_sentence: They are holding a vigil in the funeral hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孝堂嘅布置好庄严。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau3 tong4 ge3 bou3 zi3 hou2 zong1 jim4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灵堂的布置很庄严。
examples.english_sentence: The arrangement of the funeral hall is very solemn.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孝堂里面好多人拜祭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau3 tong4 leoi5 min6 hou2 do1 jan4 baai3 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 灵堂里很多人祭拜。
examples.english_sentence: There are many people paying their respects in the funeral hall.

english_meaning: Filial son
explanation_mandarin: 指非常孝顺父母的儿子。
explanation_english: Refers to a son who is very filial to his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係一個孝子，對佢父母好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 haau3 zi2, deoi3 keoi5 fu6 mou5 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真是一个孝顺的儿子，对他父母很好。
examples.english_sentence: He's truly a filial son, very good to his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李先生個仔係個孝子，日日都打電話返屋企問候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 sin1 saang1 go3 zai2 hai6 go3 haau3 zi2, jat1 jat6 dou1 daa2 din6 waa2 faan1 uk1 kei2 man6 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生的儿子是个孝顺儿子，每天都打电话回家问候。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li's son is a filial son, calling home every day to check in.

mandarin_meaning: 孝顺的儿子和贤惠的孙子；孝子贤孙
english_meaning: Filial sons and virtuous grandsons; Used to praise descendants who are devoted to their ancestors and elders, especially during funerals or ancestral rites; ironical use for being servile.
explanation_mandarin: 指孝顺的儿子和贤惠的孙子。通常用来形容后代对祖先或长辈的孝顺和敬重，尤其是在葬礼或祭祀活动中。有时也带讽刺意味，形容人奴颜婢膝。
explanation_english: Refers to filial sons and virtuous grandsons. Usually used to describe the filial piety and respect of descendants towards ancestors or elders, especially during funerals or ancestral rites. Can sometimes be used ironically to describe someone who is overly servile or obsequious.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喪禮搞得咁盛大，就係想畀人覺得佢哋係孝子賢孫啫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 song3 lai5 gaau2 dak1 gam3 sing6 daai6, zau6 hai6 soeng2 bei2 jan4 gok3 dak1 keoi5 dei6 hai6 haau3 zi2 yin4 syun1 ze1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把葬礼办得这么盛大，就是想让人觉得他们是孝子贤孙罢了。
examples.english_sentence: They held such a grand funeral because they just wanted to make people think they are filial sons and virtuous grandsons.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺老闆面前乜都應承，真係似足個孝子賢孫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 mat1 dou1 ying3 sing4, zan1 hai6 ci5 zuk1 go3 haau3 zi2 yin4 syun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在老板面前什么都答应，真像个孝子贤孙。
examples.english_sentence: He agrees to everything in front of the boss, he really acts like a filial son and virtuous grandson.

english_meaning: filial piety; filial devotion
explanation_mandarin: 指子女尊敬、顺从、爱护父母的心意和行为。
explanation_english: Filial piety refers to the virtue of respecting, obeying, and caring for one's parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對阿爸阿媽好有孝心㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa1 hou2 jau5 haau3 sam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对爸爸妈妈很有孝心。
examples.english_sentence: He is very filial to his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想報答父母嘅養育之恩，所以好有孝心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 bou3 daap3 fu6 mou5 ge3 joeng5 juk6 zi1 jan1, so2 ji5 hou2 jau5 haau3 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想报答父母的养育之恩，所以很有孝心。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to repay his parents for raising him, so he is very filial.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁孝心，一定會照顧好屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 haau3 sam1, jat1 ding6 wui5 ziu3 gu3 hou2 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么孝顺，一定会照顾好家人。
examples.english_sentence: Being so filial, he will definitely take good care of his family.

english_meaning: to show filial piety and respect; to give a gift to one's elders as a sign of respect
explanation_mandarin: 指子女对父母长辈尽孝心，尊敬并给予物质上的供养。
explanation_english: To show filial piety and respect towards one's parents or elders, often by providing them with material support or gifts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 過年嘅時候，我哋應該孝敬吓阿爸阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwo3 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 haau3 ging3 haa5 aa3 baa4 aa3 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，我们应该孝敬一下爸爸妈妈。
examples.english_sentence: During the Lunar New Year, we should show our parents some filial piety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每年都會攞啲錢返屋企，孝敬父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 lo2 di1 chin2 faan1 uk1 kei2, haau3 ging3 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每年都会拿一些钱回家，孝敬父母。
examples.english_sentence: He takes some money home every year to show filial piety to his parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲係我哋嘅心意，孝敬你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 sam1 yi3, haau3 ging3 nei1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些是我们的心意，孝敬您的。
examples.english_sentence: These are our regards, a gift to show our respect for you.

english_meaning: mourning clothes
explanation_mandarin: 指丧事期间穿的白色或素色的衣服，表示对逝者的哀悼。
explanation_english: Mourning attire; traditionally white or plain-colored clothing worn during a funeral or mourning period to express grief for the deceased.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋全家都著住孝服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 cyun4 gaa1 dou1 zoek3 zyu6 haau3 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家都穿着孝服。
examples.english_sentence: The whole family is wearing mourning clothes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時嘅孝服好多時都係麻布造嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 ge3 haau3 fuk6 hou2 do1 si4 dou1 hai6 maa4 bou3 zou6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的孝服很多时候都是麻布做的。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, mourning clothes were often made of hemp.

english_meaning: filial piety and righteousness; loyalty and filial devotion
explanation_mandarin: 指既孝顺父母，又有情有义，讲义气。 强调一个人在家庭和朋友之间都表现出良好的品德。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is both filial to their parents and righteous, emphasizing loyalty and moral character in both family and friendship contexts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好孝義嘅人，對屋企人好好，對朋友又好夠義氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 haau3 ji6 ge3 jan4, deoi3 uk1 kei2 jan4 hou2 hou2, deoi3 pang4 jau5 jau6 hou2 gau3 ji6 hei3.

examples.english_sentence: He is a very filial and righteous person; he treats his family well and is also very loyal to his friends.

english_meaning: filial piety; the respect and obedience shown to one's parents and ancestors
explanation_mandarin: 指子女对父母的尊敬、顺从和赡养，以及对祖先的祭祀。
explanation_english: Refers to the respect, obedience, and support that children show to their parents, as well as the worship of ancestors.

examples.english_sentence: Filial piety is an important value in traditional Chinese culture.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視孝道，所以對佢父母好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 haau3 dou6, so2 ji5 deoi3 keoi5 fu6 mou5 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重视孝道，所以对他的父母很好。
examples.english_sentence: He values filial piety a lot, so he treats his parents very well.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 現今社會，孝道嘅定義都有啲改變。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin6 gam1 se5 wui2, haau3 dou6 ge3 ding6 ji6 dou1 jau5 di1 goi2 bin3.

examples.english_sentence: In today's society, the definition of filial piety has changed somewhat.

english_meaning: filial piety, to be filial, dutiful to parents
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 形容词 (xíng róng cí), 动词 (dòng cí)
explanation_mandarin: 指对父母尊敬顺从，尽心奉养。
explanation_english: To show respect, obedience, and care to one's parents; filial piety.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢真係好孝順，日日都煲湯畀佢阿媽飲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 haau3 seon6, jat1 jat1 dou1 bou1 tong1 bei2 keoi5 aa3 maa1 jam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他真的很孝顺，每天都煲汤给他妈妈喝。
examples.english_sentence: He is really filial, he makes soup for his mother to drink every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做仔女嘅，孝順父母係應份嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 zai2 neoi5 ge3, haau3 seon6 fu6 mou5 hai6 jing1 fan6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为子女，孝顺父母是应该的。
examples.english_sentence: As children, it is our duty to be filial to our parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望我嘅仔女大個咗之後會孝順我。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望我的子女长大后会孝顺我。
examples.english_sentence: I hope that my children will be filial to me when they grow up.

mandarin_meaning: 鲁莽的; 猛撞; 凶猛的

explanation_mandarin: 形容人做事鲁莽，不顾后果；或形容猛烈的撞击。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is rash and reckless, not considering the consequences of their actions; can also describe a fierce collision or impact.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好孟，做嘢唔經大腦。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很鲁莽，做事不经过大脑。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very rash person and doesn't think before he acts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車好孟咁撞埋去，搞到好多人受傷。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 车子很猛地撞过去，导致很多人受伤。
examples.english_sentence: The car crashed fiercely into it, causing many injuries.

english_meaning: Bangladesh

explanation_english: Bangladesh, a country in South Asia.

english_meaning: Mencius, a Chinese philosopher (372–289 BC)
explanation_mandarin: 孟子，名轲，字子舆，战国时期思想家、教育家，儒家代表人物之一。
explanation_english: Mencius, born Meng Ke, also known as Ziyu, was a Chinese philosopher and educator during the Warring States period, and one of the representative figures of Confucianism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今日要讀孟子嘅其中一篇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 jiu3 duk6 maang6 zi2 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 pin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今天需要读孟子的其中一篇。
examples.english_sentence: We need to read one of Mencius' essays today.

english_meaning: Mumbai (Bombay), India
explanation_mandarin: 印度的城市，舊稱孟買。
explanation_english: City in India, formerly known as Bombay.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我下個月會去孟買做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 heoi3 maang6 maai2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我下个月会去孟买工作。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Mumbai to work next month.

english_meaning: saliva, drool, spit
explanation_mandarin: 指口水、唾液。
explanation_english: Refers to saliva, drool, or spit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日吐孢啦，污糟邋遢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tou3 paau1 laa1, wu1 zou1 laat3 taat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要老是吐口水，脏兮兮的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't spit all the time, it's dirty.

examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 sai3 lou2 fan3 gaau3 go2 zan6 si4 lau4 saai3 paau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个小孩睡觉的时候流了一堆口水。
examples.english_sentence: That kid drooled a lot while sleeping.

english_meaning: season
explanation_mandarin: 一年中的一个时段，根据气候或其他特点划分。
explanation_english: A period of the year characterized by specific weather conditions or other features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅雨季通常喺夏天。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 jyu5 gwai3 tung1 soeng4 hai2 haa6 tin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的雨季通常在夏天。
examples.english_sentence: The rainy season in Hong Kong is usually in summer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最鍾意秋季，因為天氣唔熱又唔凍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 cau1 gwai3, jan1 wai6 tin1 hei3 m4 jit6 jau6 m4 dung3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最喜欢秋季，因为天气不热也不冷。
examples.english_sentence: I like autumn the most, because the weather is neither hot nor cold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅菜單會根據季節嚟轉換。

explanation_english: A seasonal wind that reverses its direction between summer and winter, often bringing heavy rainfall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港夏天嘅天氣好受季候風影響，成日落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 haa6 tin1 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 sau6 gwai3 hau6 fung1 jing2 hoeng2, seng4 jat6 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港夏天的天气很容易受到季风影响，经常下雨。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's summer weather is greatly affected by monsoons, and it rains often.

english_meaning: quarterly (publication)
explanation_mandarin: 指每三个月出版一次的刊物。
explanation_english: A publication issued four times a year, or once every three months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本季刊啲文章都幾高質素㗎。

english_meaning: preseason (sports)

examples.english_sentence: We have a preseason game tomorrow, see you then!

examples.english_sentence: The results of the preseason don't mean anything, what matters most is performing well in the regular season.

english_meaning: end of the season; end of the quarter
explanation_mandarin: 指一个季节的末尾。常用于商业语境，例如季度结算或季度促销等。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of a season or quarter, often used in a business context such as quarterly settlements or seasonal promotions.

synonyms: 年尾 (if referring to end of year)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擺出一副高高在上嘅姿態，搞到冇人敢埋佢身，真係做到孤家寡人噉樣。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是摆出一副高高在上的姿态，搞得没人敢靠近他，真像个孤家寡人。

english_meaning: stingy, miserly, tight-fisted

examples.english_sentence: Don't be so stingy; buy yourself a gift to make yourself happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢孤寒到出晒名㗎啦，唔好期望佢會請你飲嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gu1 hon4 dou3 chut1晒 ming4 gaa3 laa1, m4 hou2 kei1 mong6 keoi5 wui5 ceng2 nei5 jam2 je5.

english_meaning: miser, stingy person, cheapskate

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬咗去外國之後，佢成日都覺得好有孤獨感。

explanation_english: Refers to a single man and a single woman, often implying that something inappropriate or ambiguous might happen if they are alone together.

english_meaning: isolated; to isolate; to be left out

examples.english_sentence: On the battlefield, if you lose your comrades, it is easy to fall into a state of being isolated and without help.

explanation_mandarin: 中国古典小说《西游记》中的主角，是一只神通广大的猴子，又称齐天大圣。
explanation_english: The main character in the classic Chinese novel "Journey to the West", a powerful monkey also known as the Monkey King.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嘅時候，我最鍾意睇《西遊記》，尤其係孫悟空。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 tai2 "sai1 jau4 gei3", jau4 kei4 hai6 syun1 ng6 hung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我最喜欢看《西游记》，尤其是孙悟空。
examples.english_sentence: When I was a kid, I loved watching "Journey to the West", especially Sun Wukong.

explanation_english: To carry something on one's back.

examples.english_sentence: He carried a lot of things up the mountain.

english_meaning: To shoulder responsibility; to take the blame; to carry the burden
explanation_mandarin: 指承担责任或替别人受过。类似“背锅”。
explanation_english: Refers to taking responsibility or taking the blame for someone else. Similar to "to take the blame" or "to carry the can". The literal meaning is to carry something on your back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 老細將啲鑊孭晒上我身，真係唔抵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lou5 sai3 zoeng1 di1 wok6 me1 saai3 soeng5 ngo5 san1, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2.

examples.english_sentence: The boss put all the blame on me; it's really not worth it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好乜都孭上身，有啲嘢唔係你嘅責任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mat1 dou1 me1 soeng5 san1, jau5 di1 je5 m4 hai6 nei5 ge3 zaak3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要什么都揽在自己身上，有些事情不是你的责任。
examples.english_sentence: Don't take on everything, some things are not your responsibility.

english_meaning: to carry a child on one's back
explanation_mandarin: 用背部背负孩子。
explanation_english: To carry a child on one's back, usually using a carrier or by holding the child directly against one's back.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢孭住個仔行咗好耐，都唔覺得攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 be1 zyu6 go3 zai2 haang4 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 m4 gok3 dak1 gui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她背着孩子走了很久，都不觉得累。
examples.english_sentence: She carried her child on her back for a long time, and didn't feel tired at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲阿婆成日孭住個孫出去玩。
