examples.english_sentence: He has to shoulder the main responsibility for this project, the pressure must be huge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺套戲入面孭重飛，演技好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 tou3 hei3 jap6 min6 me1 cung5 fei1, jin2 gei6 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在这部电影里担任主角，演技很好。
examples.english_sentence: He played the leading role in this movie and his acting was excellent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好乜都叫我孭重飛，我都會攰㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 mat1 dou1 giu3 ngo5 me1 cung5 fei1, ngo5 dou1 wui5 gui6 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要什么都叫我承担重任，我也会累的！
examples.english_sentence: Don't ask me to take on all the responsibility, I get tired too!

english_meaning: To carry heavy items on one's back; to carry a heavy burden (literal or figurative)
explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是背着铁，通常指背负很重的东西。也引申为背负重担或责任。
explanation_english: Literally means 'carrying iron' on the back. It generally refers to carrying heavy items on one's back. It can also be used figuratively to describe carrying a heavy burden or responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日都要孭鐵返工，好辛苦㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 dou1 jiu3 me1 tit3 faan1 gung1, hou2 san1 fu2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都要背着重物上班，很辛苦的。
examples.english_sentence: He has to carry heavy things to work every day, it's very tiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人孭鐵成頭家，真係好叻女。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 me1 tit3 sing4 tau4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 neoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她一个人承担整个家庭的重担，真的很能干。
examples.english_sentence: She carries the burden of the whole family alone, she's really capable.

english_meaning: to take the blame for something (that one did not do); to be scapegoated
explanation_mandarin: 比喻替别人承担责任或罪责，通常指替别人背黑锅。
explanation_english: A metaphor for taking the blame or responsibility for someone else's wrongdoing, typically meaning to be a scapegoat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事衰咗，一定係我孭鑊㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 seoi1 zo2, jat1 ding6 hai6 ngo5 me1 wok6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次事情搞砸了，肯定是我背黑锅了。
examples.english_sentence: This time the matter is ruined, I'll definitely be the one to take the blame.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫老細孭鑊，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 lou5 sai3 me1 wok6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是帮老板背黑锅，真可怜。
examples.english_sentence: He always takes the blame for his boss, it's really pitiful.

english_meaning: to shoulder responsibility; to take the fall (for someone)
explanation_mandarin: 承担责任，尤指承担不应该承担的责任或替他人承担责任。
explanation_english: To take responsibility, especially taking responsibility that one shouldn't have to, or taking the fall for someone else's mistake or wrong-doing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次件事咁大鑊，唔通要我一個人孭飛咩？
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 gin6 si6 gam3 daai6 wok6, m4 tung1 jiu3 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 me1 fei1 me1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次事情这么严重，难道要我一个人承担责任吗？
examples.english_sentence: This incident is so serious, are you saying I have to take the fall all by myself?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做錯嘢，唔好諗住叫我幫你孭飛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 co3 je5, m4 hou2 lam2 zyu6 giu3 ngo5 bong1 nei5 me1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做错了事，别想着让我帮你承担责任。
examples.english_sentence: You messed up, don't think about asking me to take the blame for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老闆衰咗，佢要孭飛辭職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 baan2 seoi1 zo2, keoi5 jiu3 me1 fei1 ci4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的老板犯事了，他要承担责任辞职。
examples.english_sentence: His boss did something wrong, he has to take the blame and resign.

english_meaning: Twins
explanation_mandarin: 指双胞胎，尤指同卵双胞胎。
explanation_english: Refers to twins, especially identical twins.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係一對孮嚟㗎，樣好似㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 jat1 deoi3 sung1 lai4 gaa3, joeng2 hou2 ci5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是一对双胞胎，长得很像。
examples.english_sentence: They are twins, they look very alike.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好想有個孮細佬妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 soeng2 jau5 go3 sung1 sai3 lou2 mui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很想有一个双胞胎弟弟妹妹。
examples.english_sentence: When I was young, I really wanted to have twin younger siblings.

english_meaning: which (one); which (of two or more); which is better
explanation_mandarin: 表示疑问或选择的代词，相当于“哪个”、“哪一个”。 多用于书面语或较为正式的场合。
explanation_english: A pronoun indicating a question or choice, equivalent to "which one" or "which". Mostly used in written language or more formal settings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 孰可忍，孰不可忍？
examples.jyutping_sentence: suk6 ho2 jan2, suk6 bat1 ho2 jan2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 哪个能忍受，哪个不能忍受？
examples.english_sentence: Which is tolerable, and which is intolerable?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 兩者孰優孰劣？
examples.jyutping_sentence: loeng5 ze2 suk6 jau1 suk6 lyut3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 两者哪个更好哪个更差？
examples.english_sentence: Which of the two is better and which is worse?

english_meaning: weak, feeble, frail, lacking in strength
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体或意志软弱无力。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is physically or mentally weak and lacking in strength.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好孱，成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 saan4, seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很虚弱，经常生病。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very weak person and gets sick often.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁孱啦，振作啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 saan4 laa1, zan3 jok3 di1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么软弱了，振作一点！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so weak, cheer up!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好睇佢細細粒，其實佢好鬼馬，一啲都唔孱。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 tai2 keoi5 sai3 sai3 lap1, kei4 sat6 keoi5 hou2 gwai2 maa5, jat1 di1 dou1 m4 saan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要看她小小的，其实她很聪明，一点都不软弱。
examples.english_sentence: Don't look at her being small, she is actually very clever and not weak at all.

english_meaning: weak, feeble, frail, delicate
explanation_mandarin: 形容身体虚弱，缺乏力量；也可形容意志薄弱。
explanation_english: Describes a person's physical weakness and lack of strength; can also describe a weak will.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢自細身體都好孱弱，成日病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zi6 sai3 san1 tai2 dou1 hou2 caan4 joek6, seng4 jat6 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小身体就很虚弱，经常生病。
examples.english_sentence: He has been weak since he was a child and is often sick.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁孱弱啦，企起身試吓！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 caan4 joek6 laa1, kei5 hei2 san1 si3 haa5!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么软弱了，站起来试试！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so weak, stand up and try!

mandarin_meaning: 滋生, 生长, 繁殖
english_meaning: to breed, to grow, to multiply, to produce
explanation_mandarin: （文言）滋生；生长；繁殖。通常不单独使用，更多出现在成语或词组中。
explanation_english: (Classical Chinese) To breed, grow, multiply, produce. Usually not used alone, but more often appears in idioms or phrases.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好容易孳生蚊嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 jung4 ji6 zi1 sang1 man1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很容易滋生蚊子。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong is very prone to breeding mosquitoes.

english_meaning: assiduous and tireless; diligent and never weary
explanation_mandarin: 形容工作或学习勤奋不知疲倦。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is diligent and never tires of working or studying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做研究嘅時候，永遠都係孳孳不倦，好值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 jin4 gau3 ge3 si4 hau6, wing5 jyun5 dou1 hai6 zi1 zi1 bat1 gyun6, hou2 dak1 zik6 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做研究的时候，永远都是孜孜不倦的，很值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: When he does research, he is always assiduous and tireless, which is worth learning from.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爸教我做功課嘅時候，都係孳孳不倦咁教，好有耐心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 baa4 gaau3 ngo5 zou6 gung1 fo3 ge3 si4 hau6, dou1 hai6 zi1 zi1 bat1 gyun6 gam2 gaau3, hou2 jau5 noi6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爸爸教我做功课的时候，都是孜孜不倦地教，很有耐心。
examples.english_sentence: When Dad teaches me homework, he teaches assiduously and patiently.

english_meaning: to incubate; to hatch
explanation_mandarin: 鸟类伏在卵上使其孵化，或用人工方法保持适宜的温度使卵孵化。
explanation_english: To sit on eggs to hatch them; to incubate eggs using artificial methods to maintain a suitable temperature for hatching.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雞喺度孵蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gai1 hai2 dou6 fu1 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 母鸡正在孵蛋。
examples.english_sentence: The hen is incubating the eggs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想孵啲小雞出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 fu1 di1 siu2 gai1 ceot1 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想孵出一些小鸡。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to hatch some chicks.

english_meaning: to incubate, to hatch; (figurative) to foster, to incubate (ideas, projects, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指通过适宜的温度和湿度使卵发育成熟并破壳而出；也比喻培养、扶植使事物发展成熟。
explanation_english: Literally refers to the process of incubating eggs to hatch them. Figuratively, it means to foster, cultivate, or nurture something to develop and mature, such as ideas, projects, or talents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 隻雞喺度孵化緊啲蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zek3 gai1 hai2 dou6 fu1 faa3 gan2 di1 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这只鸡正在孵化鸡蛋。
examples.english_sentence: This chicken is incubating the eggs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司有個孵化器，幫啲初創企業發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jau5 go3 fu1 faa3 hei3, bong1 di1 co1 cong3 kei5 jip6 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司有一个孵化器，帮助初创企业发展。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has an incubator to help startups develop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃醞釀咗好耐，而家終於開始孵化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 wan3 joeng6 zo2 hou2 noi6, ji4 gaa1 zung1 jyu1 hoi1 ci2 fu1 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划酝酿了很久，现在终于开始孵化了。
examples.english_sentence: This plan has been brewing for a long time, and now it's finally starting to incubate.

mandarin_meaning: 待在家里；赋闲；无所事事
english_meaning: To stay at home and do nothing; to be unemployed; to be a couch potato
explanation_mandarin: 原意是母鸡孵蛋，引申指人待在家里无所事事，没有工作或不出去活动。
explanation_english: Literally, it means a hen incubating eggs. Figuratively, it means a person staying at home doing nothing, unemployed, or not going out to socialize.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失業之後日日都喺屋企孵蛋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 fu1 daan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失业之后每天都在家待着。
examples.english_sentence: He has been staying at home doing nothing every day since he lost his job.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放假梗係要出街玩啦，唔好成日喺屋企孵蛋啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 gaa3 gang2 hai6 jiu3 ceot1 gaai1 waan2 laa1, m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 fu1 daan2 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放假当然要出去玩了，不要总是待在家里。
examples.english_sentence: Of course, you should go out and have fun during the holidays, don't just stay at home all the time.

english_meaning: to learn, to study, to imitate
explanation_mandarin: 学习，模仿；模仿
explanation_english: To learn, to study; to imitate; to acquire knowledge or skills through instruction or experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家學緊廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hok6 gan2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在正在学习粤语。
examples.english_sentence: I am currently learning Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學人講嘢嘅語氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 jan4 gong2 je5 ge3 jyu5 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学别人说话的语气。
examples.english_sentence: He is imitating the way other people speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要努力啲學先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 nou5 lik6 di1 hok6 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要努力点学才行。
examples.english_sentence: You need to study harder in order to succeed.

english_meaning: to imitate; to mimic; to copy someone
explanation_mandarin: 指模仿别人，通常带有贬义，暗示模仿得不好或是不自然。
explanation_english: Refers to imitating someone, often with a negative connotation, implying that the imitation is poor or unnatural.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日學人講英文，但係講到唔湯唔水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hok6 jan4 gong2 jing1 man2, daan6 hai6 gong2 dou3 m4 tong1 m4 seoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是学别人说英语，但是说得不伦不类。
examples.english_sentence: He always tries to imitate others speaking English, but he speaks it very poorly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好淨係學人，要有自己嘅風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hok6 jan4, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要只是模仿别人，要有自己的风格。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just imitate others, you need to have your own style.

english_meaning: to apply what one has learned
explanation_mandarin: 学习到的知识或技能，能够运用到实际工作中。
explanation_english: To put what one has learned into practice; to apply knowledge gained from study to practical situations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀完大學之後，最緊要嘅就係學以致用，將啲知識應用喺工作上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 jyun4 daai6 hok6 zi1 hau6, zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 ge3 zau6 hai6 hok6 ji5 zi3 yung6, zoeng1 di1 zi1 sik1 jing3 jung6 hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大学毕业后，最重要的是学以致用，把知识应用到工作上。
examples.english_sentence: After graduating from university, the most important thing is to apply what you've learned, to apply the knowledge to your work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好叻，可以學以致用，所以好快就上手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 lek1, ho2 ji5 hok6 ji5 zi3 yung6, so2 ji5 hou2 faai3 zau6 soeng5 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很厉害，能够学以致用，所以很快就上手了。
examples.english_sentence: He is very capable, he can apply what he has learned, so he got the hang of it quickly.

english_meaning: to imitate, to mimic, to copy
explanation_mandarin: 模仿，学着像。
explanation_english: To imitate or mimic someone or something, trying to be similar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥最鍾意學似大人講嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 go1 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 hok6 ci5 daai6 jan4 gong2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子最喜欢模仿大人说话。
examples.english_sentence: Children like to imitate adults when they speak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係學似人哋，要有自己嘅風格。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 hok6 ci5 jan4 dei6, jiu3 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fung1 gaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只是模仿别人，要有自己的风格。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just imitate others, you need to have your own style.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學似啲明星嘅打扮，但係唔係好襯佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 ci5 di1 ming4 sing1 ge3 daa2 bun3, daan6 hai6 m4 hai6 hou2 can3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她模仿那些明星的打扮，但是不太适合她。
examples.english_sentence: She imitates the dressing style of those celebrities, but it doesn't really suit her.

english_meaning: academic degree
explanation_mandarin: 指高等教育机构授予的证明学历水平的证书，如学士、硕士、博士学位。
explanation_english: An academic degree is a qualification awarded to students upon successful completion of a course of study in higher education, such as a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個碩士學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 sek6 si6 hok6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到了硕士学位。
examples.english_sentence: He obtained a master's degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多工都需要大學學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 gung1 dou1 seoi1 jiu3 daai6 hok6 hok6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多工作都需要大学学位。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many jobs require a university degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讀緊咩學位呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 gan2 me1 hok6 wai2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你正在读什么学位呀？
examples.english_sentence: What degree are you studying for?

english_meaning: Graduate teacher
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有学士学位或以上学历的教师。
explanation_english: Refers to a teacher who possesses a bachelor's degree or higher qualification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校好多老師都係學位教師，所以教學質素都幾高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 hou2 do1 lou5 si1 dou1 hai6 hok6 wai2 gaau3 si1, so2 ji5 gaau3 hok6 zat1 so3 dou1 gei2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校很多老师都是学位教师，所以教学质量都挺高的。
examples.english_sentence: Many teachers in our school are graduate teachers, so the quality of teaching is quite high.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成為學位教師，起碼都要有個學士學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 wai4 hok6 wai2 gaau3 si1, hei2 maa5 dou1 jiu3 jau5 go3 hok6 si6 hok6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成为学位教师，至少也要有个学士学位。
examples.english_sentence: To become a graduate teacher, you need at least a bachelor's degree.

english_meaning: to imitate foreigners, to act like a foreigner
explanation_mandarin: 指模仿外国人的言行举止，通常带有一定的贬义或调侃意味。
explanation_english: To imitate the behavior, mannerisms, or lifestyle of foreigners. Often used with a slightly derogatory or mocking connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日學佬咁講英文，聽到我都覺得尷尬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hok6 lou2 gam2 gong2 jing1 man4, teng1 dou2 ngo5 dou1 gok3 dak1 gaam3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是学外国人那样说英语，听得我都觉得尴尬。
examples.english_sentence: He always speaks English imitating foreigners, it's embarrassing for me to listen to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好成日學佬啦，做返自己咪幾好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hok6 lou2 laa1, zou6 faan1 zi6 gei2 mai1 gei2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要总是学外国人了，做回自己不是很好吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't always try to act like a foreigner, isn't it good to just be yourself?

english_meaning: credit (academic)
explanation_mandarin: 指在学校或大学里，完成一门课程后所获得的积分，是衡量学生学习成果和毕业资格的重要指标。
explanation_english: Academic credit: A unit that represents the completion of an academic course, used as a measure of a student's progress towards a degree or qualification.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要讀夠一百二十個學分先可以畢業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 duk6 gau3 jat1 bak3 ji6 sap6 go3 hok6 fan1 sin1 ho2 ji5 bat1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你必须修满一百二十个学分才可以毕业。
examples.english_sentence: You need to accumulate 120 credits to graduate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢科有三個學分，都幾重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fo1 jau5 saam1 go3 hok6 fan1, dou1 gei2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这门课有三个学分，挺重要的。
examples.english_sentence: This course is worth three credits, it's quite important.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爭一個學分就夠畢業，點算啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zaang1 jat1 go3 hok6 fan1 zau6 gau3 bat1 jip6, dim2 syun3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我差一个学分就够毕业了，怎么办啊？
examples.english_sentence: I'm just one credit short of graduating, what should I do?

english_meaning: education system; school system
explanation_mandarin: 指一个国家或地区教育机构的组织、结构、入学年龄、修业年限等方面的制度。
explanation_english: Refers to the system of education in a country or region, including the organization, structure, entrance age, and duration of study in educational institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅學制同英國嘅學制有啲唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hok6 zai3 tung4 jing1 gwok3 ge3 hok6 zai3 jau5 di1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的学制和英国的学制有些不同。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's education system is somewhat different from the UK's.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你對依家嘅學制有咩睇法？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 deoi3 ji1 ga1 ge3 hok6 zai3 jau5 me1 tai2 faat3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你对现在的学制有什么看法？
examples.english_sentence: What are your thoughts on the current education system?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人覺得香港嘅學制太過注重考試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 gok3 dak1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 hok6 zai3 taai3 gwo3 zyu3 zung6 haau2 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人觉得香港的学制太过注重考试。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think that Hong Kong's education system focuses too much on exams.

english_meaning: preschool; pre-primary; before school age
explanation_mandarin: 指上小学之前的阶段。
explanation_english: Refers to the period before starting primary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個女而家讀緊學前班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 neoi5 ji4 gaa1 duk6 gan2 hok6 cin4 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我女儿现在正在读学前班。
examples.english_sentence: My daughter is in preschool now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學前教育對小朋友嘅發展好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 cin4 gaau3 juk6 deoi3 siu2 pang4 jau5 ge3 faat3 zin2 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学前教育对小朋友的发展很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Preschool education is very important for children's development.

english_meaning: preschool, kindergarten
explanation_mandarin: 指幼儿进入小学前接受教育的班级。
explanation_english: A class or school for young children, typically aged 3-5, before they start formal schooling (primary school/elementary school). It prepares children for primary school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個仔今年喺度讀緊學前班，下年就升小學喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 zai2 gam1 nin4 hai2 dou6 duk6 gan2 hok6 cin4 baan1, haa6 nin4 zau6 sing1 siu2 hok6 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的儿子今年在这里读学前班，明年就要上小学了。
examples.english_sentence: My son is in preschool here this year, and he will be going to primary school next year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得小朋友讀學前班有冇用㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 siu2 pang4 jau5 duk6 hok6 cin4 baan1 jau5 mou5 jung6 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得小朋友读学前班有用吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think it's useful for children to attend preschool?

english_meaning: educational background; academic qualifications
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人接受教育的程度，通常以获得的文凭或证书来衡量。
explanation_english: Refers to the level of education a person has attained, usually measured by the diplomas or certificates they have obtained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份工好睇重學歷㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 gung1 hou2 tai2 zung6 hok6 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工作很看重学历。
examples.english_sentence: His job places a lot of emphasis on educational qualifications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 宜家啲公司請人，好多都要求大學學歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gung1 si1 ceng2 jan4, hou2 do1 dou1 jiu1 kiu4 daai6 hok6 hok6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多公司招聘都要求大学学历。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many companies require a university degree when hiring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學歷唔高，但係經驗好豐富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 lik6 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 ging1 gim6 hou2 fung1 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学历不高，但是经验很丰富。
examples.english_sentence: His educational background is not high, but his experience is very rich.

english_meaning: scientific name; technical name
explanation_mandarin: 指事物在科学或学术领域中使用的正式名称，通常用于避免歧义。
explanation_english: Refers to the formal name used for something in scientific or academic fields, usually to avoid ambiguity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你知唔知呢種植物嘅學名係咩呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 ni1 zung2 zik6 mat6 ge3 hok6 ming4 hai6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你知道这种植物的学名叫什么吗？
examples.english_sentence: Do you know what the scientific name of this plant is?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日用啲學名嚟扮嘢，其實都唔係好識。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sing4 jat6 yung6 di1 hok6 ming4 lai4 baan6 je5, kei4 sat6 dou1 m4 hai6 hou2 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们总是用一些学名来装样子，其实也不是很懂。
examples.english_sentence: They always use some technical terms to pretend, but they don't really understand it.

english_meaning: Trainee; student; participant (in a course, program, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指参加学习或培训的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who participates in learning or training.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋呢班學員下個禮拜要去實習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ni1 baan1 hok6 jyun4 haa6 go3 lai5 baai1 jiu3 heoi3 sat6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们这批学员下个星期要去实习。
examples.english_sentence: Our group of trainees will go for internship next week.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司搞咗個培訓班，招募咗一批學員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 gaau2 zo2 go3 pui4 fan3 baan1, ziu1 muk6 zo2 jat1 bat1 hok6 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们公司举办了一个培训班，招募了一批学员。
examples.english_sentence: Their company organized a training course and recruited a batch of trainees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新入職嘅學員要接受三個月嘅培訓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 jap6 zik1 ge3 hok6 jyun4 jiu3 zip3 sau6 saam1 go3 jyut6 ge3 pui4 fan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新入职的学员要接受三个月的培训。
examples.english_sentence: Newly hired trainees need to receive three months of training.

english_meaning: knowledge, learning, scholarship
explanation_mandarin: 指有系统的知识或学识。
explanation_english: Refers to systematic knowledge or learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學問好深。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 man6 hou2 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学问很深。
examples.english_sentence: His knowledge is very profound.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢有好多學問喺裏面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 jau5 hou2 do1 hok6 man6 hai2 leoi5 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些东西里面有很多学问。
examples.english_sentence: There's a lot of knowledge in these things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人處世都係一門學問。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 cyu2 sai3 dou1 hai6 jat1 mun4 hok6 man6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人处世都是一门学问。
examples.english_sentence: Conducting oneself in the world is a subject of study.

english_meaning: to learn something; to acquire skills or knowledge; to be taught a lesson (often a hard one)
explanation_mandarin: 学习东西，获取知识或技能。也可以指某人经历了一次教训，学到了东西（通常是不好的教训）。
explanation_english: To learn something, acquire knowledge or skills. It can also refer to someone learning a lesson, often a hard or unpleasant one, through experience.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我最近喺公司學緊好多嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 hai2 gung1 si1 hok6 gan2 ho2 do1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我最近在公司学很多东西。
examples.english_sentence: I'm learning a lot of things at the company recently.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次瀨嘢，學到嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 laai6 je5, hok6 dou2 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次出事了，学到教训了。
examples.english_sentence: He messed up this time and learned a lesson.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你跟師傅學嘢要用心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gan1 si1 fu2 hok6 je5 jiu3 yung6 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你跟师傅学东西要用心点。
examples.english_sentence: You should be more attentive when learning from your master.

english_meaning: school, academy (often referring to older, traditional schools)
explanation_mandarin: 指旧时的学校，或指某些特殊训练机构，如警官学校。
explanation_english: Refers to a school in the old days, or certain special training institutions, such as a police academy. Can also be used to generally refer to a school, often implying a more traditional setting or historical context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我爺爺嗰陣讀書唔係喺普通學校，係喺舊式嘅學堂讀嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je4 je2 go2 zan6 duk6 syu1 m4 hai6 hai2 pou2 tung1 hok6 haau6, hai6 hai2 gau6 sik1 ge3 hok6 tong4 duk6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷那时候读书不是在普通学校，是在旧式的学堂读的。
examples.english_sentence: Back in my grandfather's time, he didn't study in a regular school, he studied in an old-fashioned schoolhouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲學堂好注重傳統文化教育嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 hok6 tong4 hou2 zyu3 zung6 cyun4 tung2 man4 faa3 gaau3 juk6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的学堂很注重传统文化教育的。
examples.english_sentence: In the old days, schoolhouses emphasized traditional cultural education.

english_meaning: academic journal, scholarly journal
explanation_mandarin: 学术期刊，通常由大学或研究机构出版，发表学术研究成果。
explanation_english: An academic journal, typically published by universities or research institutions, that publishes academic research findings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢篇論文發表咗喺大學嘅學報上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 pin1 leon6 man4 faat3 biu2 zo2 hai2 daai6 hok6 ge3 hok6 bou3 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的论文发表在大学的学报上。
examples.english_sentence: His paper was published in the university's academic journal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫學報嘅文章要好嚴謹㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 hok6 bou3 ge3 man4 zoeng1 jiu3 hou2 jim4 gan2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写学报的文章要非常严谨的。
examples.english_sentence: Writing articles for academic journals requires high precision.

english_meaning: to become bad, to go astray, to learn bad habits
explanation_mandarin: 指学习到不好的行为或习惯，变坏。
explanation_english: To learn bad habits or behaviors; to go astray; to become bad, especially due to negative influences or exposure to undesirable behaviors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個嗰陣冇人管，好易學壞㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 mou5 jan4 gun2, hou2 ji6 hok6 waai6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他小时候没人管，很容易学坏的。
examples.english_sentence: When he was young, nobody looked after him, so it was easy for him to pick up bad habits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日同啲壞朋友玩，費事學壞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 tung4 di1 waai6 pang4 jau5 waan2, fai3 si6 hok6 waai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要整天和坏朋友玩，免得学坏。
examples.english_sentence: Don't always hang out with bad friends, in case you learn bad habits.

english_meaning: Bachelor's degree; Bachelor
explanation_mandarin: 高等教育的第一级学位，通常指完成本科课程并获得证书的人。
explanation_english: The first level of academic degree awarded by a university or college, usually after completing a bachelor's program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢攞咗個電腦科學嘅學士學位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lo2 zo2 go3 din6 nou5 fo1 hok6 ge3 hok6 si6 hok6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他拿到了一个计算机科学的学士学位。
examples.english_sentence: He obtained a bachelor's degree in computer science.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿明係一個物理學學士。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 ming4 hai6 jat1 go3 mat6 lei5 hok6 hok6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 阿明是一个物理学学士。
examples.english_sentence: Ah Ming is a Bachelor of Physics.

english_meaning: Female junior (student)
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一学校或机构，比自己年级低的女性学生。
explanation_english: Refers to a female student who is in a lower grade than oneself in the same school or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋ocamp識咗好多靚女學妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 o1 cam1 sik1 zo2 ho2 do1 leng3 neoi2 hok6 mui6-2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在迎新营认识了很多漂亮的女学妹。
examples.english_sentence: We met a lot of pretty female juniors during the orientation camp.

english_meaning: Senior female student; female schoolmate who is older or in a higher grade
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己年長或高年級的女同學或女學姐。
explanation_english: Refers to a female student who is older or in a higher grade than oneself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我成日問個學姊借啲 notes 嚟溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 seng4 jat6 man6 go3 hok6 zi2 ze3 di1 notes lai4 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我常常问学姐借一些笔记来复习。
examples.english_sentence: I often ask my senior to borrow some notes to study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個關係好好，學姊好照顧學妹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2, hok6 zi2 hou2 ziu3 gu3 hok6 mui6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她们两个关系很好，学姐很照顾学妹。
examples.english_sentence: They have a good relationship; the senior student takes good care of the junior student.

english_meaning: female senior student
explanation_mandarin: 指在同一学校或机构比自己年长的女性学生。
explanation_english: Refers to a female student who is older and/or in a higher grade than oneself in the same school or institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個學姐好照顧我，成日教我功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 hok6 ze2 hou2 ziu3 gu3 ngo5, sing4 jat6 gaau3 ngo5 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的学姐很照顾我，经常教我功课。
examples.english_sentence: My female senior student takes good care of me and often helps me with my homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今年好多學姐都畢業走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gam1 nin4 hou2 do1 hok6 ze2 dou1 bat1 jip6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说今年很多学姐都毕业走了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that many female senior students have graduated and left this year.

mandarin_meaning: 家; 专家; -学家 (接在学科名词后表示从事该学科研究的人)
english_meaning: -ist; -ologist; expert; specialist; (suffix indicating a specialist in a field of study)
explanation_mandarin: 后缀，接在学科名词后表示从事该学科研究的人或在某方面有专长的人。也可以指“家”的意思，例如科学家。
explanation_english: Suffix used after a field of study to denote a person who studies or specializes in that field. It can also mean 'family' or 'expert'. Analogous to '-ist' or '-ologist' in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 科學家喺實驗室做緊研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fo1 hok6 gaa1 hai2 sat6 jim6 sat1 zou6 gan2 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 科学家在实验室做研究。
examples.english_sentence: Scientists are doing research in the laboratory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係語言學家，對唔同嘅語言好有研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jyu5 jin4 hok6 gaa1, deoi3 m4 tung4 ge3 jyu5 jin4 hou2 jau5 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是语言学家，对不同的语言很有研究。
examples.english_sentence: He is a linguist and has done a lot of research on different languages.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺係個木匠學家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 hai6 go3 muk6 zoeng6 hok6 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷是个木匠世家。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather's family are carpenters.

mandarin_meaning: 学富五车 (xué fù wǔ chē)
english_meaning: To be extremely learned; erudite; to have a great store of knowledge
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人学问渊博，知识丰富，像用五辆车才能装下的书那么多。
explanation_english: Describes a person who is extremely learned and knowledgeable, possessing so much knowledge that it would fill five carts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀咁多書，真係學富五車呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gam3 do1 syu1, zan1 hai6 hok6 fu3 ng5 ce1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他读了这么多书，真是学富五车啊。
examples.english_sentence: He's read so many books, he's truly extremely learned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要喺呢個領域成為專家，你都要學富五車先得㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hai2 ni1 go3 ling5 wik6 sing4 wai4 zhun1 ga1, nei5 dou1 jiu3 hok6 fu3 ng5 ce1 sin1 dak1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要想在这个领域成为专家，你也要学富五车才行啊。
examples.english_sentence: If you want to become an expert in this field, you need to be extremely learned.

english_meaning: to be an apprentice; apprenticeship
explanation_mandarin: 指跟随师傅学习技艺或技能。也可以指学徒的身份或阶段。
explanation_english: To learn a trade or skill by working under a master; apprenticeship. It can also refer to the status or stage of being an apprentice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家喺髮型屋學師，希望將來可以自己開鋪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 hai2 faat3 ying4 uk1 hok6 si1, hei1 mong6 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 zi6 gei2 hoi1 pou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在理发店当学徒，希望将来可以自己开店。
examples.english_sentence: He's currently an apprentice in a hair salon, hoping to open his own shop in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學師嗰陣時真係好辛苦，日日都要幫師傅做嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 si1 go2 zan6 si4 zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2, jat1 jat1 dou1 jiu3 bong1 si1 fu2 zou6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当学徒的时候真的很辛苦，每天都要帮师傅做事。
examples.english_sentence: It was really tough when I was an apprentice, having to help the master with work every day.

english_meaning: apprentice, trainee
explanation_mandarin: 指正在学习手艺或技能的人，通常跟在师傅身边学习。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is learning a trade or skill, usually working under the guidance of a master or experienced person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢依家喺間車房做學師仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji1 gaa1 hai2 gaan1 ce1 fong2 zou6 hok6 si1 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在在一家修车厂做学徒。
examples.english_sentence: He is now working as an apprentice in a garage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做學師仔頭幾年通常都係比較辛苦嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hok6 si1 zai2 tau4 gei2 nin4 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 bei2 gaau3 san1 fu2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 当学徒的头几年通常都比较辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: The first few years of being an apprentice are usually quite hard.

english_meaning: academic year; school year
explanation_mandarin: 学校教育系统中的一年，通常从秋季开始到次年夏季结束。
explanation_english: A year in the educational system, usually starting in the fall and ending in the summer of the following year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新嘅學年就嚟開始喇，你有冇準備好呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ge3 hok6 nin4 zau6 lei4 hoi1 ci2 laa3, nei5 jau5 mou5 zyun2 bei6 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新的学年就要开始了，你有没有准备好啊？
examples.english_sentence: The new academic year is about to start, are you ready?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個學年嘅目標係攞到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hok6 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 lo2 dou2 hou2 sing4 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个学年的目标是取得好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: The goal for this academic year is to get good grades.

mandarin_meaning: 野鸡大学, 以盈利为目的的学校
english_meaning: Diploma mill, degree mill, for-profit school (pejorative)
explanation_mandarin: 指一些以盈利为主要目的，教学质量低劣，主要靠卖文凭赚钱的学校。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to schools that primarily aim to profit, with low teaching quality and mainly earn money by selling diplomas. Usually used in a pejorative way.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰間大學都係間學店嚟㗎，讀完出嚟都冇人認。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 gaan1 daai6 hok6 dou1 hai6 gaan1 hok6 dim3 lei4 gaa3, duk6 jyun4 chut1 lai4 dou1 mou5 jan4 jing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那所大学就是一间野鸡大学，读完出来也没人认可。
examples.english_sentence: That university is just a diploma mill, no one recognizes its graduates.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好信佢哋嘅廣告啦，好多都係學店嚟，呃人錢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seon3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwong2 gou3 laa1, hou2 do1 dou1 hai6 hok6 dim3 lei4, aak1 jan4 cin2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要相信他们的广告，很多都是野鸡大学，骗人钱的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't trust their advertisements, many of them are diploma mills, just cheating people out of their money.

english_meaning: institution of learning; academic institution
explanation_mandarin: 指高等教育机构，如大学。
explanation_english: Refers to an institution of higher education, such as a university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成功考入咗香港大學呢間學府。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 gung1 haau2 jap6 zo2 hoeng1 gong2 daai6 hok6 ni1 gaan1 hok6 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他成功考入了香港大学这所学府。
examples.english_sentence: He successfully got into the University of Hong Kong, this academic institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學府嘅聲譽好好，好多學生都想入去讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 fu2 ge3 seng1 jyu6 hou2 hou2, hou2 do1 hok6 sang1 dou1 soeng2 jap6 heoi3 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学府的声誉很好，很多学生都想进去读书。
examples.english_sentence: The reputation of this institution is very good; many students want to study there.

english_meaning: to learn to be a chef; to study cooking
explanation_mandarin: 学习烹饪技术，成为厨师。
explanation_english: To learn cooking skills to become a chef; to study culinary arts.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始學廚，依家已經係五星級酒店嘅總廚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 chi2 hok6 cyu4, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 ng5 sing1 kap1 zau2 dim3 ge3 zung2 cyu4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学厨，现在已经是五星级酒店的总厨了。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning to cook since he was young and is now the head chef of a five-star hotel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住退休之後學廚，開間小餐廳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 teoi3 jau1 zi1 hau6 hok6 cyu4, hoi1 gaan1 siu2 chaan1 teng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算退休之后学厨师，开一家小餐厅。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of learning to cook after I retire and opening a small restaurant.

english_meaning: junior schoolmate (male)
explanation_mandarin: 指比自己低年级的男同学。
explanation_english: A male student who is in a lower grade than oneself; junior schoolmate (male).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我個學弟好勤力㗎，成日喺圖書館溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 go3 hok6 dai6 hou2 kan4 lik6 gaa3, seng4 jat6 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的学弟很勤奋，经常在图书馆复习。
examples.english_sentence: My junior schoolmate is very diligent, he's always studying in the library.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講今年好多靚仔學弟入咗嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 gam1 nin4 hou2 do1 leng3 zai2 hok6 dai6 jap6 zo2 lai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说今年有很多帅气的学弟进来了。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that many handsome junior schoolmates joined this year.

english_meaning: apprentice
explanation_mandarin: 指跟随师傅学习技术的人。
explanation_english: A person who is learning a trade or skill from a master craftsman or experienced professional.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢而家做緊電工學徒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 din6 gung1 hok6 tou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他现在做电工学徒。
examples.english_sentence: He is working as an electrician's apprentice now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做學徒頭幾年人工唔高嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 hok6 tou4 tau4 gei2 nin4 yan4 gung1 m4 gou1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做学徒头几年工资不高的。
examples.english_sentence: The salary for an apprentice in the first few years is not high.

english_meaning: to complete one's studies; to finish learning; to become proficient through study
explanation_mandarin: 完成学业；学有所成。
explanation_english: To complete one's studies successfully; to become proficient in a skill or subject through learning and practice.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗英國留學五年，終於學成返嚟啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ying1 gwok3 lau4 hok6 ng5 nin4, jung1 jyu1 hok6 sing4 faan1 lai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去英国留学五年，终于学成回来了。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the UK to study for five years and has finally completed his studies and returned.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望我可以努力啲，早啲學成，報答父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 nu5 lik6 di1, zou2 di1 hok6 sing4, bou3 daap3 fu6 mou5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望我可以努力一些，早点学成，报答父母。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can work harder, finish my studies sooner, and repay my parents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要學成一門手藝唔係一件容易嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 hok6 sing4 jat1 mun4 sau2 ngai6 m4 hai6 jat1 gin6 yung4 yi6 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要学成一门手艺不是一件容易的事。
examples.english_sentence: Mastering a craft is not an easy task.

english_meaning: to learn martial arts; to study boxing
explanation_mandarin: 学习拳术，练习武术。
explanation_english: To learn and practice martial arts, specifically boxing or other related fighting styles.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候都有學拳㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 dou1 jau5 hok6 kyun4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候也学过拳的。
examples.english_sentence: I learned martial arts when I was a kid.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想學拳嚟保護自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 hok6 kyun4 lai4 bou2 wu6 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想学拳来保护自己。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to learn martial arts to protect himself.

english_meaning: to mimic fighting; to play fight (usually among children)
explanation_mandarin: 指小孩子模仿大人打架，或者互相嬉闹打闹。
explanation_english: Refers to children mimicking adults fighting or playfully wrestling and fighting with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔成日學斗，搞到周身傷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 zai2 sing4 jat6 hok6 dau2, gaau2 dou3 zau1 san1 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子们整天模仿打架，弄得全身是伤。
examples.english_sentence: The kids are always play fighting, getting themselves hurt all over.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日學斗，但係其實感情好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 sing4 jat6 hok6 dau2, daan6 hai6 kei4 sat6 gam2 cing4 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个经常打闹，但其实感情很好。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always play fighting, but they actually have a very good relationship.

mandarin_meaning: 鹦鹉学舌；照搬照抄；生搬硬套
english_meaning: parrot fashion; to parrot; to imitate slavishly; to copy blindly
explanation_mandarin: 指像鹦鹉学舌一样，不理解事物本质，只是单纯地模仿或照搬别人的行为或说法。带有贬义，形容人没有自己的思考和判断。
explanation_english: Refers to imitating or copying someone else's actions or words without understanding the essence of the matter, like a parrot repeating words. It has a negative connotation, describing someone who lacks their own thinking and judgment and simply copies what others do or say.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日學斗白人哋講嘢啦，自己諗下好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 hok6 dau2 baak6 jan4 dei6 gong2 je5 laa1, zi6 gei2 lam2 haa5 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要总是鹦鹉学舌别人说话，自己想想更好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just parrot what other people say all the time, think for yourself instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份報告完全係學斗白人哋嘅，冇自己嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bou3 gou3 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 hok6 dau2 baak6 jan4 dei6 ge3, mou5 zi6 gei2 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的报告完全是照搬别人的，没有自己的意见。
examples.english_sentence: His report is completely copied from others, without his own opinions.

english_meaning: to learn to distinguish right from wrong; to learn to tell the difference between what is right and what is wrong; to discern good from evil
explanation_mandarin: 學習分辨事情的對與錯。通常指開始學習判斷是非對錯的能力。
explanation_english: To learn to distinguish between right and wrong. It usually refers to the beginning of learning the ability to judge right and wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路哥開始返學就係學是學非嘅時候。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou6 go1 hoi1 chi2 faan1 hok6 zau6 hai6 hok6 si6 hok6 fei1 ge3 si4 hau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子开始上学就是学习明辨是非的时候。
examples.english_sentence: When children start school, it's the time they begin to learn to distinguish right from wrong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁快判斷，俾佢哋學是學非下先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 faai3 pun3 dyun6, bei2 keoi5 dei6 hok6 si6 hok6 fei1 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要这么快判断，让他们学习分辨是非一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't judge so quickly, let them learn to distinguish right from wrong first.

english_meaning: To learn to gossip, to learn to be malicious, to pick up bad habits of spreading rumors and causing trouble.
explanation_mandarin: 指开始学习说人坏话，搬弄是非，变得爱挑拨离间。
explanation_english: Refers to learning to gossip, spread rumors, and become prone to stirring up trouble. It implies picking up bad habits of speaking ill of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細路仔唔好俾佢學是非，教壞佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 lou2 zai2 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 hok6 si6 fei1, gaau3 waai6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小孩子不要让他学坏，教坏他了。
examples.english_sentence: Don't let the child learn bad habits and start gossiping, it will corrupt him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢返咗新公司之後，成日學是非，變得好乞人憎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faan1 zo2 san1 gung1 si1 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 hok6 si6 fei1, bin3 dak1 hou2 hat1 jan4 zang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了新公司之后，总是学坏，变得很令人讨厌。
examples.english_sentence: After he joined the new company, he kept picking up bad habits of spreading rumors and became very annoying.

english_meaning: to learn; to master; to acquire (knowledge or skill); school association; learned society
explanation_mandarin: 1. 动词：学习并掌握；学会了某种技能或知识。 2. 名词：学校或学术机构的学会组织。
explanation_english: 1. Verb: To learn; to master; to acquire a skill or knowledge. 2. Noun: An association or society, often academic or related to a school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我學會咗點樣用筷子喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 wui2 zo2 dim2 joeng2 jung6 faai3 zi2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我已经学会怎么用筷子了。
examples.english_sentence: I have already learned how to use chopsticks.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋學校有個攝影學會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hok6 haau6 jau5 go3 se3 ying2 hok6 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们学校有个摄影学会。
examples.english_sentence: Their school has a photography club.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你學會游水未呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 hok6 wui2 jau4 seoi2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你学会游泳了吗？
examples.english_sentence: Have you learned how to swim yet?

english_meaning: to achieve academic success; to make accomplishments in one's studies
explanation_mandarin: 指在学习方面取得了成就，学业有成。
explanation_english: Refers to having achieved success in learning or studies; to have made accomplishments in academics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望你將來學有所成，貢獻社會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 nei5 jeung1 loi4 hok6 jau5 so2 sing4, gung3 hin3 se5 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望你将来学有所成，贡献社会。
examples.english_sentence: I hope that you will achieve academic success in the future and contribute to society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好努力讀書，希望第日學有所成，可以報答父母。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1, hei1 mong6 dai6 jat6 hok6 jau5 so2 sing4, ho2 ji5 bou3 daap3 fu6 mu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很努力读书，希望将来学有所成，可以报答父母。
examples.english_sentence: He studies very hard, hoping to achieve academic success in the future so that he can repay his parents.

english_meaning: semester; term
explanation_mandarin: 学校一年里分为几个学期，每个学期都有一定的教学计划和考核。
explanation_english: A division of the academic year in schools, each with a defined curriculum and assessment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個學期我讀咗五科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 duk6 zo2 ng5 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个学期我读了五门课。
examples.english_sentence: I took five courses this semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 下個學期我想去交流。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haa6 go3 hok6 kei4 ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 gaau1 lau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 下个学期我想去交流。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go on exchange next semester.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋就快放學期假喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zau6 faai3 fong3 hok6 kei4 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们快要放学期假了！
examples.english_sentence: We're almost on semester break!

english_meaning: school
explanation_mandarin: 提供教育的機構。
explanation_english: An institution for educating children or students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日唔使返學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明天不用回学校。
examples.english_sentence: We don't have to go back to school tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校很大。
examples.english_sentence: This school is very big.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺邊間學校讀書啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 duk6 syu1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在哪所学校读书啊？
examples.english_sentence: Which school does he study at?

english_meaning: academic studies, schoolwork
explanation_mandarin: 指学习的事务或成就，通常指在学校或教育机构中的学习。
explanation_english: Refers to the work or achievements in learning, usually in school or other educational institutions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學業成績好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 jip6 sing4 jik1 ho2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学业成绩很好。
examples.english_sentence: His academic performance is very good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你最近學業忙唔忙啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zeoi3 gan6 hok6 jip6 mong4 m4 mong4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你最近学业忙不忙啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you busy with your studies lately?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想專心搞好學業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zyun1 sam1 gaau2 hou2 hok6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想专心搞好学业。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to concentrate on doing well in his studies.

english_meaning: educational background; academic qualifications
explanation_mandarin: 指个人的教育程度或所获得的学历证书。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's level of education or the academic qualifications they have obtained.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學歷好高，係博士嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 lik6 hou2 gou1, hai6 bok3 si6 lai4 ga3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学历很高，是博士。
examples.english_sentence: His educational background is very high, he's a PhD.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份工好睇學歷，最少都要大學畢業先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 gung1 hou2 tai2 hok6 lik6, zeoi3 siu2 dou1 jiu3 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份工作很看重学历，最少也要大学毕业才行。
examples.english_sentence: This job values educational background, you need at least a university degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲公司請人好重視學歷，有番個大學學位都好啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gung1 si1 ceng2 jan4 hou2 zung6 si6 hok6 lik6, jau5 faan1 go3 daai6 hok6 hok6 wai2 dou1 hou2 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多公司招聘都很重视学历，有个大学学位也好一些。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays companies value educational qualifications a lot when hiring, it's better to have a university degree.

english_meaning: school (of thought)
explanation_mandarin: 指学术上的流派，拥有共同的理论体系和观点。
explanation_english: A school of thought, referring to a group of people who share a common theoretical system or viewpoint in academic disciplines.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係唔同嘅學派，所以好多嘢都唔同意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 m4 tung4 ge3 hok6 paai3, so2 ji5 ho2 do1 je5 dou1 m4 tung4 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是不同的学派，所以很多东西都意见不一致。
examples.english_sentence: They belong to different schools of thought, so they have different opinions on many things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經濟學有好多唔同嘅學派，例如凱恩斯主義同埋自由市場學派。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging1 zai3 hok6 jau5 ho2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 hok6 paai3,例 如 hoi2 yan1 si1 zyu2 ji6 tung4 maai4 zi6 jau4 si5 coeng4 hok6 paai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 经济学有很多不同的学派，例如凯恩斯主义和自由市场学派。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different schools of thought in economics, such as Keynesianism and the free market school.

jyutping: hok6 hoi2 mou4 ngaai4, wai4 kan4 si6 ngon6
mandarin_meaning: 学海无涯，唯勤是岸 (xué hǎi wú yá, wéi qín shì àn)
english_meaning: The sea of knowledge is boundless; diligence is the only shore.
explanation_mandarin: 形容知识的海洋是无边无际的，只有勤奋学习才能到达彼岸。劝勉人们勤奋学习。
explanation_english: This idiom describes the ocean of knowledge as boundless and endless. Only through diligent study can one reach the shore. It encourages people to study hard and be diligent in their learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁輕易放棄啊，記住學海無涯，唯勤是岸。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 hing1 ji6 fong3 hei3 aa3, gei3 zyu6 hok6 hoi2 mou4 ngaai4, wai4 kan4 si6 ngon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么轻易放弃啊，记住学海无涯，唯勤是岸。
examples.english_sentence: Don't give up so easily. Remember, the sea of knowledge is boundless; diligence is the only shore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然讀書好辛苦，但係要記住學海無涯，唯勤是岸，努力啲就會成功嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 duk6 syu1 hou2 san1 fu2, daan6 hai6 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 hok6 hoi2 mou4 ngaai4, wai4 kan4 si6 ngon6, nu5 lik6 di1 zau6 wui5 sing4 gung1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然读书很辛苦，但是要记住学海无涯，唯勤是岸，努力点就会成功的。
examples.english_sentence: Although studying is hard, remember the sea of knowledge is boundless, and diligence is the only shore. If you work harder, you will succeed.

english_meaning: learner's permit, learner's license
explanation_mandarin: 指学习驾驶时所需要的临时执照或许可证，允许持有者在有经验的驾驶员陪同下合法上路学习驾驶。
explanation_english: A learner's permit or license that allows someone to learn to drive under the supervision of a licensed driver.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啱啱攞咗學牌，開始學揸車啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 lo2 zo2 hok6 paai4, hoi1 ci2 hok6 zaa1 ce1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我刚刚拿到学习驾驶执照，开始学开车了。
examples.english_sentence: I just got my learner's permit and I'm starting to learn how to drive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞咗學牌之後，記得搵個有經驗嘅司機教你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 zo2 hok6 paai4 zi1 hau6, gei3 dak1 wan2 go3 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 si1 gei1 gaau3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿到学习驾驶执照之后，记得找个有经验的司机教你。
examples.english_sentence: After getting your learner's permit, remember to find an experienced driver to teach you.

english_meaning: student
explanation_mandarin: 指在学校或其他教育机构接受教育的人。
explanation_english: A person who is studying at a school or other educational institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我係一個大學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai6 jat1 go3 daai6 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是一个大学生。
examples.english_sentence: I am a university student.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋係中學生，要準備考公開試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai6 zung1 hok6 sang1, jiu3 zeon2 bei6 haau2 gung1 hoi1 si5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们是中学生，要准备考公开试。
examples.english_sentence: They are secondary school students and need to prepare for the public exams.

english_meaning: Students; school children
explanation_mandarin: 指学生，通常带有亲切或调侃的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to students or school children, often used with a friendly or slightly teasing tone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲學生哥放學喇，好鬼嘈。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hok6 sang1 go1 fong3 hok6 laa3, hou2 gwai2 cou4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生们放学了，非常吵闹。
examples.english_sentence: The students are leaving school, it's very noisy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生哥最緊要係讀好書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 sang1 go1 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 hai6 duk6 hou2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生最重要的是好好读书。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing for students is to study well.

english_meaning: student newspaper, student publication
explanation_mandarin: 指由学生编辑、出版的报纸或刊物。
explanation_english: Refers to a newspaper or publication edited and published by students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我以前喺中學嘅時候，成日睇學校嘅學生報。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji5 cin4 hai2 zung1 hok6 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 jat6 tai2 hok6 haau6 ge3 hok6 sang1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我以前在中学的时候，经常看学校的学生报。
examples.english_sentence: When I was in secondary school, I often read the school's student newspaper.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋份學生報嘅內容都幾多元化㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 fan6 hok6 sang1 bou3 ge3 noi6 yung4 dou1 gei2 do1 jyun4 faa3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的学生报的内容还挺多元化的。
examples.english_sentence: The content of their student newspaper is quite diverse.

english_meaning: schoolgirl, young female student; (slang) often refers to a young woman who is perceived as innocent and attractive
explanation_mandarin: 指年轻的女学生。有时带有对年轻女性的性化意味，将其视为一种吸引力的对象。
explanation_english: Refers to a young female student. Sometimes, it carries a sexualized connotation, referring to a young woman viewed as an object of attraction. It can also simply refer to a schoolgirl.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日扮學生妹，明明都三十幾歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 baan6 hok6 sang1 mui2, ming4 ming4 dou1 saam1 sap6 gei2 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她总是打扮成女学生，明明都三十几岁了。
examples.english_sentence: She always dresses up like a schoolgirl, even though she's already in her thirties.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校好多學生妹都好pure 好true。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 do1 hok6 sang1 mui2 dou1 hou2 pure hou2 true.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那间学校有很多女学生都很清纯。
examples.english_sentence: There are many pure and innocent schoolgirls at that school.

english_meaning: Student Union; Student Government
explanation_mandarin: 学生自治组织，代表学生利益，组织学生活动。
explanation_english: A student-run organization that represents the interests of students and organizes student activities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住參加學生會，幫同學仔爭取更多福利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zeoi6 caam1 gaa1 hok6 sang1 wui2, bong1 tung4 hok6 zai2 zaang1 ceoi2 gang3 do1 fuk1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算参加学生会，帮同学们争取更多福利。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of joining the Student Union to fight for more benefits for fellow students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係學生會嘅主席，好有領導才能。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hok6 sang1 wui2 ge3 zyu2 zik6, hou2 jau5 ling5 dou6 coi4 nang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是学生会的主席，很有领导才能。
examples.english_sentence: He is the president of the Student Union and has great leadership skills.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學生會搞咗個迎新營，俾新生更快融入大學生活。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 sang1 wui2 gaau2 zo2 go3 jing4 san1 jing4, bei2 san1 sang1 faai3 dak1 jung6 jap6 daai6 hok6 sang1 wut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学生会举办了一个迎新营，让新生更快融入大学生活。
examples.english_sentence: The Student Union organized a welcome camp to help freshmen integrate into university life faster.

english_meaning: Student ID card
explanation_mandarin: 证明学生身份的证件。
explanation_english: An identification card that proves one's student status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔見咗張學生証，要去學生事務處補領。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gin3 zo2 zoeng1 hok6 sang1 zing3, jiu3 heoi3 hok6 sang1 si6 mou6 cyu3 bou2 ling5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把学生证弄丢了，要到学生事务处补办。
examples.english_sentence: I lost my student ID card and need to go to the Student Affairs Office to apply for a replacement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 入圖書館要出示學生証。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jap6 tou4 syu1 gun2 jiu3 ceot1 si6 hok6 sang1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 进入图书馆需要出示学生证。
examples.english_sentence: You need to show your student ID card to enter the library.

english_meaning: student ID card
explanation_mandarin: 证明学生身份的证件
explanation_english: An identification card that proves a person is a student.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該，畀我睇下你張學生證。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1, bei2 ngo5 tai2 haa5 nei5 zoeng1 hok6 sang1 zing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请给我看一下你的学生证。
examples.english_sentence: Please let me see your student ID card.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得帶學生證，唔知可唔可以入去圖書館呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 daai3 hok6 sang1 zing3, m4 zi1 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 jap6 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记带学生证了，不知道能不能进图书馆呢？
examples.english_sentence: I forgot to bring my student ID card, I wonder if I can enter the library?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 攞學生證買飛有學生優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lo2 hok6 sang1 zing3 maai5 fei1 jau5 hok6 sang1 jau1 wai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拿学生证买票有学生优惠。
examples.english_sentence: You can get student discounts when buying tickets with a student ID card.

english_meaning: academic circles; student sports competitions; the world of education
explanation_mandarin: 指学术界或教育界。在香港，也常特指学生运动比赛。
explanation_english: Refers to academic or educational circles. In Hong Kong, it often specifically refers to student sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學界比賽攞咗好多獎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 gaai3 bei2 coi3 lo2 zo2 houn2 do1 zoeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在学生运动比赛中获得了很多奖。
examples.english_sentence: He won many awards in student sports competitions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學界對呢個研究嘅反應好正面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 gaai3 deoi3 ni1 go3 jin4 gau3 ge3 faan2 jing3 hou2 zing3 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学术界对这项研究的反应很正面。
examples.english_sentence: The academic community's reaction to this research is very positive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係學界嘅知名人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 hok6 gaai3 ge3 zi1 ming4 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是学术界的知名人物。
examples.english_sentence: He is a well-known figure in academic circles.

english_meaning: Academic society; study group; academic association
explanation_mandarin: 指以学术研究或学习为目的的团体。
explanation_english: Refers to a group or organization formed for the purpose of academic research or study.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗大學嘅數學學社。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 daai6 hok6 ge3 sou3 hok6 hok6 se5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了大学的数学学术社团。
examples.english_sentence: He joined the university's mathematics academic society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學社搞咗好多學術講座。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 se5 gaau2 zo2 hou2 do1 hok6 seot6 gong2 zo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学术社团举办了很多学术讲座。
examples.english_sentence: The academic society organized many academic lectures.

mandarin_meaning: 新手; 菜鸟; 新手司机
english_meaning: Learner driver; novice driver; beginner driver; newbie
explanation_mandarin: 指刚刚开始学习驾驶的人，通常驾驶技术还不太熟练。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has just started learning to drive, and whose driving skills are usually not very proficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個學神，揸車好慢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 hok6 san4, zaa1 ce1 hou2 maan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个新手司机，开车很慢。
examples.english_sentence: He's a learner driver, he drives very slowly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁大力㩒喇，我係學神嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 daai6 lik6 gam6 laa1, ngo5 hai6 hok6 san4 lei4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要按喇叭按得那么响，我是新手。
examples.english_sentence: Don't honk so loudly, I'm a learner driver.

english_meaning: subject; discipline; academic subject; field of study
explanation_mandarin: 指学术研究或教学的分类，如数学、物理、化学等。
explanation_english: A branch of knowledge taught and researched as part of higher education; an academic subject or discipline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你讀緊咩學科呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 duk6 gan2 me1 hok6 fo1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你正在读什么学科啊？
examples.english_sentence: What subject are you studying?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺大學讀緊醫學科。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 daai6 hok6 duk6 gan2 yi1 hok6 fo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在大学读医学科。
examples.english_sentence: He is studying medicine at university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對科學嘅學科好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 fo1 hok6 ge3 hok6 fo1 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对科学的学科很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: I am very interested in the field of science.

english_meaning: pedant, scholastic; bookworm (derogatory)
explanation_mandarin: 指只知书本知识，不谙世事的人； 也指咬文嚼字，拘泥于形式的人。（贬义）
explanation_english: Refers to someone who only knows book knowledge and is ignorant of the world; also refers to someone who is pedantic and adheres to formality. (Derogatory)

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁學究，講嘢成日引經據典，好難明㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hok6 gau3, gong2嘢seng4 jat6 jan5 ging1 geoi3 din2, hou2 naan4 ming4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他太学究了，说话总是引经据典，很难懂的。
examples.english_sentence: He is such a pedant, always quoting classics when he speaks, it's hard to understand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁學究啦，放鬆啲啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 hok6 gau3 laa1, fong3 sung1啲laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别那么学究了，放松点吧！
examples.english_sentence: Don't be such a pedant, relax!

english_meaning: schoolchild; schoolboy/schoolgirl
explanation_mandarin: 指正在上学的儿童。
explanation_english: Refers to children who are currently attending school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 朝早返學時間，好多學童都會喺巴士站等車。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ziu1 zou2 faan1 hok6 si4 gaan3, hou2 do1 hok6 tung4 dou1 wui5 hai2 baa1 si2 zaam6 dang2 ce1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 早上上学的时候，很多学童都会在巴士站等车。
examples.english_sentence: During the morning school hours, many schoolchildren wait for the bus at the bus stop.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間小學有五百幾個學童。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 siu2 hok6 jau5 ng5 baak3 gei2 go3 hok6 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间小学有五百多个学童。
examples.english_sentence: This primary school has over five hundred schoolchildren.

english_meaning: student status; academic record; school registration
explanation_mandarin: 指学生在学校的注册身份和档案记录。
explanation_english: Refers to a student's registered status and academic record in a school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學籍已經俾學校取消咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 zik6 ji5 ging1 bei2 hok6 haau6 ceoi2 siu1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学籍已经被学校取消了。
examples.english_sentence: His student status has been cancelled by the school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要準時註冊先可以保留學籍㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zeon2 si4 zyu3 caak3 sin1 ho2 ji5 bou2 lau4 hok6 zik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要准时注册才可以保留学籍的。
examples.english_sentence: You need to register on time to retain your student status.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅學籍資料唔齊全，所以註冊唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 hok6 zik6 zi1 liu6 m4 cai4 cyun4, so2 ji5 zyu3 caak3 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学籍资料不齐全，所以注册不了。
examples.english_sentence: His student record is incomplete, so he can't register.

english_meaning: to become wiser/smarter through experience; to learn from experience; to wise up
explanation_mandarin: 指通过经历或教训变得更聪明、更精明。
explanation_english: Refers to becoming wiser, more savvy, or more street-smart through experience, usually after making a mistake or encountering a difficult situation. It implies learning from past errors and not repeating them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢上次俾人呃咗鑊金，今次學精咗，唔會再咁易信人啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng6 ci3 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2 wok6 gam1, gam1 ci3 hok6 zing1 zo2, m4 wui5 zoi3 gam3 ji6 seon3 jan4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他上次被人骗了一笔钱，这次学聪明了，不会再那么容易相信别人了。
examples.english_sentence: He got scammed last time, he's wised up this time, he won't trust people so easily anymore.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 上次考試唔夠時間做，今次我學精咗，一嚟就做最難嘅題目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: soeng6 ci3 haau2 si5 m4 gau3 si4 gaan3 zou6, gam1 ci3 ngo5 hok6 zing1 zo2, jat1 lai4 zau6 zou6 zeoi3 naan4 ge3 tai4 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上次考试时间不够，这次我学聪明了，一开始就做最难的题目。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't have enough time in the last exam, this time I've learned my lesson and will do the hardest questions first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都俾佢呃咗咁多次，都應該學精啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 bei2 keoi5 aak1 zo2 gam3 do1 ci3, dou1 jing1 goi1 hok6 zing1 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你都被他骗了这么多次，都应该学聪明了吧！
examples.english_sentence: You've been tricked by him so many times, you should have learned your lesson by now!

english_meaning: department (in a university); academic department; faculty
explanation_mandarin: 大学中的学科部门，负责特定学科的教学和研究。
explanation_english: A department within a university responsible for teaching and research in a specific academic discipline.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺香港大學讀電腦科學學系。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 daai6 hok6 duk6 dim6 nou5 fo1 hok6 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在香港大学读计算机科学系。
examples.english_sentence: I'm studying in the Computer Science Department at the University of Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想入醫學學系，但係成績唔夠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 jap6 ji1 hok6 hok6 hai6, daan6 hai6 sing4 jik1 m4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想进医学系，但是成绩不够。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to get into the medical department, but his grades aren't good enough.

english_meaning: to learn; to study
explanation_mandarin: 通过阅读、听讲、研究、实践等途径获得知识或技能。
explanation_english: To acquire knowledge or skills through reading, listening, studying, practice, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我宜家學習緊廣東話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hok6 zaap6 gan2 gwong2 dung1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在正在学习粤语。
examples.english_sentence: I am currently learning Cantonese.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好勤力，日日都學習到好夜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 kan4 lik6, jat6 jat6 dou1 hok6 zaap6 dou3 hou2 je2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很勤奋，每天都学习到很晚。
examples.english_sentence: He is very diligent and studies until very late every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 學習一門新技能需要時間同埋耐心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hok6 zaap6 jat1 mun4 san1 gei1 nang4 seoi1 jiu3 si4 gaan3 tung4 maai4 noi6 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学习一门新技能需要时间和耐心。
examples.english_sentence: Learning a new skill requires time and patience.

english_meaning: scholar; academic
explanation_mandarin: 指在学术上有较高造诣，从事学术研究的人。
explanation_english: A person who is highly accomplished in academics and engages in academic research.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李教授係一位好出名嘅學者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 gaau3 sau6 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 ceot1 ming4 ge3 hok6 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李教授是一位很有名的学者。
examples.english_sentence: Professor Li is a very famous scholar.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想成為一位出色嘅學者，所以好努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sing4 wai4 jat1 wai2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 hok6 ze2, so2 ji5 hou2 nou5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想成为一位出色的学者，所以很努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to become an outstanding scholar, so he studies very hard.

english_meaning: Learning ability; aptitude for learning
explanation_mandarin: 指学习的能力，包括理解、记忆、运用知识等方面的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to the ability to learn, including the ability to understand, memorize, and apply knowledge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學能好高，好快就學識咗點樣編程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 nang4 hou2 gou1, hou2 faai3 zau6 hok6 sik1 zo2 dim2 joeng2 pin1 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的学习能力很高，很快就学会了如何编程。
examples.english_sentence: His learning ability is very high. He quickly learned how to program.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 提升學能對將來嘅發展好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai4 sing1 hok6 nang4 deoi3 jeung1 loi4 ge3 faat3 zin2 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 提高学习能力对将来的发展很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Improving learning ability is very important for future development.

english_meaning: to learn a skill; to study a craft; apprenticeship
explanation_mandarin: 学习某种技能或手艺，通常指为了将来从事相关职业而进行的学习。
explanation_english: To learn a skill or craft, often with the intention of pursuing a related profession in the future; to serve an apprenticeship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細個就開始學藝，依家已經係一個好出色嘅廚師啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 go3 zau6 hoi1 ci2 hok6 ngai6, ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ceot1 sik1 ge3 cyu4 si1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就开始学手艺，现在已经是一个很出色的厨师了。
examples.english_sentence: He started learning his craft when he was young, and now he's already a very outstanding chef.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗京劇團學藝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 ging1 kek1 tyun4 hok6 ngai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了京剧团学艺。
examples.english_sentence: He went to the Peking opera troupe to learn the art.

english_meaning: skills not yet perfected; not yet proficient in one's craft
explanation_mandarin: 指学习技艺还没有达到精通的程度，水平还不够高。
explanation_english: Refers to a state where one's skills or craft have not yet been perfected or mastered; not yet proficient.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢學藝未精，仲要多多練習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hok6 ngai6 mei6 zing1, zung6 jiu3 do1 do1 lin6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的技艺还不够精湛，还需要多多练习。
examples.english_sentence: His skills are not yet perfected; he needs to practice more.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢學咗好耐，但係都係學藝未精。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seui1 jin4 keoi5 hok6 zo2 hou2 noi6, daan6 hai6 dou1 hai6 hok6 ngai6 mei6 zing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他学了很久，但是还是学艺不精。
examples.english_sentence: Although he has been learning for a long time, his skills are still not perfected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我學藝未精，唔敢隨便示範。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 ngai6 mei6 zing1, m4 gam2 ceoi4 bin2 si6 faan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的技艺还不够精湛，不敢随便示范。
examples.english_sentence: My skills are not yet perfected, I dare not demonstrate casually.

english_meaning: Baby romper, crawler pants
explanation_mandarin: 指婴儿学习走路时穿的连体裤，通常裆部较宽松，方便活动。
explanation_english: Refers to a one-piece garment worn by babies learning to walk, usually with a loose crotch area for ease of movement.

examples.cantonese_sentence: BB學行緊，著住條學行褲就唔怕佢跌親啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bi1 bi1 hok6 hang4 gan2, zoek3 zyu6 tiu4 hok6 hang4 fu3 zau6 m4 paa3 keoi5 dit3 can1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 宝宝正在学走路，穿着连体衣就不怕他摔倒了。
examples.english_sentence: The baby is learning to walk, and wearing a romper will prevent him from falling.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條學行褲嘅質地好舒服，啱晒俾BB著。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 hok6 hang4 fu3 ge3 zat1 dei6 hou2 syu1 fuk6, ngaam1 saai3 bei2 bi1 bi1 zoek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条连体衣的材质很舒服，非常适合宝宝穿。
examples.english_sentence: The material of this romper is very comfortable, perfect for babies to wear.

english_meaning: baby walker
explanation_mandarin: 帮助婴儿学习走路的工具。
