explanation_english: Refers to the end of a semester in a university or college. "Sem" is an abbreviation of "Semester".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 終於完sem喇，可以放暑假喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zung1 jyu1 jyun4 sem1 laa3, ho2 ji5 fong3 syu2 gaa3 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 终于学期结束了，可以放暑假了！
examples.english_sentence: Finally, the semester is over! We can have summer vacation!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 完sem之後，你諗住做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 sem1 zi1 hau6, nei5 lam2 zyu6 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 学期结束后，你打算做什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What are you planning to do after the semester ends?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個sem好chur，好想快啲完sem。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 sem1 hou2 chur1, hou2 soeng2 faai3 di1 jyun4 sem1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个学期很辛苦，很想快点结束。
examples.english_sentence: This semester is very intense, I really want it to end quickly.

synonyms: 學期完結 (hok6 kei4 jyun4 git3)

english_meaning: to finish, to be done, to be over, to complete a task
explanation_mandarin: 指事情完成、结束。也可用作口语，表示“好了”、“可以了”。
explanation_english: Refers to the completion or ending of a task or matter. Can also be used colloquially to mean "done," "okay," or "that's it."

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搞掂曬喇，完事！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau2 dim6 saai3 laa3, jyun4 si6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 都弄好了，完事了！
examples.english_sentence: Everything is done, finished!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 等埋佢完事，我哋先走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: dang2 maai4 keoi5 jyun4 si6, ngo5 dei6 sin1 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 等他做完事，我们再走。
examples.english_sentence: Let's wait for him to finish his work before we leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 完事未啊？我仲有嘢做㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyun4 si6 mei6 aa3? ngo5 zung6 jau5 je5 zou6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做完了吗？我还有事要做。
examples.english_sentence: Are you done yet? I still have things to do.

english_meaning: complete, perfect, comprehensive
explanation_mandarin: 指事物完整齐备，没有遗漏或缺陷。
explanation_english: Referring to something being complete, perfect, and without omissions or defects.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 份合約啲條款好完備，冇咩甩漏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fan6 hap6 joek3 di1 tiu4 kwan2 hou2 jyun4 bei6, mou5 me1 lat1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份合同的条款很完备，没有什么遗漏。
examples.english_sentence: The terms of this contract are very comprehensive, with no omissions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃準備得好完備，應該冇問題啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 zhun2 bei6 dak1 hou2 jyun4 bei6, ying1 goi1 mou5 man6 tai4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个计划准备得很完备，应该没问题了吧。
examples.english_sentence: This plan is very well prepared and complete; there shouldn't be any problems.

english_meaning: completely, entirely, fully, totally
explanation_mandarin: 指全部，没有例外；指一点儿也不保留。
explanation_english: meaning completely, entirely, wholly, or totally; without any exception or reservation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我完全唔記得咗呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我完全忘记了这件事。
examples.english_sentence: I completely forgot about this matter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢完全明白我嘅意思。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jyun4 cyun4 ming4 baak6 ngo5 ge3 ji3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他完全明白我的意思。
examples.english_sentence: He completely understands what I mean.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事完全係佢嘅錯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 jyun4 cyun4 hai6 keoi5 ge3 co3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事完全是他的错。
examples.english_sentence: This matter is entirely his fault.

english_meaning: completely perverted; utter deviation from the norm; grotesque; monstrous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物完全失去原有的正常状态，变得非常奇怪或不正常。程度比一般的“变态”更深。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that has completely lost its original normal state, becoming very strange or abnormal. It is a stronger form of "perverted" or "abnormal," suggesting a severe deviation from what is considered acceptable or typical.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅諗法完全變態，根本冇人會同意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 lam2 faat3 jyun4 cyun4 bin3 taai3, gan1 bun2 mou5 jan4 wui5 tung3 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的想法完全变态，根本没有人会同意。
examples.english_sentence: His ideas are completely perverted; no one would ever agree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲嘅劇情完全變態，睇到人好唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 ge3 kek6 cing4 jyun4 cyun4 bin3 taai3, tai2 dou3 jan4 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电影的剧情完全变态，看得人很不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: The plot of this movie is utterly grotesque; it makes people very uncomfortable.

english_meaning: complete victory, crushing victory
explanation_mandarin: 指完全的胜利，彻底地击败对手。
explanation_english: To achieve a complete and overwhelming victory; to totally defeat an opponent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋隊波完勝對手！
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 jyun4 sing3 deoi3 sau2!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们队彻底战胜了对手！
examples.english_sentence: Our team completely defeated the opponent in this competition!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺辯論比賽入面完勝咗對方。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 bin6 leon6 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 jyun4 sing3 zo2 deoi3 fong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在辩论比赛中完胜了对方。
examples.english_sentence: He completely defeated the other party in the debate competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺呢個遊戲入面完勝曬所有人！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 ni1 go3 jau4 hei3 jap6 min6 jyun4 sing3 saai3 so2 jau5 jan4!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我在这个游戏里面完全赢了所有人！
examples.english_sentence: I completely won against everyone in this game!

english_meaning: perfect, complete, improve, refine
explanation_mandarin: 使更加完美，使更加完备；完美完备。
explanation_english: To make something perfect or complete; perfect and complete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要完善呢個計劃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 jyun4 sin6 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要完善这个计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to improve this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統仲未夠完善，需要再測試。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 zung6 mei6 gau3 jyun4 sin6, seoi1 jiu3 zoi3 caak1 si3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个系统还不够完善，需要再测试。
examples.english_sentence: This system is not perfect yet and needs to be tested again.

english_meaning: end (of a game, show, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指比赛、演出等活动结束。
explanation_english: Refers to the end of an event, such as a game or performance.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 波都完場啦，我哋走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bo1 dou1 jyun4 coeng4 laa1, ngo5 dei6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 比赛都结束了，我们走吧。
examples.english_sentence: The game is over, let's go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 演唱會完場之後，好多人仲唔肯走。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jin2 coeng3 wui2 jyun4 coeng4 zi1 hau6, hou2 do1 jan4 zung2 m4 hang2 zau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 演唱会结束后，很多人还不肯走。
examples.english_sentence: After the concert ended, many people still didn't want to leave.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 套戲就嚟完場，你準備好走未啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou3 hei3 zau6 lai4 jyun4 coeng4, nei5 zyun2 bei6 hou2 zau2 mei6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 电影快要结束了，你准备好走了吗？
examples.english_sentence: The movie is almost over, are you ready to leave?

english_meaning: to fulfill a dream, to realize a dream
explanation_mandarin: 实现梦想。
explanation_english: To fulfill or realize a dream; to make a dream come true.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢用咗十年時間去完佢嘅音樂夢。

examples.english_sentence: He spent ten years to fulfill his musical dream.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 經過多年努力，我終於可以完夢，去環遊世界。

examples.english_sentence: After many years of hard work, I can finally fulfill my dream and travel around the world.

synonyms: 實現梦想 (sat6 sin6 mung6 soeng2)

english_meaning: intact; in perfect condition; complete and undamaged
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物完整无损，没有残缺。
explanation_english: Describes something that is complete and undamaged, without any flaws or imperfections.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個花樽運送嗰陣包得好好，到我哋手嗰陣都仲係完好無缺。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 faa1 zyun1 wan6 sung3 go2 zan6 baau1 dak1 hou2 hou2, dou3 ngo5 dei6 sau2 go2 zan6 dou1 zung1 hai6 jyun4 hou2 mou4 kyut3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个花瓶运输的时候包装得很好，到我们手上的时候还是完整无缺的。
examples.english_sentence: The vase was packaged very well during transportation, and it was still intact when it reached our hands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 架車撞到咁，竟然可以完好無缺，真係奇蹟。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 车撞成这样，竟然可以完整无缺，真是奇迹。
examples.english_sentence: It's a miracle that the car can be intact after being crashed like that.

english_meaning: to complete a project, to finish work, to be completed
explanation_mandarin: 完成工作或工程。
explanation_english: To complete a piece of work or a project; to be finished.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 zau6 ho2 ji5 jyun4 gung1 laa3.

examples.english_sentence: We can finish the work tomorrow.

examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个工程预计下个月完工。
examples.english_sentence: This project is expected to be completed next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日OT，希望可以準時完工。

explanation_english: Refers to the imperial clan of the same surname as the emperor, and generally refers to the relatives of the emperor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 清朝嘅宗室有好多特權。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing1 ciu4 ge3 zung1 sat1 jau5 hou2 do1 dak6 kwan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 清朝的皇族有很多特权。
examples.english_sentence: The imperial clan of the Qing Dynasty had many privileges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係宗室之後，生活好富裕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zung1 sat1 zi1 hau6, sang1 wut6 hou2 fu3 jyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是皇族后裔，生活很富裕。
examples.english_sentence: He is a descendant of the imperial clan and lives a wealthy life.

english_meaning: grandmaster; master (of a skill, especially martial arts)
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一领域有极高成就，被公认为一代大师的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has achieved extremely high accomplishments in a certain field and is recognized as a grandmaster.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係詠春嘅一代宗師，好多人跟佢學功夫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 wing6 ceun1 ge3 jat1 doi6 zung1 si1, hou2 do1 jan4 gan1 keoi5 hok6 gung1 fu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是咏春的一代宗师，很多人跟他学习功夫。
examples.english_sentence: He is a grandmaster of Wing Chun. Many people follow him to learn kung fu.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺書法界都算係宗師級嘅人物啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 syu1 faat3 gaai3 dou1 syun3 hai6 zung1 si1 gap1 ge3 jan4 mat6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在书法界也算是宗师级别的人物了。
examples.english_sentence: He can be considered a master-level figure in the field of calligraphy.

english_meaning: religion
explanation_mandarin: 对超自然力量的信仰和崇拜，以及由此形成的社会组织和文化体系。
explanation_english: A system of faith and worship, involving a belief in and reverence for a supernatural power or powers, and often including a moral code.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你信咩宗敎㗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 seon3 me1 zung1 gaau3 gaa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你信什么宗教啊？
examples.english_sentence: What religion do you believe in?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多唔同嘅宗敎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zung1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多不同的宗教。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many different religions.

english_meaning: religion
explanation_mandarin: 指一种信仰体系，通常包括对超自然力量或神灵的信仰，以及相应的仪式、道德规范和社群。
explanation_english: A system of faith and worship, typically involving belief in a supernatural power or powers, and often containing a code of ethics and a community of believers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多唔同嘅宗教。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zung1 gaau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多不同的宗教。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many different religions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對佢嘅宗教好虔誠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zung1 gaau3 hou2 kin4 sing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对他的宗教很虔诚。
examples.english_sentence: He is very devout in his religion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔同嘅宗教有唔同嘅信仰同埋習俗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 tung4 ge3 zung1 gaau3 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 seon3 joeng5 tung4 mai4 zaap6 suk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不同的宗教有不同的信仰和习俗。
examples.english_sentence: Different religions have different beliefs and customs.

english_meaning: clan; lineage; extended family; patriarchal clan
explanation_mandarin: 以父系血缘关系为基础的家族组织。
explanation_english: A family organization based on patrilineal blood ties; extended family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋個宗族喺條村度好有勢力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 go3 zung1 zuk6 hai2 tiu4 cyun1 dou6 hou2 jau5 sai3 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的宗族在这个村里很有势力。
examples.english_sentence: Their clan is very influential in this village.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅宗族觀念好重，而家就淡咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 zung1 zuk6 gun1 nim6 hou2 cung5, ji4 gaa1 zau6 daam6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的宗族观念很重，现在就淡了很多。
examples.english_sentence: The clan concept was very strong in the past, but now it has faded a lot.

english_meaning: aim, purpose, objective, principle, tenet, doctrine
explanation_mandarin: 主要的思想或目的；根本的原则。
explanation_english: The main idea or purpose; a fundamental principle or tenet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅宗旨係以客為先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zung1 zi2 hai6 ji5 haak3 wai4 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的宗旨是以客户为先。
examples.english_sentence: The principle of this company is customer first.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅宗旨係為社區服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 zung1 zi2 hai6 wai6 se5 kui1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的宗旨是为社区服务。
examples.english_sentence: Our aim is to serve the community.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅人生宗旨係幫助其他人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jan4 sang1 zung1 zi2 hai6 bong1 zo6 gei2 taa1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的人生宗旨是帮助其他人。
examples.english_sentence: His life's purpose is to help others.

english_meaning: sect; denomination
explanation_mandarin: 指宗教内部的不同分支或派别。
explanation_english: A religious sect or denomination; a branch or faction within a religion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佛教都有好多唔同嘅宗派㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fat6 gaau3 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 m4 tung4 ge3 zung1 paai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 佛教也有很多不同的宗派。
examples.english_sentence: There are many different sects in Buddhism.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔同宗派嘅人對經文嘅理解都唔一樣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 tung4 zung1 paai3 ge3 jan4 deoi3 ging1 man4 ge3 lei5 gaai2 dou1 m4 jat1 joeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不同宗派的人对经文的理解都不一样。
examples.english_sentence: People from different sects have different understandings of scriptures.

english_meaning: ancestral hall; clan hall
explanation_mandarin: 祭祀祖先的场所，通常是同一宗族的人共同使用的祠堂。
explanation_english: A building or hall dedicated to the veneration of ancestors, typically used by members of the same clan or lineage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋每年清明都會返鄉下拜宗祠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 mui5 nin4 cing1 ming4 dou1 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 baai3 zung1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们每年清明节都会回乡下祭拜宗祠。
examples.english_sentence: Every year during Qingming Festival, we go back to our hometown to worship at the ancestral hall.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個宗祠有成百年歷史㗎啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zung1 ci4 jau5 seng4 baak3 nin4 lik6 si2 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个祠堂已经有上百年的历史了。
examples.english_sentence: This ancestral hall has a history of over a hundred years.

english_meaning: kinsfolk; relatives (from the same clan or lineage)
explanation_mandarin: 指同一宗族或同一姓氏的亲属。
explanation_english: Refers to relatives who belong to the same clan or share the same surname.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣時，好多宗親都會返鄉下拜山。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6 si4, hou2 do1 zung1 can1 dou1 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 haa5 baai3 saan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过年的时候，很多宗亲都会回乡下扫墓。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, many kinsfolk return to their hometown to visit the ancestral graves.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成班宗親一齊夾錢起咗間宗祠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 baan1 zung1 can1 jat1 cai4 gaap3 cin2 hei2 zo2 gaan1 zung1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一群宗亲一起集资建了一间祠堂。
examples.english_sentence: A group of kinsfolk pooled their money together to build an ancestral hall.

english_meaning: Clan association; lineage association
explanation_mandarin: 指同一宗族的人组成的社团组织，旨在联络宗亲，互助互利，弘扬祖德。
explanation_english: A clan association is an organization formed by people sharing the same surname and/or lineage. It aims to connect relatives, provide mutual support, and promote ancestral virtues.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿爺以前成日去宗親會開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 je4 ji5 cin4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 zung1 can1 wui2 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爷爷以前经常去宗亲会开会。
examples.english_sentence: My grandfather used to frequently go to clan association meetings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間宗親會搞咗好多慈善活動，幫助咗唔少人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 zung1 can1 wui2 gaau2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci4 sin6 wut6 dung6, bong1 zo6 bat1 siu2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家宗亲会举办了很多慈善活动，帮助了不少人。
examples.english_sentence: This clan association organized many charitable activities and helped many people.

english_meaning: Government official; government; organ
explanation_mandarin: 指政府官员或政府机构。也指人体的器官。
explanation_english: Refers to government officials or government institutions. It can also refer to organs in the human body.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個政府官員嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 zing3 fu2 gun1 jyun4 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位政府官员。
examples.english_sentence: He is a government official.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋身體嘅重要器官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 san1 tai2 ge3 zung6 jiu3 hei3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们身体的重要器官。
examples.english_sentence: This is an important organ of our body.

english_meaning: Master (historical), Husband (historical, archaic, or as a joke)
explanation_mandarin: 古代对官员的称呼，也指旧时妇女对丈夫的称呼。现代粤语有时开玩笑地称呼丈夫。
explanation_english: Historically, it referred to a government official. It also used to be a wife's term of address for her husband in old times. Nowadays in Cantonese, it can sometimes be used jokingly to refer to one's husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇古裝劇成日聽到啲女人叫佢哋嘅老公做「官人」。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 gu2 zong1 kek6 seng4 jat6 ting1 dou2 di1 neoi5 jan2 giu3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 lou5 gung1 zou6 "gun1 jan4".
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看古装剧经常听到一些女人叫她们的丈夫做“官人”。
examples.english_sentence: In historical dramas, you often hear women call their husbands "Master".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你都幾好服侍㗎，官人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dou1 gei2 hou2 fuk6 si6 gaa3, gun1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还挺难伺候的，老爷。
examples.english_sentence: You're quite demanding, Master.

mandarin_meaning: 衣冠楚楚, 整整齐齐
english_meaning: Well-dressed, neatly dressed, prim and proper
explanation_mandarin: 形容人穿着整洁，衣冠楚楚的样子。也形容人非常正式，规矩。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is well-dressed, neatly attired, and appearing prim and proper. Can also describe someone who is very formal and adheres strictly to rules and etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今日官仔骨骨咁，唔知去邊度呢？
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 gun1 zai2 gwat1 gwat1 gam2, m4 zi1 heoi3 bin1 dou6 ne1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天穿得衣冠楚楚的，不知道去哪里呢？
examples.english_sentence: He is so well-dressed today, I wonder where he's going?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好官仔骨骨，講嘢都好有規矩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 gun1 zai2 gwat1 gwat1, gong2 je5 dou1 hou2 jau5 kwai1 geoi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很正式，说话也很有规矩。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very formal person, and even his speech is very proper.

english_meaning: bureaucrat; bureaucracy; bureaucratic
explanation_mandarin: 指官场中形式主义严重、办事效率低下、脱离实际的作风或人员。
explanation_english: Refers to a bureaucratic style in government characterized by formalism, inefficiency, and detachment from reality; also refers to bureaucrats exhibiting these characteristics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府部門啲官僚作風真係令人厭惡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 bou6 mun4 dik1 gun1 liu4 zok3 fung1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 jim3 ngou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府部门的官僚作风真是令人厌恶。
examples.english_sentence: The bureaucratic style of government departments is really annoying.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好官僚，乜都跟足程序，完全唔識變通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 gun1 liu4, mat1 dou1 gan1 zuk1 cing4 seoi6, jyun4 cyun4 m4 sik1 bin3 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很官僚，什么都按照程序来，完全不懂得变通。
examples.english_sentence: He's very bureaucratic at work; he follows the procedures strictly and doesn't know how to be flexible at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事涉及好多官僚程序，可能要搞好耐先搞得掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 sip3 gap6 hou2 do1 gun1 liu4 cing4 seoi6, ho2 nang4 jiu3 gaau2 hou2 noi6 sin1 gaau2 dak1 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事涉及很多官僚程序，可能要弄很久才能弄好。
examples.english_sentence: This matter involves a lot of bureaucratic procedures; it might take a long time to sort out.

english_meaning: bureaucracy, bureaucratism
explanation_mandarin: 指脱离实际、脱离群众、不负责任、办事拖拉、敷衍塞责的工作作风。
explanation_english: Bureaucracy; a style of working characterized by being out of touch with reality and the masses, irresponsible, slow and inefficient, and perfunctory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司啲官僚主義好嚴重，乜嘢都要等好耐先搞掂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 di1 gun1 liu4 zyu2 ji6 hou2 jim4 zung6, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 dang2 hou2 noi6 sin1 gaau2 dim6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的官僚主义非常严重，什么都要等很久才能办好。
examples.english_sentence: The bureaucracy in this company is very serious. Everything takes a long time to get done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以俾官僚主義阻礙我哋嘅進步。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 gun1 liu4 zyu2 ji6 zo2 ngoi6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zeon3 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们不能让官僚主义阻碍我们的进步。
examples.english_sentence: We cannot let bureaucracy hinder our progress.

english_meaning: government troops; soldiers; the authorities
explanation_mandarin: 指政府的军队，也可泛指官方人员。
explanation_english: Refers to government troops. Can also broadly refer to government officials or representatives of the authorities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你哋唔好亂嚟呀，陣間啲官兵嚟捉你哋㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 m4 hou2 lyun6 lai4 aa3, zan6 gaan1 di1 gun1 bing1 lei4 zuk1 nei5 dei6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你们别乱来啊，等会儿官兵来抓你们的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't mess around, the authorities will come and arrest you later.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人好驚官兵嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 hou2 geng1 gun1 bing1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人很怕官兵的。
examples.english_sentence: People in the past were very afraid of the authorities.

english_meaning: lawsuit; litigation; legal case
explanation_mandarin: 指涉及法律纠纷的案件，通常需要通过法院等法律途径解决。
explanation_english: A legal case or lawsuit, typically involving a dispute that needs to be resolved through legal channels, such as a court.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋打緊場官司，爭緊啲錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 daa2 gan2 coeng4 gun1 si1, zaang1 gan2 di1 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们正在打一场官司，争一些钱。
examples.english_sentence: They are fighting a lawsuit over some money.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想惹官司上身，做嘢要小心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 ze2 gun1 si1 soeng5 san1, zou6 je5 jiu3 siu2 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想惹官司上身，做事要小心一些。
examples.english_sentence: To avoid getting involved in a lawsuit, you need to be more careful when you do things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單官司搞咗好耐，都未解決到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 gun1 si1 gaau2 zo2 hou2 noi6, dou1 mei6 gaai2 kyut3 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个官司搞了很久，都还没有解决。
examples.english_sentence: This lawsuit has been going on for a long time and hasn't been resolved yet.

english_meaning: government official; government functionary; civil servant
explanation_mandarin: 泛指政府的官员和办事人员。
explanation_english: A general term referring to government officials and functionaries.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前嘅官吏好多都好貪污。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 ge3 gun1 lei6 hou2 do1 dou1 hou2 taam1 wu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的官吏很多都很贪污。
examples.english_sentence: Many government officials in the past were very corrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想考入政府做個官吏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 haau2 jap6 zing3 fu2 zou6 go3 gun1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想考入政府做个官吏。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to pass the civil service exam and become a government official.

english_meaning: official; government official
explanation_mandarin: 指政府部门的工作人员，尤指担任一定职务的人。
explanation_english: A person working in a government department, especially one holding a certain position.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲官員成日都講埋啲離地嘅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 gun1 jyun4 seng4 jat6 dou1 gong2 maai4 di1 lei4 dei6 ge3 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些官员总是说一些不切实际的话。
examples.english_sentence: These officials always say things that are out of touch with reality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想考政府工做官員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 haau2 zing3 fu2 gung1 zou6 gun1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想考政府工作，做官员。
examples.english_sentence: He wants to take the civil service exam to become a government official.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民對啲官員嘅表現好失望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 deoi3 di1 gun1 jyun4 ge3 biu2 hin3 hou2 sat1 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民对这些官员的表现很失望。
examples.english_sentence: The citizens are very disappointed with the performance of these officials.

english_meaning: collusion between government officials and business people; cronyism
explanation_mandarin: 指官员和商人互相勾结，利用职权和商业手段谋取私利的不正当行为。
explanation_english: Describes the corrupt relationship between government officials and business people, where they collude to exploit their positions and commercial means for personal gain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢單嘢擺明係官商勾結嘅結果，如果唔係點會咁順利通過？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 daan1 je5 baai2 ming4 hai6 gun1 soeng1 ngau1 git3 ge3 git3 gwo2, jyu4 gwo2 m4 hai6 dim2 wui5 gam3 seon6 lei6 tung1 gwo3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事明显是官商勾结的结果，不然怎么会这么顺利通过？
examples.english_sentence: This matter is clearly the result of collusion between government officials and business people, otherwise how could it have passed so smoothly?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 市民對政府嘅信任已經跌到谷底，因為太多官商勾結嘅醜聞爆出嚟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: si5 man4 deoi3 zing3 fu2 ge3 seon3 jam6 ji5 ging1 dit3 dou3 guk1 dai2, jan1 wai6 taai3 do1 gun1 soeng1 ngau1 git3 ge3 cau2 man4 baau3 chut1 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 市民对政府的信任已经跌到谷底，因为太多官商勾结的丑闻被曝光出来。
examples.english_sentence: The public's trust in the government has plummeted because too many scandals of collusion between government officials and business people have been exposed.

synonyms: 貪污腐敗 (taam1 wu1 fu6 baai6)

english_meaning: government land; public land
explanation_mandarin: 指政府拥有的土地。
explanation_english: Refers to land owned by the government.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰笪地係官地，唔可以隨便起嘢㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 daat3 dei6 hai6 gun1 dei6, m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 hei2 je5 gaa3.

explanation_english: Refers to the world of government officials, the bureaucracy, and the relationships and practices within it. Often carries connotations of corruption and power struggles.

explanation_mandarin: 指政府官员的妻子。通常用于指代级别较高的官员的妻子，带有一定的尊敬和地位的含义。
explanation_english: Refers to the wife of a government official. It usually refers to the wife of a higher-ranking official and carries a sense of respect and status.

examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 go3 lo2 po4 hai6 gun1 taai3, so2 ji5 keoi5 dei6 hou2 jau5 dei6 wai6.

english_meaning: official arrogance, display of authority, bureaucratic airs
explanation_mandarin: 指官员或有权势的人摆出的傲慢姿态和权力气势，以此来压制他人。
explanation_english: Refers to the arrogant attitude and imposing manner displayed by officials or people in positions of power, used to intimidate or suppress others.

examples.english_sentence: Don't put on such a display of authority; we're just colleagues.

english_meaning: state media, government media
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府或执政党控制、运营的媒体机构。
explanation_english: Refers to media organizations controlled and operated by the government or the ruling party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好盡信官媒嘅報導，好多時都係報喜不報憂。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要完全相信官方媒体的报道，很多时候都是报喜不报忧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't completely trust the reports from state media, often they only report good news and not bad news.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 官媒成日宣傳國家幾咁好，但係實情就唔係咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gun1 mui4 seng4 jat6 syun1 cyun4 gwok3 gaa1 gei2 gam2 hou2, daan6 hai6 sat6 cing4 zau6 m4 hai6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 官方媒体经常宣传国家有多么好，但实际情况并非如此。
examples.english_sentence: State media often promotes how good the country is, but the reality is not like that.

mandarin_meaning: 官方学说；官方倡导的学习内容
english_meaning: Official doctrine; officially promoted learning; the official line (in terms of education/knowledge)
explanation_mandarin: 指官方提倡或规定的学说、学习内容，有时带贬义，指僵化、脱离实际的理论。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前那些官二代学生经常欺负穷学生。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, those privileged students often bullied the poor students.

english_meaning: official, bureaucratic, formalistic
explanation_mandarin: 指官方的，正式的，或指形式主义、官僚主义。
explanation_english: Refers to something official, formal, or indicative of formalism and bureaucracy.

examples.english_sentence: This company has a lot of government shares, so it's difficult to manage.

english_meaning: bureaucratic tone; officialese; jargon used by officials
explanation_mandarin: 指官方或官员讲话时使用的套话、空话，通常给人以虚假、敷衍的印象。
explanation_english: Refers to the formulaic and empty rhetoric used by officials or in official settings, often giving the impression of insincerity and superficiality.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 gun1 hong1, teng1 lok6 hou2 gaa2.

examples.english_sentence: The content of this report is all officialese, it has no practical meaning at all.

english_meaning: Mandarin Chinese, official spoken language
explanation_mandarin: 指中国大陆的官方通用语言，即普通话。
explanation_english: Refers to Mandarin Chinese, the official standard spoken language of mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺學校學緊官話。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hok6 haau6 hok6 gan2 gun1 waa2.

examples.english_sentence: He is learning Mandarin at school.

examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sik1 gong2 gun1 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多人都会说普通话。
examples.english_sentence: Many people in Hong Kong can speak Mandarin.

english_meaning: public funds; government expense; official expense
explanation_mandarin: 指由政府或公共机构支付的费用。
explanation_english: Refers to expenses paid by the government or a public institution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅旅行全部都係官費㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 leoi5 hang4 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 gun1 fai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的旅行全部都是公费的。
examples.english_sentence: Their entire trip is at public expense.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個會議嘅所有開支都係官費報銷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 wui6 ji5 ge3 so2 jau5 hoi1 zi1 dou1 hai6 gun1 fai3 bou3 siu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次会议的所有开销都是公费报销。
examples.english_sentence: All expenses for this meeting will be reimbursed with public funds.

english_meaning: When the government oppresses the people, the people will revolt.
explanation_mandarin: 指当统治者或官府对人民的压迫超过一定限度时，人民就会起来反抗。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a situation where excessive oppression by the government or authorities leads to popular revolt or rebellion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲貪官越嚟越過分，真係官逼民反呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 taam1 gun1 yut6 lai4 yut6 gwo3 fan6, zan1 hai6 gun1 bik1 man4 faan2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些贪官越来越过分，真是官逼民反啊！
examples.english_sentence: These corrupt officials are going too far. It's a classic case of the government driving the people to revolt!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果政府唔理民生，一味只係顧住自己利益，遲早官逼民反。
examples.jyutping_sentence: yu4 gwo2 zing3 fu2 m4 lei5 man4 sang1, jat1 wai6 zi2 hai6 gu3 zyu6 zi6 gei2 lei6 jik1, ci4 zou2 gun1 bik1 man4 faan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果政府不顾民生，一味只顾自己的利益，迟早官逼民反。
examples.english_sentence: If the government ignores the people's livelihood and only cares about its own interests, sooner or later it will drive the people to revolt.

english_meaning: official residence (of a high-ranking official)
explanation_mandarin: 指高级官员居住的住宅。
explanation_english: The official residence of a high-ranking government official.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅新官邸好宏偉呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 gun1 dai2 hou2 wang4 wai5 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的新官邸很宏伟啊。
examples.english_sentence: Their new official residence is very grand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 記者成日喺官邸外面等，希望可以採訪到重要人物。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 ze2 seng4 jat6 hai2 gun1 dai2 ngoi6 min6 dang2, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 cai2 fong2 dou3 zung6 jiu3 jan4 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 记者经常在官邸外面等，希望可以采访到重要人物。
examples.english_sentence: Reporters often wait outside the official residence, hoping to interview important figures.

english_meaning: official rank; bureaucratic rank; grade (in the civil service)
explanation_mandarin: 指政府官员的等级制度。
explanation_english: Refers to the hierarchical system of government officials.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一路都好努力咁升官，想爬上更高嘅官階。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 lou6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 sing1 gun1, soeng2 paa4 soeng5 gang3 gou1 ge3 gun1 gaai1.

examples.english_sentence: He has been working hard to get promoted, hoping to climb to a higher official rank.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺政府做嘢，官階好重要㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zing3 fu2 zou6 je5, gun1 gaai1 hou2 zung6 jiu3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在政府工作，官阶很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Working in the government, official rank is very important.

english_meaning: legal trouble; lawsuit; litigation
explanation_mandarin: 指与政府或法律有关的麻烦，通常涉及诉讼、控告等。
explanation_english: Refers to trouble with the authorities or the law, usually involving lawsuits, accusations, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢惹咗單官非，依家好頭痕。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 je5 zo2 daan1 gun1 fei1, ji1 gaa1 hou2 tau4 han4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他惹上了一场官司，现在很头疼。
examples.english_sentence: He got into legal trouble and is having a headache now.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果唔想惹官非，就唔好貪心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 m4 soeng2 je5 gun1 fei1, zau6 m4 hou2 taam1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果不想惹上官司，就不要贪心。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want to get into legal trouble, don't be greedy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲人話佢一定會衰官非。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 jan4 waa6 keoi5 jat1 ding6 wui seoi1 gun1 fei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 人们说他一定会输掉官司。
examples.english_sentence: People say he will definitely lose the lawsuit.

english_meaning: universe, cosmos
explanation_mandarin: 指包括地球及其他所有天体的无限空间，即宇宙。
explanation_english: The universe; cosmos; the totality of space and all that is in it, including planets, stars, galaxies, and other forms of matter and energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋所知嘅宇宙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 so2 zi1 ge3 zau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们所知的宇宙。
examples.english_sentence: This is the universe as we know it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對宇宙嘅奧秘好有興趣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 zau6 ge3 ou3 mai6 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对宇宙的奥秘很感兴趣。
examples.english_sentence: He is very interested in the mysteries of the universe.

mandarin_meaning: 确定; 一定; 稳定
english_meaning: to decide; to fix; to determine; definite; fixed; stable; calm
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词; 形容词; 副词
explanation_mandarin: 表示确定，固定，或是稳定。可以作动词，表示决定；也可以作形容词，表示稳定的状态；还可以作副词，表示一定。
explanation_english: Indicates certainty, fixity, or stability. It can be used as a verb, meaning to decide; as an adjective, indicating a stable state; or as an adverb, meaning definitely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋定咗下個月去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ding6 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们定了下个月去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We have decided to travel next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好定性。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 ding6 sing3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很稳定。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very stable person.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 放心，我定會幫你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: fong3 sam1, ngo5 ding6 wui5 bong1 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 放心，我一定会帮你。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will definitely help you.

english_meaning: to decide on; to set; to establish; to determine; to make (a decision); to agree on
explanation_mandarin: 表示决定、确定或制定某事。
explanation_english: Indicates the action of deciding, setting, establishing, or determining something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經定下咗下個月去旅行嘅日期啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 ding6 haa5 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 jat6 kei4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们已经确定了下个月去旅行的日期了。
examples.english_sentence: We have already decided on the date for our trip next month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司定下咗今年嘅銷售目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 ding6 haa5 zo2 gam1 nin4 ge3 siu1 sau3 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司制定了今年的销售目标。
examples.english_sentence: The company has set the sales target for this year.

examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ding6 haa5 jat1 go3 ming4 kok3 ge3 gai3 waak6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要制定一个明确的计划。
examples.english_sentence: We need to establish a clear plan.

english_meaning: to position; to locate; positioning; location
explanation_mandarin: 1. 确定位置或方向。2. 确定某事物在一定范围或系统中的位置。
explanation_english: 1. To determine the position or direction of something. 2. To determine the position of something within a certain range or system.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要搞清楚公司嘅市場定位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 gaau2 cing1 chu2 gung1 si1 ge3 si5 cheung5 ding6 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要搞清楚公司的市场定位。
examples.english_sentence: We need to clarify the company's market positioning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 部電話有GPS定位功能，唔怕蕩失路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 din6 waa2 jau5 GPS ding6 wai2 gung1 nang4, m4 paa3 dong6 sat1 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这部电话有GPS定位功能，不怕迷路。
examples.english_sentence: This phone has GPS positioning function, so you don't have to worry about getting lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記得開定位呀，我先搵到你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 dak1 hoi1 ding6 wai2 aa3, ngo5 sin1 wan2 dou2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记得打开定位啊，我才能找到你。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to turn on location services, so I can find you.

english_meaning: or
explanation_mandarin: 表示选择的连词，相当于普通话的“还是”。
explanation_english: A conjunction indicating an alternative or choice; equivalent to 'or' in English.

examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 wui5 m4 wui5 lai4 ding6 hai6 ting1 jat6 sin1 lai4 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他今天会不会来还是明天才来啊？
examples.english_sentence: Will he come today or will he come tomorrow?

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 nam2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 zyu2 ding6 hai6 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你打算自己做饭还是出去吃啊？
examples.english_sentence: Are you planning to cook yourself or eat out?

explanation_mandarin: 表示询问对方的意见或打算，语气较为随意。
explanation_english: A casual way to ask someone what they want to do or what the situation is; it expresses a desire for clarification or further information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你搞掂咗未啊？ 定係點？要唔要我幫手？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaau2 dim6 zo2 mei6 aa3? ding6 hai6 dim2? jiu3 m4 jiu3 ngo5 bong1 sau2?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你弄好了没有啊？ 还是怎么样？要不要我帮忙？
examples.english_sentence: Have you finished it yet? Or what? Do you need me to help?

english_meaning: to set a price; pricing
explanation_mandarin: 确定商品或服务的价格。
explanation_english: To set the price of a product or service; also refers to the price set.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食定價都幾貴。

examples.english_sentence: What is the pricing strategy for this product?

english_meaning: to formulate; to draw up; to work out; to establish
explanation_mandarin: 制定，订出，想出或确立某个计划、方案、规则等。
explanation_english: To formulate, draw up, work out, or establish a plan, scheme, rule, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要定出一個詳細嘅計劃先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ding6 ceot1 jat1 go3 cheung4 sai3 ge3 gai3 waak6 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要制定一个详细的计划才行。
examples.english_sentence: We need to draw up a detailed plan first.

examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 ding6 ceot1 zo2 san1 ge3 waan4 bou2 zing3 chaak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府制定了新的环保政策。
examples.english_sentence: The government has formulated new environmental protection policies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋定出咗一套應對緊急情況嘅方案。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ding6 ceot1 zo2 jat1 tou3 ying3 deui3 gan2 gap1 ching4 kwong3 ge3 fong1 on3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们制定了一套应对紧急情况的方案。
examples.english_sentence: They have worked out a plan to deal with emergencies.

english_meaning: concentration, focus, composure, stability; willpower
explanation_mandarin: 指一个人集中注意力、控制情绪、保持稳定状态的能力。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's ability to concentrate, control emotions, and maintain a stable state.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅定力好強，喺咁嘈嘅環境都可以溫習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 ding6 lik6 hou2 keung4, hai2 gam3 cou4 ge3 waan4 ging2 dou1 ho2 ji5 wan1 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的定力很强，在这么吵的环境都可以复习。
examples.english_sentence: His concentration is very strong; he can revise even in such a noisy environment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個考試好考驗你嘅定力，唔好俾其他同學影響到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 haau2 si3 hou2 haau2 jim6 nei5 ge3 ding6 lik6, m4 hou2 bei2 kei5 taa1 tung4 hok6 ying2 heong2 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个考试很考验你的定力，不要被其他同学影响到。
examples.english_sentence: This exam tests your concentration; don't be influenced by other students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢意志力好強，有定力去完成目標。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji3 zi3 lik6 hou2 keung4, jau5 ding6 lik6 heoi3 wun4 sing4 muk6 biu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他意志力很强，有定力去完成目标。
examples.english_sentence: He has a strong will and the determination to achieve his goals.

english_meaning: to target; to be directed towards; directed; targeting; orienteering
explanation_mandarin: 1.指向一定的方向或目标。 2.一种体育运动，运动员借助地图和指北针，按规定的方向和距离，越过不同的地形，到达各个检查点，并以所用的时间决定胜负。
explanation_english: 1. To be directed towards a specific direction or target. 2. A sport where athletes use a map and compass to navigate across different terrains, following specified directions and distances, to reach various checkpoints, with the time taken determining the winner. Can also mean 'directed' or 'targeting'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個廣告嘅對象係年輕人，所以佢哋嘅宣傳策略都係定向針對年輕人。

examples.english_sentence: The target audience of this advertisement is young people, so their promotional strategies are all targeted at young people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢參加咗定向比賽，睇嚟佢對地圖同埋指南針都好熟悉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 caam1 gaa1 zo2 ding6 hoeng3 bei2 coi3, tai2 lai4 keoi5 deoi3 dei6 tou4 tung4 mai4 zi2 naam4 zam1 dou1 hou2 suk6 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他参加了定向比赛，看来他对地图和指南针都很熟悉。
examples.english_sentence: He participated in an orienteering competition, so it seems he is very familiar with maps and compasses.

mandarin_meaning: 没问题，当然可以，肯定了
english_meaning: Definitely, of course, surely, no problem, it is settled
explanation_mandarin: 表示肯定、同意、确定或没问题等语气。通常用于口语中，表达一种轻松肯定的态度。
explanation_english: Expresses certainty, agreement, confirmation, or that there is no problem. Commonly used in spoken language to convey a relaxed and affirmative attitude.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我哋去食飯，定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 sik6 faan6, ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我们去吃饭，定了！
examples.english_sentence: We're going to dinner tomorrow, definitely!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你放心，件事我一定幫你搞掂，定啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 fong3 sam1, gin6 si6 ngo5 jat1 ding6 bong1 nei5 gaau2 dim6, ding6 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你放心，这件事我肯定帮你搞定，没问题！
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I'll definitely help you sort this out, no problem!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嚟唔嚟啊？定啦，一定要嚟啊！
