examples.english_sentence: She dotes on her daughter-in-law, treating her like her own daughter, so my mother-in-law and daughter-in-law have a very good relationship.

english_meaning: Mother-in-law (husband's mother)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的母亲。
explanation_english: Refers to the mother of one's husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我同我家婆關係好好嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tung4 ngo5 gaa1 po4 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 hou2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我和我婆婆关系很好。
examples.english_sentence: I have a very good relationship with my mother-in-law.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意同家婆一齊住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 tung4 gaa1 po4 jat1 cai4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不喜欢和婆婆住在一起。
examples.english_sentence: I don't like living with my mother-in-law.

english_meaning: sister-in-law (wife of elder brother)
explanation_mandarin: 指哥哥的妻子。
explanation_english: Refers to the wife of one's elder brother.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋家嫂好錫佢哋啲仔女㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa1 sou2 hou2 sek3 keoi5 dei6 di1 zai2 neoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的嫂子很疼爱他们的子女。
examples.english_sentence: Our sister-in-law loves their children very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日我帶埋家嫂一齊嚟探你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 ngo5 daai3 maai4 gaa1 sou2 jat1 cai4 lai4 taam3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天我带嫂子一起来看你。
examples.english_sentence: I'll bring my sister-in-law to visit you tomorrow.

mandarin_meaning: 家境; 家事; 家居
english_meaning: family circumstances; household affairs; home (the physical dwelling); ancestral home
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭的经济状况、家居环境或家中事务。
explanation_english: Refers to the economic circumstances of a family, the home environment, or matters related to the household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋家宅好窮，成日要慳住慳住咁用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zaak6 hou2 kung4, seng4 jat6 jiu3 haan1 zyu6 haan1 zyu6 gam2 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家境很穷，总是要省着省着地用。
examples.english_sentence: Their family circumstances are very poor, they always have to save carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年流流，唔好講埋啲唔好嘅家宅嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 lau4 lau4, m4 hou2 gong2 maai4 di1 m4 hou2 ge3 gaa1 zaak6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年期间，不要说那些不好的家事。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, don't talk about bad family matters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋風水好好，可以保佑家宅平安。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 fung1 seoi2 hou2 hou2, ho2 ji5 bou2 jau6 gaa1 zaak6 ping4 on1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的房子风水很好，可以保佑家宅平安。
examples.english_sentence: The feng shui of his house is very good, it can protect the home and family's safety.

english_meaning: family; household; dependants
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭，包括配偶和子女等。
explanation_english: Refers to family, including spouse and children (dependants).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢已經成家室喇，唔會好似以前咁自由啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 ging1 sing4 gaa1 sat1 laa3, m4 wui5 hou2 ci5 ji5 cin4 gam3 zi6 jau4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他已经成家了，不会像以前那么自由了。
examples.english_sentence: He has a family now, he won't be as free as he used to be.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁後生就想成家室，真係好少見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 soeng2 sing4 gaa1 sat1, zan1 hai6 hou2 siu2 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这么年轻就想成家，真是很少见。
examples.english_sentence: It's rare to see someone so young wanting to start a family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咗家室之後，佢嘅責任重大咗好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 zo2 gaa1 sat1 zi1 hau6, keoi5 ge3 zaak3 jam6 zung6 daai6 zo2 hou2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有了家庭之后，他的责任重大了很多。
examples.english_sentence: After having a family, his responsibilities became much greater.

english_meaning: every family, every household
explanation_mandarin: 指所有的家庭，每一户人家。
explanation_english: Refers to every family, each and every household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，家家戶戶都會貼揮春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 wui5 tip3 fai1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，每家每户都会贴挥春。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, every family will put up Fai Chun (festive decorations).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 打風落雨嗰陣，家家戶戶都要閂好門窗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daa2 fung1 lok6 jyu5 go2 zan6, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 jiu3 saan1 hou2 mun4 coeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刮风下雨的时候，每家每户都要关好门窗。
examples.english_sentence: When it's windy and rainy, every household needs to close their doors and windows properly.

english_meaning: every family; every household; each and every family
explanation_mandarin: 指每一户人家，表示普遍性。
explanation_english: Refers to every household, expressing universality or generality.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嗰陣時，家家戶戶都會貼揮春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 go2 zan6 si4, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 wui tip3 fai1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 过新年的时候，每家每户都会贴春联。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, every family pastes spring couplets.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，家家戶戶都要清理屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 jiu3 cing1 lei5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，每家每户都要清理家里。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, every household had to clean their homes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派錢，家家戶戶都有份。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 cin2, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 jau5 fan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府派钱，每家每户都有一份。
examples.english_sentence: The government distributed money, and every household got a share.

english_meaning: every family; every household
explanation_mandarin: 指所有的家庭或住户，没有例外。
explanation_english: Refers to every family or household without exception; all families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，家家户户都會貼揮春。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 wui5 tip3 fai1 ceon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，家家户户都会贴春联。
examples.english_sentence: During the New Year, every family puts up New Year scrolls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 颱風過後，家家户户都忙住清理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: toi4 fung1 gwo3 hau6, gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6 dou1 mong4 zyu6 cing1 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 台风过后，家家户户都忙着清理。
examples.english_sentence: After the typhoon, every household was busy cleaning up.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府派錢俾家家戶戶，希望可以刺激經濟。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 paai3 cin2 bei2 gaa1 gaa1 wu6 wu6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 ci3 gik1 ging1 zai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府给家家户户发钱，希望可以刺激经济。
examples.english_sentence: The government is distributing money to every household, hoping to stimulate the economy.

jyutping: gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 dik1 ging1
mandarin_meaning: 每家都有一本难念的经
english_meaning: Every family has its own problems; Every family has its own skeletons in the closet.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻每个人、每个家庭都有各自的难处和问题，难以向外人倾诉。
explanation_english: This idiom means that every family has its own set of problems and difficulties that are hard to resolve and often kept private.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係睇人哋風光，家家有本難唸嘅經㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 tai2 jan4 dei6 fung1 gwong1, gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 ge3 ging1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只看别人风光的一面，家家都有一本难念的经。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just look at the glamorous side of others; every family has its own problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企都唔容易㗎，家家有本難唸嘅經嘛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 dou1 m4 jung4 ji6 gaa3, gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 ge3 ging1 maa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家也不容易啊，家家都有一本难念的经嘛。
examples.english_sentence: Our family isn't having it easy either; every family has its own problems, you know.

jyutping: gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 dik1 ging1
mandarin_meaning: 家家都有一本难念的经
english_meaning: Every family has its own problems; every family has its own skeleton in the closet.
explanation_mandarin: 比喻每个人或每个家庭都有各自的难处，都有难以解决的问题。
explanation_english: This idiom means that every family has its own troubles and difficulties, often hidden from public view. It acknowledges that no family is perfect and that everyone faces unique challenges.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好淨係羨慕人哋，其實家家有本難念的經㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 sin6 mou6 jan4 dei6, kei4 sat6 gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 dik1 ging1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要只羡慕别人，其实家家都有一本难念的经。
examples.english_sentence: Don't just envy others; every family has its own problems.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 睇佢哋咁風光，可能家家有本難念的經呢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tai2 keoi5 dei6 gam3 fung1 gwong1, ho2 nang4 gaa1 gaa1 jau5 bun2 naan4 nim6 dik1 ging1 ne1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 看他们那么风光，可能家家都有一本难念的经呢。
examples.english_sentence: Looking at how successful they are, maybe every family has its own problems.

english_meaning: Every family has its own needs/demands.
explanation_mandarin: 指每个家庭都有各自的需求和愿望，通常用于说明不同家庭情况各异，需要区别对待。
explanation_english: This idiom means that every family has its own unique needs and desires. It is often used to illustrate that different families have different circumstances and should be treated accordingly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幫佢哋嘅時候要諗清楚，家家有求，唔可以一概而論。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 bong1 keoi5 dei6 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 nam2 cing1 co2, gaa1 gaa1 jau5 kau4, m4 ho2 ji5 jat1 koi3 ji4 leon6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们帮助他们的时候要想清楚，家家户户都有需求，不可以一概而论。
examples.english_sentence: When we help them, we need to think carefully. Every family has its own needs, so we can't generalize.

english_meaning: Everyone's a Bodhisattva; a person who tries to please everyone, often to their own detriment; a doormat.
explanation_mandarin: 形容某人对所有人都很好，过度迁就他人，如同观音菩萨普度众生一样。常带有贬义，指这个人没有原则，容易被人利用。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is overly kind and accommodating to everyone, like Guanyin (Bodhisattva of Compassion) saving all beings. It often carries a negative connotation, implying that the person lacks principles and is easily taken advantage of.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日幫人做嘢唔收錢，真係家家觀世音。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 bong1 jan4 zou6 je5 m4 sau1 cin2, zan1 hai6 gaa1 gaa1 gun1 sai3 jam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是帮别人做事不收钱，真是个烂好人。
examples.english_sentence: He always helps people with things without charging them, he's such a doormat.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做家家觀世音呀，要識得拒絕人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gaa1 gaa1 gun1 sai3 jam1 aa3, jiu3 sik1 dak1 keoi5 jyut6 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做好好先生，要学会拒绝别人。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a doormat, you need to learn to say no to people.

synonyms: 好好先生 (hou2 hou2 sin1 saang1)

english_meaning: home; household; domestic
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭生活或家庭环境。
explanation_english: Refers to home life or the home environment; related to the home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想買啲新嘅家居擺設。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 maai5 di1 san1 ge3 gaa1 geoi1 baai2 sat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想买一些新的家居摆设。
examples.english_sentence: We want to buy some new home decorations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好重視家居清潔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zung6 si6 gaa1 geoi1 cing1 git3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很重视家居清洁。
examples.english_sentence: He places great importance on home cleanliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司做家居服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zou6 gaa1 geoi1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司做家居服务。
examples.english_sentence: This company provides home services.

english_meaning: home quarantine
explanation_mandarin: 指在自己家中进行的隔离，通常是因为接触过传染病患者或者出现疑似症状。
explanation_english: Refers to quarantine conducted at one's home, usually due to contact with individuals infected with a contagious disease or experiencing suspected symptoms.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢因為接觸過確診者，所以要家居隔離十四日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jan1 wai6 zip3 cuk1 gwo3 kok3 zan2 ze2, so2 ji5 jiu3 gaa1 geoi1 gaak3 lei4 sap6 sei3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为他接触过确诊者，所以要居家隔离十四天。
examples.english_sentence: Because he had contact with a confirmed case, he needs to undergo home quarantine for fourteen days.

english_meaning: family members; dependents
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭成员，尤指依靠户主供养的成员。
explanation_english: Refers to family members, especially those who are dependent on the head of the household for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫院通知佢屋企嘅家屬嚟醫院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 jyun2 tung1 zi1 keoi5 uk1 kei5 ge3 gaa1 suk6 lai4 ji1 jyun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医院通知了他的家人来医院。
examples.english_sentence: The hospital notified his family members to come to the hospital.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅家屬都好擔心佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaa1 suk6 dou1 hou2 daam1 sam1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的家人都很担心他。
examples.english_sentence: His family members are all very worried about him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 申請簽證要提供家屬嘅資料。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 ching2 cin1 zing3 jiu3 tai4 gung1 gaa1 suk6 ge3 zi1 liu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 申请签证需要提供家属的资料。
examples.english_sentence: You need to provide information about your family members when applying for a visa.

english_meaning: hometown; native place; ancestral home
explanation_mandarin: 指自己的家乡，祖籍地，带有怀念的感情色彩。
explanation_english: Refers to one's hometown, ancestral home, or native place, often carrying sentimental feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋幾時可以返家山探下啲親戚啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gei2 si4 ho2 ji5 faan1 gaa1 saan1 taam3 haa5 di1 can1 cik1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们什么时候可以回老家探望一下亲戚啊？
examples.english_sentence: When can we go back to our hometown to visit our relatives?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然我喺香港出世，但係我嘅家山喺廣東。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 ngo5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 ceot1 sai3, daan6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gaa1 saan1 hai2 gwong2 dung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然我在香港出生，但是我的家乡在广东。
examples.english_sentence: Although I was born in Hong Kong, my hometown is in Guangdong.

english_meaning: Heaven has eyes; divine retribution; Karma will get you.
explanation_mandarin: 指上天能够明辨是非，善恶终有报应。
explanation_english: This idiom suggests that Heaven (or a higher power) is able to discern right from wrong and that good and evil will eventually be rewarded or punished, respectively. It implies that wrongdoers will eventually face consequences for their actions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢咁衰，遲早家山有眼㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam3 seoi1, ci4 zou2 gaa1 saan1 jau5 ngaan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他那么坏，迟早会遭到报应的。
examples.english_sentence: He's so bad, sooner or later he will face retribution.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為做壞事冇人知，家山有眼㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 zou6 waai6 si6 mou5 jan4 zi1, gaa1 saan1 jau5 ngaan5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要以为做坏事没人知道，老天有眼。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think that doing bad things will go unnoticed, Heaven has eyes.

english_meaning: Blessed family lineage; A family blessed with good fortune due to virtuous ancestors.
explanation_mandarin: 指祖先积德，给后代带来福气。形容家族历史悠久，底蕴深厚，并且子孙昌盛，生活幸福。
explanation_english: This idiom describes a family that is blessed with good fortune due to the virtuous deeds of their ancestors. It implies a long and rich family history, a strong foundation, and prosperity for future generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企幾代都咁風光，真係家山有福呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 gei2 doi6 dou1 gam3 fung1 gwong1, zan1 hai6 gaa1 saan1 jau5 fuk1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家几代都这么风光，真是祖上有德啊！
examples.english_sentence: Their family has been successful for generations, truly a family with blessed lineage!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李生個仔咁叻仔，都係家山有福，父母教得好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 saang1 go3 zai2 gam3 lek1 zai2, dou1 hai6 gaa1 saan1 jau5 fuk1, fu6 mou5 gaau3 dak1 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李先生的儿子这么优秀，都是祖上有德，父母也教得好。
examples.english_sentence: Mr. Li's son is so outstanding, it's a blessing of the family lineage, and also his parents taught him well.

english_meaning: To be rich, to have a good financial foundation, to live a comfortable and wealthy life
explanation_mandarin: 形容家庭有较好的经济基础，生活富裕，衣食无忧。
explanation_english: Describes a family with a solid financial foundation, living a wealthy and comfortable life with no worries about basic necessities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家家山發，住緊半山別墅㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 gaa1 saan1 faat3, zyu6 gan2 bun3 saan1 bit6 seoi5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家家底殷实，住在半山别墅。
examples.english_sentence: They are a well-off family and live in a villa on the Mid-Levels.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢細細個就家山發，乜都唔使愁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sai3 sai3 go3 zau6 gaa1 saan1 faat3, mat1 dou1 m4 sai2 sau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他从小就家境富裕，什么都不用愁。
examples.english_sentence: He was born into wealth and has never had to worry about anything.

mandarin_meaning: 自己人; 自己人; 自己人
english_meaning: one of us; our own people; fellow Cantonese speaker
explanation_mandarin: 指自己人，屬於同一群体或关系亲近的人，含有亲切友好的意味。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who is 'one of us,' belonging to the same group or someone with close ties, implying a sense of familiarity and friendliness. Often used to identify fellow Cantonese speakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢都係家己儂，唔使咁客氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 hai6 gaa1 gei2 nung4, m4 sai2 gam3 haak3 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他也是自己人，不用那么客气。
examples.english_sentence: He is one of us, you don't need to be so polite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 大家家己儂，有咩困難咪出聲囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: daai6 gaa1 gaa1 gei2 nung4, jau5 me1 kwan3 naan4 mai5 chut1 seng1 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 大家都是自己人，有什么困难就说出来吧。
examples.english_sentence: We are all our own people, if you have any difficulties, just say it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽到佢講廣東話，就覺得好似見到家己儂咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting3 dou2 keoi5 gong2 gwong2 dung1 waa2, zau6 gok3 dak1 hou2 ci5 gin3 dou2 gaa1 gei2 nung4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听到他说广东话，就觉得好像见到自己人一样。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing him speak Cantonese, I feel like I've met someone who is one of us.

english_meaning: one of us; our own people; insider
explanation_mandarin: 指关系亲近，可以信任，属于同一阵营的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone close, trustworthy, and belonging to the same group or team; one of us; insider.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔使驚，佢哋都係家己冷，會幫你嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 sai2 geng1, keoi5 dei6 dou1 hai6 gaa1 gei2 laang1, wui5 bong1 nei5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不用怕，他们都是自己人，会帮你的。
examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, they are all our own people, they will help you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次個project交畀家己冷做，穩陣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 go3 project gaau1 bei2 gaa1 gei2 laang1 zou6, wan2 zin6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次的项目交给自己人做，稳妥一点。
examples.english_sentence: This time, let's give the project to one of us, it's safer that way.

english_meaning: everyday, common, homely, simple (referring to food or activities)
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物普通、平常、不特别。多用于形容食物简单、日常。
explanation_english: Describes something as ordinary, common, and not special. Often used to describe food as simple and everyday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲餸好家常啫，唔係咩山珍海味。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 sung3 hou2 gaa1 soeng4 ze1, m4 hai6 me1 saan1 zan1 hoi2 mei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅的菜很家常，不是什么山珍海味。
examples.english_sentence: The dishes at this restaurant are very simple and common; they're not any kind of delicacies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食啲家常便飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 sik6 di1 gaa1 soeng4 bin6 faan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚吃些家常便饭吧。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have a simple, home-style meal tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好家常，好易相處。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 gaa1 soeng4, hou2 ji6 soeng1 chu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的为人很家常，很容易相处。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very down-to-earth person and easy to get along with.

english_meaning: commonplace; an everyday occurrence; routine; nothing special
explanation_mandarin: 指日常生活中常见的、平常的事情或食物；也形容某事很普通，没什么特别。
explanation_english: Refers to something common, ordinary, or routine in daily life, like everyday food or events. It can also describe something as being unremarkable or nothing special.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲嘢對佢嚟講簡直係家常便飯啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 je5 deoi3 keoi5 lei4 gong2 gaan2 zik6 hai6 gaa1 soeng4 baan6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些事情对他来说简直是家常便饭。
examples.english_sentence: These things are simply commonplace for him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋食啲家常便飯就得㗎啦，唔使咁隆重嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sik6 di1 gaa1 soeng4 baan6 zau6 dak1 gaa3 laa1, m4 sai2 gam3 lung4 zung6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们吃些家常便饭就可以了，不用那么隆重。
examples.english_sentence: We can just have some simple home-style food; there's no need for such a grand occasion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對於佢哋嚟講，加班到凌晨係家常便飯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 jyu1 keoi5 dei6 lei4 gong2, gaa1 baan1 dou3 ling4 san4 hai6 gaa1 soeng4 baan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对于他们来说，加班到凌晨是家常便饭。
examples.english_sentence: For them, working overtime until dawn is a common occurrence.

english_meaning: home-style dish; home cooking
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭日常制作的菜肴，通常比较简单、朴实。
explanation_english: Refers to dishes that are typically cooked at home. They are usually simple, straightforward, and not particularly elaborate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日我哋食啲家常菜啦，唔好咁多花款。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ngo5 dei6 sik6 di1 gaa1 soeng4 coi3 laa1, m4 hou2 gam3 do1 faa1 fun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天我们吃些家常菜吧，不要那么多花样。
examples.english_sentence: Let's have some home-style dishes today, nothing too fancy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嫲嫲煮嘅家常菜最好食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: maa4 maa4 zyu2 ge3 gaa1 soeng4 coi3 zeoi3 hou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 奶奶做的家常菜最好吃。
examples.english_sentence: Grandma's home cooking is the best.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢煮嘅家常菜好有鑊氣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyu2 ge3 gaa1 soeng4 coi3 hou2 jau5 wok6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她做的家常菜很有锅气。
examples.english_sentence: The home-style dishes he/she cooks have a good wok hei (wok aroma).

english_meaning: family fortune, family assets, financial standing
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭拥有的财富、资产或经济状况。
explanation_english: Refers to a family's wealth, assets, or financial standing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企嘅家底好厚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei5 ge3 gaa1 dai2 hou2 hau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家的家底很厚。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has a substantial fortune.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢靠自己嘅努力，白手興家，打好咗份家底。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 ge3 nu5 lik6, baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, daa2 hou2 zo2 fan6 gaa1 dai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他靠自己的努力，白手起家，积累了一份家底。
examples.english_sentence: He built up his family's fortune through his own hard work, starting from nothing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要守住呢份家底都唔容易㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sau2 zyu6 ni1 fan6 gaa1 dai2 dou1 m4 jung4 yi6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要守住这份家底也不容易啊。
examples.english_sentence: It's not easy to preserve this family fortune.

english_meaning: family, household
explanation_mandarin: 以婚姻、血缘或收养关系为基础组成的社会群体。包括父母和子女等成员。
explanation_english: A social group consisting of parents and their children, based on marriage, blood relations, or adoption; a household.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我愛我嘅家庭。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 oi3 ngo5 ge3 gaa1 ting4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我爱我的家庭。
examples.english_sentence: I love my family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋家庭好幸福。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 ting4 hou2 hang6 fuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的家庭很幸福。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very happy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家庭教育好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 ting4 gaau3 juk6 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家庭教育很重要。
examples.english_sentence: Family education is very important.

english_meaning: housewife, homemaker
explanation_mandarin: 主要负责家庭事务的已婚妇女，通常不从事有薪工作。
explanation_english: A married woman who primarily manages the household, typically not engaging in paid employment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽係一個家庭主婦，佢照顧晒我哋全家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 hai6 jat1 go3 gaa1 ting4 zyu2 fu5, keoi5 ziu3 gu3 saai3 ngo5 dei6 cyun4 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈是一个家庭主妇，她照顾我们全家。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is a housewife, she takes care of our whole family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多女性都唔想做家庭主婦，想有自己嘅事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 neoi5 sing3 dou1 m4 soeng2 zou6 gaa1 ting4 zyu2 fu5, soeng2 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多女性都不想做家庭主妇，想要有自己的事业。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many women don't want to be housewives, they want to have their own career.

english_meaning: private tutor, home tutor
explanation_mandarin: 指在学生家中进行课业辅导的老师。
explanation_english: A teacher who provides academic tutoring to a student in the student's home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我請咗個家庭敎師嚟幫我個仔補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ceng2 zo2 go3 gaa1 ting4 gaau3 si1 lai4 bong1 ngo5 go3 zai2 bou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我请了一个家庭教师来帮我儿子补习。
examples.english_sentence: I hired a private tutor to help my son with tutoring.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家啲家長好捨得洗錢請家庭敎師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 di1 gaa1 zoeng2 hou2 se2 dak1 sai2 cin2 ceng2 gaa1 ting4 gaau3 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在的家长很舍得花钱请家庭教师。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, parents are willing to spend a lot of money on private tutors.

synonyms: 私補老師 (si1 bou2 lou5 si1)

english_meaning: private tutor, home tutor
explanation_mandarin: 指受雇到学生家中进行辅导的老师。
explanation_english: A teacher hired to provide private tutoring to a student at their home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋請咗個家庭教師幫個仔補習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 gaa1 ting4 gaau3 si1 bong1 go3 zai2 bou2 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们请了个家庭教师帮儿子补习。
examples.english_sentence: We hired a private tutor to help our son with his studies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做緊家庭教師，幫啲小朋友做功課。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 gan2 gaa1 ting4 gaau3 si1, bong1 di1 siu2 pang4 jau5 zou6 gung1 fo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她正在做家庭教师，帮孩子们做作业。
examples.english_sentence: She is working as a private tutor, helping the kids with their homework.

english_meaning: Family planning
explanation_mandarin: 指夫妇有计划地生育子女，包括生育的数量、间隔时间等。
explanation_english: Family planning refers to the practice of intentionally controlling the number of children in a family and the intervals between their births, often involving contraception or other reproductive technologies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆都有共識，會做好家庭計劃先至生小朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 dou1 jau5 gung6 sik1, wui5 zou6 hou2 gaa1 ting4 gai3 waak6 sin1 zi3 sang1 siu2 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们夫妻俩都有共识，会做好计划生育之后再生孩子。
examples.english_sentence: The couple has reached a consensus that they will practice family planning before having children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅家庭計劃指導會提供好多有關避孕嘅資訊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 gaa1 ting4 gai3 waak6 zi2 dou6 wui2 tai4 cung1 hou2 do1 jau5 gwaan1 bei6 jyun6 ge3 zi1 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港家庭计划指导会提供很多有关避孕的信息。
examples.english_sentence: The Family Planning Association of Hong Kong provides a lot of information about contraception.

mandarin_meaning: 家徒四壁 (jiā tú sì bì)
english_meaning: Poverty-stricken; penniless; destitute; one's family is so poor that there is nothing but the bare walls
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常贫穷，家里什么都没有，只有四面墙壁。
explanation_english: Describes extreme poverty, where a home is completely bare, with nothing but the four walls.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到家徒四壁，真係好慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 gaa1 tou4 sei3 bik1, zan1 hai6 hou2 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌得家徒四壁，真是很惨。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled until he was completely penniless, it's truly pitiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 場大火搞到佢哋家徒四壁，乜嘢都冇晒。
examples.jyutping_sentence: coeng4 daai6 fo2 gaau2 dou3 keoi5 dei6 gaa1 tou4 sei3 bik1, mat1 je5 dou1 mou5 saai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一场大火搞得他们家徒四壁，什么都没有了。
examples.english_sentence: The big fire left them completely destitute, they lost everything.

synonyms: 一貧如洗 (jat1 pan4 jyu4 sai2)

english_meaning: my mother (humble form)
explanation_mandarin: 谦称自己的母亲。在正式场合或书面语中使用。
explanation_english: A humble way to refer to one's own mother. Used in formal situations or in writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 家慈身體安好，多謝關心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaa1 ci4 san1 tai2 on1 hou2, do1 ze6 gwaan1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我母亲身体很好，谢谢关心。
examples.english_sentence: My mother is in good health, thank you for your concern.

english_meaning: to manage household finances; to support the family; to be the breadwinner
explanation_mandarin: 指负责家庭的经济开支和管理，负担家庭的主要经济责任。
explanation_english: Refers to being responsible for the household's financial expenses and management, and bearing the family's main financial responsibility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人家持成頭家，真係好辛苦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 gaa1 ci4 sing4 tau4 gaa1, zan1 hai6 hou2 san1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人负担整个家庭的开销，真的很辛苦。
examples.english_sentence: He supports the whole family alone, it's really tough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家經濟唔好，兩公婆都要出嚟做嘢家持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 ging1 zai3 m4 hou2, loeng5 gung1 po4 dou1 jiu3 chut1 lai4 zou6 je5 gaa1 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在经济不好，夫妻俩都要出来工作维持家计。
examples.english_sentence: The economy is not good now, both husband and wife need to work to support the family.

synonyms: 撐起頭家 (caang1 hei2 tau4 gaa1)

english_meaning: home economics; home management; household management
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭事务的管理和经营，包括烹饪、清洁、缝纫、育儿、家庭理财等方面。
explanation_english: Refers to the management and running of household affairs, including cooking, cleaning, sewing, childcare, and family finances.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢讀緊家政，想第時做個好老婆。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 duk6 gan2 gaa1 zing3, soeng2 dai6 si4 zou6 go3 hou2 lou5 po2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她正在学习家政，想以后做个好妻子。
examples.english_sentence: She's studying home economics, hoping to be a good wife in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我阿媽家政好叻，屋企執到好企理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 maa1 gaa1 zing3 hou2 lek1, uk1 kei2 zap1 dou3 hou2 kei5 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我妈妈家政很好，家里收拾得很整洁。
examples.english_sentence: My mom is good at home economics, she keeps the house very tidy.

english_meaning: family education; upbringing; manners
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭的教育，包括礼仪、道德等方面的教养。
explanation_english: Refers to the education received from one's family, including manners, morals, and upbringing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢呢個人好有家敎，講嘢好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ni1 go3 jan4 hou2 jau5 gaa1 gaau3, gong2 je5 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个人很有家教，说话很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: This person has good manners, speaking very politely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁無家敎啦，食飯唔好出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou4 gaa1 gaau3 laa1, sik6 faan6 m4 hou2 chut1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别这么没家教，吃饭不要出声。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so ill-mannered, don't make noise while eating.

english_meaning: upbringing; family education; family rules; manners; breeding
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭中的教育和培养，也指家庭的规矩和礼仪；也可以指个人所表现出来的教养。
explanation_english: Refers to education and upbringing within a family; also refers to family rules and etiquette. It can also refer to the manners or breeding displayed by an individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好有家教，見到長輩都好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 gaa1 gaau3, gin3 dou2 zoeng2 bui3 dou1 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很有家教，见到长辈都很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: He has good upbringing, he is very polite when he sees elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋屋企家教好嚴，細個嗰陣唔可以講粗口。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 uk1 kei2 gaa1 gaau3 hou2 jim4, sai3 go3 go2 zan6 m4 ho2 ji5 gong2 cou1 hau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家家教很严，小时候不可以讲脏话。
examples.english_sentence: Our family's upbringing was very strict, we couldn't swear when we were young.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅家教反映咗佢屋企嘅文化。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 gaa1 gaau3 faan2 jing2 zo2 keoi5 uk1 kei2 ge3 man4 faa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的家教反映了他的家庭文化。
examples.english_sentence: His upbringing reflects his family's culture.

english_meaning: family; clan
explanation_mandarin: 指有血缘关系的人组成的社会组织，通常包括几代人。
explanation_english: A group of people related by blood or marriage, usually spanning several generations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋家族喺香港好有影響力㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 zuk6 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 hou2 jau5 jing2 hoeng2 lik6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的家族在香港很有影响力。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very influential in Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋家族每逢過年都會聚埋一齊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaa1 zuk6 mui5 fung4 gwo3 nin4 dou1 wui5 zeoi6 maai4 jat1 cai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们家族每年过年都会聚在一起。
examples.english_sentence: Our family gathers together every Chinese New Year.

english_meaning: Family office
explanation_mandarin: 为超高净值家族提供全方位财富管理和家族服务的机构。
explanation_english: An institution that provides comprehensive wealth management and family services to ultra-high-net-worth families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多香港嘅富豪都設立咗家族辦公室嚟管理佢哋嘅資產。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 ge3 fu3 hou4 dou1 sat3 lap6 zo2 gaa1 zuk6 baan6 gung1 sat1 lai4 gun2 lei5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zi1 caan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多香港的富豪都设立了家族办公室来管理他们的资产。
examples.english_sentence: Now many Hong Kong tycoons have established family offices to manage their assets.

english_meaning: domestic violence
explanation_mandarin: 指发生在家庭成员之间的暴力行为，包括身体虐待、精神虐待、性虐待等。
explanation_english: Domestic violence refers to acts of violence occurring between family members, including physical abuse, emotional abuse, sexual abuse, and other forms of mistreatment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔可以容忍任何形式嘅家暴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji5 jung4 jan2 jam6 ho4 hang4 sik1 ge3 gaa1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不能容忍任何形式的家庭暴力。
examples.english_sentence: Domestic violence of any kind is not to be tolerated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢報警話佢老公對佢施行家暴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bou3 ging2 waa6 keoi5 lou5 gung1 deoi3 keoi5 si1 hang4 gaa1 bou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她报警说她丈夫对她实施家庭暴力。
examples.english_sentence: She reported to the police that her husband was committing domestic violence against her.

english_meaning: letter from home; family letter
explanation_mandarin: 家人写的信，通常指远在他乡的人收到的来自家里的信件。
explanation_english: A letter from family members, usually referring to letters received by someone who is far from home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 收到屋企寄嚟嘅家書，我開心到不得了。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sau1 dou3 uk1 kei2 gei3 lai4 ge3 gaa1 syu1, ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 bat1 dak1 liu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收到家里寄来的家书，我开心得不得了。
examples.english_sentence: I was extremely happy to receive the letter from home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人成日打仗，家書都好難寄到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 seng4 jat6 daa2 zoeng3, gaa1 syu1 dou1 hou2 naan4 gei3 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前人们经常打仗，家书都很难寄到。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, when people were constantly at war, it was difficult for letters from home to be delivered.

english_meaning: family property, family business, family estate, family's livelihood
explanation_mandarin: 指祖上或家族所遗留下来的产业或事业。
explanation_english: Refers to the property or business passed down from ancestors or the family.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩兄弟為咗爭家業而反面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 hing1 dai6 wai4 zo2 zaang1 gaa1 jip6 ji4 faan2 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两兄弟为了争夺家产而翻脸。
examples.english_sentence: The two brothers fell out over fighting for the family property.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢阿爺白手興家，建立咗龐大家業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 aa3 je4 baak6 sau2 hing1 gaa1, gin3 lap6 zo2 pong4 daai6 gaa1 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爷爷白手起家，建立了庞大的家业。
examples.english_sentence: His grandfather started from scratch and built a huge family business.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想繼承家業，想自己闖一番事業。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 gai3 sing4 gaa1 jip6, soeng2 zi6 gei2 cong2 jat1 faan1 si6 jip6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想继承家业，想自己闯一番事业。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to inherit the family business, he wants to make his own way in the world.

mandarin_meaning: 家乐径 (通常指短途、适合家庭的自然步道)
english_meaning: Family Walk Trail (usually refers to a short, family-friendly nature trail)
explanation_mandarin: 指短途、难度较低、适合家庭成员一同行走的自然步道，通常设施完善，风景优美。
explanation_english: Refers to a short, low-difficulty nature trail suitable for families to walk together. It usually has good facilities and beautiful scenery.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋一家人成日去行家樂徑，輕鬆又健康。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 seng4 jat6 heoi3 hang4 gaa1 lok6 ging3, hing1 sung1 jau6 gin6 hong1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们一家人经常去走家乐径，轻松又健康。
examples.english_sentence: My family often goes hiking on family walk trails, it's relaxing and healthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度啲家樂徑好啱小朋友行，唔會太攰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 di1 gaa1 lok6 ging3 hou2 ngaam1 sai2 peng4 jau5 hang4, m4 wui2 taai3 leoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的家乐径很适合小朋友走，不会太累。
examples.english_sentence: The family walk trails here are very suitable for children to walk on, they won't be too tired.

mandarin_meaning: 爱炫耀的人；爱显摆的人
english_meaning: Show-off; someone who likes to flaunt or show off.
explanation_mandarin: 指那些喜欢炫耀自己拥有的东西，或喜欢卖弄自己才能的人。
explanation_english: Refers to someone who likes to show off what they have, or someone who likes to flaunt their talents or abilities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺Facebook度曬佢啲名牌手袋，真係家機布。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 Facebook dou6 saai3 keoi5 di1 ming4 paai4 sau2 doi2, zan1 hai6 gaa1 gei1 bou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是喜欢在Facebook上晒他的名牌包，真是个爱炫耀的人。
examples.english_sentence: He always shows off his branded handbags on Facebook. What a show-off.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咪做家機布啦，無人想知你幾有錢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mai5 zou6 gaa1 gei1 bou3 laa1, mou5 jan4 soeng2 zi1 nei5 gei2 jau5 cin2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别显摆了，没人想知道你多有钱。
examples.english_sentence: Stop showing off, no one wants to know how rich you are.

mandarin_meaning: 指没见过世面，土里土气的人
english_meaning: Unsophisticated, rustic, unworldly; someone who hasn't seen much of the world; country bumpkin
explanation_mandarin: 形容一个人见识少，没见过大场面，做事土里土气，缺乏经验和世故。
explanation_english: Describes someone who lacks worldly experience, hasn't seen much of the world, and behaves in an unsophisticated or rustic manner. They are often seen as lacking experience and worldliness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都喺鄉下，乜嘢都唔識，真係家欄雞咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai2 hoeng1 haa6, mat1 je5 dou1 m4 sik1, zan1 hai6 gaa1 laan4 gai1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是待在乡下，什么都不懂，真是个没见过世面的人。
examples.english_sentence: He's always in the countryside and doesn't know anything. He's such a country bumpkin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好笑人哋係家欄雞，可能佢哋有你哋冇嘅優點。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 siu3 jan4 dei6 hai6 gaa1 laan4 gai1, ho2 nang4 keoi5 dei6 jau5 nei5 dei6 mou5 ge3 jau1 dim2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要嘲笑别人是没见过世面的人，可能他们有你们没有的优点。
examples.english_sentence: Don't laugh at people for being unsophisticated, they might have advantages that you don't have.

english_meaning: Housewife; a woman who is seen as dowdy and lacking in style because she is mainly occupied with domestic tasks.
explanation_mandarin: 指主要负责家庭事务，打扮朴素，缺乏时尚感的家庭主妇。通常带有贬义。
explanation_english: Refers to a housewife who is mainly responsible for domestic affairs and is dressed plainly and lacks a sense of fashion. Usually has a negative connotation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢結婚之後就變成咗個家欄鷄，日日都喺屋企湊仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 git3 fan1 zi1 hau6 zau6 bin3 sing4 zo2 go3 gaa1 laan4 gai1, jat1 jat1 dou1 hai2 uk1 kei2 cau3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她结婚后就变成了一个家庭主妇，每天都在家里带孩子。
examples.english_sentence: After she got married, she became a housewife, staying at home to take care of her children every day.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁冇打扮啦，唔想俾人話你係家欄鷄呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou5 daa2 bun2 laa1, m4 soeng2 bei2 jan4 waa6 nei5 hai6 gaa1 laan4 gai1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你不要这么不修边幅啦，不想被人说你是黄脸婆吗？
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so unkempt, don't you want people to call you a dowdy housewife?

english_meaning: my mother (humble)
explanation_mandarin: 谦称自己的母亲。是对别人称呼自己母亲的客气说法。
explanation_english: A humble way of referring to one's own mother when speaking to others. It's a polite term used to refer to your mother to someone else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日係家母嘅生日，我哋會出去食飯慶祝。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hai6 gaa1 mou5 ge3 saang1 jat6, ngo5 dei6 wui5 cheot1 heoi3 sik6 faan6 qing3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天是我母亲的生日，我们会出去吃饭庆祝。
examples.english_sentence: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday, we will go out for dinner to celebrate.

english_meaning: family rules, family discipline, domestic discipline
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭内部制定的规矩和惩罚措施，通常带有一定的强制性。旧时指家长对违反家规的子女进行体罚的方式。
explanation_english: Refers to the rules and disciplinary measures established within a family, often with a certain degree of compulsion. In the past, it referred to the methods parents used to physically punish children who violated family rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲父母好興用家法嚟教仔。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 fu6 mou5 hou2 hing3 yung6 gaa1 faat3 lai4 gaau3 zai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的父母很喜欢用家法来教育孩子。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, parents liked to use family discipline to educate their children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做錯事，屋企人話要執行家法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 co3 si6, uk1 kei2 yan4 waa6 jiu3 zap1 hang4 gaa1 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做错了事，家里人说要执行家法。
examples.english_sentence: He did something wrong, and his family said they would enforce the family rules.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家好多人都唔贊成用家法打細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hou2 do1 yan4 dou1 m4 zaan3 sing4 yung6 gaa1 faat3 daa2 sai3 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在很多人都不赞成用家法打小孩。
examples.english_sentence: Nowadays, many people do not approve of using family discipline to hit children.

english_meaning: my father (humble)
explanation_mandarin: 对人称自己的父亲的谦词。
explanation_english: A humble way to refer to one's own father.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，家父今日唔得閒見你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, gaa1 fu6 gam1 jat6 m4 dak1 haan4 gin3 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，我父亲今天没空见你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm sorry, my father is not free to meet you today.

english_meaning: the whole family; the entire family (including grandparents, parents, and children)
explanation_mandarin: 指整个家庭的所有成员，包括祖父、祖母、父母和子女。
explanation_english: Refers to all members of the entire family, including grandparents, parents, and children.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 新年嘅時候，我哋成家爺仔乸都會返鄉下拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: san1 nin4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 sing4 gaa1 je4 zai2 naa2 dou1 wui5 faan1 hoeng1 haa6 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 新年的时候，我们全家老小都会回老家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: During Chinese New Year, our entire family will return to our hometown to pay New Year visits.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋家爺仔乸都好錫對方㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaa1 je4 zai2 naa2 dou1 hou2 sek3 deoi3 fong1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们全家都很疼爱对方。
examples.english_sentence: Their whole family is very loving and caring towards each other.

english_meaning: tools; implements; utensils; belongings
explanation_mandarin: 泛指工具、器具、家當或隨身物品。
explanation_english: Refers generally to tools, implements, household belongings, or personal possessions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶咗好多家生去露營。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 zo2 ho2 do1 gaa1 sang1 heoi3 lou6 ying4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他带了很多工具去露营。
examples.english_sentence: He brought a lot of tools/belongings to go camping.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋嘅時候，啲家生要小心處理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 ge3 si4 hau6, di1 gaa1 sang1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 chu2 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的时候，这些傢伙要小心处理。
examples.english_sentence: When moving house, the belongings need to be handled carefully.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 廚房入面擺滿晒煮飯嘅家生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: chu4 fong2 jap6 min6 baai2 mun5 saai3 zyu2 faan6 ge3 gaa1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 厨房里面摆满了做饭的工具。
examples.english_sentence: The kitchen is full of cooking utensils.

english_meaning: Family property; family fortune; inheritance; (in some contexts, used as an insult meaning 'good-for-nothing offspring')
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭拥有的财产，包括房屋、土地、金钱等。有时也指子女，尤指不成器的子女（含贬义）。
explanation_english: Refers to family property and assets, including houses, land, money, etc. Sometimes it can also refer to one's offspring, especially those who are considered useless or disappointing (with a derogatory connotation).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日攞屋企啲家產去賭錢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 lo2 uk1 kei2 di1 gaa1 caan2 heoi3 dou2 cin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拿家里的家产去赌钱。
examples.english_sentence: He always takes the family fortune to gamble.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你呢個家產，乜都做唔掂！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ni1 go3 gaa1 caan2, mat1 dou1 zou6 m4 dim6!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你这个不成器的东西，什么都做不好！
examples.english_sentence: You good-for-nothing, you can't do anything right!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿爺留低好多家產畀佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 je4 lau4 dai1 hou2 do1 gaa1 caan2 bei2 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爷爷留下了很多家产给他们。
examples.english_sentence: Grandfather left a lot of family fortune for them.

english_meaning: household expenses, allowance (given to parents/family)
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭日常开支，也指子女给父母或配偶给家庭的经济支持。
explanation_english: Refers to household expenses. Also refers to financial support given to parents by their children or to the family by a spouse.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我每個月都要畀家用阿媽。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 go3 jyut6 dou1 jiu3 bei2 gaa1 jung6 aa3 maa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我每个月都要给妈妈家用。
examples.english_sentence: I have to give my mom an allowance every month.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人工唔高，但都盡力畀多啲家用。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 gung1 m4 gou1, daan6 dou1 zeon6 lik6 bei2 do1 di1 gaa1 jung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的工资不高，但还是尽力多给一些家用。
examples.english_sentence: His salary isn't high, but he tries his best to give more money for household expenses.

english_meaning: livestock; domestic animal
explanation_mandarin: 指人类为了经济或其他目的而饲养的动物。
explanation_english: Livestock refers to animals raised by humans for economic or other purposes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 農場養咗好多家畜，好似牛、羊、豬咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nung4 coeng4 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 cuk1, hou2 ci5 ngau4, joeng4, zyu1 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 农场养了很多家畜，比如牛、羊、猪等。
examples.english_sentence: The farm raises a lot of livestock, such as cows, sheep, and pigs.

english_meaning: belongings; property; household effects; possessions; one's all
explanation_mandarin: 指全部的家庭财产或物品。可以是实际的财产，也可以指某人所拥有的全部东西。
explanation_english: Refers to all of one's household property or belongings. It can be tangible assets or everything that someone owns.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成副家當都俾人呃咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 fu3 gaa1 dong3 dou1 bei2 jan4 aak1 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的全部家当都被人骗走了。
examples.english_sentence: All his belongings were swindled away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 執埋啲家當，我哋走佬啦！
examples.jyutping_sentence: zaap1 maai4 di1 gaa1 dong3, ngo5 dei6 zau2 lou2 laa1!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 收拾一下东西，我们跑路吧！
examples.english_sentence: Pack up the belongings, let's run away!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢得返少少家當，生活好艱難。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dak1 faan1 siu2 siu2 gaa1 dong3, sang1 wut6 hou2 gaan1 naan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他只剩下一点家当，生活很艰难。
examples.english_sentence: He only has a few belongings left, and life is very difficult.

english_meaning: family members; dependents
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭成员，通常指配偶、子女等受供养的亲属。
explanation_english: Refers to family members, usually spouses, children, and other relatives who are dependent on someone for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢帶埋成家眷去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daai3 maai4 sing4 gaa1 gyun3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他带着全家去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He took his whole family on a trip.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 以前啲人做官，升官發財就帶埋家眷上任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji5 cin4 di1 jan4 zou6 guan1, sing1 guan1 faat3 coi4 zau6 daai3 maai4 gaa1 gyun3 soeng5 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人当官，升官发财就带着家属上任。
examples.english_sentence: In the past, when people became officials, they would bring their families with them when they were promoted and became wealthy.

english_meaning: family ruined and people dead; total destruction of a family
explanation_mandarin: 形容家庭彻底毁灭，所有人都遭遇不幸。
explanation_english: Describes the complete destruction of a family, with everyone experiencing misfortune or death. It implies a catastrophic event or series of events leading to total ruin.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 戰爭令到好多家庭都家破人亡。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zin3 zaan3 ling6 dou3 hou2 do1 gaa1 ting4 dou1 gaa1 po3 jan4 mong4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 战争导致很多家庭家破人亡。
examples.english_sentence: War has caused many families to be ruined and people to die.

synonyms: 妻离子散 (cai1 li4 zi2 saan3)

english_meaning: poultry
explanation_mandarin: 指人工饲养的鸟类，主要用作食物或提供蛋。
explanation_english: Domesticated birds raised for meat or eggs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋農場養咗好多家禽，好似雞、鴨、鵝噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 nung4 coeng4 joeng5 zo2 hou2 do1 gaa1 kam4, hou2 ci5 gai1, aap3, ngo4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的农场养了很多家禽，比如鸡、鸭、鹅等。
examples.english_sentence: Our farm raises a lot of poultry, like chickens, ducks, and geese.

english_meaning: furniture; household items; belongings
explanation_mandarin: 指家里的各种家具和生活用品。
explanation_english: Refers to various furniture and household items in a home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 搬屋嗰陣，好多家私都要掉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bun1 uk1 go2 zan6, hou2 do1 gaa1 si1 dou1 jiu3 diu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 搬家的时候，很多家具都要扔掉。
examples.english_sentence: When moving house, a lot of furniture needs to be thrown away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間屋嘅家私好齊全。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 uk1 ge3 gaa1 si1 hou2 cai4 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这间屋子的家具很齐全。
examples.english_sentence: The furniture in this house is very complete.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲家私都係二手嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gaa1 si1 dou1 hai6 ji6 sau2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的家具都是二手的。
examples.english_sentence: His furniture is all second-hand.

english_meaning: House empty, belongings gone; left with absolutely nothing; destitute.
explanation_mandarin: 形容家里什么都没有了，非常贫穷，一无所有。
explanation_english: Describes a household that is completely empty and devoid of possessions, indicating extreme poverty and destitution. It emphasizes the lack of even basic necessities.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢賭錢賭到家空物淨，真係慘。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou2 cin2 dou2 dou3 gaa1 hung1 mat6 zing6, zan1 hai6 caam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他赌钱赌得家徒四壁，真是惨。
examples.english_sentence: He gambled until he was left with absolutely nothing; it's truly tragic.

english_meaning: father-in-law (husband's father)
explanation_mandarin: 指丈夫的父亲。
explanation_english: Refers to the father of one's husband.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好錫我嘅家翁，佢對我好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 sek3 ngo5 ge3 gaa1 jung1, keoi5 deoi3 ngo5 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢我的公公，他对我很好。
examples.english_sentence: I really like my father-in-law, he is very good to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年新年，我哋要去家翁屋企拜年。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 san1 nin4, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 heoi3 gaa1 jung1 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年新年，我们要去公公家拜年。
examples.english_sentence: This Chinese New Year, we need to go to my father-in-law's house to pay a New Year visit.

english_meaning: family reputation, family name, family honor
explanation_mandarin: 指家庭的声誉或名声。强调一个家庭在社会上的评价和口碑。
explanation_english: Refers to the reputation or name of a family. Emphasizes the family's evaluation and reputation in society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋一家嘅家聲都好好，個個都好尊重佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 ge3 gaa1 seng1 dou1 hou2 hou2, go3 go3 dou1 hou2 zyun1 zung6 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们一家的名声都很好，大家都非常尊重他们。
examples.english_sentence: Their family has a very good reputation, and everyone respects them a lot.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢要小心啲，唔好整衰我哋屋企嘅家聲。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 自從老豆過咗身之後，佢哋屋企就發生咗家變，啲兄弟姐妹為咗啲財產反哂面。

explanation_mandarin: 字面意思是家养的猪。比喻好吃懒做，不事生产的男人，通常指丈夫或男朋友。
explanation_english: Literally means domestic pig. Figuratively, it refers to a lazy and gluttonous man who doesn't contribute to household chores or work, usually referring to a husband or boyfriend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我老公真係一隻家豬，日日返嚟就瞓，乜都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou5 gung1 zan1 hai6 jat1 zek3 gaa1 zyu1, jat1 jat6 faan1 lai4 zau6 fan3, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6.

examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 laan5 laa1, m4 hai6 dai6 si4 bin3 sing4 zek3 gaa1 zyu1 zau6 m4 hou2 laa1!

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他经过多年的努力，终于在这个城市找到自己的安身之处。
