examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺戰亂嘅時候，能夠有個容身之所已經算好彩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zin3 lyun6 ge3 si4 hau6, nang4 gau3 jau5 go3 jung4 san1 zi1 so2 ji5 ging1 syun3 hou2 coi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在战乱的时候，能够有个安身之处已经算幸运了。
examples.english_sentence: During wartime, it's already lucky to have a place to stay.

english_meaning: capacity, volume
explanation_mandarin: 指物体容纳东西的多少；也指存储信息、数据等的空间大小。
explanation_english: Refers to the amount of space an object can hold; also refers to the size of space for storing information, data, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個水樽嘅容量係兩公升。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 seoi2 zeon2 ge3 jung4 loeng6 hai6 loeng5 gung1 sing1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个水壶的容量是两公升。
examples.english_sentence: This water bottle has a capacity of two liters.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我部電腦嘅硬碟容量唔夠用喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 bou6 din6 nou5 ge3 ngaang6 dip2 jung4 loeng6 m4 gau3 yung6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我电脑的硬盘容量不够用了。
examples.english_sentence: My computer's hard drive capacity is not enough.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個場地嘅容量最多可以容納五百人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 coeng4 dei6 ge3 jung4 loeng6 zeoi3 do1 ho2 ji5 jung4 naap6 ng5 baak3 yan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个场地的容量最多可以容纳五百人。
examples.english_sentence: The capacity of this venue is a maximum of 500 people.

english_meaning: fault tolerance, error tolerance
explanation_mandarin: 允许程序或系统在出现错误时继续运行的能力。
explanation_english: The ability of a program or system to continue operating properly even in the event of some failure or incorrect input.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個系統有容錯機制，就算其中一個零件壞咗，都仲可以繼續運作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 jau5 jung4 co3 gei1 zai3, zau6 syun3 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 ling4 gin2 waai6 zo2, dou1 zung6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk1 wan6 jok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个系统有容错机制，即使其中一个零件坏了，仍然可以继续运作。
examples.english_sentence: This system has a fault tolerance mechanism, so even if one component fails, it can still continue to operate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要設計一個容錯嘅程式，確保喺用戶輸入錯嘅時候唔會崩潰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sai3 gai3 jat1 go3 jung4 co3 ge3 cing4 sik1, kok3 bou2 hai2 jung6 wu6 syu1 jap6 co3 ge3 si4 hau6 m4 wui2 bang1 kwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要设计一个容错的程序，确保在用户输入错误的时候不会崩溃。
examples.english_sentence: We need to design a fault-tolerant program to ensure it doesn't crash when the user enters incorrect information.

english_meaning: countenance; facial appearance; looks
explanation_mandarin: 指人的面貌，尤指美丽的容貌。
explanation_english: Refers to a person's face, especially beautiful features.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅容顏真係好靚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 jung4 ngaan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的容貌真的很漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: Her appearance is really beautiful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 歲月真係會改變人嘅容顏。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi3 jyut6 zan1 hai6 wui5 goi2 bin3 jan4 ge3 jung4 ngaan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 岁月真的会改变人的容貌。
examples.english_sentence: Time really changes a person's appearance.

mandarin_meaning: 住宿; 夜宿; 停留
english_meaning: to stay overnight; to lodge; to stay at; to roost (birds); to harbour
explanation_mandarin: 过夜，住宿。有时也指在某地停留。
explanation_english: To stay overnight; to lodge. It can also refer to staying in a place for a short period.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚喺酒店度宿一晚。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 hai2 zau2 dim3 dou6 suk1 jat1 maan5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们今晚在酒店住宿一晚。
examples.english_sentence: We're staying at the hotel for one night tonight.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲雀仔喺棵樹上面宿。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zoek3 zai2 hai2 fo2 syu6 soeng6 min6 suk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 鸟儿在树上栖息。
examples.english_sentence: The birds are roosting in the tree.

english_meaning: host (biology); host (computer science)
explanation_mandarin: 生物学上指寄生生物所寄生的生物； 计算机科学中指提供资源或服务的计算机。
explanation_english: In biology, refers to the organism that a parasite lives on. In computer science, refers to a computer that provides resources or services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻病毒需要宿主先可以生存。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 beng6 duk6 seoi1 jiu3 suk1 zyu2 sin1 ho2 ji5 sang1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种病毒需要宿主才可以生存。
examples.english_sentence: This virus needs a host to survive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部電腦係我哋嘅宿主伺服器。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 suk1 zyu2 si6 fu6 hei3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台电脑是我们的主机服务器。
examples.english_sentence: This computer is our host server.

english_meaning: dormitory place; dormitory bed; residential place (in school, hospital, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 指提供住宿的床位，通常在學校、醫院等機構內。
explanation_english: Refers to a bed or place provided for accommodation, usually in institutions such as schools or hospitals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年大學嘅宿位好緊張，好多人都申請唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 daai6 hok6 ge3 suk1 wai2 hou2 gan2 zoeng1, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 san1 cheng2 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年大学的住宿床位很紧张，很多人都申请不到。
examples.english_sentence: Dormitory places in universities are very competitive this year; many people can't get one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話醫院嘅宿位唔夠，所以要我阿婆快啲出院。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ji1 yun2 ge3 suk1 wai2 m4 gau3, so2 ji5 jiu3 ngo5 aa3 po4 faai3 di1 cheut1 yun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说医院的住宿床位不够，所以要我奶奶快点出院。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said there aren't enough beds in the hospital, so my grandma needs to be discharged soon.

english_meaning: outdated, unfashionable, behind the times
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不合潮流，思想或行为陈旧过时。
explanation_english: Describes a person or thing that is not trendy, with outdated ideas or behaviour.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你仲用緊呢部舊款手機啊？真係好宿包喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zung6 yung6 gan2 ni1 bou6 gau6 fun2 sau2 gei1 aa3? zan1 hai6 hou2 suk1 baau1 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你还在用这部旧款手机啊？ 真是太老土了！
examples.english_sentence: You're still using this old model phone? That's really outdated!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲打扮好宿包，好似上個世紀嘅人咁。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 daa2 bun6 hou2 suk1 baau1, hou2 ci5 soeng6 go3 sai3 gei2 ge3 yan4 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的打扮很老土，好像上个世纪的人一样。
examples.english_sentence: His dressing style is so outdated, like someone from the last century.

english_meaning: fate, destiny
explanation_mandarin: 指前世注定的命运，无法改变。
explanation_english: Predestined fate; destiny; something that is predetermined and unavoidable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 或者呢啲就係宿命啦，冇得改變㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: waak6 ze2 ni1 di1 zau6 hai6 suk1 ming6 laa1, mou5 dak1 goi2 bin3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 或许这些就是宿命吧，无法改变的。
examples.english_sentence: Maybe this is fate, there's no changing it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話自己嘅失敗係宿命安排。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 zi6 gei2 ge3 sat1 baai6 hai6 suk1 ming6 aan1 paai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是说自己的失败是宿命安排。
examples.english_sentence: He always says that his failure is arranged by fate.

mandarin_meaning: 非常干净, 一尘不染
english_meaning: Spotlessly clean, immaculate
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常干净，没有任何灰尘或污垢。
explanation_english: Describes something that is extremely clean, with no dust or dirt; immaculate.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢間屋執到宿堪堪，真係好佩服佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 uk1 zap1 dou3 suk1 ham1 ham1, zan1 hai6 hou2 pui3 fu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她把房子收拾得非常干净，真的很佩服她。
examples.english_sentence: She keeps her house spotlessly clean; I really admire her for it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢每次都會將間房抹到宿堪堪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mui5 ci3 dou1 wui5 zoeng1 gaan1 fong2 mut3 dou3 suk1 ham1 ham1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她每次都会把房间擦得非常干净。
examples.english_sentence: She always wipes her room until it's spotlessly clean.

synonyms: 乾淨到反光 (gon1 zeng6 dou3 faan2 gwong1)
一塵不染 (jat1 can4 bat1 jim5)

english_meaning: old grudge; long-standing resentment; deep-seated animosity
explanation_mandarin: 指由来已久的怨恨，积攒的仇恨。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-standing grudge, accumulated resentment or animosity.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩家之間有宿怨，所以一直都冇交往。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaa1 zi1 gaan1 jau5 suk1 jyun3, so2 ji5 jat1 zik6 dou1 mou5 giao1 wong5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家之间有宿怨，所以一直都没有来往。
examples.english_sentence: There's a long-standing feud between the two families, so they've never interacted with each other.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 為咗化解佢哋之間嘅宿怨，我哋諗咗好多辦法。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai6 zo2 faa3 gaai2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 gaan1 ge3 suk1 jyun3, ngo5 dei6 nam2 zo2 hou2 do1 baan6 faat3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了化解他们之间的宿怨，我们想了很多办法。
examples.english_sentence: In order to resolve the old grudge between them, we have tried many methods.

english_meaning: arch-enemy, nemesis, sworn enemy
explanation_mandarin: 指前世或过去结怨，今生注定要作对的敌人。 也指长期对立、竞争激烈的对手。
explanation_english: An enemy predestined by fate or past grievances; a long-standing rival or opponent; a nemesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個由細鬥到大，根本就係宿敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 jau4 sai3 dau3 dou3 daai6, gan1 bun2 zau6 hai6 suk1 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个从小斗到大，根本就是宿敌。
examples.english_sentence: Those two have been fighting since they were kids; they're basically arch-enemies.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢同佢公司嘅競爭對手已經變成咗宿敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tung4 keoi5 gung1 si1 ge3 ging6 zang1 deoi3 sau2 ji5 ging1 bin3 sing4 zo2 suk1 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他和他的公司的竞争对手已经变成了宿敌。
examples.english_sentence: He and his company's competitor have become arch-rivals.

english_meaning: camping (overnight)
explanation_mandarin: 指户外过夜的露营活动，通常是团体活动，例如学校组织的露营。
explanation_english: Refers to an overnight camping activity, usually a group activity, such as camping organized by a school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校下個月會搞宿營，你參加唔參加啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 gaau2 suk1 ying4, nei5 caam1 gaa1 m4 caam1 gaa1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校下个月会举办露营，你参加吗？
examples.english_sentence: Our school will hold a camping trip next month. Will you participate?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候好鍾意去宿營，可以同啲同學仔一齊玩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zung1 ji3 heoi3 suk1 ying4, ho2 ji5 tung4 di1 tung4 hok6 zai2 jat1 cai4 waan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候很喜欢去露营，可以和同学们一起玩。
examples.english_sentence: I really liked going camping when I was young, I could play with my classmates.

english_meaning: resident student, dormitory student
explanation_mandarin: 指在学校或学院宿舍居住的学生。
explanation_english: Refers to a student who lives in a dormitory or hall of residence at a school or college.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我大學嗰陣住hall，係宿生嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai6 hok6 go2 zan6 zyu6 hall, hai6 suk1 sang1 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我上大学的时候住宿舍，是住宿生。
examples.english_sentence: When I was at university, I lived in a hall of residence, I was a resident student.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今年嘅宿生註冊日喺聽日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 ge3 suk1 sang1 zyu3 caak3 jat6 hai2 ting1 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今年的住宿生注册日在明天。
examples.english_sentence: The registration day for resident students is tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多宿生都鍾意喺hall嘅common room度溫書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 suk1 sang1 dou1 zung1 ji3 hai2 hall ge3 common room dou6 wan1 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多住宿生都喜欢在宿舍的公共休息室温习功课。
examples.english_sentence: Many resident students like to study in the hall's common room.

english_meaning: chronic illness; old ailment; long-standing disease
explanation_mandarin: 指长期患病或难以根治的疾病。
explanation_english: Refers to a long-term illness or a disease that is difficult to cure completely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢有宿疾，成日都覺得唔舒服。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 suk1 zat6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 m4 syu1 fuk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他有老毛病，总是觉得不舒服。
examples.english_sentence: He has a chronic illness and always feels unwell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生話呢個係宿疾，要長期調理。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 waa6 ni1 go3 hai6 suk1 zat6, jiu3 coeng4 kei4 tiu4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生说这是老毛病，需要长期调理。
examples.english_sentence: The doctor said this is a chronic illness that requires long-term treatment.

english_meaning: dormitory, hostel
explanation_mandarin: 供学生或职工集体居住的房屋。
explanation_english: A building or part of a building, usually at a school or college, used for providing accommodation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋大學嘅宿舍好細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daai6 hok6 ge3 suk1 se3 hou2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们大学的宿舍很小。
examples.english_sentence: Our university dormitory is very small.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋住喺學生宿舍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyu6 hai2 hok6 saang1 suk1 se3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们住在学生宿舍。
examples.english_sentence: They live in the student dormitory.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你覺得住宿舍好定係自己租屋好啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gok3 dak1 zyu6 suk1 se3 hou2 deng6 hai6 zi6 gei2 zu1 uk1 hou2 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你觉得住宿舍好还是自己租房好啊？
examples.english_sentence: Do you think it's better to live in a dormitory or rent your own place?

english_meaning: hangover
explanation_mandarin: 指饮酒过多后，第二天早上醒来时仍然感到头痛、恶心等不适的症状。
explanation_english: The unpleasant physical effects, such as a headache or nausea, felt after drinking too much alcohol.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我琴晚飲大咗，今日朝頭早宿醉好辛苦啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 kam4 maan1 jam2 daai6 zo2, gam1 jat6 ziu1 tau4 zou2 suk1 zeoi3 hou2 san1 fu2 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我昨天晚上喝多了，今天早上宿醉很难受啊！
examples.english_sentence: I drank too much last night, and I have a terrible hangover this morning!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有咩方法可以快速解宿醉啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 me1 fong1 faat3 ho2 ji5 faai3 suk1 gaai2 suk1 zeoi3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有什么方法可以快速缓解宿醉吗？
examples.english_sentence: Are there any ways to quickly cure a hangover?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔想聽日宿醉就唔好飲咁多啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 soeng2 ting1 jat6 suk1 zeoi3 zau6 m4 hou2 jam2 gam3 do1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不想明天宿醉就不要喝太多了。
examples.english_sentence: If you don't want a hangover tomorrow, don't drink so much.

english_meaning: long-cherished wish; long-held aspiration; ambition
explanation_mandarin: 长期以来怀有的愿望；夙愿。
explanation_english: A long-cherished wish or aspiration; a deep-seated ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅宿願終於實現咗，就係成為一位醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 suk1 jyun6 zung1 jyu1 sat6 sin6 zo2, zau6 hai6 sing4 wai4 jat1 wai2 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的宿愿终于实现了，就是成为一名医生。
examples.english_sentence: His long-cherished wish was finally fulfilled: to become a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一直都好努力，希望可以達成佢嘅宿願。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 nou5 lik6, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 daat6 sing4 keoi5 ge3 suk1 jyun6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直都很努力，希望可以达成他的宿愿。
examples.english_sentence: He has been working very hard, hoping to achieve his long-held aspiration.

english_meaning: lonely, solitary, quiet, desolate
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境或心情冷清、孤单。
explanation_english: Describes a quiet, lonely, and desolate environment or mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人喺屋企覺得好寂寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei2 gok3 dak1 hou2 zik6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在家里觉得很寂寞。
examples.english_sentence: He feels very lonely being alone at home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 條街靜到好寂。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tiu4 gaai1 zing6 dou3 hou2 zik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街安静得很寂静。
examples.english_sentence: The street is so quiet and desolate.

english_meaning: obscure, unknown, anonymous
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不为人知，没有名气。
explanation_english: Describing a person or thing as being unknown, without fame or reputation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢以前寂寂無名，但係依家已經成為咗一個國際巨星啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 zik6 zik6 mou4 ming4, daan6 hai6 ji1 gaa1 ji5 ging1 sing4 wai4 zo2 jat1 go3 gwok3 zai3 geoi6 sing1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他以前默默无闻，但是现在已经成为一个国际巨星了。
examples.english_sentence: He used to be unknown, but now he has become an international superstar.

english_meaning: unknown and unheard of; obscure; insignificant
explanation_mandarin: 形容人或事物不为人所知，没有名气。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something that is not known to the public, lacking fame or reputation. Suggests a state of being unknown and undistinguished.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢出道咁耐都重係寂寂無聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 cheot1 dou6 gam3 noi6 dou1 zung6 hai6 zik6 zik6 mou4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他出道这么久，仍然默默无闻。
examples.english_sentence: He's been in the industry for so long, but he's still relatively unknown.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多科學家做咗好多嘢，但係一世都寂寂無聞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 fo1 hok6 gaa1 zou6 zo2 ho2 do1 ye5, daan6 hai6 yat1 sai3 dou1 zik6 zik6 mou4 man4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多科学家做了很多事情，但是一辈子都默默无闻。
examples.english_sentence: Many scientists do a lot of work, but remain obscure their whole lives.

english_meaning: lonely; lonesome; solitary; desolate; quiet; still
explanation_mandarin: 形容人感到孤单，缺乏陪伴而产生的失落感。
explanation_english: Describing the feeling of being lonely and lacking companionship, resulting in a sense of loss or emptiness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我一個人喺屋企好寂寞呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 uk1 kei2 hou2 zik6 mok6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我一个人在家好寂寞啊。
examples.english_sentence: I'm so lonely being at home alone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢移民咗之後，成日都覺得好寂寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji4 man4 zo2 zi1 hau6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gok3 dak1 hou2 zik6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他移民了之后，总是觉得很寂寞。
examples.english_sentence: After he immigrated, he always felt very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好靜，唔鍾意熱鬧，反而享受寂寞。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zing6, m4 zung1 ji3 jit6 naau6, faan2 ji4 hoeng2 sau6 zik6 mok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很安静，不喜欢热闹，反而享受寂寞。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very quiet person, doesn't like hustle and bustle, and enjoys solitude instead.

english_meaning: lonely; desolate; deserted; bleak
explanation_mandarin: 形容环境冷清空旷，或心情孤独冷寞。
explanation_english: Describes a desolate and deserted environment, or a feeling of loneliness and isolation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一個人喺外國住，覺得好寂寥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 go3 jan4 hai2 ngoi6 gwok3 zyu6, gok3 dak1 hou2 zik6 liu4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一个人在国外住，觉得很寂寞。
examples.english_sentence: He lives alone abroad and feels very lonely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條街夜晚好寂寥，都冇乜人行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 gaai1 je6 maan5 hou2 zik6 liu4, dou1 mou5 mat1 jan4 haang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这条街晚上很冷清，都没什么人走。
examples.english_sentence: This street is very desolate at night, with hardly anyone walking around.

english_meaning: silent, quiet, still, tranquil
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常安静，没有声音。
explanation_english: Describes a state of complete silence or quietness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 夜晚嘅時候，成條街都好寂靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: je6 maan5 ge3 si4 hau6, seng4 tiu4 gaai1 dou1 hou2 zik6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 晚上的时候，整条街都很寂静。
examples.english_sentence: At night, the whole street is very quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 圖書館入面要保持寂靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tou4 syu1 gun2 jap6 min6 jiu3 bo2 ci4 zik6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 图书馆里面要保持安静。
examples.english_sentence: Silence must be maintained in the library.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 暴風雨過後，一切都恢復咗寂靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: bou6 fung1 jyu5 gwo3 hau6, jat1 cai3 dou1 fui1 fuk1 zo2 zik6 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 暴风雨过后，一切都恢复了寂静。
examples.english_sentence: After the storm, everything returned to silence.

english_meaning: to mail; to send; to entrust; to depend on
explanation_mandarin: 通过邮局或快递公司传送物品; 托付, 寄托情感或希望
explanation_english: To send something via mail or courier service; to entrust, to place emotions or hopes upon something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想寄呢封信去美國。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 gei3 ni1 fung1 seon3 heoi3 mei5 gwok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把这封信寄到美国。
examples.english_sentence: I want to mail this letter to the United States.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將我嘅希望寄託喺佢身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 ngo5 ge3 hei1 mong6 gei3 tok3 hai2 keoi5 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把我的希望寄托在他身上。
examples.english_sentence: I place my hopes on him.

english_meaning: to place (hope, expectations) on; to entrust
explanation_mandarin: 把希望、理想等放在某人或事物上。
explanation_english: To place hopes, ideals, etc. on someone or something; to entrust something to someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋對呢個計劃寄予厚望。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 deoi3 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 gei3 jyu5 hau5 mong6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们对这个计划寄予厚望。
examples.english_sentence: We place high hopes on this plan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 屋企人寄予佢好大期望，希望佢可以考入大學。
examples.jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 jan4 gei3 jyu5 keoi5 hou2 daai6 kei1 mong6, hei1 mong6 keoi5 ho2 ji5 haau2 jap6 daai6 hok6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 家里人对他寄予很大期望，希望他可以考入大学。
examples.english_sentence: His family has great expectations for him, hoping he can get into university.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寄予你全部嘅信任。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 jyu5 nei5 cyun4 bou6 ge3 seon3 jam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把全部的信任寄托给你。
examples.english_sentence: I entrust you with all my trust.

english_meaning: living under someone else's roof; dependent on others; living at the mercy of others
explanation_mandarin: 比喻依赖别人生活，不得自由。
explanation_english: A metaphor for living in dependence on others, lacking freedom and autonomy. It describes a situation where someone is reliant on someone else for support, often implying a lack of independence and potential for feeling constrained or obligated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 細個嗰陣時，我哋寄人籬下，乜都唔敢出聲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sai3 go3 go2 zan6 si4, ngo5 dei6 gei3 jan4 lei4 haa6, mat1 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 小时候，我们寄人篱下，什么都不敢出声。
examples.english_sentence: When we were little, we were living under someone else's roof, so we didn't dare to say anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢唔想再寄人籬下，所以好努力咁搵工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 m4 soeng2 zoi3 gei3 jan4 lei4 haa6, so2 ji5 hou2 nu5 lik6 gam2 wan2 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他不想再寄人篱下，所以很努力地找工作。
examples.english_sentence: He doesn't want to be dependent on others anymore, so he's working very hard to find a job.

english_meaning: to live as a guest; to lodge; to stay at someone's place
explanation_mandarin: 指寄居在别人家居住。
explanation_english: To reside temporarily in someone else's home; to live as a guest.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我而家寄住喺我表哥屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 gei3 zyu6 hai2 ngo5 biu2 go1 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我现在寄宿在我表哥家里。
examples.english_sentence: I'm currently staying at my cousin's house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺香港寄住咗幾個月。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 gong2 gei3 zyu6 zo2 gei2 go3 jyut6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在香港寄宿了几个月。
examples.english_sentence: He stayed in Hong Kong for a few months.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 因為屋企裝修，我需要寄住朋友度一段時間。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jan1 wai6 uk1 kei2 zong1 sau1, ngo5 seoi1 jiu3 gei3 zyu6 pang4 jau5 dou6 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 因为家里装修，我需要寄住在朋友那里一段时间。
examples.english_sentence: Because my house is being renovated, I need to stay at a friend's place for a while.

english_meaning: to mail a letter; to post a letter
explanation_mandarin: 把信件投入邮筒或交给邮局寄送。
explanation_english: To send a letter by mail; to post a letter.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去郵局寄信。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 jau4 guk6 gei3 seon3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天会去邮局寄信。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to the post office to mail a letter tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你記住寄封信俾你阿嫲呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei3 zyu6 gei3 fung1 seon3 bei2 nei5 aa3 maa4 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你记住给你的奶奶寄一封信啊。
examples.english_sentence: Remember to mail a letter to your grandma.

mandarin_meaning: 寄存行李； 仓库储存
english_meaning: to store luggage; to deposit goods in a warehouse
explanation_mandarin: 把行李或货物寄存在仓库或行李寄存处。
explanation_english: To store luggage or goods in a warehouse or a luggage storage facility.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋可以喺機場寄倉行李。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 hai2 gei1 coeng4 gei3 cong1 hang4 lei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们可以在机场寄存行李。
examples.english_sentence: We can store our luggage at the airport.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司將啲貨寄倉喺貨倉度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 di1 fo3 gei3 cong1 hai2 fo3 cong1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那家公司把一些货物寄存在仓库里。
examples.english_sentence: That company stores some goods in the warehouse.

english_meaning: consignment sale
explanation_mandarin: 将货物委托给商家代为销售，卖出后商家支付货款。
explanation_english: To sell goods on consignment; to entrust goods to a merchant for sale, with the merchant paying the owner after the goods are sold.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將啲衫攞去寄售。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 di1 saam1 lo2 heoi3 gei3 sau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把一些衣服拿去寄卖。
examples.english_sentence: I want to take some clothes to sell on consignment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭有做寄售嘅服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jau5 zou6 gei3 sau6 ge3 fung4 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店铺有做寄卖的服务。
examples.english_sentence: This shop offers consignment sale services.

english_meaning: lost in the mail; lost in transit
explanation_mandarin: 指通过邮寄或快递等方式发送的物品在运输过程中丢失。
explanation_english: Refers to an item sent via mail or courier that is lost during transportation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份文件寄失咗，唔知點算好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 man4 gin2 gei3 sat1 zo2, m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的文件寄丢了，不知道怎么办才好。
examples.english_sentence: My document got lost in the mail, I don't know what to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢網購嘅嘢寄失咗，間鋪頭肯賠償。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mong5 gau3 ge3 je5 gei3 sat1 zo2, gaan1 pou3 tau2 hang2 pui4 soeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她网购的东西寄丢了，店铺愿意赔偿。
examples.english_sentence: The thing she bought online got lost in the mail, the shop is willing to compensate.

english_meaning: to deposit, to check (luggage), to leave in someone's care, to store
explanation_mandarin: 暂时存放物品在某处，待日后取回。
explanation_english: To temporarily leave items in a place for safekeeping and later retrieval.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想將啲行李寄存喺車站。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 di1 hang4 lei5 gei3 cyun4 hai2 ce1 zaam6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想把行李寄存在车站。
examples.english_sentence: I want to deposit my luggage at the station.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你可以喺呢度寄存你嘅外套。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 ni1 dou6 gei3 cyun4 nei5 ge3 ngoi6 tou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你可以把你的外套寄存在这里。
examples.english_sentence: You can check your coat here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲書寄存咗喺圖書館。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 syu1 gei3 cyun4 zo2 hai2 tou4 syu1 gun2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把书寄存在图书馆了。
examples.english_sentence: I deposited the books at the library.

english_meaning: to lodge; to board; boarding
explanation_mandarin: 指居住在学校宿舍或他人家中。
explanation_english: To live and stay at a boarding school or someone else's home.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣寄宿喺學校。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 gei3 suk1 hai2 hok6 haau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我小时候寄宿在学校。
examples.english_sentence: When I was little, I boarded at school.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢去咗英國寄宿讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 heoi3 zo2 jing1 gwok3 gei3 suk1 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他去了英国寄宿读书。
examples.english_sentence: He went to England to study as a boarder.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間學校有寄宿服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 hok6 haau6 jau5 gei3 suk1 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这所学校有寄宿服务。
examples.english_sentence: This school provides boarding service.

english_meaning: to live as a lodger; to lodge; to stay temporarily
explanation_mandarin: 指寄住在别人家中或地方。
explanation_english: To live in someone else's home or place temporarily; to lodge.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢暫時寄居喺朋友屋企。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zaam6 si4 gei3 geoi1 hai2 pang4 jau5 uk1 kei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他暂时寄居在朋友家。
examples.english_sentence: He is temporarily lodging at his friend's house.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋以前窮嘅時候，曾經寄居喺親戚度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 cin4 kung4 ge3 si4 hau6, cang4 ging1 gei3 geoi1 hai2 can1 cik1 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们以前穷的时候，曾经寄居在亲戚家。
examples.english_sentence: When we were poor before, we used to lodge at our relatives' house.

english_meaning: Hermit crab
explanation_mandarin: 一种腹部柔软，居住在其他动物遗弃的贝壳中的甲壳类动物。
explanation_english: A type of crustacean with a soft abdomen that lives in empty seashells abandoned by other animals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋琴日喺沙灘度見到好多寄居蟹。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 kam4 jat6 hai2 saa1 taan1 dou6 gin3 dou2 hou2 do1 gei3 geoi1 haai5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们昨天在沙滩上看到了很多寄居蟹。
examples.english_sentence: We saw a lot of hermit crabs on the beach yesterday.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寄居蟹好得意，佢哋會搵啱自己嘅殼嚟住。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 geoi1 haai5 hou2 dak1 ji3, keoi5 dei6 wui2 wan2 aam1 zi6 gei2 ge3 hok3 lai4 zyu6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 寄居蟹很有趣，它们会找到适合自己的壳来住。
examples.english_sentence: Hermit crabs are very interesting, they find shells that fit them to live in.

english_meaning: to entrust one's feelings; to find solace in; to express one's feelings through (something)
explanation_mandarin: 把自己的感情寄托在某事物上，通常指通过某种方式表达或转移情感，以获得慰藉或抒发心情。
explanation_english: To entrust one's feelings or emotions to something, usually referring to expressing or transferring emotions through a medium to find solace or to express one's mood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢鍾意寫詩嚟寄情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zung1 ji3 se2 si1 lai4 gei3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他喜欢写诗来寄托感情。
examples.english_sentence: He likes to write poetry to express his feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢失戀之後，就寄情工作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sat1 lyun2 zi1 hau6, zau6 gei3 cing4 gung1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他失恋之后，就寄托感情于工作。
examples.english_sentence: After his heartbreak, he found solace in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人鍾意透過音樂嚟寄情。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 zung1 ji3 tau3 gwo3 jam1 ngok6 lai4 gei3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人喜欢通过音乐来寄托感情。
examples.english_sentence: Many people like to express their feelings through music.

english_meaning: to express one's feelings (through something); to convey a message (implicitly)
explanation_mandarin: 把心意、情感、愿望等寄托在某事物上。
explanation_english: To express one's feelings, emotions, or wishes through something else, often implicitly. To entrust one's emotions to an object or action.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢啲畫寄意深刻，睇得出佢對社會嘅關懷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 waa2 gei3 ji3 san1 hak1, tai2 dak1 chut1 keoi5 deoi3 se5 wui2 ge3 gwaan1 waai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的画寄托的意义深刻，看得出他对社会的关怀。
examples.english_sentence: His paintings express deep meanings, and you can see his concern for society.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢首歌嘅歌詞寄意好正面，鼓勵人積極面對人生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 sau2 go1 ge3 go1 ci4 gei3 ji3 hou2 zing3 min6, gu2 lai6 jan4 zik1 gik1 min6 deoi3 jan4 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这首歌的歌词寄托的意义很正面，鼓励人们积极面对人生。
examples.english_sentence: The lyrics of this song convey a very positive message, encouraging people to face life actively.

english_meaning: to place (hope, feeling, etc.) on; to entrust; to consign; to rely on
explanation_mandarin: 把理想、感情等放在（某人或事物上）。
explanation_english: To place one's hopes, feelings, or affections on someone or something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅希望都寄托喺個仔身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 hei1 mong6 dou1 gei3 tok3 hai2 go3 zai2 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的希望都寄托在儿子身上。
examples.english_sentence: He places all his hopes on his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將佢嘅感情寄托喺寫作上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 keoi5 ge3 gam2 ching4 gei3 tok3 hai2 se2 zok3 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将他的感情寄托在写作上面。
examples.english_sentence: He pours his emotions into his writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅未來寄托喺呢次機會上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 mei6 loi4 gei3 tok3 hai2 ni1 ci3 gei1 wui2 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的未来寄托在这次机会上面。
examples.english_sentence: Their future depends on this opportunity.

english_meaning: to place hope on; to expect; to look forward to
explanation_mandarin: 把希望寄托在某人或某事上；期望。
explanation_english: To place hope or expectations on someone or something; to look forward to with anticipation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋寄望你將來可以為社會作出貢獻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gei3 mong6 nei5 zoeng1 loi4 ho2 ji5 wai4 se5 wui2 zok3 ceot1 gung3 hiun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们寄望你将来可以为社会做出贡献。
examples.english_sentence: We hope that you will be able to contribute to society in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好將所有嘅寄望擺喺一個人身上，咁樣佢壓力會好大。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 gei3 mong6 baai2 hai2 jat1 go3 jan4 san1 soeng6, gam2 joeng2 keoi5 aat3 lik6 wui ho2 daai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要把所有的希望放在一个人身上，这样他的压力会很大。
examples.english_sentence: Don't place all your hopes on one person, it will put a lot of pressure on them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 阿媽寄望我考到好成績。
examples.jyutping_sentence: aa3 maa1 gei3 mong6 ngo5 haau2 dou3 hou2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 妈妈寄望我考到好成绩。
examples.english_sentence: My mother hopes that I will get good grades.

english_meaning: parasite; parasitic; to live off (someone else)
explanation_mandarin: 指生物体依靠另一生物体生存，从中摄取营养，或比喻依赖别人生活。
explanation_english: Refers to an organism that lives on or in another organism (its host) and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense; metaphorically, to live off someone else or depend on others for support.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好似啲寄生蟲咁，乜都靠晒屋企人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 ci5 di1 gei3 sang1 cung4 gam2, mat1 dou1 kaau3 saai3 uk1 kei2 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人就像寄生虫一样，什么都依靠家里人。
examples.english_sentence: He's like a parasite, relying on his family for everything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢種植物係寄生喺其他樹上面嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zung2 z植 mat6 hai6 gei3 sang1 hai2 kei4 taa1 syu6 soeng6 min6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这种植物是寄生在其他树上的。
examples.english_sentence: This plant is parasitic on other trees.

english_meaning: parasite; freeloader; leech
explanation_mandarin: 比喻依赖他人生活，不劳而获的人；指生物寄生在其他生物体上，从中获取营养，损害宿主。
explanation_english: Literally: parasite; Figuratively: a person who lives off others without contributing; someone who is dependent on others for support; also refers to a biological parasite.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢日日喺屋企攤抖，乜都唔做，真係一條寄生蟲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 hai2 uk1 kei2 taan1 dau2, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6, zan1 hai6 jat1 tiu4 gei3 sang1 cung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他每天都在家里闲待着，什么都不做，真是一条寄生虫。
examples.english_sentence: He stays at home lazing around every day and doesn't do anything. He's such a freeloader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好做寄生蟲，自己搵嘢做啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zou6 gei3 sang1 cung4, zi6 gei2 wan2 je5 zou6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要做寄生虫，自己找点事做吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be a freeloader, find something to do yourself.

english_meaning: to send a message; to pass on a message; to convey regards
explanation_mandarin: 托人传话；请人代为问候。
explanation_english: To send a message through someone; to ask someone to pass on your regards.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該你寄聲俾佢，話我聽日會遲到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 nei5 gei3 seng1 bei2 keoi5, waa6 ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 ci4 dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 麻烦你捎个话给他，说我明天会迟到。
examples.english_sentence: Please send a message to him, saying I'll be late tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以幫我寄聲問候下你阿媽？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 gei3 seng1 man6 hau6 haa5 nei5 aa3 maa1?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 可以帮我捎个话问候一下你妈妈吗？
examples.english_sentence: Could you please help me pass on my regards to your mother?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果見到佢，記得幫我寄聲話我好掛住佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 gin3 dou2 keoi5, gei3 dak1 bong1 ngo5 gei3 seng1 waa6 ngo5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果见到他，记得帮我捎个话，说我很想他。
examples.english_sentence: If you see him, please remember to send him a message saying that I miss him very much.

english_meaning: to check (luggage), to check in (baggage)
explanation_mandarin: 将行李办理托运手续，使其在运输途中被放置于飞机的货舱中。
explanation_english: To check luggage; to hand over baggage to be transported in the cargo hold of an airplane.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我要寄艙呢個喼去倫敦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 gei3 chong1 ni1 go3 gip1 heoi3 leon4 deon1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我要把这个箱子托运到伦敦。
examples.english_sentence: I want to check this suitcase to London.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你啲行李有幾多件要寄艙啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 di1 hang4 lei5 jau5 gei2 do1 gin6 jiu3 gei3 chong1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的行李有几件需要托运？
examples.english_sentence: How many pieces of luggage do you need to check?

english_meaning: to entrust; to consign; to place (hope, feeling, etc.) on
explanation_mandarin: 把希望、理想、感情等放在某人或事物上。
explanation_english: To place hope, ideals, or feelings on someone or something; to entrust or consign something to a person or place.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將所有嘅希望寄託喺個仔身上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 so2 jau5 ge3 hei1 mong6 gei3 tok3 hai2 go3 zai2 san1 soeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把所有的希望都寄托在儿子身上。
examples.english_sentence: He places all his hopes on his son.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將啲感情寄託喺寫作上面。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 di1 gam2 cing4 gei3 tok3 hai2 se2 zok3 soeng6 min6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把感情寄托在写作上。
examples.english_sentence: I channel my emotions into writing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人都將退休生活嘅快樂寄託喺旅行度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 dou1 zoeng1 teoi3 jau1 sang1 wut6 ge3 faai3 lok6 gei3 tok3 hai2 leoi5 hang4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人都把退休生活的快乐寄托在旅行上。
examples.english_sentence: Many people place their hopes for a happy retirement on traveling.

english_meaning: to send a message; to entrust words; message; words of encouragement
explanation_mandarin: 表达希望或期望，传递信息或鼓励。
explanation_english: To express hope or expectations, to convey information or encouragement, usually in a formal or written context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我寄語所有嘅畢業生，希望佢哋前程似錦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gei3 jyu5 so2 jau5 ge3 bat1 jip6 sang1, hei1 mong6 keoi5 dei6 cin4 cing4 ci5 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我寄语所有的毕业生，希望他们前程似锦。
examples.english_sentence: I entrust this message to all the graduates, hoping that their future is bright and promising.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺臨走嘅時候，寄語我哋要努力讀書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 lam4 zau2 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nu5 lik6 duk6 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在临走的时候，寄语我们要努力读书。
examples.english_sentence: Before leaving, he left us with the message to study hard.

english_meaning: consignment (selling goods through a third party); to sell on consignment
explanation_mandarin: 将商品寄放在别人的商店里代为出售。
explanation_english: To leave goods with a retailer who sells them on your behalf, and takes a percentage of the sale price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我諗住將啲二手衫攞去寄賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 nam2 zyu6 zoeng1 di1 ji3 sau2 saam1 lo2 heoi3 gei3 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我打算把一些二手衣服拿去寄卖。
examples.english_sentence: I'm thinking of taking some second-hand clothes to sell on consignment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭有寄賣服務，你可以將啲手作擺喺度賣。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 jau5 gei3 maai6 fuk6 mou6, nei5 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 di1 sau2 zok3 baai2 hai2 dou6 maai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店有寄卖服务，你可以把一些手工艺品放在这里卖。
examples.english_sentence: This shop provides consignment services, you can put some handicrafts here to sell.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將自己畫嘅畫寄賣喺畫廊度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 waak6 ge3 waa2 gei3 maai6 hai2 waa2 long4 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他把自己的画寄卖在画廊里。
examples.english_sentence: He consigned his paintings to the art gallery.

english_meaning: to donate; to present as a gift
explanation_mandarin: 把物品或资金无偿地献给他人或组织。
explanation_english: To donate or present something as a gift, usually without expectation of return.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋寄贈咗好多醫療物資俾非洲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gei3 zung6 zo2 hou2 do1 ji1 liu4 mat6 zi1 bei2 fei1 zau1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们捐赠了很多医疗物资给非洲。
examples.english_sentence: They donated a lot of medical supplies to Africa.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司寄贈咗一百萬蚊俾慈善機構。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gei3 zung6 zo2 jat1 baak3 maan6 man1 bei2 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司捐赠了一百万给慈善机构。
examples.english_sentence: This company donated one million dollars to the charity.

english_meaning: foster care; to foster
explanation_mandarin: 将儿童或动物暂时安置在非亲属家庭或机构照料。
explanation_english: To provide temporary care for a child or animal in a family or institution other than their own; foster care.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋將個細路仔寄養咗俾一對夫婦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 go3 sai3 lou2 zai2 gei3 joeng5 zo2 bei2 jat1 deoi3 fu1 fu2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们把这个小孩寄养给了一对夫妇。
examples.english_sentence: They placed the child in foster care with a couple.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間機構專門負責寄養嘅服務。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gei1 gau3 zyun1 mun4 fu6 zaak3 gei3 joeng5 ge3 fuk6 mou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家机构专门负责寄养服务。
examples.english_sentence: This organization specializes in foster care services.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人願意做寄養家庭，幫助啲有需要嘅細路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 jan4 jyun4 ji3 zou6 gei3 joeng5 gaa1 ting4, bong1 zo6 di1 jau5 seoi1 jiu3 ge3 sai3 lou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人愿意做寄养家庭，帮助那些有需要的孩子。
examples.english_sentence: Many people are willing to become foster families to help children in need.

mandarin_meaning: 寅时 (yín shí); 地支的第三位 (dì zhī de dì sān wèi)
english_meaning: Third of the twelve Earthly Branches (寅时: 3-5 AM); Respectful; To advance
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 名词 (míng cí); 量词 (liàng cí)
explanation_mandarin: 地支的第三位，与十二生肖中的虎对应。寅时指凌晨三点到五点。在一些旧式说法中，有恭敬、前进的意思，但现代粤语中不常用。
explanation_english: The third of the twelve Earthly Branches, corresponding to the Tiger in the Chinese zodiac.  'Yin shi' refers to the time from 3 to 5 AM. In older contexts, it can mean respectful or to advance, but it's not commonly used in modern Cantonese except when referring to the time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 而家係寅時，仲咁早起身呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji4 gaa1 hai6 jan4 si4, zung6 gam3 zou2 hei2 san1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 现在是寅时，这么早就起床啊？
examples.english_sentence: It's Yin Shi (3-5 AM), why are you getting up so early?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 舊時啲人會用寅嚟計時辰。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gau6 si4 di1 jan4 wui5 yung6 jan4 lai4 gai3 si4 san4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 以前的人会用地支寅来计时辰。
examples.english_sentence: People used to use the Earthly Branch 'Yin' to calculate the hours in the past.

mandarin_meaning: 紧密; 秘密; 稠密
english_meaning: dense; thick; close; secret; frequent
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物之间距离很小，排列紧凑；也指秘密，不公开。
explanation_english: Describes something with small gaps or closely packed; also refers to something secret or not publicly known.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲樹葉生得好密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 syu6 jip6 saang1 dak1 hou2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 树叶长得很茂密。
examples.english_sentence: The leaves are growing very densely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅關係好密。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 mat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的关系很密切。
examples.english_sentence: They have a close relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事係秘密，唔好同人講咁多，要保密呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 hai6 bei3 mat6, m4 hou2 tung4 jan4 gong2 gam3 do1, jiu3 bou2 mat6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事是秘密，不要和别人说太多，要保密啊。
examples.english_sentence: This is a secret, don't tell other people too much, you need to keep it confidential.

english_meaning: inseparable; inextricably linked
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系非常密切，不可分割。
explanation_english: Describes a very close and inseparable relationship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅經濟發展同中國大陸嘅經濟發展係密不可分嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 tung4 zung1 gwok3 daai6 luk6 ge3 ging1 zai3 faat3 zin2 hai6 mat6 bat1 ho2 fan1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的经济发展和中国大陆的经济发展是密不可分的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's economic development is inseparable from that of mainland China.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 愛情同信任係密不可分嘅，冇咗信任，愛情就好難維持。
examples.jyutping_sentence: oi3 cing4 tung4 seon3 jam6 hai6 mat6 bat1 ho2 fan1 ge3, mou5 zo2 seon3 jam6, oi3 cing4 zau6 hou2 naan4 wai4 ci4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 爱情和信任是密不可分的，没有了信任，爱情就很难维持。
examples.english_sentence: Love and trust are inseparable; without trust, love is difficult to maintain.

mandarin_meaning: 严密不透风; 滴水不漏
english_meaning: impermeable; airtight; watertight; leaving no loopholes; thoroughly sealed
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常严密，连风都透不过去。比喻防范措施周密，没有一点漏洞；或形容说话、做事非常严谨，不透露任何信息。
explanation_english: Describes something as being very tightly sealed, so much so that even wind cannot pass through. It can be used to describe thorough preventative measures that leave no loopholes, or to describe someone who is very discreet and careful with their words and actions, revealing no information.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅保安措施做得密不透風，根本入唔到去。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 bou2 on1 co3 si1 zou6 dak1 mat6 bat1 tau3 fung1, gan1 bun2 jap6 m4 dou2 heoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的保安措施做得滴水不漏，根本进不去。
examples.english_sentence: Their security measures are so airtight that you can't get in at all.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢件事佢哋處理得密不透風，完全冇洩漏任何消息。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gin6 si6 keoi5 dei6 cyu2 lei5 dak1 mat6 bat1 tau3 fung1, jyun4 cyun4 mou5 sit3 lau6 jam6 ho4 siu1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这件事他们处理得严密不透风，完全没有泄露任何消息。
examples.english_sentence: They handled this matter so discreetly that they didn't leak any information.

english_meaning: Confidential document; classified document
explanation_mandarin: 指需要保密的文件，不宜公开的文件。
explanation_english: Refers to documents that need to be kept secret and are not suitable for public disclosure. It's a formal term used for confidential or classified documents.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份係一份密件，唔可以俾其他人睇㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 hai6 jat1 fan6 mat6 gin2, m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 gei2 ta1 jan4 tai2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份是一份机密文件，不可以给其他人看。
examples.english_sentence: This is a confidential document, you can't let other people see it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要小心處理呢啲密件。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 siu2 sam1 chu2 lei5 ni1 di1 mat6 gin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要小心处理这些机密文件。
examples.english_sentence: We need to handle these confidential documents carefully.

synonyms: 機密文件 (gei1 mat6 man4 gin2)

english_meaning: secret envoy; secret messenger
explanation_mandarin: 秘密派遣的使者，通常肩负重要任务。
explanation_english: A secret envoy or messenger, usually carrying an important mission.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋派咗個密使去同對方談判。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 paai3 zo2 go3 mat6 sai2 heoi3 tung4 deoi3 fong1 taam4 pun3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们派了一个密使去和对方谈判。
examples.english_sentence: They sent a secret envoy to negotiate with the other party.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 傳聞話佢係皇帝嘅密使，專門負責處理啲見唔得光嘅事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cyun4 man4 waa6 keoi5 hai6 wong4 dai3 ge3 mat6 sai2, zyun1 mun4 fu6 zaak3 cyu5 lei5 di1 gin3 m4 dak1 gwong1 ge3 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 传闻说他是皇帝的密使，专门负责处理一些见不得光的事情。
examples.english_sentence: Rumor has it that he is the Emperor's secret envoy, specially responsible for handling things that cannot see the light.

english_meaning: to conspire; to discuss secretly; secret meeting
explanation_mandarin: 指私下里商量，通常带有不公开或不正当的含义，类似于“密谋”。
explanation_english: Refers to discussing something privately and secretly, often with connotations of being clandestine or illicit; similar to 'conspire'.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩個成日密偈，唔知搞乜鬼。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 seng4 jat6 mat6 gai2, m4 zi1 gaau2 mat1 gwai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两个经常私下商量，不知道在搞什么鬼。
examples.english_sentence: Those two are always conspiring together, I don't know what they're up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好以為我唔知你哋密偈緊啲乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 dei6 mat6 gai2 gan2 di1 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别以为我不知道你们在密谋什么。
examples.english_sentence: Don't think I don't know what you guys are plotting.

jyutping: mat6 hak1 lo4 ni4 sai1 aa3
english_meaning: Micronesia
explanation_mandarin: 位于太平洋的岛国，称为密克罗尼西亚联邦。
explanation_english: A country in the Pacific Ocean, officially known as the Federated States of Micronesia.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢下個月去密克羅尼西亞旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haa6 go3 jyut6 heoi3 mat6 hak1 lo4 ni4 sai1 aa3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他下个月去密克罗尼西亚旅行。
examples.english_sentence: He is going to Micronesia for travel next month.

english_meaning: close, intimate, carefully and closely
explanation_mandarin: 形容关系紧密，联系紧密。也可以指仔细、密切地关注。
explanation_english: Describes a close and intimate relationship or connection. Can also refer to careful and close attention.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋關係好密切㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gwaan1 hai6 hou2 mat6 chit3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的关系很密切。
examples.english_sentence: Our relationship is very close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩間公司嘅合作非常密切。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 hap6 jok3 fei1 soeng4 mat6 chit3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两家公司的合作非常密切。
examples.english_sentence: The cooperation between the two companies is very close.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方正密切留意事態發展。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 zing3 mat6 chit3 lau4 ji3 si6 taai3 faat3 zin2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方正密切留意事态发展。
examples.english_sentence: The police are closely monitoring the development of the situation.

english_meaning: close contact
explanation_mandarin: 指与感染者有密切接触，可能导致感染的情况。
explanation_english: Refers to being in close proximity to an infected person, potentially leading to infection.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係確診者嘅密切接觸者，所以要隔離。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 kok3 zan2 ze2 ge3 mat6 cit3 zip3 zuk1 ze2, so2 ji5 jiu3 gaak3 lei4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是确诊者的密切接触者，所以要隔离。
examples.english_sentence: He is a close contact of a confirmed case, so he needs to be quarantined.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府正追蹤所有確診者嘅密切接觸者。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 zing3 zeoi1 zung1 so2 jau5 kok3 zan2 ze2 ge3 mat6 cit3 zip3 zuk1 ze2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府正在追踪所有确诊者的密切接触者。
examples.english_sentence: The government is tracing all close contacts of confirmed cases.

english_meaning: Close contact
explanation_mandarin: 指与感染者有密切接触，可能被感染的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who has had close contact with an infected individual and is therefore at risk of becoming infected.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢俾人列做密切接觸者，要隔離十四日。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 jan4 lit6 zou6 mat6 chit3 zip3 zuk1 ze2, jiu3 gaak3 lei4 sap6 sei3 jat6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他被列为密切接触者，需要隔离十四天。
examples.english_sentence: He was listed as a close contact and has to quarantine for 14 days.

examples.english_sentence: My close friend and I often go shopping together.

english_meaning: tight-lipped; secretive; discreet; to keep one's mouth shut

explanation_english: Describes someone who is good at keeping secrets and doesn't easily reveal information; tight-lipped.

examples.english_sentence: Don't worry, I will definitely keep my mouth shut.

explanation_english: To speed up, to do something faster. To urge or encourage someone to be quicker.

english_meaning: frequently; continuously; closely

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他频繁地打电话给我。
examples.english_sentence: He calls me frequently.

mandarin_meaning: 频繁商量, 仔细商议
english_meaning: To discuss something thoroughly and frequently; to keep consulting on something; to have detailed and repeated consultations.
explanation_mandarin: 形容不断地、仔细地商量或讨论某事。 强调讨论的频率和深度。
explanation_english: Describes the act of frequently and thoroughly discussing or consulting on something. It emphasizes the frequency and depth of the discussion.

explanation_english: Describes something that is very dense and tightly packed together, closely arranged.

english_meaning: to have a secret consultation; to confer secretly; to have a clandestine meeting
explanation_mandarin: 秘密地商量、讨论，通常指重要或敏感的事情。
explanation_english: To have a secret consultation or discussion, typically about important or sensitive matters. It implies a clandestine or private meeting for deliberation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋閂埋門喺度密斟緊，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 saan1 maai4 mun4 hai2 dou6 mat6 zam1 gan2, m4 zi1 dou1 gaa2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们关着门在里面秘密商议，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: They're having a secret consultation behind closed doors, I wonder what's going on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢哋兩個高層密斟咗成晚，好似有咩大計劃噉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 dei6 loeng5 go3 gou1 cang4 mat6 zam1 zo2 seng4 maan5, hou2 ci5 jau5 me1 daai6 gai3 waak6 gam2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他们两个高层秘密商议了一整晚，好像有什么大计划。
examples.english_sentence: I heard the two executives had a secret meeting all night long, it seems like they have some big plans.

english_meaning: password
explanation_mandarin: 用于保护信息安全的秘密代码。
explanation_english: A secret code used to protect information security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅Wi-Fi密碼係乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 Wi-Fi mat6 maa5 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的Wi-Fi密码是什么啊？
examples.english_sentence: What's your Wi-Fi password?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔記得咗我個銀行戶口密碼喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 gei3 dak1 zo2 ngo5 go3 ngan4 hong4 wu6 hau2 mat6 maa5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我忘记了我的银行账户密码了。
examples.english_sentence: I forgot my bank account password.

english_meaning: Thorough; meticulous; attentive to detail
explanation_mandarin: 形容做事非常细致周到，考虑全面，不遗漏细节。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is very thorough, meticulous, and attentive to detail, considering all aspects and not missing any details.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好密籠㗎，唔使擔心佢會漏嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 mat6 lung4 gaa3, m4 sai2 daam1 sam1 keoi5 wui5 lau6 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很周到的，不用担心他会遗漏什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's very thorough in his work, you don't have to worry about him missing anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份報告寫得好密籠，分析得好深入。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 se2 dak1 hou2 mat6 lung4, fan1 sik1 dak1 hou2 sam1 jap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份报告写得很周到，分析得很深入。
examples.english_sentence: This report is written very thoroughly with in-depth analysis.

english_meaning: Mississippi River
explanation_mandarin: 北美洲的一条主要河流，是世界第四长河。
explanation_english: A major river in North America and the fourth-longest river in the world.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋學校嘅地理老師話，密西西比河好長㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hok6 haau6 ge3 dei6 lei5 lou5 si1 waa6, mat6 sai1 sai1 bei2 ho4 hou2 coeng4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们学校的地理老师说，密西西比河很长的。
examples.english_sentence: Our school's geography teacher said the Mississippi River is very long.

english_meaning: to plot; to conspire; conspiracy; plot
explanation_mandarin: 秘密地计划或策划不好的事情。
explanation_english: To secretly plan or plot something, typically something negative or harmful.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度密謀緊啲嘢，唔知想做乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 mat6 mau4 gan2 di1 je5, m4 zi1 dou3 soeng2 zou6 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在密谋着什么，不知道想做什么。
examples.english_sentence: They are plotting something, I don't know what they want to do.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 警方發現咗佢哋嘅密謀，即刻採取行動。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ging2 fong1 faat3 yin6 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 mat6 mau4, zik1 hak1 coi2 ceoi3 hang4 dung6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 警方发现了他们的密谋，立即采取行动。
examples.english_sentence: The police discovered their conspiracy and immediately took action.

english_meaning: Dense; compact; solid; tightly packed
explanation_mandarin: 形容物体结构非常紧密，没有空隙或空洞。也可以形容人思考问题非常细致周到，考虑周全。
explanation_english: Describes something that is very dense and compact, with no gaps or holes. Can also describe someone who is very meticulous and thorough in their thinking.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢塊蛋糕密質質咁，好足料喎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 faai3 daan6 gou1 mat1 zat1 zat1 gam2, hou2 zuk1 liu2 wo3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这块蛋糕很扎实，用料很足啊！
examples.english_sentence: This cake is so dense, it's packed with ingredients!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好密質質，做嘢好仔細。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 mat1 zat1 zat1, zou6 je5 hou2 zai2 sai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很细致周到，做事很仔细。
examples.english_sentence: He's a very thorough person and very careful in his work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢本書啲字印得密質質，睇到眼都花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bun2 syu1 di1 zi6 jan3 dak1 mat1 zat1 zat1, tai2 dou3 ngaan5 dou1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这本书的字印得很密集，看得眼睛都花了。
examples.english_sentence: The words in this book are printed so densely that it's straining my eyes to read it.

english_meaning: to beat the drums urgently and closely; to prepare busily and intensively for something; to work towards a goal with great energy
explanation_mandarin: 形容准备工作进行得非常密集和紧张，气氛热烈。
explanation_english: Describes a situation where preparations are underway very intensively and busily, creating a lively atmosphere. It implies a high level of activity and urgency in preparation for an event or task.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋為咗下個月嘅演唱會，密鑼緊鼓咁排練緊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 wai6 zo2 haa6 go3 jyut6 ge3 jin2 coeng3 wui2, mat6 lo4 gan2 gu2 gam2 paai4 lin6 gan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们为了下个月的演唱会，正在紧锣密鼓地排练。
examples.english_sentence: They are preparing intensively for next month's concert, rehearsing with great energy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司為咗推出新產品，密鑼緊鼓咁做緊宣傳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 wai6 zo2 teoi1 ceot1 san1 caan2 ban2, mat6 lo4 gan2 gu2 gam2 zou6 gan2 syun1 cyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了推出新产品，公司正在紧锣密鼓地进行宣传。
examples.english_sentence: The company is busily preparing the promotion for the new product launch.

synonyms: 有條不紊 (jau5 tiu4 bat1 man6) - in an orderly way (though not a direct synonym)

english_meaning: sealed, closed, airtight
explanation_mandarin: 指紧密地封闭起来，使内外隔绝。
explanation_english: Refers to being tightly sealed or closed, isolating the inside from the outside.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個容器係密閉嘅，唔會漏水。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 jung4 hei3 hai6 mat6 bai3 ge3, m4 wui5 lau6 seui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个容器是密封的，不会漏水。
examples.english_sentence: This container is sealed and won't leak.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房嘅門窗都密閉咗，所以好靜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 ge3 mun4 coeng1 dou1 mat6 bai3 zo2, so2 ji5 hou2 zing6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间的门窗都封闭了，所以很安静。
examples.english_sentence: The doors and windows of the room are all closed tightly, so it's very quiet.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要確保個實驗室嘅環境係密閉嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 kok3 bou2 go3 sat6 jim6 sat1 ge3 waan4 ging2 hai6 mat6 bai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要确保实验室的环境是密封的。
examples.english_sentence: We need to ensure the environment of the lab is sealed.

english_meaning: dense; intensive; concentrated
explanation_mandarin: 形容事物分布紧密，集中。
explanation_english: Describing something that is densely distributed or concentrated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度嘅樓起得好密集，好逼呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 ge3 lau2 hei2 dak1 hou2 mat6 zaap6, hou2 bik1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里的楼建得很密集，很拥挤啊！
examples.english_sentence: The buildings here are built very densely, it's so crowded!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司最近開咗好多密集式嘅訓練班。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 zeoi3 gan6 hoi1 zo2 hou2 do1 mat6 zaap6 sik1 ge3 fan3 lin6 baan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司最近开了很多密集式的训练班。
examples.english_sentence: The company recently opened many intensive training courses.

english_meaning: dense clouds, overcast
explanation_mandarin: 形容天空布满浓厚的云层。
explanation_english: Describes the sky being covered with thick clouds, indicating cloudy weather.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日密雲呀，好似會落雨噉喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 mat6 wan4 aa3, hou2 ci5 wui5 lok6 jyu5 gam2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天阴云密布，好像要下雨的样子。
examples.english_sentence: It's overcast today, it looks like it's going to rain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲相影出嚟，密雲嘅景冇咁靚嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 soeng2 ying2 ceot1 lei4, mat6 wan4 ge3 ging2 mou5 gam3 leng3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 拍出来的照片，阴云密布的景色没那么漂亮。
examples.english_sentence: The photos turned out less beautiful because of the overcast sky.

english_meaning: Closed-toe shoes
explanation_mandarin: 指鞋头是封闭的鞋子，例如皮鞋、波鞋等，不露出脚趾。
explanation_english: Refers to shoes that have a closed toe, such as dress shoes or sneakers, where the toes are not exposed.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 返工最好着密頭鞋，穩陣啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: faan1 gung1 zeoi3 hou2 zeok3 mat6 tau4 haai4, wan2 zan6 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 上班最好穿包头鞋，稳妥一些。
examples.english_sentence: It's best to wear closed-toe shoes for work, it's safer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 去行山唔好着拖鞋，要着密頭鞋保護對腳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: heoi3 haang4 saan1 m4 hou2 zoek3 to1 haai4, jiu3 zoek3 mat6 tau4 haai4 bou2 wu6 deoi3 goek3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 去爬山不要穿拖鞋，要穿包头鞋保护脚。
examples.english_sentence: Don't wear slippers when hiking, wear closed-toe shoes to protect your feet.

mandarin_meaning: 少量多次地吃，可以抵得上一次吃很多
english_meaning: Eating frequent small meals is as effective as eating three large meals.
explanation_mandarin: 指少量多次地进食，其效果等同于一次性大量进食。强调细水长流的重要性，也暗示健康饮食的理念。
explanation_english: This proverb suggests that eating small, frequent meals can be as effective as eating three large meals. It emphasizes the importance of a steady, continuous approach and implies a healthy eating habit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 減肥唔一定要餓親自己嘅，密食當三番，一樣可以瘦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaam2 fei4 m4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 ngo6 can1 zi6 gei2 ge3, mat6 sik6 dong3 saam1 faan1, jat1 joeng6 ho2 ji5 sau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 减肥不一定要饿着自己，少量多次地吃，一样可以瘦。
examples.english_sentence: You don't necessarily have to starve yourself to lose weight. Eating frequent small meals is just as effective.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢都係咁，密密做當三番，唔使一次過做晒佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 dou1 hai6 gam2, mat6 mat6 zou6 dong3 saam1 faan1, m4 sai2 jat1 ci3 gwo3 zou6晒佢.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作也是这样，经常做就等于一次性做完，不需要一次全部做完。
examples.english_sentence: It's the same with work, doing it frequently is like doing it all at once. You don't need to finish everything at once.

english_meaning: dense, crowded, packed, full of
explanation_mandarin: 形容非常密集，拥挤，数量很多而且排列紧密。
explanation_english: Describes something very dense, crowded, packed together, or full of many things closely arranged.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲字密麻麻，睇到我眼都花。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 zi6 mat6 maa4 maa4, tai2 dou3 ngo5 ngaan5 dou1 faa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 字密密麻麻的，看得我眼睛都花了。
examples.english_sentence: The words are so densely packed that my eyes are blurry.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日啲巴士密麻麻都逼唔上。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 di1 baa1 si2 mat6 maa4 maa4 dou1 bik1 m4 soeng5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天的公共汽车非常拥挤，根本挤不上去。
examples.english_sentence: The buses are so crowded today that I can't even get on.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間房擺滿嘢，密麻麻。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 baai2 mun5 je5, mat6 maa4 maa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 房间里摆满了东西，密密麻麻的。
examples.english_sentence: The room is full of things, all packed together.

english_meaning: to chat, to chit-chat, to engage in small talk
explanation_mandarin: 指没有特定目的的闲聊，轻松地谈话。
explanation_english: Refers to chatting without a specific purpose, engaging in light conversation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋成日喺公司密龍㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seng4 jat6 hai2 gung1 si1 mat6 lung4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们经常在公司聊天。
examples.english_sentence: We often chat at the office.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺度密龍，唔知講緊乜嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 hai2 dou6 mat6 lung4, m4 zhi1 dou3 gong2 geng2 mat1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在那里聊天，不知道在说什么。
examples.english_sentence: They are chatting over there, I don't know what they are talking about.

mandarin_meaning: 贼, 盗贼, 入侵者
english_meaning: bandit, robber, enemy, invader
explanation_mandarin: 指盗贼，侵略者。
explanation_english: Refers to a bandit, robber, or invader.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 啲海寇好惡㗎，成日搶嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: di1 hoi2 kau3 hou2 ok3 gaa3, seng4 jat6 coeng2 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那些海盗很凶恶，经常抢东西。
examples.english_sentence: Those pirates are very vicious, they often rob things.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代好多地方都有寇患。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 dou1 jau5 kau3 waan6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代很多地方都有匪患。
examples.english_sentence: In ancient times, many places suffered from banditry.

english_meaning: rich, wealthy, abundant
explanation_mandarin: 指拥有大量财富或资源，经济状况良好。
explanation_english: Refers to possessing a large amount of wealth or resources, indicating a good economic condition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企好富貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei1 hou2 fu3 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家很富有的。
examples.english_sentence: Their family is very wealthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港好多有錢人都好富。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 jau5 cin2 jan4 dou1 hou2 fu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港很多有钱人都很富有。
examples.english_sentence: Many rich people in Hong Kong are very wealthy.

mandarin_meaning: 富不过三代 (fù bù guò sān dài)
english_meaning: Wealth never survives three generations; Shirt sleeves to shirt sleeves in three generations.
explanation_mandarin: 形容家业即使再大，后代如果不能保持，经过三代也会衰败。
explanation_english: Describes how even great wealth will eventually be lost if future generations cannot maintain it; suggests that the skills and habits needed to build wealth are not easily passed down through families.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋屋企以前好有錢㗎，但係而家都冇乜嘢喇，真係應咗嗰句「富不過三代」呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 uk1 kei2 ji5 cin4 hou2 jau5 cin2 gaa3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 dou1 mou5 mat1 je5 laa3, zan1 hai6 jing3 zo2 go2 geoi3 "fu3 bat1 gwo3 saam1 doi6" aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们家以前很有钱的，但是现在没什么了，真的应了那句“富不过三代”啊。
examples.english_sentence: Their family used to be very wealthy, but now they don't have much anymore. It really proves the saying 'wealth never survives three generations'.

english_meaning: second-generation rich; someone born into a wealthy family
explanation_mandarin: 指继承巨额财富的富家子弟，一般指第二代。
explanation_english: Refers to the children of wealthy families who inherit a large fortune, typically the second generation. Often carries a negative connotation, implying they are spoiled, entitled, and lack ambition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係個富二代，唔使做都有錢使。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 go3 fu3 ji6 doi6, m4 sai2 zou6 dou1 jau5 cin2 sai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是个富二代，不用工作也有钱花。
examples.english_sentence: He's a second-generation rich kid; he doesn't need to work to have money to spend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 好多人覺得啲富二代都唔識得珍惜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ho2 do1 jan4 gok3 dak1 di1 fu3 ji6 doi6 dou1 m4 sik1 dak1 zan1 sik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 很多人觉得那些富二代都不懂得珍惜。
examples.english_sentence: Many people think that those second-generation rich kids don't know how to cherish what they have.

synonyms: 千金小姐 (cin1 gam1 siu2 je2)

mandarin_meaning: 财富可以与一个国家匹敌
english_meaning: wealthy enough to rival a country; immensely rich
explanation_mandarin: 形容极其富有，财富可以与一个国家相抗衡。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is extremely rich, with wealth comparable to that of a nation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢個集團咁大，都算係富可敵國啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 zaap6 tyun4 gam3 daai6, dou1 syun3 hai6 fu3 ho2 dik6 gwok3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的集团这么大，也算是富可敌国了。
examples.english_sentence: His corporation is so big, it can be considered wealthy enough to rival a country.

english_meaning: wealthy merchant, rich businessman
explanation_mandarin: 指有钱的商人。
explanation_english: Refers to a wealthy merchant or businessman.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢老豆係一個好成功嘅富商。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lou5 dou2 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 sing4 gung1 ge3 fu3 soeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他爸爸是一个很成功的富商。
examples.english_sentence: His father is a very successful wealthy merchant.

english_meaning: Mount Fuji
explanation_mandarin: 日本的一座著名山峰，是日本的象征之一。
explanation_english: A famous mountain in Japan, one of the symbols of Japan.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋下年諗住去日本睇富士山啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 haa6 nin4 nam2 zyu6 heoi3 jat6 bun2 tai2 fu3 si6 saan1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们明年打算去日本看富士山。
examples.english_sentence: We are planning to go to Japan to see Mount Fuji next year.

english_meaning: Fuji apple
explanation_mandarin: 一种苹果的品种，果实大而圆，颜色红润，味道甜脆多汁。
explanation_english: A type of apple known for its large size, round shape, reddish color, and sweet, crisp, and juicy taste.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想買兩個富士蘋果做下午茶。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 loeng5 go3 fu3 si6 ping4 gwo2 zou6 haa6 ng5 caa4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想买两个富士苹果当下午茶。
examples.english_sentence: I want to buy two Fuji apples for afternoon tea.

mandarin_meaning: 富裕家庭; 有钱人家
english_meaning: wealthy family; rich family
explanation_mandarin: 指经济上非常富裕的家庭，通常指代拥有大量财富和资源的家庭。
explanation_english: Refers to a family that is economically very wealthy, usually referring to a family with a large amount of wealth and resources.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係富家仔，細個已經乜都有。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 fu3 gaa1 zai2, sai3 go3 ji5 ging1 mat1 dou1 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是富家子弟，从小就什么都有。
examples.english_sentence: He is from a wealthy family, he had everything since he was a child.
