examples.cantonese_sentence: 我啲錢射晒落海咁，乜都冇買到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 di1 cin2 se6 saai3 lok6 hoi2 gam2, mat1 dou1 mou5 maai5 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我的钱都白花了，什么都没买到。
examples.english_sentence: It's like my money was thrown down the drain, I bought nothing.

english_meaning: to shoot (in sports, especially soccer/football)
explanation_mandarin: 在足球等运动中，指将球踢向球门，试图得分。
explanation_english: In sports like football (soccer), to kick or head the ball towards the goal with the intention of scoring a point.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢一射門就入咗，真係好犀利呀！
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat1 se6 mun4 zau6 jap6 zo2, zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一射门就进了，真是太厉害了！
examples.english_sentence: He scored as soon as he shot the ball. He's really amazing!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅前鋒成日射門，但係都冇入波。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 cin4 fung1 sing4 jat6 se6 mun4, daan6 hai6 dou1 mou5 jap6 bo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的前锋经常射门，但是都没有进球。
examples.english_sentence: Their forward shoots a lot, but they haven't scored any goals.

english_meaning: to flatter, to brown-nose, to suck up to
explanation_mandarin: 用言语或行动讨好别人，以获取好处。
explanation_english: To try to gain favor from someone by flattering them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日射馬紙，想升職。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 se6 maa5 zi2, soeng2 sing1 zik1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是拍马屁，想升职。
examples.english_sentence: He always flatters the boss, hoping to get promoted.

english_meaning: to try one's luck; to wing it; to shoot at the goal (in football/soccer)
explanation_mandarin: 原指足球运动中射门，引申为尝试侥幸过关，蒙混过关。也指没有充分准备，临时应付。
explanation_english: Originally referring to shooting at the goal in football/soccer. By extension, it means to try one's luck, to scrape by, or to wing it. It can also refer to handling a situation without adequate preparation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我今晚冇温习，听日考试唯有射龙门咯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 mou5 wan1 zaap6, ting1 jat6 haau2 si3 wai4 jau5 se6 lung4 mun4 lok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我今晚没有复习，明天考试只好蒙混过关了。
examples.english_sentence: I didn't study tonight, so I'll just have to wing it on the exam tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢份project我完全唔熟，听日present唯有射龙门啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 fan6 project ngo5 wun4 cyun4 m4 suk6, ting1 jat6 present wai4 jau5 se6 lung4 mun4 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这份项目我完全不熟悉，明天演示只好临时应付了。
examples.english_sentence: I'm completely unfamiliar with this project, so I'll just have to wing the presentation tomorrow.

english_meaning: To masturbate (male)
explanation_mandarin: 一个粗俗的粤语口语，指男性进行性自慰的行为，即打手枪。
explanation_english: A vulgar Cantonese slang term for male masturbation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日匿喺房度射龜，唔知搞乜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 nik1 hai2 fong4 dou6 se6 gwai1, m4 zi1 dou3 gaau2 mat1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他整天躲在房间里打手枪，不知道在搞什么。
examples.english_sentence: He's always locked in his room masturbating; I don't know what he's up to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喂，你唔好咁無聊啦，成日喺度射龜。
examples.jyutping_sentence: wai3, nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 mou4 liu4 laa1, sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 se6 gwai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 喂，你别这么无聊了，整天在这里打手枪。
examples.english_sentence: Hey, don't be so bored. Don't just sit around masturbating all day.

mandarin_meaning: 要; 会; 拿; 把
english_meaning: will; going to; shall; about to; to take; to bring; to use; with; by means of; check (chess); general
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 助动词; 介词; 动词; 名词
explanation_mandarin: 1. 助动词，表示未来或即将发生：将要，将会。2. 介词，表示处置或凭借：将功补过，将心比心。3. 动词，拿，用：将计就计。4. 名词，指将领或象棋中的“将”：大将，将军。
explanation_english: 1. Auxiliary verb: Indicates future tense or something about to happen: will, going to. 2. Preposition: Indicates disposal or means: to use (something) to compensate for (a fault), to put oneself in another's shoes. 3. Verb: To take, to use: to turn the enemy's trick against himself. 4. Noun: General or the 'king' piece in Chinese chess: general, high-ranking officer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋将会去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 wui5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们将要去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to travel.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 将啲垃圾攞去丢咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 laap6 saap3 lo2 heoi3 diu1 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把垃圾拿去扔了。
examples.english_sentence: Take the trash and throw it away.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺象棋入面输咗个将。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 zoeng3 kei2 jap6 min6 syu1 zo2 go3 zoeng1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在象棋中输掉了将。
examples.english_sentence: He lost his general in chess.

english_meaning: will; shall; to take; to use; to bring; to guard; general
partOfSpeech_mandarin: 动词; 副词; 名词
explanation_mandarin: 作为动词，表示拿，用，携带。作为副词，表示将要。作为名词，指将军。
explanation_english: As a verb, it means to take, to use, or to carry. As an adverb, it means will or shall. As a noun, it refers to a general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將啲嘢放喺度。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 di1 je5 fong3 hai2 dou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 把东西放在这里。
examples.english_sentence: Put the things here.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將會去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zoeng1 wui5 heoi3 Hoeng1 Gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我将要去香港。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 李將軍好勇猛。
examples.jyutping_sentence: lei5 zoeng1 gwan1 hou2 jung5 maang5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 李将军很勇敢。
examples.english_sentence: General Li is very brave.

english_meaning: future
explanation_mandarin: 未来的时间，未来的日子。
explanation_english: The time to come; the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將來你想做咩啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeung1 loi4 nei5 soeng2 zou6 me1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你将来想做什么？
examples.english_sentence: What do you want to do in the future?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我希望將來我可以去旅行環遊世界。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hei1 mong6 zeung1 loi4 ngo5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 waan4 jau4 sai3 gaai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我希望将来我可以去旅行环游世界。
examples.english_sentence: I hope I can travel around the world in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋嘅將來睇嚟一片光明。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ge3 zeung1 loi4 tai2 lai4 jat1 pin3 gwong1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们的将来看起来一片光明。
examples.english_sentence: Their future looks bright.

english_meaning: half-believing, dubious, skeptical
explanation_mandarin: 表示对某事或某人抱着怀疑的态度，既相信又不完全相信。
explanation_english: Expressing a state of uncertainty or doubt about something or someone, believing to some extent but not fully convinced.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘅嘢我將信將疑，唔知係咪真係咁好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 ngo5 zoeng1 seon3 zoeng1 ji4, m4 zi1 hai6 mai1 zan1 hai6 gam3 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他说的话我半信半疑，不知道是不是真的那么好。
examples.english_sentence: I'm half-believing what he said; I don't know if it's really that good.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽佢咁講，我都將信將疑，但係都決定試吓。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 keoi5 gam2 gong2, ngo5 dou1 zoeng1 seon3 zoeng1 ji4, daan6 hai6 dou1 kyut3 ding6 si3 haa5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听他这么说，我将信将疑，但还是决定试一下。
examples.english_sentence: Hearing what he said, I was dubious, but I decided to give it a try anyway.

mandarin_meaning: 根据价格迁就货物；将就着买
english_meaning: To make a purchase based on the price; to settle for something that fits the budget; to compromise on quality or features to match a desired price.
explanation_mandarin: 指因为价格的限制，而选择质量或功能略逊的商品。 带有无奈或者妥协的意味。
explanation_english: This phrase describes making a purchase where one compromises on the quality or features of a product due to budgetary constraints. It implies a sense of resignation or compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋預算有限，唯有將價就貨，買部二手車算喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 syun3 jau5 haan6, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 gaa3 zau6 fo3, maai5 bou6 ji5 sau2 ce1 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的预算有限，只能根据价格买东西，买辆二手车算了。
examples.english_sentence: Our budget is limited, so we have to buy based on the price and just settle for a second-hand car.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想住大啲嘅屋，但係啲錢唔夠，唯有將價就貨，搬去細啲嘅單位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zyu6 daai6 di1 ge3 uk1, daan6 hai6 di1 cin2 m4 gau3, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 gaa3 zau6 fo3, bun1 heoi3 sai3 di1 ge3 daan1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想住大一点的房子，但是钱不够，只好根据价格买东西，搬去小一点的公寓。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to live in a bigger house, but he didn't have enough money, so he had to compromise and move to a smaller apartment.

english_meaning: to atone for a fault with merit; to redeem oneself by good deeds
explanation_mandarin: 用功劳来弥补过错。
explanation_english: To make up for mistakes with good deeds; to compensate for errors by performing meritorious service.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次犯咗個錯，希望可以將功補過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 faan6 zo2 go3 co3, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 gung1 bou2 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次犯了个错，希望可以用功劳弥补过错。
examples.english_sentence: He made a mistake this time, hopefully he can atone for it with merit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢之前做錯咗嘢，但係佢之後好努力工作，都算係將功補過啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 zi1 cin4 zou6 co3 zo2 je5, daan6 hai6 keoi5 zi1 hau6 hou2 nou5 lik6 gung1 zok3, dou1 syun3 hai6 zoeng1 gung1 bou2 gwo3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他之前做错了事，但是他之后很努力工作，也算是将功补过。
examples.english_sentence: Although he made mistakes before, he worked very hard afterwards, which can be considered as atoning for his faults.

english_meaning: to atone for one's crimes with meritorious service; to redeem oneself through good deeds
explanation_mandarin: 用立功的表现来抵消所犯的罪过。比喻通过好的表现来弥补之前的错误。
explanation_english: To make amends for past misdeeds by performing meritorious deeds. It implies atoning for sins or mistakes through acts of good service or accomplishments.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢今次幫公司簽咗單大刁，算係將功贖罪啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 ci3 bong1 gung1 si1 cim1 zo2 daai6 diu1, syun3 hai6 zoeng1 gung1 suk6 zeoi6 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这次帮公司签了一笔大生意，算是将功补过了。
examples.english_sentence: He closed a big deal for the company this time, it can be considered as atoning for his previous mistake.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢之前犯咗錯，但係佢好努力咁做嘢，希望可以將功贖罪。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 zi1 cin4 faan6 zo2 co3, daan6 hai6 keoi5 hou2 nou5 lik6 gam2 zou6 je5, hei1 mong6 ho2 ji5 zoeng1 gung1 suk6 zeoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他之前犯了错，但是他很努力地工作，希望可以将来功补过。
examples.english_sentence: Although he made a mistake before, he is working very hard, hoping to atone for his sins with good deeds.

english_meaning: Diligence can compensate for lack of talent; hard work can make up for clumsiness.
explanation_mandarin: 用勤奋来弥补笨拙。形容勤奋可以弥补先天的不足。
explanation_english: To compensate for a lack of talent or skill with hard work and diligence. It emphasizes that even if someone is not naturally gifted, they can achieve success through effort.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然佢天資唔高，但係佢相信將勤補拙，所以好努力學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 keoi5 tin1 zi1 m4 gou1, daan6 hai6 keoi5 soeng1 seon3 zoeng1 kan4 bou2 zyut3, so2 ji5 hou2 nu5 lik6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然他天资不高，但是他相信勤能补拙，所以很努力学习。
examples.english_sentence: Although he isn't very talented, he believes that diligence can compensate for lack of talent, so he studies very hard.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢有時都要將勤補拙，唔好諗住自己好叻，咩都唔做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jau5 si4 dou1 jiu3 zoeng1 kan4 bou2 zyut3, m4 hou2 nim2 zyu6 zi6 gei2 hou2 lek1, me1 dou1 m4 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作有时候也要勤能补拙，不要觉得自己很聪明，什么都不做。
examples.english_sentence: Sometimes you have to compensate for lack of talent with hard work. Don't think you are clever and do nothing.

english_meaning: officers and soldiers; troops
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中的将领和士兵，泛指军队。
explanation_english: Refers to generals and soldiers in the army; a general term for troops.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 班將士好英勇啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: baan1 zeong3 si6 hou2 jing1 yung5 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这群将士非常英勇啊！
examples.english_sentence: These troops are very brave!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將士們為咗國家而戰鬥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zeong3 si6 mun4 wai6 zo2 gwok3 gaa1 ji4 zin3 dau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将士们为了国家而战斗。
examples.english_sentence: The officers and soldiers fought for their country.

english_meaning: General (military rank)
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中高级军官，通常指将军级别的军官。
explanation_english: Refers to senior military officers in the armed forces, typically general-level officers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好有經驗嘅將官。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 zeong3 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有经验的将官。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very experienced general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 軍隊入面，將官嘅地位好高。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gwan1 deoi2 jap6 min6, zeong3 gun1 ge3 dei6 wai2 hou2 gou1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 军队里面，将官的地位很高。
examples.english_sentence: In the military, the position of general is very high.

mandarin_meaning: 凑合; 迁就; 容忍
english_meaning: to put up with; to make do; to make the best of it; to compromise; to accommodate
explanation_mandarin: 勉强适应不理想的情况；迁就他人；容忍
explanation_english: To make do with something that is not ideal; to compromise; to accommodate or tolerate something or someone.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 冇辦法喇，將就下啦，下次買過份好啲嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: mou5 baan6 faat3 laa3, zoeng1 zau6 haa5 laa1, haa6 ci3 maai5 gwo3 fan6 hou2 di1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 没办法了，凑合一下吧，下次买个好一点的。
examples.english_sentence: There's no way around it, let's just make do with it for now, next time we'll buy a better one.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好將就人嘅，成日都遷就朋友。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zoeng1 zau6 jan4 ge3, seng4 jat6 dou1 cin1 zau6 pang4 jau5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很能迁就别人，总是迁就朋友。
examples.english_sentence: He is very accommodating, always compromising for his friends.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 咁嘅質素都將就到，真係服咗你。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam3 ge3 zat1 so3 dou1 zoeng1 zau6 dou3, zan1 hai6 fuk6 zo2 nei5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这样的质量你都能忍受，真是佩服你。
examples.english_sentence: I'm impressed that you can put up with this kind of quality.

english_meaning: general; commander
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中的高级指挥官，负责指挥作战。
explanation_english: Refers to a high-ranking commander in the army, responsible for directing combat operations.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋喺戰場上都係英勇嘅將帥。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keui5 dei6 hai2 jin3 cheung4 seung6 dou1 hai6 ying1 yung5 ge3 jeung3 seui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们在战场上都是英勇的将帅。
examples.english_sentence: They are all brave generals on the battlefield.

english_meaning: to put oneself in someone else's shoes; to be empathetic
explanation_mandarin: 设想自己处在别人的地位或境地，从而理解或体谅别人的处境和感受。
explanation_english: To imagine oneself in another person's situation; to understand or empathize with their circumstances and feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人要將心比己，唔好淨係諗自己。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 zoeng1 sam1 bei2 gei2, m4 hou2 zing6 hai6 nam2 zi6 gei2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人要设身处地，不要只考虑自己。
examples.english_sentence: As a person, you should put yourself in others' shoes and not just think about yourself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 如果你將心比己咁諗下，你就會明白點解佢會咁做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 zoeng1 sam1 bei2 gei2 gam2 nam2 haa5, nei5 zau6 wui5 ming4 baak6 dim2 gaai2 keoi5 wui5 gam2 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 如果你设身处地地想一下，你就会明白他为什么会这么做。
examples.english_sentence: If you put yourself in his shoes and think about it, you'll understand why he did that.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺人哋有困難嘅時候，我哋應該將心比己，盡力幫佢哋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jan4 dei6 jau5 kwan3 naan4 ge3 si4 hau6, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zoeng1 sam1 bei2 gei2, zeon6 lik6 bong1 keoi5 dei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在别人有困难的时候，我们应该设身处地，尽力帮助他们。
examples.english_sentence: When others are in trouble, we should put ourselves in their shoes and do our best to help them.

english_meaning: to put oneself in someone else's shoes; to be considerate; empathy
explanation_mandarin: 设想自己处在别人的地位或境地，从而理解别人的感受和需求。
explanation_english: To put yourself in someone else's position in order to understand their feelings and needs; to be empathetic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你將心比心諗下，如果你係佢，你會點做啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoeng1 sam1 bei2 sam1 nam2 haa5, jyu4 gwo2 nei5 hai6 keoi5, nei5 wui5 dim2 zou6 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你设身处地想一下，如果你是他，你会怎么做？
examples.english_sentence: Put yourself in his shoes and think, if you were him, what would you do?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做人最緊要將心比心，咁先可以建立良好嘅人際關係。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 zeoi3 gan2 jiu3 zoeng1 sam1 bei2 sam1, gam2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gin3 lap6 loeng4 hou2 ge3 jan4 zai3 gwaan1 hai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 做人最重要的是设身处地，这样才能建立良好的人际关系。
examples.english_sentence: The most important thing in life is to be considerate, only then can you build good interpersonal relationships.

english_meaning: will; shall; be going to; be about to
explanation_mandarin: 表示将来发生的动作或情况。
explanation_english: Expresses an action or situation that will happen in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我將會去香港。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zeong1 wui2 heoi3 Hoeng1 Gong2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我将会去香港。
examples.english_sentence: I will go to Hong Kong.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將會成為一個醫生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zeong1 wui2 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 ji1 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他将会成为一名医生。
examples.english_sentence: He will become a doctor.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日將會落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zeong1 wui2 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天将会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: It will rain tomorrow.

english_meaning: Advent
explanation_mandarin: 基督教教会年历的一个节期，从将临期第一主日开始，到圣诞节前结束。信徒们预备庆祝耶稣基督的降生。
explanation_english: Advent is a season observed in many Western Christian churches as a time of expectant waiting and preparation for both the celebration of the Nativity of Christ at Christmas and the return of Christ at the Second Coming.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 教會喺將臨期嘅時候會有點蠟燭嘅傳統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaau1 wui2 hai2 zoeng1 lam4 kei4 ge3 si4 hau6 wui2 jau5 dim2 laap6 zuk1 ge3 cyun4 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 教会在将临期的时候会有点蜡烛的传统。
examples.english_sentence: The church has a tradition of lighting candles during Advent.

english_meaning: about to arrive; imminent; approaching
explanation_mandarin: 指某事物或事件即将到来。
explanation_english: Refers to something or an event that is about to happen or arrive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聖誕節將至，好多舖頭都開始做緊大減價。
examples.jyutping_sentence: sing3 daan3 zit3 zoeng1 zi3, hou2 do1 pou3 tau2 dou1 hoi1 ci2 zou6 gan2 daai6 gaam2 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 圣诞节将至，很多商店都开始做大减价。
examples.english_sentence: Christmas is approaching, and many shops are starting to have big sales.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試將至，要努力溫書喇！
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si3 zoeng1 zi3, jiu3 nu5 lik6 wan1 syu1 laa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试将至，要努力复习了！
examples.english_sentence: The exam is approaching, you need to study hard!

english_meaning: will; shall; be going to; be about to
explanation_mandarin: 表示将要发生的事情。
explanation_english: Indicates something that is about to happen in the future.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋將要搬去新屋喇。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 jiu3 bun1 heoi3 san1 uk1 laa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们就要搬到新房子了。
examples.english_sentence: We are going to move to a new house soon.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日將要落雨。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 zoeng1 jiu3 lok6 jyu5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天将会下雨。
examples.english_sentence: It will rain tomorrow.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將要結婚啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 jiu3 git3 fan1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她将要结婚了。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is going to get married.

english_meaning: to turn the tables; to use someone's plot against them; to beat someone at their own game; to use someone's trick against them
explanation_mandarin: 利用对方的计谋来反击对方；顺着对方的计划去做，然后达到自己的目的。
explanation_english: To use someone's plan against them; to turn the tables on someone by pretending to go along with their plan, but then using it to your advantage.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢想呃我，我就將計就計，等佢偷雞唔到蝕揸米。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 aak1 ngo5, ngo5 zau6 zoeng1 gai3 zau6 gai3, dang2 keoi5 tau1 gai1 m4 dou2 sit3 zaa1 mai1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想骗我，我就将计就计，让他偷鸡不成蚀把米。
examples.english_sentence: He wanted to trick me, so I turned the tables on him, making him end up losing out instead.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢諗住屈我，我咪將計就計囉。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam2 zyu6 wat1 ngo5, ngo5 mai1 zoeng1 gai3 zau6 gai3 lo1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他想冤枉我，那我就将计就计了。
examples.english_sentence: He was planning to frame me, so I just turned the tables on him.

synonyms: 以其人之道，還治其人之身 (ji5 kei4 jan4 zi1 dou6, waan4 zi6 kei4 jan4 zi1 san1)

english_meaning: to adjust the price according to the quality of the goods; to make do; to lower one's standards
explanation_mandarin: 根据货物的实际情况来调整价格，有时也指降低标准，凑合着使用。
explanation_english: To adjust the price to fit the quality of the goods, often implying a compromise or lowering of standards to make something work or to make a sale.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢啲貨品質素唔係咁好，我哋唯有將貨就價啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 di1 fo3 ban2 zat1 m4 hai6 gam3 hou2, ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 zoeng1 fo3 zau6 gaa3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这些货品质不太好，我们只能降价销售了。
examples.english_sentence: The quality of these goods isn't very good, so we have no choice but to lower the price.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋預算有限，唯有將貨就價，買啲平啲嘅嘢算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jyu6 syun3 jau5 haan6, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 fo3 zau6 gaa3, maai5 di1 peng4 di1 ge3 je5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们的预算有限，只能降低标准，买一些便宜的东西算了。
examples.english_sentence: Our budget is limited, so we have to lower our standards and just buy something cheaper.

english_meaning: General (military rank); to check (in chess); checkmate
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指军队中级别最高的军官。2. 在象棋中，指一方棋子对对方将（帅）形成威胁，使其下一步必须采取措施解除威胁。3. 比喻使对方陷入困境。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the highest-ranking officer in the military. 2. In chess, it means that one player's piece is threatening the opponent's king/general, forcing them to take action to remove the threat. 3. Metaphorically, it means to put the opponent in a difficult situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好出色嘅將軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 chut1 sik1 ge3 zoeng1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很出色的将军。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very outstanding general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我行咗一步將軍，佢就輸咗啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haang4 zo2 jat1 bou6 zoeng1 gwan1, keoi5 zau6 syu1 zo2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我走了一步将军，他就输了。
examples.english_sentence: I made a checkmate move, and he lost.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 間公司用新策略將咗對手一軍。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 yung6 san1 chak1 leok6 zoeng1 zo2 deoi3 sau2 jat1 gwan1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司用新策略将了对手一军。
examples.english_sentence: The company used a new strategy to put the opponent in a difficult position.

mandarin_meaning: 将军澳 (香港的一个地区)
english_meaning: Tseung Kwan O (a district in Hong Kong)
explanation_mandarin: 香港新界东南部的一个地区，位于西贡区。
explanation_english: A district in the southeastern New Territories of Hong Kong, located in the Sai Kung District.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我住喺將軍澳。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 zoeng1 gwan1 ou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我住在将军澳。
examples.english_sentence: I live in Tseung Kwan O.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將軍澳嘅樓價都幾貴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 gwan1 ou3 ge3 lau2 gaa3 dou1 gei2 gwai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 将军澳的房价都挺贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The property prices in Tseung Kwan O are quite expensive.

english_meaning: nearly; almost; close to
explanation_mandarin: 表示时间或数量接近某个程度。
explanation_english: Indicates that time or quantity is approaching a certain degree.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 將近十二點喇，我哋走啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zoeng1 gan6 sap6 ji6 dim2 laa3, ngo5 dei6 zau2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 快十二点了，我们走吧。
examples.english_sentence: It's almost twelve o'clock, let's go.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司將近執笠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 zoeng1 gan6 zap1 lap1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司快要倒闭了。
examples.english_sentence: This company is close to going bankrupt.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢將近三十歲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zoeng1 gan6 saam1 sap6 seoi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他快三十岁了。
examples.english_sentence: He is nearly thirty years old.

english_meaning: to make the best of a mistake; to go along with an error
explanation_mandarin: 指事情已经错了，就顺着错误做下去，以求得到意外的结果或避免更大的损失。
explanation_english: To accept a mistake and continue along the wrong path, either to obtain an unexpected result or to avoid a greater loss. It implies acknowledging an error but proceeding with it due to various reasons, like convenience or an inability to rectify the situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 頭先唔小心買錯咗張飛，唯有將錯就錯，睇埋佢算啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tau4 sin1 m4 siu2 sam1 maai5 co3 zo2 zoeng1 fei1, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 co3 zau6 co3, tai2 maai4 keoi5 syun3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 刚才不小心买错了票，只好将错就错，看完它算了。
examples.english_sentence: I accidentally bought the wrong ticket earlier, so I guess I'll just make the best of it and watch the show.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 既然都講咗大話，唯有將錯就錯，圓咗佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gei3 jin4 dou1 gong2 zo2 daai6 waa6, wai4 jau5 zoeng1 co3 zau6 co3, jyun4 zo2 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 既然已经说了谎，只好将错就错，把谎圆上。
examples.english_sentence: Now that I've already told the lie, I have no choice but to go along with it and make it believable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 雖然一開始嘅方法係錯嘅，但係而家將錯就錯，反而搞掂咗件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: seoi1 jin4 jat1 hoi2 chi2 ge3 fong1 faat3 hai6 co3 ge3, daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1 zoeng1 co3 zau6 co3, faan2 ji1 gao2 dim6 zo2 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 虽然一开始的方法是错的，但是现在将错就错，反而解决了事情。
examples.english_sentence: Although the initial method was wrong, going along with the mistake has surprisingly solved the problem.

english_meaning: general; high-ranking military officer
explanation_mandarin: 指军队中职位较高的军官，通常指挥一个较大的作战单位。
explanation_english: A high-ranking military officer, usually in command of a large operational unit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一位好有經驗嘅將領。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 wai2 hou2 jau5 ging1 jim6 ge3 zoeng3 ling5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是一位很有经验的将领。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very experienced general.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢場戰爭嘅勝負，好取決於將領嘅指揮能力。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 coeng4 zin3 caang4 ge3 sing3 fu6, hou2 ceoi2 kyut3 jyu1 zoeng3 ling5 ge3 zi2 fai1 nang4 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这场战争的胜负，很大程度上取决于将领的指挥能力。
examples.english_sentence: The victory or defeat of this war largely depends on the commanding ability of the generals.

mandarin_meaning: 专心; 专门; 特地
english_meaning: concentrated; specialized; specially
explanation_mandarin: 集中注意力，不分散；专门从事某种事物；特地，特意。
explanation_english: Concentrated, focused; specialized, dedicated to a specific task or area; specially, particularly.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你上堂要專心啲呀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 soeng5 tong4 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 di1 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你上课要专心点儿啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to concentrate more in class.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間鋪頭專賣海鮮嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou1 tau4 zyun1 maai6 hoi2 sin1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店专门卖海鲜的。
examples.english_sentence: This shop specializes in selling seafood.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我專登嚟探你㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyun1 dang1 lai4 taam3 nei5 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我特地来看你的。
examples.english_sentence: I came specially to visit you.

english_meaning: faithful, devoted, single-minded, constant
explanation_mandarin: 形容感情或注意力集中在某一方面，不改变。
explanation_english: Describes someone who is faithful or devoted to one person or thing, not changing their affections or focus.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢對愛情好專一㗎，拍拖好少會分手。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 deoi3 oi3 ching4 hou2 zyun1 jat1 gaa3, paak3 to1 hou2 siu2 wui5 fan1 sau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他对爱情很专一，谈恋爱很少会分手。
examples.english_sentence: He's very faithful in love and rarely breaks up when dating.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要專一啲，唔好三心兩意。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 zyun1 jat1 di1, m4 hou2 saam1 sam1 loeng5 yi3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 工作要专一一点，不要三心二意。
examples.english_sentence: You need to be more focused at work, don't be indecisive.

english_meaning: post-secondary
explanation_mandarin: 指高于中学的教育程度，如大学、学院等。
explanation_english: Refers to the level of education above secondary school, such as universities, colleges, etc.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋兩公婆都係專上學歷。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 dou1 hai6 zyun1 soeng5 hok6 lik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们两口子都是专科学历。
examples.english_sentence: Both of them (husband and wife) have post-secondary qualifications.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 讀完中學之後，佢想繼續讀專上課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: duk6 jyun4 zung1 hok6 zi1 hau6, keoi5 soeng2 gai3 zuk6 duk6 zyun1 soeng5 fo3 ching4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 中学毕业后，他想继续读专科课程。
examples.english_sentence: After finishing secondary school, he wants to continue studying a post-secondary course.

english_meaning: Post-secondary education; higher education
explanation_mandarin: 指中学毕业后的教育，包括大学、学院、职业技术学校等。
explanation_english: Refers to education after secondary school graduation, including universities, colleges, vocational and technical schools.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港嘅專上教育制度都幾完善。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 ge3 zyun1 soeng5 gaau3 juk6 zai3 dou6 dou1 gei2 jyun4 sin6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港的高等教育制度还是比较完善的。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong's post-secondary education system is quite comprehensive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢希望畢業之後可以繼續讀專上教育。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hei1 mong6 bat1 jip6 zi1 hau6 ho2 ji5 gai3 zuk6 duk6 zyun1 soeng5 gaau3 juk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他希望毕业之后可以继续接受高等教育。
examples.english_sentence: He hopes to continue his higher education after graduation.

english_meaning: Post-secondary institutions; higher education institutions
explanation_mandarin: 指提供高等教育的院校，包括大学、学院和一些职业培训机构。
explanation_english: Refers to institutions providing higher education, including universities, colleges, and some vocational training institutes.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港有好多間專上院校提供唔同嘅課程。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 jau5 hou2 do1 gaan1 zyun1 soeng6 jyun2 haau6 tai4 gung1 m4 tung4 ge3 fo3 cing4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港有很多所高等院校提供不同的课程。
examples.english_sentence: Hong Kong has many post-secondary institutions offering different courses.

english_meaning: dedicated person; specialist; designated personnel
explanation_mandarin: 指专门负责某项工作的人员。
explanation_english: Refers to personnel specifically assigned to handle a particular task or role.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋會有專人幫你跟進呢件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 wui5 jau5 zyun1 jan4 bong1 nei5 gan1 zeon3 ni1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们会安排专人帮您跟进这件事。
examples.english_sentence: We will have a dedicated person to follow up on this matter for you.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢部機器需要由專人操作。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 bou6 gei1 hei3 seoi1 jiu3 jau4 zyun1 jan4 caau1 zok3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这台机器需要由专人操作。
examples.english_sentence: This machine needs to be operated by a specialist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 酒店會安排專人接機。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zau2 dim3 wui5 aan1 paai4 zyun1 jan4 zip3 gei1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 酒店会安排专人接机。
examples.english_sentence: The hotel will arrange designated personnel to pick you up from the airport.

english_meaning: patent
explanation_mandarin: 指一种由政府授予的发明或创造的独占权利，允许权利人在一定时期内独占使用、销售和制造该发明或创造。
explanation_english: A patent is an exclusive right granted for an invention, which allows the patent holder to exclude others from making, using, or selling the invention for a limited period of time.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢發明咗新嘢，已經申請咗專利。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 faat3 ming4 zo2 san1 je5, ji5 ging1 san1 cheng2 zo2 zyun1 lei6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他发明了新东西，已经申请了专利。
examples.english_sentence: He invented something new and has already applied for a patent.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個產品有專利保護，其他人唔可以隨便抄襲㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 caan2 ban2 jau5 zyun1 lei6 bou2 wu6, kei4 taa1 jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin2 caau1 zaap6 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个产品有专利保护，其他人不可以随便抄袭的。
examples.english_sentence: This product is protected by a patent, so others cannot copy it casually.

english_meaning: autocratic, dictatorial, despotic
explanation_mandarin: 指独断专行，不接受他人意见的统治或制度。
explanation_english: Referring to a rule or system that is autocratic, dictatorial, or despotic, not accepting the opinions of others.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 嗰個國家嘅政府好專制，人民冇自由。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go2 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 zing3 fu2 hou2 zyun1 zai3, jan4 man4 mou5 zi6 jau4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 那个国家的政府很专制，人民没有自由。
examples.english_sentence: The government of that country is very autocratic, and the people have no freedom.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好專制，乜嘢都要聽佢嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 zyun1 zai3, mat1 je5 dou1 jiu3 ting1 keoi5 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他这个人很专制，什么都要听他的。
examples.english_sentence: He is a very dictatorial person; everyone has to listen to him.

english_meaning: Special zone, designated area, dedicated section
explanation_mandarin: 指为了某种特定目的而设立的区域或范围。
explanation_english: Refers to an area or section established for a specific purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢度係母嬰專區，方便啲媽媽餵奶同埋換片。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 dou6 hai6 mou5 ying1 zyun1 keoi1, fong1 bin6 di1 maa1 maa1 wai3 naai5 tung4 maai4 wun6 pin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这里是母婴专区，方便妈妈们喂奶和换尿布。
examples.english_sentence: This is the mother and baby zone, convenient for mothers to breastfeed and change diapers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 個商場有個化妝品專區，全部都係唔同嘅牌子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: go3 seung1 coeng4 jau5 go3 faa3 zong1 ban2 zyun1 keoi1, cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 m4 tung4 ge3 paai4 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个商场有个化妆品专区，全部都是不同的牌子。
examples.english_sentence: This shopping mall has a cosmetics section, all of which are different brands.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 政府劃咗一塊地做工業專區，吸引投資。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zing3 fu2 waak6 zo2 jat1 faai3 dei6 zou6 gung1 jip6 zyun1 keoi1, kap1 jan5 tau4 zi1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 政府划了一块地作为工业专区，吸引投资。
examples.english_sentence: The government designated a piece of land as an industrial zone to attract investment.

english_meaning: proper noun
explanation_mandarin: 指称特定的人、地方、机构或事物的名词，具有唯一性和独特性。
explanation_english: A noun that designates a particular person, place, thing, or idea, and is usually capitalized in English.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「香港」係一個專名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 zyun1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “香港”是一个专有名词。
examples.english_sentence: "Hong Kong" is a proper noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋嘅公司名都係一個專名。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ge3 gung1 si1 ming2 dou1 hai6 jat1 go3 zyun1 ming4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司的名字也是一个专有名词。
examples.english_sentence: Our company name is also a proper noun.

english_meaning: proper name mark (Chinese punctuation)
explanation_mandarin: 标点符号的一种，用于标明人名、地名、机构名等专有名词。
explanation_english: A type of punctuation mark in Chinese used to indicate proper nouns such as names of people, places, and organizations. It is usually a single underline placed below the proper noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺中文入邊，專名號係用嚟劃條線喺啲人名或者地名下面嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 zung1 man4 jap6 bin1, zyun1 ming4 hou6 hai6 yung6 lai4 waak6 tiu4 sin3 hai2 di1 yan4 ming4 waak6 ze2 dei6 ming4 haa6 min6 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在中文里，专名号是用来在人名或地名下面划一条线的。
examples.english_sentence: In Chinese, a proper name mark is used to draw a line under people's names or place names.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你寫佢個名嘅時候，記得加返條專名號啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 se2 keoi5 go3 ming4 ge3 si4 hau6, gei3 dak1 ga1 faan1 tiu4 zyun1 ming4 hou6 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你写他的名字的时候，记得加上专名号啊。
examples.english_sentence: When you write his name, remember to add the proper name mark.

english_meaning: Commissioner; specialist; officer
explanation_mandarin: 指专门负责某项事务的人员。在政府部门、机构或公司中，担任特定职务，负责专门事务的人。
explanation_english: Refers to a person who is specifically responsible for a particular task or area. In government departments, organizations, or companies, it refers to a person who holds a specific position and is responsible for specialized affairs.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係廉政公署嘅調查專員。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 lim4 zing3 gung1 syu5 ge3 diu6 caa4 zyun1 jyun4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是廉政公署的调查专员。
examples.english_sentence: He is an investigation commissioner of the Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC).

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要一個電腦專員嚟幫手解決呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 jat1 go3 din6 nou5 zyun1 jyun4 lai4 bong1 sau2 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要一个电脑专员来帮忙解决这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need a computer specialist to help solve this problem.

english_meaning: expert, specialist
explanation_mandarin: 在某个领域具有专门知识或技能的人。
explanation_english: A person who has special skill or knowledge in a particular field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係電腦保安嘅專家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 din6 nou5 bou2 on1 ge3 zyun1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是电脑安全方面的专家。
examples.english_sentence: He is an expert in computer security.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 請教下專家嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: cing2 gaau3 haa5 zyun1 gaa1 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请教一下专家的意见。
examples.english_sentence: Let's consult the opinion of an expert.

english_meaning: exclusive, dedicated, proprietary
explanation_mandarin: 特别属于某个人的，专门用于某物的。
explanation_english: Belonging exclusively to a particular person or thing; dedicated.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個係我哋嘅專屬空間，唔俾其他人入嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zyun1 suk6 hung1 gaan1, m4 bei2 kei4 ta1 jan4 jap6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这是我们专属的空间，不允许其他人进来。
examples.english_sentence: This is our exclusive space, no one else is allowed in.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳有專屬會員優惠。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 jau5 zyun1 suk6 wui2 jyun4 jau1 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家餐厅有专属会员优惠。
examples.english_sentence: This restaurant has exclusive member discounts.

english_meaning: concentrate, focus, attentive
explanation_mandarin: 集中精神，专一的心。
explanation_english: To concentrate; to focus one's attention; to be attentive.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你做功課嘅時候要專心啲。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 gung1 fo3 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 di1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你做作业的时候要专心一点。
examples.english_sentence: You need to concentrate more when you do your homework.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好專心咁聽老師講書。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyun1 sam1 gam2 teng1 lou5 si1 gong2 syu1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很专心地听老师讲课。
examples.english_sentence: He is listening to the teacher very attentively.

english_meaning: Concentrate one's attention; wholehearted and undivided attention; single-minded
explanation_mandarin: 形容注意力非常集中，心无旁骛，目标明确。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being completely focused, with no distractions and a clear goal.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢溫書嘅時候好專心一致，乜嘢都聽唔到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wan1 syu1 ge3 si4 hau6 hou2 zyun1 sam1 jat1 zi3, mat1 je5 dou1 teng1 m4 dou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他学习的时候非常专心一致，什么都听不到。
examples.english_sentence: When he studies, he is very focused, he can't hear anything.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 要成功，就要專心一致咁去做一件事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jiu3 sing4 gung1, zau6 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 jat1 zi3 gam2 heoi3 zou6 jat1 gin6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 要成功，就要专心一致地去做一件事。
examples.english_sentence: To be successful, you need to concentrate and do one thing wholeheartedly.

english_meaning: wholehearted devotion; single-mindedness; to concentrate one's attention
explanation_mandarin: 形容一心一意，集中精神。
explanation_english: Describes a state of being completely focused and devoted to something; single-minded.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嘅時候要專心致志，唔好諗其他嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 ge3 si4 hau6 jiu3 zyun1 sam1 zi3 zi3, m4 hou2 nim2 kei4 taa1 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 考试的时候要专心致志，不要想其他的事情。
examples.english_sentence: During exams, you need to concentrate and not think about anything else.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好專心致志，所以做得好快。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 sam1 zi3 zi3, so2 ji5 zou6 dak1 hou2 faai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作非常专心致志，所以做得很快。
examples.english_sentence: He is very focused on his work, so he gets it done quickly.

english_meaning: Specialist, Professional, Expert, Talent
explanation_mandarin: 指在某一特定领域具有专门知识和技能的人才。
explanation_english: Refers to a person with specialized knowledge and skills in a specific field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 香港政府需要更多嘅資訊科技專才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 zing3 fu2 seoi1 jiu3 gang3 do1 ge3 zi1 seon3 fo1 gei6 zyun1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 香港政府需要更多的信息技术专业人才。
examples.english_sentence: The Hong Kong government needs more IT specialists.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好重視培訓專才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 zung6 si6 pui4 fan3 zyun1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很重视培养专业人才。
examples.english_sentence: This company highly values the training of professionals.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺金融界係個專才。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gam1 jung4 gaai3 hai6 go3 zyun1 coi4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在金融界是个专业人才。
examples.english_sentence: He is a specialist in the financial industry.

english_meaning: dictatorship; autocracy; absolute rule
explanation_mandarin: 指少数人或一个政党掌握全部权力，实行独裁统治的政治制度。
explanation_english: A political system in which a small group of people or a single political party holds absolute power and exercises autocratic rule; dictatorship.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 有啲人認為呢個政府係行緊專政嘅路線。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jau5 di1 jan4 jing6 wai4 ni1 go3 zing3 fu2 hai6 hang4 gan2 zyun1 zing3 ge3 lou6 sin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 有些人认为这个政府正在走专政的路线。
examples.english_sentence: Some people think this government is taking the path of dictatorship.

english_meaning: proper noun
explanation_mandarin: 指代表特定人、地点、组织、事物、事件等的名词，通常需要大写。
explanation_english: A noun that designates a particular being, place, or thing and is not used to denote a class of things. It is usually capitalized.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「香港」係一個專有名詞嚟嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: 「hoeng1 gong2」 hai6 jat1 go3 zyun1 jau5 ming4 ci4 lai4 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “香港”是一个专有名词。
examples.english_sentence: "Hong Kong" is a proper noun.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺英文入面，專有名詞嘅首字母要大寫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 jing1 man2 jap6 min6, zyun1 jau5 ming4 ci4 ge3 sau2 zi6 mou5 jiu3 daai6 se2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在英语中，专有名词的首字母要大写。
examples.english_sentence: In English, proper nouns are capitalized.

english_meaning: project; case; special task
explanation_mandarin: 指為了解決特定問題或完成特定目標而制定的計劃或任務。
explanation_english: A planned set of related activities designed to achieve a particular aim or objective; a specific case or assignment.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司今年有幾個新嘅專案要做。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 jau5 gei2 go3 san1 ge3 zyun1 on3 jiu3 zou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们公司今年有几个新的项目要做。
examples.english_sentence: Our company has several new projects to work on this year.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢個專案好複雜，要好多人合作先得。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 zyun1 on3 hou2 fuk1 zaap6, jiu3 hou2 do1 jan4 hap6 zok3 sin1 dak1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这个项目很复杂，需要很多人合作才行。
examples.english_sentence: This project is very complex and requires a lot of people to work together.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢負責管理呢個專案嘅所有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fu6 zaak3 gun2 lei5 ni1 go3 zyun1 on3 ge3 so2 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他负责管理这个项目的所有事情。
examples.english_sentence: He is responsible for managing everything in this project.

english_meaning: professional; expertise; specialized
explanation_mandarin: 形容具有专门的知识、技能或经验；指某行业或职业的性质。
explanation_english: Describing someone who possesses specialized knowledge, skills, or experience; refers to the nature of a particular industry or occupation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好專業，好值得信賴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 jip6, hou2 zik6 dak1 seon3 laai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他工作很专业，很值得信赖。
examples.english_sentence: He's very professional in his work and very trustworthy.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 醫生需要有專業嘅知識先可以醫好病人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ji1 sang1 seoi1 jiu3 jau5 zyun1 jip6 ge3 zi1 sik1 sin1 ho2 ji5 ji1 hou2 beng6 jan2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 医生需要有专业的知识才能治好病人。
examples.english_sentence: Doctors need to have professional knowledge to be able to cure patients.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅專業係會計。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 hai6 wui6 gai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的专业是会计。
examples.english_sentence: His major is accounting.

mandarin_meaning: 职业操守, 专业精神
english_meaning: professional ethics, professional conduct, professional integrity
explanation_mandarin: 指从事某种职业的人所应遵守的道德规范和行为准则。
explanation_english: Refers to the moral principles and code of conduct that people engaged in a certain profession should adhere to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 作為醫生，佢嘅專業操守好值得我哋學習。
examples.jyutping_sentence: zok3 wai4 ji1 sang1, keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 cou1 sau2 hou2 zik6 dak1 ngo5 dei6 hok6 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 作为医生，他的职业操守非常值得我们学习。
examples.english_sentence: As a doctor, his professional ethics are very worthy of our learning.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 一間公司嘅成功，除咗盈利之外，專業操守都好重要。
examples.jyutping_sentence: jat1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 sing4 gung1, ceoi4 zo2 jing4 lei6 zi1 ngoi6, zyun1 jip6 cou1 sau2 dou1 hou2 zung6 jiu3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 一间公司的成功，除了盈利之外，职业操守也很重要。
examples.english_sentence: For a company to succeed, besides profitability, professional ethics are also very important.

english_meaning: Professional exam/test
explanation_mandarin: 指针对某一专业的技能或知识进行的考试。
explanation_english: Refers to an exam or test conducted to assess skills or knowledge related to a specific profession or field.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要考個會計嘅專業試，好緊張啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 haau2 go3 wui2 gai3 ge3 zyun1 jip6 si3, hou2 gan2 zoeng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要考会计的专业考试，好紧张啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have an accounting professional exam tomorrow, I'm so nervous!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢考咗好多次律師嘅專業試先 pass 到。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 haau2 zo2 hou2 do1 ci3 leot6 si1 ge3 zyun1 jip6 si3 sin1 pass dou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他考了很多次律师的专业考试才通过。
examples.english_sentence: He took the lawyer's professional exam many times before passing.

english_meaning: private plane, special plane
explanation_mandarin: 专门为特定人员或用途而准备的飞机。
explanation_english: A plane specifically designated for a particular person or purpose, often used for VIPs or special missions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢搭專機去外國開會。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daap3 zyun1 gei1 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 hoi1 wui2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他乘坐专机去国外开会。
examples.english_sentence: He took a private plane to attend a meeting abroad.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽講佢係搭專機嚟香港嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 gong2 keoi5 hai6 daap3 zyun1 gei1 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 听说他是乘坐专机来香港的。
examples.english_sentence: I heard that he came to Hong Kong by private plane.

english_meaning: domineering, arbitrary, autocratic
explanation_mandarin: 形容人独断专行，不讲道理，一意孤行。
explanation_english: Describing someone as domineering, arbitrary, and acting autocratically without regard for reason or others' opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好專橫，成日都唔聽人哋意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 waang4, seng4 jat6 dou1 m4 ting1 jan4 dei6 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很专横，总是听不进别人的意见。
examples.english_sentence: He is very domineering at work and never listens to other people's opinions.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁專橫啦，大家一齊商量吓先啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zyun1 waang4 laa1, daai6 gaa1 jat1 cai4 seong1 loeng4 haa5 sin1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 别这么专横，大家一起商量一下吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so domineering, let's discuss it together first.

english_meaning: Boutique counter, branded counter, concession stand (in a department store)
explanation_mandarin: 指百货公司或商场里销售特定品牌商品的柜台。
explanation_english: Refers to a counter in a department store or shopping mall that sells products of a specific brand.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去Chanel嘅專櫃睇吓手袋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 Chanel ge3 zyun1 gwai6 tai2 haa5 sau2 doi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去香奈儿的专柜看看包包。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the Chanel boutique counter to take a look at the handbags.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間百貨公司好多名牌都有專櫃。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 baak3 fo3 gung1 si1 hou2 do1 ming4 paai4 dou1 jau5 zyun1 gwai6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家百货公司很多名牌都有专柜。
examples.english_sentence: Many famous brands have their own boutique counters in this department store.

english_meaning: column (in a newspaper, magazine, etc.)
explanation_mandarin: 报纸、杂志等刊物上，由特定作者或围绕特定主题定期发表文章的栏目。
explanation_english: A regular section in a newspaper, magazine, or website devoted to a particular subject or writer.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺份報紙度有個財經專欄，好受歡迎㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 fan6 bou3 zi2 dou6 jau5 go3 coi4 ging1 zyun1 laan4, hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在报纸上有一个财经专栏，很受欢迎。
examples.english_sentence: He has a financial column in the newspaper, and it's very popular.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意睇佢個影評專欄，寫得好到位。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 tai2 keoi5 go3 jing2 ping3 zyun1 laan4, se2 dak1 hou2 dou3 wai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很喜欢看他的影评专栏，写得很到位。
examples.english_sentence: I really like reading his movie review column; it's very insightful.

english_meaning: autocratic; dictatorial; to abuse power; to wield power arbitrarily
explanation_mandarin: 指独自掌握权力，行事独断专行，不听取他人意见。
explanation_english: Describes someone who holds and abuses power alone, acting arbitrarily without listening to others' opinions; autocratic or dictatorial behavior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好專權，乜都自己話事。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 zyun1 kyun4, mat1 dou1 zi6 gei2 waa6 si6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他做事很专权，什么都自己说了算。
examples.english_sentence: He's very autocratic in his work, deciding everything himself.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好咁專權啦，聽吓其他人嘅意見啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 gam3 zyun1 kyun4 laa1, ting1 haa5 kei4 taa1 jan4 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不要那么专权了，听听别人的意见吧。
examples.english_sentence: Don't be so dictatorial, listen to other people's opinions.

mandarin_meaning: 专门治疗；专精；专门对付
english_meaning: Specialize in treating; Specialize in; Specifically deals with; Good at dealing with (something undesirable)
explanation_mandarin: 原指专门治疗某种疾病。引申为专长于处理某种问题或对付某种情况。含有幽默或调侃的意味，指擅长解决特定（通常是不好的）情况。
explanation_english: Originally referring to specializing in treating a specific disease. It extends to meaning specializing in handling a particular problem or dealing with a specific situation. Often used humorously or sarcastically, implying being good at dealing with a specific (usually undesirable) situation.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我專治小朋友扭計㗎，你交俾我就得啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyun1 zi6 siu2 pang4 jau5 nau1 gai2 gaa3, nei5 gaau1 bei2 ngo5 zau6 dak1 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我专门对付小孩耍赖的，你交给我就可以了。
examples.english_sentence: I specialize in dealing with children's tantrums; just leave it to me.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專治啲唔聽話嘅學生。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 zi6 di1 m4 ting1 waa6 ge3 hok6 sang1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他专门对付那些不听话的学生。
examples.english_sentence: He's good at dealing with disobedient students.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間診所專治皮膚病。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 can2 so2 zyun1 zi6 pei4 fu1 beng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家诊所专门治疗皮肤病。
examples.english_sentence: This clinic specializes in treating skin diseases.

english_meaning: to concentrate, to focus, to be attentive
explanation_mandarin: 集中精神，用心去做某件事情。也可以形容一个人非常专心。
explanation_english: To concentrate one's attention or energy on something. Can also describe someone who is very focused.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 考試嗰陣要專注啲，唔好諗其他嘢。

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係專責負責處理客戶投訴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 zyun1 zaak3 fu6 zaak3 cyu2 lei5 haak3 wu6 tau4 sou3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是专门负责处理客户投诉的。
examples.english_sentence: He is specifically responsible for handling customer complaints.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋需要搵個專責嘅人嚟做呢個項目。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 seoi1 jiu3 wan2 go3 zyun1 zaak3 ge3 jan4 lai4 zou6 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要找一个专责的人来做这个项目。
examples.english_sentence: We need to find a dedicated person to do this project.

english_meaning: private car, dedicated vehicle, chartered vehicle
explanation_mandarin: 专门用途或特别安排的车辆。
explanation_english: A vehicle designated for a specific purpose or arranged for exclusive use. Can refer to a private car service like Uber Black, or a chartered bus or train for a specific group.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋搭專車去機場，舒服好多。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 daap3 zyun1 ce1 heoi3 gei1 coeng4, syu1 fuk6 ho2 do1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们坐专车去机场，舒服多了。
examples.english_sentence: We took a private car to the airport, it's much more comfortable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 公司安排咗專車接送員工放工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 on1 paai4 zo2 zyun1 ce1 zip3 sung3 wun4 gung1 fong3 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 公司安排了专车接送员工下班。
examples.english_sentence: The company arranged a dedicated vehicle to pick up and drop off employees after work.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋包咗架專車去旅行。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 baau1 zo2 gaa3 zyun1 ce1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们包了一辆专车去旅行。
examples.english_sentence: They chartered a car for their trip.

english_meaning: album (music)
explanation_mandarin: 通常指音乐专辑，也可能指其他类型的作品合集。
explanation_english: Generally refers to a music album, but can also refer to a collection of other types of works.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我好期待佢嘅新專輯。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 kei5 doi6 keoi5 ge3 san1 zyun1 zaap6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很期待他的新专辑。
examples.english_sentence: I'm really looking forward to his new album.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢隻專輯賣得好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 zek3 zyun1 zaap6 maai6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这张专辑卖得很好。
examples.english_sentence: This album is selling very well.

english_meaning: specialty, expertise, strong point, forte
explanation_mandarin: 特别擅长的技能或领域。
explanation_english: A special skill or area of expertise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅專長係畫畫。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zyun1 coeng4 hai6 waa2 waa2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的特长是画画。
examples.english_sentence: His specialty is drawing.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你嘅專長係乜嘢呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 zyun1 coeng4 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你的特长是什么呀？
examples.english_sentence: What is your specialty?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢喺電腦方面好有專長。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 din6 nou5 fong1 min6 hou2 jau5 zyun1 coeng4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他在电脑方面很有特长。
examples.english_sentence: He has a great expertise in computers.

english_meaning: specialized; specialist; specially; particularly; expressly
explanation_mandarin: 形容词：指专门从事某一行业或具有某项技能的。副词：指特意，特地。
explanation_english: Adjective: Specialized in a particular field or having a specific skill. Adverb: Specifically; expressly; for a particular purpose.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢專門幫人補衫㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 bou2 saam1 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他是专门帮人补衣服的。
examples.english_sentence: He specializes in mending clothes for people.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我專門嚟睇你㗎！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zyun1 mun4 lai4 tai2 nei5 gaa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我是专门来看你的！
examples.english_sentence: I came specially to see you!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間舖頭專門賣日本零食。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 zyun1 mun4 maai6 jat6 bun2 ling4 sik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家店专门卖日本零食。
examples.english_sentence: This shop specializes in selling Japanese snacks.

english_meaning: specialty store, boutique, exclusive shop
explanation_mandarin: 专门经营某种商品的商店。与百货公司等售卖多种商品的商店相对。
explanation_english: A store that specializes in selling a particular type of product, often from a single brand. It contrasts with department stores that sell a variety of goods.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我想去Nike嘅專門店買對新波鞋。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 Nike ge3 zyun1 mun4 dim3 maai5 deoi3 san1 bo1 haai2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我想去耐克的专卖店买双新运动鞋。
examples.english_sentence: I want to go to the Nike store to buy a new pair of sneakers.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間名牌嘅專門店啲嘢好貴㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 ming4 paai2 ge3 zyun1 mun4 dim3 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家名牌的专卖店的东西很贵的。
examples.english_sentence: The items in this brand-name boutique are very expensive.

english_meaning: fan page, dedicated page, special page
explanation_mandarin: 在互联网上，通常指在社交媒体平台（如Facebook）上创建的，专注于特定主题、品牌或个人的页面。
explanation_english: On the internet, usually refers to a page created on social media platforms (such as Facebook) that focuses on a specific topic, brand, or individual.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺Facebook開咗個專頁，歡迎大家嚟Like。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 Facebook hoi1 zo2 go3 zyun1 jip6, fun1 ying4 daai6 ga1 lai4 Like.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们在Facebook上开了一个专页，欢迎大家来点赞。
examples.english_sentence: We've created a fan page on Facebook, welcome everyone to like it.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅專頁好多人follow，因為佢成日post靚相。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 hou2 do1 jan4 follow, yan1 wai6 keoi5 sing4 jat6 post leng3 soeng2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 她的专页很多人关注，因为她经常发漂亮的照片。
examples.english_sentence: Her fan page has a lot of followers because she often posts beautiful photos.

english_meaning: special topic, feature article, thematic
explanation_mandarin: 针对某一特定主题进行的深入研究、报道或讨论。
explanation_english: A special topic, feature article, or thematic study focusing on a specific subject with in-depth research, reporting, or discussion.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今個禮拜嘅新聞節目做咗一個關於人口老化嘅專題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 lai5 baai3 ge3 san1 man4 zit3 muk6 zou6 zo2 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 jan4 hau2 lou5 faa3 ge3 zyun1 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这周的新闻节目做了一个关于人口老龄化的专题。
examples.english_sentence: This week's news program did a special topic on population aging.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢份畢業論文係一個關於香港電影嘅專題研究。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 bat1 jip6 leon6 man4 hai6 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 hoeng1 gong2 din6 jing2 ge3 zyun1 tai4 jin4 gau3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的毕业论文是一个关于香港电影的专题研究。
examples.english_sentence: His graduation thesis is a special research topic on Hong Kong cinema.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要準備一個關於環境保護嘅專題報告。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 jat1 go3 gwaan1 jyu1 waan4 ging2 bou2 wu6 ge3 zyun1 tai4 bou3 gou3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们需要准备一个关于环境保护的专题报告。
examples.english_sentence: We need to prepare a special report on environmental protection.

english_meaning: to comfort, to console, to soothe; to reassure
explanation_mandarin: 安抚，慰问，使心情安定。
explanation_english: To comfort, console, or soothe someone; to provide reassurance and ease their worries or pain.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尉下佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 wai3 haa5 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该安慰他。
examples.english_sentence: We should comfort him/her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 聽日落去探下佢，尉下佢先。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 lok6 heoi3 taam3 haa5 keoi5, wai3 haa5 keoi5 sin1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 明天下去看看他，先安慰他。
examples.english_sentence: Go down and visit him tomorrow, and comfort him first.

english_meaning: to respect, to honour, venerable
explanation_mandarin: 表示尊敬、敬重，形容值得尊敬的。
explanation_english: To respect, to honour. Also used to describe someone or something that is venerable or worthy of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你要尊重長輩啊。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 zoeng2 bui3 aa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你要尊重长辈啊。
examples.english_sentence: You need to respect your elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢位係我哋嘅尊師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 wai2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 ge3 zyun1 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这位是我们的尊师。
examples.english_sentence: This is our venerable teacher.

english_meaning: hierarchy; social status; seniority
explanation_mandarin: 指社会等级制度中的尊贵和卑贱，高低之分。
explanation_english: Refers to the hierarchy or social status distinctions within a social system, the difference between the noble and the humble, the superior and the inferior.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司好講究尊卑，唔可以亂嚟㗎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hou2 gong2 gau3 zyun1 bei1, m4 ho2 ji5 lyun6 lai4 gaa3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司很讲究尊卑，不可以随便的。
examples.english_sentence: This company is very particular about hierarchy; you can't be careless.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 古代社會好注重尊卑有序。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gu2 doi6 se5 wui2 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zyun1 bei1 jau5 seoi6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 古代社会很注重尊卑有序。
examples.english_sentence: Ancient society placed great emphasis on hierarchical order.

english_meaning: dignity; honor; self-respect
explanation_mandarin: 指人应有的体面和受到尊重的权利。
explanation_english: The state or quality of being worthy of honor or respect; a sense of pride in oneself; self-respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢為咗尊嚴，寧願辭職都唔肯妥協。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 wai6 zo2 zyun1 ngaam4, ning4 jyun2 ci4 zik1 dou1 m4 hang2 to2 hip3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 为了尊严，他宁愿辞职也不肯妥协。
examples.english_sentence: For the sake of his dignity, he'd rather resign than compromise.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要尊重每個人嘅尊嚴。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 mui5 go3 jan4 ge3 zyun1 ngaam4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要尊重每个人的尊严。
examples.english_sentence: We must respect the dignity of every person.

mandarin_meaning: 尊容 (zūn róng) / 尊颜 (zūn yán)
english_meaning: Your honourable countenance / face (used to politely refer to someone's face)
explanation_mandarin: 一种客气的说法，用来称呼对方的容貌，表示尊敬。通常在正式场合或对长辈使用。
explanation_english: A polite and respectful way to refer to someone's face or appearance. Commonly used in formal settings or when addressing elders or superiors.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，請問我可以影低你嘅尊容嗎？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si1, ching2 man6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 ying2 dai1 nei5 ge3 zyun1 yung4 maa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，请问我可以拍下您的尊容吗？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, may I take a picture of your honourable face?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今日能夠見到你嘅尊容，真係好開心。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 nang4 gau3 gin3 dou2 nei5 ge3 zyun1 yung4, zan1 hai6 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 今天能够见到您的尊容，真是很高兴。
examples.english_sentence: It's truly a pleasure to see your honourable face today.

english_meaning: to respect, to revere, to esteem, to venerate
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬和推崇。表示对某人或某事物高度的敬佩和重视。
explanation_english: To respect and admire someone or something highly. To regard with great reverence and esteem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該尊崇長輩嘅智慧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zyun1 sung4 zoeng2 bui3 ge3 zhi3 wai3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尊敬长辈的智慧。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect the wisdom of elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好尊崇呢位藝術家。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyun1 sung4 ni1 wai2 ngai6 seot1 gaa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尊敬这位艺术家。
examples.english_sentence: He greatly admires this artist.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋尊崇自由同平等嘅價值觀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 zyun1 sung4 zi6 jau4 tung4 ping4 dang2 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们尊崇自由和平等的价值观。
examples.english_sentence: They revere the values of freedom and equality.

english_meaning: to respect teachers and value education
explanation_mandarin: 尊重老师，重视教育的道德观念。强调师道尊严，推崇知识和教育的重要性。
explanation_english: An idiom that emphasizes the importance of respecting teachers and valuing education. It highlights the authority of teachers and promotes the significance of knowledge and education.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該要尊師重道，唔好對老師冇禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 jiu3 zyun1 si1 zung6 dou6, m4 hou2 deoi3 lou5 si1 mou5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该要尊师重道，不要对老师没有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect teachers and value education; we shouldn't be disrespectful to them.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋間學校好注重尊師重道嘅精神，所以啲學生都好有禮貌。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gaan1 hok6 haau6 hou2 zyu3 zung6 zyun1 si1 zung6 dou6 ge3 jing1 san4, so2 ji5 di1 hok6 sang1 dou1 hou2 jau5 lai5 maau6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们学校很注重尊师重道的精神，所以学生们都很有礼貌。
examples.english_sentence: Their school emphasizes the spirit of respecting teachers and valuing education, so the students are very polite.

english_meaning: respect; to respect
explanation_mandarin: 表示尊重、敬重的意思。可以是动词，表示尊敬的动作，也可以是形容词，表示值得尊敬的。
explanation_english: To respect, revere, or esteem. Can be used as a verb describing the act of respecting, or as an adjective describing something/someone worthy of respect.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該尊敬長輩。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 zyun1 ging3 zoeng2 bui3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尊敬长辈。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect our elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢係一個好尊敬嘅老師。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 zyun1 ging3 ge3 lou5 si1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他/她是一个很受尊敬的老师。
examples.english_sentence: He/She is a very respected teacher.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢嘅專業能力好尊敬。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 zyun1 jip6 nang4 lik6 hou2 zyun1 ging3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我很尊敬他的专业能力。
examples.english_sentence: I have great respect for his/her professional ability.

english_meaning: honorific title; to address someone respectfully
explanation_mandarin: 尊敬地称呼；表示尊敬的称谓。
explanation_english: A respectful term of address; to address someone with respect and using honorifics.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該用「李先生」呢個尊稱嚟稱呼佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 yung6 "lei5 sin1 saang1" ni1 go3 zyun1 cing1 lai4 cing1 fu1 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该用“李先生”这个尊称来称呼他。
examples.english_sentence: We should address him with the honorific title "Mr. Lee".

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺商業場合，用尊稱係好重要嘅禮儀。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 soeng1 jip6 coeng4 hap6, yung6 zyun1 cing1 hai6 hou2 zung6 jiu3 ge3 lai5 ngai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在商业场合，使用尊称是非常重要的礼仪。
examples.english_sentence: In business settings, using honorifics is very important etiquette.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，請問點樣尊稱你？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 ji3 si1, cing2 man6 dim2 joeng2 zyun1 cing1 nei5?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，请问怎么尊称您？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, how should I address you respectfully?

english_meaning: honorable, respectable, esteemed, precious, noble
explanation_mandarin: 指地位高，值得尊敬，非常贵重。
explanation_english: Describes someone or something of high status, deserving of respect, and of great value.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間酒店啲服務好尊貴嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 zau2 dim3 di1 fuk6 mou6 hou2 zyun1 gwai3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家酒店的服务非常尊贵。
examples.english_sentence: The service at this hotel is very honorable.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢嘅身份好尊貴，我哋要尊重佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ge3 san1 fan2 hou2 zyun1 gwai3, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zyun1 zung6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他的身份很尊贵，我们要尊重他。
examples.english_sentence: His status is very noble, we must respect him.

english_meaning: respect; to value; to esteem; to take seriously
explanation_mandarin: 重视并敬重; 表示尊敬或重视的心情或态度。
explanation_english: To show regard, appreciation, and consideration for someone or something. It implies acknowledging their worth, value, or rights.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該尊重長輩嘅意見。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jing1 goi1 zyun1 zung6 zoeng2 bui3 ge3 ji3 gin3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们应该尊重长辈的意见。
examples.english_sentence: We should respect the opinions of our elders.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好尊重自己嘅文化傳統。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 zyun1 zung6 zi6 gei2 ge3 man4 faa3 cyun4 tung2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很尊重自己的文化传统。
examples.english_sentence: He respects his own cultural traditions very much.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔該尊重吓人哋嘅私隱啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 goi1 zyun1 zung6 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 si1 yan2 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请尊重一下别人的隐私吧。
examples.english_sentence: Please respect other people's privacy.

english_meaning: You (honorific); Your esteemed self
explanation_mandarin: 一种比较正式和尊敬的称呼，用来称呼对方。
explanation_english: A formal and respectful way to address someone. It shows deference and politeness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔知尊駕貴姓呀？
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 zi1 zyun1 gaa3 gwai3 sing3 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 请问您贵姓？
examples.english_sentence: May I ask your honorable surname?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 唔好意思，尊駕擋住我條路。
examples.jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 ji3 si3, zyun1 gaa3 dong2 zyu6 ngo5 tiu4 lou6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 不好意思，您挡住我的路了。
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, you are blocking my way.

english_meaning: to look for; to seek; to find
explanation_mandarin: 寻找，找寻。表示为了找到某人或某物而进行活动。
explanation_english: To look for; to seek; to try to find something or someone that is lost or not easily available.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我喺度尋緊我嘅鎖匙。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hai2 dou6 cam4 gan2 ngo5 ge3 so2 si4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我正在找我的钥匙。

examples.mandarin_sentence: 他一直在寻找一个可以共度余生的人。
examples.english_sentence: He has been seeking someone to spend the rest of his life with.

english_meaning: to seek; to search out; to look for
explanation_mandarin: 寻找并访问。
explanation_english: To search for and visit.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋想尋訪一啲歷史建築。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 soeng2 cam4 fong2 jat1 di1 lik6 si2 gin3 zuk1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们想寻访一些历史建筑。
examples.english_sentence: We want to seek out some historical buildings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋四處尋訪失散嘅親人。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 sei3 cyu3 cam4 fong2 sat1 saan3 ge3 can1 jan4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们四处寻访失散的亲人。
examples.english_sentence: They are searching everywhere for their lost relatives.

english_meaning: correct, right, towards, pair, couple, to face
explanation_mandarin: 表示正确，朝向，一对等意思。根据语境有不同的含义。
explanation_english: Indicates correctness, direction, a pair, etc. The meaning varies depending on the context.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢條問題嘅答案係對嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 tiu4 man6 tai4 ge3 daap3 aan3 hai6 deoi3 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这道问题的答案是对的。
examples.english_sentence: The answer to this question is correct.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我對佢好好。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 hou2 hou2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我对她很好。
examples.english_sentence: I am very good to her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢對鞋幾靚喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 deoi3 haai4 gei2 leng3 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这双鞋挺好看的。
examples.english_sentence: These shoes are quite pretty.

mandarin_meaning: 碰上; 对上; 遇到
english_meaning: To match up with; to meet; to go up against; to encounter; to compare
explanation_mandarin: 1. 指时间或事件的吻合。2. 指对抗或竞争。3. 指遇到或碰上。
explanation_english: 1. Refers to the matching of time or events. 2. Refers to confrontation or competition. 3. Refers to encountering or meeting someone/something.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我聽日要對上老細，好驚啊！
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 deoi3 soeng6 lou5 sai3, hou2 geng1 aa3!
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我明天要和老板见面，好害怕啊！
examples.english_sentence: I have to meet with my boss tomorrow, I'm so scared!

examples.cantonese_sentence: 今次比賽我哋隊波對上勁敵。
examples.jyutping_sentence: gam1 ci3 bei2 coi3 ngo5 dei6 deoi2 bo1 deoi3 soeng6 ging6 dik6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这次比赛我们队要对上强劲的对手。
examples.english_sentence: This time, our team is going up against a strong opponent in the competition.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我份報告對上佢嘅，發現好多數據都唔同。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 fan6 bou3 gou3 deoi3 soeng6 keoi5 ge3, faat3 jin6 hou2 do1 sou3 geoi3 dou1 m4 tung4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我把我的报告和他（她）的对照了一下，发现很多数据都不一样。
examples.english_sentence: I compared my report with his/hers and found that a lot of the data is different.

english_meaning: sorry, excuse me
explanation_mandarin: 表示道歉、请求原谅或表达歉意。
explanation_english: Expressing regret, apology, or asking for forgiveness; also used to get someone's attention politely.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對唔住，我唔係有心嘅。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 m4 zyu6, ngo5 m4 hai6 jau5 sam1 ge3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，我不是故意的。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I didn't mean to.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對不起，請問洗手間喺邊啊？
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 bat1 hei2, cing2 man6 sai2 sau2 gaan1 hai2 bin1 aa3?
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，请问洗手间在哪里？
examples.english_sentence: Excuse me, where is the restroom?

examples.cantonese_sentence: 對不起，我遲到咗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: deoi3 bat1 hei2, ngo5 ci4 dou3 zo2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 对不起，我迟到了。
examples.english_sentence: Sorry, I'm late.

english_meaning: To focus on the issue, not the person; To be objective and impartial
explanation_mandarin: 指处理事情时，只针对事情本身的问题，不针对涉事的人，保持客观公正的态度。
explanation_english: This idiom means to address an issue or problem objectively, focusing on the facts and evidence rather than personal feelings or biases against the individual involved. It emphasizes impartiality and fairness.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要對事不對人，唔好因為佢係你朋友就包庇佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 deoi3 si6 bat1 deoi3 jan4, m4 hou2 jan1 wai4 keoi5 hai6 nei5 pang4 jau5 zau6 baau1 bei3 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要对事不对人，不要因为他是你朋友就包庇他。
examples.english_sentence: We need to focus on the issue, not the person. Don't protect him just because he's your friend.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 喺工作上，我哋應該對事不對人，咁樣先可以解決問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: hai2 gung1 zok3 soeng6, ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 deoi3 si6 bat1 deoi3 jan4, gam2 joeng2 sin1 ho2 ji5 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 在工作上，我们应该对事不对人，这样才可以解决问题。
examples.english_sentence: At work, we should focus on the issue, not the person, so we can solve problems.

english_meaning: To have feelings for someone; to be interested in someone romantically.
explanation_mandarin: 指对某人抱有好感，有恋爱的情愫。
explanation_english: Refers to having a good impression of someone, often with romantic feelings.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢成日望住 Lisa，擺明對人有嘢啦。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 mong6 zyu6 Lisa, baai2 ming4 deoi3 jan4 jau5 je5 laa1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他总是看着Lisa，明显是对她有意思啦。
examples.english_sentence: He keeps looking at Lisa; it's obvious he has feelings for her.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 你唔好扮晒無嘢，我睇得出你對人有嘢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 baan6 saai3 mou5 je5, ngo5 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 deoi3 jan4 jau5 je5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 你别装没事，我看得出来你对她有意思。
examples.english_sentence: Don't pretend like nothing's happening; I can tell you have feelings for her.

english_meaning: antithesis; parallelism; a pair of lines in poetry where the words and grammatical structure are symmetrical
explanation_mandarin: 指诗词中相对的两句，其词性和结构对应，意义相互联系。
explanation_english: In poetry, '對仗' refers to a pair of lines where the words, grammatical structure, and meaning are symmetrical and related.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢兩句詩對仗好工整喎。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 loeng5 geoi3 si1 deoi3 zoeng6 hou2 gung1 zing2 wo3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这两句诗对仗很工整。
examples.english_sentence: The parallelism in these two lines of poetry is very well done.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 寫揮春嘅時候，要留意上下聯嘅對仗。
examples.jyutping_sentence: se2 fai1 ceon1 ge3 si4 hau6, jiu3 lau4 yi3 soeng6 haa6 lyun4 ge3 deoi3 zoeng6.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 写春联的时候，要注意上下联的对仗。
examples.english_sentence: When writing Spring Festival couplets, pay attention to the parallelism between the upper and lower lines.

english_meaning: to deal with; to cope with; to handle; to tackle
explanation_mandarin: 处理、应付（人或事）；使用手段或力量制服。
explanation_english: To deal with someone or something; to cope with a situation; to use means or force to subdue.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我唔知點樣對付佢。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zi1 dim2 joeng2 deoi3 fu6 keoi5.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我不知道该怎么对付他。
examples.english_sentence: I don't know how to deal with him.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 我哋要諗吓點樣對付呢個問題。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 nam2 haa5 dim2 joeng2 deoi3 fu6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 我们要想一下怎么对付这个问题。
examples.english_sentence: We need to think about how to tackle this problem.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢好識得對付啲麻煩嘅客。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 sik1 dak1 deoi3 fu6 di1 maa4 faan4 ge3 haak3.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他很懂得对付那些麻烦的客人。
examples.english_sentence: He knows how to handle difficult customers.

english_meaning: antithesis, parallelism (in literature)
explanation_mandarin: 一种修辞手法，把字数相等、结构相同或相似、意义相关或相反的两个句子或短语对称地排列在一起，也叫对仗。
explanation_english: A figure of speech in which two sentences or phrases of equal length, similar or identical structure, and related or contrasting meaning are arranged symmetrically; also known as parallelism or antithesis.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋寫嘅對聯用咗好多對偶嘅技巧。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 se2 ge3 deoi3 lyun4 yung6 zo2 hou2 do1 deoi3 ngau5 ge3 gei2 haau2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们写的对联使用了许多对偶的技巧。
examples.english_sentence: They used many antithesis techniques in the couplets they wrote.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 「天增歲月人增壽，春滿乾坤福滿門」呢句就係一個好經典嘅對偶例子。
examples.jyutping_sentence: tin1 zang1 seoi3 jyut6 jan4 zang1 sau6, ceon1 mun5 kin4 kwan1 fuk1 mun5 mun4 ne1 geoi3 zau6 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 ging1 din2 ge3 deoi3 ngau5 lai6 zi2.
examples.mandarin_sentence: “天增岁月人增寿，春满乾坤福满门”这句话就是一个很经典的对偶例子。
examples.english_sentence: “Heaven increases years, people increase life; Spring fills the universe, fortune fills the door” is a very classic example of antithesis.

english_meaning: internal; inward; domestic
explanation_mandarin: 指向内部的，涉及内部事务的。
explanation_english: Relating to or concerning the inside or internal affairs; domestic.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 呢間公司嘅政策主要係對內嘅，即係影響內部員工。
examples.jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 zing3 caak3 zyu2 jiu3 hai6 deoi3 noi6 ge3, zik1 hai6 jing2 hoeng2 noi6 bou6 yun4 gung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 这家公司的政策主要是对内的，意思是影响内部员工。
examples.english_sentence: This company's policy is mainly internal, meaning it affects internal employees.

examples.cantonese_sentence: 佢哋要加強對內嘅溝通。
examples.jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jiu3 gaa1 koeng4 deoi3 noi6 ge3 kau1 tung1.
examples.mandarin_sentence: 他们要加强对内的沟通。
examples.english_sentence: They need to strengthen internal communication.

english_meaning: facing; facing outwards; looking out onto
explanation_mandarin: 表示朝向某个方向，正对着某个事物。
